GEN 1:1 In the beginning God made the heaven and the earth.
GEN 1:2 But the earth was unseen and unready; and darkness was upon the abyss. And spirit of God bore upon the water.
GEN 1:3 And God said, Let there be light! And there was light.
GEN 1:4 And God beheld the light, that it was good. And God parted between the light and between the darkness.
GEN 1:5 And God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night. And there was evening and there was morning, day one.
GEN 1:6 And God said, Let there be a firmament in the midst of the water, and let it be for parting between water and water!
GEN 1:7 And God made the firmament. And God parted between the water which was underneath the firmament, and between the water above the firmament.
GEN 1:8 And God called the firmament Heaven. And God beheld that it was good. And there was evening and there was morning, the second day.
GEN 1:9 And God said, Let the water underneath the heaven come together into one gathering, and let the dry land appear! And it was so. And the water underneath the heaven gathered together into its gatherings, and the dry land appeared.
GEN 1:10 And God called the dry land Earth. And the collections of the waters he called Seas. And God beheld that it was good.
GEN 1:11 And God said, Let the earth grow pasturage of grass sowing seed according to type, and according to likeness, and the fruitful tree producing fruit of which the seed of it is in it, according to type, upon the earth! And it was so.
GEN 1:12 And the earth brought forth pasturage of grass sowing seed according to type, and according to likeness; and the fruitful tree producing fruit, of which the seed of it is in it, according to type, upon the earth. And God beheld that it was good.
GEN 1:13 And there was evening and there was morning, the third day.
GEN 1:14 And God said, Let there be luminaries in the firmament of the heaven for giving light upon the earth, to part between the day and between the night! And let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and for years!
GEN 1:15 And let them be for giving light in the firmament of the heaven, so as to shine upon the earth! And it was so.
GEN 1:16 And God made the two great luminaries; the great luminary for beginnings of the day, and the lesser luminary for beginnings of the night, and the stars.
GEN 1:17 And God put them in the firmament of the heaven, so as to shine upon the earth,
GEN 1:18 and to begin the day and the night, and to part between the light and between the darkness. And God beheld that it was good.
GEN 1:19 And there was evening and there was morning, the fourth day.
GEN 1:20 And God said, Let the waters bring forth reptiles of living souls, and flying winged creatures upon the earth below the firmament of the heaven! And it was so.
GEN 1:21 And God made the great sea monsters, and every soul of living creatures of reptiles which the waters brought forth according to their types, and every feathered winged creature according to type. And God beheld that it was good.
GEN 1:22 And God blessed them, saying, Grow and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let the winged creatures be multiplied upon the earth!
GEN 1:23 And there was evening and there was morning, the fifth day.
GEN 1:24 And God said, Let the earth bring forth a living soul according to type - four-footed, and reptiles, and wild beasts of the earth according to type! And it was so.
GEN 1:25 And God made the wild beasts of the earth according to type, and the cattle according to their type, and all the reptiles of the earth according to type. And God beheld that it was good.
GEN 1:26 And God said, Let us make man according to our image, and according to likeness! And let them control the fishes of the sea, and the winged creatures of the heaven, and the cattle, and all the earth, and all the reptiles crawling upon the earth!
GEN 1:27 And God made man. According to the image of God he made him. Male and female he made them.
GEN 1:28 And God blessed them, saying, Grow and multiply, and fill the earth, and dominate it! And control the fishes of the sea, and the winged creatures of the heaven, and all the cattle, and all of the earth, and all of the reptiles crawling upon the earth!
GEN 1:29 And God said, Behold, I have given to you every grass fit for sowing a sowing of seed which is upon the earth, and every tree which has in itself a fruit seed fit for sowing; to you it will be for food,
GEN 1:30 and to all the wild beasts of the earth, and to all the winged creatures of the heaven, and to every reptile crawling upon the earth, which has in itself soul of life, even every green grass for food. And it was so.
GEN 1:31 And God beheld all as much as he made. And behold, it was exceedingly good. And there was evening and there was morning, the sixth day.
GEN 2:1 And the heaven and the earth were completed, and all the cosmos of them.
GEN 2:2 And God completed in the sixth day his works which he did. And he rested on the seventh day from all of his works which he did.
GEN 2:3 And God blessed the seventh day, and sanctified it; for in it he rested from all of his works - which God began to do.
GEN 2:4 This is the book of the origin of heaven and earth, when it became, in the day God made the heaven and the earth,
GEN 2:5 and every green field before it existed upon the earth, and all grass of the field before its rising. For not did the LORD God rain upon the earth, and there was not a man to work it.
GEN 2:6 But a spring ascended from out of the earth, and it watered all the face of the earth.
GEN 2:7 And God shaped man, taking dust from the earth, and breathed into his face breath of life; and man became a living soul.
GEN 2:8 And God planted paradise in Eden according to the east; and put there the man whom he shaped.
GEN 2:9 And God caused to rise up yet from out of the earth every beautiful tree to the sight, and good for food; and the tree of life in the midst of the paradise, and the tree to perceive knowing good and evil.
GEN 2:10 And a river goes forth from out of Eden to water the paradise; from there it separates into four sources.
GEN 2:11 The name to the one is Pison. This is the one encircling all the land of Havilah, of which the gold is there.
GEN 2:12 And the gold of that land is good. And there is the carbuncle and the leek colored stone.
GEN 2:13 And the name to the second river is Gihon; this is the one encircling all the land of Ethiopia.
GEN 2:14 And the third river is the Tigris. This is the one going forth over against the Assyrians. And the fourth river is the Euphrates.
GEN 2:15 And the LORD God took the man whom he shaped, and put him in the paradise to work it and to guard.
GEN 2:16 And the LORD God gave charge to Adam, saying, From all of a tree of the one in the paradise you shall eat food,
GEN 2:17 but from the tree of the knowing good and evil, you shall not eat from it; but in whatever day you should eat from it, to death you shall die.
GEN 2:18 And the LORD God said, It is not good for the man to be alone; let us make to him a helper according to him!
GEN 2:19 And God shaped yet from out of the earth all the wild beasts of the field, and all the winged creatures of the heaven. And he led them to Adam, to behold what he would call them. And all what ever Adam called it - the living soul, this was the name to it.
GEN 2:20 And Adam called names to all the cattle, and to all the winged creatures of the heaven, and to all the wild beasts of the field; but to Adam there was not found a helper likened to him.
GEN 2:21 And the LORD God put a change of state over Adam, and he slept. And he took one of his ribs, and supplied flesh against it.
GEN 2:22 And the LORD God built the rib, which he took from Adam, into a woman, and led her to Adam.
GEN 2:23 And Adam said, This now is bone from out of my bones, and flesh from out of my flesh; she shall be called Woman, for from out of the man she was taken.
GEN 2:24 Because of this a man shall leave his father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife, and the two shall be for one flesh.
GEN 2:25 And the two were naked, both Adam and his wife, and were not ashamed.
GEN 3:1 But the serpent was most skilled of all of the wild beasts upon the earth whom the LORD God made. And the serpent said to the woman, For why said God, No way should you eat from all of a tree of the paradise?
GEN 3:2 And the woman said, From fruit of the tree of the paradise we shall eat;
GEN 3:3 but from the fruit of the tree which is in the midst of the paradise, God said, Eat not from it, nor in any way touch it, that you should not die!
GEN 3:4 And the serpent said to the woman, Not to death will you die.
GEN 3:5 For God knows that in which ever day you should eat of it, your eyes will be opened wide, and you will be as gods, knowing good and evil.
GEN 3:6 And the woman beheld that the tree is good for food, and that it is pleasing to the eyes to behold, and is beautiful for contemplating. And having taken of the fruit of it, she ate, and she gave also to her husband with her, and they ate.
GEN 3:7 And the eyes of the two were opened wide, and they knew that they were naked. And they sewed leaves of a fig-tree, and made to themselves loincloths.
GEN 3:8 And they heard the sound of the LORD God walking in the paradise at dusk. And both Adam and his wife hid from the face of the LORD God in the midst of the tree of the paradise.
GEN 3:9 And God called Adam, and said to him, Adam, Where are you?
GEN 3:10 And he said to him, I heard your sound while walking in the paradise, and I feared, for I am naked, and I hid.
GEN 3:11 And God said to him, Who announced to you that you are naked, unless from the tree of which I gave charge to you, saying, This alone you are not to eat from it - you ate.
GEN 3:12 And Adam said, The woman whom you gave to be with me, she gave to me from the tree, and I ate.
GEN 3:13 And the LORD God said to the woman, What is this you did? And the woman said, The serpent deceived me, and I ate.
GEN 3:14 And the LORD God said to the serpent, Because you did this, accursed are you from all of the cattle, and from all of the wild beasts upon the earth. Upon your breast and belly you shall go, and earth you shall eat all the days of your life.
GEN 3:15 And I will put hatred between you and between the woman; and between your seed and between her seed. He will give heed to your head, and you will give heed to his heel.
GEN 3:16 And to the woman he said, In multiplying I will multiply your distresses, and your moanings. In distresses you will bear children, and to your husband your submission, and he will dominate you.
GEN 3:17 And to Adam he said, Because you hearkened to the voice of your wife, and ate from the tree of which I gave charge to you, saying, This alone you are not to eat from it - and you ate; accursed is the land among your works; in distresses you will eat it all the days of your life.
GEN 3:18 Thorn-bushes and thistles will rise to you, and you will eat the grass of the field.
GEN 3:19 By sweat of your face you will eat your bread, until the returning you into the earth from out of which you were taken. For earth you are and unto earth you will go.
GEN 3:20 And Adam called the name of his wife, Zoe, for she was mother of all the living.
GEN 3:21 And the LORD God made to Adam and to his wife garments of skins, and he clothed them.
GEN 3:22 And God said, Behold, Adam has become as one of us, to know good and evil. And now, lest at any time he might stretch out the hand, and should take from the tree of life, and should eat, and will live into the eon -
GEN 3:23 that the LORD God ejected him from out of the paradise of the delicacy, to work the earth from out of which he was taken.
GEN 3:24 And he cast out Adam, and settled him before the paradise of the delicacy; and he ordered the cherubim, and the flaming turning broadsword, to guard the way of the tree of life.
GEN 4:1 And Adam knew Eve his wife. And conceiving, she bore Cain, and said, I acquired a man through God.
GEN 4:2 And she added to bear his brother Abel. And Abel became a shepherd of sheep, but Cain was working the land.
GEN 4:3 And it came to pass after some days, Cain brought from the fruits of the land a sacrifice offering to the LORD.
GEN 4:4 And Abel brought also himself from the first-born of his sheep, and from his fatlings. And God looked upon Abel and upon his gifts.
GEN 4:5 But upon Cain and upon his sacrifices he did not take heed. And Cain fretted exceedingly, and became downcast in the face.
GEN 4:6 And the LORD God said to Cain, Why are you dejected, and why is your face downcast?
GEN 4:7 If not rightly you brought, but not rightly divided, you sinned? Be still, to you shall be his submission, and you will control him!
GEN 4:8 And Cain said to Abel his brother, Let us go into the plain. And it came to pass in their being in the plain, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and killed him.
GEN 4:9 And the LORD God said to Cain, Where is Abel your brother? And he said, I do not know. I am not the keeper of my brother.
GEN 4:10 And the LORD said, What have you done? The voice of the blood of your brother yells to me from out of the ground.
GEN 4:11 And now, accursed are you from the earth which gaped wide her mouth to receive the blood of your brother from out of your hand.
GEN 4:12 When you work the ground, and it adds not to give her strength to you, then in moaning and trembling you will be upon the earth.
GEN 4:13 And Cain said to the LORD, My fault is too great to forgive me.
GEN 4:14 If you cast me today from the face of the earth, and from your face, I will hide, and I will be moaning and trembling upon the earth; and it will be everyone finding me will kill me.
GEN 4:15 And the LORD God said to him, Not so, everyone killing Cain will be disabled by punishing seven times. And the LORD God put a sign to Cain for everyone finding him to not do away with him.
GEN 4:16 And Cain went forth from the face of God and lived in the land of Nod over against Eden.
GEN 4:17 And Cain knew his wife. And she, conceiving, bore Enoch. And he was building a city. And he named the city after the name of his son - Enoch.
GEN 4:18 And to Enoch was born Irad; and Irad procreated Mehujael; and Mehujael procreated Mathusala; and Mathusala procreated Lamech.
GEN 4:19 And Lamech took to himself two wives; the name to the one was Adah, and the name to the second was Zillah.
GEN 4:20 And Adah bore Jabel. This one was father of the ones living in tents, grazing cattle.
GEN 4:21 And the name to his brother was Jubal, this one was the one introducing the psaltery and harp.
GEN 4:22 But Zillah also herself bore Tubal-cain. And he was a hammer-smith brazier of brass and of iron. And the sister of Tubal-cain was Naamah.
GEN 4:23 And Lamech said to his own wives, Adah and Zillah, Hear my voice, O wives of Lamech! Give ear to my words! For I killed a man for giving a wound to me, even a young man for giving a stripe to me.
GEN 4:24 For punishment seven times is for Cain, but for Lamech, seventy times seven.
GEN 4:25 And Adam knew Eve his wife. And conceiving, she bore a son, and named his name Seth, saying, For God raised up to me another seed instead of Abel, whom Cain killed.
GEN 4:26 And to Seth was born a son. And he named his name Enos; this one hoped to call upon the name of the LORD God.

GEN 5:2 Male and female he made them; and he blessed them. And he named his name Adam, in which day he made them.
GEN 5:3 And Adam lived thirty and two hundred years. And he procreated a son according to his shape, and according to his image; and he named his name Seth.
GEN 5:4 And came to pass the days of Adam which he lived after his procreating Seth - seven hundred years. And he procreated sons and daughters.
GEN 5:5 And came to pass all the days of Adam which he lived - thirty and nine hundred years; and he died.
GEN 5:6 And Seth lived five and two hundred years; and he procreated Enos.
GEN 5:7 And Seth lived after his procreating Enos, seven years and seven hundred; and he procreated sons and daughters.
GEN 5:8 And came to pass all the days of Seth - twelve and nine hundred years; and he died.
GEN 5:9 And Enos lived a hundred ninety years, and he procreated Cainan.
GEN 5:10 And Enos lived after his procreating Cainan, fifteen years and seven hundred; and he procreated sons and daughters.
GEN 5:11 And came to pass all the days of Enos - five years and nine hundred; and he died.
GEN 5:12 And Cainan lived seventy and a hundred years; and he procreated Mahalaleel.
GEN 5:13 And Cainan lived, after his procreating Mahalaleel, forty and seven hundred years; and he procreated sons and daughters.
GEN 5:14 And came to pass all the days of Cainan - ten years and nine hundred; and he died.
GEN 5:15 And Mahalaleel lived five and sixty and a hundred years; and he procreated Jared.
GEN 5:16 And Mahalaleel lived, after his procreating Jared, thirty and seven hundred years; and he procreated sons and daughters.
GEN 5:17 And came to pass all the days of Mahalaleel - five and ninety and eight hundred years; and he died.
GEN 5:18 And Jared lived two and sixty years and a hundred; and he procreated Enoch.
GEN 5:19 And Jared lived after his procreating Enoch - eight hundred years; and he procreated sons and daughters.
GEN 5:20 And came to pass all the days of Jared - two and sixty and nine hundred years; and he died.
GEN 5:21 And Enoch lived five and sixty and a hundred years; and he procreated Mathusala.
GEN 5:22 And Enoch was well-pleasing to God. And Enoch lived, after his procreating Mathusala, two hundred years; and he procreated sons and daughters.
GEN 5:23 And came to pass all the days of Enoch - five and sixty and three hundred years.
GEN 5:24 And Enoch was well-pleasing to God. And he was not found, for God transposed him.
GEN 5:25 And Mathusala lived seven and eighty and a hundred years, and he procreated Lamech.
GEN 5:26 And Mathusala lived, after his procreating Lamech, two and eighty and seven hundred years; and he procreated sons and daughters.
GEN 5:27 And came to pass all the days of Mathusala which he lived - nine and sixty and nine hundred years; and he died.
GEN 5:28 And Lamech lived eight and eighty and a hundred years; and he procreated a son.
GEN 5:29 And he named his name Noah, saying, This one will rest us from our works, and from the distresses of our hands, and from the earth of which the LORD God cursed.
GEN 5:30 And Lamech lived, after his procreating Noah, five hundred and sixty and five years; and he procreated sons and daughters.
GEN 5:31 And came to pass all the days of Lamech - seven hundred and fifty three years; and he died.

GEN 6:1 And it came to pass when many men began to become upon the earth, and daughters were born to them,
GEN 6:2 and the sons of God were beholding the daughters of men, that they are good, that they took to themselves wives from all of whom they chose.
GEN 6:3 And the LORD God said, No way should my spirit stay with these men, on account of their being flesh; and their days will be a hundred twenty years.
GEN 6:4 And the giants were upon the earth in those days. And after that, the sons of God continually entered to the daughters of men, and procreated for themselves. Those were the giants from the eon, the renowned men.
GEN 6:5 And the LORD God beholding that the evils of men were multiplying upon the earth, and that all what man considered in his heart was diligently upon the wicked things all the days,
GEN 6:6 that God pondered that he made the man upon the earth - and he considered it.
GEN 6:7 And God said, I will wipe away the man, whom I made, from the face of the earth; from man unto beast, and from reptiles unto the winged creatures of the heaven; for I regreted that I made them.
GEN 6:8 But Noah found favor before the LORD God.
GEN 6:9 And these are the origins of Noah. Noah was a just man, being perfect in his generation - Noah was well-pleasing to God.
GEN 6:10 And Noah procreated three sons - Shem, Ham, Japheth.
GEN 6:11 But the earth was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled of iniquity.
GEN 6:12 And the LORD God beheld the earth, and it was being corrupted; for all flesh corrupted its way upon the earth.
GEN 6:13 And the LORD God said to Noah, A season for every man comes before me; for the earth is filled of iniquity by means of them; and behold, I lay them waste, and the earth.
GEN 6:14 Make then to yourself an ark from out of four-cornered wood! Nested compartments you shall make among the ark, and you shall apply tar to it - from inside and from outside with the tar.
GEN 6:15 And so you shall make the ark - three hundred cubits the length of the ark, and fifty cubits the width, and thirty cubits the height of it.
GEN 6:16 By assembling, you shall make the ark; and by a cubit measure you shall complete it from above; but the door of the ark you shall make from out of the side. You shall make it with ground second stories and third stories.
GEN 6:17 And I, behold, I bring the flood of water upon the earth, to lay waste all flesh in which is a breath of life underneath the heaven; and as much as might be upon the earth shall come to an end.
GEN 6:18 And I will establish my covenant with you; and you shall enter into the ark, you, and your sons, and your wife, and the wives of your sons with you.
GEN 6:19 And from all of the cattle, and from all of the reptiles, and from all of the wild beasts, and from all flesh, two by two from all you shall bring into the ark, that you may maintain them with yourself - male and female they shall be.
GEN 6:20 From all of the fowl according to type, and from all of the cattle according to type, and from all of the reptiles of the ones crawling upon the earth according to their type - two by two from all shall enter to you, to be maintained with you - male and female.
GEN 6:21 But you shall take to yourself from all of the foods which you shall eat, and you shall bring them together to yourself, and it shall be to you and to them to eat.
GEN 6:22 And Noah did all as much as the LORD God gave charge to him - so he did.

GEN 7:3 And from the winged creatures of the heaven, of the clean - seven by seven, male and female; and from all of the winged creatures not clean, - two by two, male and female, to maintain seed upon all the earth.

GEN 7:5 And Noah did all as much as the LORD God gave charge to him.

GEN 7:19 But the water prevailed exceedingly exceedingly upon the earth; and it covered all the high mountains which were underneath the heaven.
GEN 7:20 the water was raised fifteen cubits above, and it covered over all the high mountains.
GEN 7:21 And there died all flesh moving upon the earth of the winged creatures, and of the cattle, and from wild beasts, and every reptile moving upon the earth, and every man,
GEN 7:22 and all as many as have breath of life, and everyone who was upon the dry land died.

GEN 7:24 And the water was raised up high from the earth a hundred fifty days.

GEN 8:3 And the water gave way going from the earth. And the water was lessened after fifty and a hundred days.

GEN 8:7 And going forth it returned not until the drying of the water from the earth.

GEN 8:10 And waiting still another seven days, again he sent out the dove from out of the ark.

GEN 8:14 And in the second month, seventh and twentieth of the month, the earth was dried.

GEN 8:22 All the days of the earth, seed and harvest, chilliness and sweltering heat, summer and spring, day and night, will not be caused to cease.
GEN 9:1 And God blessed Noah, and his sons. And he said to them, Grow and multiply, and fill the earth, and dominate it!
GEN 9:2 And the fear of you, and the trembling will be upon all the wild beasts of the earth, upon all the winged creatures of the heaven, and upon all the things moving upon the earth, and upon all the fishes of the sea; under your hands I have given them to you.
GEN 9:3 And every reptile which is living shall be to you for food; as I have given all vegetation of grass to you.
GEN 9:4 Except you shall not eat meat with the blood of life.
GEN 9:5 For even your blood - of the blood of your lives at the hand of all of the wild beasts I shall require it, and from the hand of a man's brother I shall require it.
GEN 9:6 The one shedding blood of a man, in return his blood shall be shed; for in the image of God I made the man.
GEN 9:7 But you grow, and multiply, and fill the earth, and multiply upon the earth!
GEN 9:8 And God said to Noah, and to his sons, saying,
GEN 9:9 Behold, I raise up my covenant to you, and to your seed after you,
GEN 9:10 and every living soul after you, from fowls and from cattle, and to all the wild beasts of the earth, as many as are with you, from all of the ones coming forth from out of the ark.
GEN 9:11 And I will establish my covenant with you; and all flesh will not die any longer from the water of the flood. And there shall not be any longer a flood of water to lay waste all the earth.

EXO 12:12 And I shall go through in the land of Egypt in this night. And I shall strike all first-born in the land of Egypt, from man unto beast. And among all the gods of the Egyptians I will execute punishment - I the LORD.

EXO 12:16 And the first day shall be called holy. And the seventh day shall be called holy to you. All servile work shall not be done in them, except as much as is necessary to do for every soul - this only shall be done by you.

EXO 12:20 Anything leavened you shall not eat. In every home of yours you shall eat unleavened breads.

EXO 12:23 And the LORD will go by to strike the Egyptians. And he shall see the blood upon the lintel, and upon both of the doorposts. And the LORD will go by the door, and will not leave off the annihilating so as to enter into your house to strike.

EXO 16:24 And they left of it into the morning, as Moses ordered them. And it did not stink, nor was there a worm in it.

EXO 18:21 And you yourself look about from all of the people for men mighty and godly - just men, detesting pride! And you shall place of them over them commanders of thousands, and commanders of hundreds, and commanders of fifties, and commanders of tens.
EXO 18:22 And they shall judge the people every hour. But the enormous thing they shall offer unto you, but the little matters of the judgments they shall judge them; and they shall lighten the load from you, and shall give aid to you.
EXO 18:23 If this thing you do, then God will strengthen you, and you will be able to stand, and all this people shall come unto their own place with peace.
EXO 18:24 And Moses hearkened to the voice of his father-in-law, and did as much as he said to him.
EXO 18:25 And Moses chose mighty men from all Israel, and appointed them over them as commanders of thousands, and commanders of hundreds, and commanders of fifties, and commanders of tens, and judicial recorders.
EXO 18:26 And they judged the people every hour; but the enormous matter they offered to Moses, but every light matter they judged themselves.
EXO 18:27 And Moses sent out his own father-in-law; and he went forth unto his land.
EXO 19:1 And in the third month of the exodus of the sons of Israel from the land Egypt, on this day they came into the wilderness of Sinai.
EXO 19:2 And they lifted away from Rephidim, and came into the wilderness of Sinai, and Israel camped there over against the mountain.
EXO 19:3 And Moses ascended into the mountain of God. And God called him from the mountain, saying, Thus you shall say to the house of Jacob, and announce to the sons of Israel,
EXO 19:4 You have seen as much as I have done to them - to the Egyptians. And I took you as upon wings of eagles, and led you to myself.
EXO 19:5 And now, if in hearing you should hear my voice, and guard my covenant, you will be to me a prized people from all of the nations. For all the earth is mine.
EXO 19:6 And you shall be to me a royal priesthood, and a holy nation. These words you shall say to the sons of Israel.
EXO 19:7 And Moses came and called the elders of the people. And he placed near to them all of these words of which God gave orders to them.
EXO 19:8 And all the people answered with one accord, and said, All as much as God said we shall do, and we shall hearken. And Moses offered the words of the people to God.
EXO 19:9 And the LORD said to Moses, Behold, I come to you in a column of cloud, that the people should hear me speaking to you, and should trust you into the eon. And Moses announced the words of the people to the LORD.
EXO 19:10 And the LORD said to Moses, In going down, testify to the people, and purify them today and tomorrow, and let them wash their garments!
EXO 19:11 And let them be prepared for the third day! For in the third day the LORD shall come down upon mount Sinai before all the people.
EXO 19:12 And you shall separate the people round about, saying, Take heed to yourselves ascending unto the mountain, and any lightly touching of it. All touching the mountain, by death he will come to an end.
EXO 19:13 His hand shall not touch it, for with stones they shall be stoned or with an arrow dart. they shall be shot; if it be also cattle, or if it be also man, he shall not live. And whenever the voices, and the trumpets, and the cloud go forth from the mountain, they shall ascend to the mountain.
EXO 19:14 And Moses went down from the mountain to the people, and sanctified them. And they washed their garments.
EXO 19:15 And he said to the people, Be prepared three days - do not come forward to a woman.
EXO 19:16 And it came to pass in the third day, happening towards dawn, and there were voices, and lightnings, and overcast clouds upon mount Sinai; the sound of the trumpet sounded greatly, and all the people were terrified in the camp.
EXO 19:17 And Moses led the people for a meeting with God from out of the camp. And they stood by the mountain.
EXO 19:18 Mount Sinai smoked entirely on account of God coming down upon it in fire. And the smoke ascended as smoke of a furnace. And all the people were exceedingly amazed.
EXO 19:19 And there were the sounds of the trumpet advancing strong - exceedingly. Moses spoke, and God answered to him by voice.
EXO 19:20 And the LORD came down upon mount Sinai, upon the top of the mountain. And the LORD called Moses unto the top of the mountain; and Moses ascended.
EXO 19:21 And God said to Moses, saying, Go down to testify to the people, lest at any time they should approach to God to contemplate, and a multitude of them should fall!
EXO 19:22 And the priests approaching to the LORD God - let them be sanctified, lest at any time the LORD should get rid of them!
EXO 19:23 And Moses said to God, The people shall not be able to ascend to mount Sinai, for you testified to us, saying, Separate from the mountain, and sanctify it!
EXO 19:24 And the LORD said to him, Proceed, go down, and then ascend, you and Aaron with you! But the priests and the people shall not use force to ascend to God, lest at any time the LORD should destroy some of them.
EXO 19:25 And Moses went down to the people, and spoke to them.
EXO 20:1 And the LORD spoke all these words, saying,
EXO 20:2 I am the LORD your God, the one leading you from out of the land of Egypt, from out of the house of slavery.
EXO 20:3 There shall not be to you other gods besides me.
EXO 20:4 You shall not make to yourself an idol, nor any representation, as much as is in the heaven upward, nor as much as is in the earth below, nor as much as is in the waters underneath the earth.
EXO 20:5 You shall not do obeisance to them, nor in any way shall you serve to them. For I am the LORD your God - a jealous God, rendering sins of fathers upon children unto the third and fourth generation to the ones detesting me;
EXO 20:6 and having mercy to thousands loving me, and guarding my orders.
EXO 20:7 You shall not take the name of the LORD your God in vain. For not in any way shall the LORD cleanse the one taking his name in vain.
EXO 20:8 Remember the day of the sabbaths to sanctify it!
EXO 20:9 Six days you shall work, and shall do all your works;
EXO 20:10 but the seventh day is a sabbath to the LORD your God. You shall not do on it any work - you, and your son, and your daughter, your servant, and your maidservant, your ox, and your beast of burden, and all your cattle, and the convert sojourning among you.
EXO 20:11 For in six days the LORD made the heaven, and the earth, and the sea, and all the things in them. And he rested on the seventh day. Because of this the LORD blessed the seventh day, and sanctified it.
EXO 20:12 Esteem your father and your mother, that good should happen to you, and that you may be a long time upon the good earth which the LORD your God gives to you!
EXO 20:13 You shall not murder.
EXO 20:14 You shall not commit adultery.
EXO 20:15 You shall not steal.
EXO 20:16 You shall not falsely witness against your neighbor as a lying witness.
EXO 20:17 You shall not covet the wife of your neighbor. You shall not covet the house of your neighbor, nor his field, nor his manservant, nor his maidservant, nor his ox, nor his beast of burden, nor any of his beasts, nor as much is to your neighbor.
EXO 20:18 All the people perceived the voice, and the lamps, and the sound of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking. And fearing, all the people stood afar off.
EXO 20:19 And they said to Moses, You speak to us, and do not let God speak to us, lest we might die!
EXO 20:20 And Moses says to them, Be of courage! For because of the testing you God came to you, so that there might be the fear of him in you, that you should not sin!
EXO 20:21 And all the people stood afar off. But Moses entered into the dimness where God was.
EXO 20:22 And the LORD said to Moses, Thus shall you say to the house of Jacob, and announce to the sons of Israel, You have seen that from out of the heaven I have spoken to you.
EXO 20:23 You shall not make to yourselves gods of silver, and gods of gold; you shall not make them to yourselves.
EXO 20:24 An altar from out of the earth you shall make to me, and you shall sacrifice upon it your whole burnt offerings, and your deliverance offerings - the sheep, and your calves, in every place of which ever I should name my name there. And I will come to you, and I will bless you.
EXO 20:25 And if you should make an altar of stones to me, you shall not build them cut into shape; for you have put your knife upon them, and they are defiled.
EXO 20:26 You shall not ascend by stairs unto my altar, so that you should not uncover your indecency upon it.
EXO 21:1 And these are the ordinances which you shall place before them.
EXO 21:2 If you should acquire a Hebrew servant, he shall serve to you six years, but the seventh year you shall send him free without charge.
EXO 21:3 If he alone should enter, also alone he shall go forth; but if a wife should enter together with him, also the wife shall go out together with him.
EXO 21:4 And if the master should give to him a wife, and she should bear to him sons and daughters - the wife and the children shall be to his master, and he alone shall go forth by himself.
EXO 21:5 And if responding the servant should have said, I have loved my master, and my wife, and the children - I do not run free.
EXO 21:6 Then his master shall lead him to the judgment seat of God, and then lead him to the door, unto the doorpost. And his master shall make a hole in the ear with the shoemaker's awl, and he shall serve to him into the eon.
EXO 21:7 But if any should give over his own daughter as a domestic servant, she shall not go forth as the maidservants run forth.
EXO 21:8 If she should not be well-pleasing to her master, who did not solemnly promise her; on payment of ransom he shall release her. But the master is not to sell her to an alien nation, for he disrespected her.
EXO 21:9 And if to his son he solemnly promised her, according to the ordinance of the daughters, he shall commit to her.
EXO 21:10 And if he should take another woman to himself, the things necessary, and the clothes, and her companionship he shall not deprive.
EXO 21:11 And if these three things he should not do for her, she shall go forth freely, without paying money.
EXO 21:12 And if any should strike any, and he should die, to death let him be put to death!
EXO 21:13 But if it be done not willingly, but God delivered up into his hands, I will give to you a place in which he shall flee there - the one man-slaying.
EXO 21:14 But if any should set against the neighbor, to kill him by treachery, and should take refuge; you shall take him from my altar to be put to death.
EXO 21:15 Whoever beats his father or his mother, to death he should be put to death.
EXO 21:16 The one speaking evil of his father or his mother, to death let him come to an end!
EXO 21:17 Who ever should steal any of any one of the sons of Israel, and tyrannizing him, should give him over, and should be found with him, to death let him come to an end!
EXO 21:18 And if two men revile each other, and one should strike the neighbor with a stone, or fist, and he should not die, but lies down upon the bed;
EXO 21:19 if in arising, the man should walk outside upon his cane, the one striking will be innocent; except he shall pay for his idleness, and the physician's fee.
EXO 21:20 But if any strike his servant or his maidservant with a rod, and one should die by his hand, with punishment let him be punished!
EXO 21:21 And if the one should continue to live one day or two, he shall not be punished, for he is his money.
EXO 21:22 And if two men should do combat, and should strike a woman having one in the womb, and should come forth her child not completely formed, with a fine he shall be penalized, in so far as the husband of the woman should put upon him, and he shall give by means of what is fit.
EXO 21:23 And if it should be completely formed, he shall give life for life,
EXO 21:24 eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,
EXO 21:25 burning for burning, wound for wound, stripe for stripe.
EXO 21:26 And if any should strike the eye of his man-servant, or the eye of his female attendant, and he should blind; he shall send them free on account of their eye.
EXO 21:27 And if the tooth of the man-servant, or the tooth of his female attendant he should knock out; he shall send them free on account of their tooth.
EXO 21:28 And if a bull should gore a man or woman, and either die; with stones you shall stone the bull, and you shall not eat of its meats; but the owner of the bull shall be innocent.
EXO 21:29 But if the bull should be goring before yesterday, and before the third day before, and men testified to its owner, and he should not remove it, and if it should have done away with a man or a woman; they shall stone the bull, and the owner of it shall die in addition.
EXO 21:30 And if ransoms should be put to him, he shall give ransoms for the life of it, as much as should be put upon him.
EXO 21:31 And if a son or daughter should be gored - according to this ordinance they shall observe it.
EXO 21:32 And if the bull should have gored a manservant or a maidservant; he shall give thirty double-drachmas of silver to their owner, and the bull shall be stoned.
EXO 21:33 And if any should open a pit, or a quarry pit, and should not cover it, and a calf or donkey should fall in there;
EXO 21:34 the owner of the pit shall pay - he shall give money to their owner, and the animal coming to an end will be his.
EXO 21:35 And if any bull should gore the bull of the neighbor, and it should come to an end, they shall give over the living bull for sale, and divide the money from it; and the bull having died they shall divide.
EXO 21:36 And if it is made known that the bull is given to goring before yesterday, and before the third day, and they should have been testifying to its owner, and he did not remove it; he shall pay bull for bull; but the bull coming to an end will be his.
EXO 22:1 And if any should steal a calf or a sheep, and should slay it, or should sell it, he shall pay five calves for the calf, and four sheep for the sheep.
EXO 22:2 And if the thief should be found in the ditch, and being struck should die, it is not murder to him striking.
EXO 22:3 But if the sun should rise upon him, he is liable, he shall die for it; and if there be no possessions to him, let him be sold for the theft.
EXO 22:4 And if anything should be left, and should be found in his hand from the theft, from both donkey unto sheep which may be living, he shall pay double for it.
EXO 22:5 And if any should graze upon a field or a vineyard, and should let his cattle graze upon another field, he shall pay from his field according to his produce; but if all the field should be grazed upon, he shall pay from his best field and from his best vineyard.
EXO 22:6 And if a fire going forth should find thorn-bushes, and should set on fire a threshing-floor, or ears of wheat, or a field, the one burning with the fire shall pay.
EXO 22:7 And if any should give to his neighbor silver or items to guard, and it should be stolen from out of the house of the man; if the one stealing should be found he shall pay double.
EXO 22:8 But if the one stealing should not be found, the master of the house shall come forward before God, and shall swear by an oath that assuredly he did not do wickedly regarding all that was in deposit for the care of his neighbor.
EXO 22:9 According to every particular offence, concerning both calf, and beast of burden, and sheep, and garment, and every destruction being accused, the one who then should be before God when the judgment of both shall come; then the one convicted by God shall pay double to his neighbor.
EXO 22:10 And if any should give to the neighbor a beast of burden, or a calf, or sheep, or any cattle to guard; and it should break, or come to an end, or become captive, and no one should know;
EXO 22:11 then there shall be an oath of God between both, swearing that assuredly he had not done wickedly to partake altogether of the deposit put in care by his neighbor; and thus his owner shall receive him favorably, and he shall not pay.
EXO 22:12 And if it be stolen from him, he shall pay the owner of it.
EXO 22:13 And if it should be taken by wild beasts, he shall lead him to the game, and he shall not pay.
EXO 22:14 And if anyone should ask to borrow from his neighbor, and it should break, or die, or become captive, and the owner of it should not be with it, he shall pay.
EXO 22:15 But if its owner should be with it, he shall not pay; but if a hireling should be with it, it will be to him for his wage.
EXO 22:16 And if any should beguile a virgin not betrothed, and should go to bed with her, he shall endow her to himself as a wife with a dowry.
EXO 22:17 But if in shaking he shakes his head in dissent, and her father should not be willing to give her to him as wife, he shall pay to the father silver according to as much as is the dowry of the virgins.
EXO 22:18 Administers of potions you shall not procure.
EXO 22:19 Every one going to bed with a beast - to death you shall kill them.
EXO 22:20 The one sacrificing to gods shall be utterly destroyed - except to the LORD alone.
EXO 22:21 And you shall not maltreat a foreigner, nor should you afflict him; for you were foreigners in the land of Egypt.
EXO 22:22 Every widow and orphan you shall not maltreat.
EXO 22:23 And if you should maltreat them, and crying out they should yell out to me, in hearing I shall listen to their yell,
EXO 22:24 and I shall be provoked to anger with rage, and I will kill you by the sword, and your wives will be widows, and your children orphans.
EXO 22:25 And if money should be lent with interest to the brother destitute close to you, you shall not be coercing him, you shall not place interest upon him.
EXO 22:26 And if for collateral you should take for security the cloak of your neighbor, before the descent of the sun you shall give it back to him,
EXO 22:27 for this is his wrap-around garment, this alone is his cloak for indecency - in what manner shall he go to bed? If then he should yell out to me, I will listen to him; for I am merciful.
EXO 22:28 You shall not speak evil of magistrates, and you shall not speak wickedly of rulers of your people.
EXO 22:29 You shall not be late of your first-fruits of the threshing-floor and wine vat. Your first-born son you shall give to me -
EXO 22:30 so shall you do with your calf, and your sheep, and your beast of burden. Seven days it shall be under the mother, but in the eighth day you shall give it back to me.
EXO 22:31 And you shall be holy men to me. And meat in a field taken by wild beasts you shall not eat - throw it away to the dogs!
EXO 23:1 You shall not welcome a vain report. Not shall you assent together with the unjust to become an unjust witness.
EXO 23:2 You shall not be with many people for evil. You shall not be added with a multitude to turn aside a judgment.
EXO 23:3 And you shall not show mercy in a judgment because one is needy.
EXO 23:4 And if you should meet up to the ox of your enemy, or to his beast of burden wandering, by returning you shall give it back to him.
EXO 23:5 And if you should see the beast of burden of your enemy falling under its load of merchandise, you shall not go by it, but you shall raise it with him.
EXO 23:6 You shall not turn aside a judgment of the needy in his judgment.
EXO 23:7 From all things unjust you shall abstain. An innocent and just one you shall not kill. And you shall not give justice to the impious one because of bribes.
EXO 23:8 And you shall not receive bribes; for the bribes blind the eyes of seeing, and lay waste just matters.
EXO 23:9 And you shall not maltreat a foreigner, nor in any way afflict. For you know the soul of the foreigner, for you yourselves were foreigners in the land of Egypt.
EXO 23:10 Six years you shall sow your land, and you shall gather its produce;
EXO 23:11 but on the seventh you shall make a release from work, and spare it, and the poor of your nation shall eat; and the things being left behind of them the wild beasts of the field shall eat. Thus you shall do with your vineyard, and your olive grove.
EXO 23:12 Six days you shall do your works, but on the seventh day you shall rest, that your ox may rest, and your beast of burden, and that the son of your maidservant may be refreshed, and the foreigner.
EXO 23:13 All, as much as I have spoken to you, guard! And the name of other gods you shall not call to mind, nor should one be heard from out of your mouth.
EXO 23:14 Three times of the year solemnize a holiday to me!
EXO 23:15 The holiday of the unleavened breads keep to do! Seven days you shall eat unleavened breads, just as I gave charge to you, according to the time of the month of the new produce; for in it you came forth from out of Egypt. You shall not appear before me empty.
EXO 23:16 And a holiday of the harvest of the first produce you shall observe of your works, what ever you sow in your field; and a holiday of completion at the conclusion of the year in the gathering of your works from out of your field.
EXO 23:17 Three times a year every male of yours shall appear before the LORD your God.
EXO 23:18 For whenever I should cast out the nations from your face, and widen your boundaries, you shall not sacrifice with yeast the blood of my sacrifice offering, neither shall the fat of my holiday feast remain through the night until morning.
EXO 23:19 The first-fruits of the first produce of your land you shall carry into the house of the LORD your God. You shall not boil a lamb in its mother's milk.
EXO 23:20 And behold, I send my messenger before your face, that he may guard you in the way, that he may bring you into the land which I prepared for you.
EXO 23:21 Take heed to yourself, and hearken to him, and do not resist his persuasion, for not in any way should he avoid you, for my name is upon him!
EXO 23:22 If in hearing you should hearken to my voice, and should do all as much as I give charge to you, I will be an enemy to your enemies, and I will be an adversary to the ones being an adversary of you.
EXO 23:23 For my messenger shall go leading you; and he will bring you to the Amorite, and Hittite, and Perizzite, and Canaanite, and Gergasite, and Hivite, and Jebusite; and I will obliterate them.
EXO 23:24 You shall not do obeisance to their gods, nor shall you serve to them. You shall not do according to their works. But by demolition you shall demolish them; and by breaking you shall break their monuments.
EXO 23:25 And you shall serve to the LORD your God, and I will bless your bread, and your wine, and your water; and I will turn infirmity from you.
EXO 23:26 It will not be barren, nor sterile upon your land; the number of your days I will fill up.
EXO 23:27 And the fear of me I will send leading before you, and will startle all the nations into which you enter into them; and I will give over all your opponents unto exiles.
EXO 23:28 And I will send the swarms of wasps in front of you, and will cast out the Amorites, and the Hivites, and the Canaanites, and the Hittites, from you.
EXO 23:29 I will not cast them from your face in one year; so that the land should not become wilderness, and many wild beasts should happen upon you in the land.
EXO 23:30 According to little by little I will cast them from you, until whenever you should grow and be heir to the land.
EXO 23:31 And I will establish your boundaries from the red sea unto the sea of the Philistines; and from the wilderness unto the river of the great Euphrates. And I will deliver up into your hands the ones lying in wait in the land; and I will cast them from you.
EXO 23:32 You shall not assent together with them, and with their gods you shall not establish a covenant.
EXO 23:33 And they shall not lie in wait in your land, lest they should cause you to sin against me; for if you should be a slave to their gods, these will be to you an occasion for stumbling.
EXO 24:1 And to Moses he said, Ascend to the LORD, you, and Aaron, and Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel! And they shall do obeisance far off to the LORD.
EXO 24:2 And Moses shall approach alone to God; but they shall not approach, and the people shall not go up with them.
EXO 24:3 And Moses entered and described to the people all the words of God, and the ordinances. And all the people answered in one voice, saying, All the words which the LORD spoke we will do, and will hearken.
EXO 24:4 And Moses wrote down all the words of the LORD. And Moses rising early in the morning built an altar by the mountain, even with twelve stones for the twelve tribes of Israel.
EXO 24:5 And he sent out the young men of the sons of Israel. And they offered whole burnt offerings, and sacrificed a sacrifice of deliverance offering to God of young calves.
EXO 24:6 And Moses taking half of the blood, poured it into a basin; and the other half of the blood he poured upon the altar.
EXO 24:7 And taking the scroll of the covenant, he read into the ears of the people. And they said, All as much as the LORD spoke we shall do, and shall hearken to it.
EXO 24:8 And Moses taking the blood, scattered it upon the people. And he said, Behold, the blood of the covenant of which the LORD ordained for you concerning all of these words.
EXO 24:9 And Moses ascended, and Aaron, and Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel.
EXO 24:10 And they saw the place where the God of Israel stood. And the things under his feet were as a brick work of sapphire, and as the form of firmament of the heaven in the cleanliness.
EXO 24:11 And of the chosen ones of Israel, he dissented not - not one. And they appeared in the place of God, and ate and drank.
EXO 24:12 And the LORD said to Moses, Ascend to me unto the mountain, and you be there! And I will give to you the stone writing-tablets - the law, and the commandments which I wrote to establish law to them.
EXO 24:13 And Moses rising up, and Joshua the one standing beside him, they ascended into the mountain of God.
EXO 24:14 And they said to the elders, Be still here, until we return to you! And behold, Aaron and Hur are with you. If anyone should come for a judgment, let them go to them!
EXO 24:15 And Moses ascended into the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain.
EXO 24:16 And the glory of God came down upon mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days. And the LORD called Moses on the seventh day from out of the midst of the cloud.
EXO 24:17 And the sight of the glory of the LORD was as fire blazing upon the top of the mountain before the sons of Israel.
EXO 24:18 And Moses entered in the midst of the cloud, and ascended unto the mountain. And he was there in the mountain forty days and forty nights.
EXO 25:1 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
EXO 25:2 Speak to the sons of Israel! And take to me first-fruits of all the things which seem good in the heart! You shall take the first-fruits of mine.
EXO 25:3 And this is the first-fruit which you shall take of them - gold, silver, brass,
EXO 25:4 blue, purple, scarlet doubled up, and linen being twined, and hairs of goats,
EXO 25:5 and skins of rams being dyed red, and skins of blue, and incorruptible wood,
EXO 25:6 and oil for the giving light, incenses for the oil of the anointing, and for the composition of the incense,
EXO 25:7 and stones of sardius, and stones for the carving for the shoulder-piece, and the foot length robe.
EXO 25:8 And you shall make for me a sanctuary, and I will be seen by you.
EXO 25:9 And you shall make for me according to all as much as I show to you in the mountain - the model of the tent, and the model of all the items of it - even thus you shall do.
EXO 25:10 And you shall make an ark of testimony from out of incorruptible wood - two cubits and a half the length, and a cubit and a half the width, and a cubit and a half the height.
EXO 25:11 And you shall gild it with pure gold; from inside and from outside you shall gild it. And you shall make for it a waved border of gold twisted round about.
EXO 25:12 And you shall forge for it four rings of gold, and shall place them upon the four sides; two rings upon the one side, and two rings upon the second side.
EXO 25:13 And you shall make bearing poles from incorruptible wood, and shall gild them with gold.
EXO 25:14 And you shall bring the bearing poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, to lift the ark by them.
EXO 25:15 In the rings of the ark of the covenant the bearing poles will be fixed.
EXO 25:16 And you shall put into the ark the testimonies which ever I give to you.
EXO 25:17 And you shall make an atonement-seat, a lid of pure gold - two cubits and a half is the length, and a cubit and a half the width.
EXO 25:18 And you shall make two cherubim golden wrought, and you shall place them at both of the sides of the atonement-seat.
EXO 25:19 You shall make one cherub from out of this one side, and one cherub from out of the second side of the atonement-seat. Thus you shall make the two cherubim upon the two sides.
EXO 25:20 The two cherubim will be stretching out the wings on top, overshadowing with their wings above the atonement-seat, and their faces to one another; the faces of the cherubim will be towards the atonement-seat.
EXO 25:21 And you shall place the atonement-seat upon the ark from above. And into the ark you shall put the testimonies which I shall give to you.
EXO 25:22 And I will be known to you from there, and I will speak to you from above the atonement-seat, between the two cherubim being upon the ark of the testimony, according to all as much as I give charge to you for the sons of Israel.
EXO 25:23 And you shall make a table of incorruptible wood; of two cubits being the length, and a cubit the breadth, and a cubit and a half the height.
EXO 25:24 And you shall gild it in pure gold, and shall make for it a twisted waved border of gold round about. And you shall make for it a rim of a palm width round about.
EXO 25:25 And you shall make a twisted waved border on the rim round about.
EXO 25:26 And you shall make for it four rings of gold, and shall place the four rings upon the four parts of its feet under the rim.
EXO 25:27 And the rings shall be for holders for the bearing poles, so as to lift the table.
EXO 25:28 And you shall make the bearing poles from out of incorruptible woods. And you shall gild them with pure gold. And the table shall be lifted by them.

EXO 25:30 And you shall place breads upon the table face to face before me always.

EXO 26:1 And for the tent you shall make ten curtains of linen being twined, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, being twined with cherubim. A work of a weaver you shall make them.
EXO 26:2 The length of the one curtain shall be eight and twenty cubits; and a breadth of four cubits shall be to the one curtain. The same measure shall be to all the curtains.
EXO 26:3 And five curtains will be of one another, being held the other with the other. And five curtains will be of one another, being held the other with the other.
EXO 26:4 And you shall make for them loops of blue upon the edge of the one curtain joining the one part to the coupling. And thus you shall make upon the edge of the outer curtain for the second coupling.
EXO 26:5 And fifty loops you shall make for the one curtain, and fifty loops you shall make for the part of the curtain corresponding to the coupling of the second, facing headlong into one another each.
EXO 26:6 And you shall make fifty hooks of gold. And you shall join together the curtains another to the other to the hooks. And the tent will be one.
EXO 26:7 And you shall make hide coverings of hair for protection upon the tent - eleven hide coverings you shall make them.
EXO 26:8 The length of the one hide covering will be thirty cubits; and four cubits the breadth of the one hide covering; the same measure will be to the eleven hide coverings.
EXO 26:9 And you shall join together the five hide coverings to the same, and the six hide coverings to the same. And you shall double up the sixth hide covering in front of the tent.
EXO 26:10 And you shall make fifty loops upon the edge of the one hide covering in the middle by the coupling. And fifty loops you shall make upon the edge of the hide covering joining the second.
EXO 26:11 And you shall make fifty hooks of brass. And you shall join together the hooks by the loops, and shall join together the hide coverings, and it shall be one.
EXO 26:12 And you shall set the extra in the hide coverings of the tent - the half of the hide covering being left over you shall cover up for the extra of the hide coverings of the tent. You shall cover up behind the tent.
EXO 26:13 A cubit from out of this side, and a cubit from out of that side of the superior part of the hide coverings, from out of the length of the hide coverings of the tent. And it will be to cover over the sides of the tent on this side and that side, so that it should be covered.

EXO 26:17 two joints to the one post resting headlong against another to the other. Thus you shall make to all the posts of the tent.
EXO 26:18 And you shall make the posts for the tent - twenty posts by the side towards the south.
EXO 26:19 And forty bases of silver you shall make for the twenty posts. Two bases to the one post for both its parts, and two bases to the other one post for both its parts.
EXO 26:20 And the second side towards the north - twenty posts.
EXO 26:21 And forty bases for them made of silver. Two bases to the one post for both its parts, and two bases to the other one post for both its parts.
EXO 26:22 And by the rear of the tent by the part towards the west you shall make six posts.
EXO 26:23 And two posts you shall make at the corners of the tent at the posteriors.
EXO 26:24 And they shall be of equal below, and according to the same measurement they shall be equal from the heads unto one coupling. Thus shall you make to both the two corners - let them be equal!
EXO 26:25 And there shall be eight posts. And their bases of silver - sixteen; and two bases to the one post, and two bases to the other one post.
EXO 26:26 And you shall make bars from out of incorruptible wood; five to the posts from the one part of the tent.
EXO 26:27 And five bars to the posts to the second side of the tent, and five bars for the posts to the posterior side of the tent towards the west.
EXO 26:28 And the middle bar in between the posts - let it penetrate from the one side unto the other side!
EXO 26:29 And the posts you shall gild in gold. And the rings you shall make of gold, into which you shall insert the bars. And you shall gild the bars in gold.
EXO 26:30 And you shall raise the tent according to the form being shown to you in the mountain.

EXO 26:32 And you shall place it upon four posts of incorruptible wood being gilded in gold. And the tips of them shall be in gold, and their four bases made of silver.

EXO 27:1 And you shall make an altar from out of incorruptible woods, of five cubits the length, and five cubits the breadth. The altar will be four-cornered, and its height three cubits.

EXO 27:5 And you shall place them under the grate of the altar from below. And the grate will be for half of the altar.
EXO 27:6 And you shall make to the altar bearing poles from out of incorruptible woods; and you shall brass plate them in brass.

EXO 27:8 You shall make it hollow planked. According to the holding forth of the example to you on the mountain - thus you shall make it.

EXO 28:1 And you lead forward to yourself both Aaron your brother, and his sons, from out of the sons of Israel, to officiate as priest to me - Aaron, and Nadab, and Abihu, and Eleazar, and Ithamar, the sons of Aaron!

EXO 28:3 And you speak to all the wise in the thought, whom I filled with a spirit of wisdom and perception! And they shall make the holy apparel for Aaron, for the holy place, in which he shall officiate as priest to me.
EXO 28:4 And these are the apparels which they shall make - the breast-plate, and the shoulder-piece, and the foot length robe, and a fringed inner garment, and turban, and belt. And they shall make holy apparels for Aaron, and to his sons, for officiating as priest to me.
EXO 28:5 And they shall take the gold, and the blue, and the purple, and the scarlet, and the linen.
EXO 28:6 And they shall make the shoulder-piece from out of linen being twined - a woven work of an embroiderer.

EXO 28:10 Six names upon the one stone, and six names remaining upon the second stone, according to their births.

EXO 28:12 And you shall put the two stones upon the shoulders of the shoulder-piece. They are stones of memorial to the sons of Israel. And Aaron shall lift up the names of the sons of Israel before the LORD upon his two shoulders, as a memorial for them.

EXO 29:1 And these are what you shall do to them, to sanctify them, so as to officiate as priest to me. You shall take one young calf from out of the oxen, and two unblemished rams,
EXO 29:2 and unleavened breads being mixed up with olive oil, and unleavened pancakes being coated with olive oil - you shall make them of fine flour of wheat.
EXO 29:3 And you shall place them unto one bin, and shall offer them unto the bin, and the young calf, and the two rams.
EXO 29:4 And Aaron and his sons you shall lead forward at the door of the tent of the testimony, and shall bathe them in water.
EXO 29:5 And taking the apparels, you shall put on Aaron your brother both the inner garment, the foot length robe, and the shoulder-piece, and the oracle; and you shall join it - the oracle to the shoulder-piece.
EXO 29:6 And you shall place the mitre upon his head, and shall place the sanctified panel upon the mitre.

EXO 29:9 And you shall tie around them the belts, and shall put on them the turbans, and it will be for them a priesthood to me into the eon. And you shall perfect the hands of Aaron, and the hands of his sons.
EXO 29:10 And you shall lead forward the calf unto the door of the tent of the testimony. And Aaron and his sons shall place their hands upon the head of the calf, before the LORD, by the doors of the tent of the testimony.
EXO 29:11 And you shall slay the calf before the LORD by the doors of the tent of the testimony.
EXO 29:12 And you shall take from the blood of the calf, and put it upon the horns of the altar with your finger. And all the remaining blood you shall discharge by the base of the altar.
EXO 29:13 And you shall take all the fat upon the belly, and the lobe of the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat upon them, and shall place it upon the altar.
EXO 29:14 But the meats of the calf, and the skin, and the dung, you shall incinerate with fire outside the camp, for it is a sin offering.
EXO 29:15 And you shall take one ram; and Aaron and his sons shall place their hands upon the head of the ram.
EXO 29:16 And you shall slay the ram. And taking the blood of it, you shall pour it upon the altar round about.
EXO 29:17 And the ram you shall cut in pieces according to its limbs. And you shall wash the entrails, and the feet in water. And you shall place them upon the pieces with the head.
EXO 29:18 And you shall offer all the ram upon the altar, as a whole burnt offering to the LORD, for a scent of pleasant aroma - it is a sacrifice offering to the LORD.
EXO 29:19 And you shall take the ram - the second; and Aaron and his sons shall place their hands upon the head of the ram.
EXO 29:20 And you shall slay it, and take of the blood of it, and place it upon the lobe of the ear of Aaron - the right one, and upon the big toe of the foot - the right one, and upon the lobes of the right ears of his sons, and upon the thumbs of their right hands, and upon the big toes of their right feet.
EXO 29:21 And you shall take of the blood from the altar, and from the oil of the anointing, and sprinkle it upon Aaron, and upon his apparel, and upon his sons, and upon the apparels of his sons with him. And you shall sanctify him, and his apparel, and his sons, and the apparels of his sons with him. And the blood of the ram you shall pour before the altar round about.
EXO 29:22 And you shall take from the ram its fat, both the fat covering up the belly, and the lobe of the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat upon them, and the right shoulder - for this is a consecration offering.
EXO 29:23 And one bread made with olive oil, and one pancake from the bin of the unleavened breads being set before the LORD.
EXO 29:24 And you shall place the whole amount upon the hands of Aaron, and upon the hands of his sons. And you shall separate them as a separation offering before the LORD.
EXO 29:25 And you shall take them from their hands, and you shall offer them upon the altar of the whole burnt offering, as a scent of pleasant aroma before the LORD - it is a yield offering to the LORD.
EXO 29:26 And you shall take the breast from the ram of the consecration offering, which is Aaron's. And you shall separate it as a separation offering before the LORD - and it will be to you for a portion.
EXO 29:27 And you shall sanctify the separation offering breast, and the shoulder of the choice portion which has been separated, and which has been removed from the ram of the consecrationn offering - from Aaron, and from his sons.
EXO 29:28 And it will be to Aaron, and to his sons an eternal law for the sons of Israel, for this is a choice portion; and it will be a choice portion by the sons of Israel from the things offered in sacrifices of the deliverance offerings - a choice portion to the LORD.
EXO 29:29 And the apparel of the holy place, which is Aaron's, shall be to his sons after him, for them to be anointed in them, and to perfect their hands.
EXO 29:30 Seven days he shall put them on - the priest replacing him from his sons, who shall enter into the tent of the testimony to officiate in the holy place.
EXO 29:31 And the ram of the consecration offering you shall take; and you shall boil the meats in the holy place.

EXO 29:33 They shall eat them by which they were sanctified by them, to perfect their hands, to sanctify them. And a foreigner shall not eat from them, for it is holy.
EXO 29:34 And if anything should be left behind from the meats of the sacrifice of the consecration offering, and of the breads until morning - you shall incinerate the remainder with fire; it shall not be eaten, for it is sanctified.
EXO 29:35 And you shall do for Aaron, and his sons thus, according to all as much as I gave charge to you. Seven days you shall perfect their hands.

EXO 29:37 Seven days you shall cleanse the altar, and sanctify it. And the altar will be a holy of the holies; all touching the altar shall be sanctified.
EXO 29:38 And these are what you shall offer upon the altar - lambs of a year old, unblemishled, two for each day perpetually - a yield offering of perpetuity.
EXO 29:39 The lamb - the first one you shall offer in the morning, and the second lamb, you shall offer at dusk.
EXO 29:40 And a tenth measure of fine flour being mixed with olive oil being beaten to the fourth part of a hin; and a libation - the fourth part of the hin of wine to the lamb - to the first one.
EXO 29:41 And the second lamb you shall offer at dusk, after the manner of the early morning sacrifice offering, and according to its libation - you shall do it for a scented pleasant aroma, a yield offering to the LORD;
EXO 29:42 a perpetual sacrifice offering unto your generations upon the doors of the tent of the testimony before the LORD - in which I will be known to you there, so as to speak to you.
EXO 29:43 And I will give orders there to the sons of Israel, and I will be sanctified in my glory.
EXO 29:44 And I will sanctify the tent of the testimony, and the altar. And Aaron and his sons I will sanctify to officiate as priests to me.
EXO 29:45 And I will be called upon by the sons of Israel, and I will be their God.
EXO 29:46 And they shall know that I am the LORD their God, the one leading them from out of the land of Egypt, to be called upon by them, and to be their God.
EXO 30:1 And you shall make an altar of incense from out of incorruptible wood.

EXO 30:5 And you shall make staves from out of incorruptible wood, and you shall gild them in gold.
EXO 30:6 And you shall put it before the veil being for the ark of the testimony, in which I shall be made known to you there.
EXO 30:7 And Aaron shall burn incense upon it; incense compounded fine - in the morning by morning. Whenever he should trim the lamps, he shall burn incense upon it.
EXO 30:8 And whenever Aaron should light up the lamps late, he shall burn incense upon it - incense of perpetuity, always before the LORD unto your generations.
EXO 30:9 And you shall not offer upon it another incense. A yield offering, and a sacrifice offering, and a libation you shall not offer upon it.
EXO 30:10 And Aaron shall atone upon its horns once a year. From the blood of the cleansing of the sins of the making an atonement once a year he shall cleanse it for your generations - it is a holy of holies to the LORD.
EXO 30:11 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
EXO 30:12 If you should take the assessment of the sons of Israel in the overseeing of them, then each shall give ransoms for his soul to the LORD, and there shall not be among them a failure in the overseeing of them.
EXO 30:13 And this is what they shall give, as many as pass the numbering - the half double-drachma, which it shall be according to the double-drachma of the holy place - twenty oboli to the double-drachma; but the half double-drachma is a contribution to the LORD.
EXO 30:14 Every one passing in the numbering from twenty years old and above shall give the contribution to the LORD.
EXO 30:15 The ones being rich shall not add more, and the ones needing shall not add less from the half of the double-drachma, in the giving the contribution to the LORD to atone for your souls.
EXO 30:16 And you shall take the silver of the contribution given by the sons of Israel, and you shall give it for the upkeep of the tent of the testimony. And it will be to the sons of Israel as a memorial before the LORD, to atone for your souls.
EXO 30:17 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
EXO 30:18 Make a bathing tub of brass, and a base for it of brass, so as to wash. And you shall put it between the tent of the testimony, and between the altar. And you shall pour water into it.
EXO 30:19 And Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet from it.
EXO 30:20 Whenever they should enter into the tent of the testimony they shall wash in water, and no way shall they die. Or whenever they should go to the altar to officiate and to offer the whole burnt offerings to the LORD,
EXO 30:21 they shall wash their hands and their feet in water, that they should not die. And it will be to them an eternal law, to him and his generations after him.
EXO 30:22 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
EXO 30:23 And you take spices, the flower of choice myrrh - five hundred shekels, and sweet smelling cinnamon half of this - two hundred and fifty, and sweet smelling calamus - two hundred fifty,
EXO 30:24 and of oil of cassia - five hundred shekels of the holy place, and olive oil from olives - a hin!
EXO 30:25 And you shall make it a holy scented unguent oil, a perfumed liquid scented by the craft of a perfumer - it shall be a holy scented unguent oil.
EXO 30:26 And you shall anoint with it the tent of the testimony, and the ark of the testimony,
EXO 30:27 and all its utensils, and the lamp-stand, and its utensils, and the altar of the of incense,
EXO 30:28 and the altar of the whole burnt offerings, and all its utensils, and the table, and all its utensils, and the bathing tub, and its base.
EXO 30:29 And you shall sanctify them, and they shall be a holy of the holies. Every one touching them shall be sanctified.
EXO 30:30 And Aaron and his sons you shall anoint, and sanctify them to officiate as priests to me.
EXO 30:31 And to the sons of Israel you shall speak, saying, An oil of anointing - this will be a holy anointing to you into your generations.
EXO 30:32 You shall not anoint with it upon the flesh of man. And concerning this composition, you shall not make any to you yourselves likewise - it is holy, and it shall be sanctified to you.
EXO 30:33 Who ever should make likewise, and who ever should give of it to a foreigner, he shall be utterly destroyed from his people.
EXO 30:34 And the LORD said to Moses, Take to yourself spices - balsam, and onycha, and luscious galbanum, and transparent frankincense, equal to equal it will be.
EXO 30:35 And they shall make a scented incense with it, a work of a perfumer - a pure holy work being mixed.
EXO 30:36 And you shall cut of these into fine parts, and you shall put it before the testimony in the tent of the testimony, from where I will be known to you from there. It will be to you a holy of the holies incense.
EXO 30:37 According to this composition you shall not make to you yourselves - it shall be a sanctified thing to you to the LORD.
EXO 30:38 Who ever should make likewise so as to smell by it shall be destroyed from out of his people.
EXO 31:1 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
EXO 31:2 Behold, I have called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
EXO 31:3 And I filled him a divine spirit of wisdom, and understanding, and higher knowledge, to consider in every work,
EXO 31:4 and to supervise construction; to work the gold, and the silver, and the brass, and the blue, and the purple, and the spun scarlet,
EXO 31:5 and the linen being twined, and the stonecutting works, and for the woodworkers of the works of wood - to work according to all the works.
EXO 31:6 And I have given him even Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan. And to every one discerning in heart I have given understanding. And they shall make all as much as I gave orders to you -

EXO 31:8 and the altars, and the table, and all the utensils of it, and the pure lamp-stand, and all the utensils of it,

EXO 31:11 and the anointing oil, and the incense of the composition of the holy place. According to all as much as I gave charge to you they shall make.

EXO 31:13 And you speak to the sons of Israel, saying! Perceive and guard my sabbaths! For it is a sign by me and among you unto your generations, that you might know that I the LORD am the one sanctifying you.
EXO 31:14 And you shall guard the sabbath, for it is holy to you. The one profaning it, unto death shall be put to death. Every one who shall do work on it, that soul shall be utterly destroyed from the midst of his people.
EXO 31:15 Six days you shall do works, but the seventh day is a holy sabbath rest to the LORD. All who shall do work on the day of the sabbaths shall be put to death.
EXO 31:16 And the sons of Israel shall guard the sabbaths to observe them unto their generations.
EXO 31:17 It is an eternal covenant with me and the sons of Israel - it is an eternal sign. For in six days the LORD made the heaven and the earth, and on the seventh day he ceased and rested.
