EXO 32:1 And the people seeing that Moses passed time to come down from out of the mountain, the people stood together by Aaron. And they say to him, Rise up, and make for us gods, who will go before us! For Moses, this man who led us from out of the land of Egypt, we know not what has happened to him.
EXO 32:2 And Aaron says to them, Remove the gold ear-rings in the ears of your wives, and daughters, and bring them to me!
EXO 32:3 And all the people removed the gold ear-rings in their ears, and they brought them to Aaron.
EXO 32:4 And he took them from out of their hands, and shaped them with the stylus. And he made it a molten calf. And they said, These are your gods, O Israel, who hauled you from out of the land of Egypt.
EXO 32:5 And seeing, Aaron built an altar over against it. And Aaron proclaimed, saying, A holiday of the LORD is tomorrow.
EXO 32:6 And rising early in the next day, he offered whole burnt offerings, and offered the sacrifice of deliverance offering. And the people sat to eat and to drink, and they rose up to play.
EXO 32:7 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying, Proceed quickly to go down from here, for your people whom you led from out of the land of Egypt acted lawlessly!
EXO 32:8 They violate quickly from the way which I gave charge to them; they made to themselves a calf, and they do obeisance to it, and they have sacrificed to it. And they said, These are your gods, O Israel, who hauled you from out of the land of Egypt.
EXO 32:9 And now allow me! For being enraged in anger against them, I will obliterate them.
EXO 32:10 And I will make you into a great nation.
EXO 32:11 And Moses beseeched in front of the LORD God, and said, Why, O LORD, be enraged in anger against your people, whom you led from out of the land of Egypt in great strength, and with your high arm?
EXO 32:12 Lest at any time the Egyptians should say, in saying, With wickedness he led them to kill them in the mountains, and to completely consume them from the earth. Cease the anger of your rage, and be propitious to the evil of your people,
EXO 32:13 remembering Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob your servants, to whom you swore by an oath to them according to yourself! And you spoke to them, saying, I will greatly multiply your seed as the stars of the heaven in multitude, and all this land which you spoke of to give it to their seed, so that they shall hold it into the eon.
EXO 32:14 And the LORD dealt kindly concerning the bad which he said he would do to his people.
EXO 32:15 And Moses returning, went down from the mountain, and the two tablets of the testimony were in his hands - tablets of stone, having been written on both their parts; on this side and that side they were written.
EXO 32:16 And the tablets were a work of God, and the writing is a writing of God chiseled in the tablets.
EXO 32:17 And Joshua hearing the voice of the people crying out, says to Moses, It is a sound of war in the camp.
EXO 32:18 And he says, It is not a sound originating from strength, nor a sound originating by a routing of the enemy, but a sound originating from wine I hear.
EXO 32:19 And when he approached the camp, he sees the calf, and the company of dancers. And Moses being provoked to anger in rage, tossed from his hands the two tablets, and broke them below the mountain.
EXO 32:20 And having taken the calf which they made, he incinerated it in fire, and ground it fine, and sowed it upon the water, and made the sons of Israel drink it.
EXO 32:21 And Moses said to Aaron, What did this people do to you, that you brought upon them a great sin?
EXO 32:22 And Aaron said to Moses, Be not provoked to anger, O master, for you know the impulse of this people!
EXO 32:23 For they say to me, Make to us gods, which shall go before us! For this man Moses, who led us out of Egypt, we know not what has happened to him.
EXO 32:24 And I said to them, Anyone who possesses pieces of gold, remove them! And they gave them to me, and I tossed them into the fire, and there came forth this calf.

EXO 32:27 And he says to them, Thus says the LORD God of Israel, Let each put on himself a broadsword upon his thigh! And let him go through and return from gate to gate through the camp! And let each kill his brothers, and each his neighbor, and each the one nearest him!

EXO 32:31 And Moses returned to the LORD, and said, I beseech, O LORD, this people have sinned a great sin, and made to themselves golden gods.
EXO 32:32 And now, if forasmuch as you forgive them of their sin - forgive! But if not, wipe me away from out of your book which you wrote!
EXO 32:33 And the LORD said to Moses, If any sin before me, I will wipe them from out of my book.
EXO 32:34 And now, proceed, and guide this people into the place which I told to you! Behold, my angel shall go forth before your face, and in whatever day I should visit, I will bring upon them their sin.

EXO 33:1 And the LORD said to Moses, Go forth, ascend from here, you and your people, which you led from out of the land of Egypt, into the land which I swore by an oath to Abraham, and to Isaac, and to Jacob! saying, To your seed I will give it.
EXO 33:2 And I will send along my angel before your face; and he will cast out the Amorite, and Hittite, and Perizzite, and Gergasite, and Hivite, and Jebusite, and Canaanite.
EXO 33:3 And I will bring you into a land flowing milk and honey. For I will not go up with you, because you are a hard-necked people, that I should not completely consume you in the way.
EXO 33:4 And the people hearing this severe saying, mourned in mourning.
EXO 33:5 And the LORD said to the sons of Israel, You are a people hard-necked. See that I bring not another calamity upon you, and should completely consume you! Now then, remove your glorious apparels, and the ornament, and I will show to you what I will do to you!
EXO 33:6 And the sons of Israel removed their ornamentation, and the attire at the mountain of Horeb.

EXO 33:9 And as Moses entered into the tent, the column of cloud came down, and stood at the door of the tent, and he spoke to Moses.
EXO 33:10 And all the people saw the column of cloud standing by the door of the tent. And all the people stood and did obeisance, each from the door of his tent.
EXO 33:11 And the LORD spoke to Moses face to face, as if any might speak to his own friend. And he retired into the camp. And the attendant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, did not go forth from out of the tent.

EXO 33:13 If then I have found favor before you, reveal to me yourself knowingly, that I might see you, how ever I should be found in favor before you, and that I might know that this nation is your people!
EXO 33:14 And he says, I myself will go before you, and will rest you.
EXO 33:15 And he says to him, Unless you yourself should go with us, you should not lead me from here.
EXO 33:16 And how will it truly be made known that I have found favor by you - I and also your people, unless you are going with us, and both I and your people will be glorified by all the nations, as many as are upon the earth?
EXO 33:17 And the LORD said to Moses, And this word which you have said I will do to you, for you have found favor before me, and I know you above all.

EXO 40:1 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
EXO 40:2 On day one of the month of the first new moon you shall set up the tent of the testimony.
EXO 40:3 And you shall set up there the ark of the testimony. And you shall shelter the ark by the veil.
EXO 40:4 And you shall carry in the table. And you shall set its place setting. And you shall carry in the lamp-stand. And you shall place on it its lamps.
EXO 40:5 And you shall place the golden altar to burn incense before the ark of the testimony. And you shall place a covering veil upon the door of the tent.
EXO 40:6 And the altar of the yield offerings you shall put by the door of the tent of the testimony.
EXO 40:7 And you shall place the bathing tub between the tent of the testimony and between the altar. And you shall put water in it.
EXO 40:8 And you shall station the courtyard round about. And you shall station the veil of the gate of the courtyard.
EXO 40:9 And you shall take the oil of the scented unguent, and shall anoint the tent, and all the things in it. And you shall sanctify it, and all its items - and it shall be holy.
EXO 40:10 And you shall anoint the altar of the yield offerings, and all its utensils.
EXO 40:11 And you shall anoint the bathing tub, and its base. And you shall sanctify it. And you shall sanctify the altar. And it will be the altar of the holy of the holies.
EXO 40:12 And you shall lead Aaron and his sons unto the doors of the tent of the testimony, and you shall bathe them in water.
EXO 40:13 And you shall put on Aaron the holy apparels, and shall anoint him, and shall sanctify him, and he shall officiate as priest to me.
EXO 40:14 And his sons you shall lead forward, and shall put on them inner garments.
EXO 40:15 And you shall anoint them in which manner you anointed their father, and they shall officiate as priests to me. And it will be so as to be to them an anointing priesthood into the eon, unto their generations.
EXO 40:16 And Moses did all as much as the LORD gave charge to him - thus he did.
EXO 40:17 And it came to pass in the first month, in the second year of their going forth from out of Egypt, at the new moon, the tent was set up.
EXO 40:18 And Moses set up the tent, and placed the tips, and inserted the bars, and set up its posts.
EXO 40:19 And he stretched out the curtains upon the tent, and they placed the tent coverings upon it from above - as the LORD gave orders to Moses.
EXO 40:20 And taking the testimonies he put them into the ark, and placed the poles under the ark, and placed the atonement-seat upon the ark.
EXO 40:21 And he carried the ark into the tent, and set the covering of the veil; and it sheltered the ark of the testimony; in which manner the LORD gave orders to Moses.
EXO 40:22 And he placed the table in the tent of the testimony by the side of the tent of the testimony towards the north, from outside the veil of the tent.
EXO 40:23 And he set upon it the breads of the place setting before the LORD; in which manner the LORD gave orders to Moses.
EXO 40:24 And he put the lamp-stand in the tent of the testimony, before the table, to the side of the tent towards the south.
EXO 40:25 And he placed upon it its lamps before the LORD; in which manner the LORD gave orders to Moses.
EXO 40:26 And he put the golden altar in the tent of the testimony before the veil.
EXO 40:27 And he burned incense upon it, the incense of the composition; just as the LORD gave orders to Moses.
EXO 40:28 And he placed the draw curtain of the door of the tent.
EXO 40:29 And the altar of the yield offerings he put by the door of the tent of the testimony. And he offered on it a whole burnt offering, and a sacrifice offering; as the LORD gave orders to Moses.
EXO 40:30 And he put the bathing tub between the tent of the testimony, and between the altar. And he placed water in it,
EXO 40:31 for Moses and Aaron and his sons to wash from it their hands and feet,
EXO 40:32 in their entering into the tent of the testimony. Or whenever they went to the altar to officiate, they washed from it; as the LORD gave orders to Moses.
EXO 40:33 And he set up the courtyard round about the tent and the testimony. And he stationed the draw curtain of the door of the courtyard. And Moses completed all the works.
EXO 40:34 And the cloud covered the tent of the testimony, and the tent was filled of the glory of the LORD.
EXO 40:35 And Moses was not able to enter into the tent of the testimony, for the cloud overshadowed upon it, and the tent was filled of the glory of the LORD.
EXO 40:36 And when ever the cloud ascended from the tent, the sons of Israel broke camp with their chattel.
EXO 40:37 But if the cloud ascends not, they did not break camp till the day which the cloud ascended.
EXO 40:38 For the cloud was upon the tent by day, and fire was upon it by night, before all Israel, in all their marchings.
LEV 1:1 And he called Moses, and the LORD spoke to him from out of the tent of the testimony, saying,
LEV 1:2 Speak to the sons of Israel! And you shall say to them, A man of you, if he should bring gift offerings to the LORD from the cattle, and from the oxen, and from the sheep - you shall bring your gift offerings thus.
LEV 1:3 If his gift offering be a whole burnt offering of the oxen, he shall bring an unblemished male for it, to the door of the tent of the testimony. He shall bring it acceptable before the LORD.
LEV 1:4 And he shall place his hand upon the head of the yield offering acceptable to him, to atone for him.
LEV 1:5 And they shall slay the calf before the LORD. And the sons of Aaron the priests shall bring the blood, and shall pour the blood upon the altar round about the one at the doors of the tent of the testimony.
LEV 1:6 And flaying the whole burnt offering, they shall dismember it by limbs.
LEV 1:7 And the sons of Aaron the priests shall put fire upon the altar. And they shall pile wood upon the fire.
LEV 1:8 And the sons of Aaron the priests shall pile up the pieces, and the head, and the fat upon the wood upon the fire being upon the altar.
LEV 1:9 But the intestines and the feet they shall wash in water. And the priest shall place the whole amount upon the altar - it is a yield offering sacrifice scent of pleasant aroma to the LORD.
LEV 1:10 And if his gift offering is from the sheep to the LORD, or also from the lambs, and of the kids, for a whole burnt offering, he shall bring an unblemished male for it. And he shall place his hand upon its head.
LEV 1:11 And they shall slay it by the side of the altar towards the north, before the LORD. And the sons of Aaron the priests shall pour the blood of it upon the altar round about.
LEV 1:12 And they shall divide it by limbs, and the head, and its fat. And the priests shall pile them upon the wood upon the fire upon the altar.
LEV 1:13 And the intestines and the feet they shall wash in water. And the priest shall bring the whole amount, and shall place them upon the altar - it is a yield offering sacrifice scent of pleasant aroma to the LORD.
LEV 1:14 But if from the birds he should bring his gift yield offering to the LORD, then he shall bring his gift from the turtle-doves or from the pigeons.
LEV 1:15 And the priest shall bring it to the altar, and shall pluck off its head. And the priest shall place it upon the altar, and shall wring out the blood to the base of the altar.
LEV 1:16 And he shall remove the crop with the feathers, and cast them by the altar according to the east, into the place of the ashes.
LEV 1:17 And he shall break it from the wings, and shall not divide it. And the priest shall place it upon the altar upon the wood upon the fire - it is a yield offering sacrifice scent of pleasant aroma to the LORD.
LEV 2:1 And if a soul should bring a gift offering sacrifice to the LORD, his gift offering shall be fine flour. And he shall pour upon it olive oil. And he shall place upon it frankincense - it is a sacrifice.
LEV 2:2 And he shall bring it to the sons of Aaron of the priests. And grabbing of it a full handful of the fine flour, with the olive oil, and all its frankincense, that the priest shall place its memorial portion upon the altar - a sacrifice scent of pleasant aroma to the LORD.
LEV 2:3 And the remainder of the sacrifice shall be for Aaron and to his sons; it is a holy of the holies of the sacrifices of the LORD.
LEV 2:4 And if he should bring a gift offering sacrifice being baked in an oven, it shall be of fine flour, of unleavened breads being mixed up with olive oil, or unleavened pancakes being smeared all over in olive oil.
LEV 2:5 And if a sacrifice from the frying pan is your gift offering, it shall be unleavened fine flour mixed up with olive oil.
LEV 2:6 And you shall break them into pieces, and you shall pour upon them olive oil - it is a sacrifice to the LORD.
LEV 2:7 And if your gift offering sacrifice be from the grate, it shall be made of fine flour with olive oil.
LEV 2:8 And you shall bring the sacrifice, what ever he should have made of these, to the LORD. And you shall bring it to the priest. And in drawing near to the altar,
LEV 2:9 the priest shall remove from the sacrifice the memorial portion of it. And the priest shall place it upon the altar - a yield offering scent of pleasant aroma to the LORD.
LEV 2:10 And the amount being left behind from the sacrifice shall be for Aaron and to his sons, a holy of the holies of the yield offerings of the LORD.
LEV 2:11 Every sacrifice which ever you should bring to the LORD, you shall not make leavened; for all yeast, and all honey you shall not offer of it, to yield to the LORD a gift offering.
LEV 2:12 Of first-fruit - you shall bring them to the LORD, but upon the altar they shall not be brought up for a scent of pleasant aroma to the LORD.
LEV 2:13 And every gift offering of your sacrifice shall be salted with salt. You shall not discontinue salt from the covenant of the LORD with your sacrifices; you shall offer salt upon all your gift offering.
LEV 2:14 And if you should bring a sacrifice of first produce to the LORD, it shall be new parched ground up green wheat to the LORD. And thus shall you bring the sacrifice of the first produce.
LEV 2:15 And you shall pour upon it olive oil. And you shall put upon it frankincense. It is a sacrifice offering.
LEV 2:16 And the priest shall offer the memorial portion of it from the green wheat with the olive oil, and all its frankincense - it is a yield offering to the LORD.
LEV 3:1 And if his gift offering be a sacrifice of deliverance to the LORD, and if then from out of his oxen he should bring it, if indeed a male, and if indeed a female, he shall bring it unblemished before the LORD.
LEV 3:2 And he shall place his hands upon the head of the gift offering, and shall slay it by the doors of the tent of the testimony. And the sons of Aaron the priests shall pour the blood upon the altar of the whole burnt offerings round about.
LEV 3:3 And they shall bring, for the sacrifice of deliverance a yield offering to the LORD - the fat covering up the belly, and all the fat upon the belly,
LEV 3:4 and the two kidneys, and the fat upon them, the part upon the thighs, and the lobe upon the liver, with the kidneys - it he shall remove.
LEV 3:5 And the sons of Aaron the priests shall offer them upon the altar, upon the whole burnt offerings, upon the wood upon the fire - a yield offering scent of pleasant aroma to the LORD.
LEV 3:6 And if his gift offering sacrifice of deliverance to the LORD is of the sheep, he shall bring an unblemished male or female for it.
LEV 3:7 If he should bring a lamb for his gift offering, he shall bring it before the LORD.
LEV 3:8 And he shall place hands upon the head of his gift offering, and shall slay it by the doors of the tent of the testimony. And the sons of Aaron the priests shall pour the blood upon the altar round about.
LEV 3:9 And he shall bring from the sacrifice of deliverance a yield offering to the LORD - the fat, and the loin, unblemished with the flank - he shall remove it, and all the fat covering up the belly, and all the fat upon the belly,
LEV 3:10 and both the kidneys, and the fat upon them, and the fat upon the thighs, and the lobe upon the liver, with the kidneys being removed.
LEV 3:11 And the priest shall offer it upon the altar - a scent of pleasant aroma yield offering to the LORD.
LEV 3:12 And if his gift offering is from the goats, then he shall bring it before the LORD.
LEV 3:13 And he shall place the hands upon the head of it. And they shall slay it before the LORD by the doors of the tent of the testimony. And the sons of Aaron the priests shall pour the blood upon the altar round about.
LEV 3:14 And he shall offer of it a yield offering to the LORD - the fat covering up the belly, and all the fat upon the belly,
LEV 3:15 and the two kidneys, and all the fat upon them, and the fat upon the thighs, and the lobe upon the liver with the kidneys - it he shall remove.
LEV 3:16 And the priest shall offer it upon the altar - a yield offering scent of pleasant aroma to the LORD. All fat belongs to the LORD,
LEV 3:17 as an everlasting law unto your generations in every dwelling of yours. All fat and all blood you shall not eat.
LEV 4:1 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
LEV 4:2 Speak to the sons of Israel! saying, If a soul should sin unintentionally from all of the orders of the LORD, of which things he must not be doing, and shall do any one of them;
LEV 4:3 if then the anointed chief priest should sin to cause the people to sin, then he shall bring for his sin of which he sinned an unblemished calf of the oxen to the LORD for the sin.
LEV 4:4 And he shall bring the calf by the door of the tent of the testimony before the LORD. And he shall place his hand upon the head of the calf before the LORD, and he shall slay the calf in the presence of the LORD.
LEV 4:5 And the anointed priest having perfected the hands taking from the blood of the calf even shall carry it into the tent of the testimony.
LEV 4:6 And the priest shall dip the finger into the blood, and shall sprinkle on from the blood seven times with the finger before the LORD at the holy veil.
LEV 4:7 And the priest shall put of the blood of the calf upon the horns of the altar of incense of the composition before the LORD, which is in the tent of the testimony. And he shall pour all the blood of the calf by the base of the altar of the yield offering, which is by the doors of the tent of the testimony.
LEV 4:8 And all the fat of the calf of the sin offering, even he shall remove from it the fat covering up the entrails, and all the fat upon the entrails,
LEV 4:9 and the two kidneys, and the fat upon them by the thighs; and the lobe upon the liver, with the kidneys - he shall remove it,
LEV 4:10 in which manner he removes from the calf of the sacrifice of the deliverance offering. And the priest shall offer upon the altar of the yield offering,
LEV 4:11 even the skin of the calf, and all of its flesh, with the head, and the extremities, and the belly, and the dung.
LEV 4:12 And they shall bring forth the entire calf outside the camp into a clean place, where they shall pour out the ashes. And they shall incinerate it upon wood with fire; it shall be burnt upon the outpouring of the ashes.
LEV 4:13 And if all the congregation of Israel should not know, it being unintentionally done, and the thing should be unaware from the eyes of the congregation, and they should do one trespass from all of the commandments of the LORD which should not be done, and they should trespass,
LEV 4:14 and the sin should be made known to them which they sinned by it; then the congregation shall bring a calf from out of the oxen, unblemished, for the sin offering; and it shall bring it by the doors of the tent of the testimony.
LEV 4:15 And the elders of the congregation shall place their hands upon the head of the calf before the LORD. And they shall slay the calf before the LORD.
LEV 4:16 And the anointed priest shall carry some of the blood of the calf into the tent of the testimony.
LEV 4:17 And the priest shall dip his finger into the blood of the calf, and shall sprinkle it seven times before the LORD in front of the holy veil.
LEV 4:18 And some of the blood the priest shall place upon the horns of the altar of the incenses of the composition, which is before the LORD, which is in the tent of the testimony. And he shall pour out all the blood before the base of the altar of the yield offering, being before the door of the tent of the testimony.
LEV 4:19 And he shall remove all of its fat from it, and shall offer it upon the altar.
LEV 4:20 And he shall offer the calf, in which manner he did the calf for the sin offering - so it shall be done. And the priest shall atone for them, and the sin shall be forgiven them.
LEV 4:21 And they shall bring forth the complete calf outside the camp. And they shall incinerate the calf in which manner they incinerated the calf formerly - it is a sin offering for the congregation.
LEV 4:22 And if the ruler should sin, and should commit one trespass of all of the commandments of the LORD his God which he should not do - unintentionally; and he should sin and should trespass,
LEV 4:23 and the sin by which he sinned by it should be known to him, then he shall bring his gift offering of a young he-goat from the goats - a male unblemished.
LEV 4:24 And he shall place his hand upon the head of the young he-goat, and they shall slay it in the place of which they slay the whole burnt offerings before the LORD - it is a sin offering.
LEV 4:25 And the priest shall place some of the blood of the one of the sin offering, with the finger, upon the horns of the altar of the whole burnt offerings, and shall pour out all of its blood by the base of the altar of the whole burnt offerings.
LEV 4:26 And he shall offer all of its fat upon the altar, as the fat sacrifice of deliverance. And the priest shall atone for him of his sin, and it shall be forgiven him.
LEV 4:27 And if one soul should sin unintentionally from among the people of the land, in the committing one trespass from all of the commandments of the LORD, which should not be done, and he should trespass,
LEV 4:28 and the sin should be made known to him, which he sinned by it, then he shall bring the gift offering - he shall offer an unblemished female yearling of the goats for the sin which he sinned.
LEV 4:29 And he shall place his hand upon the head of his sin offering; and they shall slay the yearling of the sin offering in the place where they slay the whole burnt offerings.
LEV 4:30 And the priest shall take some of its blood with his finger, and shall put it upon the horns of the altar of the whole burnt offerings. And all of its blood he shall pour out by the base of the altar.
LEV 4:31 And all the fat he shall remove in which manner he removed the fat from the sacrifice of deliverance offering. And the priest shall offer it upon the altar for a scent of pleasant aroma to the LORD. And the priest shall atone for him, and it shall be forgiven him.
LEV 4:32 And if he should bring a sheep for his gift for the sin offering, he shall bring an unblemished female for it.
LEV 4:33 And he shall place his hand upon the head of the one for the sin offering. And they shall slay it for a sin offering in the place of which they slay the whole burnt offerings.
LEV 4:34 And the priest taking some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, he shall place it upon the horns of the altar of the whole offering; and all of its blood he shall pour out by the base of the altar of the whole burnt offering.
LEV 4:35 And all of its fat he shall remove in which manner the fat of the sheep from the sacrifice of deliverance offering was removed. And the priest shall place it upon the altar, upon the whole burnt offerings of the LORD. And the priest shall atone for him for the sin of which he sinned, and it shall be forgiven him.
LEV 5:1 And if a soul should sin, and should hear a voice of conjuring, and witness this, or see, or be fully conscious of it; if he should not report it, he takes responsibility for his sin.
LEV 5:2 That soul which ever should touch any thing unclean, or decaying flesh, or that which is unclean taken by wild beasts, or of the decaying flesh of abominations of the unclean, or of the decaying flesh of unclean cattle,
LEV 5:3 or should touch of the uncleanness of a man, of any of his uncleanness of what ever touching he should be defiled, and he be unaware of it, but after this he should know that he should have trespassed;
LEV 5:4 or the soul, in what ever he should swear by an oath, drawing apart his lips to do evil or to do well, according to all as much as the man should draw apart according to an oath, and should be unaware of it; and this one should later know, and should have sined any one of these things -
LEV 5:5 then he shall declare openly the sin for which he has sinned by it.
LEV 5:6 And he shall bring, for which he trespassed against the LORD for the sin of which he sinned, a female from the sheep, a ewe-lamb or a yearling of the goats for a sin offering. And the priest shall atone for him for the sin of which he sinned, and the sin shall be forgiven him.
LEV 5:7 And if his hand is not strong to be fit for bringing the sheep, he shall bring for his sin offering, of which he sinned, two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons to the LORD; one for a sin offering, and one for a whole burnt offering.
LEV 5:8 And he shall bring them to the priest; and the priest shall bring the one for the prior sin offering; and the priest shall pluck off its head from the neck, and shall not divide it.
LEV 5:9 And he shall sprinkle from the blood of the one for the sin offering upon the wall of the altar; but the rest of the blood he shall drop upon the base of the altar - for it is a sin offering.
LEV 5:10 And the second one he shall offer for a whole offering as is fit. And the priest shall atone for him for his sin of which he sinned, and it shall be forgiven him.
LEV 5:11 And if his hand should not find a pair of turtle-doves, or two young pigeons, then he shall bring his gift for which he sinned the tenth of the ephah of fine flour for a sin offering. He shall not pour upon it olive oil, nor place upon it frankincense; for it is an offering on account of sin.
LEV 5:12 And he shall bring it to the priest. And the priest grabbing from it a full handful of his, shall place the memorial portion of it upon the altar, upon the whole burnt offerings to the LORD - it is a sin offering.
LEV 5:13 And the priest shall atone for him for his sin of which he sinned against one of these things, and it shall be forgiven him. And the remaining will be for the priest as a sacrifice of the fine flour.
LEV 5:14 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
LEV 5:15 The soul who ever should be unaware himself with forgetfulness, and should sin unintentionally of the holy things of the LORD; then he shall bring for his trespass offering to the LORD an unblemished ram of the flocks, of the value of silver of shekels, in the shekel in the holy place, for of what he trespassed.
LEV 5:16 And what ever he sinned, he shall pay from the holy things, and the fifth part he shall add to it, and shall give it to the priest. And the priest shall atone for him by the ram of the trespass offering, and it shall be forgiven him.
LEV 5:17 And the soul who ever should sin, and should commit one trespass from all of the commandments of the LORD which he must not do; and does not know, and should trespass, and should take the guilt for his sin;
LEV 5:18 then he shall bring an unblemished ram from out of the flocks, the value of silver for the trespass offering to the priest. And the priest shall atone for him for his ignorance of which he was ignorant of, and he did not know. And it will be forgiven him,
LEV 5:19 for he trespassed a trespass - it is a trespass offering before the LORD.
LEV 6:1 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
LEV 6:2 The soul which ever should sin, and by ignoring should ignore the commandments of the LORD, and should lie concerning the neighbor in a matter of trust, or concerning fellowship, or concerning seizure, or he wronged the neighbor in any way,
LEV 6:3 or he found something lost and should lie concerning it, and should swear by an oath unjustly concerning any one of all which ever a man should do so as to sin by these.
LEV 6:4 Then it shall be when ever he should sin, and trespass, that he should give back the seized thing which he seized by force, or the offence which he wronged, or the trust which was placed in him, or the loss which he found of every thing of which he swore by an oath concerning it unjustly; and he shall pay it, the total sum, and his fifth part shall be added upon it - whatever is his he shall give back in the day he should be reproved.
LEV 6:5 And he shall bring for his trespass offering to the LORD, an unblemished ram from the flocks, the value for what he trespassed.
LEV 6:6 And the priest shall atone for him before the LORD. And it shall be forgiven to him for one of all which he did, and trespassed by it.
LEV 6:7 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
LEV 6:8 Give charge to Aaron and to his sons, saying!
LEV 6:9 This is the law of the bringing the whole burnt offering. This is the bringing the whole burnt offering upon its burning upon the altar the entire night until morning; and the fire of the altar shall burn upon it, and shall not be extinguished.
LEV 6:10 And the priest shall put on a flaxen linen inner garment, and shall put on flaxen linen pants on his body. And he shall remove the incinerated remains, which ever the fire should have consumed of the whole burnt offering of the altar. And he shall place it next to the altar.
LEV 6:11 And he shall take off his apparel, and shall put on other apparel. And he shall bring forth the incinerated remains outside the camp unto a clean place.
LEV 6:12 And the fire upon the altar shall be kept burning upon it; it shall not be extinguished. And the priest shall burn wood upon it morning by morning, and shall pile upon it the whole burnt offering. And he shall place upon it the fat of the deliverance offering.
LEV 6:13 And fire shall always burn upon the altar; it shall not be be extinguished.
LEV 6:14 This is the law of the sacrifice offering which the sons of Aaron shall bring it before the LORD, before the altar.
LEV 6:15 And he shall remove from it by the handful of the fine flour of the sacrifice offering, with its olive oil, and with all its frankincense being upon the sacrifice, and shall offer up upon the altar a yield offering scent of pleasant aroma, a memorial of it to the LORD.
LEV 6:16 And the remainder of it Aaron shall eat and his sons. It shall be eaten unleavened in a holy place; in the courtyard of the tent of the testimony they shall eat it.
LEV 6:17 It shall not be baked being leavened. I have given it as a portion to them of the yield offerings of the LORD; it is a holy of holies, as the one for the sin offering, and as the one for the trespass offering.
LEV 6:18 Every male of the priests shall eat it - an eternal law unto your generations of the yield offerings of the LORD. All who ever should touch them shall be sanctified.
LEV 6:19 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
LEV 6:20 This is the gift offering of Aaron and his sons, which they shall bring to the LORD in the day which ever you shall anoint him - the tenth of the ephah of fine flour for a sacrifice offering always, half of it in the morning, and half of it at dusk.
LEV 6:21 You shall prepare it upon a frying pan with olive oil. He shall bring it being mixed up, kneaded, as a sacrifice of pieces; he shall bring a sacrifice for a scent of pleasant aroma to the LORD.
LEV 6:22 And the anointed priest in place of him from his sons will prepare it. It is an eternal law to the LORD - all shall be completed.
LEV 6:23 And every sacrifice offering of a priest shall be wholly burnt; and it shall not be eaten.
LEV 6:24 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
LEV 6:25 Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, This is the law of the sin offering. In the place where they slay the whole burnt offerings, they shall slay also the one for the sin offering before the LORD - it is a holy of holies.
LEV 6:26 The priest offering it shall eat it in a holy place; he shall eat it in the courtyard of the tent of the testimony.
LEV 6:27 Every one touching of its meats shall be sanctified. And to whom ever should be sprinkled upon of its blood, upon the cloak - the one who should be sprinkled upon by it shall be washed in a holy place.
LEV 6:28 And an earthenware item of what ever should have been boiled in it shall be broken. And if it should have been boiled in an item of brass, he shall scour it, and wash it out in water.
LEV 6:29 Every male among the priests shall eat it; it is a holy of holies to the LORD.
LEV 6:30 And all the meats concerning the sin offering, what ever might be carried in of their blood into the tent of the testimony, to atone in the holy place, shall not be eaten; it shall be incinerated in fire.
LEV 7:1 And this is the law of the ram for the trespass offering - it is a holy of holies.
LEV 7:2 In the place of which they slay the whole burnt offering, they shall slay the ram of the trespass offering before the LORD. And he shall pour the blood upon the base of the altar round about.
LEV 7:3 And all the fat of it he shall offer of it, and the loin, and the fat covering up the entrails, and all the fat upon the entrails.
LEV 7:4 And the two kidneys, and the fat upon them upon the thighs, and the lobe upon the liver, with the kidneys - he shall remove them.
LEV 7:5 And the priest shall offer them upon the altar of the yield offering to the LORD - it is for a trespass offering.
LEV 7:6 Every male of the priests shall eat them; in the holy place they shall eat - it is a holy of holies.
LEV 7:7 As the one concerning the sin offering, so also the one of the trespass offering - there is one law for them. The priest, whoever shall atone for it, it shall be to him.
LEV 7:8 And the priest bringing the whole burnt offering of a man - the skin of the whole burnt offering which he offers will be his.
LEV 7:9 And every sacrifice offering which should be prepared in the oven, and all which shall be prepared upon a grate or upon a frying pan, of the priest offering it, it shall be his.
LEV 7:10 And every sacrifice offering being prepared in olive oil, and not being prepared with olive oil - all of it shall be for the sons of Aaron, to each equally.
LEV 7:11 This is the law of the sacrifice of deliverance, which they shall bring to the LORD.
LEV 7:12 If indeed for praise a man should offer it, then he shall bring upon the sacrifice of praise unleavened breads made of fine flour, being prepared in olive oil, and unleavened pancakes being smeared all over with olive oil, and fine flour being mixed with olive oil.
LEV 7:13 With leavened breads he shall offer his gift with a sacrifice of praise of his deliverance offering.
LEV 7:14 And he shall bring from his offering one portion from all of his gift offerings, a cut-away portion to the LORD; to the priest pouring on the blood of the deliverance offering - it will be to him.
LEV 7:15 And the meats of the sacrifice of praise of deliverance - it will be his. And in the day it is presented, it shall be eaten. They shall not leave behind of it into the morning.
LEV 7:16 And if it should be a vow, he should sacrifice the voluntary offering of his gift offering - in which ever day he should bring his sacrifice it shall be eaten, and in the next morning.
LEV 7:17 And the thing being left from the meats of the sacrifice until the third day shall be incinerated in fire.
LEV 7:18 And if in eating he should eat from the meats of the third day, it shall not be accepted to the one offering it; it shall not be imputed to him - it is a defilement, and the soul who should eat of it shall bear the sin.
LEV 7:19 And meats, whatever as much as touch any unclean thing, shall not be eaten; it shall be incinerated in fire. Every one clean shall eat clean meats.
LEV 7:20 And the soul which ever should eat from the meats of the sacrifice of the deliverance, which is to the LORD, then his uncleanness is upon him, that soul shall be destroyed from its people.
LEV 7:21 And the soul which ever should touch any thing unclean, or from an uncleanness of man, or of the four-footed creatures of the unclean, or any abomination of an unclean thing, and should eat from the meats of the sacrifice of the peace offerings, which is for the LORD, that soul shall be destroyed from its people.
LEV 7:22 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
LEV 7:23 Speak to the sons of Israel, saying! All fat of oxen, and sheep, and goats, you shall not eat.
LEV 7:24 And the fat of decaying flesh, and that taken by wild beasts, shall be appointed for all work things, but for food it shall not be eaten.
LEV 7:25 Every one eating fat off the cattle, of which he will bring from them as a yield offering to the LORD, that soul shall be destroyed from its people.
LEV 7:26 You shall not eat any blood in all of your house, of either the cattle and of the birds.
LEV 7:27 Every soul which ever should eat blood, that soul shall be destroyed from its people.
LEV 7:28 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
LEV 7:29 And to the sons of Israel you shall speak, saying, The one offering a sacrifice of his peace offerings to the LORD shall bring his gift to the LORD from the sacrifice of his deliverance offering.
LEV 7:30 His own hands shall bring the yield offerings to the LORD - the fat upon the breast, and the lobe upon the liver. He shall bring them so as to place a gift before the LORD.
LEV 7:31 And the priest shall offer the fat upon the altar. And the breast shall be Aaron's and to his sons.
LEV 7:32 And the right shoulder you shall give as a cut-away portion to the priest from the sacrifices of your deliverance offering.
LEV 7:33 The one offering the blood of the deliverance offering, and the fat, from the sons of Aaron - to him will be the right shoulder for a portion.
LEV 7:34 For the breast of the increase offering and the shoulder of the cut-away portion I have taken from the sons of Israel from the sacrifices of your deliverance offering, and I gave them to Aaron the priest and to his sons - an eternal law for the sons of Israel.

LEV 8:1 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

LEV 8:5 And Moses said to the congregation, This is the word which the LORD gave charge to do.
LEV 8:6 And Moses led forward Aaron, and his sons, and bathed them in water.

LEV 8:15 And he slew it. And Moses took of the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about with his finger, and cleansed the altar. And the blood he poured out upon the base of the altar, and sanctified it, to atone upon it.

LEV 8:21 and the belly and the feet he washed in water. And Moses offered up all the ram upon the altar. It is a whole burnt offering for a scent of pleasant aroma; it is a yield offering to the LORD; just as the LORD gave charge to Moses.
LEV 8:22 And Moses brought the second ram, the ram of consecration offering. And Aaron and his sons placed their hands upon the head of the ram.
LEV 8:23 And he slew it. And Moses took some of its blood, and he placed it upon the lobe of the right ear of Aaron, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the big toe of his right foot.
LEV 8:24 And Moses brought the sons of Aaron, and Moses put some of the blood upon the lobe of their right ear, and upon the thumb of their right hand, and upon the big toe of their right foot. And Moses poured the blood upon the altar round about.
LEV 8:25 And he took the fat, and the loin, and the fat upon the belly, and the lobe of the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat upon them, and the right shoulder.
LEV 8:26 And from the bin of the consecration offering being before the LORD, he took one unleavened bread, and one bread made of olive oil, and one pancake, and placed them upon the fat and upon the right shoulder.
LEV 8:27 And he put all these in the hands of Aaron, and upon the hands of his sons. And he offered them as a cut-away portion before the LORD.
LEV 8:28 And Moses took from their hands, and offered them upon the altar, upon the whole burnt offering of the consecration offering; which is a scent of pleasant aroma - it is a yield offering to the LORD.
LEV 8:29 And Moses taking the breast, removed it for an increase offering before the LORD, from the ram of the consecration; and it became to Moses for a portion; as the LORD gave charge to Moses.
LEV 8:30 And Moses took of the oil of the anointing, and of the blood upon the altar, and sprinkled it upon Aaron, and upon his apparels, and upon his sons, and upon the apparels of his sons. And he sanctified Aaron and his apparels, and his sons, and the apparels of his sons with him.
LEV 8:31 And Moses said to Aaron and his sons, Boil the meats by the gate of the tent of the testimony in the holy place! And there you shall eat them, and the breads in the bin of the consecration, in which manner it was ordered to me, saying, Aaron and his sons shall eat them.
LEV 8:32 And the amount being left behind of the meats and the breads shall be incinerated in fire.

LEV 10:4 And Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, sons of Uzziel brother of the father of Aaron, and said to them, Come forward and lift your brothers from before the holies outside of the camp.

LEV 11:1 And the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
LEV 11:2 Speak to the sons of Israel, saying! These are the animals which you shall eat from out of all of the animals upon the earth.
LEV 11:3 Every animal being cloven hoof, and clovenfooted, clawing with two claws, and taken up chewing the cud among the animals, these you shall eat.
LEV 11:4 Except from these you shall not eat - of the ones taking up chewing the cud, and of the ones not being cloven of the hoofs, and clawing clovenfooted - the camel, for this one takes up chewing the cud, and the hoof is not cloven; this one is unclean to you.
LEV 11:5 And the hare, for this one takes up chewing the cud, and its hoof is not cloven; this one is unclean to you.
LEV 11:6 And the hyrax, for this one does not take up chewing the cud, and the hoof is not cloven; this one is unclean to you.
LEV 11:7 And the pig, for this one is cloven of hoof, and claws with the claw of the hoof, but this one takes not up chewing the cud; this one is unclean to you.
LEV 11:8 Of their meats you shall not eat, and of the meats of their decaying flesh you shall not touch; these are unclean to you.
LEV 11:9 And these you shall eat out of all of the ones in the waters - all as many as there are fins to them and scales, being in the waters, and in the seas, and in the rushing streams - these you shall eat.
LEV 11:10 And all as many as there are not fins to them, nor scales, being in the waters, and in the seas, and in the rushing streams, of all which bubble the waters, and from every soul living in the water, it is an abomination.
LEV 11:11 And they shall be abominations to you; you shall not eat of their meats, and their decaying flesh you shall abhor.
LEV 11:12 And all as many as there are not fins to them, nor scales of the ones in the waters, this is an abomination to you.
LEV 11:13 And these you shall abhor from the winged creatures, and shall not be eaten, it is an abomination - the eagle, and the griffin, and the osprey,
LEV 11:14 and the vulture, and kite, and the ones likened to it; and all the crows, and the ones likened to it;
LEV 11:15 and the ostrich, and owl, and gull, and the ones likened to it;
LEV 11:16 and hawk, and the ones likened to it;
LEV 11:17 and long-eared owl, and cormorant, and ibis,
LEV 11:18 and the purple-legged stork, and pelican, and swan,
LEV 11:19 and heron, and curlew, and the ones likened to it; and hoopoe, and bat,
LEV 11:20 and all the crawling things of the winged creatures which go upon fours, is an abomination to you.
LEV 11:21 But these you shall eat from the crawling things of the winged creatures which go upon fours. which have legs upward from their feet, to spring up with them upon the earth.
LEV 11:22 And you shall eat these from them - the grasshopper, and the ones likened to it; and the hopping locust, and the ones likened to it; and crawling locust, and the ones likened to it; and the locust, and the ones likened to it.
LEV 11:23 And every crawling thing of the winged creatures which are of four feet, is an abomination to you.
LEV 11:24 And by these you shall be defiled - every one touching their decaying flesh will be unclean until evening.
LEV 11:25 And every one lifting their decaying flesh shall wash their garments, and shall be unclean until evening.
LEV 11:26 And among all the animals which are cloven hoof, and with clovenfooted claws, and of chewing the cud does not chew the cud - they shall be unclean to you. Every one touching their decaying flesh will be unclean until evening.
LEV 11:27 And every one which goes upon his hands among all the wild beasts, which go upon fours, it is unclean to you. Every one touching of their decaying flesh will be unclean until evening.
LEV 11:28 And the one lifting of their decaying flesh shall wash his garments, and will be unclean until evening - these shall be unclean to you.
LEV 11:29 And these are unclean to you of the crawling things of the ones crawling upon the earth - the weasel, and the mouse, and the dry land crocodile, and the ones likened to it;
LEV 11:30 the field-mouse, and chameleon, and newt, and lizard, and mole -
LEV 11:31 these are unclean to you from all of the crawling things crawling upon the earth - every one touching their decaying flesh will be unclean until evening.
LEV 11:32 And all upon what ever should fall upon it, upon their ones having died, shall be unclean from every wooden item, or garment, or skin, or a sackcloth. Every item in which ever work should be done by it shall be dipped into water, and it shall be unclean until evening - and then it will be clean.
LEV 11:33 And every earthenware item into what ever should fall in from them inside, as much as should be inside, it shall be unclean, and it shall be broken.
LEV 11:34 And every food eaten, into what ever water from such a container should come upon it, will be unclean to you. And every beverage which is drunk in any such receptacle, it shall be unclean.
LEV 11:35 And all upon what ever should fall from their decaying flesh upon it, it shall be unclean - ovens, and pots with feet, shall be demolished; these are unclean, and they shall be unclean to you.
LEV 11:36 Except springs of waters, or a well, or a gathering of water, it will be clean; but the one touching their decaying flesh, it shall be unclean.
LEV 11:37 And if anything should fall from their decaying flesh upon any seed fit for sowing, which shall be sown, it shall be clean.
LEV 11:38 But if water should be poured upon any seed, and their decaying flesh should fall upon it, it is unclean to you.
LEV 11:39 And if one should die of the animals, which this one is allowed for you to eat, the one touching of their decaying flesh will be unclean until evening.
LEV 11:40 And the one eating from their decaying flesh shall wash his garments, and shall be unclean until evening. And the one lifting of their decaying flesh shall wash his garments, and shall bathe in water, and shall be unclean until evening.
LEV 11:41 And every crawling thing which crawls upon the earth - this is an abomination to you, you shall not eat it.
LEV 11:42 And all going upon the belly, and all going upon fours always, which is numerous in feet among all the crawling things crawling upon the earth - you shall not eat it, for it is an abomination to you.
LEV 11:43 And no way shall you abhor your souls among all the crawling things crawling upon the earth. And you shall not be defiled by these, and you shall not be unclean by these.
LEV 11:44 For I am the LORD your God. And you shall be sanctified, and you shall be holy; for I the LORD your God am holy. And you shall not defile your souls among all the crawling things moving upon the earth.
LEV 11:45 For I am the LORD leading you from out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. And you shall be holy, for I the LORD am holy.
LEV 11:46 This is the law for the animals, and the winged creatures, and all life moving in the water, and all life crawling upon the earth;
LEV 11:47 to distinguish between the unclean and between the clean; and between the ones bringing forth alive the ones being eaten, and between the ones bringing forth alive the ones not being eaten.
LEV 12:1 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
LEV 12:2 Speak to the sons of Israel! And you shall say to them, saying, A woman whoever should conceive, and should give birth to a male; she shall be unclean seven days. According to the days of the separation of her menstruation she shall be unclean.
LEV 12:3 And in the eighth day she shall circumcise the flesh of his foreskin.
LEV 12:4 And thirty and three days she shall sit in the blood of her cleansing. She shall not touch anything holy, and she shall not enter into the sanctuary, until whenever the days of her cleansing should have been fulfilled.
LEV 12:5 But if she should give birth to a female, then she will be unclean twice seven days, according to her menstruation; and sixty days and six she shall be seated in her unclean blood.
LEV 12:6 And whenever the days of her cleansing should be fulfilled, for a son, or for a daughter, she shall bring a lamb of a year old for a whole burnt offering, and a young pigeon, or turtle-dove for a sin offering, to the door of the tent of the testimony, to the priest.
LEV 12:7 And she shall bring it before the LORD, and the priest shall atone for her, and shall cleanse her from the spring of her blood. This is the law for the giving birth to a male or female.
LEV 12:8 But if her hand does not find enough for a lamb, then she shall take two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons - one for a whole burnt offering, and one for a sin offering; and the priest shall atone for her, and she shall be cleansed.
LEV 13:1 And the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
LEV 13:2 If any man should have in the skin of his flesh a discoloration radiant spot, and an infection of leprosy takes place in the skin of his flesh, he shall be led to Aaron the priest, or one of his sons of the priests.
LEV 13:3 And the priest shall look at the infection in the skin of his flesh. And if a hair in the infection should turn white, and the appearance of the infection be deep under the skin of his flesh, it is an infection of leprosy - and the priest shall look, and shall declare him defiled.
LEV 13:4 And if the radiant spot should be white in the skin of his flesh, and its appearance should not be deep below the skin, and its hair did not turn white, but it is faint, then the priest shall separate the infection for seven days.
LEV 13:5 And the priest shall look at the infection on the seventh day. And behold, if the infection abides before him, and if the infection did not degenerate in the skin, then the priest shall separate him seven days the second time.
LEV 13:6 And the priest shall look at him on the seventh day the second time. And behold, if the infection is faint, and the infection did not degenerate in the skin, then the priest will cleanse him; for it is a spot. And washing his garments, he will be clean.
LEV 13:7 But if in turning, the spot degenerates in the skin, after the priest looking at him to cleanse him, then he shall appear the second time to the priest.
LEV 13:8 And the priest shall look at him, and behold, if the spot degenerated in the skin, then the priest shall declare him defiled - it is leprosy.
LEV 13:9 And if an infection of leprosy happens in a man, then he shall come to the priest.
LEV 13:10 And the priest shall look. And behold, if it is a white discoloration in the skin, and if it turned the hair white, and some of the healthy flesh be living in the discoloration -
LEV 13:11 it is a leprosy becoming old in the skin of his flesh, and the priest shall declare him defiled, and shall separate him; for he is unclean.
LEV 13:12 But if blooming leprosy shall break out in the skin, and the leprosy shall cover all the skin with the infection, from head unto his feet, according to the whole vision of the priest;
LEV 13:13 then the priest shall look, and behold, if the leprosy covers all the skin of his flesh, then he shall cleanse the infection, for all turned white - he is clean.
LEV 13:14 And in what ever day living flesh should appear to him, he shall be declared defiled.
LEV 13:15 And the priest shall look at the healthy flesh, and the healthy flesh shall prove him defiled; for it is unclean - it is leprosy.
LEV 13:16 But if the healthy flesh should restore and turn white, then he shall come to the priest;
LEV 13:17 and the priest shall see him. And behold, if the infection turned to the white, then the priest shall declare him cleansed by the infection - he is clean.
LEV 13:18 And if flesh should have a lesion in its skin, and should heal,
LEV 13:19 and there should become in the place of the lesion a white discoloration, or radiant spot being whitened, or being reddish, and it should be looked at by the priest;
LEV 13:20 then the priest shall look. And behold, if the appearance be deeper under the skin, and its hair turns into white; then the priest shall declare him defiled; for it is leprosy - it broke out in the lesion.
LEV 13:21 But if the priest should look at him, and behold, there is not a white hair on it, and it should not be deep under the skin of the flesh, and it should be faint; then the priest shall separate him seven days.
LEV 13:22 But if in a diffusion it should have diffused in the skin, then the priest shall declare him defiled - it is an infection of leprosy; it broke out in the lesion.
LEV 13:23 And if in its place the radiance should abide, and should not diffuse, it is a discoloration of the lesion; and the priest shall cleanse him.
LEV 13:24 And if flesh should become a fiery inflammation in his skin, and there should be in his skin the healing of the inflammation, shining forth radiant white, becoming somewhat reddish, or very white;
LEV 13:25 then the priest shall look at him. And behold, if the hair is turned white in the shining forth, and the appearance of it is deep under the skin; it is leprosy - it broke out in the inflammation; and the priest shall declare him defiled - it is an infection of leprosy.
LEV 13:26 But if the priest should look at him, and behold, there is not in the shining forth a white hair, and it should not be deep under the skin, but it is faint; then the priest shall separate him seven days.
LEV 13:27 And the priest shall look at him in the seventh day. But if the diffusion should diffuse in the skin, then the priest shall declare him defiled - it is an infection of leprosy; it broke out in the lesion.
LEV 13:28 But if the shining forth should stay in its place, and should not be diffused in the skin, but it should be faint; it is a discoloration of an inflammation, and the priest should declare him cleansed - for it is an effect of an inflammation.
LEV 13:29 And a man or a woman in whom ever has in themselves an infection of leprosy in the head or in the beard;
LEV 13:30 then the priest shall look at the infection. And behold, if its appearance be imbedded under the skin, and in it a yellowish thin hair; then the priest shall declare him defiled - it is an outbreak; it is a leprosy of the head or a leprosy of the beard.
LEV 13:31 And if the priest should look at the infection of the outbreak, and behold, the appearance is not imbedded under the skin, and the hair is not yellowish in it, then the priest shall separate the infection of the outbreak seven days.
LEV 13:32 And the priest shall look at the infection on the seventh day. And behold, if the outbreak should not be diffused, and there is not a yellowish hair in it, and the appearance of the outbreak is not hollow under the skin;
LEV 13:33 then the skin shall be shaven, but the outbreak shall not be shaven; and the priest shall separate the outbreak seven days for the second time.
LEV 13:34 And the priest shall look at the outbreak on the seventh day; and behold, if the outbreak should not be diffused in the skin after the shaving of it, and the appearance of the outbreak is not hollow under the skin; then the priest shall cleanse him; and washing his garments, he will be clean.
LEV 13:35 But if the diffusion should be diffused in the outbreak in the skin after cleansing it;
LEV 13:36 then the priest shall look at him. And behold, if the outbreak should be diffused in the skin, the priest shall not examine concerning the hair being yellowish - he is unclean.
LEV 13:37 But if before him the outbreak should abide in its place \Gr be stabilized., and a black hair should rise in it; the outbreak is healed - he is clean; and the priest shall declare him cleansed.
LEV 13:38 And a man or woman in whom ever should have in the skin of his flesh shinings shining forth, being white;
LEV 13:39 then the priest shall look. And behold, in the skin of his flesh shinings shining forth being white; it is a psoriasis, it broke out in the skin; he is clean.
LEV 13:40 And if any one should be loose of hair - his head is bald; he is clean.
LEV 13:41 But if his head is loose of hair by his face, he is forehead bald; he is clean.
LEV 13:42 But if there becomes in his baldness, or in his being forehead bald a white infection or reddening; it is leprosy blossoming in his baldness, or in his forehead baldness.
LEV 13:43 And the priest shall look at it. And behold, if the appearance of the infection be white or reddish in his baldness, or in his being forehead bald, as the form of leprosy in the skin of his flesh -
LEV 13:44 he is a leprous man, he is unclean. In defilement the priest shall declare him defiled - in his head is his infection.
LEV 13:45 And the leper in whom is the infection, his garments shall be disabled, and his head uncovered, and concerning his mouth - let him put something around it! And he shall call himself Unclean.
LEV 13:46 All the days, as many as the infection might be upon him being unclean; he shall be unclean. Being separated he shall sit down outside of his camp - it will be to him a place for pastime.
LEV 13:47 And a garment which ever should have in it an infection of leprosy in a woolen garment, or in a garment made of hemp,
LEV 13:48 or in the warp, or in the woof, or in the flaxen linens, or in the woolen threads, or in a skin, or in any worked skin;
LEV 13:49 and the infection should become greenish or reddish in the skin, or in the garment, or in the warp, or in the woof, or in any item in worked skin - it is an infection of leprosy, and he shall show it to the priest.
LEV 13:50 And the priest shall look at the infection; and the priest shall separate the infection seven days.
LEV 13:51 And he shall look at the infection on the seventh day. But if the infection should diffuse in the garment, or in the warp, or in the woof, or in the skin, according to all as much as might be made with the skins in the work - it is permanent leprosy; it is an unclean infection.
LEV 13:52 He shall incinerate the garment, or the warp, or the woof which is in the woolen garments, or in the flaxen linens, or in every item made of skin, in which ever there might be in it the infection - for it is a permanent leprosy; by fire it shall be incinerated.
LEV 13:53 But if the priest should look, and the infection should not be diffused in the garment, or in the warp, or in the woof, or in any item made of skin;
LEV 13:54 then the priest shall order, and one shall wash that upon which ever there might be an infection upon it; and the priest shall separate the infection seven days for the second time.
LEV 13:55 And the priest shall look after the washing the infection. And if thus the infection in no way should turn of its appearance, and the infection did not diffuse, it is unclean; in fire you shall incinerate it; it is fixed firm in the garment, or in the warp, or in the woof.
LEV 13:56 And if the priest should look, and the infection should be faint after the washing it; then he shall rip it from the garment, or from the warp, or from the woof, or from the skin.
LEV 13:57 And if it should appear still in the garment, or in the warp, or in the woof, or in any item made of skin - it is leprosy breaking out; by fire you shall incinerate that which the infection is in.
LEV 13:58 And the garment, or the warp, or the woof, or any item made of skin which shall be washed, and the infection leaves from it, then it shall be washed the second time, and it shall be clean.
LEV 13:59 This is the law of an infection of leprosy of a garment of wool, or made of hemp, or warp, or woof, or any item made of skin, in the declaring it cleansed or defiled.
LEV 14:1 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
LEV 14:2 This is the law of the leper in whatever day he should have been cleansed, and shall be brought to the priest.
LEV 14:3 And the priest shall come forth outside the camp; and the priest shall look, and behold, if the infection has been healed of the leprosy from the leper;
LEV 14:4 then the priest shall assign, and they shall take for the one being cleansed two clean living small birds, and wood of cedar, and twined scarlet, and hyssop.
LEV 14:5 And the priest shall assign, and they shall slay the one small bird into an earthenware receptacle over living water.
LEV 14:6 And the small living bird - he shall take it, and the wood of cedar, and the spun scarlet, and the hyssop, and shall dip them, and the small living bird into the blood of the small bird being slain over living water.
LEV 14:7 And he shall sprinkle it about upon the one being cleansed of the leprosy seven times, and he will be clean. And he shall send out the small living bird into the plain.
LEV 14:8 And the one being cleansed shall wash his garments, and he shall shave all his hair, and shall bathe in water, and shall be clean. And after these things he shall enter into the camp, and shall spend time outside of his house seven days.
LEV 14:9 And it will be on the seventh day, he shall shave all of his hair, the hair of his head, and the beard, and the brows - even all his hair he shall shave. And he shall wash his garments, and shall bathe his body in water, and he shall be clean.
LEV 14:10 And on the eighth day he shall take two lambs, unblemished, of a year old, and one sheep, unblemished of a year old, and three tenths of fine flour for a sacrifice offering, being mixed in olive oil, and one small cup of olive oil.
LEV 14:11 And the priest that cleanses shall stand the man for the cleansing, and these offerings before the LORD, at the door of the tent of the testimony.
LEV 14:12 And the priest shall take the one lamb, and bring it for the trespass offering, and the small cup of olive oil; and he shall separate them as a separation offering before the LORD.
LEV 14:13 And he shall slay the lamb in the place where they slay the whole burnt offerings, and the ones for a sin offering, in the holy place. For it is the one for a sin offering; as the one of the trespass offering is for the priest - it is a holy of holies.
LEV 14:14 And the priest shall take from the blood, of the trespass offering, and the priest shall place it upon the lobe of the ear of the one being cleansed - the right, and upon the thumb of his hand - the right, and upon the big toe of his foot - the right.
LEV 14:15 And the priest taking from the small cup of the olive oil, he shall pour upon the left hand of the priest.
LEV 14:16 And the priest shall dip his right finger from the olive oil being in his left hand. And he shall sprinkle from the olive oil with his finger seven times before the LORD.
LEV 14:17 And the left behind olive oil being in his hand the priest shall place upon the lobe of the right ear of the one being cleansed, and upon the thumb of his hand - the right, and upon the big toe of his foot - the right, upon the place of the blood of the trespass offering.
LEV 14:18 And the left over olive oil that is upon the hand of the priest, the priest shall place it upon the head of the one being cleansed, and the priest shall atone for him before the LORD.
LEV 14:19 And the priest shall offer the thing for the sin offering, and the priest shall atone for the one being cleansed of his sin; and after this the priest shall slay the whole burnt offering.
LEV 14:20 And the priest shall offer the whole burnt offering and the sacrifice offering upon the altar before the LORD - and the priest shall atone for him, and he shall be cleansed.
LEV 14:21 And if he should be in need, and his hand should not find what is needed - he shall take one lamb for what he trespassed for a cut-away portion, so as to atone for him, and a tenth of fine flour being mixed in olive oil for a sacrifice offering, and one small cup of olive oil,
LEV 14:22 and two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons, as much as his hand found. And the one shall be for a sin offering, and the one for a whole burnt offering.
LEV 14:23 And he shall bring them on the eighth day for his cleansing to the priest, unto the door of the tent of the testimony, before the LORD.
LEV 14:24 And the priest taking the lamb of the trespass offering, and the small cup of the olive oil, and he shall place them for an increase offering before the LORD.
LEV 14:25 And he shall slay the lamb of the trespass offering. And the priest shall take from the blood of the trespass offering, and shall place it upon the lobe of the ear of the one being cleansed - the right, and upon the thumb of his hand - the right, and upon the big toe of his foot - the right.
LEV 14:26 And of the olive oil the priest shall pour upon his own hand - the left.
LEV 14:27 And the priest shall sprinkle with his finger - the right from the olive oil in his hand - the left, seven times before the LORD.
LEV 14:28 And the priest shall put of the olive oil being in his hand, upon the lobe of the ear of the one being cleansed - the right, and upon the thumb of his hand - the right, and upon the big toe of his foot - of the right, upon the place of the blood of the one of the trespass offering.
LEV 14:29 And the left over olive oil being in the hand of the priest he shall place upon the head of the one being cleansed, and the priest shall atone for him before the LORD.
LEV 14:30 And he shall offer one from the turtle-doves, or from the young ones of the pigeons, in so far as his hand found,
LEV 14:31 the one for a sin offering, and the one for a whole burnt offering with the sacrifice offering. And the priest shall atone for the one being cleansed before the LORD.
LEV 14:32 This is the law in whom is found the infection of the leprosy, and not finding means in his hand enough for his cleansing.
LEV 14:33 And the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
LEV 14:34 When ever you should enter into the land of the Canaanites, which I give to you for a possession, and I put an infection of leprosy in the houses of the land procured by you;
LEV 14:35 then one from the house shall come and shall announce to the priest, saying, Something as an infection has appeared to me in the house.
LEV 14:36 And the priest will assign to pack up the house before the priest enters to look at the infection, that in no way as much as might be in the house should become unclean. And after these things the priest shall enter to study the house.
LEV 14:37 And he shall look at the infection. And behold, if the infection is in the walls of the house, with a cavity being greenish or being reddish, and their appearance deeper in the walls,
LEV 14:38 and the priest coming forth from out of the house, at the door of the house, that the priest shall separate the house seven days.
LEV 14:39 And the priest shall come back again on the seventh day, and he shall look at the house. And behold, if the infection was diffused in the walls of the house,
LEV 14:40 then the priest shall assign, and they shall take out the stones in which is the infection, and shall cast them outside the city, into an unclean place.
LEV 14:41 And they shall scrape the house from inside round about, and shall pour out the plaster dust of the scraping outside the city into an unclean place.
LEV 14:42 And they shall take stones being scraped of others. And they shall substitute for the stones. And they shall take other plaster dust, and they shall plaster the house.
LEV 14:43 But if the infection should come again, and should rise up in the house after the taking away of the stones, and after the scraping the house, and after the plastering,
LEV 14:44 then the priest shall enter and shall look. If the infection in the house be dispersed, it is a permanent leprosy in the house - it is unclean.
LEV 14:45 And they shall demolish the house, and its wood, and its stones; and all the plaster dust of the house they shall bring forth outside the city unto an unclean place.
LEV 14:46 And the one entering into the house, all the days which it is being separated, will be unclean until evening.
LEV 14:47 And the one going to bed in the house shall wash his garments, and he will be unclean until evening. And the one eating in the house shall wash his garments.
LEV 14:48 And if coming, the priest should enter and look, and behold, the infection is not dispersed in the house after the plastering the house, that the priest shall declare the house cleansed, for the infection is healed.
LEV 14:49 And he shall take to purify the house, two small living birds, and wood of cedar, and twined scarlet, and hyssop.
LEV 14:50 And he shall slay the one small bird into an earthenware utensil over living water.
LEV 14:51 And he shall take the wood of cedar, and the twined scarlet, and the hyssop, and the living small bird, and shall dip them into the blood of the small bird having been slain over living water, and shall sprinkle about with them upon the house seven times.
LEV 14:52 And he shall purify the house with the blood of the small bird, and with the living water, and with the living small bird, and with the wood of cedar, and with the hyssop, and with the twined scarlet.
LEV 14:53 And he shall send out the living small bird outside the city into the plain, and shall atone for the house - and it will be clean.
LEV 14:54 This is the law for every infection of leprosy, and outbreak,
LEV 14:55 and the leprosy of a garment, and house,
LEV 14:56 and discoloration, and spot, and shining;
LEV 14:57 to describe the day unclean, and the day it shall be cleansed - this is the law of the leprosy.
LEV 15:1 And the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
LEV 15:2 Speak to the sons of Israel! And you shall say to them, A man, a man in whom ever should have a flow from out of his body, his flow is unclean.
LEV 15:3 And this is the law of his uncleanness. Flowing semen from out of his body, from out of the flow, in which his body concocted, his uncleanness is through this flow in him.
LEV 15:4 Every bed upon which ever he should go to bed upon it, the one having a seminal emission, is unclean; and every item upon which ever he should sit upon it, the one having a seminal emission, is unclean.
LEV 15:5 And a man who ever should touch his bed shall wash his garments, and shall bathe in water, and shall be unclean until evening.
LEV 15:6 And the one sitting down upon the item, upon what ever the one having a seminal emission should sit upon it, shall wash his garments, and shall bathe in water, and shall be unclean until evening.
LEV 15:7 And the one touching the flesh of the one having a seminal emission shall wash his garments, and shall bathe in water, and will be unclean until evening.
LEV 15:8 And if the one having a seminal emission should salivate upon one that is clean; that person shall wash his garments, and shall bathe in water, and will be unclean until evening.
LEV 15:9 And every saddle upon which the one having a seminal emission should mount upon it will be unclean until evening.
LEV 15:10 And every one touching from all as much as might be underneath him will be unclean until evening. And the one lifting them shall wash his garments, and shall bathe in water, and will be unclean until evening.
LEV 15:11 And of as many as should touch the one having a seminal emission, and his hands have not been washed in water, he shall wash his garments, and shall bathe in water, and he will be unclean until evening.
LEV 15:12 And an earthenware item of which ever the one having a seminal emission should have touched, shall be broken. And every wooden item shall be washed in water, and it will be clean.
LEV 15:13 And if the one having a seminal emission should be cleansed from his flow; then he shall count out to himself seven days for his cleansing, and shall wash his garments, and bathe his body in living water, and he will be clean.

LEV 15:15 And the priest shall offer them - one for a sin offering, and one for a whole burnt offering; and the priest shall atone for him before the LORD for his flow.

LEV 15:23 And if being in her bed, or upon the item of which ever she should sit upon it, in its touching her, it shall be unclean until evening.
LEV 15:24 And if any one should bed down in her bed with her, and her uncleanness should be upon him, he shall be unclean seven days. And every bed upon which ever he should go to bed upon it shall be unclean.
LEV 15:25 And a woman, if she should flow a flow of blood many days, not in the time of her menstruation, and if also it should flow after her menstruation; all the days of the flow of her uncleanness shall be just as the days of her menstruation - she shall be unclean.
LEV 15:26 And every bed upon of which ever she should go to bed upon it all the days of her flow will be to her as the bed of her menstruation. And every item upon which ever she should sit upon it shall be unclean, according to the uncleanness of her menstruation.

LEV 15:28 But if she should be cleansed from her flow, then she shall count out to herself seven days, and after this she shall be cleansed.
LEV 15:29 And the eighth day she shall take for herself two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons, and shall bring them to the priest, unto the door of the tent of the testimony.
LEV 15:30 And the priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the one for a whole burnt offering. And the priest shall atone for her before the LORD of the flow of her uncleanness.
