LEV 16:1 And the LORD spoke to Moses after the coming to an end of the two sons of Aaron, in their offering alien fire before the LORD, and they came to an end.
LEV 16:2 And the LORD said to Moses, Speak to Aaron your brother, that he enters not at any hour into the holy place inside the veil, at the front of the atonement-seat, which is upon the ark of the testimony, that he shall not die! For in a cloud I will appear upon the atonement-seat.
LEV 16:3 Thus Aaron shall enter into the holy place - with a calf of the oxen for a sin offering, and a ram for a whole burnt offering.
LEV 16:4 And he shall put on an inner garment of flaxen linen having been sanctified; and flaxen linen pants will be upon his flesh, and a flaxen linen belt shall be tied around, and a flaxen linen turban shall be placed - they are the holy garments. And he shall bathe in water all his body, and shall put them on.
LEV 16:5 And from the congregation of the sons of Israel he shall take two young he-goats of the goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a whole burnt offering.
LEV 16:6 And Aaron shall bring the calf for a sin offering for himself, and shall atone for himself and his house.
LEV 16:7 And he shall take the two young he-goats, and present them before the LORD by the door of the tent of the testimony.
LEV 16:8 And Aaron shall place lots upon the two young he-goats; one lot to the LORD, and one lot to the scapegoat.
LEV 16:9 And Aaron shall bring the young he-goat upon which came unto it the lot to the LORD, and shall offer it for a sin offering.
LEV 16:10 And the young he-goat, upon which the lot of the scapegoat came unto it, he shall set it living before the LORD, so as to atone for him, so as to send him out as the scapegoat, and to let him go into the wilderness.
LEV 16:11 And Aaron shall bring the calf for the sin offering for himself, and shall atone for himself and his house; and he shall slay the calf for the sin offering for himself.
LEV 16:12 And he shall take the censer full of coals of fire from the altar before the LORD, and shall fill his hands of fine incense composition, and shall carry it inside the veil.
LEV 16:13 And he shall place the incense upon the fire before the LORD. And the vapor of the incense shall cover the atonement-seat upon the testimonies, and he shall not die.
LEV 16:14 And he shall take some of the blood of the calf, and shall sprinkle with his finger on the atonement-seat, according to the east; in front of the atonement-seat he shall sprinkle seven times of the blood with his finger.
LEV 16:15 And he shall slay the young he-goat for a sin offering for the people, before the LORD. And he shall carry its blood inside the veil, and shall offer its blood in which manner he offered the blood of the calf, and shall sprinkle its blood on the atonement-seat, according to the front of the atonement-seat.
LEV 16:16 And he shall atone the holy place of the uncleannesses of the sons of Israel, and of their offences for all their sins. And thus he shall do to the tent of the testimony created among them in the midst of their uncleanness.
LEV 16:17 And every man shall not be in the tent of the testimony, of his entering to atone in the holy place, until whenever he should come forth, and shall atone for himself, and his house, and for all the congregation of Israel.
LEV 16:18 And he shall come forth unto the altar before the LORD, and shall atone upon it. And he shall take from the blood of the calf, and from the blood of the young he-goat, and shall place it upon the horns of the altar round about.
LEV 16:19 And he shall sprinkle upon it some of the blood with his finger seven times, and shall cleanse it, and shall sanctify it from the uncleannesses of the sons of Israel.
LEV 16:20 And he shall complete making an atonement for the holy place, and the tent of the testimony, and the altar, and shall make a cleansing for the priests, and shall bring the living young he-goat.
LEV 16:21 And Aaron shall place his two hands upon the head of the living young he-goat, and shall declare openly over it all the lawless deeds of the sons of Israel, and all their iniquities, and all their sins. And he shall place them upon the head of the living young he-goat, and shall send it out by the hand of a prepared man into the wilderness.
LEV 16:22 And the young he-goat shall take upon himself their lawlessnesses into a land untrodden. And he shall send out the young he-goat into the wilderness.
LEV 16:23 And Aaron shall enter into the tent of the testimony, and shall take off the flaxen linen apparel, which he put on of his entering into the holy place, and shall put it aside there.
LEV 16:24 And he shall bathe his body in water in the holy place, and shall put on his apparel, and coming forth shall offer his whole burnt offering, and the whole offering of the people, and shall atone for himself, and for his house, and for the people as for the priests.
LEV 16:25 And the fat for the sin offerings he shall offer upon the altar.
LEV 16:26 And the one sending out the young he-goat, the one having been drawn apart for release, shall wash his garments, and shall bathe his body in water, and after these things he shall enter into the camp.
LEV 16:27 And the calf for the sin offering, and the young he-goat for the sin offering, which their blood was carried to atone in the holy place, they shall bring them outside the camp, and shall incinerate them in fire, and their skins, and their meats, and their dung.
LEV 16:28 And the one incinerating them shall wash his garments, and shall bathe his body in water, and after these things he shall enter into the camp.
LEV 16:29 And this shall be to you an eternal law. In the seventh month, the tenth of the month, humble your souls! And you shall not do any work - the native born and the foreigner joining up with you.
LEV 16:30 For in this day he shall atone for you, to cleanse you from all your sins before the LORD, and you shall be cleansed.
LEV 16:31 A sabbath of sabbaths it shall be to you. And you shall humble your souls - an eternal law.
LEV 16:32 And the priest shall make atonement - whom ever they should anoint him, and whom ever shall perfect his hands to officiate as priest after his father. And he shall put on the flaxen linen apparel - holy apparel.
LEV 16:33 And he shall atone the holy of the holy. And the tent of the testimony and the altar he shall atone. And for the priests, and for all the congregation he shall atone.
LEV 16:34 And this will be to you an eternal law, to atone for the sons of Israel from all their sins. Once of the year you shall do as the LORD gave orders to Moses.
LEV 17:1 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
LEV 17:2 Speak to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the sons of Israel! And you shall say to them this saying which the LORD gives charge, saying,
LEV 17:3 A man, a man of the sons of Israel, who ever should slay a calf or a sheep or a goat in the camp, and who ever should slay outside the camp,
LEV 17:4 and should not bring it to the door of the tent of the testimony, so as to bring a gift to the LORD before the tent of the LORD; blood shall be imputed to that man, for blood was poured out. That soul shall be utterly destroyed from its people,
LEV 17:5 so that the sons of Israel should bring their sacrifices, as many as they should slay in the plains, and shall bring them to the LORD at the door of the tent of the testimony, to the priest. And they shall sacrifice them as a sacrifice of deliverance to the LORD.
LEV 17:6 And the priest shall pour the blood upon the altar, before the LORD, by the door of the tent of the testimony. And he shall offer the fat for a scent of pleasant aroma to the LORD.
LEV 17:7 And they shall not sacrifice still their sacrifices to the vain gods in which they fornicate after them. It will be an eternal law to you unto your generations.
LEV 17:8 And you shall say to them, A man, a man from the sons of Israel, and from the foreigners of the ones lying nearby among you, who ever should offer a whole burnt offering or sacrifice,
LEV 17:9 and at the door of the tent of the testimony should not bring anything to offer it to the LORD, that man shall be utterly destroyed from his people.
LEV 17:10 And a man, a man of the sons of Israel, or of the foreigners of the ones lying nearby among you, who ever should eat any blood; even I will set my face against the soul eating the blood, and I will destroy it from out of its people.
LEV 17:11 For the life of all flesh is its blood. And I gave it to you upon the altar to atone for your souls. For its blood shall atone for the soul.
LEV 17:12 On account of this I have said to the sons of Israel, Every soul of you shall not eat blood; and the foreigner, the one lying near by to you shall not eat blood.
LEV 17:13 And a man, a man of the sons of Israel, or of the foreigners of the ones lying near to you, who ever shall hunt a hunt for a wild beast or birds, which is to be eaten, shall pour out its blood, and cover it in the ground.
LEV 17:14 For the life of all flesh is its blood. And I said to the sons of Israel, The blood of all flesh you shall not eat; for life of all flesh is its blood. Every one eating it shall be utterly destroyed.
LEV 17:15 And every soul who should eat decaying flesh, or flesh taken by wild beasts, among the native born, or by the foreigners, shall wash his garments, and shall bathe in water, and will be unclean until evening - then he will be clean.
LEV 17:16 But if he should not wash his garments, and should not bathe his body in water, then he shall take the violation of the law himself.
LEV 18:1 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
LEV 18:2 Speak to the sons of Israel! And you shall say to them, I am the LORD your God.
LEV 18:3 According to the practices of the land of Egypt, in which you sojourned in it, you shall not do. And according to the practices of the land of Canaan, into which I bring you there, you shall not do. And their laws you shall not go by.
LEV 18:4 My judgments you shall execute, and my orders you shall keep, and shall go by them - I am the LORD your God.
LEV 18:5 And you shall keep all my orders, and all my judgments; and you shall observe them - by which a man observing them shall live by them. I am the LORD your God.
LEV 18:6 A man, a man shall not draw near to any family member of his flesh to uncover their indecency - I am the LORD.
LEV 18:7 The indecency of your father, and the indecency of your mother, you shall not uncover - for she is your mother. Her indecency you shall not uncover.
LEV 18:8 The indecency of a wife of your father you shall not uncover - it is your father's indecency.
LEV 18:9 The indecency of your sister of your father or of your mother, natural or being procreated outside - you shall not uncover their indecency.
LEV 18:10 The indecency of a daughter of your son, or a daughter of your daughter - you shall not uncover their indecency, for it is your indecency.
LEV 18:11 The indecency of the daughter of your father's wife you shall not uncover - she is your sister of the same father, you shall not uncover her indecency.
LEV 18:12 The indecency of your father's sister you shall not uncover, for she is a member of the family of your father.
LEV 18:13 The indecency of your mother's sister you shall not uncover, for she is a member of the family of your mother.
LEV 18:14 The indecency of a brother of your father you shall not uncover, and to his wife you shall not enter, for she is your relative.
LEV 18:15 The indecency of your daughter-in-law you shall not uncover, for she is your son's wife - you shall not uncover her indecency.
LEV 18:16 The indecency of your brother's wife you shall not uncover - it is your brother's indecency.
LEV 18:17 The indecency of a woman and her daughter you shall not uncover; the daughter of her son and the daughter of her daughter you shall not take to uncover their indecency - they are members of your family; it is an act of impiety.
LEV 18:18 You shall not take a wife in addition to her sister as a rival, to uncover her indecency instead of her, while she is yet living.
LEV 18:19 And to a wife in separation of her uncleanness you shall not enter, to uncover her indecency.
LEV 18:20 And to the wife of your neighbor you shall not give a marriage-bed of your semen, to be thoroughly defiled with her.
LEV 18:21 And you shall not give of your semen to serve a ruler; and you shall not profane the holy name - I am the LORD.
LEV 18:22 And with a man you shall not go to bed in a marriage-bed in the feminine way; for it is an abomination.
LEV 18:23 And with any four-footed creature, you shall not give your marriage-bed for a discharge of semen, to be thoroughly defiled with it. And a woman shall not set herself with any four-footed creature to breed; for it is detestable.
LEV 18:24 Do not defile yourselves in any of these; for in all these the nations were defiled which I eject before your face.
LEV 18:25 And the land was thoroughly defiled; and I recompensed injustice to them because of it, and the land is loathed with the ones lying in wait upon it.
LEV 18:26 And you shall guard all my laws, and my orders, and the native inhabitant and the foreigner uniting with you shall not do any of these abominations.
LEV 18:27 For all these abominations the men of the land committed - the ones being prior of you, and the land was defiled.
LEV 18:28 And lest the land should loathe you in your defiling it, in which manner it loathed the nations before you -
LEV 18:29 that all who ever should do of all these abominations shall be utterly destroyed (the souls doing them) from out of the midst of their people.
LEV 18:30 And you shall keep my orders, so that you should not do of any of the laws of the ones being abhorred, which happened before you, and so that you shall not be defiled among them - for I am the LORD your God.
LEV 19:1 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
LEV 19:2 Speak to all the congregation of the sons of Israel! And you shall say to them, You shall be holy, for I the LORD your God am holy.
LEV 19:3 Let each one fear his father and his mother! And my sabbaths you shall keep - I am the LORD your God.
LEV 19:4 You shall not follow after idols, and you shall not make to yourselves molten gods - I am the LORD your God.
LEV 19:5 And if you should sacrifice a sacrifice of deliverance offering to the LORD, you shall sacrifice acceptable for yourselves.
LEV 19:6 In which ever day you should sacrifice, it shall be eaten, and in the next morning. And if any should be left behind until the third day, it shall be incinerated by fire.
LEV 19:7 And if food should be eaten the third day it is unfit, you shall not accept it.
LEV 19:8 And the one eating it shall take the sin, for the holy things of the LORD he profaned. And the souls eating it shall be utterly destroyed from their people.
LEV 19:9 And of your reaping the harvest of your land - you shall not complete your harvest of your field to completely reap it; and the parts falling away of your harvest you shall not collect together.
LEV 19:10 And of your vineyard you shall not glean the vintage; nor shall you collect together the grape-stones of your vineyard - to the poor and to the foreigner you shall leave behind for them. I am the LORD your God.
LEV 19:11 You shall not steal, and you shall not lie, nor shall you extort each his neighbor.
LEV 19:12 And you shall not swear by an oath upon my name unjustly. And you shall not profane the holy name of your God - I am the LORD your God.
LEV 19:13 You shall not wrong your neighbor, and you shall not seize by force, and the wages of your hireling shall not go to bed with you until morning.
LEV 19:14 You shall not wickedly speak to a mute, and before the blind you shall not put an obstacle. And you shall fear the LORD your God - I am the LORD your God.
LEV 19:15 You shall not act unjustly in a judgment. You shall not take favor on the face of the poor, nor marvel before the face of a mighty one. With righteousness you shall judge your neighbor.
LEV 19:16 You shall not go by treachery among your nation. You shall not rise up together for blood of your neighbor - I am the LORD your God.
LEV 19:17 You shall not detest your brother in your mind. With rebuke you shall reprove your neighbor, and you shall not take sin on account of him.
LEV 19:18 And your hand shall not avenge. And you shall not be infuriated at the sons of your people. And you shall love your neighbor as yourself - I am the LORD your God.
LEV 19:19 My law you shall keep. Your cattle you shall not mate unequally yoked. And in your vineyard you shall not scatter abroad diverse seed. And a garment of two materials being woven commingled you shall not put upon yourself.
LEV 19:20 And if any man should go to bed with a woman in the marriage-bed of semen, and she is a domestic servant being guarded for a man, and to her ransoms have not been ransomed, or freedom was not given to her; an overseeing will be to them; they shall not die, for she was not set free.
LEV 19:21 And he shall bring his trespass offering to the LORD by the door of the tent of the testimony - a ram for a trespass offering.
LEV 19:22 And the priest shall atone for him with the ram of the trespass offering before the LORD for his sin of which he sinned; and the sin shall be forgiven him which he sinned.
LEV 19:23 And whenever you should enter into the land which the LORD your God gives to you, and you should plant any eatable tree, then you shall purge away its uncleanness. Its fruit for three years will be impure to you - it shall not be eaten.
LEV 19:24 And the fourth year all of its fruit will be holy, praiseworthy to the LORD.
LEV 19:25 And in the fifth year you shall eat of its fruit; its produce is an addition to you - I am the LORD your God.
LEV 19:26 Eat not upon the mountains; and you shall not foretell, nor use augury!
LEV 19:27 You shall not make a lock of hair consecrated to an idol from out of the hair of your head, nor shall you corrupt the appearance of your beards.
LEV 19:28 And you shall not make cuts for a dead soul on your body; and letter marks you shall not make upon you - I am the LORD your God.
LEV 19:29 You shall not profane your daughter to fornicate her; and you shall not fornicate the land, and the land be filled of lawlessness.
LEV 19:30 My sabbaths you shall keep, and of my holy things you shall fear - I am the LORD.
LEV 19:31 You shall not follow after ones who deliver oracles, and to the enchanters you shall not cleave to be thoroughly defiled by them - I am the LORD your God.
LEV 19:32 At the face of a gray haired one you shall rise up, and you shall esteem the face of an older one. And you shall fear your God - I am the LORD your God.
LEV 19:33 And if any foreigner in your land should come forward to you, you shall not afflict him.
LEV 19:34 The foreigner approaching to you shall be as the native born among you; and you shall love him as yourself, for you became foreigners in the land of Egypt - I am the LORD your God.
LEV 19:35 You shall not act unjustly in an equity with measures, and with weights, and with yoke balance scales.
LEV 19:36 Just yoke balance scales, and just dry measure weights, and a just coos liquid measure shall be to you - I am the LORD your God, the one leading you from out of the land of Egypt.
LEV 19:37 And you shall keep all my laws, and all my orders, and shall do them - I am the LORD.

LEV 21:21 Every man in which there is on him a blemish from the seed of Aaron the priest shall not approach to offer the sacrifices to the LORD; for a blemish is on him; he shall not come forward to bring the gifts of his God.

LEV 21:23 Except to the veil he shall not come forward, and to the altar he shall not approach, for he has a blemish; and he shall not profane the holy things of his God; for I the LORD am the one sanctifying them.
LEV 21:24 And Moses spoke to Aaron, and his sons, and to all of the sons of Israel.
LEV 22:1 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
LEV 22:2 Speak to Aaron and to his sons! And let them take heed concerning the holy things of the sons of Israel, and they shall not profane my holy name, as much as they sanctify to me - I am the LORD!
LEV 22:3 Say to them! Unto your generations every man who ever should come forward from all your seed to the holy things, as much as indeed the sons of Israel should sanctify to the LORD, and his uncleanness is upon him, they shall utterly destroy that soul from me - I am the LORD.
LEV 22:4 And a man of the seed of Aaron the priest, and this one is leprous or having gonorrhea, shall not eat of the holy things, until whenever he should be cleansed. And the one touching any uncleanness of soul, or a man in whom ever should come forth from out of his marriage-bed of semen,
LEV 22:5 or who ever should touch any unclean reptile, which should defile him, or come upon a man in which he shall defile him according to any of his uncleanness;
LEV 22:6 the soul who ever should touch them will be unclean until evening - he shall not eat from the holy things, if he should not have bathed his body in water.
LEV 22:7 And when the sun should go down, then he will be clean, and then he shall eat from the holy things, for it is his bread.
LEV 22:8 Decaying flesh, and that taken by wild beasts, he shall not eat to be defiled by it - I am the LORD.
LEV 22:9 And they shall guard my injunctions, that they should not take sin on account of them, and should die because of them, if they shall profane them - I am the LORD, the one sanctifying them.
LEV 22:10 And all of another race shall not eat the holy things - a sojourner with a priest, or a hireling, shall not eat the holy things.
LEV 22:11 And if a priest should acquire a soul procured with silver, he shall eat of his bread; and his native-born servants, even these shall eat of his bread.
LEV 22:12 And a daughter of a man a priest, if she should become the wife of a man of another race, she shall not eat of the first-fruits of the holy things.
LEV 22:13 And the daughter of a priest, if she becomes a widow or being cast out, and seed might not be in her, and she shall return unto the house of her father, as in her youth - from the breads of her father she shall eat. And all of another race shall not eat of them.
LEV 22:14 And a man who ever should eat holy things according to ignorance, then he shall add his fifth part unto it, and shall give to the priest the holy thing.
LEV 22:15 And they shall not profane the holy things of the sons of Israel, which they offer to the LORD;
LEV 22:16 that they shall bring upon themselves lawlessness of the trespass in their eating their holy things - for I am the LORD, the one sanctifying them.
LEV 22:17 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
LEV 22:18 Speak to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the congregation of the sons of Israel! And you shall say to them, A man, a man from the sons of Israel, or of the foreigners lying near them among Israel, who ever should offer his gifts according to every acknowledgment offering of theirs, or according to every choice offering of theirs, as much as they should offer to the LORD for a whole burnt offering,
LEV 22:19 what is acceptable unto you is an unblemished male of the herds, and of the sheep, and of the goats.
LEV 22:20 Of all as many as you have with a blemish among them you shall not bring to the LORD; for it shall not be accepted for you.
LEV 22:21 And a man who ever should offer a sacrifice of deliverance offering to the LORD, while setting apart a vow, or according to a choice offering, or in your holiday feasts, out of the herds or of the sheep, it shall be unblemished for acceptance - There shall not be any blemish upon it.
LEV 22:22 Blind, or broken, or with the tongue cut out, or troubled with warts, or chronic mange, or having scabs - they shall not bring these to the LORD; and for a yield offering you shall not give of them upon the altar to the LORD.
LEV 22:23 And a calf or a sheep with mutilated ears, or tailless, you shall make them for slaughter to yourself; but for your vow it shall not be taken.
LEV 22:24 Crushed testicles, or being squeezed out, or emasculated, or drawn away - you shall not bring them to the LORD - even upon your land you shall not offer them.
LEV 22:25 And from out of the hand of a son of another race you shall not offer the gifts of your God of all these things; for there is corruption in them, a blemish in them - these shall not be received to you.
LEV 22:26 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
LEV 22:27 A calf, or a sheep, or a goat, when ever it is born, then it shall be seven days under its mother; but the eighth day and beyond it shall be accepted for gift offerings - a yield offering to the LORD.
LEV 22:28 And a calf and a sheep - it and its offspring you shall not slay in one day.
LEV 22:29 And if you should sacrifice a sacrifice vow of joyfulness to the LORD, you shall sacrifice it acceptable to you.
LEV 22:30 In that day it shall be eaten; you shall not leave of the meats into the morning - I am the LORD.
LEV 22:31 And you shall keep my commandments, and you shall observe them - I am the LORD.
LEV 22:32 And you shall not profane my holy name; and I shall be sanctified in the midst of the sons of Israel - I am the LORD, the one sanctifying you,
LEV 22:33 the one leading you from out of the land of Egypt, so as to be your God - I am the LORD.
LEV 23:1 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
LEV 23:2 Speak to the sons of Israel! And you shall say to them, The holiday feasts of the LORD which you shall call them holy convocations - these are my holiday feasts.
LEV 23:3 Six days you shall do work, but the seventh day is a sabbath rest, a holy convocation to the LORD; all work you shall not do, it is a sabbath to the LORD in all your house.
LEV 23:4 These are the holiday feasts to the LORD, holy convocations, which you shall call them in their seasons.
LEV 23:5 In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, between the evenings is a passover to the LORD.
LEV 23:6 And on the fifteenth day of this month is the holiday feast of the unleavened breads to the LORD. Seven days you shall eat unleavened breads.
LEV 23:7 And the first day will be a holy convocation to you - you shall not do any servile work.
LEV 23:8 And you shall bring a whole burnt offering to the LORD seven days. And the seventh day will be a holy convocation to you - you shall not do any servile work.
LEV 23:9 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
LEV 23:10 Speak to the sons of Israel! And you shall say to them, Whenever you should enter into the land which I give to you, and should harvest its harvest, even you shall bring the sheaf first-fruit of your harvest to the priest.
LEV 23:11 And he shall offer the sheaf before the LORD accepted for you. On the next day of the first of the sabbaths the priest shall offer it.
LEV 23:12 And you shall offer on the day in which ever you should bring the sheaf - a sheep unblemished of a year old for a whole burnt offering to the LORD.
LEV 23:13 And with its sacrifice two tenths of fine flour being prepared in olive oil, a sacrifice to the LORD for a scent of pleasant aroma to the LORD; and its libation - the fourth of the hin of wine.
LEV 23:14 And bread, and new parched green wheat, you shall not eat until this same day, until whenever you should offer the gifts to your God - an eternal law unto your generations in every dwelling of yours.
LEV 23:15 And you shall count to yourselves from the next day of the sabbaths, from the day which ever you should bring the sheaf of the increase offering, seven entire periods of seven.
LEV 23:16 Until the next day of the last period of seven you shall count fifty days; and you shall bring a new sacrifice offering to the LORD.
LEV 23:17 From your houses you shall bring breads - an increase offering. They shall be two breads of two tenths of fine flour, baked being leaven of the first produce to the LORD.
LEV 23:18 And you shall bring with the breads seven unblemished lambs of a year old, and one calf of the herd, and two unblemished rams. And they shall be a whole burnt offering to the LORD, and their sacrifice offerings, and their libations, a sacrifice scent of pleasant aroma to the LORD.
LEV 23:19 And they shall offer a young he-goat from out of the goats - one for a sin offering, and two lambs of a year old for a sacrifice of deliverance offering, with the breads of the first produce.
LEV 23:20 And the priest shall place them with the breads of the first produce increase offering before the LORD, with the two lambs. They shall be holy to the LORD - to the priest bringing them, to him it will be.
LEV 23:21 And you shall call this day a convocation - it shall be holy to you. You shall not do any servile work on it, it is an eternal law unto your generations in all your house.
LEV 23:22 And whenever you shall harvest the harvest of your land, you shall not complete the remainder of the harvest of your field in your harvesting. And the fall away portions of your harvest you shall not collect together; to the poor, and to the foreigner, you shall leave them - I am the LORD your God.
LEV 23:23 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
LEV 23:24 Speak to the sons of Israel, saying! The seventh month, day one of the month, will be to you a rest, a memorial of trumpets, a holy convocation to the LORD.
LEV 23:25 You shall not do any servile work, and you shall bring a whole burnt offering to the LORD.
LEV 23:26 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
LEV 23:27 Also on the tenth of this seventh month is a day of making an atonement - it will be a holy convocation to you; and you shall humble your souls, and shall bring a whole burnt offering to the LORD.
LEV 23:28 All work you shall not do in it, in this day, for this is to you a day of making an atonement, to atone for you before the LORD your God.
LEV 23:29 Every soul who shall not be humbled in it, in this day, shall be utterly destroyed from among its people.
LEV 23:30 And every soul which shall do work in it, in this day, that soul shall be destroyed from among its people.
LEV 23:31 All work you shall not do - it is an eternal law unto your generations in all your houses.
LEV 23:32 A sabbath of sabbaths it will be to you, and you shall humble your souls. From the ninth of the month, from evening to evening, you shall observe the sabbath of your sabbaths.
LEV 23:33 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
LEV 23:34 Speak to the sons of Israel! saying, The fifteenth of the seventh month, this is a holiday of tents for seven days to the LORD.
LEV 23:35 And the first day shall be a holy convocation to you - you shall not do any servile work.
LEV 23:36 Seven days you shall bring the whole burnt offerings to the LORD, and the eighth day will be a holy convocation to you; and you shall bring a whole burnt offering to the LORD - it is a holiday recess, you shall not do any servile work.
LEV 23:37 These are holiday feasts to the LORD, which you shall call them holy convocations, so as to bring a yield offering to the LORD, whole burnt offerings, and their sacrifices, and libations; the thing according to day by day;
LEV 23:38 besides the sabbaths of the LORD, and besides your gifts, and besides all your vows, and besides all your voluntary offerings, which ever you shall give to the LORD.
LEV 23:39 And on the fifteenth day of this seventh month, whenever you should complete gathering the produce of the land, you shall solemnize a holiday to the LORD for seven days - on the first day a rest, and on the eighth day a rest.
LEV 23:40 And you shall take to yourselves on the first day beautiful fruit of the tree, and palm branches of palm trees, and tender branches of a bushy tree, and willows, and tender branches of the chaste tree of a rushing stream; and you shall be glad before the LORD your God seven days.
LEV 23:41 And you shall solemnize it the holiday to the LORD seven days of the year - an eternal law unto your generations. In the seventh month you shall solemnize it a holiday.
LEV 23:42 In tents you shall dwell for seven days; all the native born in Israel shall dwell in tents.
LEV 23:43 That your generations should see that in tents I settled the sons of Israel, in my leading them from our of the land of Egypt - I am the LORD your God.
LEV 23:44 And Moses told the holidays of the LORD to the sons of Israel.
LEV 24:1 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
LEV 24:2 Give charge to the sons of Israel! And let them take to you olive oil, pure, being beaten for light to burn in a lamp continually.
LEV 24:3 From outside the veil, in the tent of the testimony, Aaron and his sons shall burn it from evening until morning before the LORD perpetually - an eternal law unto your generations.
LEV 24:4 Upon the pure lamp-stand you shall burn the lamps before the LORD until into the morning.
LEV 24:5 And you shall take fine flour, and you shall make for it twelve breads; two tenths parts will be for the one bread.
LEV 24:6 And you shall place them two places - six breads to each one place upon the pure table before the LORD.
LEV 24:7 And you shall place upon the place pure frankincense and salt; and they will be the breads for remembrance being situated before the LORD.
LEV 24:8 On the day of the sabbaths you shall put them before the LORD always, before the sons of Israel - an eternal covenant.
LEV 24:9 And it will be for Aaron, and to his sons. And they shall eat them in the holy place; for this is a holy of holies to him from the things being sacrificed to the LORD - an eternal law.
LEV 24:10 And a son of an Israelitish woman went forth, and he was a son of an Egyptian man among the sons of Israel. And they did combat in the camp - the one of the Israelitish woman and the Israelite man.
LEV 24:11 And the son of the Israelitish woman named the name - he cursed. And they led him to Moses. And the name of his mother was Shelomith, daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.
LEV 24:12 And they put him in prison, to litigate over him because of the order of the LORD.
LEV 24:13 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
LEV 24:14 Lead the one cursing outside the camp; and all the ones hearing shall place their hands upon his head, and all the congregation shall stone him.
LEV 24:15 And to the sons of Israel speak! And you shall say to them, A man, a man if he should curse God shall take the sin.
LEV 24:16 And the one naming the name of the LORD, to death let him be put to death! Let all the congregation stone him with stones. Whether a foreigner, or whether native born in his naming the name of the LORD - let him come to an end!
LEV 24:17 And a man who ever should strike the life of a man, and he should die, to death let him be put to death!
LEV 24:18 And who ever should strike cattle, and it should die, let him pay life for life!
LEV 24:19 And if any shall give a blemish to his neighbor; as he did to him, likewise he shall act against him.
LEV 24:20 A break for a break, eye for eye, tooth for tooth. In so far as he should give a blemish to a man, so it shall be given to him.
LEV 24:21 Who ever should strike a man, and he should die, to death let him be put to death!
LEV 24:22 Justice will be one to the foreigner, and the same to the native inhabitant - for I am the LORD your God.
LEV 24:23 And Moses spoke to the sons of Israel, and they led the one cursing outside the camp, and stoned him with stones. And the sons of Israel did just as the LORD gave orders to Moses.
LEV 25:1 And the LORD spoke to Moses on mount Sinai, saying,
LEV 25:2 Speak to the sons of Israel! And you shall say to them, Whenever you should enter into the land which I give to you, then the land shall rest a sabbath to the LORD.
LEV 25:3 Six years you shall sow your field, and six years you shall trim your grapevine, and you shall bring together its fruit.
LEV 25:4 But the seventh year will be a sabbath rest in the land - a sabbath to the LORD. You shall not sow your field, and you shall not trim your grapevine,
LEV 25:5 and the produce ascending by itself in your field you shall not reap up, and the grape of your sanctification you shall not gather in the vintage - a year's rest will be for the land.
LEV 25:6 And the sabbath of the land will be foods to you, and to your children, and to your maidservant, and to your hireling, and to the sojourner lying near to you,
LEV 25:7 and to your cattle, and to the beasts in your land - all of its produce shall be for food.
LEV 25:8 And you shall count out to yourself seven rests of years, seven years seven times. And they will be to you seven periods of seven of years, nine and forty years.
LEV 25:9 And you shall declare by trumpet sound in all your land, in the seventh month, the tenth of the month. In the day of making an atonement you shall declare by trumpet in all your land.
LEV 25:10 And you shall sanctify the year - the fiftieth year. And you shall proclaim forth a release upon the land to all the ones dwelling it. A year of release will be its indication to you. And you shall go forth each to his possession, and you shall go forth each to his family.
LEV 25:11 This indication year of release - it will be to you the fiftieth year. You shall not sow, nor in any way shall you reap the produce ascending of its self; and you shall not gather the vintage - the things having been sanctified of it.
LEV 25:12 For it is an indication of release - it shall be holy to you. From the fields you shall eat its produce.
LEV 25:13 In the year of the release, the indication of it, each shall return back unto his possession.
LEV 25:14 And if you should render a sale property to your neighbor, or if you should acquire by your neighbor, let not a man afflict his neighbor!
LEV 25:15 According to the number of years after the indication shall you acquire land from your neighbor, and according to the number of years left of the produce shall he sell to you.
LEV 25:16 In so far as there might be many of the years, he shall multiply the value of his possession; and in so far as there might be less of the years, he shall lessen the value of his possession; for by number of the produce years left shall he sell to you.
LEV 25:17 Let not a man afflict his neighbor! And you shall fear the LORD your God - I am the LORD your God.
LEV 25:18 And you shall observe all my ordinances, and all my judgments. And you shall keep, and you shall observe them; and you shall dwell upon the land complying.
LEV 25:19 And the land shall give its resources, and you shall eat in fullness, and you shall dwell complying upon it.
LEV 25:20 And if you should say, What shall we eat in this seventh year if we do not sow, and we do not gather in our produce?
LEV 25:21 Then I will send my blessing to you in the sixth year, and the land shall produce its produce for the three years.
LEV 25:22 And you shall sow the eighth year, and you shall eat of the old produce until the ninth year - until whenever its produce should come, you shall eat old produce of the old.
LEV 25:23 And the land shall not be sold for security - for the land is mine; for you are foreigners and sojourners before me.
LEV 25:24 And according to all the land of your possession you shall give ransoms for the land.
LEV 25:25 But if your brother with you should be in need, and should have sold part of his possession, and the one acting as next of kin being near to him should come, then he shall ransom the sale property of his brother.
LEV 25:26 But if there might not be any acting as next of kin, and later he should be well-provided in the hand, and should find himself fit for his ransoms,
LEV 25:27 then he shall reckon the years of his sale property, and shall give back the superior amount to the man to whom he sold it, and he shall return back to his possession.
LEV 25:28 But if his hand should not be well-provided with the thing fit so as to repay him, then his sale property will be to the one acquiring it until the year of the release; and it shall go forth in the release; then he shall go return to his possession.
LEV 25:29 But if any should sell a house inhabited in a city being walled, then there shall be the ransoming of it, until the time should be fulfilled - a year of days will be the time of ransoming of it.
LEV 25:30 But if it should not be ransomed until the entire year should be fulfilled, the house being in the city having a wall shall be validated firmly to the one acquiring it, unto his generations, and it shall not go forth in the release.
LEV 25:31 But the houses in properties, in which there is not among them a wall round about; they shall be considered belonging to the field of the land - ransomable always they shall be. And in the release they shall go forth.
LEV 25:32 And the cities of the Levites, the houses of the cities of their possession, shall be always ransomable to the Levites.
LEV 25:33 And what ever should be ransomed by the Levites, then the sale of houses of the city of their possession shall go forth unto the release - for the houses of the cities of the Levites is their possession in the midst of the sons of Israel.
LEV 25:34 And the fields being separated in their cities shall not be sold - for this is their eternal possession.
LEV 25:35 And if your brother who is with you should be in need, and shall be powerless in the hands with you; then you shall take hold of him - and he shall live with you as a foreigner and a sojourner.
LEV 25:36 You shall not take interest from him, nor for an amount. And you shall fear your God; and your brother shall live with you.
LEV 25:37 You shall not give your money to him with interest due; and with usury you shall not give to him of your foods.
LEV 25:38 I am the LORD your God, the one leading you from out of the land of Egypt, to give to you the land of Canaan, so as to be your God.
LEV 25:39 And if your brother should be humbled by you, and should be sold to you, he shall not serve to you in the slavery of a servant.
LEV 25:40 He shall be as a hireling or a sojourner to you until the year of the release - thus he shall work for you.
LEV 25:41 And then he shall go forth in the release from you himself, and his children with him. And he shall go unto his family; unto the possession of his father he shall run.
LEV 25:42 For these are my servants whom I led out of the land of Egypt. They shall not be sold in a sale of a domestic servant.
LEV 25:43 You shall not violently strain him in his trouble, and you shall fear your God.
LEV 25:44 And a boy, and a girl, as many as should be to you from the nations, as many as there are round about you - from them you shall acquire a manservant and a maidservant.
LEV 25:45 And from the sons of the sojourners being among you - from these you shall acquire, and from their relatives with you. As many as happen to be in your land, let them be to you for a possession!
LEV 25:46 And you shall divide them to your children after you, and they shall be to you possessions unto the eon. But the ones of your brothers of the sons of Israel, each concerning his brother shall not violently strain him in his troubles.
LEV 25:47 And if wealth should find the hand of the foreigner or the sojourner of the one living by you; and your brother being in distress should be sold to the foreigner or to the sojourner living by you, or to a foreigner by birth;
LEV 25:48 after his being sold there shall be a ransoming to him - one of his brothers shall ransom him.
LEV 25:49 A brother of his father, or a son of his father's brother shall ransom him, or one of the members of the family of his flesh of his tribe shall ransom him. And if being well-provided in his hands, then he shall ransom himself.
LEV 25:50 And he shall reckon together with the one acquiring him from the year of which he sold himself to him until the year of the release. And the money of his sale will be as the day of a hireling - year to year he will be with him.
LEV 25:51 And if to any there might be many surplus years, for these he shall render his ransoms of the money of his sale.
LEV 25:52 And if few should be left behind of the years to the year of the release, then he shall reckon to him according to his years, and shall render his ransoms.
LEV 25:53 As a hireling year to year he shall be with him - you shall not violently strain him in his trouble before you.
LEV 25:54 And if he should not pay ransom according to these things, then he shall go forth in the year of the release - he and his children with him.
LEV 25:55 For to me the sons of Israel are servants; these are of my children, whom I led from out of the land of Egypt - I am the LORD your God.
LEV 26:1 You shall not make to yourselves handmade things, nor carvings, nor shall you raise up a monument to yourselves, nor a stone exemplar shall you stand in your land to do obeisance to it - I am the LORD your God.
LEV 26:2 My sabbaths you shall keep, and of my holy things you shall fear - I am the LORD.
LEV 26:3 If in my orders you should go, and my commandments you should keep, and should do them,
LEV 26:4 then I will give the rain to you in its season, and to the land I will give its produce, and the trees of the fields will give back their fruit.
LEV 26:5 And the threshing shall overtake among you the gathering of the crops; and the gathering of the crops shall overtake the sowing; and you shall eat your bread unto fullness. And you shall dwell with safety upon your land.
LEV 26:6 And I will put peace in your land, and you shall go to bed, and there shall not be among you one frightening. And I will destroy the ferocious wild beasts from your land, and war shall not go through your land.
LEV 26:7 And you shall pursue your enemies, and they shall fall before you in carnage.
LEV 26:8 And there shall pursue from out of you five after a hundred, and a hundred of you shall pursue tens of thousands; and your enemies shall fall before you by sword.
LEV 26:9 And I will look upon you, and I will increase you, and I will multiply you, and I will establish my covenant with you.
LEV 26:10 And you shall eat even the old of the old, and you shall bring forth the old in front of the new.
LEV 26:11 And I will put my tent among you, and my soul shall not abhor you.
LEV 26:12 And I will walk about among you, and will be your God, and you shall be to me for a people.
LEV 26:13 I am the LORD your God, the one leading you from out of the land of Egypt, where you were slaves. And I broke the bond of your yoke, and led you out in an open manner.
LEV 26:14 And if you should not obey me, nor should observe these my orders,
LEV 26:15 but should resist them, and should loathe my judgments in your soul, so as for you to not observe all my commandments, so as for you to efface my covenant;
LEV 26:16 then I will do thus to you; and I will set upon you perplexity, and also mange, and jaundice, inflaming of your eyes, and of your life wasting away. And you shall sow ineffectually of your seeds, and your opponents shall eat them.
LEV 26:17 And I will set my face against you, and you shall fall before your enemies; and the ones detesting you shall pursue you, and you shall flee with no one pursuing you.
LEV 26:18 And if in this you should not obey me, then I will add to correct you with strokes seven times for your sins.
LEV 26:19 And I will break the insolence of your pride; and I will establish your heaven as iron, and your land as brass.
LEV 26:20 And your strength shall be in vain. And the earth shall not give of your sowing it, and the tree of the field shall not give its fruit.
LEV 26:21 And if after these things you should go sideways, and should not want to obey me; I will add to you seven calamities according to your sins.
LEV 26:22 And I will send upon you the wild beasts of the land, and they shall eat you, and shall completely consume your cattle, and I will make you very few, and your ways shall be made desolate.
LEV 26:23 And if over these things you should not be corrected, but should go to me sideways,
LEV 26:24 I will go also with you in rage sideways, and will strike you also seven times for your sins.
LEV 26:25 And I will bring upon you a sword, avenging punishment of covenant. And you shall take refuge in your cities, and I will send out plague upon you; and you shall be delivered up into the hands of the enemies.
LEV 26:26 In your being afflicted there will be scarcity of breads. Ten women shall bake your breads in one oven, and they shall render the breads to you by money; and you shall eat, and no way shall you be filled.
LEV 26:27 And if upon this you do not obey me, but should go to me sideways,
LEV 26:28 then I myself shall go with you in rage sideways; and I will correct you, even I, seven times according to your sins.
LEV 26:29 And you shall eat the flesh of your sons; and the flesh of your daughters you shall eat.
LEV 26:30 And I will make desolate your monuments, and will utterly destroy your wooden images made by hands. And I will put your carcasses upon the carcasses of your idols, and my soul will loathe in you.
LEV 26:31 And I will establish your cities as desolate, and will make quite desolate your holy places, and no way shall I smell the scents of your sacrifices.
LEV 26:32 And I will make quite desolate, even I, your land. And your enemies dwelling in it shall wonder over it.
LEV 26:33 And I will disseminate you into the nations, and the sword coming upon you will completely consume you. And your land will be desolate, and your cities will be desolate places.
LEV 26:34 Then the land will favor its sabbaths all the days of its desolation, and you will be in the land of your enemies. Then the land shall observe the sabbath, and will favor its sabbaths.
LEV 26:35 All the days of its desolation it shall observe the sabbath, in which it did not observe the sabbath in your sabbaths, when you dwelt it.
LEV 26:36 And to the ones being left behind of you, I will bring dread into their heart in the land of their enemies. And the sound of a leaf being brought along will pursue them; and they shall flee as fleeing from war, and shall fall with no one pursuing.
LEV 26:37 And the brother will neglect his brother as in war, but with no one running them down. And you will not be able to oppose your enemies.
LEV 26:38 And you shall perish among the nations, and the land of your enemies will devour you.
LEV 26:39 And the ones being left behind from you shall be corrupted on account of their sins, and on account of the sins of their fathers. In the land of their enemies they shall be melted away.
LEV 26:40 And they shall declare openly their sins, and the sins of their fathers; for they violated and overlooked me, and that they went before me sideways.
LEV 26:41 And I went with them in rage sideways, and I will destroy them in the land of their enemies. Then their uncircumcised heart shall have felt shame, and then they shall think well on their sins.
LEV 26:42 And I shall remember the covenant of Jacob, and the covenant of Isaac; and the covenant of Abraham I shall remember; and the land I shall remember.
LEV 26:43 And the land shall be abandoned of them. Then the land shall favorably receive her sabbaths, in her being made desolate because of them. And they shall accept the things of their own lawlessness; because they overlooked my judgments, and they loathed my orders in their soul.
LEV 26:44 And thus, they being in the land of their enemies, I did not overlook them, nor loathed them so as to completely consume them for effacing my covenant with them - for I am the LORD their God.
LEV 26:45 And I will remember their covenant, the former one, when I led them from out of the land of Egypt, from out of the house of slavery before the nations, to be their God - I am the LORD.
LEV 26:46 These are the judgments, and the orders, and the law, which the LORD made between himself and between the sons of Israel on mount Sinai by the hand of Moses.
LEV 27:1 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
LEV 27:2 Speak to the sons of Israel! And you shall say unto them, A man who ever should vow a vow for a value of his life to the LORD,
LEV 27:3 it will be the value of a male from twenty years unto sixty years old - his value will be fifty double-drachmas of silver by the holy weight.
LEV 27:4 And the female will be the price of thirty double-drachmas.
LEV 27:5 And if from five years old unto twenty years old, the value of the male shall be twenty double-drachmas, and the female ten double-drachmas.
LEV 27:6 And from a month unto five years old, the value of the male shall be five double-drachmas of silver, and the female three double-drachmas of silver.
LEV 27:7 And if from sixty years old and up, if indeed it might be a male, his value shall be fifteen double-drachmas of silver; for the female ten double-drachmas.
LEV 27:8 And if he might be of low estate for a value, he shall be stood before the priest, and the priest shall value him, just as the hand of the one making a vow is able to afford - thus the priest shall value him.
LEV 27:9 And if it be from the cattle being offered of them as a gift to the LORD, who ever should give of these to the LORD shall be holy.
LEV 27:10 He shall not change it good for bad, nor bad for good. And if by bartering he should barter it cattle for cattle, it and the thing bartered shall be holy.
LEV 27:11 And if be any unclean beast, of which is not offered of them as a gift to the LORD, he shall set the beast before the priest.
LEV 27:12 And the priest shall value it, between good and between bad. And as far as the priest valuing it, so it will stand.
LEV 27:13 And if the one ransoming should ransom it, he shall add the fifth part to the value of it.
LEV 27:14 And a man who ever should sanctify his house holy to the LORD, then the priest shall value it between good and between bad - what ever the priest shall value it, so it shall stand.
LEV 27:15 And if the one sanctifying it should redeem his house, he shall add unto it the fifth part of the money for the value, and it shall be his.
LEV 27:16 And if a man should sanctify from the field of his possession to the LORD, then the value shall be according to its sowing - a cor of barley equals fifty double-drachmas of silver.
LEV 27:17 And if from the year of the release he should sanctify his field, according to his value it shall stand.
LEV 27:18 But if he should sanctify his field last after the release, the priest shall count in addition to it the money for the years remaining, until unto the next year of the release, and it shall be deducted from his valuation.
LEV 27:19 And if the one sanctifying the field should ransom it, he shall add the fifth part of the money to the value of it, and it will be his.
LEV 27:20 And if he should not ransom the field, and should give back the field to another man, no longer shall he ransom it.
LEV 27:21 But the field coming forth from the release will be holy to the LORD, as the land being separated - to the priest it will be his possession.
LEV 27:22 And if from the field of which he acquired, which is not from the field of his possession, that he should sanctify to the LORD,
LEV 27:23 the priest shall impute to him the full value from the year of the release; and he shall render the value in that day as holy to the LORD.
LEV 27:24 And in the year of the release he shall give back the field to the man from whom he acquired it, of whom was in possession of the land.
LEV 27:25 And all value will be by holy weights - twenty oboli will be the double-drachma.
LEV 27:26 And every first-born, which ever should be born among your cattle, will be to the LORD, and not anyone shall consecrate it; if also a calf, if also a sheep - it is to the LORD.
LEV 27:27 And if of the four-footed creatures of the unclean he should barter for the value of it, then he shall add his fifth part to it, and it will be his. But if he should not ransom it, it shall be sold according to its valuation.
LEV 27:28 And every offering for consumption, which ever a man should present to the LORD of all as much as is to him, from man unto beast, and from a field of his possession, he shall not sell it, nor ransom it; every offering for consumption will be a holy of holies to the LORD.
LEV 27:29 And all, what ever should be presented from men, it shall not be ransomed, but to death it shall be put to death.
LEV 27:30 Every tenth of the land, from the seed of the land, and from the fruit of the wood to the LORD, is holy to the LORD.
LEV 27:31 And if by ransoming a man should ransom his tenth, then his fifth part he shall add to it, and it will be his.
LEV 27:32 And every tenth of oxen, and sheep, and all which should go through in the number by the rod measure, the tenth will be holy to the LORD.
LEV 27:33 You shall not barter it good for bad, nor bad for good. And if in bartering you should barter it, it shall be and its barter holy; it shall not be ransomed.
LEV 27:34 These are the commandments which the LORD gave charge to Moses for the sons of Israel on mount Sinai.
NUM 1:1 And the LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tent of the testimony, on day one of the second month of the second year of their coming forth from out of the land of Egypt, saying,
NUM 1:2 Take the sum of all the congregation of the sons of Israel according to their kin, and houses of their patrimony, according to the number of their names, every male according to their head count;
NUM 1:3 from twenty years and up, all going forth in the force of Israel; you number them with their force - you and Aaron!
NUM 1:4 And with you shall be each of the rulers according to each tribe; they shall be according to the houses of their patrimony.
NUM 1:5 And these are the names of the men who shall stand with you of the ones of Reuben - Elizur son of Shedeur.
NUM 1:6 Of the ones of Simeon - Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai.
NUM 1:7 Of the ones of Judah - Nashon son of Amminadab.
NUM 1:8 Of the ones of Issachar - Nethaneel son of Zuar.
NUM 1:9 Of the ones of Zebulun - Eliab son of Helon.
NUM 1:10 Of the sons of Joseph, of the ones of Ephraim - Elishama son of Ammihud. Of the ones of Manasseh - Gamaliel son of Pedahzur.
NUM 1:11 Of the ones of Benjamin - Abidan son of Gideoni.
NUM 1:12 Of the ones of Dan - Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai.
NUM 1:13 Of the ones of Asher - Pagiel son of Ocran.
NUM 1:14 Of the ones of Gad - Eliasaph son of Reuel.
NUM 1:15 Of the ones of Naphtali - Ahira son of Enan.
NUM 1:16 These are the selected ones of the congregation, rulers of the tribes according to their patrimony; they are commanders of thousands in Israel.
NUM 1:17 And Moses and Aaron took these men, of the ones being called by name.
NUM 1:18 And all the congregation gathered on day one of the month, of the second year, and were numbered according to their origins, according to their patrimony, according to the number of their names, from twenty years old and up, every male according to their head count,
NUM 1:19 in which manner the LORD gave orders to Moses. And they were numbered in the wilderness of Sinai.
NUM 1:20 And there were to the sons of Reuben, first-born of Israel, according to their kin, according to their peoples, according to the houses of their patrimony, according to the number of their names, according to their head count, every male from twenty years and up, every one going forth in the force,
NUM 1:21 the numbering of them from out of the tribe of Reuben - six and forty thousand and five hundred.
NUM 1:22 To the sons of Simeon, according to their kin, according to their peoples, according to the houses of their patrimony, according to the number of their names, according to their head count, all males from twenty years and up, every one going forth in the force,
NUM 1:23 their numbering from out of the tribe of Simeon - nine and fifty thousand and three hundred.
NUM 1:24 To the sons of Gad, according to their kin, according to their peoples, according to the houses of their patrimony, according to the number of their names, all males from twenty years and up, every one going forth in the force,
NUM 1:25 their numbering from out of the tribe of Gad - five and forty thousand and six hundred and fifty.
NUM 1:26 To the sons of Judah, according to their kin, according to their peoples, according to the houses of their patrimony, according to the number of their names, all males from twenty years and up, every one going forth in the force,
NUM 1:27 their numbering from out of the tribe of Judah - four and seventy thousand and six hundred.
NUM 1:28 To the sons of Issachar, according to their kin, according to their peoples, according to the houses of their patrimony, according to the number of their names, all males from twenty years and up, every one going forth in the force,
NUM 1:29 their numbering from out of the tribe of Issachar - four and fifty thousand and four hundred.
NUM 1:30 To the sons of Zebulun, according to their kin, according to their peoples, according to the houses of their patrimony, according to the number of their names, all males from twenty years and up, every one going forth in the force,
NUM 1:31 their numbering from out of the tribe of Zebulun - seven and fifty thousand and four hundred.
NUM 1:32 To the sons of Joseph, the sons of Ephraim, according to their kin, according to their peoples, according to the houses of their patrimony, according to the number of their names, all males from twenty years and up, every one going forth in the force,
NUM 1:33 their numbering from out of the tribe of Ephraim - forty thousand and five hundred.

NUM 1:35 their numbering from out of the tribe of Manasseh - two and thirty thousand and two hundred.
NUM 1:36 To the sons of Benjamin, according to their kin, according to their peoples, according to the houses of their patrimony, according to the number of their names, all males from twenty years and up, every one going forth in the force,
NUM 1:37 their numbering from out of the tribe of Benjamin - five and thirty thousand and four hundred.
NUM 1:38 To the sons of Dan, according to their kin, according to their peoples, according to the houses of their patrimony, according to the number of their names, all males from twenty years and up, every one going forth in the force,
NUM 1:39 their numbering from out of the tribe of Dan - two and sixty thousand and seven hundred.
NUM 1:40 To the sons of Asher, according to their kin, according to their peoples, according to the houses of their patrimony, according to the number of their names, all males from twenty years and up, every one going forth in the force,
NUM 1:41 their numbering from out of the tribe of Asher - one and forty thousand and five hundred.
NUM 1:42 To the sons of Naphtali, according to their kin, according to their peoples, according to the houses of their patrimony, according to the number of their names, all males from twenty years and up, every one going forth in the force,
NUM 1:43 their numbering from out of the tribe of Naphtali - three and fifty thousand and four hundred.
NUM 1:44 This is the numbering which Moses numbered, and Aaron, and the rulers of Israel - twelve men, one man according to tribe - there was one according to the tribe of the houses of their patrimony.
NUM 1:45 And came to pass all the numbering of the sons of Israel with their force, from twenty years and up, all the ones going forth to deploy in Israel -
NUM 1:46 six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
NUM 1:47 But the Levites from out of the tribes of their patrimony were not considered together among the sons of Israel.
NUM 1:48 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
NUM 1:49 Know that you shall not consider the tribe of Levi, and their number you shall not take in the midst of the sons of Israel!
NUM 1:50 And you set the Levites over the tent of the testimony, and over all the items of it, and over all as much as is in it! They shall lift the tent and all the items for it. And they shall officiate in it, and shall camp round about the tent.
NUM 1:51 And in the lifting away the tent, the Levites shall lower it. And in the pitching the tent, they shall raise it up. And the foreigner going in it - let him die!
NUM 1:52 And the sons of Israel shall camp, every man in his own order, and every man according to his own governing authority, with their force.
NUM 1:53 But the Levites - let them camp opposite round about the tent of the testimony, and there shall not be sin among the sons of Israel. And the Levites themselves shall guard the watch of the tent of the testimony.
NUM 1:54 And the sons of Israel did according to all as much as the LORD gave charge to Moses and Aaron - thus they did.

NUM 3:1 And these are the origins of Aaron and Moses in which day the LORD spoke to Moses on mount Sinai.
NUM 3:2 And these are the names of the sons of Aaron - first-born Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
NUM 3:3 These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests, the ones being anointed whom were perfected of their hands to officiate as priest.
NUM 3:4 And Nadab and Abihu came to an end before the LORD, of their offering alien fire before the LORD, in the wilderness of Sinai. And there was not children to them. And Eleazar and Ithamar officiated as priest with Aaron their father.
NUM 3:5 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
NUM 3:6 Take the tribe of Levi! And you shall set them before Aaron the priest, and they shall officiate to him.
NUM 3:7 And they shall guard his watches, and the watches of the sons of Israel before the tent of the testimony, to work the works of the tent.
NUM 3:8 And they shall guard all the items of the tent of the testimony, and the watches of the sons of Israel, according to all the works of the tent.
NUM 3:9 And you shall give the Levites to Aaron your brother, and to his sons - to the priests for a gift being given; these to me are from the sons of Israel.
NUM 3:10 And Aaron and his sons you shall place over the tent of the testimony, and they shall guard their priesthood. And the foreigner touching shall die.
NUM 3:11 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
NUM 3:12 And behold, I have taken the Levites from out of the midst of the sons of Israel, in place of every first-born male opening wide the womb of the sons of Israel - they shall be their ransoms, and the Levites will be mine.
NUM 3:13 For every first-born is mine. In which day I struck all the first-born in the land of Egypt I sanctified to myself every first-born in Israel - from man unto beast; they shall be mine. I am the LORD.
NUM 3:14 And the LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,
NUM 3:15 Number the sons of Levi according to the houses of their patrimony, according to their kin! Every male from a month and up you number them!
NUM 3:16 And Moses and Aaron numbered them because of the voice of the LORD, in which manner the LORD gave orders to them.
NUM 3:17 And these were the sons of Levi by their names - Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
NUM 3:18 And these are the names of the sons of Gershon according to their peoples - Libni and Shimei.
NUM 3:19 And the sons of Kohath according to their peoples - Amram, and Izehar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
NUM 3:20 And the sons of Merari according to their peoples - Mahli, and Mushi. These are the peoples of the Levites according to the houses of their patrimony.
NUM 3:21 To Gershon was the people of Libni, and the people of Shemei. These are the peoples of Gershon -
NUM 3:22 their numbering according to the number of every male from a month and up in their numbering - seven thousand and five hundred.
NUM 3:23 And the sons of Gershon shall camp behind the tent towards the west.
NUM 3:24 And the ruler of the household of the family of the people of Gershon was Elisaph son of Lael.
NUM 3:25 And the watch of the sons of Gershon was in the tent of the testimony - the tent, and the covering, and the overcovering of the door of the tent of the testimony,
NUM 3:26 and the shrouds of the courtyard, and the veil of the gate of the courtyard being at the tent, and the remainder of all its works.
NUM 3:27 To Kohath was one division of people for Amram, and one division of people for Izehar, and one division of people for Hebron, and one division of people for Uzziel. These are the peoples of Kohath according to number.
NUM 3:28 Every male from a month and up - eight thousand and six hundred, guarding the watches of the holy place.
NUM 3:29 The peoples of the sons of Kohath shall camp by the side of the tent towards the south.
NUM 3:30 And the ruler of the house of the patrimony of the peoples of Kohath was Elizaphan son of Uzziel.
NUM 3:31 And their watch is the ark, and the table, and the lamp-stand, and the altars, and the items of the holy as they officiate with them, and the overcovering, and all their works.
NUM 3:32 And the ruler over the rulers of the Levites was Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, being placed to guard the watches of the holy places.
NUM 3:33 To Merari was the people Mahli, and the people Mushi. These are the peoples of Merari.
NUM 3:34 Their numbering according to the number of every male, from a month and up - six thousand and two hundred.
NUM 3:35 And the ruler of the house of the patrimony of the people of Merari was Zuriel son of Abihail. By the side of the tent they shall camp towards the north.
NUM 3:36 The numbering of the watch of the sons of Merari is the tips of the tent, and their bars, and their posts, and their bases, and all their items, and their works,
NUM 3:37 and the posts of the courtyard round about, and their bases, and their stanchions, and their ropes.
NUM 3:38 The ones camping according to the front of the tent of the testimony, from the east was Moses and Aaron and his sons, guarding the watches of the holy place, for the watches of the sons of Israel - and the foreigner approaching shall die.
NUM 3:39 All the numbering of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron numbered through the voice of the LORD, according to their peoples, every male from a month and up - two and twenty thousand.
NUM 3:40 And the LORD said to Moses, saying, Number every first-born male of the sons of Israel, from a month and up, and take their number by name!
NUM 3:41 And you shall take the Levites for me, I am the LORD, in place of all the first-born of the sons of Israel; and the cattle of the Levites in place of all the first-born among the cattle of the sons of Israel.
NUM 3:42 And Moses numbered in which manner the LORD gave charge to him - every first-born among the sons of Israel.
NUM 3:43 And were all the first-born males, by number, and by name, from a month and up, from out of their numbering - two and twenty thousand and three and seventy and two hundred.
NUM 3:44 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
NUM 3:45 Take the Levites in place of all the first-born sons of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites in place of their cattle! And the Levites will be mine - I am the LORD.
NUM 3:46 And for the ransoms of three and seventy and two hundred - the ones abounding over the Levites, from the first-born of the sons of Israel,
NUM 3:47 you shall take five shekels per head; according to the double-drachma of the holy place you shall take them; twenty oboli was the shekel.
NUM 3:48 And you shall give the money to Aaron and to his sons - the ransoms of the ones abounding to them.
NUM 3:49 And Moses took the money, the ransoms for the ones abounding for the ransoming of the Levites.
NUM 3:50 From the first-born of the sons of Israel he took the money - a thousand three hundred sixty-five shekels, according to the shekel of the holy place.
NUM 3:51 And Moses gave the money, the ransoms of the ones abounding, to Aaron and to his sons, by the voice of the LORD, in which manner the LORD gave charge to Moses.
NUM 4:1 And the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
NUM 4:2 Take the total sum of the sons of Kohath from out of the midst of the sons of Levi, according to their peoples, according to the houses of their patrimony -
NUM 4:3 from twenty and five years and up unto fifty years, every one entering to officiate to do all the works in the tent of the testimony!
NUM 4:4 And these are the works of the sons of Kohath in the tent of the testimony, a holy of the holies.
NUM 4:5 And Aaron shall enter, and his sons, whenever the camp should lift away. And they shall lower the veil overshadowing, and shall cover with it the ark of the testimony.
NUM 4:6 And they shall place upon it a skin overcovering of blue. And they shall put upon it a garment entirely of blue from above. And they shall insert the bearing poles.
NUM 4:7 And upon the table being situated for the breads, they shall put upon it a garment entirely of purple, and the saucers, and the incense pans, and the cups, and the libation bowls in which you offer a libation; and the continual breads shall be upon it.
NUM 4:8 And they shall put upon it a scarlet garment, and shall cover it with a covering made of a skin of blue, and shall insert the bearing poles in it.
NUM 4:9 And they shall take the cloak of blue, and shall cover the lamp-stand giving light, and its lamps, and its tongs, and its oil funnels, and all the receptacles for its oil, as many things as they officiate with them.
NUM 4:10 And they shall put it, and all the items for it, into a covering made of skin of blue, and shall place it upon bearing poles.
NUM 4:11 And upon the golden altar they shall place a garment of blue, and shall cover it with a covering made of a skin of blue, and shall insert the bearing poles of it.
NUM 4:12 And they shall take all the items of the ministry, as many as they officiate with them in the holy places, and shall put them into a garment of blue, and shall cover them with a covering made of a skin of blue, and shall place them upon bearing poles.
NUM 4:13 And they shall place the lid upon the altar, and shall cover over it with a garment entirely of purple.
NUM 4:14 And they shall place upon it all its items, as many as to officiate with them, and the censers, and the meat hooks, and the bowls, and the lid, and all the items of the altar. And they shall put upon it a covering made of skin of blue, and shall insert the bearing poles of it.
NUM 4:15 And Aaron and his sons shall complete covering the holy things, and all the holy items in the lifting away the camp. And after these things the sons of Kohath shall enter to lift. And they shall not touch of the holy things, that they should not die. These things the sons of Kohath shall lift in the tent of the testimony,
NUM 4:16 Eleazar son of Aaron the priest is overseer of the oil for the light, and the incense of the composition, and the sacrifice by day, and the oil for the anointing - the overseeing entirely of the tent and as much as is in it in the holy place, and in all the works.
NUM 4:17 And the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
NUM 4:18 Do not annihilate the tribe of the people of Kohath from out of the midst of the Levites.
NUM 4:19 But do this to them, and they shall live, and in no way shall they die in their approaching to the holy of the holies. Let Aaron and his sons enter! And they shall place themselves each in his office.
NUM 4:20 And in no way shall they enter to see suddenly the holy place - for they shall die.
NUM 4:21 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
NUM 4:22 Take the sum of the sons of Gershon, and these according to the houses of their patrimony, according to their peoples!
NUM 4:23 From five and twenty years and up unto fifty years you number them - every one entering to officiate, and to do his work in the tent of the testimony!
NUM 4:24 This is the ministration of the people of Gershon, to officiate and to lift.
NUM 4:25 And they shall lift the hide coverings of the tent, and the tent of the testimony, and its covering, and the overcovering of blue being upon it from above, and the overcovering of the door of the tent of the testimony.
NUM 4:26 And the shrouds of the courtyard, and the overcovering of the door of the courtyard, as many as are upon the tent, and upon the altar, and their extras, and all the items of their ministries. And as many as they officiate with them they shall prepare.
NUM 4:27 By the mouth of Aaron and his sons shall be the ministration of the sons of Gershon, according to all their ministrations, and according to all their works. And you shall number them by names, and all the works by them.
NUM 4:28 This is the ministration of the sons of Gershon in the tent of the testimony, and their watch by the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
NUM 4:29 The sons of Merari according to their peoples, according to the houses of their patrimony, you number them!
NUM 4:30 From five and twenty years and up unto fifty years number them - every one entering to officiate the works of the tent of the testimony!
NUM 4:31 And these are the injunctions of the things lifted by them, according to all their works in the tent of the testimony - the tips of the tent, and its bars, and its posts, and its bases,
NUM 4:32 and the posts of the courtyard round about, and their bases, and the posts for the veil of the gate of the courtyard, and their bases, and their stanchions, and their ropes, and all their items, and all the things of their ministrations. You shall number them by names, and all the items of the watch of the things being lifted by them.
NUM 4:33 This is the ministration of the people of the sons of Merari, in all their works, in the tent of the testimony, by the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
