NUM 5:1 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
NUM 5:2 Assign to the sons of Israel, and let them send out from out of the camp every leper, and every one having gonorrhea, and every one unclean from a dead soul!
NUM 5:3 From male unto female you send them outside the camp, for in no way shall they defile their camp in which I occupy among them!
NUM 5:4 And the sons of Israel did thus, and sent them outside the camp; as the LORD said to Moses, thus the sons of Israel did.
NUM 5:5 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
NUM 5:6 Speak to the sons of Israel! saying, A man or woman, who ever should commit of all the sins of mankind, and ignoring should ignore, and that soul should trespass,
NUM 5:7 he should declare openly the sin which he did, and shall give for the trespass offering the total sum, and the fifth part of it he shall add unto it, and shall give back to whomever he trespassed against him.
NUM 5:8 But if there might not be to the man acting as next of kin, so as to give to him satisfaction for the trespass offering, let the trespass offering being given to the LORD be for the priest, besides the ram of the atonement, by which he shall atone with it for him.
NUM 5:9 And every first-fruit of all the things having been sanctified among the sons of Israel, as many as they should offer to the LORD, will be for the priest himself.
NUM 5:10 And the things of each man having been sanctified it will be his; and a man, who ever should give anything to the priest, to him it will be.
NUM 5:11 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
NUM 5:12 Speak to the sons of Israel! And you shall say to them, A man - a man if his wife should violate, and in overlooking should ignore him,
NUM 5:13 and anyone should go to bed with her in the marriage-bed of semen, and it should be unaware from the eyes of her husband, and she should hide it, and she should be defiled, and there should be no witness against her, and she should not be conceived;
NUM 5:14 and there should come upon him a spirit of jealousy, and he should be jealous of his wife, and she be defiled; or there should come upon him a spirit of jealousy and he should be jealous of his wife, and she should not be defiled;
NUM 5:15 then the man shall lead his wife to the priest, and he shall bring the gift for her, the tenth of the ephah of flour of barley - he shall not pour upon it olive oil, nor shall he place upon it frankincense; for it is a sacrifice for jealousy, a sacrifice of memorial, calling to mind sin.
NUM 5:16 And the priest shall bring her, and stand her before the LORD.
NUM 5:17 And the priest shall take clean living water in an earthenware receptacle, and some of the earth being upon the floor of the tent of the testimony; and taking it, the priest shall put it into the water.
NUM 5:18 And the priest shall stand the woman before the LORD, and he shall uncover the head of the woman, and shall give unto her hands the sacrifice of memorial, the sacrifice of jealousy; but in the hand of the priest will be the water of rebuke accursing this.
NUM 5:19 And the priest shall adjure her, and shall say to the woman, If no one has gone to bed with you, if you have not violated to be defiled being under your own husband, be innocent from this accursing by the water of rebuke!
NUM 5:20 But if being married you violated, or were defiled, and any gave of his marriage-bed with you, besides your husband;
NUM 5:21 then the priest shall bind the woman by the oaths of this imprecation. And the priest shall say to the woman, May the LORD appoint you to a curse and solemn affirmation in the midst of your people, in the LORD giving of your thigh to miscarry, and your belly to bloat;
NUM 5:22 and this accursing water shall enter into your belly to bloat pregnant, and to miscarry by your thigh. And the woman shall say, May it be. May it be.
NUM 5:23 And the priest shall write these imprecations on a scroll, and shall wipe them away in the water of the rebuke of the accursing.
NUM 5:24 And he shall give to drink to the woman the water of the rebuke of the accursing - and shall enter into her the water of the rebuke of the accursing.
NUM 5:25 And the priest shall take from out of the hand of the woman the sacrifice of jealousy, and shall place the sacrifice before the LORD, and shall bring it unto the altar.
NUM 5:26 And the priest shall grab from the sacrifice, its memorial, and shall offer it upon the altar; and after these things he will cause the woman to drink the water.
NUM 5:27 And it shall be if she should be defiled, and in forgetfulness her husband should be unaware, then shall enter into her the water of rebuke of accursing, and the belly shall bloat, and her thigh shall miscarry, and the woman will be for a curse to her people.
NUM 5:28 But if the woman should not be defiled, and should be clean, then she will be innocent, and shall produce offspring of semen.
NUM 5:29 This is the law of the jealousy in which ever a woman being married should violate and should be defiled;
NUM 5:30 or a man who ever should have a spirit of jealousy come upon him, and should be jealous of his wife; then he should stand his wife before the LORD, and the priest shall do to her all this law.
NUM 5:31 Then the man will be innocent from sin, and that woman shall take the sin on herself.
NUM 6:1 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
NUM 6:2 Speak to the sons of Israel! And you shall say to them, A man or woman, who ever should greatly vow a vow to purify oneself in purity to the LORD.
NUM 6:3 From wine and liquor he shall be pure; and strong drink from out of wine, and strong drink from out of liquor he shall not drink; and as many things as are manufactured from out of the grape he shall not drink; and fresh grape and dried grape he shall not eat.
NUM 6:4 All the days of his vow, from all as many things as come from the grapevine, wine, from dregs unto grape-stone, he shall not eat.
NUM 6:5 All the days of the vow of his purification a razor shall not come upon his head, until whenever the days should be fulfilled, as many as he made a vow to the LORD. He shall be holy, maintaining the lock of hair on his head.
NUM 6:6 All the days of the vow to the LORD he shall not enter unto any soul coming to an end.
NUM 6:7 Unto father and unto mother, and to brother, and to sister, he shall not be defiled by them in their dying - for his vow of God is upon him, upon his head.
NUM 6:8 All the days of his vow will be holy to the LORD.
NUM 6:9 And if anyone should die to death near him suddenly, immediately the head of his vow shall be defiled; and he shall shave his head in which day he should be cleansed - the seventh day he shall be shaved.
NUM 6:10 And the eighth day he shall bring two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons, to the priest, at the doors of the tent of the testimony.
NUM 6:11 And the priest shall offer one for a sin offering, and one for a whole burnt offering; and the priest shall atone for him, for of which he sinned concerning touching the dead soul. And he shall sanctify his head in that day,
NUM 6:12 in which he was sanctified to the LORD, all the days of the vow. And he shall lead forward a lamb of a year old for a trespass offering. And the former days shall not be reckoned, for the head of his vow was defiled.
NUM 6:13 And this is the law of the making a vow. In which ever day he shall have fulfilled the days of his vow, he shall bring himself by the doors of the tent of the testimony.
NUM 6:14 And he shall lead his gift to the LORD - one unblemished he-lamb of a year old for a whole burnt offering, and one unblemished ewe-lamb of a year old for a sin offering, and one unblemished ram for a deliverance offering;
NUM 6:15 and a bin of unleavened fine flour breads being prepared in olive oil, and unleavened pancakes being anointed in olive oil, and their sacrifice, and their libation.
NUM 6:16 And the priest shall bring them before the LORD, and shall offer the sacrifice for his sin offering, and his whole burnt offering.
NUM 6:17 And with the ram he shall make a sacrifice of deliverance offering to the LORD, with the bin of the unleavened breads. And the priest shall offer his sacrifice offering, and his libation.
NUM 6:18 And the one making a vow shall shave (by the doors of the tent of the testimony) the head of his vow, and shall place the hair upon the fire which is upon the sacrifice of the deliverance offering.
NUM 6:19 And the priest shall take the shoulder cooked from the ram, and one unleavened bread from the bin, and one unleavened pancake, and shall place them upon the hands of the one making a vow, after his shaving his head.
NUM 6:20 And the priest shall offer them as an increase offering before the LORD - it shall be a holy portion to the priest, beside the breast of the increase offering, and beside the shoulder of the separation portion offering. And after this the one making a vow shall drink wine.
NUM 6:21 This is the law of the one making a vow - who ever should make a vow to the LORD of his gift to the LORD, concerning the vow, separate from what ever his hand should find according to ability of his vow, of what ever he should have vowed according to the law of his purity.
NUM 6:22 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
NUM 6:23 Speak to Aaron and to his sons! saying, Thus you shall bless the sons of Israel, saying to them,
NUM 6:24 May The LORD bless you, and keep you.
NUM 6:25 May the LORD shine his face upon you, and show mercy on you.
NUM 6:26 May the LORD lift up his face upon you, and give you peace.
NUM 6:27 And they shall place my name upon the sons of Israel; and I will bless them.

NUM 8:1 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
NUM 8:2 Speak to Aaron! And you shall say to him, Whenever you should place the lamps by rank, the seven lamps shall give light in front of the lamp-stand.
NUM 8:3 And Aaron did so - in front of the lamp-stand he lit up its lamps as the LORD gave orders to Moses.
NUM 8:4 And this is the apparatus of the lamp-stand - its stem is solid gold, and its lilies are solid entirely, according to the form which the LORD showed Moses - thus he made the lamp-stand.
NUM 8:5 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
NUM 8:6 Take the Levites from out of the midst of the sons of Israel, and you shall purify them.
NUM 8:7 And thus you shall do to them for their purification - you shall sprinkle about them water of purification, and a razor shall come upon the whole of their body, and you shall wash their garments, and they shall be clean.
NUM 8:8 And they shall take one calf from out of the oxen, and of this a sacrifice offering of fine flour being prepared in olive oil. And a calf of a year old from out of the oxen you shall take for a sin offering.
NUM 8:9 And you shall lead forward the Levites before the tent of the testimony. And you shall bring together all the congregation of the sons of Israel.
NUM 8:10 And you shall lead forward the Levites before the LORD; and the sons of Israel shall place their hands upon the Levites.
NUM 8:11 And Aaron shall separate the Levites for a render before the LORD from the sons of Israel. And they shall be so as to work the works of the LORD.
NUM 8:12 And the Levites shall place the hands upon the heads of the calves. And you shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the one for a whole burnt offering to the LORD to atone for them.
NUM 8:13 And you shall stand the Levites before Aaron, and before his sons, and shall render them as a render to the LORD.
NUM 8:14 And you shall draw apart the Levites from out of the midst of the sons of Israel, and they shall be mine.
NUM 8:15 And after these things the Levites shall enter to work the works of the tent of the testimony. And you shall cleanse them, and render them before the LORD.
NUM 8:16 For as a render these are being rendered to me. They are from out of the midst of the sons of Israel, in place of the ones opening wide every womb of all first-born of the sons of Israel - I have taken them to myself.
NUM 8:17 For every first-born among the sons of Israel is mine, from man unto beast; in which day I struck every first-born in the land of Egypt, I sanctified them to myself.
NUM 8:18 And I took the Levites instead of every first-born among the sons of Israel.
NUM 8:19 And I gave back the Levites as a render, rendering Aaron and to his sons from out of the midst of the sons of Israel, to work the works of the sons of Israel in the tent of the testimony, and to atone for the sons of Israel, that a calamity shall not be among the sons of Israel whenever drawing near to the holy things.
NUM 8:20 And Moses and Aaron did, and all the congregation of the sons of Israel, to the Levites as the LORD gave charge to Moses concerning the Levites - thus the sons of Israel did to them.
NUM 8:21 And the Levites purified themselves, and washed their garments; and Aaron rendered them as a render before the LORD; and Aaron made atonement for them to purify them.
NUM 8:22 And after these things the Levites entered to officiate their ministration in the tent of the testimony before Aaron, and before his sons - as the LORD gave orders to Moses for the Levite, so they did to them.
NUM 8:23 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
NUM 8:24 This is the thing for the Levites from five and twenty years and up - they shall enter to minister a ministration in works in the tent of the testimony.
NUM 8:25 And from fifty years old he shall leave from the ministration, and shall not work any longer.
NUM 8:26 And he shall officiate with his brethren in the tent of the testimony, to guard the watches; but he shall not work the works - so shall you do to the Levites in their watches.
NUM 9:1 And the LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the second year of their coming forth from out of the land of Egypt, in the first month, saying,
NUM 9:2 Speak! saying, And let the sons of Israel prepare the passover according to its season!
NUM 9:3 On the fourteenth day of the first month towards evening you shall observe it - according to its time, according to its law. And according to the interpretation given for it you shall observe it.
NUM 9:4 And Moses spoke to the sons of Israel to observe the passover,
NUM 9:5 commencing on the fourteenth day of the month in the wilderness of Sinai. As the LORD gave orders to Moses, thus the sons of Israel did.
NUM 9:6 And men came who were unclean by reason of touching a dead soul of a man, and they were not able to observe the passover in that day. And they came forward before Moses and Aaron on that day.
NUM 9:7 And those men said to them, We are unclean by reason of the dead soul of a man - are we then lacking so as to bring the gift to the LORD according to its time in the midst of the sons of Israel?
NUM 9:8 And Moses said to them, Stand yourself, and I will hear what the LORD gives charge concerning you.
NUM 9:9 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
NUM 9:10 Speak to the sons of Israel! saying, A man - a man who ever becomes unclean by reason of a dead soul of a man, or on a journey far from you, even among your generations, shall observe the passover to the LORD.
NUM 9:11 In the second month on the fourteenth day towards evening they shall prepare it; upon unleavened breads and bitter herbs they shall eat it.
NUM 9:12 They shall not leave behind any of him into the morning, and they shall not break a bone of his. According to the law of the passover they shall observe it.
NUM 9:13 And a man who ever might be clean, and is not on a journey far away, and should lack to observe the passovers, that soul shall be utterly destroyed from out of its people, because the gift to the LORD he offered not according to its time; that man shall take his sin.
NUM 9:14 But if a foreigner should come forward to you in your land, and would observe the passover to the LORD, then according to the law of the passover, and according to its arrangement, thus he shall observe it - there will be one law to you, both to the foreigner, and to the native born of the land.
NUM 9:15 And in the day which the tent was set up the cloud covered the tent - the house of the testimony. And in the evening there was upon the tent as a form of fire until morning.
NUM 9:16 So it was always - the cloud covered it by day, and the form of fire by the night.
NUM 9:17 And when the cloud ascended from the tent, then after this the sons of Israel departed. And in the place where ever the cloud stopped, there the sons of Israel camped.
NUM 9:18 By order of the LORD the sons of Israel shall camp, and by order of the LORD they shall depart. All the days in which the cloud shadows over the tent, the sons of Israel shall camp.
NUM 9:19 And whenever the cloud should be dragged upon the tent for many days, that the sons of Israel shall guard the watch of the LORD, and in no way shall they lift away.
NUM 9:20 And it shall be whenever the cloud should become a number of days upon the tent; by the voice of the LORD they shall camp, and by order of the LORD they shall depart.
NUM 9:21 And it shall be whenever the cloud should be present from evening until morning, and the cloud should ascend in the morning, then they shall depart by day or night,
NUM 9:22 or when being more than a month of days of the cloud shadowing upon it, the sons of Israel shall camp, and in no way shall they depart.
NUM 9:23 For by order of the LORD they shall depart - they guarded the watch of the LORD, by order of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
NUM 10:1 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
NUM 10:2 Make to yourself two trumpets of silver! A hammered work you shall make them, and they will be to you to call the congregation, and to lift away the camps.
NUM 10:3 And you shall trump with them, and bring together all the congregation unto the door of the tent of the testimony.
NUM 10:4 But if they should trump with one sound, then shall come forward to you all the rulers of the heads of Israel.
NUM 10:5 And you shall trump a signal - and the camps camping according to the east shall lift away.
NUM 10:6 And you shall trump for a signal a second time - and the camps camping according to the south shall lift away. And you shall trump a third signal - and the camps camping by the west shall lift away. And you shall trump a fourth signal - and the camps camping towards the north shall lift away. You shall trump a signal at their departure.
NUM 10:7 And whenever you should bring together the congregation, you shall trump, but not a signal.
NUM 10:8 And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall trump with the trumpets; and it will be to you an eternal law unto your generations.
NUM 10:9 But if you should go forth to war in your land against the opponents opposing you, then you shall signify with the trumpets; and you will be called to mind before the LORD your God, and you shall be preserved from your enemies.
NUM 10:10 And in the days of your gladness, and in your holidays, and in your new moons, you shall trump with the trumpets at the whole burnt offerings, and at the sacrifices of your deliverance offerings. And it shall be to you for a remembrance before your God - I am the LORD your God.
NUM 10:11 And it came to pass in the second year, in the second month, the twentieth of the month, the cloud ascended from the tent of the testimony.
NUM 10:12 And the sons of Israel lifted away with their chattel in the wilderness of Sinai. And the cloud stopped in the wilderness of Paran.
NUM 10:13 And the first ranks lifted away by the voice of the LORD by the hand of Moses.

NUM 10:29 And Moses said to Hobab, son of Raguel the Midianite, father-in-law of Moses, We are lifting away unto the place which the LORD said, This I will give to you. Come with us, and we will do good for you; for the LORD spoke good concerning Israel.
NUM 10:30 And he said to him, I shall not go; but unto my land, and unto my family I will go.
NUM 10:31 And he said, You should not abandon us, because you were with us in the wilderness, and you will be among us as an ambassador.
NUM 10:32 And it shall be if you should go with us, that it shall be the good things that whatever as many as the LORD shall do good for us, also we shall do good for you.
NUM 10:33 And they lifted away from out of the mountain of the LORD a journey of three days. And the ark of covenant of the LORD went forth in front of them, a journey of three days, to survey themselves a rest.
NUM 10:34 And the cloud of the LORD came to pass shadowing over them by day in their lifting away from out of the camp.
NUM 10:35 And it came to pass in the lifting away the ark, that Moses said, Awaken, O LORD, and let your enemies be dispersed, and let all the ones detesting you flee!
NUM 10:36 And in the resting, he said, Turn, O LORD, thousands of myriads in Israel!
NUM 11:1 And the people were grumbling wickedly before the LORD. And the LORD heard, and he became enraged in anger; and there burned among them a fire by the LORD, and it devoured a certain part of the camp.
NUM 11:2 And the people cried out to Moses. And Moses made a vow to the LORD, and the fire abated.
NUM 11:3 And he called the name of that place, Combustion, for fire by the LORD burned among them.
NUM 11:4 And the intermixed people among them desired with a great desire. And being seated, they wept along with the sons of Israel, and said, Who will feed us meats?
NUM 11:5 We remember the fishes, which we ate in Egypt without charge, and the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlics.
NUM 11:6 But now our soul is dried up - there is nothing except for the manna to our eyes.
NUM 11:7 And the manna is as seed of coriander, and the appearance of it is the appearance of ice.
NUM 11:8 And the people traveled around, and collected together, and ground it with the millstone, and ground it with the hand mill, and boiled it in the earthen pot, and made it into a cake baked in hot ashes. And the satisfaction of it was as the taste of pastry made from olive oil.
NUM 11:9 And whenever the dew came down upon the camp at night, the manna came down upon it.
NUM 11:10 And Moses heard their weeping, according to their peoples, each at his door. And the LORD was enraged in anger exceedingly. And before Moses it was wicked.
NUM 11:11 And Moses said to the LORD, Why do you afflict your attendant? And why have I not found favor before you to place the thrust of this people upon me?
NUM 11:12 Have I conceived in the womb all this people, or have I given birth to them that you say to me, Take them into your bosom, as a wet-nurse lifts the one being nursed, unto the land which you swore by an oath to their fathers?
NUM 11:13 From what place is it to me to give meats to all this people? For they weep upon me, saying, Give to us meats that we may eat!
NUM 11:14 I shall not be able alone to bring this people, for this matter is heavy for me.
NUM 11:15 But if so you do to me, kill me with my removal, if I have found favor with you, that I should not see my ill-treatment.
NUM 11:16 And the LORD said to Moses, Bring together to me seventy men from the elders of Israel, whom you yourself know! These are elders of the people, and their scribes. And you shall lead them to the tent of the testimony, and they shall stand there with you.
NUM 11:17 And I shall go down and speak there with you. And I will remove of the spirit upon you, and I will place it upon them, and they shall aid with you the thrust of the people; and you shall not bring them alone.
NUM 11:18 And to the people you shall say, Purify yourselves for tomorrow! And you shall eat meats, for you wept before the LORD, saying, Who shall feed us meats? for it was good to us being in Egypt. And the LORD shall give to you meats, and you shall eat.
NUM 11:19 You shall not eat for one day, nor two, nor five days, nor ten days, nor twenty days,
NUM 11:20 you shall eat for a month of days, until whenever it should come forth from out of your nostrils; and it shall be to you for a cholera, that you resisted the LORD who is among you, and you wept before him, saying, What did we do to come out of Egypt?
NUM 11:21 And Moses said, Six hundred thousand footmen are the people in which I am among them. And you said, I will give to them meats, and they shall eat for a month of days.
NUM 11:22 Shall sheep and oxen be slain for them, and will it suffice to them? Or shall all the fish of the sea be brought to them, and will it suffice to them?
NUM 11:23 And the LORD said to Moses, Shall the hand of the LORD not be enough? Already you shall know if my word shall overtake you or not.
NUM 11:24 And Moses came forth, and he spoke to the people the sayings of the LORD. And he brought together seventy men from the elders of the people, and stood them round about the tent.
NUM 11:25 And the LORD came down in a cloud, and he spoke to him, and he lifted from the spirit upon him, and placed it upon the seventy men of the elders. And as spirit rested upon them, that they prophesied, and no longer proceeded.
NUM 11:26 And were left behind two men in the camp. The name to the one was Eldad, and the name of the second was Medad. And the spirit rested upon them, and these were of the ones delineated, and came not to the tent. And they prophesied in the camp.
NUM 11:27 And a young man ran up to report to Moses, and said, saying, Eldad and Medad prophesy in the camp.
NUM 11:28 And answering, Joshua the son of Nun, the one standing beside Moses, his chosen one, said, O my master Moses, restrain them!
NUM 11:29 And Moses said to him, Are you zealous for me? and, O how it would be given all the people of the LORD were prophets, whenever the LORD should put his spirit upon them.
NUM 11:30 And Moses went forth into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.
NUM 11:31 And a wind went forth from the LORD, and carried over mother-quail from the sea, and it put them upon the camp, a days journey here on this side, and a days journey here on that side, round about the camp, about two cubits from the earth.
NUM 11:32 And the people rose up that entire day, and the entire night, and the entire next day, and gathered together the mother-quail - the one gathering a few was ten cors. And they cooled themselves in a time of refreshing round about the camp.
NUM 11:33 The meats still was in their teeth before the dissipating, and the LORD was enraged in wrath at the people. And the LORD struck the people an exceedingly great calamity.
NUM 11:34 And the name of that place was called, Tombs of Desire. For there they entombed the craving people.
NUM 11:35 From Tombs of the Desire the people lifted away unto Hazeroth; and the people existed in Hazeroth.
NUM 12:1 And Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Ethiopian wife whom Moses took - for he took an Ethiopian woman.
NUM 12:2 And they said, Has the LORD spoken only to Moses? Did he not also speak to us? And the LORD heard.
NUM 12:3 And the man Moses was exceedingly gentle above all the men being upon the earth.
NUM 12:4 And the LORD said immediately to Moses, and Aaron, and Miriam, Come forth you the three into the tent of the testimony!
NUM 12:5 And came forth the three into the tent of the testimony. And the LORD came down in a column of cloud, and it stood at the door of the tent of the testimony. And Aaron and Miriam were called; and both came forth.
NUM 12:6 And he said to them, Hear my words. If there should be a prophet among you to the LORD, I will be made known to him in a vision, and in sleep will speak to him.
NUM 12:7 Not so my attendant Moses; he is trustworthy in my entire house.
NUM 12:8 Mouth to mouth I will speak to him in sight, and not through enigmas; even he saw the glory of the LORD. And why were you not afraid to speak ill against my attendant Moses?
NUM 12:9 And anger of rage of the LORD was upon them; and they went forth.
NUM 12:10 And the cloud left from the tent; and behold, Miriam became leprous as snow. And Aaron looked upon Miriam, and behold, she was leprous.
NUM 12:11 And Aaron said to Moses, I beseech you, O my master, you should not join sin to us, for we knew not that we sinned.
NUM 12:12 Do not let her become as equal to death, as a miscarriage going forth from out of a womb of his mother, and it eats up half of her flesh.
NUM 12:13 And Moses yelled out to the LORD, saying, O God, I beseech you to heal her.
NUM 12:14 And the LORD said to Moses, If her father in spitting, spat into her face, would she not feel shame? Seven days she shall be separated outside the camp, and after this she shall enter.
NUM 12:15 And Miriam was separated outside the camp seven days. And the people did not lift away until Miriam was cleansed.
NUM 12:16 And after these things the people lifted away from Hazeroth, and camped in the wilderness of Paran.

NUM 14:4 And the other said to the other, We should appoint a chief, and should return unto Egypt.

NUM 14:9 But from the LORD do not become defectors. And you all, fear not the people of the land, for it is a thing devoured to us. For the time has left from them, and the LORD is among us; do not fear them!

NUM 14:17 And now, raise up high your strength, O LORD, in which manner you said, saying,
NUM 14:18 The LORD is lenient, and full of mercy, and true, removing lawless deeds, and iniquities, and sins; but by cleansing he shall not cleanse the liable, repaying the sins of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation.
NUM 14:19 Dismiss the sin of this people according to your great mercy, just as kindness happened to them from Egypt until the present.
NUM 14:20 And the LORD said, I am kind to them according to your word.
NUM 14:21 But as I live, that the glory of the LORD will fill all the earth,
NUM 14:22 that all the men seeing my glory, and the signs which I did in Egypt, and in this wilderness, and test me this tenth time, and are not listening to my voice,
NUM 14:23 assuredly they shall not see the land which I swore by an oath to their fathers; but only their children who are with me here, as many as have not known good or evil. Every young one inexperienced, to these I will give the land, but all the ones provoking me shall not see it.

NUM 15:1 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
NUM 15:2 Speak to the sons of Israel, and say to them, Whenever you should enter into the land of your dwelling, which I give to you,
NUM 15:3 and you shall offer yield offerings to the LORD, or a whole burnt offering, or a sacrifice offering to magnify a vow, or concerning a voluntary offering, or in your holiday feasts, you shall offer a scent of pleasant aroma to the LORD, either from the oxen, or from the sheep.
NUM 15:4 And the one offering shall bring his gift to the LORD being a sacrifice of fine flour - the tenth of the ephah, being prepared in olive oil, in a fourth of the hin.
NUM 15:5 And wine for a libation - the fourth of the hin, you shall offer upon the whole burnt offering, or upon the sacrifice offering to the one lamb.
NUM 15:6 And for the ram, whenever you offer it for a whole burnt offering or for a sacrifice offering, you shall prepare a sacrifice of fine flour - two tenths being prepared in olive oil, the third of the hin.
NUM 15:7 And wine for a libation - the third of the hin, you shall offer for a scent of pleasant aroma to the LORD.
NUM 15:8 But if from the oxen you should offer for a whole burnt offering, or for a sacrifice offering to magnify a vow, or for a deliverance offering to the LORD,
NUM 15:9 then he shall bring with the calf for a sacrifice offering of fine flour, three tenths, being prepared in olive oil - a half of the hin,
NUM 15:10 and the wine for a libation, the half of the hin - a yield offering scent of pleasant aroma to the LORD.
NUM 15:11 Thus you shall offer for the one calf, or the one ram, or the one lamb from out of the sheep, or a kid of the goats.
NUM 15:12 According to the number which ever you should offer, so you shall do to the one, according to their number.
NUM 15:13 Every native born shall offer thus, such as to bring yield offerings for a scent of pleasant aroma to the LORD.
NUM 15:14 And if a foreigner among you should unite in your land, or who ever was born to you among your generations, and he shall offer a yield offering scent of pleasant aroma to the LORD, in which manner you do yourselves - so shall the congregation offer to the LORD.
NUM 15:15 One law will be to you, and to the foreigners lying near to you - an eternal law unto your generations. As you, also the foreigner will be before the LORD.
NUM 15:16 There shall be one law, and there shall be one ordinance to you, and to the foreigner lying near to you.
NUM 15:17 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
NUM 15:18 Speak to the sons of Israel! And you shall say to them, In your entering into the land into which I bring you there,
NUM 15:19 that it will be whenever you yourselves should eat from the breads of the land, you shall remove a separation portion as a separation offering to the LORD, a first-fruit of your batch of dough.
NUM 15:20 You shall separate bread as a separation portion to him. As a separation portion from the threshing-floor, thus shall you remove it.
NUM 15:21 As first-fruit of your batch, even you shall give it to the LORD as a separation portion for your generations.
NUM 15:22 And whenever you should miss entirely, and should not observe all these commandments which the LORD spoke to Moses,
NUM 15:23 as the LORD gave orders for you by the hand of Moses, from the day of which the LORD gave orders to you, and beyond unto your generations;
NUM 15:24 that it shall be if from the eyes of the congregation it should happen unintentionally, then all the congregation shall offer one calf from out of the oxen, unblemished, for a whole burnt offering, for a scent of pleasant aroma to the LORD, and this sacrifice offering, and its libation, according to its arrangement, and one winter yearling from out of the goats for a sin offering,
NUM 15:25 and the priest shall make atonement for all the congregation of the sons of Israel, and it shall be forgiven them, for it is unintentional. And they brought their gift, a yield offering to the LORD for their sins, before the LORD, for their unintentional sins.
NUM 15:26 And it shall be forgiven to all the congregation of the sons of Israel, and to the foreigner lying near to you - for to all the people it is unintentional.
NUM 15:27 And if one soul should sin unintentionally, he shall lead forward one goat of a year old for a sin offering.
NUM 15:28 And the priest shall atone for the soul of the one acting unintentionally, and sinning unintentionally before the LORD, to atone for him, and to forgive him.
NUM 15:29 To the native inhabitant among the sons of Israel, and to the foreigner lying near to them, there shall be one law to them - who ever should do it unintentionally.
NUM 15:30 And the soul who shall do a thing by hand through pride, of the native born or of the foreigners, this one provokes God, and that soul shall be utterly destroyed from out of its people.
NUM 15:31 For the word of the LORD he treated as worthless, and his commandments he effaced. By obliteration that soul shall be obliterated - his sin be on him.
NUM 15:32 And the sons of Israel were in the wilderness, and found a man collecting together wood on the day of the sabbath.
NUM 15:33 And the ones finding him collecting wood led him forward to Moses and Aaron, and to all the congregation of the sons of Israel.
NUM 15:34 And they put him under guard, for they did not interpret what they should do to him.
NUM 15:35 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying, Unto death put to death the man! You shall stone him with stones - all the congregation outside the camp.
NUM 15:36 And all the congregation led him outside the camp. And they stoned him, as the LORD gave orders to Moses.
NUM 15:37 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
NUM 15:38 Speak to the sons of Israel! And you shall say to them, Even let them make for themselves decorative hems upon the borders of their cloaks throughout their generations. And you shall place upon the decorative hems of the borders a yarn of blue.

NUM 22:8 And he said to them, You rest up here the night, and I will answer you the things which ever the LORD should speak to me! And the rulers of Moab stayed with Balaam.
NUM 22:9 And God came to Balaam, and he said to him, What do these men want with you?
NUM 22:10 And Balaam said to God, Balak son of Zippor, king of Moab, sent them to me, saying,
NUM 22:11 Behold, a people come forth from out of Egypt, and covered the appearance of the earth. And now, come curse it for me! If it is so I shall be able to strike it, and I will cast it out.
NUM 22:12 And God said to Balaam, You shall not go with them, nor shall you curse the people, for they are blessed.
NUM 22:13 And Balaam rising in the morning, said to the rulers of Balak, You run to your land, the LORD does not allow me to go with you.
NUM 22:14 And rising, the rulers of Moab came to Balak. And they said, Balaam does not want to go with us.
NUM 22:15 And Balak added again to send many rulers, and ones more important than these.
NUM 22:16 And they came to Balaam, and they say to him, Thus says Balak the son of Zippor, I deem you worthy, you should not be reluctant to come to me,
NUM 22:17 for highly valued I will esteem you, and as many things as you should say to me I will do for you. Now come, accurse for me this people!
NUM 22:18 And Balaam answered and said to the rulers of Balak, If Balak shall give to me his house full of silver and gold, I shall not be able to violate the word of the LORD God, to do it small or great.
NUM 22:19 And now remain behind here, even you this night! and I will know what the LORD shall add to speak to me.
NUM 22:20 And God came to Balaam at night, and said to him, If these men calling you are at hand, rising up follow them, but the saying which ever I speak to you, this you observe!
NUM 22:21 And Balaam, rising in the morning, saddled his donkey, and went with the rulers of Moab.
NUM 22:22 And God was provoked to anger in rage that he himself went. And the angel of God rose up in the way to stand in the way as an adversary against him. And he mounted upon his donkey, and his two servants with him.
NUM 22:23 And the donkey seeing the angel of God opposing it in the way, and the broadsword being unsheathed in his hand, that the donkey turned aside from out of the way, and went into the plain. And he struck the donkey to straighten it in the way.
NUM 22:24 And the angel of God stood in the furrows of the grapevines, a barrier here on this side and a barrier here on that side.
NUM 22:25 And the donkey seeing the angel of God, pressed herself against the wall, and she squeezed the foot of Balaam to the wall, and he added again to crack the whip on her.
NUM 22:26 And the angel of God proceeded going forth. And he stood in a narrow place for which there was not a turning aside right or left.
NUM 22:27 And the donkey seeing the angel of God, sat down underneath Balaam. And Balaam became enraged, and beat the donkey with the rod.
NUM 22:28 And God opened the mouth of the donkey, and she says to Balaam, What did I do to you that you have hit me this third time?
NUM 22:29 And Balaam said to the donkey that, You have mocked me, and if I had a sword in my hand, already I would have stabbed you.
NUM 22:30 And the donkey says to Balaam, Am I not your donkey, upon which you mounted from your youth, until today's day? Have I acted to neglect by overlooking you thus? And he said, No!
NUM 22:31 And God uncovered the eyes of Balaam, and he sees the angel of the LORD opposing him in the way, and the sword being unsheathed in his hand. And bowing, he did obeisance on his face.
NUM 22:32 And the angel of God said to him, Why do you strike your donkey this third time? Now behold, I came forth to distract you, for your way was not fair before me.
NUM 22:33 And seeing me, the donkey turned aside from me this third time. And unless she turned aside from me, now then you indeed I would have killed, and then I would have preserved her.
NUM 22:34 And Balaam said to the angel of the LORD, I have sinned, for I did not have knowledge that you opposed me in the way to meet with me. And now, unless it not be sufficient to you, I shall return.
NUM 22:35 And the angel of God said to Balaam, You go with the men! Except the word which ever I should say to you, this you shall guard to speak. And Balaam went with the rulers of Balak.
NUM 22:36 And Balak hearing that Balaam had come, came forth to meet him in a city of Moab, which is upon the borders of Arnon, which is of the parts of the borders.
NUM 22:37 And Balak said to Balaam, Did I not send to you to call you? Why have you not come to me? Really, shall I not be able to esteem you?
NUM 22:38 And Balaam said to Balak, Behold, I come to you now. Am I able to speak anything? The word which ever God should put into my mouth, this I will speak.
NUM 22:39 And Balaam went with Balak. And they came to Cities of Properties.
NUM 22:40 And Balak sacrificed sheep and calves. And he sent to Balaam, and to the rulers with him.
NUM 22:41 And it became morning. And Balak, taking Balaam, transported him unto the stele of Baal, and showed to him from there a certain part of the people.
NUM 23:1 And Balaam said to Balak, Build for me here seven shrines, and prepare for me here seven calves, and seven rams!

NUM 23:3 And Balaam said to Balak, You stand beside your sacrifice, and I shall go to see if God shall appear to meet with me. And the saying which ever he shall show to me I shall announce to you. And he went straight.

NUM 23:12 And Balaam said to Balak, Is it not as many things as God should put in my mouth - this I will guard to speak?
NUM 23:13 And Balak said to him, Come yet with me to another place of which you shall not see it from there, but only a certain part of it shall you see, but in no way should you see all, and you curse it for me from there!
NUM 23:14 And he took him into a field - a height upon the top of a place for dressing stone, and built there seven shrines, and brought a calf and ram unto the shrine.
NUM 23:15 And Balaam said to Balak, Stand beside your sacrifice, and I shall go to ask God!
NUM 23:16 And God met with Balaam, and put a word into his mouth. And he said, Return to Balak, and thus you shall speak!
NUM 23:17 And he returned to him. And thus he was standing beside his whole burnt offering, and the rulers of Moab with him. And Balak said to him, What said the LORD?
NUM 23:18 And taking up his parable, he said, Rise up, O Balak, and hear! Give ear, O witness son of Zippor!
NUM 23:19 God is not as a man to waver, nor as a son of man to be threatened. He in speaking, shall he not do? Shall he speak, and not adhere to?

NUM 23:22 God, the one leading him out of Egypt; as the glory of his unicorn.
NUM 23:23 For there is not an omen in Jacob, nor divination in Israel. In time it shall be told to Jacob and to Israel what God shall complete.
NUM 23:24 Behold, the people as a cub shall raise up, and as a lion it shall prance. It shall not go to sleep until it shall eat game, and the blood of the slain it shall drink.

NUM 23:26 And Balaam answering said to Balak, Did I not speak to you, saying, The word which ever God should speak, this I will do?
NUM 23:27 And Balak said to Balaam, Come, I should take you unto another place, if it should please God, and curse him for me from there!
NUM 23:28 And Balak took Balaam upon the top of Peor, the part extending into the wilderness.
NUM 23:29 And Balaam said to Balak, Build for me here seven shrines, and prepare for me here seven calves and seven rams!
NUM 23:30 And Balak did just as Balaam said to him, and bore a calf and a ram unto the shrine.

NUM 28:13 And a tenth of fine flour being prepared in olive oil for the one lamb - a sacrifice scent of pleasant aroma, a yield offering to the LORD.
NUM 28:14 To their libation will be the half of the hin of wine for the one calf, and the third of the hin of wine will be for the one ram, and the fourth of the hin of wine will be for the one lamb. This is the whole burnt offering, month by month throughout the months of the year.
NUM 28:15 And a young he-goat from the goats - one for a sin offering to the LORD, beside the continual whole burnt offering you shall offer, and its libation.
NUM 28:16 And in the first month, the fourteenth day of the month, is a passover to the LORD.
NUM 28:17 And in the fifteenth day of the month, this is a holiday - seven days you shall eat unleavened breads.
NUM 28:18 And the first day will be a holy summoning to you. All work which is servile you shall not do.
NUM 28:19 And you shall bring whole burnt offerings, a yield offering to the LORD - two calves of the oxen, one ram, seven lambs of a year old; they shall be unblemished to you.
NUM 28:20 And their sacrifice offering shall be of fine flour being prepared in olive oil - three tenths for the one calf, and two tenths for the one ram.
NUM 28:21 You shall offer a tenth tithe for the one lamb, to the seven lambs;
NUM 28:22 and a young he-goat from the goats - one for a sin offering, to atone for you,
NUM 28:23 besides the continual whole burnt offering of the early morning, which is a perpetual whole burnt offering.
NUM 28:24 These according to these manners you shall offer per day for the seven days as a gift yield offering scent of pleasant aroma to the LORD - with the continual whole burnt offering you shall offer its libation.
NUM 28:25 And the seventh day will be a holy calling to you; all servile work you shall not do on it.
NUM 28:26 And the day of the new produce, whenever you should bring a new produce sacrifice of the period of sevens to the LORD, it will be a holy summoning to you; all servile work you shall not do.
NUM 28:27 And you shall bring whole burnt offerings for a scent of pleasant aroma to the LORD - two calves of the oxen, one ram, seven lambs of a year old unblemished.
NUM 28:28 Their sacrifice offering shall be of fine flour being prepared in olive oil, three tenths for the one calf, and two tenths for the one ram,
NUM 28:29 a tenth tithe to the one lamb, to the seven lambs,
NUM 28:30 and one young he-goat from the goats for a sin offering, to atone for you;
NUM 28:31 besides the continual whole burnt offering, and their sacrifice offering you shall offer to me - they shall be unblemished to you, and with their libations.

NUM 29:40 And Moses spoke to the sons of Israel concerning all as many things as the LORD gave charge to Moses.
NUM 30:1 And Moses spoke to the rulers of the tribes of the sons of Israel, saying, This is the saying which the LORD ordered.
NUM 30:2 A man - a man who ever should vow a vow to the LORD, or should swear by an oath, or should confirm a set of limits upon his life, he shall not profane his word; all as many things as should come forth from out of his mouth he shall do.
NUM 30:3 And if a woman should vow a vow to the LORD, or confirm a set of limits in the house of her father in her youth;
NUM 30:4 and her father should hear her vows, and her sets of limits which she confirmed on her life, and her father should remain silent, then all the matters of her vows shall stand, and all the sets of limits which she confirmed on her life she shall abide by.
NUM 30:5 But if in shaking his head in dissent her father should dissent in which ever day he should hear her vows, and her sets of limits which she confirmed on her life shall not stand - and the LORD shall clear her, for her father shook his head in dissent.
NUM 30:6 But if in coming to pass she should become a man's wife, and her vows be upon her, according to the distinction from her lips as many things as she confirmed on her life;
NUM 30:7 and her husband should hear, and should remain silent concerning her in which ever day he should hear, then thus shall stand all her vows, and her sets of limits which she confirmed on her life shall stand.
NUM 30:8 But if in shaking his head in dissent her husband should dissent in which ever day he should hear all her vows, and her sets of limits which she confirmed on her life, they shall not abide - for her husband shook his head in dissent concerning her, and the LORD shall clear her.
NUM 30:9 And a vow of a widow, and a woman being cast out, as many things as she should make a vow on her life, shall abide to her.
NUM 30:10 But if in the house of her husband her vow be, or the set of limits on her life with an oath,
NUM 30:11 and her husband should hear, and should remain silent concerning her, and should not shake his head in dissent concerning her, then all her vows shall stand, and all her sets of limits which she confirmed on her life shall stand concerning her.
NUM 30:12 But if in removing her husband should remove them, in which ever day he should hear all as many things as should come forth from out of her lips concerning her vows, and concerning the sets of limits on her life, it shall not remain to her - her husband removed them, and the LORD cleared her.
NUM 30:13 Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict her soul, her husband shall set for her, and her husband shall remove for her.
NUM 30:14 But if in keeping silent he should remain silent at her day by day; then all her vows shall stand to her, and the sets of limits upon her shall stand to her; for he kept silent at her in the day in which he heard.
NUM 30:15 But if removing her husband should remove them after the day which he heard them; then he shall take the sin unto himself.
NUM 30:16 These are the ordinances, as many as the LORD gave charge to Moses, between a husband and between his wife, and between a father and daughter in youth in the house of her father.
NUM 31:1 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
NUM 31:2 Let the sons of Israel avenge with punishment on the Midianites - and at the last you shall be added to your people.
NUM 31:3 And Moses spoke to the people saying, Completely arm your men, and deploy before the LORD against Midian, to render punishment by the LORD to Midian.
NUM 31:4 A thousand from out of a tribe - even a thousand from out of a tribe from out of all tribes of the sons of Israel you send to deploy!
NUM 31:5 And they counted out from out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand from out of a tribe - twelve thousand being armed in battle array.
NUM 31:6 And Moses sent them - a thousand from out of a tribe; even a thousand from out of a tribe with their force, and Phinehas son of Eleazar son of Aaron the priest, and the holy items, and the trumpets in their hands for the signals.
NUM 31:7 And they deployed against Midian as the LORD gave charge to Moses; and they killed every male.
NUM 31:8 And they killed the kings of Midian together with their slain - Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, five kings of Midian. And Balaam son of Beor they killed by the broadsword with their slain.
NUM 31:9 And they despoiled the women of Midian, and their belongings, and their cattle, and all the things procured by them, and despoiled their force.
NUM 31:10 And all their cities in their dwellings, and their properties, they burned by fire.
NUM 31:11 And they took all the plunder, and all their spoils - from man unto beast.
NUM 31:12 And they brought to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to all the sons of Israel, the captivity, and the spoils, and the plunder, into the camp in the wilderness of Moab which is upon the Jordan by Jericho.
NUM 31:13 And Moses came forth, and Eleazar the priest, and all the rulers of the congregation, to meet with them outside the camp.
NUM 31:14 And Moses was provoked to anger with the overseers of the force - commanders of thousands, and commanders of hundreds, the ones coming from out of the battle array of the war.
NUM 31:15 And Moses said to them, Why did you take alive every female?
NUM 31:16 For these were the occasion to the sons of Israel by the word of Balaam of their leaving and overlooking the word of the LORD, because of Peor - and came to pass the calamity in the congregation of the LORD.
NUM 31:17 And now, kill every male among all the chattel! And every woman who knew the marriage-bed of a man kill!
NUM 31:18 And all the chattel of the women who knew not the marriage-bed of a man, take them alive!
NUM 31:19 And you camp outside the camp seven days, every one doing away with a soul! And all having touched the one being pierced shall be purified in the third day, and in the seventh day, you and your captivity.
NUM 31:20 And every wrap-around garment, and every item made of skin, and every work of goat skin, and every wooden item, you shall purify.
NUM 31:21 And Eleazar the priest said to the men of the force coming from out of the battle array of the war, This is the ordinance of the law which the LORD gave orders to Moses.
NUM 31:22 Besides the gold, and the silver, and brass, and iron, and lead, and tin,
NUM 31:23 every thing which shall go through in fire shall be led through in fire, and shall be clean; but only with the water of purification shall it be purified. And all as many as should not travel through fire, shall go through water.
NUM 31:24 And you shall wash the garments on the seventh day, and you shall be clean, and after this you shall enter into the camp.
NUM 31:25 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
NUM 31:26 Take the total sum of the spoils of the captivity, from man unto beast, you and Eleazar the priest, and the rulers of the patrimony of the congregation!
NUM 31:27 And you shall divide the spoils between the warriors going forth into the battle array, and between the whole congregation.
NUM 31:28 And you shall offer up the tax to the LORD from the men of the warriors going forth into the battle array; one soul from five hundred of the people, and from the cattle, and from the oxen, and from the sheep, and from the donkeys.
NUM 31:29 From their half you shall take, and shall give to Eleazar the priest the first-fruits of the LORD.
NUM 31:30 And from the half of the ones of the sons of Israel, you shall take one from fifty, from the people, and from the oxen, and from the sheep, and from the donkeys, and from all the cattle, and shall give them to the Levites guarding the watches in the tent of the LORD.
NUM 31:31 And Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the LORD gave orders to Moses.
NUM 31:32 And came to pass the surplus of the plunder which the warrior men despoiled from the sheep - six hundred thousand and seventy thousand and five thousand;
NUM 31:33 and oxen - two and seventy thousand;
NUM 31:34 and donkeys - one and sixty thousand.
NUM 31:35 And souls of peoples from the women who knew not the marriage-bed of a male, all souls - two and thirty thousand.
NUM 31:36 And came to pass the half portion of the ones going forth into the war, of the number of the sheep - three hundred thousand and thirty thousand and seven thousand and five hundred.
NUM 31:37 And came to pass the tax to the LORD of the sheep - six hundred and seventy five;
NUM 31:38 and oxen - six and thirty thousand; and their tax to the LORD - two and seventy;
NUM 31:39 and donkeys - thirty thousand and five hundred; and their tax to the LORD - one and sixty;
NUM 31:40 and the souls of people - six and ten thousand; and their tax to the LORD - two and thirty souls.
NUM 31:41 And Moses gave the tax due to the LORD (the separation portion of God) to Eleazar the priest, as the LORD gave orders to Moses,
NUM 31:42 from the half of the sons of Israel whom Moses divided from the men of the warriors.
NUM 31:43 And came to pass the half from the congregation, of the sheep - three hundred thousand and thirty thousand and seven thousand and five hundred;
NUM 31:44 and oxen - six and thirty thousand;
NUM 31:45 donkeys - thirty thousand and five hundred;
NUM 31:46 and souls of peoples - six and ten thousand.
NUM 31:47 And Moses took from the half of the sons of Israel, the one from every fifty of the people, and of the cattle, and gave them to the Levites guarding the watches of the tent of the LORD; in which manner the LORD gave orders to Moses.
NUM 31:48 And there came forward to Moses all the ones placed as the commanders of the force - commanders of thousands, and commanders of hundreds. And they said to Moses,
NUM 31:49 Your servants have taken the total sum of the men of the warriors with us, and not even one dissented of them.
NUM 31:50 And we have brought the gift to the LORD, every man who found an item of gold, and armlet, and bracelet, and ring, and right armband, and wreath, to atone for us before the LORD.
NUM 31:51 And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold from them, every item being worked.
NUM 31:52 And came to pass all the gold for the separation portion which they removed to the LORD - sixteen thousand and seven hundred and fifty shekels from the commanders of thousands, and from the commanders of hundreds.
NUM 31:53 And the men, the warriors, despoiled each unto himself.
NUM 31:54 And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold from the commanders of a thousand, and from the commanders of hundreds, and carried them into the tent of the testimony - a memorial of the sons of Israel before the LORD.
NUM 32:1 And there was a multitude of cattle to the sons of Reuben, and to the sons of Gad - an exceedingly great multitude. And they saw the place of Jazer, and the place of Gilead; and the place was a place of cattle.
NUM 32:2 And the sons of Reuben coming forward, and the sons of Gad, said to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the rulers of the congregation, saying,
NUM 32:3 Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Shebam, and Nebo, and Beon -
NUM 32:4 the land which the LORD delivered up before the sons of Israel, is land for grazing cattle, and your servants subsist on cattle.
NUM 32:5 And they said, If we find favor before you, give this land to your servants for a possession, and do not cause us to pass over the Jordan!
NUM 32:6 And Moses said to the sons of Gad, and to the sons of Reuben, Shall your brethren go to war, and you sit here?
NUM 32:7 And why do you turn aside the thoughts of the sons of Israel to not pass over into the land which the LORD gives to them?
NUM 32:8 Did not your fathers do thus when I sent them from out of Kadesh Barnea to study the land?
NUM 32:9 And they ascended the Ravine of the Cluster, and studied the land, and separated the heart of the sons of Israel, so as to not enter into the land which the LORD gave to them.
NUM 32:10 And the LORD was provoked to anger in rage in that day, and swore by an oath, saying,
NUM 32:11 Shall these men see, (the men ascending from Egypt, from twenty years old and up, having knowledge of the good and the bad,) the land which I swore by an oath to Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob? For they did not follow together after me,
NUM 32:12 except Caleb son of Jephunneh, the one being parted, and Joshua the son of Nun - for they followed after the LORD.
NUM 32:13 And the LORD was provoked to anger in rage over Israel, and he staggered them in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation doing evil before the LORD was completely consumed.
NUM 32:14 Behold, you rose up in place of your fathers, a confederation of men of sinners, to add still unto the rage of the anger of the LORD against Israel.
NUM 32:15 For shall you be turned away from him to add still to leave him in the wilderness, and act lawlessly against this entire congregation.
NUM 32:16 And they came forward to him, and said, Properties for flocks we shall build here to our cattle, and cities for our chattel.
NUM 32:17 And we, arming ourselves, will be an advance guard in front of the sons of Israel, until when we should lead them into their own place. And our belongings shall dwell in cities being walled, because of the ones dwelling the land.
NUM 32:18 In no way should we return to our dwellings, until whenever the sons of Israel each should divide into his inheritance.
NUM 32:19 And no longer shall we be heir with them from the other side of the Jordan and beyond; for we receive our lots on the other side of the Jordan eastwards.
NUM 32:20 And Moses said to them, If you should do according to this thing, if you should completely arm before the LORD for war,
NUM 32:21 and you yourselves all shall go over the Jordan armed with large shields before the LORD, until his enemy shall be obliterated from his face,
NUM 32:22 and the land shall be dominated before the LORD - then after these things you shall return, and you will be innocent before the LORD, and from Israel. And this land shall be to you for a possession before the LORD.
NUM 32:23 But if you should not do so, you shall sin before the LORD - and you shall know your sin, whenever bad things should overtake you.
NUM 32:24 And thus you shall build to yourselves to them cities for your belongings, and properties for your cattle; and the thing going forth from out of your mouth you shall do.
NUM 32:25 And the sons of Reuben and the the sons of Gad spoke to Moses, saying, Your servants shall do as our master gives charge.
NUM 32:26 Our belongings, and our women, and our possessions, and all our cattle, shall be there in the cities of Gilead.
NUM 32:27 But your servants shall all go over, being armed and being arrayed before the LORD, for war, in which manner the master says.
NUM 32:28 And Moses stood together with them, with Eleazar the priest, and Joshua son of Nun, and the rulers of the patrimony of the tribes of the sons of Israel.
NUM 32:29 And Moses said to them, If the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad should pass over the Jordan with you, every one being armed for war before the LORD, and you should dominate the land before you, then you shall give to them the land of Gilead for a possession.
NUM 32:30 But if they should not pass over being armed with you for war before the LORD, then you shall cause them to pass over with their belongings, and their women, and their cattle in front of you into the land of Canaan - and they shall inherit together with you in the land of Canaan.
NUM 32:31 And the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad answered, saying, As much as the LORD says to his attendants, so we shall do.
NUM 32:32 We will pass over being armed before the LORD into the land of Canaan, and you shall give our possession on the other side of the Jordan.

NUM 33:51 Speak to the sons of Israel! And you shall say to them, You pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan!
NUM 33:52 And you shall destroy all the ones dwelling in the land before your face. And you shall lift away their sacred heights; and all their molten idols - you shall destroy them; and all their sacred monuments you shall lift away.
NUM 33:53 And you shall destroy the ones dwelling the land, and you shall dwell in it. For to you I have given their land by lot.
NUM 33:54 And you shall inherit the land by lot, according to your tribes. To the many you shall multiply their possession, and to the lesser you shall give less for their possession. To what ever part his name should come forth by lot, there his possession will be - according to the tribes of your patrimony you shall inherit.
NUM 33:55 And if you should not destroy the ones dwelling upon the land from your face; then it shall be whom ever you should leave behind of them shall be barbs in your eyes, and arrows in your sides, and shall be an enemy to you upon the land upon which you dwell.
NUM 33:56 And it will be in so far as I had determined to do to them, I shall do to you.
NUM 34:1 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
NUM 34:2 Give charge to the sons of Israel! And you shall say to them, You enter into the land of Canaan! This will be to you for an inheritance - the land of Canaan with its boundaries.
NUM 34:3 And it shall be to you the side towards the south from the wilderness of Zin unto being next to Edom - and it shall be to you the boundaries towards the south from the part of the salty sea from the east.
NUM 34:4 And the borders shall encircle you from the south to the ascending of Akrabbim, and shall go by Ennak. And its outer reaches will be towards the south - Kadesh Barnea, and shall come forth unto the property of Addar, and shall go by Azmon.
NUM 34:5 And it shall encircle the borders from Azmon to the rushing stream of Egypt, and the outer reaches will be the sea.
NUM 34:6 And the boundaries of the west will be to you - the great sea shall define the bounds. This will be to you the boundaries of the west.
NUM 34:7 And this will be to you the boundaries towards the north - from the great sea you shall measure out them to yourselves by the mountain.
NUM 34:8 And from mount Hor you shall measure out to yourselves entering into Hamath; and the outer reaches of it will be the borders of Zedad.
NUM 34:9 And the borders shall go forth to Ziphron, and its outer reaches will be Hazer-enan. This will be to you the borders from the north.
NUM 34:10 And you shall measure out to you yourselves the borders of the east from Hazar-enan to Shepham.
NUM 34:11 And the borders shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, from the east by the springs. And the borders shall go down from Beel by the back of the sea of Chinnereth by the east.
NUM 34:12 And the borders shall go down upon the Jordan, and the outer reaches will be the salty sea. This shall be to you the land and its borders round about.
NUM 34:13 And Moses gave charge to the sons of Israel, saying, This is the land which you shall inherit it by lot, in which manner the LORD gave orders to give it to the nine tribes, and the half tribe of Manasseh.
NUM 34:14 For the tribe of the sons of Reuben received it according to the houses of their patrimony, and the tribe of the sons of Gad according to the houses of their patrimony, and the half tribe of Manasseh took their lots.
NUM 34:15 Two tribes and a half tribe took their lots on the other side of the Jordan by Jericho from the south towards the east.
NUM 34:16 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
NUM 34:17 These are the names of the men who shall allot to you the land - Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.
NUM 34:18 And one ruler from out of a tribe you shall take to allot to you the land.
NUM 34:19 And these are the names of the men of the tribe of Judah - Caleb son of Jephunneh.
NUM 34:20 Of the tribe of Simeon - Shemuel son of Ammihud.
NUM 34:21 Of the tribe of Benjamin - Elidad son of Chislon.
NUM 34:22 Of the tribe of Dan - ruler Bukki son of Jogli.
NUM 34:23 Of the sons of Joseph, of the tribe of the sons of Manasseh - ruler Hanniel son of Ephod.
NUM 34:24 Of the tribe of the sons of Ephraim - ruler Kemuel son of Shiphtan.
NUM 34:25 Of the tribe of Zebulun - ruler Elizaphan son of Parnach.
NUM 34:26 Of the tribe of the sons of Issachar - ruler Paltiel son of Azzan.
NUM 34:27 Of the tribe of the sons of Asher - ruler Ahihud son of Shelomi.
NUM 34:28 Of the tribe of Naphtali - ruler Pedahel son of Ammihud.
NUM 34:29 These are the ones whom the LORD gave charge to divide the inheritance to the sons of Israel in the land of Canaan.
NUM 35:1 And the LORD spoke to Moses upon the descent of Moab, by the Jordan, across from Jericho, saying,
NUM 35:2 Give orders to the sons of Israel! And they shall give to the Levites from the lots of their possession cities to dwell in - and the outskirts of the cities round about them you shall give to the Levites.
NUM 35:3 And the cities shall be to dwell in. And their separation offerings of lands will be for their cattle, and all their four-footed animals.
NUM 35:4 And the lands falling in with the cities, which you shall give to the Levites, shall be from the wall of the city and outside - a thousand cubits round about.
NUM 35:5 And you shall measure outside the city the side towards the east - two thousand cubits, and the side towards the south - two thousand cubits; and the side towards the west - two thousand cubits; and the side towards the north - two thousand cubits; and the city between this will be to you, and the adjoining areas of the cities.
NUM 35:6 And the cities which you shall give to the Levites are the six cities of the places of refuge, which you shall give for the one man-slaying to flee there - and in addition to these, forty two cities.
NUM 35:7 All the cities which you shall give to the Levites are forty and eight cities - these and their outskirts.
NUM 35:8 And the cities which you shall give from the possession of the sons of Israel; from the ones having many will be many; and from the ones having less will be less - each according to his inheritance which they shall allot shall give from the cities to the Levites.
NUM 35:9 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
NUM 35:10 Speak to the sons of Israel! And you shall say to them, You are passing over the Jordan into the land of Canaan.
NUM 35:11 And you shall draw apart to you cities for them; it will be places of refuge to you for the man-slayer to flee there - any one striking a soul unintentionally.
NUM 35:12 And they will be cities for you as places of refuge from the one acting as next of kin for blood, that in no way should the one man-slaying die until whenever he should stand before the congregation for judgment.
NUM 35:13 And the cities which you shall appoint - the six cities will be places of refuge to you.
NUM 35:14 Three cities you shall appoint on the other side of the Jordan, and three cities you shall appoint in the land of Canaan.
NUM 35:15 A place of refuge it will be to the sons of Israel, and to the foreigner, and to the sojourner among you. These cities will be for a place of refuge to flee there, to all striking a soul unintentionally.
NUM 35:16 And if by an item of iron one should strike him, and he should come to an end, he is a murderer - unto death let the murderer be put to death!
NUM 35:17 And if by a stone from out of the hand in which one should die by it, then the one who should strike him even he should die, he is a murderer - unto death let the murderer be put to death!
NUM 35:18 And if by an item of wood from out of his hand of which one should die, as he should strike him, and one should die, he is a murderer - unto death the murderer shall die!
NUM 35:19 The one acting as next of kin for blood, this one shall kill the one man-slaying - whenever he meets him, this one shall kill him.
NUM 35:20 And if through hatred he should thrust him through, or should cast upon him any item by ambush, and he should die,
NUM 35:21 or through vehement anger he strikes him by the hand, and he should die - to death let the one striking be put to death, he is a murderer! The one acting as next of kin for the blood shall kill the one man-slaying in the meeting up with him.
NUM 35:22 But if suddenly, he should thrust him through not by hatred, or cast upon him any item, not from ambush,
NUM 35:23 or any stone in which he shall die by it, not knowing, and he should fall upon him, and he should die, but he was not his enemy, nor seeking to do evil against him -
NUM 35:24 then the congregation shall judge between the one striking and between the one acting as next of kin for blood according to these cases.
NUM 35:25 And the congregation shall rescue the one man-slaying from the one acting as next of kin for blood. And the congregation shall restore him into the city of his place of refuge, of which he took refuge. And he shall dwell there until whenever the great priest should die, whom they anointed him with the holy oil.
NUM 35:26 But if by an exit the one man-slaying should come forth from the borders of the city in which he took refuge there,
NUM 35:27 and the one acting as next of kin for blood should find him outside the borders of the city of his refuge, and the one acting as next of kin for blood should slaughter the one man-slaying; he is not liable.
NUM 35:28 For in the city of his refuge let him dwell until the great priest should die! And after the dying of the great priest the one man-slaying will be able to return unto the land of his possession.
NUM 35:29 And these things will be to you for an ordinance of judgment unto your generations in all your dwellings.
NUM 35:30 Every one striking a soul, with witnesses - you shall slaughter the one man-slaying; and one witness shall not witness for a soul to die.
NUM 35:31 And you shall not take ransoms for a soul from the one murdering - the one being liable is to be done away with; for unto death he shall be put to death.
NUM 35:32 And you shall not take ransoms for the one fleeing into a city of the places of refuge, to again dwell in the land, until whenever the great priest should die.
NUM 35:33 And in no way should you pollute with murder the land upon which you dwell upon it; for this blood pollutes the land by murder; and the land shall not be atoned from the blood having been poured out upon it, but it shall be upon the blood of the one pouring it out.
NUM 35:34 And you shall not defile the land upon which you dwell upon it, of which I should encamp among you - for I am the LORD encamping in the midst of the sons of Israel.
NUM 36:1 And came forward the rulers of the fathers' side of the tribes of the sons of Gilead, son of Machir, son of Manasseh, from out of the tribe of the sons of Joseph, and spoke before Moses, and before Eleazar the priest, and before the rulers of the houses of the patrimony of the sons of Israel.
NUM 36:2 And they said, The LORD gave charge to our master to give the land of inheritance by lot to the sons of Israel. And the LORD gave orders to the master to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother to his daughters.
NUM 36:3 And they will be to one of the tribes of the sons of Israel for wives, and their lot shall be removed from out of the possession of our fathers, and thus they shall be added for an inheritance for the tribe in which ever they should become wives - and from out of the lot of our inheritance it shall be removed.
NUM 36:4 And if there should be the release of the sons of Israel, then their inheritance shall be added unto the inheritance of the tribe in which ever the women become wives - and from the inheritance of the tribe of our family their inheritance shall be removed.
NUM 36:5 And Moses gave charge to the sons of Israel, through the order of the LORD, saying, Thus to the tribe of the sons of Joseph, say,
NUM 36:6 This is the saying which the LORD ordered to the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, Of whom ever it is pleasing before them let them be wives, only from out of the people of their father let them be wives!
NUM 36:7 And the inheritance to the sons of Israel shall not be moved around from tribe to tribe - for each in the inheritance of the tribe of his family the sons of Israel shall cleave to.
NUM 36:8 And every daughter acting as next of kin of an inheritance from out of the tribes of the sons of Israel, they shall be wives to one of the ones from out of the people of her father, that the sons of Israel should be acting as next of kin, each in the inheritance of his father.
NUM 36:9 And the lot shall not be moved around from out of one tribe to another tribe, but each unto his inheritance shall the sons of Israel cleave to.
NUM 36:10 In which manner the LORD ordered Moses, thus the daughters of Zelophehad did.
NUM 36:11 And it came to pass Mahlah, Tizrah, and Hoglah, and Milchah, and Noah, daughters of Zelophehad became wives to their cousins of the people of Manasseh of the sons of Joseph.
NUM 36:12 And their inheritance came to the tribe of the people of their father.
NUM 36:13 These are the commandments, and the ordinances, and the judgments, which the LORD gave charge by the hand of Moses to the sons of Israel at the descent of Moab near the Jordan by Jericho.
DEU 1:1 These are the words which Moses spoke to all Israel on the other side of the Jordan in the wilderness, towards the west neighboring the red sea, between Paran, Tophel, and Laban, and Canyons, and Place Abounding in Gold.
DEU 1:2 ( It is a journey eleven days from Horeb by mount Seir unto Kadesh Barnea.)
DEU 1:3 And it came to pass in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, day one of the month, Moses spoke to all the sons of Israel according to all as much as the LORD gave charge to him for them;
DEU 1:4 after the striking of Sihon king of the Amorites dwelling in Heshbon, and Og king of Bashan dwelling in Astaroth and in Edrei.
DEU 1:5 On the other side of the Jordan, in the land of Moab, Moses began to make clear this law, saying,
DEU 1:6 The LORD our God spoke to us in Horeb, saying, Let it be enough to you dwelling in this mountain!
DEU 1:7 You turn and depart, and enter into the mountain of the Amorites, and to all the ones adjacent the wilderness, to the mountain, and the plain, and to the south, and the coast land of the Canaanites, and Antilebanon, unto the river of the great Euphrates!
DEU 1:8 Behold, I have delivered up the land before you! Having entered, inherit the land which I swore by an oath to your fathers, to Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, to give to them and to their seed after them!
DEU 1:9 And I said to you in that time, saying, I will not be able alone to bear you.
DEU 1:10 The LORD your God multiplied you, and behold, you are today as the stars of the heaven in multitude.
DEU 1:11 ( The LORD God of your fathers may he add to you as you are a thousand times more, and bless you in so far as he spoke to you!)
DEU 1:12 How shall I be able alone to bear your toil, and support you, and your disputes?
DEU 1:13 Appoint to yourselves wise men, and having higher knowledge, and discerning among your tribes, and I will ordain them over you as your leaders!
DEU 1:14 And you answered to me, and said, The saying is good which you spoke to do.
DEU 1:15 And I took from out of you wise men, and having knowledge, and discerning, for your tribes. And I ordained them to take the lead over you - commanders of thousands, and commanders of hundreds, and commanders of fifties, and commanders of tens, and judicial recorders for your judges.
DEU 1:16 And I gave charge to your judges in that time, saying, Hold a hearing between your brothers, and judge justly between a man and between his brother, and between the foreigner with him!
DEU 1:17 You shall not discriminate for a person in a judgment; concerning the small and according to the great you shall judge equally. In no way shall you keep back justice by accepting the person of a man, for the judgment is of God. And the matter which ever might be hard for you, you shall bear it to me, and I will hear it.
DEU 1:18 And I gave charge to you at that time all the words which you shall do.
DEU 1:19 And departing from out of Horeb, we went through all that great and dreadful wilderness, which you beheld by the way of the mountain of the Amorite, in so far as the LORD our God gave charge to us; and we came unto Kadesh Barnea.
DEU 1:20 And I said to you, You came unto the mountain of the Amorite, which the LORD our God gives to you.
DEU 1:21 Behold, the LORD your God has delivered up the land to us before your face! Ascending, you inherit it in which manner the LORD God of your fathers spoke to you! You should not fear nor be timid.
DEU 1:22 And you all came forward to me, and said, You should send men in front of us, and let them explore the land for us, and let them announce to us an answer for the way through which we shall ascend by it, and the cities into which we shall enter into them!
DEU 1:23 And the saying was pleasing before me. And I took from out of you twelve men - one man according to tribe.
DEU 1:24 And turning they ascended into the mountain, and came unto Ravine of Cluster, and spied it.
DEU 1:25 And they took in their hands of the fruit of the land, and carried it to you, and said, The land is good which the LORD our God gives to us.
DEU 1:26 And you wanted not to ascend, but you resisted persuasion against the word of the LORD your God.
DEU 1:27 And you complained in your tents, and said, Because the LORD detested us, he led us out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hands of the Amorites, and to utterly destroy us.
