DEU 1:28 Where do we ascend? And our brothers caused our heart to abstain, saying, It is a great and populous nation, and mightier than we; and great cities, and walled unto the heaven; moreover also we saw sons of giants there.
DEU 1:29 And I said to you, Do not be alarmed, nor fear from them!
DEU 1:30 The LORD your God going forth before your face, he will join in making war against them with you, according to all as much as he did for you in the land of Egypt;
DEU 1:31 and in this wilderness, which you beheld how as the LORD your God nurtured you, as if any man might nurture his son, according to all the way into which you were gone, until you came unto this place.
DEU 1:32 And in this word you entrusted not to the LORD your God,
DEU 1:33 who goes forth in front of you in the way, to choose to you a place, guiding you by fire at night, showing to you the way by which you go by it, and with a cloud by day.
DEU 1:34 And the LORD heard the voice of your words, and being provoked swore by an oath, saying,
DEU 1:35 Shall any of these wicked men see this good land which I swore by an oath to their fathers?
DEU 1:36 Except Caleb son of Jephunneh, this one shall see it; and to this one I shall give the land upon which he mounted, and to his sons, because of joining to himself the things of the LORD.
DEU 1:37 And the LORD was enraged at me because of you, saying, Nor should you in any way enter there.
DEU 1:38 Joshua son of Nun, the one standing beside you, this one shall enter there; you strengthen him! for he shall allot it to Israel and your children, which you said to be for ravaging.
DEU 1:39 And every new child, whoever does not know today good or bad, this one shall enter there. And to these I shall give it, and to them they shall inherit it.
DEU 1:40 And you, in turning, encamped in the wilderness, the way near the red sea.
DEU 1:41 And you answered and said to me, We sinned before the LORD our God. We, in ascending, shall wage war according to all as much as the LORD our God gave charge to us. And each taking up the items for his warfare, and gathering together, ascended into the mountain.
DEU 1:42 And the LORD said to me, Say to them, You shall not ascend, nor wage war, for I am not with you; lest you shall be broken before your enemies.
DEU 1:43 And I spoke to you; and you listened not to me, and violated the word of the LORD, and pressing forward ascended unto the mountain.
DEU 1:44 And the Amorite dwelling in that mountain came forth to meet you. And they pursued you as the bees may do, and pierced you from Seir unto Hormah.
DEU 1:45 And sitting, you wept before the LORD your God; and the LORD listened not to your voice, nor took heed to you.
DEU 1:46 And you laid in wait in Kadesh many days, as many days as at some other time you laid in wait.
DEU 2:1 And turning, we departed into the wilderness by way of the red sea, in which manner the LORD spoke to me. And we encircled mount Seir many days.
DEU 2:2 And the LORD said to me,
DEU 2:3 Your encircling this mountain is enough - turn then towards the north!
DEU 2:4 And you give charge to the people, saying, You go through the borders of your brothers, of the sons of Esau dwelling in Seir! And they shall fear you, and shall be exceedingly cautious of you.
DEU 2:5 You shall not join against them for war; for not in any way will I give to you of their land, nor a stool for your foot; for by lot I have given to Esau mount Seir.
DEU 2:6 With silver buy foods from them and eat! And you receive from them a water measure for silver - and you shall drink.
DEU 2:7 For the LORD your God blessed you in every work of your hands. Determine how you went through that great and dreadful wilderness! Behold, forty years the LORD your God was with you; you wanted not of a thing.
DEU 2:8 And we went by our brothers the sons of Esau dwelling in Seir, by the way of the wilderness from Aelon, and from Ezion Gaber; and turning we went by the way of the wilderness of Moab.
DEU 2:9 And the LORD said to me, Do not hate the Moabites, and do not join together against them in war! For in no way will I give to you of their land. For I have given Aroer by lot to the sons of Lot to inherit.
DEU 2:10 The Emims prior laid in wait upon it, a great and populous nation, and strong, as the Anakims.
DEU 2:11 And these shall be considered of the Raphaim as also the Anakims; and the Moabites named them Emims.
DEU 2:12 And in Seir the Horite formerly laid in wait. And the sons of Esau destroyed them, and obliterated them from their face. And they settled in place of them; in which manner Israel did the land of his inheritance, which the LORD gave to them.
DEU 2:13 Now then, I said, Rise up, and depart, and come near the ravine of Zared! And we went by the ravine of Zered.
DEU 2:14 And the days which we passed from Kadesh Barnea, until of which we went by the ravine of Zered - thirty eight years; until of which all the generation of men of war perished, dying from the camp, as the LORD God swore by an oath to them.
DEU 2:15 And the hand of God was upon them, to completely consume them from out of the midst of the camp, until of which they perished.
DEU 2:16 And it came to pass, as soon as all the ones dying fell - men warriors, from out of the midst of the people,
DEU 2:17 that the LORD spoke to me, saying,
DEU 2:18 You shall pass over today the borders of Moab - the Aroer.
DEU 2:19 And you shall lead near the sons of Ammon. Do not hate them, nor join against them in war! For not in any way will I give from the land of the sons of Ammon to you by lot - for to the sons of Lot I have given it by lot.
DEU 2:20 It shall be considered land of Raphaim, for even the Raphaim formerly dwelt upon it. And the Ammonites named them Zummim -
DEU 2:21 a great and populous nation, and mightier than you, as also the Anakims. And the LORD destroyed them before their face; and they inherited them, and were settled there in place of them until this day,
DEU 2:22 even as they did inherit the sons of Esau dwelling in Seir, in which manner he obliterated the Horite from their face; and they inherited them, and were settled in place of them until this day.
DEU 2:23 And the Hivites dwelling in Aseroth unto Gaza, and the Cappadocians coming forth from out of Cappadocia, obliterated them, and were settled in place of them.
DEU 2:24 Now then, rise up and depart, and go by the ravine of Arnon! Behold, I have delivered up into your hands Sihon king of Heshbon the Amorite and his land. Commence to inherit it! Join against him in war!
DEU 2:25 On this day commence to give the trembling of you and the fear of you upon the face of all the nations underneath the heaven! Whoever hearing your name shall be disturbed, and shall have pangs of anguish before your face.
DEU 2:26 And I sent ambassadors from out of the wilderness of Kedemoth to Sihon king of Heshbon with peaceable words, saying,
DEU 2:27 I will go through your land. I will go in the journey, I will not turn aside right nor left.
DEU 2:28 You shall give to me foods for silver, and I shall eat; and you shall give water to me for silver, and I shall drink; only that I shall go by on the feet,
DEU 2:29 (as the sons of Esau dwelling in Seir did to me, and the Moabites dwelling in Ar;) until whenever I should go by the Jordan into the land which the LORD our God gives us.
DEU 2:30 And Sihon king of Heshbon wanted not us to go by through his land - for the LORD our God hardened his spirit, and strengthened his heart, that he should be delivered up into your hands, as in this day.
DEU 2:31 And the LORD said to me, Behold, I have begun to deliver up before your face Sihon king of Heshbon the Amorite, and his land. Commence to inherit his land!
DEU 2:32 And came forth Sihon king of Heshbon to meet us, he and all his people, for war at Jahaz.
DEU 2:33 And the LORD our God delivered him before our face, into our hands; and we struck him, and his sons, and all his people.
DEU 2:34 And we held all his cities in that time, and utterly destroyed every city - next also their women and their children we did not leave behind for taking alive.
DEU 2:35 Except the cattle we despoiled for ourselves, and the spoils of the cities we took,
DEU 2:36 From out of Aroer, which is by the bank of the rushing stream Arnon, and the city being in the ravine, and unto mount Gilead, there was not a city which evaded us - the LORD our God delivered up all into our hands.
DEU 2:37 Except in the land of the sons of Ammon we did not draw near (all the parts falling in with the stream Jabbok, and the cities in the mountainous area) in so far as the LORD our God gave charge to us.
DEU 3:1 And turning, we ascended the way into Bashan. And came forth Og king of Bashan to meet us, he and all his people for war at Edrei.
DEU 3:2 And the LORD said to me, You should not fear him - for into your hands I will deliver him, and all his people, and all his land. And you shall do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon.
DEU 3:3 And the LORD our God delivered him into our hands - even Og king of Bashan, and all his people. And we struck him until there was not left behind any of his seed.
DEU 3:4 And we held all of his cities in that time; there was not a city which we did not take from them - sixty cities, all the places round about Argob, of king Og in Bashan.
DEU 3:5 All these cities were fortified with high walls, gates, and bars; besides the cities of the Perizzites - very many.
DEU 3:6 We utterly destroyed them as we did Sihon king of Heshbon. And we utterly destroyed every city - next also the women and the children,
DEU 3:7 and all the cattle; and the spoils of the cities we despoiled for ourselves.
DEU 3:8 And we took in that time the land from out of the hands of the two kings of the Amorites, who were on the other side of the Jordan - from the rushing stream of Arnon unto mount Hermon.
DEU 3:9 (The Phoenicians named Hermon - Sirion; but the Amorite named it Shenir;)
DEU 3:10 all the cities of Misor, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, unto Salchah and Edrei - cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
DEU 3:11 For only Og king of Bashan was left from the Rephaim; behold his bed is a bed of iron; behold this is in the Akra of the sons of Ammon - nine cubits was the length of it, and four cubits the breadth of it, in the cubit of a man.
DEU 3:12 And that land we inherited in that time from Aroer, which is by the bank of the stream Arnon, and the half of the mountain of Gilead. And his cities I gave to Reuben and Gad.
DEU 3:13 And the remainder of Gilead, and all Bashan - the kingdom of Og, I gave to the half tribe of Manasseh; and all the place round about Argob - all that Bashan shall be considered the land of Raphaim.
DEU 3:14 And Jair, son of Manasseh, took all the place round about Argob unto the borders of the Geshurites and Maachathites; and he named them after his name - Bashan Havoth Jair, until this day.
DEU 3:15 And to Machir I gave Gilead.
DEU 3:16 And to Reuben and to Gad I gave from Gilead unto the rushing stream Arnon, between the rushing stream's border and unto the Jabbok - and the rushing streams are the border to the sons of Ammon.
DEU 3:17 And the wilderness and the Jordan are the border from Chinnereth, and unto the sea of the wilderness - the salty sea by Ashdoth of Pisgah from the east.
DEU 3:18 And I gave charge to you at that time, saying, The LORD your God has given to you this land by lot. Arming yourselves, go forth before the face of your brothers of the sons of Israel - every one able!
DEU 3:19 Except your wives, and your children, and your cattle, (for I know there are many cattle to you,) let dwell at your cities in which I gave to you,
DEU 3:20 until whenever the LORD your God should rest your brothers, as also you, and they should have inherited also themselves the land which the LORD your God gives to you on the other side of the Jordan - then each shall turn back to his inheritance, which I have given to you.
DEU 3:21 And to Joshua I gave charge at that time, saying, Your eyes have seen all as much as the LORD our God did to these two kings - so the LORD shall do to all the kingdoms unto which you passed over there.
DEU 3:22 You shall not have fear of them - for the LORD our God himself shall wage war for you.
DEU 3:23 And I besought the LORD in that time, saying,
DEU 3:24 O Lord, O LORD, you began to show to your attendant your strength, and your power, and the fortified hand, and the high arm. For what God is in the heaven or upon the earth who shall do as you did yourself, according to your works, and according to your strength?
DEU 3:25 Passing over then, I will see this good land - the one being on the other side of the Jordan; this good mountain, and the Antilebanon.
DEU 3:26 And the LORD overlooked me because of you, and listened not to me. And the LORD said to me, Let it be enough for you to not add yet to speak to me on this matter!
DEU 3:27 Ascend upon the top of the dressed stone, and lift up your eyes towards the west, and the north, and the south, and the east, and behold with your eyes! for you shall not pass over this Jordan.
DEU 3:28 And you give charge to Joshua, and strengthen him, and comfort him - for this one shall pass over before the face of this people, and he shall allot to them the land which you have seen!
DEU 3:29 And we laid in wait in a grove in the vicinity of the house of Peor.
DEU 4:1 And now, O Israel, hear the ordinances and the judgments, as many as I teach you today to do, that you should live, and manifoldly multiply! And entering you should inherit the land which the LORD God of your fathers gives to you.
DEU 4:2 You shall not add to the saying which I give charge to you, and you shall not remove from it. Guard the commandments of the LORD your God, as many as I give charge to you today!
DEU 4:3 Your eyes have seen all as many things as the LORD our God did to Baal-peor. For every man, whoever went after Baal-peor, the LORD your God obliterated him from out of you.
DEU 4:4 But you, the ones joining with the LORD your God, all live today.
DEU 4:5 Behold, I have shown to you ordinances and judgments, as the LORD my God gave charge to me, to do thus for you in the land into which you enter there to inherit it.
DEU 4:6 And you shall guard and shall do; for this is your wisdom and your understanding before all the nations, as many as should hear all these ordinances. Then they shall say, Behold, this great nation is a wise and intelligent people.
DEU 4:7 For what great nation in which there is to it a God near to them as the LORD our God is in all things in which we should call upon him?
DEU 4:8 And what great nation in which there is to it just ordinances and judgments according to all this law which I give before you today?
DEU 4:9 Take heed to yourself and guard your life exceedingly! You should not forget all the words which your eyes have seen, and let them not leave from your heart all the days of your life! And instruct your sons, and the sons of your sons!
DEU 4:10 especially the day which you stood in the presence of the LORD your God in Horeb, in the day of the assembly. For the LORD said to me, Hold an assembly to me, and let the people hear my words, so that they should learn to fear me all the days which they live upon the earth, and that they should have taught their sons!
DEU 4:11 And you came forward and stood under the mountain; and the mountain burned fire unto the heaven - darkness, dimness, and a storm.
DEU 4:12 And the LORD spoke to you in the mountain from out of the midst of the fire. A voice of utterances you heard, and a representation you beheld not - but only a voice.
DEU 4:13 And he announced to you his covenant, which he gave charge to you to observe - the ten discourses; and he wrote them upon two tablets of stone.
DEU 4:14 And the LORD gave charge to me in that time to teach you ordinances and judgments, for you to do them upon the land into which you enter there to inherit it.
DEU 4:15 And you shall guard exceedingly your lives, that you do not behold any representation in the day in which the LORD spoke to you in Horeb, in the mountain from out of the midst of the fire -
DEU 4:16 lest you should act lawlessly, and make to yourselves a carving representation, any image, a representation of a male or female;
DEU 4:17 a representation of any beast being upon the earth; a representation of any feathered bird which flies under the heaven;
DEU 4:18 a representation of any reptile which crawls upon the earth; a representation of any fish, as many as are in the waters underneath the earth;
DEU 4:19 and lest at any time looking up into the heaven, and beholding the sun, and the moon, and the stars, and all the cosmos of the heaven wandering, you should do obeisance to them, and you should serve to them, which the LORD your God bestowed them to all the nations underneath the heaven.
DEU 4:20 But the LORD God took you, and led you from out of the furnace of iron, out of Egypt, to be to him a hereditary people, as in this day.
DEU 4:21 And the LORD God was enraged with me on account of the things having been said by you. And he swore by an oath that I should not pass over this Jordan, and that I should not enter into the good land which the LORD your God gives to you by lot.
DEU 4:22 For I die in this land, and I shall not pass over this Jordan. But you shall pass over and shall inherit this good land.
DEU 4:23 Take heed to yourselves, lest at any time you should forget the covenant of the LORD your God, which he ordained with you, and you should make to you yourselves a carving representation of all of which the LORD your God gave orders to you not to do!
DEU 4:24 For the LORD your God is a consuming fire - a jealous God.
DEU 4:25 And if you should procreate sons, and sons of your sons, and you should pass time upon the land, and you should act lawlessly, and you should make a carving representation of any thing, and you should do the wicked thing in the presence of the LORD our God to provoke him to anger,
DEU 4:26 I call to testify against you today both the heaven and the earth, that by destruction you shall be destroyed from the land in which you pass over the Jordan there to inherit it. You shall not delay long days upon it, but by obliteration you shall be obliterated.
DEU 4:27 And the LORD shall disseminate you among all the nations, and there shall be left few of you in number among all the nations into which the LORD shall bring you there.
DEU 4:28 And you shall serve there other gods, works of the hands of man - wood and stones, which see not, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.
DEU 4:29 And you shall seek after there the LORD your God, and you shall find him whenever you should seek after him with your entire heart, and with your entire soul, in your affliction.
DEU 4:30 And all these words shall find you at the last of the days, and you shall turn towards the LORD your God, and shall hearken to his voice.
DEU 4:31 For God - the LORD your God is pitying and merciful. He will not abandon you, nor in any way will he obliterate you; he will not forget the covenant of your fathers, which he swore by an oath to them.
DEU 4:32 Ask former days having taken place prior of you, from the day of which God created man upon the earth, and upon the one extremity of the heaven unto the other extremity of the heaven! Has anything taken place according to this great thing - if such was heard?
DEU 4:33 If a nation has heard the voice of the living God speaking in the midst of the fire, in which manner you have heard, and lived?
DEU 4:34 if God tested, entering to take to himself a nation from out of the midst of a nation, for a test; and in signs, and in miracles, and by war, and by a fortified hand, and with a high arm, and in great visions, according to all as much as the LORD our God did in Egypt, in the presence of your seeing;
DEU 4:35 so as to see yourself that the LORD your God - he is God, and there is not yet one besides him?
DEU 4:36 From out of the heaven he made his voice audible to you, to correct you. And upon the earth he showed to you his great fire; and his discourses you heard from out of the midst of the fire.
DEU 4:37 It is on account of his loving your fathers, that he chose their seed after them - you. And he led you himself by his great strength from out of Egypt;
DEU 4:38 to utterly destroy great and stronger nations than you before your face; to bring you, and to give to you their land to inherit, as you have today.
DEU 4:39 And you shall know today, and shall turn your mind, that the LORD your God - he is God, in the heaven upward, and upon the earth below, and there is not any besides him.
DEU 4:40 And you shall guard his commandments, and his ordinances, as many as I give charge to you today, that it should be good to you, and to your sons after you, so that you should be many days upon the earth, of which the LORD your God gives to you all the days.
DEU 4:41 Then Moses separated three cities on the other side of the Jordan of the east sun;
DEU 4:42 for the man-killer to flee there - who ever should have slaughtered the neighbor not knowingly, and this one not having detested him before yesterday and the third day before. And he shall take refuge in one of these cities, and he shall live -
DEU 4:43 Bezer in the wilderness, in the land in the plain of Reuben; and Ramoth in Gilead to the of Gadites; and Golan in Bashan to the Manassites.
DEU 4:44 This is the law which Moses placed before the sons of Israel.
DEU 4:45 These are the testimonies, and the ordinances, and the judgments, as many as Moses spoke to the sons of Israel in the wilderness, in their coming forth from out of the land of Egypt,
DEU 4:46 on the other side of the Jordan, in the ravine near the house of Peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon, who Moses struck, and the sons of Israel, in their coming forth from out of the land of Egypt.
DEU 4:47 And they inherited his land, and the land of Og king of Bashan, two kings of the Amorites, who were on the other side of the Jordan, according to the rising of the sun -
DEU 4:48 from Aroer, which is upon the bank of the rushing stream Arnon, and upon the mountain of Sion, which is Hermon,
DEU 4:49 all the wilderness on the other side of the Jordan according to the rising of the sun by Asedoth - the one of dressed stone.
DEU 5:1 And Moses called all Israel, and said to them, Hear O Israel, the ordinances and the judgments, as many as I speak in your ears in this day! And you shall learn them, and guard to do them.
DEU 5:2 The LORD your God ordained to you a covenant in Horeb.
DEU 5:3 Not with your fathers the LORD ordained this covenant, but only with you - even you here all living today.
DEU 5:4 Face to face the LORD spoke to you in the mountain from out of the midst of the fire.
DEU 5:5 And I stood between the LORD and you in that time, to announce to you the sayings of the LORD, (for you were in fear from before the fire, and you did not ascend unto the mountain,) saying,
DEU 5:6 I am the LORD your God, the one leading you from out of the land of Egypt, from out of the house of slavery.
DEU 5:7 There shall not be other gods to you before my face.
DEU 5:8 You shall not make to yourself a carving, nor any representation, as many as are in the heaven upward, and as many as are in the earth below, and as many as are in the waters underneath the earth.
DEU 5:9 You shall not do obeisance to them, nor in any way serve to them. For I am the LORD your God, a jealous God, repaying the sins of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation to the ones detesting me,
DEU 5:10 and executing mercy to thousands loving me, and to the ones keeping my orders.
DEU 5:11 You shall not take the name of the LORD your God in vain - for not in any way shall the LORD your God cleanse the one taking his name in vain.
DEU 5:12 Guard the day of the Sabbaths to sanctify it, in which manner the LORD your God gave charge to you!
DEU 5:13 Six days you shall work, and do all your works.
DEU 5:14 But the seventh day is a Sabbath to the LORD your God. You shall not do on it any work - you, and your son, and your daughter, your manservant, and your maidservant, your ox, and your beast of burden, and every beast of yours, and the foreigner sojourning among you; that your manservant and your maidservant should have cause to rest as also you.
DEU 5:15 And you shall remember that you were a servant in the land of Egypt, and the LORD your God led you from there by a fortified hand and with a high arm. On account of this the LORD your God gave orders to you so as for you to guard the day of the Sabbaths, and to sanctify it.
DEU 5:16 Esteem your father and your mother in which manner the LORD your God gave charge to you, that good should be to you, and that you may be a long time upon the earth of which the LORD your God gives to you!
DEU 5:17 You shall not murder.
DEU 5:18 You shall not commit adultery.
DEU 5:19 You shall not steal.
DEU 5:20 You shall not falsely witness against your neighbor as a lying witness.
DEU 5:21 You shall not desire the wife of your neighbor. You shall not desire the house of your neighbor, nor his field, nor his manservant, nor his maidservant, nor his ox, nor his beast of burden, nor any beast of his, nor any thing as much as is of your neighbor.
DEU 5:22 These are the discourses the LORD spoke to all your congregation in the mountain from out of the midst of the fire, darkness, dimness, storm, a great voice - and he added not any more. And he wrote them upon two tablets of stone, and gave them to me.
DEU 5:23 And it came to pass, as you heard the voice from out of the midst of the fire, and the mountain burned fire, and there came forward to me all the leaders of your tribes, and your council of elders,
DEU 5:24 that you said, Behold, the LORD our God showed to us his glory, and his voice we hear from out of the midst of the fire. In this day we beheld that God shall speak to man, and he shall live.
DEU 5:25 And now lest at any time we die, for this great fire shall completely consume us, if we ourselves should have added to hear the voice of the LORD our God any more - then we shall die.
DEU 5:26 For what flesh who heard the voice of the living God speaking from out of the midst of the fire shall live even as we?
DEU 5:27 You approach, and hear all as much as the LORD our God should say to you! And you shall speak to us all whatever as much as the LORD our God should speak to you - and we will hear, and we will do.
DEU 5:28 And the LORD heard the voice of your words speaking to me. And the LORD said to me, I heard the voice of the words of this people, as many as they spoke to you rightly, all as many as they spoke.
DEU 5:29 Who shall give their heart to be thus in them, so as to fear me, and to guard my commandments all the days, that good might be to them, and to their sons through the eon.
DEU 5:30 Proceed! Say to them, You return to your houses!
DEU 5:31 But you here, stand with me, and I shall speak to you all the commandments, and the ordinances, and the judgments, as many as you shall teach them! And let them do thus in the land which I give to them by lot!
DEU 5:32 And you shall guard to do in which manner the LORD your God gave charge to you, to not turn aside right nor left,
DEU 5:33 but according to every way which the LORD your God gave charge to you to go by it, so that he should rest you, and good might be to you, and you should prolong your days upon the land which you shall inherit.
DEU 6:1 And these are the commandments, and the ordinances, and the judgments, as many as the LORD our God gave charge to teach you, to do thus in the land into which you enter there to inherit it.
DEU 6:2 That you should fear the LORD our God, to guard all his ordinances and his commandments, which I give charge to you today - you, and your sons, and the sons of your sons, all the days of your life, that you should prolong your days.
DEU 6:3 And hear, O Israel, and guard to do! so that good might be to you, and that you should multiply exceedingly, just as the LORD God of your fathers spoke to give to you a land flowing milk and honey. And these are the ordinances, and the judgments, as many as the LORD gave charge to the sons of Israel in the wilderness, in their coming forth from out of the land of Egypt.
DEU 6:4 Hear, O Israel! The LORD our God is one Lord.
DEU 6:5 And you shall love the LORD your God with your entire heart, and with your entire soul, and with your entire power.
DEU 6:6 And these discourses as many as I give charge to you today will be in your heart, and in your soul.
DEU 6:7 And you shall assist your sons with them, and you shall speak of them sitting down in your house, and going in the way, and lying in bed, and arising.
DEU 6:8 And you shall affix them for a sign upon your hand, and it shall be unshaken before your eyes.
DEU 6:9 And you shall write them upon the lintels of your houses, and your gates.
DEU 6:10 And it will be whenever the LORD your God shall bring you into the land which he swore by an oath to your fathers, to Abraham, and to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give to you the great and good cities which you did not build;
DEU 6:11 houses full of all good things which you did not fill up; pits of quarrying which you did not quarry; vineyards and olive groves which you did not plant; and eating and being filled up.
DEU 6:12 Take heed to yourself that you should not forget the LORD your God, the one leading you from out of the land of Egypt, from out of a house of slavery!
DEU 6:13 You shall fear the LORD your God, and to him only you shall serve, and to him you shall cleave, and by his name you shall swear an oath by.
DEU 6:14 You shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the nations surrounding you;
DEU 6:15 (for the LORD your God is a jealous God among you,) lest being provoked to anger the LORD your God should be enraged against you, and should utterly destroy you from the face of the earth.
DEU 6:16 You shall not put to test the LORD your God, in which manner you put him to test in Test.
DEU 6:17 By guarding, you shall guard the commandments of the LORD your God, and his testimonies, and his ordinances, as many as he gave charge to you.
DEU 6:18 And you shall do the pleasing and the good before the LORD your God; that it should be good to you, and you should enter, and should inherit the good land which the LORD swore by an oath to your fathers,
DEU 6:19 to drive out all your enemies before your face, as the LORD spoke.
DEU 6:20 And it will be whenever your son should ask you tomorrow, saying, What are the testimonies, and the ordinances, and the judgments, as many as the LORD our God gave charge to us?
DEU 6:21 And you shall say to your son, We were servants to Pharaoh in the land of Egypt, and the LORD led us from there by a fortified hand and with a high arm.
DEU 6:22 And the LORD executed signs and great and severe miracles in Egypt, to Pharaoh, and to his house in our presence.
DEU 6:23 And the LORD led us from there, that he should bring us, to give to us this land which the LORD our God swore by an oath to our fathers to give to us.
DEU 6:24 And the LORD gave charge to us to do all these ordinances, to fear the LORD our God, that good might be to us all the days, that we should live as even today.
DEU 6:25 And mercy will be to us, if we guard to do all the commandments of this law before the LORD our God, as he gave charge to us.
DEU 7:1 And it will be in the LORD your God bringing you into the land into which you enter there to inherit it, and he shall lift away great and numerous nations from your presence - the Hittite, and the Girgashite, and the Amorite, and Canaanite, and Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite - seven great and numerous nations, even stronger than you,
DEU 7:2 and the LORD your God shall deliver them into your hands, that you shall strike them. To extinction you shall remove them. You shall not ordain with them a covenant, nor in any way should you show mercy unto them;
DEU 7:3 nor contract a marriage with them. You shall not give your daughter to his son, and his daughter you shall not take to your son.
DEU 7:4 For your son will leave from me, and shall serve other gods; and the LORD shall be provoked to anger in rage against you, and shall utterly destroy you quickly.
DEU 7:5 But thus you shall do to them - you shall demolish their shrines, and you shall break their monuments, and you shall cut down their sacred groves, and shall incinerate their carvings of the gods by fire.
DEU 7:6 For you are a holy people to the LORD your God. And the LORD your God preferred you to be to him a prized people from all the nations, as many as are upon the face of the earth.
DEU 7:7 Not because you were more numerous than all the nations, did the LORD prefer you, and chose you; (for you are ones very few of all the nations;)
DEU 7:8 but because the LORD loved you; and to observe the oath which he swore to your fathers, the LORD led you by a fortified hand and with a high arm, and ransomed you from out of a house of slavery, from out of the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
DEU 7:9 And you shall know that the LORD your God - this one is God, the trustworthy God, the one guarding the covenant and mercy to the ones loving him, and to the ones guarding his commandments into a thousand generations;
DEU 7:10 and repaying to the ones detesting his face, to utterly destroy them. And he shall not be slow to the ones detesting; by person he shall render what is due to them.
DEU 7:11 And you shall guard the commandments, and the ordinances, and these judgments, as many as I give charge to you today to do.
DEU 7:12 And it will be when ever you should hear these ordinances, and should have guarded, and should have done them, that the LORD your God will protect the covenant with you, and the mercy which he swore by an oath to your fathers.
DEU 7:13 And he will love you, and shall bless you, and shall multiply you, and shall bless the progeny of your belly, and the fruit of your land; your grain, and your wine, and your olive oil, the herds of your oxen, and the flocks of your sheep, upon the land which the LORD swore by an oath to your fathers to give to you.
DEU 7:14 Blessed you will be of all the nations. There will not be among you barren nor sterile, even among your cattle.
DEU 7:15 And the LORD shall remove from you every infirmity. And all the severe diseases of Egypt which you knew, he will not place upon you. And he will place them upon all the ones detesting you.
DEU 7:16 And you shall eat all the spoils of the nations which the LORD your God gives to you. You shall not spare your eye over them, and no way should you serve to their gods; for this shall be an impediment to you.
DEU 7:17 But if you should say in your mind that, This nation is great; or, I, how shall I be able to utterly destroy them?
DEU 7:18 You shall not fear them. By remembering, you shall remember as much as the LORD your God did to Pharaoh, and to all the Egyptians;
DEU 7:19 the great tests which you beheld with your eyes; the signs and those great miracles; the fortified hand and the high arm. As the LORD your God led you, so the LORD your God will do to all the nations which you fear from their face.
DEU 7:20 And the LORD your God will send the swarms of wasps unto them, until whenever the ones being left behind shall be obliterated, and the ones being hidden from you.
DEU 7:21 You shall not be pierced from their face, for the LORD your God among you is a God great and fortified.
DEU 7:22 And the LORD your God shall consume these nations from your face by little and little. You shall not be able to completely consume them quickly, that the land might not become wilderness, and the wild beasts should multiply upon you.
DEU 7:23 And the LORD your God delivered them into your hands, and you shall destroy them in a great destruction, until whenever you should utterly destroy them.
DEU 7:24 And he shall deliver up their kings into your hands. And he shall destroy their name under the heaven. Not shall anyone withstand against your face until whenever you should have utterly destroyed them.
DEU 7:25 The carvings of their gods you shall incinerate in fire. You shall not desire silver nor gold from them, to take to yourself, lest you should be at fault because of it - for it is an abomination to the LORD your God.
DEU 7:26 And you shall not carry an abomination into your house that you shall be anathema as this thing. Loathing, you shall loathe, and as an abomination you shall abhor it, for it is anathema.
DEU 8:1 All the commandments which I give charge to you today you shall guard to do, that you should live and manifoldly multiply, and should enter and should inherit the land which the LORD swore by an oath to your fathers.
DEU 8:2 And you shall remember the whole journey which the LORD your God led you this fortieth year in the wilderness, how he should afflict you, and should test you, and should determine the things in your heart, if you shall guard his commandments, or not.
DEU 8:3 And he afflicted you, and caused you to hunger, and fed you the manna which your fathers had not known; that he should announce to you that man shall not live by bread alone; but by every word going forth through the mouth of God shall a man live.
DEU 8:4 Your garments did not grow old from you; your feet were not calloused - behold, for forty years.
DEU 8:5 And you shall know in your heart, that as if any man should correct his son, so the LORD your God corrects you.
DEU 8:6 And you shall guard the commandments of the LORD your God, to go in his ways, and to fear him.
DEU 8:7 For the LORD your God shall bring you into a land good and abundant, of which are rushing streams of waters, and springs of the deeps going forth through the plains, and through the mountains.
DEU 8:8 A land of wheat, and barley, grapevines, fig-trees, pomegranates - a land of olive oil, and honey.
DEU 8:9 A land upon which you shall eat your bread not with poorness, and you shall not be in want upon it. A land of which its stones are iron, and from out of its mountains you shall mine brass.
DEU 8:10 And you shall eat and shall be filled up, and shall bless the LORD your God upon the good land of which he has given to you.
DEU 8:11 Take heed to yourself! You should not forget the LORD your God, so as to not guard his commandments, and his judgments, and his ordinances, as many as I give charge to you today.
DEU 8:12 Lest having eaten, and being filled up, and having built good houses, and dwelling in them,
DEU 8:13 and your oxen and your sheep having been multiplied to you, and silver and gold having been multiplied to you, and all as much as to you shall be multiplying,
DEU 8:14 you should be raised up high in your heart, and should forget the LORD your God, the one leading you from out of the land of Egypt, from out of the house of slavery;
DEU 8:15 the one leading you through the great and dreadful wilderness, that one of which has the biting serpent, and scorpion, and thirst, of which there was not water; the one leading to you a spring of water from out of chiseled rock;
DEU 8:16 the one feeding you the manna in the wilderness, which you had not known, and your fathers did not know; that he should afflict you, and that he should put you to the test, and do good unto you upon the last of your days;
DEU 8:17 and lest you should say in your heart, My strength and the might of my hand produced to me this great ability.
DEU 8:18 And you shall remember the LORD your God; for he gives to you strength to produce the ability, that he should establish his covenant which he swore by an oath to your fathers as today.
DEU 8:19 And it will be, if in forgetfulness you should forget the LORD your God, and should go after other gods, and should serve to them, and should do obeisance to them, I testify to you today on both heaven and the earth, that by destruction you shall be destroyed.
DEU 8:20 As also the remaining nations, as many as the LORD destroys before your face, so shall you be destroyed; because you hearkened not to the voice of the LORD your God.
DEU 9:1 Hear, O Israel! You pass over today the Jordan, to enter to inherit great and stronger nations than you; great and walled cities unto the heaven;
DEU 9:2 a people great and populous and tall - sons of Anak, whom you know, and you have heard said, Who can withstand against the face of the sons of Anak?
DEU 9:3 And you shall know today that the LORD your God, this one shall go forth before your face - he is a consuming fire. This one shall utterly destroy them, and this one shall turn them away before your presence. And he shall utterly destroy them, and will destroy them quickly - just as the LORD said to you.
DEU 9:4 You should not say in your heart by the complete consuming by the LORD your God of these nations before your face, saying, Because of my righteousness the LORD brought me to inherit this good land. But on account of the impiety of these nations the LORD will utterly destroy them before your face.
DEU 9:5 Not because of your righteousness, nor because of the sacredness of your heart, do you enter to inherit their land; but because of the impiety of these nations the LORD shall utterly destroy them from your presence, and that he should establish the covenant which the LORD swore by an oath to your fathers - to Abraham, and to Isaac, and to Jacob.
DEU 9:6 And you shall know today that not through your works of righteousness the LORD your God gives to you this good land to inherit - for you are a hard-necked people.
DEU 9:7 Remember! you should not forget as much as you provoked the LORD your God in the wilderness; from which day you came forth from out of the land of Egypt, until you came into this place - by resisting persuasion you completed the things against the LORD.
DEU 9:8 And in Horeb you provoked the LORD, and the LORD was enraged with you to utterly destroy you.
DEU 9:9 Of my ascending into the mountain to take the tablets of stone, tablets of covenant of which the LORD ordained for you; and I was occupied in the mountain forty days and forty nights - I did not eat bread, and I did not drink water.
DEU 9:10 And the LORD gave to me the two tablets of stone being written by the finger of God. And upon them he had written all the words of which the LORD spoke to you in the mountain, from out of the midst of the fire, in the day of assembly.
DEU 9:11 And it came to pass through forty days, and through forty nights, that the LORD gave to me the two tablets of stone - tablets of covenant.
DEU 9:12 And the LORD said to me, Arise, go down quickly from here! for your people acted lawlessly, of whom you led out from out of the land of Egypt. They violated quickly from out of the way of which you gave charge to them - they made to themselves a molten casting.
DEU 9:13 And the LORD said to me, saying, I have spoken to you once and twice, saying, I have seen this people; and behold, it is a hard-necked people.
DEU 9:14 Allow me to utterly destroy them! and I will wipe away their name from beneath the heaven. And I will make you into a great and strong nation, and more numerous rather than this one.
DEU 9:15 And turning, I went down from out of the mountain, and the mountain burned fire; and the two tablets of the covenant were in my two hands.
DEU 9:16 And seeing that you sinned before the LORD your God, and made to yourselves a calf molten image, and transgressed quickly from out of the way which the LORD gave charge to you;
DEU 9:17 that taking hold of the two tablets, I tossed them from my two hands, and I broke them before you.
DEU 9:18 And I beseeched before the LORD a second time, as also even formerly, forty days and forty nights. Bread I did not eat, and water I did not drink, on account of all your sins which you sinned, to do the wicked thing before the LORD God, to provoke him.
DEU 9:19 And I am frightened on account of the rage and the anger that the LORD was provoked by you to utterly destroy you. And the LORD hearkened to me, even at that time.
DEU 9:20 And the LORD was enraged exceedingly against Aaron to utterly destroy him. And I made a vow also for Aaron in that time.
DEU 9:21 And your sin, in which you made the calf, I took and incinerated it in fire, and cut it down, and ground it down exceeding, until of which it became fine, and became as a cloud of dust. And I tossed the dust into the rushing stream coming down from out of the mountain.
DEU 9:22 And in Combustion, and in Test, and in Tombs of Desire, you were provoking the LORD your God.
DEU 9:23 And when the LORD sent you from out of Kadesh Barnea, saying, Ascend and inherit the land which I give to you! That you resisted persuasion in the word of the LORD your God, and you trusted not in him, and listened not to his voice.
DEU 9:24 You were resisting the things towards the LORD from which day he was made known to you.
DEU 9:25 And I beseeched before the LORD forty days and forty nights. Many things I beseeched - for the LORD said he would utterly destroy you.
DEU 9:26 And I made a vow to God, and said, O Lord, LORD, you should not utterly destroy your people and your inheritance, whom you ransomed in your great strength, of whom you led out of the land of Egypt by your fortified hand, and by your high arm.
DEU 9:27 Remember Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, your attendants, to whom you swore by an oath according to yourself! You should not look upon the hardness of this people, and upon their acts of impiety, and their sins;
DEU 9:28 lest the ones dwelling the land from where you led us from there should say, saying, Because the LORD was not able to bring them into the land which he said to them, and because of the LORD detesting them, he led them in the wilderness to kill them.
DEU 9:29 And these are your people and your inheritance, of whom you led out of the land of Egypt by your great strength and by your high arm.
DEU 10:1 In that time the LORD said to me, You dress stone for yourself - two tablets of stone as the first! And ascend to me into the mountain, and make for yourself a wooden ark!
DEU 10:2 And I will write upon the tablets the words which were on the first tablets which you broke, and you shall put them into the ark.
DEU 10:3 And I made the ark from out of incorruptible wood. And I dressed the two stone tablets as the first. And I ascended into the mountain, and the two tablets were upon my two hands.
DEU 10:4 And he wrote upon the tablets according to the first writing - the ten words which the LORD spoke to you in the mountain from out of the midst of the fire in the day of the gathering. And the LORD gave them to me.
DEU 10:5 And turning, I went down from out of the mountain, and I put the tablets into the ark which I made; and they were there as the LORD gave charge to me.
DEU 10:6 And the sons of Israel departed from out of Beeroth of the sons of Jaakan to Mosera. There Aaron died, and he was entombed there. And Eleazar his son officiated as priest instead of him.
DEU 10:7 From there they departed into Gudgodah; and from Gudgodah to Jotbath, a land of rushing streams of waters.
DEU 10:8 In that time the LORD separated the tribe of Levi to lift the ark of the covenant of the LORD, to stand before the LORD to officiate, and to invoke upon his name until this day.
DEU 10:9 On account of this there is not to the Levites a portion or lot among their brothers - the LORD himself is his lot, as the LORD your God told them.
DEU 10:10 And I stayed in the mountain forty days and forty nights - and the LORD listened to me. And in that time the LORD did not want to utterly destroy you.
DEU 10:11 And the LORD said to me, Proceed, depart before this people, and let them enter and inherit the land which I swore by an oath to their fathers to give to them!
DEU 10:12 And now, Israel, what does the LORD your God ask from you, but only to fear the LORD your God, and to go in all his ways, and to love him, and to serve the LORD your God from out of your entire heart, and from out of your entire soul,
DEU 10:13 to guard the commandments of the LORD your God, and his ordinances, as many as I give charge to you today, that it might be good to you.
DEU 10:14 Behold, the heaven is of the LORD your God, and the heaven of the heaven, the earth and all as much as is in it.
DEU 10:15 Except concerning your fathers, the LORD preferred to love them, and he chose their seed after them - you, from all the nations according to this day.
DEU 10:16 And you shall circumcise the hardness of your heart, and you shall not harden your neck any longer.
DEU 10:17 For the LORD your God, he is God of gods, and Lord of lords, the great and strong and fearful God, who does not marvel over a person, nor should take a bribe;
DEU 10:18 the one executing judgment for a foreigner, and orphan, and widow; and he loves the foreigner so as to give to him bread and a garment.
DEU 10:19 And you shall love the foreigner - for you were foreigners in the land of Egypt.
DEU 10:20 The LORD your God you shall fear, and to him you shall serve, and to him you shall cleave, and upon his name you shall swear by an oath.
DEU 10:21 He is your boasting, and he is your God, who did among you the great and the honorable things - these things which your eyes beheld.
DEU 10:22 With seventy souls your fathers went down into Egypt. But now the LORD your God made you as the stars of the heaven in multitude.
DEU 11:1 And you shall love the LORD your God, and you shall guard his injunctions, and his ordinances, and his commandments, and his judgments all the days.
DEU 11:2 And you shall know today that I do not speak to your children, as many as are not knowing, nor knew the instruction of the LORD your God, and the magnificent works of his, and the fortified hand, and the high arm,
DEU 11:3 and his signs, and his miracles, as many as he did in the midst of Egypt to Pharaoh king of Egypt, and all his land;
DEU 11:4 and as much as he did to the force of the Egyptians, their chariots, and their cavalry, as he inundated them in the water of the red sea upon their face, pursuing them from the coming after you, and the LORD destroyed them until today's day;
DEU 11:5 and as many things as he did to you in the wilderness, until you came into this place;
DEU 11:6 and as much as he did to Dathan and Abiram, sons of Eliab, son of Reuben, of which the earth opening her mouth swallowed them, and their houses, and their tents, and all their means of support with them, in the midst of all Israel -
DEU 11:7 for your eyes saw all the works of the LORD, the great ones, as many as he did among you today.
DEU 11:8 And you shall guard all of his commandments, as many as I give charge to you today, that you should live, and should manifoldly multiply, and should enter, and should inherit the land into which you pass over the Jordan there to inherit it;
DEU 11:9 that you should prolong your days upon the land of which the LORD swore by an oath to your fathers to give to them, and to their seed after them - a land flowing milk and honey.
DEU 11:10 For it is the land into which you enter there to inherit it. It is not as the land of Egypt, from where you went forth from there; whenever they sow the seed, and water with the feet, as a garden of vegetables -
DEU 11:11 but the land into which you enter there to inherit it is a mountainous land and plain; from out of the rain of the heaven it shall drink water;
DEU 11:12 a land which the LORD your God oversees it always, as the eyes of the LORD your God are upon it from the beginning of the year and until the completion of the year.
DEU 11:13 But if in hearing, you should hear all his commandments, as many as I give charge to you today, to love the LORD your God, and to serve to him from out of your entire heart, and from out of your entire soul,
DEU 11:14 then he will give the rain to your land according to season - early and late; and you shall carry in your grain, and your wine, and your olive oil.
DEU 11:15 And he shall give fodder in your fields to your cattle. And having eaten and having been filled up,
DEU 11:16 take heed to yourselves not widening your heart, that you should transgress, and should serve other gods, and should do obeisance to them;
DEU 11:17 and the LORD being enraged should be angry with you, that he should hold together the heaven, and there will not be rain, and the earth shall not give of its fruit, and you shall be destroyed quickly from the good land which the LORD gave to you!
DEU 11:18 And you shall put these words into your heart, and into your soul, and shall affix them for a sign upon your hand, and it shall be unshaken before your eyes.
DEU 11:19 And you shall teach your children them, to speak them sitting down in the house, and going in the way, and laying in bed, and arising.
DEU 11:20 And you shall write them upon the lintels of your houses, and of your gates;
DEU 11:21 that you should multiply your days, and the days of your sons, upon the land which the LORD swore by an oath to your fathers to give to them, as the days of heaven upon the earth.
DEU 11:22 And it will be if hearing you should hear all these commandments which I give charge to you today, to do them, to love the LORD your God, and to go in all his ways, and to cleave to him;
DEU 11:23 then the LORD will cast out all these nations from your face, and you shall inherit great nations, and stronger ones than you.
DEU 11:24 Every place which ever the track of your foot may tread will be yours - from the wilderness and Antilebanon, and from the river of the great river Euphrates, and unto the sea at the descent of the sun - it will be your boundaries.
DEU 11:25 Not shall any one withstand against your face. The fear of you and the trembling because of you the LORD your God shall place upon the face of all the earth, upon which ever you should mount upon it, in which manner he spoke to you.
DEU 11:26 Behold, I give before you today a blessing and curse.
DEU 11:27 The blessing, if you should hear the commandments of the LORD your God, as many as I give charge to you today.
DEU 11:28 And the curse, if you do not hearken to the commandments of the LORD your God, as many as I give charge to you today, and you should wander from the way which I gave charge to you - having gone to serve other gods, ones who perceive not.
DEU 11:29 Then it will be whenever the LORD your God should bring you into the land, into which you pass over there to inherit it; then you shall give the blessing upon mount Gerizim, and the curse upon mount Ebal.
DEU 11:30 Behold are these not on the other side of the Jordan, behind the way of the descent of the sun in the land of Canaan, the people dwelling upon the descent, being next to Gilgal, neighboring the high oak?
DEU 11:31 For you are passing over the Jordan, entering to inherit the land which the LORD our God gives to us by lot all the days. And you shall inherit and dwell in it.
DEU 11:32 And you shall guard to do all his orders, and these judgments which I give in your presence today.
DEU 12:1 And these are the orders and the judgments which you shall guard to do in the land of which the LORD the God of your fathers gives to you by lot, all the days of which you live upon the land.
DEU 12:2 By destruction you shall destroy all the places in which the nations serve there their gods, (of whom you shall inherit them,) upon the high mountains, and upon the hills, and underneath every bushy tree.
DEU 12:3 And you shall raze their shrines, and break their monuments, and cut down their sacred groves, and incinerate the carvings of their gods by fire, and destroy their names from out of that place.
DEU 12:4 You shall not do so with the LORD your God.
DEU 12:5 But in the place which ever the LORD your God should choose from out of all of your tribes to name his name there, and to be called upon - even you shall seek after and enter there.
DEU 12:6 And you shall bring there your whole burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, and your tenths, and your vow offerings, and your voluntary offerings, and your acknowledgment offerings, the first-born of your oxen, and of your sheep.
DEU 12:7 And you shall eat there before the LORD your God. And you shall be glad over all of what ever you should put your hands, you and your houses, in so far as the LORD your God blessed you.
DEU 12:8 You shall not do according to all as much as we do here today - each doing the pleasing thing before him.
DEU 12:9 For you have not come unto the present time for the rest and for the inheritance which the LORD our God gives you.
DEU 12:10 But you shall pass over the Jordan, and you shall dwell upon the land of which the LORD our God shall inherit to you. And he shall rest you from all your enemies round about. And you shall dwell with safety.
DEU 12:11 And there will be the place which ever the LORD your God should choose his name to be called upon there, that there you shall bring all as many things as I give charge to you today - your whole burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, and your tithes, and the first-fruits of your hands, and every choice thing of your gifts, as many as you should vow to the LORD.
DEU 12:12 And you shall be glad before the LORD your God; you, and your sons, and your daughters, and your menservants, and your maidservants, and the Levite at your gates - for there is not to him a portion nor lot with you.
DEU 12:13 Take heed to yourself! You should not offer the things of your whole burnt offerings in any place of which ever you should behold;
DEU 12:14 but only in the place which the LORD your God should choose it, in one of your cities - there you shall offer your whole burnt offerings, and there you shall do all as many things as I give charge to you today.
DEU 12:15 But in all your desire you shall sacrifice and shall eat meats according to the blessing of the LORD your God which he gave to you in every city - the unclean among you, and the clean shall eat it the same, as a doe or stag.
DEU 12:16 Except the blood you shall not eat upon the land - you shall pour it out as water.
DEU 12:17 You shall not be able to eat in your cities the tithe of your grain, and of your wine, and of your olive oil, the first-born of your oxen, and of your sheep, and all the vows, as many as you should have vowed, and your acknowledgment offerings, and the first-fruits of your hands;
DEU 12:18 but only before the LORD your God shall you eat them in the place in which ever the LORD your God himself should choose for you and your son and your daughter, your manservant and your maidservant, and the Levite, and the foreigner in your cities. And you shall be glad before the LORD your God over all of whatsoever you should put your hand upon.
DEU 12:19 Take heed to yourself - you should not abandon the Levite all the time as long as you should live upon the land!
DEU 12:20 And if the LORD your God should widen your borders, just as he spoke to you, and you shall say, I will eat meats; if your soul should desire so as to eat meats - in every desire of your soul you shall eat meats.
DEU 12:21 And if at a farther distance from you be the place which ever the LORD your God should choose to call upon his name there, then you shall sacrifice from your oxen, and from your sheep what ever the LORD your God should give to you, in which manner I gave charge to you - then you shall eat in your cities according to the desire of your soul.
DEU 12:22 As the doe and the stag are eaten, so shall you eat it - the unclean among you, and the clean shall eat it likewise.
DEU 12:23 Take heed strongly to not eat blood! For its blood is life. You shall not eat life with the meats.
DEU 12:24 You shall not eat blood - upon the earth you shall pour it out as water.
DEU 12:25 You shall not eat it so that good should happen to you, and to your sons after you, if you should do the good and the pleasing thing before the LORD your God.
DEU 12:26 Except your holy things, which ever should come to you - that taking your vow offerings, you shall come into the place which ever the LORD your God should choose his name to be called upon there.
DEU 12:27 And you shall offer your whole burnt offerings - the meats you shall offer upon the altar of the LORD your God, but the blood of your sacrifices you shall pour towards the base of the altar of the LORD your God; but the meats you may eat.
DEU 12:28 Guard and hearken! And you shall do all the words which I give charge to you, that good should happen to you, and to your sons through the eon, if you should do the pleasing and the good thing before the LORD your God.
DEU 12:29 But if the LORD your God should utterly destroy the nations into which you enter there to inherit their land from your presence, and you should inherit them, and dwell in their land;
DEU 12:30 take heed to yourself! You should not seek to follow after them, after their being utterly destroyed from your face. Not in no way should you seek after their gods, saying, How these nations act with their gods, I also shall act.
DEU 12:31 You shall not do so to the LORD your God. For the abominations which the LORD detested, they did with their gods. For also their sons and their daughters they incinerated in fire to their gods.
DEU 12:32 Every word which I give charge to you today, this you shall guard to do. You shall not add unto it, nor remove from it.
DEU 13:1 And if there should rise up among you a prophet, or one dreaming dreams, and he should give to you a sign or miracle,
DEU 13:2 and it should come to pass - the sign or the miracle which he spoke to you, saying, We should go and serve other gods who we know not.
DEU 13:3 You shall not hearken to the words of that prophet, or the one dreaming that dream. For the LORD your God tests you, to know if you love the LORD your God from out of your entire heart, and from out of your entire soul.
DEU 13:4 You shall go after the LORD your God, and him you shall fear, and his commandments you shall keep, and his voice you shall hearken to, and to him you shall serve, and to him you shall be added to.
DEU 13:5 And that prophet, or that one dreaming the dream shall die; for he spoke to cause you to wander from the LORD your God (the one leading you from out of the land of Egypt, ransoming you from out of slavery) to push you from out of the way of which the LORD your God gave charge to you to go by it. And you shall remove their wicked thing from you.
DEU 13:6 But if your brother from out of your father should enjoin you, or from out of your mother, or of your son, or of your daughter, or of your wife, or one in your bosom, or your equal friend to your soul, in private, saying, We should go and should serve other gods, which you nor your fathers knew not;
DEU 13:7 of the gods of the nations surrounding you, of the ones near to you, or of the ones far from you, from the uttermost part of the earth, unto the uttermost part of the earth;
DEU 13:8 you shall not acquiesce to him, and you shall not hearken to him, and you shall not spare your eye upon him, and you shall not show mercy upon him, nor shall you shelter him.
DEU 13:9 By announcing, you shall announce concerning him, and your hand shall be upon him as first to kill him, and the hand of all the people upon him last.
DEU 13:10 And they shall throw stones at him with stones, and he shall die; for he sought to abstain you from the LORD your God, the one leading you from out of the land of Egypt, from out of the house of slavery.
DEU 13:11 And all Israel hearing, shall fear, and shall not add to do again according to this wicked matter among you.
DEU 13:12 And if it should be heard in one of your cities, which the LORD your God gives to you for you to dwell there, saying,
DEU 13:13 Men lawbreakers came forth from out of you, and left all the ones dwelling in their city, saying, We should go and serve other gods, which knew not;
DEU 13:14 then you shall examine, and shall ask, and shall search exceedingly; and behold, if the word be clearly true that this abomination has taken place among you;
DEU 13:15 then by doing away with, you shall do away with all the ones dwelling in that city by carnage of the sword - under anathema you shall devote it to consumption, and all the things in it, and all its cattle by the mouth of the sword.
DEU 13:16 And all its spoils you shall bring together into its corridors, and shall burn the city by fire, and all its spoils in full assembly before the LORD your God. And it shall be uninhabited into the eon - it shall not be rebuilt again.
DEU 13:17 And you shall not cleave to anything of that being offered up for consumption in your hand; so that the LORD should be turned away from the rage of his anger, and should grant to you mercy, and should show mercy on you, and should multiply you in which manner the LORD swore by an oath to your fathers;
DEU 13:18 if you should hearken to the voice of the LORD your God, to guard all his commandments which I give charge to you today, to do the good and the pleasing thing before the LORD your God.
DEU 14:1 You are sons of the LORD your God. You shall not make baldness between your eyes for the dead.
DEU 14:2 For you are a holy people to the LORD your God, and the LORD your God chose you to become his prized people, of all the nations upon the face of the earth.
DEU 14:3 You shall not eat any abomination.
DEU 14:4 These are the cattle which you shall eat - the calf of the oxen, and a lamb of the sheep, and a young he-goat of the goats,
DEU 14:5 the stag, and doe, and roebuck, and antelope, and white-tailed hart, and gazelle, and cameleopard.
DEU 14:6 Every beast cloven hoof, and clovenfooted to claw with two claws, and embarks chewing the cud among the cattle - these you shall eat.
DEU 14:7 And these you shall not eat - from of the ones embarking chewing the cud, and of the ones being cloven of the hoofs, and clawing clovenfooted - the camel, and hare, and hyrax. For they embark chewing the cud, but the hoof is not cloven - these are unclean to you.
DEU 14:8 And the pig, for this one is cloven of hoof, and claws clovenfooted of hoof, but this one as far as chewing the cud does not chew the cud - this one is unclean to you. From their meats you shall not eat, and of their decaying flesh you shall not touch.
DEU 14:9 And these you shall eat from all of the ones in the waters - all as much as there are fins and scales on them you shall eat.
DEU 14:10 And all as much as there is not fins and scales to them you shall not eat - these shall be unclean to you.
DEU 14:11 You shall eat every clean fowl.
DEU 14:12 And these you shall not eat of them - the eagle, and the griffin, and the osprey,
DEU 14:13 and the vulture, and the kite, and the ones likened to it,
DEU 14:14 and every crow and the ones likened to it,
DEU 14:15 and the ostrich, and owl, and gull,
DEU 14:16 and heron, and swan, and ibis,
DEU 14:17 and cormorant, and hawk, and the ones likened to it, and hoopoe, and long-eared owl,
DEU 14:18 and pelican, and curlew, and the ones likened to it, and the purple-legged stork, and bat.
DEU 14:19 All the crawling things of the winged creatures - these are unclean to you, you shall not eat from them.
DEU 14:20 Every winged creature being clean you shall eat.
DEU 14:21 Any decaying flesh you shall not eat - to the foreigner in your cities it shall be given, and he shall eat it; or you shall render it to the alien. For you are a holy people to the LORD your God. You shall not boil a lamb in the milk of its mother.
DEU 14:22 A tenth you shall tithe of all your produce of seed - the produce of your field year by year.
DEU 14:23 And you shall eat it before the LORD your God in the place in which ever the LORD your God should choose his name to be called upon there. You shall bring the tithes of your grain, and of your wine, and of your olive oil, and the first-born of your oxen, and of your sheep, that you should learn to fear the LORD your God all the days.
DEU 14:24 And if the journey should be far from you, and you should not be able to offer them because the place is far from you, which ever the LORD your God should choose his name to be called upon there, that the LORD your God shall bless you.
DEU 14:25 Then you shall render for them of silver. And you shall take the silver in your hands, and you shall go to the place which ever the LORD your God should choose it.
DEU 14:26 And you shall give the silver for all, of what ever your soul should desire, for oxen, or for sheep, or for wine, or for liquor, or for any thing of which ever your soul should desire. And you shall eat there before the LORD your God. And you shall be glad - you and your house.
DEU 14:27 And the Levite in your cities - you shall not abandon him, for there is not to him a portion nor a lot with you.
DEU 14:28 After three years you shall bring forth every tenth of your produce, and in that year you shall place it in your cities.
DEU 14:29 And the Levite shall come, (for there is not a portion to him nor a lot with you,) and the foreigner, and the orphan, and the widow in your cities; and they shall eat, and shall be filled, that the LORD your God should bless you in all the works of your hands, in whichever ones you should do.
DEU 15:1 For seven years you shall make a release.
DEU 15:2 And thus is the order of the release. You shall cancel every private loan which your neighbor owes to you. And you shall not exact payment of your brother; for it has been called a release to the LORD your God.
DEU 15:3 The alien - you shall exact as much as might be due to you from him; but to your brother you shall make a release of your loan.
DEU 15:4 For there shall not be among you one lacking; for by a blessing the LORD your God shall bless you in the land which the LORD your God gives to you by lot to inherit it.
DEU 15:5 But if in hearing you should hearken to the voice of the LORD your God, to guard and to do all these commandments which I give charge to you today,
DEU 15:6 (for the LORD your God blessed you in which manner he spoke to you,) then you shall lend to many nations, but you shall not borrow; and you shall control many nations, but of you they shall not control.
DEU 15:7 And if there should be among you one lacking from out of your brothers in one of your cities in the land which the LORD your God gives to you, you shall not disregard your heart, nor not in any way close your hand from your brother - the one wanting.
DEU 15:8 In opening, you shall open your hands to him, and you shall lend a loan to him as much as he wants, and according to as much as he lacks.
DEU 15:9 Take heed to yourself that there might be not a hidden thing in your heart, a violation of the law, saying, The seventh year approaches, the year of the release; and your eye should be wicked towards your brother, to the one wanting, that you should not give to him; and he shall call to aid against you to the LORD, and there shall be in you a great sin!
DEU 15:10 Giving, you shall give to him; and a loan, you shall lend to him - as much as he wants of you. And you shall not fret in your heart of your giving to him, for on account of this matter the LORD your God will bless you in all your works, and in all things of which ever you should put your hand.
DEU 15:11 For not in any way should the one lacking fail from your land. Because of this I give charge to you to do this thing, saying, In opening, you shall open your hands to your needy brother, and to the one wanting upon your land.
DEU 15:12 And if your brother a Hebrew man should be sold to you, or the Hebrew woman, he shall serve to you six years, and the seventh you shall send him free from you.
DEU 15:13 And whenever you should send him forth free from you, you shall not send him empty.
DEU 15:14 With supplies you shall provide him from your sheep, and from your grain, and from your wine vat. As the LORD your God blessed you you shall give to him.
DEU 15:15 And you shall remember that you were a servant in the land of Egypt, and the LORD your God ransomed you from there. On account of this I give charge to you to do this thing.
DEU 15:16 But if he should say to you, I shall not go forth from you; for he loves you, and your house, for it is good to him to be by you;
DEU 15:17 then you shall take the shoemaker's awl, and make a hole in his ear against the door, and he will be to you a servant into the eon. And of your maidservant you shall do likewise.
DEU 15:18 It shall not be hard before you sending them free from you; for he served to you the yearly wage of the hireling - six years. And the LORD your God shall bless you in all what ever you should do.
DEU 15:19 Every first-born which ever should give birth among your oxen, and among your sheep, you shall sanctify the males to the LORD your God. You shall not work with your first-born calf, and in no way should you shear the first-born of your sheep.
DEU 15:20 Before the LORD your God you shall eat it year by year, in the place in which ever the LORD your God should choose - you and your house.
DEU 15:21 And if there might be in it a blemish - lame or blind, or even any severe blemish, you shall not sacrifice it to the LORD your God.
DEU 15:22 In your cities you shall eat it. The unclean in you and the clean likewise shall eat as the doe or stag.
DEU 15:23 Except its blood you shall not eat - you shall pour it upon the ground as water.
DEU 16:1 Guard the month of the new grain! And you shall observe the passover to the LORD your God; for in the month of the new grain the LORD your God led you out of Egypt by night.
DEU 16:2 And you shall sacrifice the passover to the LORD your God - sheep and oxen in the place in which ever the LORD your God should choose his name to be called upon there.
DEU 16:3 You shall not eat it with yeast; seven days you shall eat it with unleavened breads, bread of affliction; for in haste you came forth from out of Egypt at night - that you should remember the day of your departure from out of the land of Egypt all the days of your life.
DEU 16:4 There shall not be seen by you any yeast in all your boundaries for seven days; and you shall not go to bed with any of the meats, which ever you should have sacrificed in the evening, left over the first day in the morning.
DEU 16:5 You shall not be able to sacrifice the passover in any one of your cities which the LORD your God gives to you;
DEU 16:6 but only in the place which ever the LORD your God should choose his name to be called upon there. You shall sacrifice the passover at evening towards the descent of the sun, in the time which you came forth from out of the land of Egypt.
DEU 16:7 And you shall boil, and bake, and eat in the place in which ever the LORD your God should choose it. And you shall return in the morning, and you shall go to your houses.
DEU 16:8 Six days you shall eat unleavened breads, and the seventh day is a recess holiday to the LORD your God; you shall not do on it any work except as much as shall be done for your life.
DEU 16:9 Seven entire periods of seven you shall count out to yourself - with the beginning of your sickle upon the harvest you shall begin to count out seven periods of seven.
DEU 16:10 And you shall observe the holiday of the period of sevens to the LORD your God, as your hand is strong, in as much as the LORD your God should give to you in so far as he blessed you.
DEU 16:11 And you shall be glad before the LORD your God, you, and your son, and your daughter, your manservant, and your maidservant, and the Levite in your cities, and the foreigner, and the orphan, and the widow among you, in the place in which ever the LORD your God should choose his name to be called upon there.
DEU 16:12 And you shall remember that you were a servant in the land of Egypt. And you shall guard and observe these commandments.
DEU 16:13 The holiday of tents you shall observe to yourself seven days in your bringing from out of your threshing-floor, and from your wine vat.
DEU 16:14 And you shall be glad in your holiday, you, and your son, and your daughter, your manservant, and your maidservant, and the Levite, and the foreigner, and the orphan, and the widow being in your cities.
DEU 16:15 Seven days you shall solemnize a holiday to the LORD your God in the place in which ever the LORD your God should choose it. But if the LORD your God should bless you in all your offspring, and in every work of your hands, then you shall be glad.
DEU 16:16 Three times of the year every male of yours shall appear before the LORD your God in the place in which ever the LORD should have chosen in the holiday of the unleavened breads, and in the holiday of the period of sevens, and in the holiday of the pitching of tents. You shall not appear in the presence of the LORD your God empty.
DEU 16:17 Each shall give according to the power of your hands; according to the blessing of the LORD your God which he gave to you.
DEU 16:18 Judges and judicial recorders you shall ordain to yourself in all your cities, which the LORD your God gives to you, according to tribes. And they shall judge the people a just judgment.
DEU 16:19 They shall not turn aside a judgment; they shall not discriminate a person, nor shall they take bribes - for the bribes make blind the eyes of wise ones, and lift away the words of just ones.
DEU 16:20 Justly you shall pursue the just thing, that you should live, and entering you should inherit the land which the LORD your God gives to you.
DEU 16:21 You shall not plant to yourself a sacred grove. Any tree by the altar of the LORD your God you shall not produce to yourself.
DEU 16:22 You shall not set up to yourself a monument which the LORD your God detests.
DEU 17:1 You shall not sacrifice to the LORD your God a calf or sheep in which there is in it a blemish - any thing in a sorry state. For it is an abomination to the LORD your God.
DEU 17:2 But if there should be among you, in one of your cities which the LORD your God gives to you, a man or woman who shall do the wicked thing before the LORD your God, to pass by his covenant,
DEU 17:3 and going forth should serve other gods, and should do obeisance to them - to the sun, or the moon, or to any of the ones of the cosmos of the heaven, which I assigned not;
DEU 17:4 and it should be announced to you, and you heard, and you sought exceedingly, and behold, if truly the thing has happened that this abomination came to pass in Israel -
DEU 17:5 then you shall lead out that man or that woman, (the ones who made this wicked order,) unto the gate, and shall stone them with stones, and they shall come to an end.
DEU 17:6 By two witnesses or three witnesses one shall die. The one dying shall not die by one witness.
DEU 17:7 And the hand of the witnesses shall be upon him among the first to put him to death, and the hand of all of the people upon him last. And you shall lift away the wicked thing of them from you.
DEU 17:8 But if a matter in a judgment should be powerless for you to decide, between blood and blood, and between judgment and judgment, and between blow and blow, and between dispute and dispute, for matters of judgment in your cities; then rising up you shall ascend unto the place which ever the LORD your God should choose for his name to be called upon there;
DEU 17:9 and you shall come to the priests of the Levites, and to the judge, who ever happens to be in those days - and seeking after the matter, they shall announce to you the judgment.
DEU 17:10 And you shall do according to the thing, which ever they should announce to you from out of the place of which ever the LORD your God should choose. And you shall guard exceedingly to do according to all as much as the law should be established to you.
