DEU 17:11 According to the law, and according to the judgment, which ever they should tell to you, thus you shall do it. You shall not turn aside from the matter of which ever they should announce to you, right nor left.
DEU 17:12 And the man who ever should do in pride to not obey the priest standing beside to officiate in the name of the LORD your God, or the judge who ever should be in those days, then that man shall die - and you shall lift away the wicked one from out of Israel.
DEU 17:13 And all the people hearing shall fear, and shall not be impious any more.
DEU 17:14 And whenever you should enter into the land which the LORD your God gives to you by lot, and you should inherit it, and should dwell upon it, and you should say, I shall place over myself a ruler, as also the rest of the nations round about me;
DEU 17:15 then in placing, you shall place over yourself a ruler, which ever the LORD your God should choose - him from out of your brothers you shall place over yourself as ruler. You shall not be able to place over yourself an alien man, for he is not your brother.
DEU 17:16 Furthermore he shall not multiply to himself a cavalry, nor shall he return the people to Egypt - so that he should not multiply to himself a cavalry. For the LORD said to you, You shall not add to return this way any more.
DEU 17:17 And he shall not multiply to himself wives, that he shall not change over his heart. And silver and gold he shall not multiply to himself exceedingly.
DEU 17:18 And it will be whenever he shall be settled in the chair of his office, then he shall write to himself this second book of the law into a scroll by the hands of the priests of the Levites.
DEU 17:19 And it shall be with him, and he shall read in it all the days of his life - that he should learn to fear the LORD his God, to guard all these commandments, and to do these ordinances;
DEU 17:20 that his heart should not be raised up high above his brothers; that he should not transgress from the commandments, right or left; so that he should be a long time in his office - he and his sons, among the sons of Israel.
DEU 18:1 There will not be to the priests, to the Levites, the entire tribe of Levi, a portion nor a lot with Israel. The yield offerings of the LORD are their lot - they shall eat them.
DEU 18:2 And there will not be a lot to him among his brothers - the LORD himself is his lot, in so far as he said to him.
DEU 18:3 And this is the distinguishing thing of the priests. The things from the people, from the ones sacrificing the sacrifices, if both a calf, or if also a sheep - that you shall give the shoulder to the priest, and the jawbones, and the large intestine,
DEU 18:4 and the first-fruits of your grain, and of your wine, and of your olive oil, and the first-fruit of the shearing of your sheep you shall give to him.
DEU 18:5 For the LORD your God chose him from out of all your tribes, to stand before the LORD God, to officiate in the name of the LORD, he and his sons, all the days.
DEU 18:6 And if the Levite should come from out of one of your cities of all the sons of Israel, of which he himself sojourns, that his soul desires, into the place which ever the LORD should choose;
DEU 18:7 then he shall officiate in the name of the LORD his God, as all his brothers the Levites standing there before the LORD.
DEU 18:8 He shall eat a portion having been portioned, besides the sale of the things of his family.
DEU 18:9 And whenever you should enter into the land which the LORD your God gives to you, you shall not learn to do according to the abominations of those nations.
DEU 18:10 There shall not be found in you one purging his son or his daughter in fire, or one using oracles for divination, or one prognosticating, and foretelling,
DEU 18:11 an administer of potions, one charming an enchantment, one who delivers oracles, and an observer of signs asking of the dead.
DEU 18:12 For every one doing these things is an abomination to the LORD your God. For because of these abominations the LORD your God shall utterly destroy them from your face.
DEU 18:13 You shall be perfect before the LORD your God.
DEU 18:14 For these nations which you inherit them, these shall hear prognostications and divinations - but to you the LORD your God did not so give.
DEU 18:15 A prophet from out of your brothers, as me, the LORD your God shall raise up to you - him you shall hear.
DEU 18:16 According to all as much as you asked of the LORD your God in Horeb, in the day of the assembly, saying, We shall not add to hear the voice of the LORD your God, and this great fire we shall not see any longer, that not in any way we shall die.
DEU 18:17 And the LORD said to me, Rightly is all as much as they spoke.
DEU 18:18 I shall raise up a prophet to them from out of the midst their brothers, as you, and I shall put my word in his mouth; and he shall speak to them in so far as I give charge to him.
DEU 18:19 And the man who ever should not hearken to his words, as many as the prophet should speak in my name, I shall exact punishment from out of him.
DEU 18:20 Except the prophet, who ever should be impious to speak a word in my name, which I assigned not to him to speak, and who ever should speak in the name of other gods, that prophet shall die.
DEU 18:21 But if you should say in your heart, How shall we know the word which the LORD spoke not?
DEU 18:22 As many things as the prophet should speak in the name of the LORD, and the thing should not take place, and this thing should not come to pass which the LORD spoke not - through impiety the prophet spoke; you shall not receive from him.
DEU 19:1 But whenever the LORD your God should remove from view the nations which your God gives to you of their land, and you should inherit them, and should dwell in their cities, and in their houses;
DEU 19:2 you shall draw apart to yourself three cities in the midst of your land, which the LORD your God gives to you.
DEU 19:3 Take thought to yourself of the way, and you shall make three parts the boundaries of your land which the LORD your God divides to you, and it will be there for a refuge to every man-slayer.
DEU 19:4 And this will be the order for the man-slayer, who ever should flee there, and shall live - who ever should strike his neighbor unintentionally, and this one was not detesting him before yesterday and before the third day.
DEU 19:5 And who ever should enter with the neighbor into the oak grove to bring wood, and his hand was knocked back with the axe while felling the wood, and the iron implement in falling off from the wood handle should happen by chance to strike the neighbor, and he should die - this one shall take refuge in one of these cities, and shall live;
DEU 19:6 lest the one acting as next of kin for blood pursue after the man-slayer, because his heart is overheated, and he overtakes him, if it might be a longer way, and he strikes his life and he should die, and there is not a judgment of death to this man, for he was not detesting him before yesterday, and before the third day.
DEU 19:7 Because of this I give charge to you this thing, saying, Three cities you shall draw apart to yourself.
DEU 19:8 And if the LORD your God should widen your borders, in which manner he swore by an oath to your fathers, and the LORD should give to you all the land which he said he would give to your fathers;
DEU 19:9 if you should listen to do all these commandments which I give charge to you today, to love the LORD your God, to go in all his ways, all the days; then you shall add to yourself again three cities to these three.
DEU 19:10 And the blood of the innocent shall not be poured out in the land which the LORD your God gives to you by lot, and there will not be blood liability among you.
DEU 19:11 But if there should be a man detesting his neighbor, and he shall lie in wait for him, and should rise up against him, and should strike his life, and he should die, and he should flee into one of these cities;
DEU 19:12 then they shall send the council of elders of his city, and they shall take him from there, and shall deliver him into the hands to the one acting as next of kin for blood, and he shall die.
DEU 19:13 You shall not spare your eye for him, and you shall cleanse the innocent blood from out of Israel, and it will be good to you.
DEU 19:14 You shall not move the boundaries of your neighbor, which they established prior of you among your inheritance, which you inherited in the land which the LORD your God gives to you by lot.
DEU 19:15 You shall not adhere to one witness in witnessing against a man for any injustice, and for any sin, and for any sin which ever he should have sinned. By the mouth of two witnesses, and by the mouth of three witnesses every word shall be established.
DEU 19:16 And if an unjust witness should stand against a man alleging his impiety;
DEU 19:17 then the two men shall stand, in which the dispute is with them, before the LORD, and before the priests, and before the judges as might be in those days.
DEU 19:18 And the judges should inquire exactly. And behold, if an unjust witness witnessed unjustly, opposed against his brother,
DEU 19:19 then you shall do to him in which manner he devised wickedly to do against his brother, and you shall lift away the wicked from out of yourselves.
DEU 19:20 And the rest hearing shall fear, and they shall not add again to do according to this wicked thing among you.
DEU 19:21 Your eye shall not spare him - life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot; in so far as any should give a blemish to the neighbor, thus you shall give to him.
DEU 20:1 And if you should go forth to war against your enemies, and you should behold a horse, and rider, and many more people than you, do not be fearful of them, for the LORD your God is with you, the one bringing you from out of the land of Egypt!
DEU 20:2 And it will be whenever you should approach to the war, that the priest drawing near shall speak to the people, and shall say to them,
DEU 20:3 Hear, O Israel! You go today to war with your enemies. Loosen not your heart; fear not nor be devastated, nor turn aside from their face!
DEU 20:4 For the LORD your God going forth with you shall join in war with you against your enemies, and shall preserve you.
DEU 20:5 And the scribes shall speak to the people, saying, Who is the man building a new house, and did not dedicate it? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the war, and another man shall dedicate it!
DEU 20:6 And who is the man whoever plants a vineyard, and was not glad from out of it? Let him go and return to his house, lest he should die in the war, and another man be glad from out of his labor!
DEU 20:7 And who is the man who has espoused a woman, and did not take her? Let him go, and let him return to his house, lest he die in the war, and another man shall take her!
DEU 20:8 And the scribes shall add to speak to the people, and shall say, Who is the man fearing and timid in the heart? Let him go, and let him return to his house, that he should not make timid the heart of his brother, as he!
DEU 20:9 And it will be whenever the scribes should cease speaking to the people, that they shall place rulers of the military taking lead of the people.
DEU 20:10 And if you should come forward to a city to wage war against it, that you should call them forth with peace.
DEU 20:11 And it shall be if then they should peaceably answer you, and open to you, it shall be that all the people being found in it shall be tributaries to you, and subjects to you.
DEU 20:12 But if they should not obey you, and should make war against you, and you shall besiege it,
DEU 20:13 and the LORD your God shall deliver it into your hands, then you shall strike every male of it by carnage of the sword.
DEU 20:14 Except the women, and the belongings, and all the cattle, and all as much as exists in the city, and all the chattel you shall despoil for yourself. And you shall eat all the plunder of your enemy, whom the LORD your God gives to you.
DEU 20:15 Thus you shall do for all the cities being far away from you exceedingly, which are not from the cities of these nations which the LORD your God gives to you to inherit their land.
DEU 20:16 But behold, from the cities of these nations which the LORD your God gives to you to inherit their land, you shall not take alive any one breathing.
DEU 20:17 But you shall devote them to consumption - the Hittite, and the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and Perizzite, and Hivite, and Jebusite, and Gergasite; in which manner the LORD your God gave charge to you;
DEU 20:18 that they should not teach you to do all their abominations, as many as they made unto their gods, that you shall sin before the LORD your God.
DEU 20:19 But if you should besiege around a city many days, to wage war against it for taking it, you shall not utterly destroy its trees by putting upon them an iron axe; but of it you shall eat, but you shall not cut it down; nor is a man to enter unto the tree in the grove from your presence for the siege mound?
DEU 20:20 But the tree which you know that it is not fruit-bearing, this you shall annihilate, and shall cut it, and shall build a siege mound at the city, whichever makes war against you, until whenever it should be delivered up.
DEU 21:1 And if a slain person should be found in the earth, (which the LORD your God gives to you to inherit,) fallen in the plain, and they do not know the one striking him;
DEU 21:2 there shall come forth your council of elders, and your judges, and they shall measure out the distances of the cities round about the slain person.
DEU 21:3 And it shall be to the city near to the slain person, that the council of elders of that city shall take a heifer from out of the oxen, which has not worked, and which did not draw a yoke.
DEU 21:4 And the council of elders of that city shall bring the heifer into a rough ravine which has not been worked, nor sowed; and they shall hamstring the heifer in the ravine.
DEU 21:5 And the priests the Levites shall come forward, (for the LORD your God chose them to stand beside him, and to bless over his name) and by their mouth will be every dispute and every blow decided.
DEU 21:6 And all (the council of elders of that city, the ones approaching the slain person,) shall wash their hands over the head of the heifer being hamstrung in the ravine.
DEU 21:7 And answering they shall say, Our hands did not pour out this blood, and our eyes have not seen it.
DEU 21:8 Let kindness come to your people Israel, whom you ransomed from out of the land of Egypt, O LORD, that there should not be innocent blood to your people Israel. And the blood shall be atoned for to them.
DEU 21:9 And you shall lift away the innocent blood from out of you of them, if you should do the good and the pleasing thing before the LORD your God.
DEU 21:10 And whenever you should go forth to war with your enemies, and the LORD your God should deliver them up into your hands, that you should despoil them by plunder.
DEU 21:11 And should you behold among the spoils a woman good to the sight, and should ponder her, and you should take her to yourself for a wife;
DEU 21:12 then you shall bring her inside into your house; and you shall shave her head, and trim her nails;
DEU 21:13 and you shall remove the garments of her captivity from her, and you shall seat her in your house, and she shall weep over her father and mother for a month of days; and after this you shall enter to her, and you shall be living together with her, and she shall be your wife.
DEU 21:14 And it shall be if you should not want her, you shall send her free; and for sale you shall not sell her for silver - you shall not disrespect her, for you humbled her.
DEU 21:15 But if there be to a man two wives, one of them being loved, and one of them being detested, and they should bear with him, both the one being loved and the one being detested, and the first-born son is born of the one being detested;
DEU 21:16 then it shall be in which ever day he should divide by lot to his sons of his possessions, he shall not be able to give the right of the first-born to the son of the one being loved, overlooking the son of the one being detested - the first-born.
DEU 21:17 But the first-born son of the one being detested he shall recognize to give to him double from all which ever should be found by him - for this one is his beginning child; and to this one the rights of the first-born are fitting.
DEU 21:18 And if any might have a son resisting persuasion, and an irritant, not obeying the voice of his father, and the voice of his mother, and they should correct him, and he should not listen to them;
DEU 21:19 then his father and his mother seizing him then shall lead him to the council of elders of his city, and unto the gate of his place.
DEU 21:20 And they shall say to the men of their city, Our son, this one, resists persuasion, and aggravates, not obeying our voice; he is fond of carousing drunk with wine.
DEU 21:21 And the men of his city shall stone him with stones, and he shall die - and thus you shall lift away the wicked from out of you of them; and all Israel hearing shall be fearful.
DEU 21:22 And if there be sin in any with the judgment of death upon him, and he should die, and you should hang him upon a tree,
DEU 21:23 his body shall not rest upon the tree, but by burial you shall entomb him on that day; (for being cursed by God is every one hanging upon a tree;) and in no way shall you defile the land which the LORD your God gives to you by lot.
DEU 22:1 In beholding the calf of your brother or of his sheep wandering in the way, do not overlook them - by returning you shall return them to your brother, and you shall give them back to him.
DEU 22:2 And if your brother is not near to you, nor do you know him, you shall bring them inside into your house, and it shall be with you until whenever your brother should seek them, and you shall give them back to him.
DEU 22:3 So shall you do for his donkey, and so you shall do for his garment, and so you shall do according to all loss of your brother; as much as should perish of his, and you should find them - you shall not be able to overlook.
DEU 22:4 You shall not just watch the donkey of your brother, or his calf fallen in the way - you should not overlook them; by raising you shall raise them up for him.
DEU 22:5 The items of a man shall not be upon a woman, nor should a man put on feminine apparel, for every one doing these things is an abomination to the LORD your God.
DEU 22:6 And if you should meet with a nest of birds before your face in the way, or upon any tree, or upon the ground - young chicks or eggs, and the mother should be incubating upon the young, or upon the eggs, you shall not take the mother with the offspring.
DEU 22:7 By discharge you shall send off the mother, but the offspring you shall take to yourself; that it should be good to you, and you shall be of many days.
DEU 22:8 And if you should build a new house, then you shall make a rim for your roof, and you will not cause carnage in your house if should fall one falling from it.
DEU 22:9 You shall not scatter abroad of your vineyard diverse seed, that the produce should not be sanctified, and also the seed which ever you should sow with the produce of your vineyard.
DEU 22:10 You shall not plow with a calf and donkey upon the same yoke.
DEU 22:11 You shall not put on commingled wool and flax upon the same garment.
DEU 22:12 A twisted fringe you shall make for yourself upon the four decorative hems of your wrap-around garments, which ever you should put around yourself by them.
DEU 22:13 And if any should take a wife, and should live with her, and should detest her,
DEU 22:14 and should place upon her words offered as an excuse, and should bring upon her a bad name, and should say, I took this woman, and drawing near to her I did not find her tokens of virginity.
DEU 22:15 And taking, the father of the child and the mother, shall bring forth the tokens of the virginity of the child to the council of elders at the gate.
DEU 22:16 And the father of the child shall say to the council of elders, This daughter of mine I gave to this man as wife, and he is detesting her.
DEU 22:17 He now places upon her words offered as an excuse, saying, I did not find tokens of virginity of your daughter; and these are the tokens of virginity of my daughter. And they shall unfold the garment worn by her before the council of elders of the city.
DEU 22:18 And the council of elders of that city shall take that man, and shall correct him,
DEU 22:19 and shall penalize him a hundred shekels, and shall give them to the father of the young woman, because he brought a bad name upon an Israelite virgin, and she shall be his wife - he shall not be able to send her away at any time.
DEU 22:20 But if in truth this word be, and tokens of virginity should not be found to the young woman -
DEU 22:21 then they shall lead the young woman unto the doors of her father's house, and the men of her city shall stone her with stones, and she shall die; for she did folly among the sons of Israel, to fornicate the house of her father - and you shall lift away the wicked from out of yourselves of them.
DEU 22:22 And if a man should be found going to bed with a wife living with a husband, you shall kill both, the man going to bed with the wife, and the wife - and you shall lift away the wickedness from out of Israel.
DEU 22:23 And if there be a virgin child being espoused to a man, and a man finding her in the city should have gone to bed with her;
DEU 22:24 you shall lead out both unto the gate of their city, and they shall be stoned with stones, and shall die - the young woman, for she did not yell out in the city; and the man, for he humbled the wife of his neighbor. And you shall lift away the evil from out of yourselves of them.
DEU 22:25 But if a man should find the girl in a plain being espoused, and using force he should go to bed with her - you shall kill the man going to bed with her only;
DEU 22:26 for the young woman shall not do anything, there is not sin worthy of death to the young woman. For as if any man should rise up against his neighbor, and should do murder taking his life, thus is this thing -
DEU 22:27 for in the field he found her; the young woman being espoused yelled, and was there not the one helping her.
DEU 22:28 And if any should find the virgin child, whoever was not espoused, and using force on her, went to bed with her, and he should be found,
DEU 22:29 the man going to bed with her shall give to the father of the young woman fifty double-drachmas of silver, and she will be his wife, because he humbled her - he will not be able to send her away at any time.
DEU 22:30 A man shall not take the wife of his father, and shall not uncover the marriage veil of his father.
DEU 23:1 One with crushed testicles shall not enter (nor being cut off) into the assembly of the LORD.
DEU 23:2 One born of a harlot shall not enter into the assembly of the LORD - unto the tenth generation.
DEU 23:3 The Ammonite and Moabite shall not enter into the assembly of the LORD - even unto the tenth generation. He shall not enter into the assembly of the LORD, even unto into the eon -
DEU 23:4 for reason of their not meeting with you with bread loaves and water in the way of your going forth from out of Egypt; and that they hired against you Balaam son of Beor from out of Mesopotamia to curse you.
DEU 23:5 And the LORD your God wanted not to listen to Balaam; and the LORD your God converted the curses into a blessing, for the LORD your God loved you.
DEU 23:6 You shall not address peaceable to them, nor be advantageous to them all your days into the eon.
DEU 23:7 You shall not abhor an Edomite, for he is your brother. You shall not abhor an Egyptian, for you were a sojourner in his land.
DEU 23:8 If they should bear sons to themselves in the third generation, they shall enter into the assembly of the LORD.
DEU 23:9 And if you should go forth to camp against your enemies, then you shall guard from every evil thing.
DEU 23:10 If there might be among you a man who is not clean because of his flow by night, then he shall go forth outside the camp, and he shall not enter into the camp.
DEU 23:11 And it will be towards evening he shall bathe his body in water; and at the going down of the sun, he shall enter into the camp.
DEU 23:12 And a place will be for you outside the camp, and you shall go forth there outside,
DEU 23:13 and a trowel will be upon your belt, and it will be whenever you should sit separately outside, that you shall dig with it, and bringing it you shall cover your indecency by it.
DEU 23:14 For the LORD your God walks about in your camp to rescue you, and to deliver up your enemy before your face; and your camp shall be holy, and there shall not be seen among you a thing of indecency, that he shall turn away from you.
DEU 23:15 You shall not deliver up a servant to his master, who was added to you by his master;
DEU 23:16 he shall dwell with you, among you, in every place of which ever it should please him. You shall not afflict him.
DEU 23:17 There shall not be a harlot from the daughters of Israel, and there shall not be one whoring from the sons of Israel.
DEU 23:18 You shall not bring the hire of a harlot, nor the price of a dog, into the house of the LORD your God for any vow - For even both are an abomination to the LORD your God.
DEU 23:19 You shall not lend to your brother with interest of silver, and interest of foods, and interest of any thing of which ever you should lend.
DEU 23:20 To the alien you may lend with interest, but to your brother you shall not lend with interest, that the LORD your God should bless you in all your works upon the land into which you enter there to inherit it.
DEU 23:21 And if you shall vow a vow to the LORD your God, you shall not pass time to render it - for requiring, the LORD your God shall require it from you; and it will be sin to you.
DEU 23:22 But if you should not want to make a vow, it is not a sin to you.
DEU 23:23 The things going forth through your lips you shall guard, and you shall do in which manner you made a vow to the LORD your God, in the matter of a gift which your mouth spoke.
DEU 23:24 And if you enter into the vineyard of your neighbor, you may eat as much grape as to fill up your soul, but you shall not put them into a container.
DEU 23:25 And if you should enter into the harvest field of your neighbor, then you may collect together an ear of wheat in your hands; but the sickle in no way shall be put upon the harvest of your neighbor.
DEU 24:1 And if any take a wife, and should live with her, and it shall be if she should not find favor before him, for he finds in her an indecent thing - then he shall write to her a certificate of divorce scroll, and shall put it into her hands, and shall send her from out of his house.
DEU 24:2 And going forth, should she become another man's wife,
DEU 24:3 and the last husband should detest her, and should write to her certificate of divorce scroll, and should put it into her hands, and send her from out of his house; or her last husband should die, who took her to himself as wife;
DEU 24:4 the former husband sending her out shall not be able to return to take her to himself for a wife, after her being defiled - for it is an abomination before the LORD your God. And you shall not defile the land which the LORD your God gives to you by lot.
DEU 24:5 And if any should take a wife recently, he shall not go forth to war, and not one thing shall be put upon him - he shall be innocent in his house; for one year he shall make glad his wife whom he took.
DEU 24:6 You shall not take for security a millstone nor an upper millstone; for this one takes a life for security.
DEU 24:7 And if you should capture a man stealing the life slavery. of his brothers of the sons of Israel, and tyrannizing him to sell him; that thief shall die; and you shall lift away the evil from out of yourselves of them.
DEU 24:8 Take heed to yourself in the infection of leprosy! You shall guard exceedingly to do according to all the law which ever the priests the Levites should announce to you - in which manner I gave charge to you you guard to do!
DEU 24:9 Remember as much as the LORD your God did to Miriam in the way of your going forth from out of Egypt!
DEU 24:10 And if a debt might be owed by your neighbor, any debt whatsoever, you shall not enter into his house to take for security of his item for security.
DEU 24:11 You shall stand outside, and the man of whom your loan is with, he shall bring forth to you the item of security outside.
DEU 24:12 But if the man should be in need, you shall not go to bed with his item of security.
DEU 24:13 By restitution you shall give back to him his item of security towards the descent of the sun, and he shall go to bed in his garment, and he will bless you - and it will be to you charity before the LORD your God.
DEU 24:14 You shall not disregard the wage of the needy, and one lacking from out of your brothers, or of the foreigners in your cities.
DEU 24:15 Daily you shall give him his wage - the sun shall not set upon him; for he is needy, and in it he has hope; and thus he shall not yell out against you to the LORD; and it will be to you a sin.
DEU 24:16 Fathers shall not die for the children, and the sons shall not die for the fathers - each for his own sin shall die.
DEU 24:17 You shall not turn aside a judgment of a foreigner, and an orphan, and a widow; and you shall not take for security a garment of a widow.
DEU 24:18 And you shall remember that you were a servant in the land of Egypt, and the LORD your God ransomed you from there - on account of this I give charge to you to do this thing.
DEU 24:19 And if you should reap your harvest in your field, and you should forget a sheaf in your field, you shall not turn back to take it - to the poor, and to the foreigner, and to the orphan, and to the widow it will be; that the LORD your God should bless you in every work of your hands.
DEU 24:20 And if one should pick olives, you shall not turn back to glean after yourself - it shall be to the foreigner and to the orphan and to the widow.
DEU 24:21 And whenever you should gather the vintage of your vineyard, you shall not glean the things after youself - it will be for the foreigner and the orphan and the widow.
DEU 24:22 And you shall remember that you were a servant in the land of Egypt - on account of this I give charge to you to do this thing.
DEU 25:1 And if there be a dispute between men, and they should come forward for judgment, and they should judge, and should do justice for the just, and should condemn the impious one;
DEU 25:2 then it will be if the one being impious might be worthy of strokes, they shall sit him before the judges, and they shall whip him before them according to his impiety.
DEU 25:3 They shall whip him forty stripes in number; they shall not add more. But if he should add to whip him above these, by the strokes being more, you shall be disgraced of your brother before you.
DEU 25:4 You shall not muzzle an ox threshing.
DEU 25:5 And if brothers should dwell in the same place, and one of them should die, and there might not be seed to him, the wife of the one having died shall not be outside the husband's family not near. The brother of her husband shall enter to her, and he shall take her to himself as wife, and he shall live with her.
DEU 25:6 And it will be, that the male child, who ever she should give birth to, shall be ordained from out of the name of the one coming to an end, and his name shall not be wiped away from out of Israel.
DEU 25:7 But if the man does not want to take the wife of his brother, then the woman shall ascend unto the gate to the council of elders, and shall say, The brother of my husband does not want to raise up the name of his brother in Israel - the brother of my husband does not want to.
DEU 25:8 And the council of elders of that city shall call him, and they shall speak to him. And standing, should he say, I am not willing to take her.
DEU 25:9 Then the wife of his brother coming forward to him, before the council of elders, then shall untie his sandal, the one from his foot, and shall spit into his face; and responding she shall say, Thus shall they do to the man who shall not build the house of his brother.
DEU 25:10 And his name shall be called in Israel, House of the Untied Sandal.
DEU 25:11 And if two men should do combat at the same time - a man against his brother; and should come forward the wife of one of them to rescue her husband from out of the hand of the one beating him, and stretching out her hand should take hold of his twins -
DEU 25:12 you shall cut off her hand; your eye shall not spare over her.
DEU 25:13 There shall not be in your money bag a false weight and a true weight - great or small.
DEU 25:14 There shall not be in your house a false measure and a true measure - great or a small.
DEU 25:15 There shall be to you a true and just weight, and there shall be to you a true and just measure, that you should be many days upon the land which the LORD your God gives to you by lot.
DEU 25:16 For every one doing these things is an abomination to the LORD your God - every one doing unjustly.
DEU 25:17 Remember as many things Amalek did to you in the way of your going forth from out of Egypt!
DEU 25:18 How he opposed you in the way, and beat your rear guard, ( even the ones tiring in your rear, and you hungered and were tired;) and he did not fear God.
DEU 25:19 And it will be when ever the LORD your God rests you from all your enemies round about you in the land which the LORD your God gives to you by lot to inherit, you shall wipe away the name Amalek from out of under the heaven, and in no way should you forget.
DEU 26:1 And it will be whenever you should enter into the land which the LORD your God gives to you by lot to inherit it, and you should dwell upon it;
DEU 26:2 that you shall take from the first-fruit of the fruits of your land, which the LORD your God gives by lot, and you shall put them into a basket, and you shall go into the place which ever the LORD your God should choose to call upon his name there.
DEU 26:3 And you shall come to the priest, who ever might be in those days, and say to him, I announce today to the LORD your God, that I have entered into the land which the LORD swore by an oath to our fathers to give to us.
DEU 26:4 And the priest shall take the basket from out of your hands, and shall put it before the altar of the LORD your God.
DEU 26:5 And you shall respond and say before the LORD your God, My father threw off Syria, and went down into Egypt, and sojourned there with few in number, and became there into a great nation and a populous multitude.
DEU 26:6 And the Egyptians maltreated us, and humbled us, and placed upon us hard works.
DEU 26:7 And we yelled out to the LORD God of our fathers. And the LORD listened to our voice, and beheld our humiliation, and our trouble, and our affliction.
DEU 26:8 And the LORD led us from out of Egypt with great strength, and with a fortified hand, and with a high arm, and with great visions, and with signs, and with miracles.
DEU 26:9 And he brought us into this place. And he gave to us this land - a land flowing milk and honey.
DEU 26:10 And now, behold, I have brought the first-fruit of the produces of the land which you gave to me, O LORD. And you shall leave it before the LORD your God, and shall do obeisance before the LORD your God.
DEU 26:11 And you shall be glad in all the good things which the LORD your God gave to you, and to your family - you, and the Levite, and the foreigner among you.
DEU 26:12 And whenever you should complete to tithe all the tenth part of the produce of your land in the third year, the second tenth part you shall give to the Levite, and to the foreigner, and to the orphan, and to the widow; and they shall eat in your cities, and they shall be satisfied.
DEU 26:13 And you shall say before the LORD your God, I cleared the holy things from out of my house, and I gave them to the Levite, and to the foreigner, and to the orphan, and to the widow, according to all your commandments which you gave charge to me - I did not pass by your commandment, and I did not forget.
DEU 26:14 And I did not eat of them in my grief; I did not yield of them in an unclean manner; I did not give of them to the one having died; I obeyed the voice of the LORD my God to do as he gave charge to me.
DEU 26:15 Look down from out of your holy house, from out of heaven, and bless your people Israel, and the land which you gave to them, as you swore by an oath to our fathers, to give to us a land flowing milk and honey!
DEU 26:16 On this day the LORD your God gave charge to you to do all these ordinances and judgments. And you shall guard and observe them from out of your entire heart, and from out of your entire soul.
DEU 26:17 You took God today to be your God, and to go in all his ways, and to guard the ordinances, and the commandments, and his judgments, and to obey his voice.
DEU 26:18 And the LORD took you today for you to be to him a prized people, just as he spoke to you - for you to guard all his commandments;
DEU 26:19 and for you to be above all the nations, as he made you famous, and a boasting, and glorious; for you to be a holy people to the LORD your God, as he spoke.
DEU 27:1 And Moses and the council of elders of Israel assigned, saying, Guard all the commandments, as many as I give charge to you today!
DEU 27:2 And it will be in which ever day you should pass over the Jordan into the land which the LORD your God gives to you, that you shall set up to yourself great stones, and you shall whitewash them in lime.
DEU 27:3 And you shall write upon the stones all the words of this law, as whenever you should pass over the Jordan, when ever you should enter into the land which the LORD your God gives to you, a land flowing milk and honey; in which manner the LORD God of your fathers spoke to you.
DEU 27:4 And it will be as when ever you should pass over the Jordan, you shall set these stones, which I give charge to you today, on mount Ebal, and you shall whitewash them with lime.
DEU 27:5 And you shall build there an altar to the LORD your God, an altar from out of stones - you shall not put upon them an iron tool.
DEU 27:6 Of whole stones you shall build the altar to the LORD your God. And you shall offer upon it whole burnt offerings to the LORD your God.
DEU 27:7 And you shall sacrifice a sacrifice of deliverance offering, and shall eat there, and shall be filled up, and shall be glad before the LORD your God.
DEU 27:8 And you shall write upon the stones all this law - very clearly.
DEU 27:9 And Moses and the priests the Levites spoke to all Israel, saying, Keep silent, and hearken, O Israel! On this day you have become a people to the LORD your God.
DEU 27:10 And you shall listen to the voice of the LORD your God, and you shall observe all his commandments and his ordinances, which I give charge to you today.
DEU 27:11 And Moses gave charge to the people in that day, saying,
DEU 27:12 These shall stand to bless the people in mount Gerizim, when passing over the Jordan - Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin.
DEU 27:13 And these shall stand for the curse on mount Ebal - Reuben, Gad, and Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.
DEU 27:14 And the Levites responding shall say to all Israel with a great voice,
DEU 27:15 Accursed is the man who shall make a carving and a molten image, an abomination to the LORD, a work of the hands of a craftsman, and shall put it in concealmenta niche.. And answering all the people shall say, May it be.
DEU 27:16 Accursed is the one dishonoring his father or his mother. And all the people shall say, May it be.
DEU 27:17 Accursed is the one altering boundaries of the neighbor. And all the people shall say, May it be.
DEU 27:18 Accursed is the one misleading the blind in the way. And all the people shall say, May it be.
DEU 27:19 Accursed is who ever turns aside a judgment which favors a foreigner, and orphan, and widow. And all the people shall say, May it be.
DEU 27:20 Accursed is the one going to bed with the wife of his father, for he uncovered the marriage veil of his father. And all the people shall say, May it be.
DEU 27:21 Accursed is the one going to bed with any beast. And all the people shall say, May it be.
DEU 27:22 Accursed is the one going to bed with a sister from out of his father or mother. And all the people shall say, May it be.
DEU 27:23 Accursed is the one going to bed with his mother-in-law. And all the people shall say, May it be. Accursed is the one going to bed with a sister of his wife. And all the people shall say, May it be.
DEU 27:24 Accursed is the one striking his neighbor with treachery. And all the people shall say, May it be.
DEU 27:25 Accursed is who ever should take bribes to strike the life of innocent blood. And all the people shall say, May it be.
DEU 27:26 Accursed is every man whoever shall not adhere to all the words of this law to do them. And all the people shall say, May it be.
DEU 28:1 If in hearing you should hear the voice of the LORD your God, to guard and to observe all his commandments which I give charge to you today, then the LORD your God shall appoint you above all the nations of the earth.
DEU 28:2 Then all these blessings shall come upon you, and shall find you, if in hearing you should listen to the voice of the LORD your God.
DEU 28:3 Being blessed are you in the city, and being blessed are you in the field.
DEU 28:4 Being blessed are the progeny of your belly, and the produce of your land, and the herds of your oxen, and the flocks of your sheep.
DEU 28:5 Being blessed are your storehouses and your surpluses.
DEU 28:6 Being blessed are you in your entering, and being blessed are you in your going forth.
DEU 28:7 The LORD your God shall deliver up your enemies opposing you by breaking them before your face - in one way they shall come forth against you, and in seven ways they will flee from your face.
DEU 28:8 May the LORD send upon you the blessing among your storerooms, and on all what ever you should put your hand. And he will bless you upon the land of which the LORD your God gives to you.
DEU 28:9 May The LORD your God raise you up to himself as a holy people, in which manner he swore by an oath to your fathers, if you should hearken to the voice of the LORD your God, and should go in his ways.
DEU 28:10 And all the nations of the earth shall see you that the name of the LORD is called upon by you; and they shall fear you.
DEU 28:11 And the LORD your God shall multiply you for good things upon the progeny of your belly, and upon the progeny of your cattle, and upon the produce of your ground, upon the land which the LORD swore by an oath to your fathers to give to you.
DEU 28:12 May the LORD open to you his good treasury - the heaven, to give the rain to your land in its season; to bless all the works of your hands. And you shall lend to many nations, but you shall not borrow. And you yourself shall rule many nations, but they shall not rule you.
DEU 28:13 May the LORD your God place you as head, and not as the tail; and you will be then above, and you will not be underneath; if you should hearken to the commandments of the LORD your God, as many as I give charge to you today, to guard and to observe.
DEU 28:14 You shall not transgress from all of the words which I give charge to you today, to the right, or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.
DEU 28:15 And it shall be if you should not listen to the voice of the LORD your God, to guard and to observe all his commandments, as many as I give charge to you today; then shall come upon you all these curses, and they shall overtake you.
DEU 28:16 Accursed are you in the city, and accursed are you in the field.
DEU 28:17 Accursed are your storehouses, and your surpluses.
DEU 28:18 Accursed are the progeny of your belly, and the produce of your land, and the herds of your oxen, and the flocks of your sheep.
DEU 28:19 Accursed are you in your entering, and accursed are you in your going forth.
DEU 28:20 May the LORD send upon you lack, and craving, and consumption upon all things of which ever you should put your hand upon, as much as you should do, until whenever he should utterly destroy you, and until whenever he should consume you quickly; because of your wicked practices, for you abandoned me.
DEU 28:21 May the LORD cleave the plague to you until whenever he should completely consume you from the land into which you enter there to inherit it -
DEU 28:22 for the LORD to strike you with perplexity, and burning heat, and shivering, and aggravation, and carnage, and wind-blown, and paleness; and may they pursue you until whenever they should destroy you.
DEU 28:23 And the heaven above your head will be as brass to you, and the earth underneath you as iron.
DEU 28:24 May the LORD appoint the rain of your land a cloud of dust; and dust from out of the heaven shall come down upon you, until it should obliterate you, and until whenever it should destroy you.
DEU 28:25 May the LORD appoint you for slaughter before your enemies. In one way you shall go forth against them, and in seven ways you shall flee from their face. And you will be in dispersion among all the kingdoms of the earth.
DEU 28:26 And your dead will be things devoured by the winged creatures of the heaven, and the wild beasts of the earth - and there will not be one frightening away.
DEU 28:27 The LORD strike you with the sore of Egypt in the buttocks, and wild mange, and itching, so as to not be able to heal.
DEU 28:28 The LORD strike you in derangement, and inability to see, and an astonishment of thought.
DEU 28:29 And you will be groping at midday as the blind one gropes in the darkness, and your ways will not prosper. And you will be then injured and torn in pieces all the days, and there shall not be one helping you.
DEU 28:30 You shall take a wife, and another man shall have her. You shall build a house, and you shall not live in it. You shall plant a vineyard, and in no way shall you gather its vintage.
DEU 28:31 Your calf being slain before you, and you will not eat from out of it. Your donkey being seized by force from you, and it shall not be given back to you. Your sheep being given to your enemies, and there shall not be one helping you.
DEU 28:32 Your sons and your daughters will be given to another nation, and your eyes shall see being inflamed over them. And your hand shall not be strong.
DEU 28:33 The resources of your land, and all the things of your toils a nation shall eat, which you have not knowledge of; and you will be injured and devastated all the days.
DEU 28:34 And you will be deranged through the visions of your eyes which you shall see,
DEU 28:35 for the LORD to strike you with a severe sore upon the knees, and upon the shanks, so as to not be able to heal yourself from the sole of your feet unto the top of your head.
DEU 28:36 May the LORD take you, and your rulers, whom ever you should place over yourself, by a nation who you have not knowledge of yourself, nor your fathers; and you shall serve there to other gods of wood and stone.
DEU 28:37 And you will be there for an enigma, and a parable, and a tale, in all the nations into which ever the LORD should take you there.
DEU 28:38 Much seed you shall bring forth in the plain, and little will be carried in; for the locust shall eat them.
DEU 28:39 You shall plant and work a vineyard, but wine you shall not drink, nor will you be glad from out of it; for the worm shall eat it.
DEU 28:40 Olive trees will be to you in all your borders, but with olive oil you will not anoint; for your olive shall flow away.
DEU 28:41 Sons and daughters you shall bear, but they shall not be yours; for they shall go forth in captivity.
DEU 28:42 All your woods and the produce of your land the blight shall completely consume.
DEU 28:43 The foreigner who is among you shall ascend over you upward and upward; but you shall go down lower and lower.
DEU 28:44 This one shall lend to you, but you shall not lend to this one. This one will be for the head, and you will be for the tail.
DEU 28:45 And all these curses shall come upon you, and shall pursue you, and overtake you, until whenever they shall utterly destroy you, and until whenever they shall consume you; for listened not to the voice of the LORD your God, to guard his commandments, and his ordinances, as many as I gave charge to you.
DEU 28:46 And it will be for signs to you, and miracles, and among your seed until the eon;
DEU 28:47 because you served not the LORD your God with gladness, and with a good heart; on account of the multitude of all these.
DEU 28:48 And you shall serve to your enemies whom the LORD shall send as a successor over you in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things. And he shall put a collar of iron upon your neck, until whenever he should utterly destroy you.
DEU 28:49 The LORD shall bring upon you a nation far off from the end of the earth, as the impulse of an eagle; a nation of which you will not hear its voice;
DEU 28:50 a nation impudent in its face, which will not admire the face of an old man, and will not show mercy for the young.
DEU 28:51 And it will devour the progeny of your cattle, and the produce of your land, so as to not leave behind for you grain, wine, olive oil, herds of your oxen, and the flocks of your sheep, until whenever it should destroy you,
DEU 28:52 and should obliterate you in all your cities; until whenever your walls should be demolished - the high and the fortified ones upon which you rely upon them in all your land. And it shall afflict you in all your cities, which the LORD your God gave to you.
DEU 28:53 And you shall eat the progeny of your belly - the meat of your sons and your daughters, as many as the LORD your God gave to you in your straits, and in your affliction, in which your enemy shall afflict you.
DEU 28:54 The one tender among you, and the very delicate shall charm with his eye his brother, and the wife in his bosom, and the left behind children, who ever should be left to him;
DEU 28:55 so as to give one of them from the flesh of his children whom ever he should eat - because of the not having left behind to him anything in the straits, and in the affliction, in which ever your enemies should afflict you in all your cities.
DEU 28:56 And the tender among you, and the exceedingly delicate one, of whom has not taken an attempt with her foot to go upon the land because of the delicacy, and because of the tenderness - she shall charm with her eye her husband near her bosom, and her son and daughter;
DEU 28:57 and her afterbirth coming forth through her thighs, and her child which ever she should give birth to - they she shall eat them because of the lack of all things, secretly, in the straits, and in the affliction by which your enemy shall afflict you in your cities.
DEU 28:58 If you should not hearken to do all the discourses of this law being written in this scroll, to fear this wonderful and valued name - the LORD your God;
DEU 28:59 then the LORD will render notorious your calamities, and the calamities of your seed - great and surprising calamities, and severe and sure diseases.
DEU 28:60 And he shall turn upon you all the grief of Egypt, the severe grief which you were on guard from in front of them - and they shall cleave to you.
DEU 28:61 And every infirmity, and every calamity not being written, and every one being written in this scroll of the law, the LORD shall bring upon you, until whenever he should utterly destroy you.
DEU 28:62 And you shall be left behind few in number, because it was that you were as the stars of the heaven in multitude; for you hearkened not to the voice of the LORD your God.
DEU 28:63 And it will be in the manner the LORD was glad over you to do good for you, and to multiply you; so the LORD will be glad over you to utterly destroy you, and to lift you away from the land into which you enter there to inherit it.
DEU 28:64 And the LORD your God will disperse you into all the nations, from the tip of the earth, unto the other tip of the earth. And you shall slave there to other gods of wood and stone, which you have not knowledge of nor your fathers.
DEU 28:65 But also in those nations he will not rest you, nor not in any way will the sole of your foot become stationary. And the LORD will give to you there another heart being depressed, and failing eyes, and a melting soul.
DEU 28:66 And your life will be hanging before your eyes. And you shall have fear day and night, and not ha ve trust in your life.
DEU 28:67 In the morning you shall say, O how that it might become evening. And in the evening you shall say, O how that it might become morning - from the fear of your heart of which you shall have fear, and from the visions of your eyes which you shall see.
DEU 28:68 And the LORD will return you unto Egypt in boats, and in the way which I said, You shall not proceed again to behold it. And you shall be sold there to your enemies for menservants and maidservants, and there shall not be one acquiring you.

DEU 29:3 the great tests which your eyes have seen; the signs and those great miracles, by the strong hand, and the high arm.
DEU 29:4 And the LORD God gave not to you a heart to behold, and eyes to see, and ears to hear, until this day.
DEU 29:5 And he led you forty years in the wilderness. Your garments did not become old, and your sandals did not wear away from your feet.
DEU 29:6 You did not eat bread, you did not drink wine and liquor, that you should know that this is the LORD your God.
DEU 29:7 And you came unto this place. And came forth Sihon king of Heshbon, and Og king of Bashan to meet us in war.
DEU 29:8 And we struck them, and took their land, and gave it by lot to Reuben, and to Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh.
DEU 29:9 And you shall guard all the words of this covenant, to do them, that you should perceive all as much as you do.
DEU 29:10 You all stand today before the LORD your God; your tribal chiefs, and your council of elders, and your judges, and your judicial recorders - every man of Israel,
DEU 29:11 your wives, and your children, and the foreigner in the midst of your camp, from your woodcutter and unto your water-carrier,

DEU 29:13 that he should establish you to himself for a people, and he will be your God, in which manner he said to you, and in which manner he swore by an oath to your fathers - Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob.
DEU 29:14 And not to you alone I ordain this covenant and this oath,
DEU 29:15 but also to the ones here being with you today before the LORD your God, and to the ones not being with you here today.

DEU 29:17 and you beheld their abominations, and their idols - wood and stone, silver and gold, which is among them;)
DEU 29:18 lest there is among you a man, or woman, or family, or tribe, whose thought turned aside from the LORD your God, to go to serve to the gods of those nations; lest there is among you a root germinating bile and bitterness upward;
DEU 29:19 and it shall be if you should hear the words of this imprecation, and one should portend in his heart, saying, May sacred things happen to me, for I shall go by the digression of my heart, that the sinner should not be destroyed together with the sinless,
DEU 29:20 not in no way should God want to propitiate for him, but then the anger of the LORD shall be burned away, and his zeal against that man; and all the imprecations of this covenant shall cleave to him, the ones being written in this scroll of the law; and the LORD will wipe away his name from out of under heaven.
DEU 29:21 And the LORD shall separate him for evils from out of all the sons of Israel, according to all the imprecations of the covenant being written in this scroll of the law.
DEU 29:22 And another generation shall speak (your sons who rise up after you, and the alien which ever should come from out of a land far off, and they shall see the calamities of that land, and its diseases, which the LORD sent unto it,
DEU 29:23 sulphur and salt incinerating - all its land shall not be sown, nor shall rise, nor should ascend upon it any green thing, as Sodom and Gomorrah were eradicated - Admah and Zeboim, which the LORD eradicated in rage and anger,)
DEU 29:24 and all the nations shall say, Why did the \Scap lord do thus to this land? What is this great rage of anger?
DEU 29:25 And they shall say, Because they left the covenant of the LORD God of their fathers, which he ordained with their fathers, when he led them out of the land of Egypt.
DEU 29:26 And going they served other gods, and did obeisance to them - ones which they had not a knowledge of, nor knowledge spread to them.
DEU 29:27 And the LORD was provoked to anger in rage over that land, to bring upon it according to all the imprecations being written in this scroll of the law.
DEU 29:28 And the LORD lifted them from their land in rage and anger, and an exceedingly great fit of temper, and cast them into another land as now.
DEU 29:29 The secret things belong to the LORD our God - but the open things are to you, and to our children into the eon, to do all the words of this law.
DEU 30:1 And it will be whenever all these things should come upon you, the blessing and the curse, which I put before your face, and you shall take them into your heart in all the nations, of which ever the LORD your God should disperse you there;
DEU 30:2 and you shall turn towards the LORD your God, and you shall hearken to his voice, according to all as much as I give charge to you today, from out of your entire heart, and from out of your entire soul;
DEU 30:3 that the LORD shall heal your sins, and shall show mercy on you, and again shall bring you from out of all the nations into which the LORD your God dispersed you there.
DEU 30:4 Even if your dispersion might be from one tip of the heaven unto one tip of the heaven, from there the LORD your God shall bring you, and from there he will take you.
DEU 30:5 And the LORD your God will bring you into the land which your fathers inherited, and you shall inherit it; and he will do you good, and will do superabundant for you above your fathers.
DEU 30:6 And the LORD shall purge your heart, and the heart of your seed, to love the LORD your God from out of your entire heart, and from out of your entire soul, that you should live.
DEU 30:7 And the LORD your God shall put these curses upon your enemies, and upon the ones detesting you, who pursued you.
DEU 30:8 And you shall turn and shall listen to the voice of the LORD your God, and shall observe his commandments, as many as I give charge to you today.
DEU 30:9 And the LORD your God shall take great care of you in every work of your hands, in the progeny of your belly, and in the progeny of your cattle, and in the produce of your land - for the LORD your God shall turn to be glad over you for good things, as he was glad over your fathers,
DEU 30:10 if you should hearken to the voice of the LORD your God, to guard his commandments, and his ordinances written in the scroll of this law, if you turn to the LORD your God with your entire heart, and with your entire soul.
DEU 30:11 For this commandment which I give charge to you today is not enormous, nor is it far from you.
DEU 30:12 It is not in the heaven, saying, Who shall ascend of us into the heaven, and shall take it to us, and hearing it we will do it?
DEU 30:13 Nor is it on the other side of the sea, saying, Who will pass through for us to the other side of the sea, and shall take it for us, and hearing it we will do it?
DEU 30:14 But the word is very near you - in your mouth, and in your heart, and in your hands to do it.
DEU 30:15 Behold, I put before your face today life and death, good and bad.
DEU 30:16 But if you should hearken to the commandments of the LORD your God, which I give charge to you today, to love the LORD your God, to go in all his ways, and to guard his ordinances, and his commandments, and his judgments, then you shall live, and you will be populous, and the LORD your God will bless you in all the land into which you enter there to inherit it.
DEU 30:17 And if your heart should change over, and you should not listen, and in wandering you should do obeisance to other gods, and should serve them;
DEU 30:18 I announce to you today, that by destruction you will be destroyed, and in no way shall there be many days upon the land, into which you pass over the Jordan there to inherit it.
DEU 30:19 I call to testify to you today both the heaven and the earth - life and death I put before your face; the blessing and the curse; then choose life that you should live and your seed;
DEU 30:20 to love the LORD your God, to listen to his voice, and to hold what is of his. For this is your life, and the duration of your days - to dwell upon the land of which the LORD swore by an oath to your fathers, to Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, to give it to them.
DEU 31:1 And Moses completed speaking all these words to all the sons of Israel.
DEU 31:2 And he said to them, A hundred and twenty years I am today. I shall not be able still to enter and go forth, for the LORD said to me, You shall not pass over this Jordan.
DEU 31:3 The LORD your God, the one going forth before your face, he shall utterly destroy these nations from your face, and you shall inherit them - and Joshua is the one going forth before your face, as spoke the LORD.
DEU 31:4 And the LORD shall do to them as he did to Sihon and Og, to the two kings of the Amorites who were on the other side of the Jordan, and to their land, in so far as he utterly destroyed them.
DEU 31:5 And the LORD delivered them up before you; and you shall do to them in so far as I gave charge to you.
DEU 31:6 Be manly and be strong! Do not fear nor should you be timid, nor should you be terrified from their face! For the LORD your God, the one going before with you - not in any way should he forsake you, nor in any way should he abandon you.
DEU 31:7 And Moses called Joshua, and said to him before all Israel, Be manly and strong! For you shall enter before the face of this people, into the land which the LORD swore by an oath to your fathers to give to them; and you shall allot it to them.
DEU 31:8 And the LORD, the one going with you, he will not forsake you, nor in any way abandon you. Do not fear nor be timid!
DEU 31:9 And Moses wrote the sayings of this law in a scroll, and gave it to the priests, to the sons of Levi lifting the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and to the elders of the sons of Israel.
DEU 31:10 And Moses gave charge to them in that day, saying, After seven years, in the time of the year of release, in the holiday of pitching of tents,
DEU 31:11 in the going with all Israel to appear before the LORD your God, in the place in which ever the LORD should choose, you shall read this law before all Israel in their ears.
DEU 31:12 Assemble the people - the men, and the women, and the progeny, and the foreigner in your cities! That they should hear, and that they should learn to fear the LORD your God. And they shall hearken to do all the words of this law.
DEU 31:13 And their sons who have not known, shall hear, and shall learn to fear the LORD your God all the days, as many as they live upon the land into which you pass over the Jordan there to inherit it.
DEU 31:14 And the LORD said to Moses, Behold, the days of your death are approaching. Call Joshua, and stand by the door of the tent of the testimony, and I will give charge to him! And Moses and Joshua went into the tent of the testimony, and stood by the door of the tent of the testimony.
DEU 31:15 And the LORD came down in a column of cloud. And it stood at the door of the tent of the testimony - even the column of cloud stood by the door of the tent.
DEU 31:16 And the LORD said to Moses, Behold, you go to sleep with your fathers; and rising up, this people shall fornicate after alien gods of the land into which this people enter there into it. And they shall forsake me, and shall efface my covenant which I ordained with them.
DEU 31:17 And I shall be provoked to anger in rage with them in that day, and I will leave them, and I will turn my face from them, and they shall be a thing devoured, and many evils and afflictions shall find it; and it shall say in that day, For the LORD my God is not among me is why these evils found me.
DEU 31:18 And I in turning will turn away my face from them in that day because of all the evils which they did, for they turned away unto alien gods.
DEU 31:19 And now write the words of this ode, and teach it to the sons of Israel! And you shall put it into their mouth, that this ode should be to me a testimony among the sons of Israel.
DEU 31:20 For I shall bring them into the good land which I swore by an oath to their fathers, a land flowing milk and honey; and they shall eat; and being filled up, they shall satisfy themselves, and shall turn to alien gods, and shall serve to them, and shall provoke me, and shall efface my covenant which I ordained with them.
DEU 31:21 And it will be whenever many evils and afflictions shall find it, that this ode shall stand firm witnessing against their face. For not in any way should they forget it from their mouth, and from the mouth of their seed. For I perceive their wickedness, as much as they do here today - before my bringing them into the good land which I swore by an oath to their fathers.
DEU 31:22 And Moses wrote this ode in that day, and taught it to the sons of Israel.
DEU 31:23 And Moses gave charge to Joshua son of Nun, and said, Be manly and be strong! For you shall bring the sons of Israel into the land which the LORD swore by an oath to them; and he will be with you.
DEU 31:24 And when Moses completed writing all the words of this law in a scroll, until completion,
DEU 31:25 that he gave charge to the Levites lifting the ark of the covenant of the LORD, saying,
DEU 31:26 Taking the scroll of this law, you shall put it sideways in the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, and it will be there to you for a testimony.
DEU 31:27 For I know the aggravation caused by you, and your hard neck. For still in my living with you today, you were embittering greatly the things towards God; how not so also at the last at my death?
DEU 31:28 Hold an assembly for me of your tribal chiefs, and your elders, and your judicial recorders, that I should speak into their ears all these words. And I call to testify to them both the heaven and the earth.
DEU 31:29 For I know that at the last of my decease, with lawlessness you shall act lawlessly, and shall turn aside from out of the way of which I gave charge to you; and evils shall meet with you at the last of the days; for you shall do the evil before the LORD to provoke him to anger by the works of your hands.
DEU 31:30 And Moses spoke into the ears of all the assembly of Israel the words of this ode, until completion.
DEU 32:1 Take heed, O heaven, and I will speak! And hear, O earth, the discourses from out of my mouth!
DEU 32:2 Expect my maxims as rain, and let my discourses go down as dew - as a heavy shower upon wild grass, and as snowflakes upon grass!
DEU 32:3 For I called the name of the LORD. Give greatness to our God!
DEU 32:4 God - his works are true, and all his ways are equity. God is trustworthy, and there is not an injustice in him. Just and sacred is the LORD.
DEU 32:5 They sinned - they are not his children; one scoffing - a crooked generation, and one turning aside.
DEU 32:6 Do you recompense these things to the LORD thus, O people, moronish and not wise? Did he not (this your father) acquire you, and make you, and shape you?
DEU 32:7 Remember the days of the eon! Perceive indeed the years of the generations of generations! Ask your father, and he will announce to you; your elders, and they shall speak to you!
DEU 32:8 When the highest divided nations into parts, as he disseminated the sons of Adam, he set the borders of nations according to the number of the angels of God.
DEU 32:9 and His people Jacob became a portion for the LORD - Israel is a piece of measured out land of his inheritance.
DEU 32:10 He sufficed him in a wilderness land, in thirst of sweltering heat in a waterless land. He encircled him, and corrected him, and guarded him as a pupil of an eye.
DEU 32:11 As an eagle sheltering his nest, he longs after and over his young. Thrusting out his wings he receives them, and takes them upon his upper back.
DEU 32:12 The LORD alone led them, and there was not with them an alien god.
DEU 32:13 He brought them unto the strength of the land. He fed them produce of fields. They nursed honey out of the rock, and olive oil out of the solid rock.
DEU 32:14 Butter of oxen, and milk of sheep, with fat of lambs and rams, offspring of bulls and he-goats, with fat of kidneys of wheat, and they drank wine the blood of the grape.
DEU 32:15 And Jacob ate and was filled up - even the one being loved kicked up. He was fattened; he was thickened; he was widened - and he abandoned God, the one making him. And he left from God his deliverer.
DEU 32:16 They provoked me over alien ones - in their abominations they greatly embittered me.
DEU 32:17 They sacrificed to demons, and not to God - to gods in whom they knew not. New and newly made gods have come, in whom their fathers knew not.
DEU 32:18 God, the one creating you, you abandoned; and you forgot God, the one maintaining you.
DEU 32:19 And the LORD beheld, and was jealous; and he was provoked to anger by their sons and daughters.
DEU 32:20 And he said, I will turn away my face from them, and I will show what will be to them at the last times, for it is a generation being distorted; sons in whom there is not belief in them.
DEU 32:21 They provoked me to jealousy over that which is not god - they provoked me to anger with their idols. And I will provoke them to jealousy over that not a nation; by a senseless nation I will provoke them to anger.
DEU 32:22 For a fire burns away of my rage - it shall be burned unto lower Hades; it shall devour the land, and its produce; it shall blaze on the foundations of mountains.
DEU 32:23 I bring together to them bad things; and by my arrows I will finish with them -
DEU 32:24 melting them away in hunger, and being food of fowls, and affected incurable. The teeth of wild beasts I will send as a successor to them - with rage dragging them upon the ground.
DEU 32:25 From outside the sword shall make them childless, and from out of the inner chambers fear - the young man with the virgin; the one nursing being placed with the old man.
DEU 32:26 I said, I will disperse them, and I will cause their memorial to cease from among men.
DEU 32:27 If not on account of the anger of the enemies, that in no way should they live a long time, and that in no way their opponents join in making an attack - lest they should say, Our high hand, and not the LORD did all these things.
DEU 32:28 For it is a nation destroying counsel, and there is not higher knowledge in them.
DEU 32:29 They did not think to perceive. Let them appreciate in the coming time.
DEU 32:30 How shall one pursue thousands, and two rout ten thousands, unless God rendered them up, and the LORD delivered them up?
DEU 32:31 For their gods are not as our God - but our enemies are unthinking.
DEU 32:32 For of the grapevine of Sodom is their grapevine, and their small vine branch is of Gomorrah; their grape is the grape of bile - their cluster is bitterness to them.
DEU 32:33 The rage of dragons is their wine, even the incurable rage of asps.
DEU 32:34 Behold, are not these things brought together by me, and to set seal among my treasures?
DEU 32:35 In the day of punishment I shall recompense - in a time whenever their foot should trip; for the day of their destruction is near, and at hand prepared for you.
DEU 32:36 For the LORD judges his people, and over his menservants he shall be comforted. For he beheld their being disabled, and failing in the hostile invasion, and were weakened.
DEU 32:37 And the LORD said, Where are their gods upon whom they yielded upon them?
DEU 32:38 Of whom the fat of their sacrifices you ate, and drank the wine of their libations? Let them rise up and help you, and be your shelterer!
DEU 32:39 Behold, behold that I am, and there is not a God besides me! I shall kill, and I shall make to live. I shall strike, and I will heal. And there is not one who shall rescue from out of my hands.
DEU 32:40 For I shall lift my hand into the heaven, and I shall swear by an oath by my right hand. And I will say, I live into the eon.
DEU 32:41 For I will sharpen my sword as lightning, and my hand will hold to equity. And I will recompense punishment against the enemies; and against the ones detesting me I will recompense.
DEU 32:42 I shall intoxicate my arrows of blood, and my sword shall eat meats from the blood of the slain, and from the captivity of the heads of the rulers of the enemies.
DEU 32:43 Be glad, O heavens, together with him! And do obeisance to him, all angels of God! Be glad, O nations, with his people! And grow in strength in him all, O sons of God! For the blood of his sons he shall avenge, and he shall avenge and recompense punishment to the enemies. And to the ones detesting him he will recompense, and the LORD shall clear out the land for his people.
DEU 32:44 And Moses wrote this ode in that day. And he taught it to the sons of Israel. And Moses approached and spoke all the words of this law into the ears of the people - he and Joshua the son of Nun.
DEU 32:45 And Moses completed speaking these words to all Israel.
DEU 32:46 And he said to them, You take heed in your heart over all these words which I testify to you today, which you shall charge to your sons to guard, and to do all the words of this law!
DEU 32:47 For this is not an empty word for you, for this is your life. And because of this word you shall prolong your days upon the land into which you pass over the Jordan there to inherit it.
DEU 32:48 And the LORD spoke to Moses in this day, saying,
DEU 32:49 Ascend into the mountain Abarim, this mountain Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, against the face of Jericho! And behold the land of Canaan, which I give to the sons of Israel for a possession.
DEU 32:50 And come to an end in the mountain into which you ascend there! And be added to your people in which manner Aaron your brother died in Hor the mountain, and was added to his people!
DEU 32:51 For you resisted persuasion to my word among the sons of Israel at the water of dispute, Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; for you did not sanctify me among the sons of Israel.
DEU 32:52 For you shall see the land before you, and you shall not enter there into the land which I give to the sons of Israel.
DEU 33:1 This is the blessing which Moses the man of God blessed the sons of Israel before his decease.
DEU 33:2 And he said, The LORD is come from out of Sinai, and he appeared upon Seir to us. And he hastened from out of mount Paran with myriads of Kadesh - at his right were angels with him.
DEU 33:3 And he spared his people, and all the ones being sanctified by your hands; these are under you; and he received of his words
DEU 33:4 the law which Moses gave charge to us, an inheritance of the congregation of Jacob.
DEU 33:5 And he will be a ruler with the one being loved being brought together with rulers of peoples among tribes of Israel.
DEU 33:6 Let Reuben live, and not die! And let Simeon be many in number!
DEU 33:7 And to this Judah. Listen, O LORD, of the voice of Judah! and unto his people, may they enter in. His hands shall litigate for him, and you will be a helper from his enemies.
DEU 33:8 And to Levi he said, Give to Levi his manifestations and his truth! To the sacred man, whom they tested him in Trial. They reviled him at Water of Dispute.
DEU 33:9 The one saying to his father and to his mother, I have not seen you; and his brothers he did not recognize, and his sons he did not know. He guarded your oracles, and he observed your covenant.
DEU 33:10 They shall manifest your ordinances to Jacob, and your law to Israel. They shall place incense in the time of your anger always upon your altar.
DEU 33:11 Bless, O LORD his strength; and the works of his hands receive! Break the loin of his enemies having risen up against him! And the ones detesting him let not rise up!
DEU 33:12 And to Benjamin he said, One being loved by the LORD. He shall encamp being yielded, and God shadows over him all the days; and he rested between his shoulders.
DEU 33:13 And to Joseph he said, His land is of the blessing of the LORD, of seasons of heaven, and of dew, and of the deeps of springs below,
DEU 33:14 and according to the season of the offsprings of the circuits of the sun, and of the returns of the months;
DEU 33:15 from the top of ancient mountains, and from the top of everlasting hills,
DEU 33:16 and according to the fullness of the land in season, and the accepted things being seen in the bush - may they come upon the head of Joseph, and upon the top being glorified among brothers.
DEU 33:17 As a first-born bull is his beauty - horns of a unicorn are his horns. With them he shall gore nations together, even from the uttermost part of the earth. These are the myriads of Ephraim, and these are the thousands of Manasseh.
DEU 33:18 And to Zebulun he said, Be glad, O Zebulun, in your departure; and Issachar in your tents!
DEU 33:19 They shall utterly destroy nations, and you shall call upon there, and you shall sacrifice a sacrifice of righteousness; for the riches of the sea shall nurse you, and market-places dwelling on the coast.
DEU 33:20 And to Gad he said, One being blessed, widening Gad. As a lion he rested, having broken the arm, and the ruler.
DEU 33:21 And he beheld his first-fruit, for there the land was portioned by rulers being brought together, heads of peoples - the LORD did righteousness, and his equity was with Israel.
DEU 33:22 And to Dan he said, Dan, a lion cub - and he shall rush out from out of Bashan.
DEU 33:23 And to Naphtali he said, Naphtali, a fullness of acceptable things; and let him be filled with blessing from the LORD! You shall inherit the west and the south.
DEU 33:24 And to Asher he said, Asher is one being blessed of children; and he will be acceptable to his brothers; he shall dip his foot in olive oil;
DEU 33:25 iron and brass will be his sandal; and as your days so your strength.
DEU 33:26 There is not any as the God of the one being loved. The one mounting upon the heaven is your helper, even the majestic one of the firmament.
DEU 33:27 And the sovereignty of God shall shelter you, and that under the strength of everlasting arms. And he shall cast out from your face the enemy, saying, May you perish.
DEU 33:28 And Israel shall encamp alone complying; fountain of Jacob, with grain and wine; and the heaven covered with clouds in dew on him.
DEU 33:29 Blessed are you, O Israel. Who is likened to you, a people being delivered by the LORD? Your helper is the shield, and the sword of your boasting. And your enemies shall lie to you, and you shall mount upon their neck.
