DEU 34:2 and all the land of Naphtali, and all the land of Ephraim, and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah, unto the latter sea;
DEU 34:3 and the wilderness, and the places round about Jericho, City of Palms, unto Zoar.
DEU 34:4 And the LORD said to Moses, This is the land which I swore by an oath to Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, saying, To your seed I shall give it. And I showed it to your eyes, but there you shall not enter.
DEU 34:5 And Moses came to an end there, the servant of the LORD, in the land of Moab, by the word of the LORD.
DEU 34:6 And they entombed him in the land of Moab near the house of Peor. And not has any one known his burial place until this day.
DEU 34:7 And Moses was a hundred and twenty years old at his coming to an end. His eyes were not darkened, nor were his lips corrupted.
DEU 34:8 And the sons of Israel wept over Moses in the wilderness of Moab, at the Jordan, by Jericho for thirty days. And they completed the days of the mourning of weeping for Moses.
DEU 34:9 And Joshua son of Nun was filled of spirit of understanding; for Moses placed his hands upon him. And the sons of Israel hearkened to him, and they did in so far as the LORD gave charge to Moses.
DEU 34:10 And there rose up not any longer a prophet in Israel as Moses, whom the LORD knew him face to face,
DEU 34:11 in all the signs and miracles, which the LORD sent him to do them in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh, and to his attendants, and to all his land;
DEU 34:12 and the great wonders - and all by the fortified hand which Moses executed before all Israel.
JOS 1:1 And it came to pass after the decease of Moses the servant of the LORD, that the LORD spoke to Joshua son of Nun, the aid of Moses, saying,
JOS 1:2 Moses, my attendant has come to an end. Now then, rising up, pass over the Jordan, you, and all this people, into the land which I give to them!
JOS 1:3 Every place upon which ever you should mount the track of your feet, I will give it to you, in which manner I spoke to Moses.
JOS 1:4 From the wilderness, and the Antilebanon, unto the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and unto the great sea from the descent of the sun, will be your boundaries.
JOS 1:5 A man shall not withstand before you all the days of your life. And as I was with Moses, so I will be also with you. And I will not abandon you, nor will I neglect you.
JOS 1:6 Be strong and manly! For you shall divide up to this people the land, which I swore by an oath to your fathers to give to them.
JOS 1:7 Be strong then and manly, to guard and to do in so far as I gave charge to you by Moses my servant! And do not turn aside from them to the right or to the left, that you should perceive in all what ever you should act on!
JOS 1:8 And this book of the law shall not leave from your mouth; and you shall meditate in it day and night, that you should perceive to do all the things written in it. Then you shall prosper your ways, and then you shall perceive.
JOS 1:9 Behold, I give charge to you - be strong and be manly! You should not be timid, nor should you be terrified, for the LORD your God is with you in every place where ever you should go.
JOS 1:10 And Joshua gave charge to the scribes of the people, saying,
JOS 1:11 Enter in the midst of the camp of the people, and give charge to the people! saying, Prepare provisions! For yet in three days even you pass over this Jordan, entering to take control of the land which the LORD God of your fathers gives to you.
JOS 1:12 And to Reuben, and to Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, Joshua said,
JOS 1:13 Remember the word of the LORD which Moses the servant of the LORD gave charge to you! saying, The LORD your God rested you, and gave to you this land.
JOS 1:14 Your wives, and your children, and your cattle - let them dwell in the land which Moses gave to you on the other side of the Jordan! And you shall pass over well-equipped prior to your brothers, every one being strong, and you shall fight along with them;
JOS 1:15 until whenever the LORD your God should rest your brothers, as also you. And so they shall be heir also to this land which the LORD your God gives to them. Then you shall go forth each unto his own inheritance, which Moses gave to you on the other side of the Jordan from the east sun.
JOS 1:16 And answering to Joshua, they said, All as much as you should give charge to us we will do, and into every place where ever you should send us, we will go.
JOS 1:17 According to all as much as we hearkened to Moses, we will hearken to you. Furthermore let the LORD our God be with you, in which manner he was with Moses!
JOS 1:18 And the man who ever should resist you, and who ever should not hearken to your words, in so far as you should give charge to him, let him die! But be strong and be manly!
JOS 2:1 And Joshua son of Nun sent from out of Shittin two men to spy, saying, Ascend and behold the land and Jericho! And going, they entered into a house of a woman harlot, whose name was Rahab, and rested up there.
JOS 2:2 And it was reported to the king of Jericho, saying, Men have entered here of the sons of Israel to spy out the land.
JOS 2:3 And the king of Jericho sent, and said to Rahab, saying, Lead out the men entering into your house in the night! for they have come to spy out the land.
JOS 2:4 And the woman taking the two men hid them. And she said to them, saying, The men entered to me, and I do not know from where they were.
JOS 2:5 But as the gate was locked in the darkness, and the men went forth, I have not knowledge of where they went. You pursue after them, and you shall overtake them!
JOS 2:6 But she brought them upon the roof, and hid them in the stalk of flax having been piled by her upon the roof.
JOS 2:7 And the men pursued after them on the way unto the Jordan near the ford - and the gate was locked.
JOS 2:8 And it came to pass as the ones pursuing after them went forth, and before their going to sleep, that she ascended upon the roof to them.
JOS 2:9 And she said to them, I know that the LORD gave the land to you, for the fear of you has fallen upon us, and all the ones dwelling the land are struck with awe of you.
JOS 2:10 For we have heard that the LORD God totally dried up the red sea before your face, when you went forth from out of Egypt, and as much as you did to the two kings of the Amorites who were on the other side of the Jordan, to Sihon and to Og, of which you utterly destroyed them.
JOS 2:11 And having heard, we were amazed in our heart, and there was not yet a spirit established in any one because of your presence; for the LORD your God is the God in heaven upward, and upon the earth below.
JOS 2:12 And now, swear by an oath to me by the LORD God! for I performed an act of mercy to you, and you shall also perform yourself an act of mercy in the house of my father, and you shall give to me a true sign.
JOS 2:13 Take alive the house of my father, and my mother, and my brothers, and my sisters, and all of my house, and all as much as is theirs! And you shall rescue our life from death.
JOS 2:14 And the men said to her, Our life for yours, even unto death. And she said, Whenever the LORD should deliver up the city to you, you shall perform for me an act of mercy and truth.
JOS 2:15 And she let them down through the window, for her house was in the wall, and in the wall she dwelt.
JOS 2:16 And she said to them, Go forth into the mountainous area, lest there should meet up with you the ones pursuing! And you shall be hidden there three days until whenever the ones pursuing after you should return; and after this you shall go forth into your way.
JOS 2:17 And the men said to her, We are innocent in this your oath.

JOS 9:11 And our elders spoke to us, and all the ones dwelling in our land, saying, Take to yourselves provisions for the journey, and go to meet with them! And you shall say to them, We are your servants - and now ordain with us the covenant!
JOS 9:12 These are our bread loaves we took hot, being provided of them from our houses in the day in which we came forth to come to you. And now, behold, they are dry, and have become worm eaten.
JOS 9:13 And these are the leather bags of the wine which we filled new - and these are torn. And these are our garments made old from the exceedingly long journey.
JOS 9:14 And the rulers took their provisions, and the mouth of the LORD they did not ask.
JOS 9:15 And Joshua made peace with them, and ordained with them a covenant, and the rulers of the congregation swore by an oath to them.
JOS 9:16 And it came to pass after three days, after the ordaining with them a covenant, they heard that they are near them, and that they dwelt among them.
JOS 9:17 And the sons of Israel departed, and came forth into their cities the third day. And their cities were Gibeon, and Chephirah, and Beeroth, and cities of Jearim.
JOS 9:18 And the sons of Israel did not wage war with them, for all the rulers of the congregation swore by an oath to them by the LORD God of Israel. And all the congregation complained about the rulers.
JOS 9:19 And all the rulers said to all the congregation, We swore by an oath to them by the LORD God of Israel. And now, we shall not be able to touch them.
JOS 9:20 This we will do to them - to take them alive, and we will preserve them, and there will not be anger against us on account of the oath which we swore by an oath to them.
JOS 9:21 And the rulers said to them, They shall live, and they shall be woodcutters and water-carriers to all the congregation, just as the rulers said to them.
JOS 9:22 And Joshua called them together, and he spoke to them, saying, Why did you mislead me, saying, We are exceedingly far from you; but you are natives of the ones dwelling among us?
JOS 9:23 And now you are accursed, in no way shall there fail from one of you being a servant, nor woodcutter, nor a water-carrier to me, and to my God.
JOS 9:24 And they answered to Joshua, saying that, A message was announced to us, as much as the LORD your God ordered Moses his servant to give to you this land, and to utterly destroy us, and all the ones dwelling upon it, from in front of you. And we feared exceedingly for our lives from your presence, and we did this thing.
JOS 9:25 And now, behold, we are under your hands. As it pleases you and as it seems good to do to us, you do it!
JOS 9:26 And they did to them thus, and Joshua rescued them in that day from the hands of the sons of Israel, and they did not do away with them.
JOS 9:27 And Joshua established them in that day as woodcutters and water-carriers to all the congregation, and for the altar of God, until the day today, and for the place which ever he should choose.
JOS 10:1 And as Adoni-zedec king of Jerusalem heard that Joshua took Ai, and utterly destroyed it; in which manner he did to Jericho and her king, and thus they did also to Ai and her king; and that the ones dwelling in Gibeon deserted to Joshua and to Israel, and were in the midst of them;
JOS 10:2 that they feared among themselves exceedingly, for he knew that Gibeon was a great city, as also one of the mother-cities of the kings, for it was great over Ai, and all its men were strong.
JOS 10:3 And Adoni-zedec king of Jerusalem sent to Holam king of Hebron, and to Piram king of Jarmuth, and to Japhia king of Lachish, and to Debir king of Eglon, saying,

JOS 10:5 And they gathered and ascended, the five kings of the Amorites - the king of Jerusalem, and the king of Hebron, and the king of Jerimuth, and the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon, they and all their people. And they besieged Gibeon, and attempted to capture it.

JOS 10:12 Then Joshua spoke to the LORD in the day God delivered up the Amorites under the hand of the sons of Israel. And Joshua said, Let the sun stand over Gibeon, and the moon over the ravine of Ajalon.
JOS 10:13 And the sun and the moon stood in position until God repulsed their enemies. Is this not written in the scroll of the upright? And the sun stood in the midst of the heaven, it did not go forth into descent for the completion of one day.
JOS 10:14 And there was not such a day nor former nor latter, so as for God to heed the voice of man, because the LORD joined in war with Israel.
JOS 10:15 And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him to the camp in Gilgal.

JOS 10:17 And it was reported to Joshua, saying, The five kings have been found hiding in the cave in Makkedah.
JOS 10:18 And Joshua said, Roll great stones upon the mouth of the cave, and place upon them men to guard them!
JOS 10:19 But you do not stand off pursuing after your enemies! But overtake their rear guard, and do not let them enter into their cities, for the LORD our God delivered them into our hands!
JOS 10:20 And it came to pass as Joshua rested, and the son of Israel, in beating them with an exceedingly great slaughter even unto completion, that the ones surviving were delivered from them, and entered into the fortified cities.
JOS 10:21 And all the people returned to Joshua in Makkedah in the camp in health - and not one of the sons of Israel growled with his tongue.
JOS 10:22 And Joshua said, Open the cave, and lead out to me these five kings from out of the cave!
JOS 10:23 And they did thus, and led to him these five kings from out of the cave - the king of Jerusalem, and the king of Hebron, and the king of Jarmuth, and the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon.
JOS 10:24 And when they led them to Joshua, then Joshua called together every man of Israel, saying to them, and the ones commencing the war going with him, saying to them, Go forth and place your feet upon their necks! And coming forward, they placed their feet upon their necks.
JOS 10:25 And Joshua said to them, You should not fear them nor be timid. Be manly and be strong, for thus the LORD shall do to all your enemies whom you make war against them!
JOS 10:26 And after this Joshua killed them, and put them to death, and hung them upon five trees. And they were hanging upon the trees until evening.
JOS 10:27 And it came to pass towards the descent of the sun, and Joshua gave charge, and they lowered them from the trees. And they tossed them into the cave into which they took refuge there. And they rolled great stones upon the cave, which remains until the day today.
JOS 10:28 And Joshua took Makkedah in that day, and slaughtered it by the mouth of the blade, and the king. And they utterly destroyed them, and every one breathing that was in it. And there was not left behind in it any one surviving. And they did to the king of Makkedah in which manner they did to the king of Jericho.
JOS 10:29 And Joshua went forth, and all Israel with him, from out of Makkedah, unto Libna, and they assaulted against Libna.
JOS 10:30 And the LORD delivered it also into the hand of Israel. And they took it, and its king. And they did to its king in which manner they did to the king of Jericho.
JOS 10:31 And Joshua went forth, and all Israel with him, from out of Libna, unto Lachish, and besieged it, and assaulted it.
JOS 10:32 And the LORD delivered Lachish into the hands of Israel. And he took it on the second day, and he slaughtered it by the mouth of the blade, and utterly destroyed it in which manner he did to Libna.
JOS 10:33 Then Horam king of Gezer ascended to help Lachish. And Joshua struck him by the mouth of the blade, and his people, until there was not being left behind of them one being delivered and escaping.
JOS 10:34 And Joshua went forth, and all Israel with him, from Lachish unto Eglon; and he besieged it, and captured it.
JOS 10:35 And the LORD delivered it into the hand of Israel. And he took it in that day, and slaughtered it by the mouth of the blade, and every one breathing in it. In that day they slaughtered in which manner they did to Lachish.
JOS 10:36 And Joshua went forth, and all Israel with him, from Eglon unto Hebron; and they besieged it.
JOS 10:37 And they overtook it, and struck it by the mouth of the blade, and its king, and all its villages, and every one breathing, as many as was in it - there was not one surviving; in which manner they did to Eglon; even they utterly destroyed it and all breathing as was in it.
JOS 10:38 And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to Debir; and they besieged it.

JOS 22:4 And now the LORD our God rested our brothers, in which manner he spoke to them. Now then in returning, you go forth to your houses, and to the land of your possession, which Moses the bondman of the LORD gave to you on the other side of the Jordan.

JOS 22:18 And you were turned away today from the LORD, and tomorrow there will be anger upon all Israel.
JOS 22:19 And now, if the land of your possession be small, pass over into the land of the possession of the LORD, where the tent of the LORD encamps there! And you inherit among us, and be not defectors from the LORD, and do not separate from us on account of your building a shrine outside the altar of the LORD our God!
JOS 22:20 Behold, did not Achan the son of Zara trespass a trespass from the offering for consumption, and anger became upon all the congregation? And this one only sinned, but not this one alone died for his sin.
JOS 22:21 And they answered, (the sons of Reuben, and the sons of Gad, and the half tribe of Manasseh,) and said to the commanders of thousands of Israel, saying,
JOS 22:22 God, the LORD is God. And God, the LORD God himself knows, and Israel itself shall know - if we trespassed by defection before the LORD, may he not rescue us in this day.
JOS 22:23 And if we built a shrine for ourselves, so as to depart from the LORD, or so as to haul upon it a sacrifice of whole burnt offerings, or so as to make upon it a sacrifice of deliverance, the LORD himself shall inquire.
JOS 22:24 But we did this thing because of veneration, saying that, Should tomorrow your children say to our children, saying, What is it to you and to the LORD God of Israel?
JOS 22:25 And the LORD put a border between us and you, the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad - the Jordan; and there is not a portion to you of the LORD. And your sons shall separate from our sons, that they should not worship the LORD.
JOS 22:26 And we said to do thus, to build this shrine, not because of yield offerings, nor because of sacrifices;
JOS 22:27 but that this testimony might be between us and between you, and between our generations after us, to serve the service of the LORD before him in our yield offerings, and in our sacrifices, and in the sacrifices of our deliverances offerings; and so that your children shall not say tomorrow to our children, There is not a portion to you of the LORD.
JOS 22:28 And we said, If it comes to pass at some time or other, and they shall speak to us or to our generations tomorrow, then we shall say, Behold, it is a representation of the altar of the LORD, which our fathers made! It is not for yield offerings, nor for sacrifices; but it is a testimony between you, and between us, and between our sons.
JOS 22:29 May it not be then for us to leave from the LORD, so as to turn away in today's days from the LORD, so as to build us an altar for the yield offerings, and the sacrifice offerings, and the sacrifice of deliverance offering, except for the altar of the LORD our God which is before his tent.

JOS 23:11 But guard exceedingly your lives, to love the LORD your God!
JOS 23:12 For if you should turn away, and should proceed to leave behind these nations with you, and you should make connections by marriage with them, and mix together with them, and they with you -
JOS 23:13 with knowledge know that in no way shall the LORD your God proceed to utterly destroy these nations from your face. And they will be to you for snares, and for obstacles, and for nails in your heels, and for arrows in your eyes, until whenever you should destroy them from this good land which the LORD your God gave to you.
JOS 23:14 But I run today the way as also all the ones upon the earth. And you shall know in your whole heart, and in your whole soul, that one word failed not from all of the good words of which the LORD our God spoke concerning you. JOS 23:15 And it will be in which manner all the good things come unto you which the LORD your God spoke unto you; so the LORD will bring upon you all the bad things, until he should utterly destroy you from this good land which the LORD your God gave to you,

JOS 24:13 And he gave to you the land upon which you tired not by labor upon it, and cities which you built not, and you settled upon them. And he gave vineyards and olive groves which you planted not, but you shall eat from.

JOS 24:17 The LORD our God - he led us and our fathers from out of the land of Egypt, from out of the house of slavery, and as many as these great signs he did to us, and guarded us in all the way which we went by it, and among all the nations which we went through them.

JDG 8:4 And Gideon came upon the Jordan, and passed over, and the three hundred men with him, faint-hearted and hungering.
JDG 8:5 And he said to the men of Succoth, Give indeed breads for the nourishment to this people with me, for they hunger! For I pursue after Zebah and Zalmunna, kings of Midian.
JDG 8:6 And the rulers of Succoth said, The hand of Zebah and Zalmunna is not now in your hand, that we shall give to your military breads.
JDG 8:7 And Gideon said, Is it not thus in the giving by the LORD Zebah and Zalmunna into my hand, that I will rend in shreds your flesh with the thorn-bushes of the wilderness, and with the Barkenim?
JDG 8:8 And he ascended from there to Penuel, and spoke to them according to these things. And the men of Penuel answered to him in which manner the men of Succoth answered to him.
JDG 8:9 And Gideon said to the men of Penuel, saying, In my returning with peace, I will raze this tower.
JDG 8:10 And Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor, and their camp with them, about fifteen thousand, all the ones being left in all the camp of the sons of the east. And the ones falling were a hundred and twenty thousand men unsheathing the broadsword.
JDG 8:11 And Gideon ascended the way of the ones dwelling in tents from the east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and struck the camp - and the camp was secure.
JDG 8:12 And Zebah fled, and Zalmunna. And he pursued after them, and took hold of the two kings of Midian - Zebah and Zalmunna, and all their camp was startled.
JDG 8:13 And Gideon the son of Joash returned from the battle from the ascent of Ares.
JDG 8:14 And he seized a servant from the men of Succoth, and questioned him. And he registered for him the rulers of Succoth, and their elders - seventy and seven men.
JDG 8:15 And he came to the rulers of Succoth. And he said to them, Behold, Zebah and Zalmunna, by whom you berated me, saying, Not is the hand of Zebah and Zalmunna now in your hand, that we will give breads to your men fainting.
JDG 8:16 And he took the rulers and the elders of the city into the thorn-bushes of the wilderness, and the Barkenim. And he rent with them the men of Succoth.
JDG 8:17 And the tower of Penuel he razed, and killed the men of the city.
JDG 8:18 And he said to Zebah and Zalmunna, What manner are the men whom you killed in Tabor? And they said, As you, so they are likened to you - likened to them as the appearance of sons of kings.
JDG 8:19 And Gideon said, They are sons of my brothers of my mother. As the LORD lives, if you brought them forth alive, I would not have killed you.
JDG 8:20 And he said to Jether his first-born, In rising up, kill them! And the boy did not unsheathe his sword, for he feared, for he was younger.
JDG 8:21 And Zebah and Zalmunna said, You rise up indeed yourself and meet us! For as a man is, so also his power. And Gideon rose up, and did away with Zebah and Zalmunna, and took the crescents on the necks of their camels.
JDG 8:22 And a man of Israel said to Gideon, Rule among us, you and your son, and the son of your son! For you have delivered us from the hand of Midian.
JDG 8:23 And Gideon said to them, I will not rule you, and my son will not rule among you - the LORD shall rule you.
JDG 8:24 And Gideon said to them, I will ask from you a request, and you give to me - every man an ear-ring of his spoils; (for ear-rings of gold was to them, because they were Ismaelites.)
JDG 8:25 And they said, In giving we will give. And he unfolded his garment, and each man tossed there an ear-ring of his spoils.
JDG 8:26 And was the weight of the ear-rings of gold which he asked for - a thousand and seven hundred shekels of gold, besides the ornaments of the crescents, and the wrap arounds of the purple garments upon the kings of Midian - even besides the collars of the ones on the necks of their camels.
JDG 8:27 And Gideon made to himself for an ephod, and set it in his city, in Ophrah. And all Israel fornicated after it there. And it became an obstacle to Gideon and his house.
JDG 8:28 And Midian was in remorse before the sons of Israel, and they proceeded not yet to lift their head. And the land was tranquil forty years in the days of Gideon.
JDG 8:29 And Jerubbaal son of Joash went and dwelt in his house.
JDG 8:30 And to Gideon there were seventy sons going forth from out of his thighs, for there were many wives to him.
JDG 8:31 And his concubine in Shechem - she bore to him also indeed a son, and put upon him his name - Abimelech.
JDG 8:32 And Gideon the son of Joash died with good grayness of hair. And he was entombed in the burying-place of Joash his father, in Ophrah of the Abi-ezrites.
JDG 8:33 And it came to pass as Gideon died, that the sons of Israel returned and fornicated after the Baalim, and established to themselves Baal-berith for a covenant, for him to be to them for god.
JDG 8:34 And the sons of Israel did not remember the LORD their God, the one rescuing them from out of the hand of all their enemies round about.
JDG 8:35 And they did not do mercy with the house of Jerubbaal - Gideon, according to all the goodness which he did with Israel.
JDG 9:1 And Abimelech the son of Jerubbaal went into Shechem to the brothers of his mother. And he spoke to them, and to all the kin of the house of his mother's father, saying,
JDG 9:2 Speak indeed into the ears of all the men of Shechem, saying, Which is best to you, for seventy men to rule you, all the sons of Jerubbaal, or for one man to dominate you? And you should remember that I am of your bone and of your flesh.
JDG 9:3 And the brothers of his mother spoke concerning him in the ears of all of the men of Shechem all these words. And their heart leaned after Abimelech; for they said, He is our brother.
JDG 9:4 And they gave to him seventy pieces of silver from out of the house of Baal-berith. And Abimelech hired for them vain and distraught men. And they went behind him.
JDG 9:5 And he entered to the house of his father at Ophrah, and killed his brothers, the sons of Jerubbaal - seventy men upon one stone. But Jotham the younger son of Jerubbaal was left behind, for he was hidden.
JDG 9:6 And came together all the men of Shechem, and all the house of Millo, and they went and gave reign to Abimelech as king at the acorn tree of the station in Shechem.
JDG 9:7 And they announced to Jotham, and he went, and stood on the top of mount Gerizim, and lifted up his voice, and called, and said to them, Hear me men of Shechem, and God shall hear you!
JDG 9:8 In going, the trees went forth to anoint for themselves a king. And they said to the olive tree, You reign over us!
JDG 9:9 And the olive tree said to them, Allowing my fatness, which God glorified in me, and men, shall I go to rule over the trees?
JDG 9:10 And the trees said to the fig-tree, Come, you reign over us!
JDG 9:11 And the fig-tree said to them, Allowing my sweetness and my good produce, should I go to rule the trees?
JDG 9:12 And the trees said to the grapevine, Come, you reign over us!
JDG 9:13 And the grapevine said to them, Allowing my wine, the gladness of God, and of the ones of men, should I go to rule over the trees?
JDG 9:14 And all the trees said to the white-thorn shrub, Come, You reign over us!
JDG 9:15 And the white-thorn shrub said to the trees, If in truth you anoint me yourselves to reign over you, come rely in my protection - and if not, may fire come forth from the white-thorn shrub, and may it devour the cedars of Lebanon.
JDG 9:16 And now, if in truth and in soundness you made even Abimelech reign, and if you did well with Jerubbaal, and with his house, and if according to the recompense of his hand you did to him,
JDG 9:17 as my father waged war for you, and tossed his life right opposite, and rescued you from out of the hand of Midian;
JDG 9:18 and you rose up against the house of my father today, and you killed his sons, seventy men upon one stone, and gave reign to Abimelech the son of his maidservant over the men of Shechem, for he is your brother;
JDG 9:19 and if you acted in truth and perfection with Jerubbaal, and his house in this day, may you be glad in Abimelech, and may he be glad also indeed himself in you.
JDG 9:20 If not, may fire come forth from Abimelech, and devour the men of Shechem, and the house Millo; and may fire come forth from the men of Shechem, and from out of the house of Millo, and devour Abimelech.
JDG 9:21 And Jotham ran away and fled, and went unto Beer. And he dwelt there away from the face of Abimelech his brother.
JDG 9:22 And Abimelech ruled over Israel three years.
JDG 9:23 And God sent a bad spirit between Abimelech, and between the men of Shechem. And the men of Shechem annulled allegiance with the house of Abimelech;
JDG 9:24 so as to bring the injustice done to the seventy sons of Jerubbaal, and for their blood to be put upon Abimelech their brother, the one killing them; and upon the men of Shechem, of the ones strengthening their hands so as to kill his brothers.
JDG 9:25 And the men of Shechem put for him ones lying in wait upon the top of the mountains. And they kidnapped all the ones going along by them in the way. And it was reported to Abimelech.
JDG 9:26 And Gaal the son of Ebed came and his brothers, and they went unto Shechem. And the men of Shechem relied in him.
JDG 9:27 And they went forth into the field, and gathered the vintage of their vineyards, and they treaded, and they made a dance, and entered into the house of their god, and ate, and drank, and cursed Abimelech.
JDG 9:28 And Gaal son of Ebed said, Who is Abimelech, and who is the son of Shechem, that we shall serve to him? Is he not the son of Jerubbaal, and Zebul his overseer, his manservant with the men of Hamor, father of Shechem? And why is it that we shall serve to him ourselves?
JDG 9:29 And if any should give this people into my hand, then I shall remove Abimelech. And I shall say to Abimelech, Multiply your force, and come forth!
JDG 9:30 And Zebul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal son of Ebed, and he was enraged in anger.
JDG 9:31 And he sent messengers to Abimelech with bribes, saying, Behold, Gaal the son of Ebed, and his brothers have come unto Shechem; and know, they assault the city against you.
JDG 9:32 And now rise up at night, you and the people with you, and lie in wait in the field!
JDG 9:33 And it will be in the morning, together with the rising of the sun, that you shall rise early and stretch out against the city. And behold, when he and the people with him go forth against you, that you shall do to him just as your hand should find opportunity.
JDG 9:34 And Abimelech rose up, and all the people with him at night. And they laid in wait at Shechem - four companies.
JDG 9:35 And Gaal son of Ebed came forth, and stood at the door of the gate of the city. And Abimelech rose up, and all the people with him, from the ambush.
JDG 9:36 And Gaal son of Ebed saw the people. And he said to Zebul, Behold, a people coming from the tops of the mountains. And Zebul said to him, The shadow of the mountains you see as men.
JDG 9:37 And Gaal proceeded still to speak, and said, Behold, a people coming down as a sea from the part next to the navel of the earth, and one company arrives from the way of the Oak of the Seers.
JDG 9:38 And Zebul said to him, Where is your mouth, the one saying, Who is Abimelech, that we shall serve to him? Is this not the people whom you treated with contempt? Go forth indeed now and wage war with him!
JDG 9:39 And Gaal went forth from the presence of the men of Shechem, and made war against Abimelech.
JDG 9:40 And Abimelech pursued him, and he fled from his face. And there fell slain many unto the doors of the city.
JDG 9:41 And Abimelech settled in Arumah. And Zebul cast out Gaal and his brothers, so as to not live in Shechem.
JDG 9:42 And it came to pass in the next day, and came forth the people into the plain, and reported to Abimelech.
JDG 9:43 And he took the people, and divided them into three companies, and laid in wait in the field, and watched, and, behold, a people came forth from out of the city; and he rose up against them, and struck them.
JDG 9:44 And Abimelech, and the companies with him, stretched out and stood by the door of the gate of the city. And the other two companies poured out upon all the ones in the field, and he struck them.
JDG 9:45 And Abimelech made war against the city that entire day. And they overtook the city; and the people in it they killed. And he demolished the city, and sowed it with salt.
JDG 9:46 And all the men of the tower of Shechem heard, and they entered into the fortress of the house of Bethel-berith.
JDG 9:47 And it was announced to Abimelech that all the men of the tower of Shechem were brought together.
JDG 9:48 And Abimelech ascended into mount Zalmon, he and all the people with him. And Abimelech took the axe in his hand, and cut a load of wood, and took it, and put it upon his shoulders. And he said to the people with him, What you see me doing, quickly, you do as also I!
JDG 9:49 And they felled wood, and indeed to them all each was a load. And they lifted, and went after Abimelech, and placed the wood at the fortress, and set fire to them at the fortress with fire. And all died - the men of the tower of Shechem, about a thousand men and women.
JDG 9:50 And Abimelech went unto Thebez, and besieged it, and first took it.
JDG 9:51 And there was a strong tower in the midst of the city. And fled there all the men, and the women, and all the leaders of the city. And they shut up themselves, and ascended upon the roof of the tower.
JDG 9:52 And Abimelech came unto the tower, and they subdued it by war. And Abimelech approached unto the door of the tower to burn it with fire.
JDG 9:53 And a woman tossed one piece of millstone upon the head of Abimelech, and it fractured his skull.
JDG 9:54 And he yelled out quickly to the servant lifting his weapons. And he said to him, Unsheathe my broadsword and kill me, lest at any time they should say that, A woman killed him! And his servant stabbed him, and he died.
JDG 9:55 And each man of Israel saw that Abimelech died, and each man departed to his place.
JDG 9:56 And God returned the evil of Abimelech, which he did to his father by killing his seventy brothers.
JDG 9:57 And all the evil of the men of Shechem, God returned on their own head. And came upon them the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal.
JDG 10:1 And rose up after Abimelech to deliver Israel, Tola son of Phua, son of his uncle, a man of Issachar. And he dwelt in Shamir in mount Ephraim.
JDG 10:2 And he judged Israel twenty and three years, and died, and was entombed in Shamir.
JDG 10:3 And rose up after him Jair the Gileadite; and he judged Israel twenty and two years.
JDG 10:4 And there were born to him thirty sons mounted upon thirty foals. And thirty cities were his. And they called them, Properties of Jair until this day - the ones which are in the land of Gilead.
JDG 10:5 And Jair died, and was entombed in Camon.
JDG 10:6 And the sons of Israel proceeded to do the wicked thing before the LORD. And they served to the Baalim, and to the Ashtaroths, and to the gods of Syria, and to the gods of Sidon, and to the gods of Moab, and to the gods of the sons of Ammon, and to the gods of the Philistines. And they abandoned the LORD, and did not serve to him.
JDG 10:7 And the LORD was enraged in anger against Israel, and he gave them into the hand of the Philistines, and into the hand of the sons of Ammon.
JDG 10:8 And they disintegrated and crushed the sons of Israel in that year - eighteen years, all of the sons of Israel on the other side of the Jordan, in the land of the Amorite, in Gilead.
JDG 10:9 And the sons of Ammon passed over the Jordan to wage war even against Judah and Benjamin, and against the house of Ephraim. And they afflicted the sons of Israel exceedingly.
JDG 10:10 And the sons of Israel cried out to the LORD, saying, We sinned against you, for we abandoned our God, and we served to the Baalim.
JDG 10:11 And the LORD said to the sons of Israel, Is it not the Egyptians, and the Amorites, and the sons of Ammon, and Moab, and the Philistines,
JDG 10:12 and Sidonians, and Amalek, and Canaan that squeeze you out? And you cried out to me, and I delivered you from out of their hand.
JDG 10:13 And you abandoned me, and served other gods. On account of this I will not proceed to deliver you.
JDG 10:14 Proceed and yell to the gods whom you chose for yourselves, and let them deliver you in the time of your affliction!
JDG 10:15 And the sons of Israel said to the LORD, We sinned, do to us according to all whatever as much as should be pleasing before you, only rescue us in this day!
JDG 10:16 And they removed the alien gods from their midst, and served to the LORD. And he was faint-hearted over the toil of Israel.
JDG 10:17 And there ascended up the sons of Ammon, and camped in Gilead. And the sons of Israel came forth and camped in Mizpeh.
JDG 10:18 And the people and the rulers of Gilead said each man to his neighbor, Who is the man who shall begin to wage war with the sons of Ammon? for he shall be head to all the ones dwelling in Gilead?
JDG 11:1 And Jephthah the Gileadite was mighty in strength. And he was the son of a harlot woman. And she bore Jephthah to Gilead.
JDG 11:2 And the wife bore to Gilead himself sons. And the sons of the woman matured, and they cast out Jephthah, and said to him, You shall not inherit among the house of our father, for you are a son of a mistress woman.
JDG 11:3 And Jephthah ran away from the face of his brothers, and dwelt in the land of Tob. And cheap men collected together with Jephthah, and went forth together with him.
JDG 11:4 And it came to pass after some days, that the sons of Ammon waged war against Israel. And it came to pass when the sons of Ammon waged war with Israel,
JDG 11:5 that the elders of Gilead went forth to take Jephthah from the land of Tob.
JDG 11:6 And they said to Jephthah, Come, and you will be to us as a leader, for we shall make war with the sons of Ammon.
JDG 11:7 And Jephthah said to the elders of Gilead, Is it not that you detest me, and cast me from out of the house of my father, and sent me from you? And why is it that you came to me now when you are afflicted?
JDG 11:8 And the elders of Gilead said to Jephthah, Not so, now we gathered together to you, and you shall go with us, and we shall wage war against the sons of Ammon, and you will be to us as head to all the ones dwelling in Gilead.
JDG 11:9 And Jephthah said to the elders of Gilead, If you return me to yourselves to make war against the sons of Ammon, and the LORD should deliver them before me, I will be to you for head.
JDG 11:10 And the elders of Gilead said to Jephthah, Let the LORD be the one hearing between us, if not according to your word thus we will do!
JDG 11:11 And Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead. And the people established him over them as head, and for leader. And Jephthah spoke all his words before the LORD in Mizpeh.
JDG 11:12 And Jephthah sent messengers to the king of the sons of Ammon, saying, What is it to me and to you, that you come to me to wage war in my land?
JDG 11:13 And the king of the sons of Ammon said to the messengers of Jephthath, Because Israel took my land in their ascending from out of Egypt, from Arnon unto Jabok, and unto the Jordan. And now return them with peace!
JDG 11:14 And Jephthah again added, and he sent messengers to the king of the sons of Ammon.
JDG 11:15 And they said to him, Thus says Jephthah, Israel did not take the land of Moab, and the land of the sons of Ammon.
JDG 11:16 In their ascending from out of Egypt, it is that Israel went in the wilderness unto the red sea, and came to Kadesh.
JDG 11:17 And Israel sent messengers to the king of Edom, saying, I shall go through your land. And the king of Edom hearkened not, and indeed to the king of Moab Israel sent, and he would not, and Israel settled in Kadesh.
JDG 11:18 And Israel went through in the wilderness, and encircled the land of Edom and the land of Moab. And it arrived according to the rising of the sun of the land of Moab, and camped on the other side of Arnon, and did not enter into the border of Moab.
JDG 11:19 And Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, king of Heshbon. And Israel said to him, I shall go by through your land unto my place.
JDG 11:20 And Sihon did not want Israel to go through his borders. And Sihon gathered all his people, and they camped at Jahaz, and he waged war with Israel.
JDG 11:21 And the LORD God of Israel delivered up Sihon and all his people into the hand of Israel. And they struck them, and Israel inherited all the land of the Amorites dwelling in that land.
JDG 11:22 And Israel inherited all the border of the Amorites, from Arnon and unto the Jabok, and from the wilderness unto the Jordan.
JDG 11:23 And now the LORD God of Israel lifted away the Amorite from the face of his people Israel. And you - shall you inherit it?
JDG 11:24 Is it not that as much as Chemosh your god allots to you, them you will inherit? And all as much as the LORD our God inherits from your person we shall inherit them.
JDG 11:25 And now are you any better than Balak son of Sephor king of Moab? Did he not with battle do combat with Israel, or by war wage war with them?
JDG 11:26 In the living of Israel in Heshbon, and in her daughter cities, and in Aroer, and in her daughter cities, and in all the cities by the Jordan for three hundred years - Why is it that you did not rescue them in that time?
JDG 11:27 And I sinned not against you, but you do wickedness with me to wage war against me. May the LORD judge, the one judging today, between the sons of Israel and between the sons of Ammon.
JDG 11:28 And the king of the sons of Ammon hearkened not to the words of Jephthah which he sent to him.
JDG 11:29 And spirit of the LORD became upon Jephthah, and he passed over Gilead, and Manasseh, and he passed over the height of Gilead, and from the height of Gilead to the other side of the sons of Ammon.
JDG 11:30 And Jephthah vowed a vow to the LORD, and said, If by delivering up you should deliver up the sons of Ammon in my hand,
JDG 11:31 then it will be concerning the one going forth, who ever might come from the doors of my house for meeting me in my returning in peace from the sons of Ammon, that it will be to the LORD, and I will offer him a whole burnt offering.
JDG 11:32 And Jephthah passed over to the sons of Ammon to wage war against them. And the LORD delivered them into his hand.
JDG 11:33 And he struck them from Aroer, and unto the coming to Minnith - twenty cities; and unto the Abel vineyards, with an exceedingly great beating. And the sons of Ammon showed respect in front of the sons of Israel.
JDG 11:34 And Jephthah came to Mizpeh to his house, and behold, his daughter went forth for meeting him with tambourines and dancers, and she was an only child. And there was not to him a son or daughter besides her.
JDG 11:35 And it happened when he beheld her, that he tore his garments, and said, Alas my daughter, you impede me, for you became an impediment in my eyes, and I opened my mouth concerning you to the LORD, and I shall not be able to turn back.
JDG 11:36 And she said to him, If about me you opened your mouth to the LORD, let him do to me in which manner it came forth from out of your mouth, because the LORD did vengeance for you on your enemies, of the sons of Ammon.
JDG 11:37 And she said to her father, And do to me this thing! Allow me two months, and I shall go and shall come down upon the mountains, and I shall weep over the tokens of my virginity - I and my female companions.
JDG 11:38 And he said, Go! And he sent her out for two months. And she went, her and her female companions. And they wept over the tokens of her virginity upon the mountains.
JDG 11:39 And it came to pass after the end of the two months that she returned to her father. And Jephthah completed his vow which he vowed. And she did not know a man. And it became an order in Israel,
JDG 11:40 from days unto days the daughters of Israel go with one another to wail over the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite four days in the year.
JDG 12:1 And the sons of Ephraim gathered together, and came to Zaphon, and said to Jephthah, Why is it that you went to wage war against the sons of Ammon, and you did not call us to go with you? We will burn your house over you with fire.
JDG 12:2 And Jephthah said to them, I was a man pleading, and my people, and the sons of Ammon humbled me exceedingly, and I yelled out to you, and you did not deliver me from out of their hand.
JDG 12:3 And I saw that there was not one delivering, and I put my life in my hand, and I passed over to the sons of Ammon, and the LORD delivered them over into my hand. And why did you ascend against me in this day to wage war against me?
JDG 12:4 And Jephthah gathered together all the men of Gilead, and waged war against Ephraim. And the men of Gilead struck Ephraim; for the men coming through safe of Ephraim said, You are Gilead in the midst of Ephraim, and in the midst of Manasseh.
JDG 12:5 And Gilead was first to take the ford of the Jordan of Ephraim. And it came to pass when the ones coming through safe of Ephraim said to them, We should pass over indeed, that the men of Gilead said to them, Are you not from out of Ephraim? And they said, We are not.
JDG 12:6 Then they said to them, Say indeed, Stachys! And if they were not straightly able to speak thus, then they would take hold of them, and slay them at the ford of the Jordan. And they that fell from Ephraim in that time were forty and two thousand.

JDG 12:9 And there were to him thirty sons, and thirty daughters being sent out, and he brought in thirty wives for his sons from outside. And he judged Israel seven years.
JDG 12:10 And Ibzan died, and was entombed in Beth-lehem.
JDG 12:11 And Elon the Zebulunite judged Israel after him; and he judged Israel ten years.
JDG 12:12 And Elon the Zebulunite died, and was entombed in Aijalon, in the land of Zebulun.
