1KI 6:1 And it came to pass in the eightieth and four hundredth year of the exodus of the sons of Israel from out of Egypt, in the fourth year, in the second month in the reigning of king Solomon over Israel, that he built the house to the LORD.
1KI 6:2 And the house which king Solomon built to the LORD - sixty cubits its length, and twenty cubits its width, and thirty cubits its height.
1KI 6:3 And the columned porch in front of the temple - twenty cubits was the length of it upon the width of the house. And ten in cubit was its width according to the face of the house.
1KI 6:4 And he made for the house a window leaning - hidden.
1KI 6:5 And he put upon the wall of the house a ridge round about the temple - also to the dabir. And he made the sides round about.
1KI 6:6 The side underneath - five cubits was the width of it. And the middle - six cubits was the width. And the third - seven cubits was the width of it. For he made a space to the house round about from outside the house, so as to not take hold of the walls of the house.
1KI 6:7 And the house in the constructing it was built in whole chiseled stones. And a hammer, and hewing axe, and every item of iron, was not heard in the constructing it.
1KI 6:8 And the vestibule of the side beneath was by the protrusion of the house on the right side. And there was a winding ascent into the middle story, and from the middle unto the third story.
1KI 6:9 And he constructed the house, and completed it; and vaulted the house with cedars.
1KI 6:10 And he built the chambers through the entire house, five cubits was the height of it. And he held it together by bonding it together with timbers of cedars.
1KI 6:11 And came to pass the word of the LORD to Solomon, saying,
1KI 6:12 This house which you construct, if you travel by my orders, and you should observe my judgments, and should keep all my commandments, to pace in them; I will establish my word with you which I spoke to David your father.
1KI 6:13 And I will encamp in the midst of the sons of Israel, and I will not abandon my people Israel.
1KI 6:14 And Solomon built the house, and finished it.
1KI 6:15 And he built the walls of the house from inside with wood of cedars, from the floors of the house, and unto the walls, and unto the beams. And he vaulted it holding it together with timbers from inside. And he compassed the inside of the house with ribs of pines.
1KI 6:16 And he built twenty cubits from the top of the house of the sides of cedars from floor unto the beams. And he made it inside of the dabir in the holy of holies.
1KI 6:17 And the temple itself was forty cubits in front of the dabir.
1KI 6:18 And cedar covered the house inside. And there was carved gourds, and leaves opened and spread out - all cedar; and stone did not appear.
1KI 6:19 And the dabir was in the midst of the house within, to give place there for the ark of the covenant of the LORD.
1KI 6:20 Twenty cubits was the length, and twenty cubits the width, and twenty cubits the height of it. And he compassed it with gold being closed up.
1KI 6:21 And he made an altar according to the front of the dabir; and he compassed it in gold.
1KI 6:22 And the entire house was compassed in gold, unto completion of all the house.
1KI 6:23 And he made in the dabir two cherubim of wood of cypresses - ten cubits was the greatness being measured by a rule,
1KI 6:24 and five cubits was the wing of the one cherub, and the second was five cubits of its wing. Ten in a cubit from one part of its wing to the other part of its wing.
1KI 6:25 Thus to the second cherub with one measure and one completion with both.
1KI 6:26 And the height of the one cherub was ten in a cubit. So also the second cherub.
1KI 6:27 And he stationed both the cherubim in the midst of the innermost house. And their wings were open and spread out, and the one wing touched the wall of the house, and the wing of the second cherub touched the second wall; and their wings were in the midst of the house, touching wing to wing.
1KI 6:28 And he compassed the cherubim with gold.
1KI 6:29 And all the walls of the house round about he depicted sculptures with a stylus - cherubim, and palms and leaves opened and spread out to the inner and to the outer.
1KI 6:30 And the floor of the house he compassed with gold - of the innermost and the outermost.
1KI 6:31 And to the doorway of the dabir he made doors of wood of juniper, and five-fold doorways.
1KI 6:32 And two doors were of woods of pines. And sculptures upon them being sculpted of cherubim, and palms. And panels were opening and spreading out. And he compassed them with gold; and the gold came down upon the cherubim and over the palms.
1KI 6:33 And thus he made to the vestibule of the temple doorposts of woods of juniper, with fourfold stoas.
1KI 6:34 And in both the doors woods of pines were used - the one door was bi- fold, and their hinges were there; and the second door was bi- fold - turning;
1KI 6:35 being sculpted with cherubim and palms; and panels opening and spreading out, and being compassed with gold being led upon the impression.
1KI 6:36 And he built the inside courtyard - three rows of hewn stones, and a row being manufactured of cedar round about.
1KI 6:37 In the fourth year the house of the LORD was laid a foundation, in the month Zif.
1KI 6:38 And in the eleventh year, in the month of Bul, this is the eighth month, the house was completed according to all his words, and according to all his responsibilities. And he built it in seven years.
1KI 7:1 And Solomon constructed his own house for thirteen years. And he wholly completed his house.
1KI 7:2 And he constructed the house of the forest of Lebanon - a hundred cubits was its length, and fifty cubits its width, and thirty cubits its height upon four rows of columns of cedars, and protrusions of cedars for the columns.
1KI 7:3 And he decorated with fretwork in cedar the house above upon the sides of the columns. And the number of the columns was forty and five - ten and five in one row.
1KI 7:4 And three ridges, with place upon place thrice.
1KI 7:5 And all the doorways and the places were four-cornered being arched over, from the doorway upon the door thrice.
1KI 7:6 And the columned porch of the columns was fifty cubits in length, and thirty cubits in width, being joined together by a columned porch in front of them. And columns and thick beams were at the front to them.
1KI 7:7 And the columned porch of the throne of which he judged there, was a columned porch for the judgment seat. And it was decorated with fretwork in cedars from floor unto upper room.
1KI 7:8 And his house in which he shall sit there - one courtyard is expanding to these according to this work. And Solomon built a house, (for the daughter of Pharaoh whom Solomon took,) according to this columned porch.
1KI 7:9 These are all from out of valuable stones being chiseled, at an interval inside from the foundation unto the moldings, and outside to the great courtyard -
1KI 7:10 the laying a foundation with great valuable stones; stones ten cubits, and eight cubits in size.
1KI 7:11 And on top were valuable stones according to the same measure - hewn stones and cedars,
1KI 7:12 of the great courtyard round about with three rows of hewn stones, and a row being chiseled of cedar, even to the inner courtyard of the house of the LORD, and to the columned porch of the house.
1KI 7:13 And king Solomon sent and took Hiram from out of Tyre,
1KI 7:14 a son of a widow woman, and this one was from the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a Tyrian man, a fabricator of brass, and being accomplished of the wisdom of the craft, and of understanding, and of full knowledge to do all the work in brass. And he was brought to king Solomon, and he did every work.
1KI 7:15 And he cast in a furnace the two columns for the columned porch of the house - eighteen cubits was the height of the column, and the perimeter had a two and ten cubits measuring cord encircling it. And so was the second column.
1KI 7:16 And he made two capitals to put upon the heads of the molten columns of brass - five cubits was the height of the one capital, and five cubits was the height of the second capital.
1KI 7:17 And he made latticed works to cover the capitals of the columns; seven to the capital - to the one; and seven to the capital - to the second.
1KI 7:18 And a hanging work - two rows of pomegranates of brass being made of lattice works, a hanging work, row upon row. And thus he did for the second capital.
1KI 7:19 2532 kaiAnd capitals upon the heads of the columns, a work of lily for the columned porch - four cubits; and a ridge upon both of the columns, and on top of the sides of the capital.
1KI 7:20 And the pomegranates - two hundred in rows upon the second capital.
1KI 7:21 And he set up the columns of the columned porch of the temple. And he set up the right column, and called the name of it - Jachin. And he set up the left column, and called the name of it - Boaz.
1KI 7:22 And upon the tops of the columns was a work of lily. And the work of the columns was finished.
1KI 7:23 And he made the cast sea - ten by a cubit from its rim unto its rim - globular; round about the same. Five by a cubit was its height. And a measuring line meeting together of thirty cubits encircled it.
1KI 7:24 And supports from beneath its rim round about encircled it - ten by a cubit raising up the sea round about; two rows of supports cast in the foundry furnace of them.
1KI 7:25 And twelve oxen were underneath the sea - three looking to the north, and three looking to the west, and three looking to the south, and three looking to the east. And the sea was upon them on top.
1KI 7:26 And all the oxen posteriors were to the inside. And the thickness of it was a palm, and the rim of it was as a rim work of a cup with a lily bud - It had a capacity of two thousand coos.
1KI 7:27 And he made ten bases of brass - four cubits was the length of the one base, and four cubits the width of it, and three cubits was the height of it.
1KI 7:28 And this is the work of the base joining it, and joining between the protruding parts.
1KI 7:29 And upon the joineries, between the protruding parts, were lions, and oxen, and cherubim. And upon the protruding parts so also from above and from below the lions and the oxen were places of a descending work.
1KI 7:30 And four wheels of brass were to the one base; and the fasteningsaxles. of brass and its four parts of their protrusion supports were from beneath the bathing tubs; and protrusion supports for a man to pour from the other side were situated before. And the mouth of it, within the top and upward, was one cubit.
1KI 7:31 And the mouth of it was globular, a thing made thus - a cubit and half a cubit. And upon its mouth were carvings. And their small pillarsaxle trees. were four-cornered, not globular.
1KI 7:32 And four wheels were underneath the small pillars. And handsaxles. were in the wheels in the base. And the height of the one wheel was a cubit and a half.
1KI 7:33 And the work of the wheels was as the work of chariot wheels. And their hands and their backs and their matters were all castedtheir axle-trees, rims and spokes..
1KI 7:34 And four protrusion supports were upon the four corners of the one base. From out of the base were its shoulders.
1KI 7:35 And upon the head of the base - a half a cubit was its globular size round about upon the head of the base. And the hands of it and its joineries were of it; and it opened upon the beginnings of its hands.
1KI 7:36 And its joinery was cherubim, and lions, and standing palms, each being next to the other in front of it inside, round about.
1KI 7:37 According to this he made ten bases, with one order and one measure to all.
1KI 7:38 And he made ten pots of brass, having the capacity of forty coos to the one pot, measuring four cubits. And one pot was upon the one base for the ten bases.
1KI 7:39 And he placed the ten bases - five on the protrusion support of the house at the right sides, and five on the protrusion support of the house at the left sides; and the sea on the protrusion support of the house was at the right sides, according to the east from the side of the south.
1KI 7:40 And Hiram made the kettles, and the tongs, and the bowls. And Hiram completed making all the works which he made for king Solomon in the house of the LORD -
1KI 7:41 two columns and the twisted works of the carvings being upon the heads of the two columns; and two latticed works to cover both the twisted carvings being upon the columns;
1KI 7:42 and the pomegranates - four hundred, to both the latticed works; two rows of pomegranates to the one latticed work, to cover all over both the twisted works being upon both of the columns;
1KI 7:43 and the ten bases, and the ten pots upon the bases;
1KI 7:44 and the one sea, and the twelve oxen underneath the sea;
1KI 7:45 and the kettles, and the tongs, and the bowls. And all the items which Hiram made for king Solomon for the house of the LORD were entirely of brass.
1KI 7:46 In the adjacent area of the Jordan the king cast them in the thick earth between Succoth and between Zarthan.
1KI 7:47 And Solomon the king put unweighed all the items, because of the exceeding multitude - there was not a weight of the brass.
1KI 7:48 And Solomon made all the items in the house of the LORD - the golden altar, and the table upon which are the breads of the golden place setting,
1KI 7:49 and the five lamp-stands at the right sides, and five at the left sides, in front of the dabir - being completely made golden, and the oil lamp bowls, and the lamps, and the golden oil funnels,
1KI 7:50 and the thresholds, and the nails, and the bowls, and the saucers, and the golden incense pans joined, and the doorways of the doors of the innermost house, of the holy of holies, and the doors of the house of the temple were of gold.
1KI 7:51 And all the work which Solomon did was fulfilled for the house of the LORD. And Solomon carried in the holy things of David his father - the silver and the gold; and the equipment he put into the treasury of the house of the LORD.
1KI 8:1 Then king Solomon held an assembly of all the elders of Israel, and all rulers of the tribes - leaders of the families of the sons of Israel, for king Solomon in Jerusalem to bear the ark of the covenant of the LORD from out of the city of David - this is Zion;
1KI 8:2 in the month Athanim during its holiday - this is the seventh month. And all the elders of Israel came.
1KI 8:3 And the priests lifted the ark,
1KI 8:4 and the tent of the testimony, and all the holy items for the tent of the testimony.
1KI 8:5 And the king, and all the people of Israel, were before the ark sacrificing oxen and sheep - innumerable.
1KI 8:6 And the priests carried the ark of the covenant of the LORD unto its place - into the dabir of the house, into the holy of holies, under the wings of the cherubim.
1KI 8:7 For the cherubim were being opened and spread out in the wings over the place of the ark. And the cherubim covered all over the ark, and over its holy things from above.
1KI 8:8 And the sanctified staves projected, and the heads of the sanctified staves looked out from the holies unto the front of the dabir. And they were not seen outside, and they were there until this day.
1KI 8:9 There was not anything in the ark except the two tablets of stone - tablets of the covenant, which Moses put there in Horeb, which the LORD ordained with the sons of Israel in their going forth from out of the land of Egypt.
1KI 8:10 And it happened as the priests came forth from out of the holy place, that the cloud filled the house.
1KI 8:11 And the priests were not able to stand to officiate in front of the cloud, for the glory of the LORD filled the house of the LORD.
1KI 8:12 Then Solomon said, The LORD spoke of encamping in dimness.
1KI 8:13 And I built a house to your name, holy to you, and readied, and to your form, for you to encamp in it into the eons.
1KI 8:14 And the king turned his face, and blessed all Israel. And all the assembly of Israel stood.
1KI 8:15 And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, who spoke by his mouth concerning David my father, and by his hands fulfilled, saying,
1KI 8:16 From which day I led out my people Israel from Egypt, I have not chosen a city in one chiefdom of Israel to build a house for my name to be there; but I chose in David to be the one leading over my people Israel.
1KI 8:17 And it was upon the heart of David my father to build a house to the name of the LORD God of Israel.
1KI 8:18 And the LORD said to David my father, That it was upon your heart to construct a house to my name you did well, for it was upon your heart.
1KI 8:19 Except you shall not build the house; but your son coming forth from out of your sides, this one shall build the house to my name.
1KI 8:20 And the LORD raised up his word which he spoke, and I am risen up instead of David my father, and I sat down upon the throne of Israel, as the LORD spoke. And I built the house to the name of the LORD God of Israel.
1KI 8:21 And I established there a place for the ark, in which is there the covenant of the LORD, which the LORD ordained with our fathers, in his leading them from out of the land of Egypt.
1KI 8:22 And Solomon stood in front of the altar of the LORD before all the assembly of Israel, and opened and spread out his hands into the heaven.
1KI 8:23 And he said, O LORD God of Israel, there is not a God as you, in the heaven upward, and upon the earth below, guarding covenant and mercy with your servant going before you with his entire heart;
1KI 8:24 which you kept with your servant David, my father, which you have spoken by your mouth; and by your hands you fulfilled, as even this day.
1KI 8:25 And now, O LORD God of Israel, keep with your servant David my father that which you spoke to him! saying, There shall not be lifted away from you a man from my face sitting upon the throne of Israel; except that your sons shall guard their ways, to go before me as you went before me.
1KI 8:26 And now, O LORD God of Israel, trustworthy indeed is your word to David my father.
1KI 8:27 But shall truly God dwell with men upon the earth? Shall the heaven and the heavens of the heavens not be sufficient for you? How then also this house which I built to your name?
1KI 8:28 And should you look also upon my prayer, upon my supplication, O LORD God of Israel, to hear the supplication and the prayer, which your servant prays before you, to you today;
1KI 8:29 for your eyes to be open towards this house day and night, to this place which you said, My name shall be there, to listen to the prayer which your servant prays in this place;
1KI 8:30 then you shall hearken to the supplication of your servant, and of your people Israel, as many things as they should pray in this place; and you should hear in the place of your dwelling in heaven, and you shall act, and shall be propitious,
1KI 8:31 to as many things as a man should sin against his neighbor. And if he should take upon himself an oath to curse him, and he should come and should declare openly in front of your altar in this house;
1KI 8:32 then you shall listen from out of the heaven, and shall act, and shall judge your people Israel, to act as lawless with the lawless - to impute his way upon his head; and to do justice with the just one - to impute to him according to his righteousness.
1KI 8:33 And in the failing of your people Israel before their enemies - because they shall sin against you, and shall return and shall acknowledge your name, and shall pray, and shall beseech in this house;
1KI 8:34 then you shall hearken from the heaven, and shall be propitious to the sins of your people Israel, and shall turn towards them in the land which you gave to their fathers.
1KI 8:35 And in the holding together the heaven, and there not being rain, because they shall sin against you; and if they shall pray in this place, and shall acknowledge your name, and shall turn from their sins, whenever you should humble them;
1KI 8:36 then you shall listen from the heaven, and you shall be propitious to the sins of your servant, and of your people Israel. For you shall manifest to them the good way to go by it. And you shall give rain upon your land, which you gave to your people for an inheritance.
1KI 8:37 And if famine should happen, if plague should happen, when there will be a grasshopper blasting, if blight should happen, and if his enemy should afflict him in one of their cities, every event, every misery,
1KI 8:38 every prayer, every supplication, if it should happen to any man, whenever each one should know the infection of his heart, and should open and spread out his hands in this house,
1KI 8:39 then you shall hearken from out of the heaven, from out of your prepared home, and you shall be propitious, and you shall act, and you shall impute to a man according to all his ways, (as even you should know his heart; for you alone know the heart of all of the sons of men;)
1KI 8:40 so that they should fear you all the days which they live upon the earth which you gave to our fathers,
1KI 8:41 and to the alien who is not from your people - this Israel, that shall come from a land far off on account of your name;
1KI 8:42 (for they shall hear your great name, and your strong hand, and your high arm,) and shall come and shall pray to this place;
1KI 8:43 then you shall listen from the heaven, from out of your prepared home, and you shall act according to all what the alien should call upon you, so that all the peoples of the land should know your name, so that they should fear you, as your people Israel, and should know that your name has been called upon in this house which I built.
1KI 8:44 And if your people should go forth to war against their enemies, in the way which you shall send them, and they shall pray by the name of the LORD by way of the city of which you chose in it, and the house which I built to your name;
1KI 8:45 then you shall listen from out of the heaven to their supplication, and their prayer, and shall do justice to them.
1KI 8:46 For they shall sin against you, (for there is not a man who shall not sin,) and if you shall strike upon them, and should deliver them up before their enemies, and the ones taking captive should take them captive into a land far or near;
1KI 8:47 and they shall turn their hearts in the land which they were led away there, and they shall turn, and shall beseech you in the land of their displacement, saying, We sinned, we acted lawlessly, we did wrong;
1KI 8:48 and they shall turn to you with their entire heart, and with their entire soul in the land of their enemies who led them away, and should pray to you by way of their land, which you gave to their fathers, and of the city which you chose, and of the house of which I constructed to your name;
1KI 8:49 then you shall listen from out of the heaven, from your prepared home, of their prayer and their supplication, and you shall do the just thing for them,
1KI 8:50 and you shall be propitious to their iniquities which they sinned against you, and according to all their disregardings which ever they disregarded; and you shall appoint them for compassions before the ones capturing them, and they shall pity them.
1KI 8:51 For they are your people, and your inheritance, whom you led out from out of the land of Egypt, from out of the midst of the foundry furnace of iron.
1KI 8:52 And let your eyes and your ears be open to the supplication of your servant, and to the supplication of your people Israel, to hearken to them in all what ever they should call upon you!
1KI 8:53 For you drew them apart unto yourself for an inheritance from out of all the peoples of the earth, as you spoke by the hand of your servant Moses, in your leading out our fathers from the land of Egypt, O Lord, O LORD.
1KI 8:54 And it came to pass as Solomon completed praying to the LORD all the prayer, and this supplication, that he rose up from in front of the altar of the LORD, having kneeled upon his knees, and his hands being opened and spread out unto the heaven,
1KI 8:55 and stood, and blessed all the assembly of Israel with a great voice, saying,
1KI 8:56 Blessed be the LORD who gave today rest to his people Israel, according to all as many things as he spoke. Not one word perished in all of his good words which he spoke by the hand of Moses his servant.
1KI 8:57 May the LORD our God be with us as he was with our fathers. May he not abandon us, nor turn from us -
1KI 8:58 to incline our heart to himself, to go in all his ways, and to guard all his commandments, and his orders, and his judgments, which he gave charge to our fathers.
1KI 8:59 And let these words be which I have beseeched before the LORD our God today, approaching to the LORD our God day and night, to do the right action for your servant, and the right action for your people Israel - a days matter in its day!
1KI 8:60 So that all the peoples of the earth should know that the LORD God - he is God, and is there not another.
1KI 8:61 And let our hearts be perfect to the LORD our God, to go sacredly by his orders, and to keep his commandments as this day!
1KI 8:62 And the king, and all the sons of Israel sacrificed a sacrifice before the LORD.
1KI 8:63 And king Solomon sacrificed the sacrifices of the peace offerings, which he sacrificed to the LORD - two and twenty thousand oxen, and a hundred and twenty thousand sheep. And the king dedicated the house of the LORD, and with all the sons of Israel.
1KI 8:64 In that day the king sanctified the middle of the courtyard in front of the house of the LORD; for he prepared there the whole burnt offering, and the sacrifice offerings, and the fats of the peace offerings, because the altar of brass before the LORD was small so as to not be able to receive the whole burnt offering, and the gift offering, and the sacrifices of the peace offerings.
1KI 8:65 And Solomon observed the holiday feast in that day, and Israel with him - a great assembly, from the entering of Hamath unto the river of Egypt, before the LORD our God, seven days and seven days - four and ten days.
1KI 8:66 And on the eighth day he sent out the people; and they blessed the king, and each went forth unto his tent rejoicing and having a good heart over the good things which the LORD did to David his servant, and to Israel his people.
1KI 9:1 And it came to pass as Solomon completed constructing the house of the LORD, and the house of the king, and all the matters of Solomon, as many things as he wanted to do,
1KI 9:2 that the LORD appeared to Solomon the second time, as he appeared to him in Gibeon.
1KI 9:3 And the LORD said to him, I heard your prayer and your supplication, which you beseeched before me. I sanctified this house, which you built, to establish my name there into the eon; and my eyes and my heart will be there all the days.
1KI 9:4 And you, if you should go before me as your father David went, in sacredness of heart, and in straightness, to do according to all which I gave charge to him, and you should keep my orders and my commandments,
1KI 9:5 then I will raise up the throne of your kingdom over Israel into the eon, as I spoke to your father David, saying, There shall not be removed from you a man leading in Israel.
1KI 9:6 But if by turning, you should turn, you and your children, from me and my orders which I put before you, so as to not keep them, and you should go and should serve other gods, and should do obeisance to them;
1KI 9:7 then I will remove Israel from the land which I gave to them; and this house, which I sanctified to my name, I shall throw away from my face; and Israel will be for extinction and for a discussion among all the peoples.
1KI 9:8 And this lofty house - every one traveling by it shall be amazed, and shall whistle; and they shall say, For what reason did the LORD do thus to this land, and to this house?
1KI 9:9 And they shall say, Because they abandoned the LORD their God, the one leading their fathers from out of the house of slavery of Egypt, and they took hold of alien gods, and they did obeisance to them, and served to them. On account of this the LORD brought upon them all this evil.
1KI 9:10 And it came to pass after twenty years in which Solomon constructed the two houses, the house of the LORD, and the house of the king,
1KI 9:11 (Hiram the king of Tyre assisted Solomon with timbers of cedars, and with timbers of pines, and in gold, and in all his want,) that then king Solomon gave to Hiram twenty cities in the land in Galilee.
1KI 9:12 And Hiram came forth from out of Tyre, and went to Galilee to behold the cities which Solomon gave to him, and they did not please him.
1KI 9:13 And Hiram said, What are these cities which you gave to me, O brother? And he called them The Border until this day.
1KI 9:14 And Hiram sent to Solomon a hundred and twenty talents of gold.
1KI 9:15 And this is the matter of the plunder which king Solomon brought to build the house of the LORD, and the house of the king, and the wall of Jerusalem, and the Akra to enclose the barrier of the city of David, and Hazor, and Megiddo, and Gezer.
1KI 9:16 For Pharaoh king of Egypt ascended and first took Gezer, and burnt it by fire, and the Canaanite dwelling in the city he put to death. And Pharaoh gave it as a dowry to his daughter, the wife of Solomon.
1KI 9:17 And Solomon built Gezer, and Beth-horon the lower,
1KI 9:18 and Baalath, and Tadmor in the wilderness,
1KI 9:19 and all the fortified cities which were to Solomon, and all the cities of the chariots, and all the cities of the horsemen, and the matters which Solomon engaged in to construct in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion;
1KI 9:20 and all the remaining people from the Hittite, and the Amorite, and the Perizzite, and the Canaanite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite, and the Gergasite, of the ones not being of the sons of Israel,
1KI 9:21 their children being left with them in the land, which the sons of Israel were not able to utterly destroy them, that Solomon led them into tribute until this day.
1KI 9:22 And from the sons of Israel Solomon did not appoint one for servitude; for they were men warriors, and his servants, and rulers, and his third rank, and rulers of his chariots, and his horsemen.
1KI 9:23 And the rulers were, (the ones having knowledge over the works of Solomon,) five hundred fifty dominating among the people doing work.

1KI 9:25 And Solomon offered thrice in a year whole burnt offerings and peace offerings upon the altar he built to the LORD. And he burnt incense upon it, the one which was before the LORD - and he finished the house.

1KI 9:27 And Hiram sent in the ship men mariners of his servants,, (people knowing to row the sea,) with the servants of Solomon.
1KI 9:28 And they came unto Ophir, and they took from there four hundred and twenty talents of gold, and brought them to king Solomon.
1KI 10:1 And the queen of Sheba heard the name of Solomon, and the name of the LORD, and came to test him with enigmas.
1KI 10:2 And she came to Jerusalem with an exceedingly heavy force, and camels lifting aromatics, and exceedingly much gold, and much valuable stone. And she went to king Solomon, and spoke to him all as much as was in her heart.
1KI 10:3 And Solomon explained to her all the words of her questions. There was not a word being overlooked by the king, which he did not explain to her.
1KI 10:4 And the queen of Sheba beheld all the intellect of Solomon, and the house which he built,
1KI 10:5 and the foods for Solomon, and the form of his servants, and the position of his ministers, and their clothes, and his wine servers, and his whole burnt offering which he offered in the house of the LORD - and she was beside herself.
1KI 10:6 And she said to king Solomon, The word is true which I heard in my land concerning the word about you, and concerning your intellect.
1KI 10:7 And I trusted not in the ones speaking to me, until of which I came, and my eyes have seen. And behold, it is not according to the half as they reported to me. You have added wisdom and good things over all the report which I heard in my land.
1KI 10:8 Blessed are your wives, and blessed are these your servants standing before you continually, and hearing your intellect.
1KI 10:9 May the LORD your God be blessing whom he wants by you, to put you upon the throne of Israel; because the LORD loves Israel to establish it into the eon, and to set you for king over them, to execute judgment in righteousness, and in their equity.
1KI 10:10 And she gave to Solomon a hundred and twenty talents of gold, and exceedingly much spices, and valuable stone. There had not come as those spices yet in multitude which the queen of Sheba gave to king Solomon.
1KI 10:11 And the ship of Hiram, carrying the gold from out of Ophir, brought exceedingly much hewn timbers, and valuable stone.
1KI 10:12 And the king made the hewn timbers for supports of the house of the LORD, and the house of the king, and stringed instruments, and lutes for the singers. There had not come such unhewn timbers unto the land, nor was seen somewhere until this day.
1KI 10:13 And king Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all as much as she wanted, and as much as she asked, outside of all which was given to her through the hand of king Solomon. And she returned and came unto her land, she and her servants.
1KI 10:14 And was the weight of the gold that came to Solomon in one year - six hundred sixty and six talents of gold,
1KI 10:15 apart from the tribute of the ones submitting, and the merchants, and all the kings of the other side of the Jordan, and the satraps of the land.
1KI 10:16 And king Solomon made two hundred spears of gold hammered out - six hundred weights of gold was used for the one spear.
1KI 10:17 And he made three hundred oblong shields of gold hammered out. Three minas of gold were used for the one oblong shield. And the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.
1KI 10:18 And the king made a great ivory throne, and gilded it in unadulterated gold -
1KI 10:19 with six stairs to the throne, and the upper part had calves from the places behind it to the throne. And There were hand rails on this side and that side upon the place of the chair, and two lions standing by the hand rails.
1KI 10:20 And there were twelve lions standing upon the six stairs on this side and that side. There was not such in any kingdom.
1KI 10:21 And all the vessels used by Solomon were of gold, and the bathing tubs were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were completely of gold. And there was not silver, for it was not thought anything in the days of Solomon.
1KI 10:22 For a ship of Tarshish belonged to king Solomon upon the sea with the ships of Hiram. One ship came to the king every three years out of Tarshish, with gold and silver, and turned and hewn stones.
1KI 10:23 And Solomon was magnified above all the kings of the earth in riches and intellect.
1KI 10:24 And all the kings of the earth sought the face of Solomon, to hear his intellect, which the LORD put in his heart.
1KI 10:25 And each brought his gifts to him - items of silver, and items of gold, and clothes, balsam and spices, and horses, and mules according to year by year.
1KI 10:26 And Solomon brought chariots and horsemen. And there were to him a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen. And he put them in the cities of the chariots, and with the king in Jerusalem.
1KI 10:27 And the king put the silver in Jerusalem as stones, and the cedars he put as the sycamine trees in the plain in multitude.
1KI 10:28 And the exiting of the horsemen of Solomon was from out of Egypt. And from out of Kue - the merchants of the king took merchandise from out of Kue in barter.
1KI 10:29 And there ascended an exiting from out of Egypt - a chariot for six hundred pieces of silver, and a horse for a hundred fifty pieces of silver. And thus to all the kings of the Hittites, and to the kings of Syria - by their hand they came forth.
1KI 11:1 And king Solomon was fond of women, and he took alien wives, and the daughter of Pharaoh, and Moabitish, and Ammonitish, and Edomites, and Sidonians, and Hittites -
1KI 11:2 they were from out of the nations which the LORD forbade to the sons of Israel, saying, You shall not enter to them, and they shall not enter to you; that they should not turn aside your hearts after their idols - for of them Solomon cleaved to love.
1KI 11:3 And there were to him wives ruling - seven hundred, and three hundred concubines. And his wives leaned his heart.
1KI 11:4 And it came to pass in a time of old age of Solomon, that his wives turned aside his heart after other gods. And his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God, as was the heart of David his father.
1KI 11:5 And Solomon went after Ashtoreth god of the Sidonians, and after Milcom the abomination of Ammon.
1KI 11:6 And Solomon did evil before the LORD, and did not go after the LORD as David his father.
1KI 11:7 Then Solomon built a high place to Chemosh, the idol of Moab, in the mountain before Jerusalem, and to Molech the idol of the sons of Ammon.
1KI 11:8 And thus he did for all his alien wives, who were burning incense and sacrificing to their idols.
1KI 11:9 And the LORD was provoked to anger at Solomon, for he turned aside his heart from the LORD God of Israel - the one appearing to him twice.
1KI 11:10 And it was being given charge to him, for this thorough word - to not go after other gods. And he guarded not what the LORD gave charge to him.
1KI 11:11 And the LORD said to Solomon, Because these things happened with you, and you guarded not my commandments and my orders, which I gave charge to you, in tearing I will tear up your kingdom from out of your hand, and will give it to your servant.
1KI 11:12 Except in your days I will not do them on account of David your father - from out of the hand of your son I will take it.
1KI 11:13 Except the entire kingdom in no way shall I take. One chiefdom I will give to your son because of David my servant, and because of Jerusalem the city which I chose.
1KI 11:14 And the LORD raised up an adversary against Solomon, Hadad the Edomite - from out of the seed of the kingdom in Edom.
1KI 11:15 And it happened in David utterly destroying Edom, in the going of Joab the ruler of the military to bury the slain, that they smote every male in Edom;
1KI 11:16 (for six months Joab laid in wait there and all Israel, until of which time he utterly destroyed every man of Edom.)
1KI 11:17 and Hadad ran away, he and the Edomite men of the servants of his father with him. And they entered into Egypt. And Hadad was a small boy.
1KI 11:18 And they rose up from out of Midian, and came into Paran. And they took men with themselves, and came to Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Hadad entered to Pharaoh, and Pharaoh gave to him a house, and ordered breads for him, and gave land to him.
1KI 11:19 And Hadad found favor before Pharaoh, exceedingly. And he gave to him a wife, the sister of his wife - the older sister of Tahpenes.
1KI 11:20 And the sister of Tahpenes bore to him, to Hadad, Genubath her son. And Tahpenes nourished him in the midst of the house of Pharaoh. And Genubath was in the house of Pharaoh in the midst of the sons of Pharaoh.
1KI 11:21 And Hadad heard in Egypt that David had gone to sleep with his fathers, and that Joab the ruler of the military had died. And Hadad said to Pharaoh, Send me, and I will return unto my land.
1KI 11:22 And Pharaoh said to Hadad, What do you lack with me, that behold, you seek to go forth into your land? And Hadad said to him, Not one thing, but by sending you shall send me.
1KI 11:23 And God raised up another adversary against him, Rezon son of Eliadah, who fled from Hadadezer king of Zobah his master.
1KI 11:24 And men were gathered together against him; and he was ruler of the confederation, and he first took Damascus, and settled in it, and reigned in Damascus.
1KI 11:25 And there was an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon - this is the evil which Hadad did, and oppressed against Israel, and reigned in the land of Edom.
1KI 11:26 And Jeroboam son of Nebat, the Ephrathite from Zereda, son of a widow woman, was a servant of Solomon.
1KI 11:27 And this was the thing he did as he lifted up the hand against king Solomon. And king Solomon built the Akra, and completed the barrier of the city of David his father.
1KI 11:28 And the man Jeroboam was strong in power. And Solomon saw the young man, that he is a man of works, and he placed him over the tribute of the house of Joseph.
1KI 11:29 And it came to pass in that time that Jeroboam came forth out of Jerusalem, and Ahijah the Shilonite the prophet found him in the way; and Ahijah separated him from the way. And Ahijah was wearing a new cloak, and both were alone in the plain.
1KI 11:30 And Ahijah took hold of his own cloak, the new one upon him, and tore it into twelve pieces.
1KI 11:31 And he said to Jeroboam, Take for yourself ten pieces! For thus says the LORD God of Israel, Behold, I tear the kingdom from out of the hand of Solomon, and I give to you ten chiefdoms.
1KI 11:32 And two chiefdoms will be his, on account of my servant David, and on account of Jerusalem the city which I chose in it from out of all the tribes of Israel -
1KI 11:33 because he abandoned me, and offered unto Ashtoreth the abomination of the Sidonians, and to Chemosh the idol of Moab, and to Milcom the loathsome thing of the sons of Ammon. And he went not in my ways to do the upright thing before me, and my orders, and my ordinances, as David his father did.
1KI 11:34 And in no way will I take the kingdom entirely from his hand; (for by resisting I shall resist him all the days of his life,) because of David my servant - whom I chose him, who guarded the commandments and my ordinances.
1KI 11:35 And I shall take the kingdom from out of the hand of his son, and I will give to you the ten chiefdoms.
1KI 11:36 But to his son I will give the two chiefdoms, so that there might be a designation to my servant David all the days before me in Jerusalem, the city which I chose for myself to put my name there.
1KI 11:37 And you shall take, and you shall reign in wherever your soul desires, and you will be king over Israel.
1KI 11:38 And it will be if you should guard all as much as I gave charge to you, and should go in my ways, and do the upright thing before me, to keep my orders, and my commandments, as did David my servant; then I will be with you, and I shall build for you a sure house, as I built to David.
1KI 11:39 And I will give to you Israel, and I will mistreat the seed of David on account of these things, except not for all the days.
1KI 11:40 And Solomon sought to put Jeroboam to death. And he rose up, and ran away unto Egypt, to Shishak king of Egypt. And he was in Egypt until Solomon died.
1KI 11:41 And the rest of the words of Solomon, and all as many things as he did, and all his intellect - behold, have not these been written in the scroll of the sayings of Solomon?
1KI 11:42 And the days which Solomon reigned in Jerusalem was forty years over all Israel.
1KI 11:43 And Solomon slept with his fathers, and they entombed him in the city of David his father. And Rehoboam his son reigned instead of him.
1KI 12:1 And king Rehoboam went to Shechem; for all Israel came unto Shechem to give him reign.
1KI 12:2 And it came to pass as Jeroboam son of Nebat heard of it, (and he was still being in Egypt, as he had fled from the face of king Solomon, and settled in Egypt;)
1KI 12:3 that they sent and called him. And Jeroboam came and all the people of Israel. And the people spoke to king Rehoboam, saying,
1KI 12:4 Your father hardened our neck yoke. And you now, lighten of the hard servitude of your father, and from his heavy neck yoke, of which he put upon us, and we will serve to you!
1KI 12:5 And he said to them, Go forth for three days, and return to me! And they went forth.
1KI 12:6 And king Rehoboam reported to the elders who were standing before Solomon his father while he was still living, saying, How do you counsel that I should answer to this people a word?
1KI 12:7 And they spoke to him, saying, If in this day you will be a servant to this people, and should serve them, and shall speak to them with good words, then they will be to you servants all the days.
1KI 12:8 And he abandoned the counsel of the elders, which they advised him, and took up advice with the young men being brought up with him standing before his face.
1KI 12:9 And he said to them, What do you advise, and what should I answer to this people speaking to me, saying, Lighten up the neck yoke which your father put upon us?
1KI 12:10 And they spoke to him - the young men having been brought up with him. And they said, Thus you shall speak to this people speaking to you, saying, Your father oppressed our neck yoke, and you now lighten it from us! Thus you shall say to them, My thinness is thicker than the loin of my father.
1KI 12:11 And now, my father saddled you with a heavy neck yoke, and I will add unto your neck yoke. My father corrected you with whips, but I will correct you with scorpions.
1KI 12:12 And Jeroboam came, and all Israel to king Rehoboam on the third day, as the king spoke to them, saying, Return to me the third day!
1KI 12:13 And the king answered to the people hard. And Rehoboam abandoned the counsel of the elders which they advised him.
1KI 12:14 And he spoke to them according to the counsel of the young men, saying, My father oppressed your neck yoke, and I shall add to your neck yoke. My father corrected you with whips, and I will correct you with scorpions.
1KI 12:15 And the king did not hear the people, for it was a conversion by the LORD, so that his word should stand, which he spoke by the hand of Ahijah the Shilonite over Jeroboam son of Nebat.
1KI 12:16 And all Israel knew that the king hearkened not to them. And the people answered to the king, saying, What is our portion with David? and, There is not an inheritance to us with the son of Jesse. Run, O Israel, to your tents! Now graze your own house, David! And Israel went forth to his tents.
1KI 12:17 And the sons of Israel dwelling in the cities of Judah gave reign to Rehoboam over them.
1KI 12:18 And king Rehoboam sent Adoram, the one for collecting the tribute. And all Israel stoned him with stones, and he died. And king Rehoboam anticipated by ascending upon the chariot, to flee into Jerusalem.
1KI 12:19 And Israel annulled allegiance with the house of David until this day.
1KI 12:20 And it came to pass as all Israel heard that Jeroboam returned from out of Egypt, that they sent and called him to the congregation. And they gave him reign over Israel. And there was not one following after the house of David except the chiefdom of Judah and Benjamin only.
1KI 12:21 And Rehoboam entered into Jerusalem, and he held an assembly of all the congregation of Judah, and the chiefdom of Benjamin - a hundred and twenty thousand young men for making war, to wage war against the house of Israel, to return the kingdom of Rehoboam son of Solomon.
1KI 12:22 And there came to pass the word of the LORD to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,
1KI 12:23 Speak to Rehoboam, son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all the house of Judah and Benjamin, and to the rest of the people! saying,
1KI 12:24 Thus says the LORD, You shall not ascend, nor wage war with your brethren of the sons of Israel. Let each return to his house, for from me this thing has taken place! And they hearkened to the word of the LORD, and ceased to go against the saying of the LORD.
1KI 12:25 And Jeroboam built Shechem in mount Ephraim, and dwelt in it; and he went forth from there and built Penuel.
1KI 12:26 And Jeroboam said in his heart, Behold, now the kingdom shall return to the house of David.
1KI 12:27 If this people should ascend to offer a sacrifice in the house of the LORD in Jerusalem, then the heart of the people shall turn towards their master, to Rehoboam king of Judah, and they shall kill me.
1KI 12:28 And the king consulted, and made two heifers of gold. And he said to the people, Let it be enough for you to ascend to Jerusalem! Behold, your gods, O Israel, the ones leading you from out of the land of Egypt.
1KI 12:29 And he put the one in Beth-el, and the other one he put in Dan.
1KI 12:30 And this account came to pass for sin. And the people went after the one unto Dan.
1KI 12:31 And he made houses upon high places, and appointed priests from any part of the people who were not of the sons of Levi.
1KI 12:32 And Jeroboam made a holiday feast in the eighth month, on the fifteenth day of the month, according to the holiday in Judah. And he ascended unto the altar which he made in Beth-el, to sacrifice to the heifers which he made. And he placed in Beth-el the priests of the high places which he made.
1KI 12:33 And he ascended unto the altar which he made in the fifteenth day in the eighth month, in the holiday which he shaped out of his own heart. And he made the holiday for the sons of Israel, and ascended unto the altar to sacrifice upon it.
1KI 13:1 And behold, a man of God came from out of Judah with a word of the LORD unto Beth-el. And Jeroboam stood upon the altar to sacrifice.
1KI 13:2 And he called upon the altar with the word of the LORD, and said, O altar, O altar, thus says the LORD, Behold, a son is born to the house of David, Josiah is his name, and he shall sacrifice upon you the priests of the high places sacrificing upon you, and bones of men he shall burn upon you.
1KI 13:3 And he executed in that day a miracle, saying, This is the saying which the LORD spoke, saying, Behold, the altar is torn, and the fatness being upon it shall be poured out.
1KI 13:4 And it came to pass as king Jeroboam heard the words of the man of God calling upon the altar in Beth-el, that he stretched out his hand from the altar, saying, Seize him! And his hand withered which he stretched out against him, and he was not able to return it to himself.
1KI 13:5 And the altar tore, and the fatness poured out from the altar, according to the portent which the man of God gave by the word of the LORD.
1KI 13:6 And the king answered, and said to the man of God, Beseech the face of the LORD your God, and return my hand to me! And the man of God beseeched the face of the LORD, and the hand of the king returned to him, and became as formerly.
1KI 13:7 And the king spoke to the man of God, Enter with me to my house and dine, and I will give to you a gift!
1KI 13:8 And the man of God said to the king, If you should give to me half of your house, I will not enter with you, neither will I eat bread, nor drink water in this place.
1KI 13:9 For thus the LORD gave charge to me by a word, saying, In no way should you eat bread, nor in any way should you drink water, nor in any way should you return in the way in which you came by it.
1KI 13:10 And he went forth by another way, and returned not in the way which he came by it unto Beth-el.
1KI 13:11 And a prophet, one old man, dwelt in Beth-el. And his sons came and described to him all the works which the man of God did in that day in Beth-el, and the words which he spoke to the king. And they turned the face of their father.
1KI 13:12 And their father said to them, saying, Which way has he went? And his sons showed to him the way which the man of God went, the one coming from out of Judah.
1KI 13:13 And he said to his sons, Saddle for me the donkey! And they saddled for him the donkey. And he mounted upon him,
1KI 13:14 and went after the man of God, and found him sitting down under the oak, and said to him, Are you the man of God coming from out of Judah? And he said, I am.
1KI 13:15 And he said to him, Come with me, and eat bread!
1KI 13:16 And he said, In no way am I able to return with you, nor should I eat bread, nor in any way should I drink water in this place.
1KI 13:17 For so it has been given charge to me by the word of the LORD, saying, You shall not eat bread there, and you shall not drink water, and you shall not return there in the way in which you went by it.
1KI 13:18 And he said to him, And I am a prophet as you, and an angel spoke to me by word of the LORD, saying, Return him with yourself to your house, and let him eat bread, and drink water! But he lied to him.
1KI 13:19 And he returned him, and he ate bread, and he drank water in his house.
1KI 13:20 And it came to pass of them sitting down at the table, that the word of the LORD came to the prophet having returned him.
1KI 13:21 And he said to the man of God having come from out of Judah, saying, Thus says the LORD, Because you rebelled against the saying of the LORD, and guarded not the commandment which the LORD your God gave charge to you,
1KI 13:22 but you returned and ate bread, and drank water in this place, in which he spoke to you, saying, You shall not eat bread nor drink water - in no way shall your body enter into the burying-place of your fathers.
1KI 13:23 And it came to pass after he ate bread and drank water, that he saddled for him the donkey - for the prophet, and he returned.
1KI 13:24 And he went forth, and a lion found him in the way, and killed him. And his body was tossed in the way, and the donkey stood by it, and the lion stood by the body.
1KI 13:25 And behold, men coming near also beheld the decaying flesh tossed in the way, and the lion standing next to the decaying flesh. And they entered and spoke in the city of which the prophet, the old man, dwelt in it.
1KI 13:26 And the one returning him from out of the way heard, and said, This is the man of God who rebelled against the word of the LORD. And the LORD gave him to the lion, and it broke him, and it killed him, according to the word of the LORD which he spoke to him.
1KI 13:27 And he spoke to his sons, saying, You saddle for me the donkey! And they saddled it.
1KI 13:28 And he went, and found his body having been tossed in the way, and the donkey and the lion were standing by the body, and the lion did not eat the body, and it did not break the donkey.
1KI 13:29 And the prophet lifted the body of the man of God, and placed it upon the donkey, and returned it to the city of the old prophet, to lament and to entomb him.
1KI 13:30 And he put his body in his tomb. And they lamented him, saying, Woe, O brother.
1KI 13:31 And it came to pass after lamenting him, that he said to his sons, saying, If I die, entomb me in this tomb in which the man of God was entombed in it! Put me by his bones, that my bones should be preserved with his bones!
1KI 13:32 For the saying which he spoke by the word of the LORD will be coming to pass against the altar in Beth-el, and against the houses of the high places in Samaria.
1KI 13:33 And after this saying Jeroboam turned not from his evil, but returned and appointed from part of the people priests of the high places. The one wanting to be a priest he filled the post by his hand, and he became priest of the high places.
1KI 13:34 And this thing came to pass for sin to the house of Jeroboam, and for ruin, and for extinction from the face of the earth.
1KI 14:1 In that time Abijah son of Jeroboam was ill.
1KI 14:2 And Jeroboam said to his wife, Rise up and change that they shall not know that you are the wife of Jeroboam, and go unto Shiloh! Behold, Ahijah the prophet is there, he spoke unto me to reign over this people.
1KI 14:3 And take in your hand ten breads, and small cakes, and a jar of honey, and you shall go to him - he will announce to you what will be to the child.
1KI 14:4 And the wife of Jeroboam did thus, and rose up, and went to Shiloh, and entered into the house of Ahijah. And the man was old for seeing, and his eyes were blunted from his old age.
1KI 14:5 And the LORD said to Ahijah, Behold, the wife of Jeroboam enters to seek an utterance from you concerning her son, for he is ill. According to this and according to that you shall speak to her. And it came to pass in her entering that she was as estranged.
1KI 14:6 And it came to pass as Ahijah heard the sound of her feet of her entering in the passage, that he said, Enter, O wife of Jeroboam! Why is this you are as estranged, and I am a harsh envoy to you?
1KI 14:7 In going, say to Jeroboam, Thus says the LORD God of Israel, Because as much as I exalted you from the midst of the people, and appointed you leading over the people of Israel,
1KI 14:8 and tore the crown of state from the house of David, and gave it to you; and yet you have not become as my servant David, who kept my commandments, and who went after me with all his heart, to do the upright thing in my eyes.
1KI 14:9 But you did wickedly doing more than all as many as were in front of you. And you went and made to yourself other gods, and molten images, to provoke me to anger, and tossed me behind you.
1KI 14:10 On account of this, behold, I bring evil to the house of Jeroboam, and I will utterly destroy of Jeroboam the one urinating against a wall, the one coming and the one being left behind in Israel, and will choose over the house of Jeroboam as one chooses the dung unto finishing it.
1KI 14:11 The one having died of Jeroboam in the city the dogs shall devour; and the one having died in the field the birds of heaven shall devour - for the LORD spoke.
1KI 14:12 And you, rising up, go unto your house! In the entering of your feet in the city the child shall die.
1KI 14:13 And all Israel shall lament him, and entomb him, for this one only shall enter to Jeroboam to the tomb, for there shall be found in him a good word concerning the LORD God of Israel among the house of Jeroboam.
1KI 14:14 And the LORD will raise up for himself a king over Israel, who shall strike the house of Jeroboam this day - and yet also indeed now.
1KI 14:15 And the LORD shall strike Israel as the reed shaken in the water. And he shall pluck out Israel upward of this good soil, which he gave to their fathers, and shall winnow them on the other side of the river, because of as many of their sacred groves they made, provoking the LORD to anger.
1KI 14:16 And the LORD gave up Israel favorably from the sins of Jeroboam, who sinned and who led Israel into sin.
1KI 14:17 And the wife of Jeroboam rose up, and went unto Tizrah. And it came to pass as she entered in the threshold of the house, that the child died.
1KI 14:18 And they entombed it, and all Israel lamented it, according to the word of the LORD, the word he spoke by the hand of his servant Ahijah the prophet.
1KI 14:19 And the extra things of Jeroboam, as much as he waged war, and as much as he reigned, behold, they are written in the scroll of the words of the days of the kings of Israel.
1KI 14:20 And the days which Jeroboam reigned - twenty and two years. And he slept with his fathers, and Nadab his son reigned instead of him.
1KI 14:21 And Rehoboam son of Solomon reigned over Judah. Rehoboam was a son being forty and one years old in his being given reign. And seventeen years he reigned in Jerusalem, in the city in which the LORD chose to put his name there from out of all of the tribes of Israel. And the name of his mother was Naamah the Ammonitess.
1KI 14:22 And Judah acted wickedly before the LORD, and provoked him to jealousy in all the things which his fathers did in their sins which they sinned.
1KI 14:23 And they built for themselves high places, and monuments, and sacred groves upon every high hill, and underneath every shady tree.
1KI 14:24 And bonding together took place in the land, and they did from all the abominations of the nations which the LORD removed in front of the sons of Israel.
1KI 14:25 And it came to pass in the fifth year of the reigning of Rehoboam, Shishak king of Egypt ascended against Jerusalem.
1KI 14:26 And he took all the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the house of the king, even the whole he took, and the shields of gold which Solomon made.
1KI 14:27 And Rehoboam the king made shields of brass instead of them, and the leaders of the bodyguards were set in place by him, guarding the vestibule of the house of the king.
1KI 14:28 And it came to pass when the king entered into the house of the LORD, that the bodyguards lifted them, and fastened them in the vestibule of the bodyguards.
1KI 14:29 And the rest of the words of Rehoboam, and all the things which he did, behold are these not written upon the scroll of the words of the days of the kings of Judah?
1KI 14:30 And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days.
1KI 14:31 And Rehoboam slept with his fathers. And they entombed him with his fathers in the city of David. And the name of his mother was Naamah the Ammonitess. And Abijam his son reigned instead of him.
1KI 15:1 And in the eighteenth year of the reigning of Jeroboam son of Nebat, Abijam son of Rehoboam reigned over Judah.
1KI 15:2 And three years he reigned in Jerusalem. And the name of his mother was Maachah daughter of Abishalom.
1KI 15:3 And he went in the sins of his father, which he did before him. And his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God, as the heart of David his grandfather.
1KI 15:4 But on account of David the LORD his God gave to him a vestige in Jerusalem, that he should establish his children after him, and establish Jerusalem -
1KI 15:5 as David did the upright thing before the LORD, and did not turn aside from all which he gave charge to him all the days of his life, except in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.
1KI 15:6 And war was between Rehoboam and between Jeroboam all the days of his life.
1KI 15:7 And the rest of the words of Abijam and all the things which he did, behold are these not written upon the scroll of the words of the days of the kings of Judah? And there was war between Abijam and between Jeroboam.
1KI 15:8 And Abijam slept with his fathers. And they entombed him in the city of David. And Asa his son reigned instead of him.
1KI 15:9 In the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Asa reigned over Judah.
1KI 15:10 And forty and one year he reigned in Jerusalem. And the name of his grandmother was Maachah daughter of Abishalom.
1KI 15:11 And Asa did the upright thing before the LORD as David his forefather.
1KI 15:12 And he removed the mystic rites from the land, and sent out all the practices which his fathers did.
1KI 15:13 And he removed Maachah his mother, so as to not be ruling, as she observed a convocation in her sacred grove; and Asa cut off her retreats, and burnt them in fire at the rushing stream Kidron.
1KI 15:14 But the high places he removed not. Except the heart of Asa was perfect with the LORD all his days.
1KI 15:15 And Asa carried into the house of the LORD the monumental pillars of his father, and the monumental pillars of silver and of gold; and he carried into the house of the LORD silver and gold and vessels.
1KI 15:16 And there was war between Asa and between Baasha king of Israel all their days.
1KI 15:17 And Baasha king of Israel ascended against Judah, and built Ramah, so as not to be going forth and entering to Asa king of Judah.
1KI 15:18 And Asa took all the silver and the gold being found in the treasuries of the house of the LORD, and in the treasuries of the house of the king, and put them into the hands of his servants. And king Asa sent them to the son of Hadad, son of Tabrimon, son of Hezion, king of Syria, the one dwelling in Damascus, saying,
1KI 15:19 A covenant between me and between you, and between my father and your father. Behold, I have sent to you gifts of silver and of gold; come efface your covenant with Baasha king of Israel, and he shall ascend from me!
1KI 15:20 And the son of Hadad hearkened to king Asa, and sent the rulers of his force in to the cities of Israel, and struck Ijon, and Dan, and Abel of the house of Maachah, and all Cinneroth, unto all the land of Naphtali.
1KI 15:21 And it came to pass when Baasha heard, that he stopped the building of Ramah, and returned unto Tizrah.
1KI 15:22 And king Asa exhorted all Judah with no exceptions. And they lifted the stones of Ramah, and its timbers, which Baasha constructed; and Asa the king built with them the hill of Benjamin, and the height.
1KI 15:23 And the rest of the words of Asa, and all his dominion, and all which he did, and the cities which he built, behold are these not written upon a scroll of the words of the days of the kings of Judah? Only in the time of his old age his feet caused pain.
1KI 15:24 And Asa slept with his fathers. And they entombed him with his fathers in the city of David his forefather. And Jehoshaphat his son reigned instead of him.
1KI 15:25 And Nadab son of Jeroboam reigned over Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned over Israel two years.
1KI 15:26 And he acted wickedly before the LORD, and went in the way of his father, and in his sins in the things which he led Israel into sin.
1KI 15:27 And Baasha son of Ahijah over the house of Issachar besieged against him, and struck him in Gibbethon, the city of the Philistines; for Nadab and all Israel were besieging at Gibbethon.
1KI 15:28 And Baasha put him to death in the third year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned instead of him.
1KI 15:29 And it came to pass as he reigned, he struck the entire house of Jeroboam; and he left not any that breathed of Jeroboam, until utterly destroying him, (according to the saying of the LORD which he spoke by the hand of his servant Ahijah the Shilonite,)
1KI 15:30 for the sins of Jeroboam which he led Israel into sin, and in his provoking to anger, in which he provoked to anger the LORD God of Israel.
1KI 15:31 And the rest of the words of Nadab, and all the things which he did, behold are these not written in a scroll of the words of the days of the kings of Israel?
1KI 15:32 And war was between Asa and between Baasha king of Israel all their days.
1KI 15:33 In the third year of Asa king of Judah, Baasha son of Ahijah reigned over Israel in Tizrah, twenty and four years.
1KI 15:34 And he did the wicked thing before the LORD, and went in the way of Jeroboam son of Nebat, and in his sins in which he led Israel into sin.
1KI 16:1 And came to pass the word of the LORD unto Jehu son of Hanani against Baasha, saying,
1KI 16:2 Because I exalted you above the earth, and gave you lead over my people Israel; and you went in the way of Jeroboam, and led my people Israel into sin, to provoke me to anger by their vanities;
1KI 16:3 behold, I arouse enemies after Baasha, and after his house; and I will appoint your house as the house of Jeroboam son of Nebat.
1KI 16:4 The one having died of Baasha in the city - the dogs shall eat him. And the one having died of his in the plain - the birds of the heaven shall eat him.
1KI 16:5 And the rest of the words of Baasha, and all which he did, and his dominations, behold are these not written in the scroll of the words of the days of the kings of Israel?
1KI 16:6 And Baasha slept with his fathers, and they entombed him in Tirzah; and Elah his son reigned instead of him.
1KI 16:7 And the LORD spoke by the hand of Jehu son of Hanani against Baasha, and against his house, and upon all the evil which he did before the LORD, in provoking him to anger by the works of his hands, for him to be as the house of Jeroboam, and for striking him.
1KI 16:8 In the sixth and twentieth year of Asa king of Judah, Elah son of Baasha reigned over Israel in Tirzah two years.
1KI 16:9 And his servant was confederated against him - Zimri, the ruler of half the chariots. And he was in Tirzah drinking, being intoxicated in the house of Azra the manager in Tirzah.
1KI 16:10 And Zimri entered and struck him, and killed him in the seventh and twentieth year, and reigned instead of him.
1KI 16:11 And it came to pass in his taking reign, in his sitting upon his throne, he struck the entire house of Baasha. And he left not to it one urinating against the wall, even the relatives, and of his friends.
1KI 16:12 And Zimri destroyed all the house of Baasha, according to the saying which the LORD spoke against the house of Baasha, by Jehu the prophet,
1KI 16:13 on account of all the sins of Baasha, and his son Elah, as he led Israel into sin, provoking to anger the LORD God of Israel in their vanities.
1KI 16:14 And the rest of the words of Elah, and all which he did, behold are these not written in the scroll of the words of the days of the kings of Israel?
1KI 16:15 In the twentieth and seventh year of Asa king of Judah Zimri reigned in Tizrah seven days. And the camp of Israel was upon Gibbethon the city of the Philistines.
1KI 16:16 And the people heard in the camp, saying, Zimri conspired, and smote the king. And they gave reign in Israel to Omri, the one leading the military over Israel in that day, in the camp.
1KI 16:17 And Omri ascended from Gibbethon, and all Israel with him, and they besieged against Tizrah.
1KI 16:18 And it came to pass as Zimri beheld that his city was taken, that he entered into the inner room of the house of the king, and set on fire the house of the king over himself with fire, and died
1KI 16:19 for his sins which he did to act wickedly before the LORD, to go in the way of Jeroboam son of Nebat, and in his sins which he committed as he led Israel into sin.
1KI 16:20 And the rest of the words of Zimri, and his associations which he joined in, behold are these not written in the scroll of the words of the days of the kings of Israel?
1KI 16:21 Then the people of Israel parted; half the people went after Tibni son of Ginath, for him to reign; and half of the people went after Omri.
1KI 16:22 And the people being after Omri prevailed against the people that followed after Tibni son of Ginath. And Tibni died, and Omri reigned.
1KI 16:23 In the thirtieth and first year of Asa king of Judah, Omri reigned over Israel twelve years. In Tirzah he reigned six years.
1KI 16:24 And Omri acquired the mountain Samaria from Shemer, the lord of the mountain for two talents of silver, and built on the mountain, and called the name of the mountain of which he built upon after the name of Shemer, the lord of the mountain - Samaria.
1KI 16:25 And Omri did the wicked thing before the LORD, and was wicked over all the ones being prior of him.
1KI 16:26 And he went in all the way of Jeroboam son of Nebat, and in his sins in which he led Israel into sin, to provoke to anger the LORD God of Israel in their vanities.
1KI 16:27 And the rest of the words of Omri, and all which he did, and his dominations, behold are these not written in the scroll of the words of the days of the kings of Israel?
1KI 16:28 And Omri slept with his fathers, and they entombed him in Samaria. And Ahab his son reigned instead of him.
1KI 16:29 But Ahab son of Omri reigned over Israel in the thirtieth and eighth year of Asa king of Judah. And Ahab son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty and two years.
1KI 16:30 And Ahab did the wicked thing before the LORD, and was wicked above all the ones prior of him.
1KI 16:31 And it was not enough for him to go in the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, but he took for wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Sidonians. And he went and served to Baal, and did obeisance to him.
1KI 16:32 And he set up an altar to Baal in the house of Baal, which he built in Samaria.
1KI 16:33 And Ahab prepared the sacred grove. And Ahab proceeded to make provocations to provoke the LORD God of Israel to anger above all the kings of Israel being prior of him.
1KI 16:34 In his days Hiel the Beth-elite built Jericho; he laid its foundation with Abiram his first-born, and with Segub his younger he set up its doors, according to the saying of the LORD, which he spoke by the hand of Joshua son of Nun.
1KI 17:1 And Elijah the Tishbite said, the one from Tishbon of Gilead, to Ahab, As the LORD lives, the God of Israel, in whom I stand before him, Shall there be these years dew and rain - only that unless it be through the word of my mouth.
1KI 17:2 And came to pass the saying of the LORD to Elijah.
1KI 17:3 Go from here, according to the east, and hide at the rushing stream Cherith, upon the face of the Jordan!
1KI 17:4 And it will be from out of the rushing stream you shall drink water; and to the crows I shall give charge to nourish you there.
1KI 17:5 And Elijah went and did according to the saying of the LORD. And he settled by the rushing stream Cherith, upon the face of the Jordan.
1KI 17:6 And the crows brought to him breads and meat in the morning, and breads and meat in the afternoon. And from out of the rushing stream he drank water.
1KI 17:7 And it came to pass after many days, that the rushing stream dried up, for there was not rain upon the land.
1KI 17:8 And the word of the LORD came to pass to Elijah, saying,
1KI 17:9 Rise up, and go into Sarepta of the Sidonians - and you shall dwell there! Behold, I have given charge there for a widow woman to nourish you.
1KI 17:10 And he rose up and went into Sarepta. And came unto the gate-house of the city. And behold, there a widow woman was collecting together wood. And Elijah yelled out after her, and said to her, Take indeed for me a little water into a container, and I shall drink.
1KI 17:11 And she went to take, and Elijah yelled out after her, and said to her, Give indeed to me the morsel of bread in your hand, and I will eat.
1KI 17:12 And the woman said, As the LORD your God lives, If there is to me a cake baked in hot ashes - good? but I only have as much as a handful of flour in the pitcher, and a little olive oil in the jar. And behold, I shall collected together two sticks, and I shall enter and make it for myself and my children, and we shall eat, and die.
1KI 17:13 And Elijah said to her, Be of courage! Enter and do according to your word! But make for me from there a small cake baked in hot ashes at first, and bring it forth to me! And to yourself you shall make and to your children at last.
1KI 17:14 For thus says the LORD God of Israel, The pitcher of flour shall not fail, and the jar of olive oil shall not have less, until the days of the giving by the LORD the rain upon the earth.
1KI 17:15 And the woman went and did according to the word of Elijah. And she gave to him, and he ate, and she and her children.
1KI 17:16 And the pitcher of flour failed not, and the jar of olive oil had not less, according to the saying of the LORD, which he spoke by the hand of Elijah.
1KI 17:17 And it came to pass after these things, that the son of the woman who was the lady of the house became ill, and his illness was fortified very much, until of which not was left behind in him a breath.
1KI 17:18 And she said to Elijah, What is it to me and to you, O man of God, for you to enter to me, to call to mind my iniquities, and to kill my son?
1KI 17:19 And Elijah said to the woman, Give me your son! And he took him from out of her bosom, and brought him into the upper room in which he settled there, and rested him upon his bed.
1KI 17:20 And Elijah yelled out to the LORD, and said, O LORD my God, also indeed the widow with whom I dwell with her, have you inflicted evil to kill her son?
1KI 17:21 And he breathed into the boy three times, and called upon the LORD, and he said, O LORD my God, return indeed the life of this boy to him!
1KI 17:22 And it became so, and the life of the boy returned to him, and the boy yelled out.
1KI 17:23 And he led him from the upper room into the house, and gave it to his mother. And Elijah said, See, your son lives!
1KI 17:24 And the woman said to Elijah, Behold, I know that you are a man of God, and the word of the LORD in your mouth is true.
1KI 18:1 And it came to pass after many days, and the word of the LORD came to Elijah in the third year, saying, Go, and appear to Ahab! And I will put rain upon the face of the earth.
1KI 18:2 And Elijah went to appear to Ahab. And there was a strong famine in Samaria.
1KI 18:3 And Ahab called Obadiah the manager. (And Obadiah was fearing the LORD exceedingly.
1KI 18:4 And it came to pass when Jezebel struck the prophets of the LORD, that Obadiah took a hundred prophets, and hid them by fifty in two caves, and nourished them with bread and water.)
1KI 18:5 And Ahab said to Obadiah, Come, and we should go through in the land unto the springs of the waters, and unto all the rushing streams, if perchance we should find pasturage, and we should preserve the horses and mules, and the cattle shall not be destroyed from us.
1KI 18:6 And they divided to themselves the way to go by it - Ahab went by one way, and Obadiah went by another way alone.
1KI 18:7 And Obadiah was in the way alone, and behold, Elijah came to meet with him. And Obadiah hastened and fell upon his face, and said, Are you he, O my master, Elijah?
1KI 18:8 And Elijah said to him, I am, Go, tell your master! Behold, Elijah.
1KI 18:9 And Obadiah said, How have I sinned that you appoint your servant into the hands of Ahab to kill me?
1KI 18:10 As the LORD your God lives, is there a nation or kingdom of which my master did not send to seek you? And if they said, He is not here, then he adjured the kingdom and its places, for he did not find you.
1KI 18:11 And now you say, Go, announce to your master! Behold, Elijah.
1KI 18:12 And it will be if I should go forth from you, and a wind of the LORD shall lift you into the land which I know not; and I shall enter to report to Ahab, and he should not find you, then he will kill me. But your servant is fearing the LORD from out of his youth.
1KI 18:13 Or was it not reported to you my master what things I have done when Jezebel killed the prophets of the LORD, that I took some of the prophets of the LORD - a hundred men, and hid them in the caves by fifty, and I maintained them with breads and water?
1KI 18:14 And now you say, Go, tell your master, Behold, Elijah! - and he will kill me.
1KI 18:15 And Elijah said, As the LORD of the forces lives, in which I stand before him, that today I will appear to him.
1KI 18:16 And Obadiah went to meet with Ahab, and he reported to him. And Ahab ran forth and went to meet with Elijah.
1KI 18:17 And it came to pass as Ahab saw Elijah, that Ahab said to Elijah, Are you he turning aside Israel?
1KI 18:18 And Elijah said, I do not turn aside Israel; but you, and the house of your father, in your leaving the LORD your God, and to go after the Baalim.
1KI 18:19 And now, send and gather together to me all Israel at mount Carmel, and the prophets of Baal - four hundred and fifty, and the prophets of the sacred groves - four hundred, eating at the table of Jezebel!
1KI 18:20 And Ahab sent into all Israel, and assembled all the prophets to mount Carmel.
1KI 18:21 And Elijah came near to all the people, and said to them, For how long will you be lame upon both your hams? If the LORD is God, go after him! But if Baal, go after him! And the people answered not a word.
1KI 18:22 And Elijah said to the people, I am left alone a prophet of the LORD; and the prophets of Baal are four hundred and fifty men.
1KI 18:23 Give then to us two oxen; and let them choose for themselves one, and let them dismember it, and place it upon the wood, and do not put fire upon it! And I will do the same with the other ox, and in no way will I put fire upon it.
1KI 18:24 And you yell out in the name of your gods, and I will call upon the name of the LORD my God. And it will be the God who ever heeds by fire, this is God. And all the people answered and said, The word is good which you have spoken.
1KI 18:25 And Elijah said to the prophets of Baal, Choose for yourselves the one ox, and prepare it first! For to you are many; and call in the name of your god, and do not put fire upon it!
