1KI 18:26 And they took the ox, and offered it, and called in the name of Baal from morning until midday. And they said, Heed us, O Baal, heed us! And there was not a sound, and there was not a hearing anything. And they ran upon the altar of which they made.
1KI 18:27 And it became midday, and Elijah the Tishbite sneered at them, and he said, Call with a great voice! Perhaps he is himself in some meditation, and at the same time perhaps he is executing business, or perhaps he sleeps, and shall rise up.
1KI 18:28 And they called out with a great voice, and mutilated themselves according to their custom with knives and by spears, until blood poured out of them.
1KI 18:29 And they prophesied until of which time it went into the midday. And it came to pass as the time of the midday to ascend for the sacrifice, that there was not a sound, and there was not a hearing anything.
1KI 18:30 And Elijah said to the people, Come forward to me! And all the people came forward to him. And he repaired the altar having been razed.
1KI 18:31 And Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of Israel, as the LORD spoke to him, saying, Israel will be your name.
1KI 18:32 And he built the stones in the name of the LORD; and repaired the altar of the LORD, the one having been razed. And he made a sea, having the space of two measures of seed, round about the altar.
1KI 18:33 And he put the kindling upon the altar which he made. And he dismembered the whole burnt offering, and he put it upon the kindling, and piled it upon the altar. And Elijah said, Bring to me four water pitchers, and pour upon the whole burnt offering, and upon the kindling!
1KI 18:34 And he said, Repeat it a second time! And they repeated it a second time. And he said, Do it a third time! And they did it a third time.
1KI 18:35 And the water went round about the altar; and the sea filled with water.
1KI 18:36 And as it was time of the offering the sacrifice, and Elijah the prophet came, and said, O LORD God of Abraham, and Isaac, and Israel, today let it be known to all this people that you are the LORD God of Israel, and I am your servant, and through you I have done all these things!
1KI 18:37 Heed me, O LORD, heed me! And let this people know that you are the LORD God, and you turned the heart of this people back!
1KI 18:38 And fire fell from the LORD from out of the heaven, and it devoured the whole burnt offering, and the kindling, and the water in the sea, and the stones, and the dust was licked up by the fire.
1KI 18:39 And all the people saw, and fell upon their face. And they said, Truly, the LORD is God. The LORD, he is God.
1KI 18:40 And Elijah said to the people, Seize the prophets of Baal; let not one of them escape! And they seized them. And Elijah led them down unto the rushing stream Kishon, and slew them there.
1KI 18:41 And Elijah said to Ahab, Ascend and eat and drink! For it is the sound of the noise of the rain.
1KI 18:42 And Ahab ascended to eat and to drink. And Elijah ascended unto Carmel; and he bowed upon the ground, and put his face between his knees.
1KI 18:43 And he said to his servant-lad, Ascend, and look the way of the sea! And the servant-lad ascended and looked. And he said, There is nothing. And Elijah said, Return seven times!
1KI 18:44 And it came to pass in the seventh time, and behold, a small cloud, as the sole of a man's foot, came with water from the sea. And he said, Ascend and say to Ahab! Team up your chariot, and go down, lest the rain should overtake you!
1KI 18:45 And it happened from here and here, and the heaven darkened with clouds and wind, and there became a great rain. And Ahab rode horseback, and went unto Jezreel.
1KI 18:46 And the hand of the LORD came upon Elijah, and he fastened his loin, and ran in front of Ahab unto Jezreel.
1KI 19:1 And Ahab announced to Jezebel all as much as Elijah did, and as to kill the prophets by the broadsword.
1KI 19:2 And Jezebel sent to Elijah, and said, Thus may the gods do to me, and thus may they add, that this hour tomorrow I shall put your life as the life of one of them.
1KI 19:3 And Elijah feared, and rose up, and went forth for his life. And he came into Beersheba of Judah, and left his servant-lad there.
1KI 19:4 And he went by the wilderness way a day, and came and stayed underneath a broom shrub. And he asked for his life to die; and said, It is fit; now, O LORD, take indeed my life from me! For I am not better than my fathers.
1KI 19:5 And he bedded down and slept there under a plant. And behold, a certain angel touched him, and said to him, Rise up and eat!
1KI 19:6 And he looked, and behold, by his head was a cake baked in hot ashes of oaten bread, and a jar of water. And Elijah rose up and ate and drank, and returned and went to bed.
1KI 19:7 And the angel of the LORD returned a second time, and touched him, and said to him, Rise up, eat! For the journey is great for you.
1KI 19:8 And he rose up, and ate and drank, and went in the strength of that food forty days and forty nights unto mount Horeb.
1KI 19:9 And he entered there into the cave, and rested up there; and behold, a word of the LORD came to him, and said, Why are you here, Elijah?
1KI 19:10 And Elijah said, Being zealous, I am zealous for the LORD almighty. For the sons of Israel abandoned you, your altar they razed, and your prophets they killed by the broadsword, and I alone am left, and they seek my life to take it.
1KI 19:11 And he said, You shall go forth, and stand before the LORD in the mountain! And behold, the LORD will go by. And there was a great strong wind parting the mountains, and breaking rocks before the LORD - the LORD was not in the wind. And after the wind a rumbling - the LORD was not in the rumbling.
1KI 19:12 And after the rumbling a fire - the LORD was not in the fire. And after the fire a sound of a fine breeze - and there was the LORD.
1KI 19:13 And it came to pass, as Elijah heard, that he covered over his face with his sheepskin, and went forth, and stood by the cave. And behold, before him was a voice, and said, Why are you here, Elijah?
1KI 19:14 And Elijah said, Being zealous, I am zealous for the LORD God almighty. For the sons of Israel abandoned your covenant, your altars they razed, and your prophets they killed by the broadsword, and I alone am left, and they seek my life to take it.
1KI 19:15 And the LORD said to him, Go, return to your journey! And you shall come unto the way of the wilderness of Damascus; and you shall anoint Hazael as king over Syria.
1KI 19:16 And Jehu son of Nimshi you shall anoint as king over Israel. And Elisha son of Shaphat of Abel-meholah you shall anoint as prophet instead of you.
1KI 19:17 And it will be the one being delivered from the broadsword of Hazael, Jehu shall put to death. And the one being delivered from the broadsword of Jehu, Elisha shall put to death.
1KI 19:18 And I shall leave behind in Israel seven thousand men, all knees which bend not the knee to Baal, and every mouth which does not do obeisance to him.
1KI 19:19 And he went forth from there, and finds Elisha son of Shaphat, and he was plowing with oxen - twelve teams were before him, and he was among the twelve. And Elijah went forth unto Elisha, and tossed upon him his sheepskin.
1KI 19:20 And Elisha left the oxen, and ran after Elijah, and said, I shall kiss my father and my mother, and I shall follow after you. And he said to him, Go, return! For I have done it to you.
1KI 19:21 And he returned from following after him, and took the teams of oxen, and sacrificed, and cooked them with the equipment of the oxen, and gave to the people, and they ate. And he rose up, and went after Elijah, and ministered to him.
1KI 20:1 And the son of Hadad king of Syria gathered together all his force, and thirty-two kings with him, and horses and chariots. And they ascended, and laid siege against Samaria, and waged war against it.
1KI 20:2 And he sent messengers to Ahab king of Israel, into the city, and said to him, Thus says the son of Hadad.
1KI 20:3 Your silver and your gold is mine; and your wives and your children - the best is mine.
1KI 20:4 And the king of Israel answered and said, As you have spoken, O my master, O king, I am yours, and all my things.
1KI 20:5 And the messengers returned and said, Thus says the son of Hadad, I have sent to you, saying, Your silver, and your gold, and your wives, and your children, you shall give to me;
1KI 20:6 for this hour tomorrow I will send my servants to you, and they will search your house, and the houses of your servants. And it will be that all the desires of their eyes, of what ever they should put upon with their hands, they shall take.
1KI 20:7 And the king of Israel called all the elders of the land, and said, Know indeed, and behold! that this one seeks evil; for he has sent to me for my wives, and for my children, and my silver, and my gold; I have not kept back from him.
1KI 20:8 And the elders and all the people said to him, You should not hearken, and you should not want.
1KI 20:9 And he said to the messengers of the son of Hadad, Say to your master! All as much as you sent to your servant at first, I will do; but this thing I shall not be able to do. And the men departed, and returned to him the word.
1KI 20:10 And the son of Hadad sent to him saying, Thus may the gods do to me, and thus may they add, if the dust of Samaria shall suffice for handfuls to all the people, to my footmen.
1KI 20:11 And the king of Israel answered and said, Let that be enough! Let not the humpback boast as the one standing straight!
1KI 20:12 And it came to pass, when he answered to him this word, as he drinking was, and all the kings with him in tents, that he said to his servants, Build a siege mound! And they put a siege mound against the city.
1KI 20:13 And behold, one prophet came forward to Ahab king of Israel, and said, Thus says the LORD, Have you seen all this great multitude? Behold, I give it today into your hands; and you shall know that I am the LORD.
1KI 20:14 And Ahab said, By whom? And he said, Thus says the LORD, By the young men of the rulers of the regions. And Ahab said, Who shall join together for the war? And he said, You.
1KI 20:15 And Ahab numbered the servants of the rulers of the regions, and they were two hundred thirty and two. And after these things he numbered the people, every son of power - seven thousand.
1KI 20:16 And he went forth at midday. And the son of Hadad was drinking and being intoxicated in Succoth, he and the kings - thirty and two kings, the allies with him.
1KI 20:17 And came forth the young men, the rulers of the regions at first. And the son of Hadad sent, and they led up to him, saying, Men have come forth from out of Samaria.
1KI 20:18 And he said to them, If in peace they come forth, seize them alive! And if for war they came forth, seize them alive!
1KI 20:19 And the young men went forth from the city of the rulers of the regions, and the force after them.
1KI 20:20 And each man struck the one by him. And Syria fled; and Israel pursued them. And the son of Hadad king of Syria escaped upon a horse of a horseman.
1KI 20:21 And the king of Israel came forth, and took the horses, and the chariots, and struck a great calamity against Syria.
1KI 20:22 And the prophet came forward to the king of Israel, and said, Strengthen yourself, and know, and see what you shall do! For returning during the year, the son of Hadad king of Syria will ascend against you.
1KI 20:23 And the servants of the king of Syria said to him, The God of mountains is the God of Israel, and not a God of valleys; on account of this they powered over us; but if we wage war against them according to the straight plains, assuredly we shall power over them.
1KI 20:24 And this thing you do! Let the kings each depart to their place, and establish satraps in place of them!
1KI 20:25 And you exchange according to the force falling from you - even horse for horse, and chariots for chariots! And we will wage war against them in the straight plains, and we will power over them. And he hearkened to their voice, and did thus.
1KI 20:26 And it came to pass at the return of the year, that the son of Hadad mustered Syria, and ascended into Aphek for war against Israel.
1KI 20:27 And the sons of Israel were mustered, and came to meet them. And Israel camped right opposite them, as two flocks of goats. And Syria filled the land.
1KI 20:28 And came forward a man of God, and said to the king of Israel, Thus says the LORD, Because Syria said, the LORD God of Israel is God of the mountains, and he is not God of the valleys, that I will give this great force into your hand, and you shall know that I am the LORD.
1KI 20:29 And these camped before those seven days. And it came to pass in the seventh day that the war led on. And Israel struck Syria - a hundred thousand footmen in one day.
1KI 20:30 And the rest fled unto Aphek, into the city. And the wall fell upon twenty and seven thousand men of the ones remaining. And the son of Hadad fled, and he entered into the house of the bedroom, into the inner chamber.
1KI 20:31 And his servants said to him, Indeed behold we heard that the kings of the house of Israel are kings of mercy. We should place indeed sackcloths upon our loins, and rough cords upon our heads, and we should go forth to the king of Israel; if by any means he shall bring forth alive our lives.
1KI 20:32 And they girded sackcloths upon their loins, and put rough cords upon their heads. And they said to the king of Israel, Your servant, the son of Hadad says, Let my soul indeed live! And he said, Does he still live? he is my brother.
1KI 20:33 And the men foretold, and hastened, and gathered up the word out of his mouth, and said, Your brother the son of Hadad. And he said, Enter, and receive him! And the son of Hadad came forth to him; and they transported him upon the chariot to him.
1KI 20:34 And he said to him, The cities which my father took from your father, I give back to you; and you shall establish streets in Damascus for yourself, as my father established in Samaria. And Ahab said, I by covenant shall send you out. And he ordained with him a covenant, and sent him out.
1KI 20:35 And one man of the sons of the prophets said to his neighbor, by a word of the LORD, Strike me indeed! And the man would not strike him.
1KI 20:36 And he said to him, Because you hearkened not to the voice of the LORD, behold, as you run from me, a lion shall strike you. And he went forth from him, and a lion found him, and struck him.
1KI 20:37 And he finds another man, and he said, Strike indeed me! And the man struck him, and striking he broke him.
1KI 20:38 And the prophet went and stood to the king of Israel upon the way, and bound his eyes with a ligature.
1KI 20:39 And it came to pass as the king came near, that he yelled out to the king. And he said, Your servant went forth with the military for war, and behold, a man brought to me another man, and he said to me, Guard this man! And if by rushing away he should rush away, then your life will be required for his life, or a talent of silver you establish for it.
1KI 20:40 And it came to pass as your servant looked round about here this way and here that way, that this man was not around. And the king of Israel said to him, Behold, you did as magistrate, you murdered for me.
1KI 20:41 And he hastened and removed the ligature from his eyes. And the king of Israel recognized him that this one was of the prophets.
1KI 20:42 And he said to him, Thus says the LORD, For you sent out a pernicious man to escape from out of your hand, even your life will be required for his life, and your people for his people.
1KI 20:43 And the king of Israel went forth being confounded and faint, and came unto Samaria.
1KI 21:1 And it came to pass after these words, that there was one vineyard to Naboth the Jezreelite, by the house of Ahab king of Samaria.
1KI 21:2 And Ahab spoke to Naboth, saying, Give to me your vineyard, and it will be to me for a garden of vegetables! For this is near my house, and I will give to you in place of it another good vineyard for it; but if it is not pleasing before you, I will give to you money in barter for this your vineyard.
1KI 21:3 And Naboth said to Ahab, May it not be to me from the LORD to give the inheritance of my fathers to you.
1KI 21:4 And Ahab went to his house being in a tumult and loosened over the word which Naboth the Jezreelite spoke to him, as he said, I will not give to you the inheritance of my fathers to you. And the spirit of Ahab became disturbed, and he went to sleep upon his bed, and covered up his face, and did not eat bread.
1KI 21:5 And Jezebel his wife entered to him, and said to him, Why is your spirit disturbed, and you are not eating bread?
1KI 21:6 And he said to her, For I spoke to Naboth the Jezreelite, saying, Give to me your vineyard for money! But if you do not want, I will give to you a vineyard in place of it. And he said, I will not give to you the inheritance of my fathers.
1KI 21:7 And Jezebel his wife said to him, Do you now so act as king over Israel? Rise up, and eat bread, and be yourself! And I will give to you the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite.
1KI 21:8 And she wrote upon a scroll the name of Ahab, and set seal by his seal, and sent the scroll to the elders, and to the free men dwelling with Naboth.
1KI 21:9 And she wrote in the scroll, saying, Fast a fast, and set Naboth at the head place of the people!
1KI 21:10 And seat two men, sons of lawbreakers, right opposite him! And let them bear witness against him! saying, You raved against God and king. And let them lead him out and stone him, and let him die!
1KI 21:11 And they did (the men of his city, the elders, and the free men dwelling in his city) as Jezebel sent to them, and as was written in the scrolls which she sent to them.
1KI 21:12 And they called a fast, and they sat Naboth at the head of the people.
1KI 21:13 And two men entered, sons of lawbreakers, and they sat right opposite him, and bore witness against him, saying, He raved against God and king. And they led him outside the city, and they stoned him with stones, and he died.
1KI 21:14 And they sent to Jezebel, saying, Naboth has been stoned, and died.
1KI 21:15 And it came to pass, as Jezebel heard the ones saying, Naboth has been stoned, and has died, that Jezebel said to Ahab, Rise up, inherit the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite! For he did not give it to you for money, for Naboth is not living, but has died.
1KI 21:16 And it came to pass, as Ahab heard that Naboth has died, Ahab rose and went down into the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, to inherit it.
1KI 21:17 And the LORD said to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,
1KI 21:18 Rise up, and go down for meeting Ahab king of Israel, in Samaria! Behold, this one is in the vineyard of Naboth, for he went down there to inherit it.
1KI 21:19 And you shall speak to him, saying, Thus says the LORD, You murdered and inherited. Therefore thus says the LORD, In the place where the dogs licked the blood of Naboth, there the dogs shall lick your blood.
1KI 21:20 And Ahab said to Elijah, Have you found me, O my enemy? And he said, I have found you, for you sell yourself in folly to act wickedly before the LORD, to provoke him to anger.
1KI 21:21 Thus says the LORD, Behold, I bring upon you evils, and I will burn away after you, and will utterly destroy of Ahab the one urinating against the wall, and the one being constrained, and the one being left in Israelthe bond and free in Israel..
1KI 21:22 And I will appoint your house as the house of Jeroboam son of Nebat, and as the house of Baasha son of Ahijah, on account of the provocations which you provoke to anger, and led Israel into sin.
1KI 21:23 And to Jezebel the LORD spoke, saying, The dogs shall eat her in the area around the wall of Jezreel.
1KI 21:24 The one having died of Ahab in the city, the dogs will eat; and the one having died of his in the plain, the birds of the heaven will eat.
1KI 21:25 Furthermore there was not one as Ahab, who sold himself to do the wicked thing before the LORD, as Jezebel his wife altered him.
1KI 21:26 And he acted exceedingly abhorrent to go after the abominations, according to all as many things which the Amorite made, whom the LORD utterly destroyed from the face of the sons of Israel.
1KI 21:27 And it came to pass, as Ahab heard these words, he tore his inner-garment, and wore sackcloth upon his body, and fasted, and laid in sackcloth, and went having downcast eyes.
1KI 21:28 And came to pass the word of the LORD to Elijah the Tishbite, and said,
1KI 21:29 Have you seen that Ahab was vexed in front of me? Because he was vexed in front of me, I shall not bring the evil in his days; but only in the days of his son will I bring the evil upon his house.
1KI 22:1 And he stayed in place three years, and there was not war between Syria and between Israel.
1KI 22:2 And it came to pass in the third year, that Jehoshaphat king of Judah went down to the king of Israel.
1KI 22:3 And the king of Israel said to his servants, Do you know that Ramoth Gilead is ours, and we keep silent to not take it from out of the hand of the king of Syria?
1KI 22:4 And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, Shall you not ascend with me unto Ramoth Gilead for war?
1KI 22:5 And Jehoshaphat said, As you, thus also I. As your people, thus also my people. As your horses, so also my horses. And Jehoshaphat king of Judah said to the king of Israel, Ask indeed today of the LORD.
1KI 22:6 And the king of Israel gathered together all the prophets, about four hundred men, and said to them, Shall I go unto Ramoth Gilead for war, or wait? And they said, Ascend! For by giving, the LORD shall give into the hands of the king.
1KI 22:7 And Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, Is there not here a prophet of the LORD, and we shall ask the LORD through him?
1KI 22:8 And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, Still there is one man for the asking the LORD through him, and I detest him, for he does not speak concerning me for good things, but only bad - Micaiah son of Imlah. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king speak so.
1KI 22:9 And the king of Israel called one eunuch, and said, Quickly bring Micaiah son of Imlah.
1KI 22:10 And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah sat down each upon his throne, armed, at the threshing-floor gate of Samaria; and all the prophets prophesied before them.
1KI 22:11 And Zedekiah son of Chenaanah made for himself horns of iron. And he said, Thus says the LORD, By these you shall gore the Syrian until whenever you finish them off entirely.
1KI 22:12 And all the prophets prophesied thus, saying, Ascend unto Ramoth Gilead, and your way shall prosper! and the LORD shall put into your hands the king of Syria.
1KI 22:13 And the messenger going to call Micaiah spoke to him, saying, Behold indeed, all the prophets speak by one mouth good things concerning the king. Let it be indeed that you be with words according to the words of one of these, and speak good!
1KI 22:14 And Micaiah said, As the LORD lives, that what ever the LORD should say to me, these things I shall speak.
1KI 22:15 And he came to the king. And the king said to him, Micaiah, Shall I ascend to Ramoth Gilead for war, or wait? And he said to him, Ascend! And the LORD shall prosper the way in the hand of the king.
1KI 22:16 And the king said to him, How often shall I adjure you that you should speak to me the truth in the name of the LORD?
1KI 22:17 And Micaiah said thus, I see all Israel being scattered in the mountains as sheep in which there is not a shepherd. And the LORD said, There is not a lord to these, let each return to his house in peace!
1KI 22:18 And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat king of Judah, Said I not to you that this one prophesies not good things to me, but only bad?
1KI 22:19 And Micaiah said, On account of this hear the word of the LORD! I saw the LORD God of Israel sitting upon his throne, and all the military of the heaven standing about him at his right and at his left.
1KI 22:20 And the LORD said, Who shall deceive Ahab king of Israel, that he shall ascend in Ramoth Gilead, and shall fall there? And this one said thus, and this other one thus.
1KI 22:21 And a spirit came forth, and stood before the LORD, and said, I will deceive him.
1KI 22:22 And the LORD said to him, In what way? And he said, I shall go forth, and I shall be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And he said, You shall deceive, and indeed you will be able. Go forth, and do so!
1KI 22:23 And now, behold, the LORD has put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these your prophets, and the LORD spoke against you bad things.
1KI 22:24 And Zedekiah son of Chenaanah came forward, and struck Micaiah upon the jaw, and said, What kind of spirit of the LORD departed from me to speak with you?
1KI 22:25 And Micaiah said, Behold, you shall see in that day, whenever you shall enter an inner chamber of the storeroom to hide.
1KI 22:26 And the king of Israel said, Take Micaiah, and return him to Amon the ruler of the city, and to Joash son of the king!
1KI 22:27 And say, Thus says the king, Put him in prison, and let him eat bread of affliction and water of affliction until my return in peace!
1KI 22:28 And Micaiah said, If in returning, you should return in peace, the LORD spoke not by me. And he said, Let all the people hearken!
1KI 22:29 And the king of Israel ascended up, and Jehoshaphat king of Judah with him unto Ramoth Gilead.
1KI 22:30 And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat king of Judah, I shall cover up myself, and enter into the battle; and you put on my clothes! And the king of Israel covered himself up, and entered into the battle.
1KI 22:31 And the king of Syria gave charge to the rulers of his chariots - thirty and two, saying, Do not do battle against the small or great, but the king of Israel alone.
1KI 22:32 And it came to pass, as the ones in charge of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat king of Judah, that they said, It appears this one is the king of Israel. And they encircled him to do battle. And Jehoshaphat shouted aloud.
1KI 22:33 And it happened as the rulers of the chariots saw that this is not the king of Israel, that they turned away from him.
1KI 22:34 And one merely stretched tight the bow, and it struck the king of Israel between the lungs and between the chest plate. And he said to his charioteer, Turn your hand, and lead me out of the battle; for I have been wounded!
1KI 22:35 And the war turned in that day. And the king was set upon the chariot right opposite Syria, from morning until evening. And the blood poured out from the wound into the cavity of the chariot.
1KI 22:36 And the herald of the army stood in the camp until the going down of the sun, saying, Each to his own city, and each to his own land,
1KI 22:37 for the king has died. And they went unto Samaria, and they entombed the king in Samaria.
1KI 22:38 And they washed the blood from the chariot at the fountain of Samaria. And the dogs licked up the blood, and the harlots bathed in the blood, according to the saying of the LORD which he spoke.
1KI 22:39 And the rest of the words of Ahab, and all which he did, and the house of ivory which he built, and all the cities which he made, behold have not these been written in the scroll of the words of the days of the kings of Israel?
1KI 22:40 And Ahab slept with his fathers; and Ahaziah his son reigned instead of him.
1KI 22:41 And Jehoshaphat son of Asa reigned over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.
1KI 22:42 And Jehoshaphat was thirty and five years old in his taking reign; and he reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem. And the name of his mother was Azubah daughter of Shilhi.
1KI 22:43 And he went in all the way of Asa his father; he turned not aside from it, to do the upright in the eyes of the LORD. Furthermore the high places he did not lift away; for the people sacrificed and burnt incense on the high places.
1KI 22:44 And Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Israel.
1KI 22:45 And the rest of the words of Jehoshaphat, and his dominions which he had, behold are these not written in the scroll of the words of the days of the kings of Judah?
1KI 22:46 And the rest of the ones being initiated of the things being forsaken in the days of Asa his father he removed from the land.
1KI 22:47 And a king was not established in Edom.
1KI 22:48 And Jehoshaphat prepared ships of Tarshish to go unto Ophir because of the gold; and they went not, for the ships were destroyed in Ezion Geber.
1KI 22:49 Then Ahaziah son of Ahab said to Jehoshaphat, Let my servants go with your servants. And Jehoshaphat wanted it not.
1KI 22:50 And Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and they entombed him by his fathers in the city of David his forefather. And Jehoram his son reigned instead of him.
1KI 22:51 And Ahaziah son of Ahab reigned over Israel in Samaria. In the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, Ahaziah son of Ahab reigned over Israel in Samaria two years.
1KI 22:52 And he acted wickedly before the LORD, and went in the way of Ahab his father, and in the way of Jezebel his mother, and in the sins of the house of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who led Israel into sin.
1KI 22:53 And he served to the Baalim, and did obeisance to them, and provoked to anger the LORD God of Israel, according to all what his father did.
2KI 1:1 And Moab annulled allegiance with Israel after the dying of Ahab.
2KI 1:2 And Ahaziah fell through the lattice in his upper room in Samaria, and was infirm. And he sent for messengers, and said to them, Go and ask of Baal the fly god of Ekron if I shall live through this my infirmity! And they went to ask.
2KI 1:3 And an angel of the LORD spoke to Elijah the Tishbite, saying, Rise up, go to meet the messengers of Ahaziah king of Samaria, and say to them! Is it on account of the not being a God in Israel you go to ask of Baal the fly god of Ekron?
2KI 1:4 On account of this thus says the LORD, The bed upon which you ascended upon it, you shall not go from it, for to death you shall die. And Elijah went, and spoke to them.
2KI 1:5 And the messengers returned to him. And he said to them, Why is it that you have returned?
2KI 1:6 And they said to him, A man ascended to meet us, and he said to us, Go, return to the king sending you, and say to him! Thus says the LORD, Is it because there is no God in Israel you go to seek anxiously by Baal the fly god of Ekron? On account of this, the bed upon which you ascended upon it you shall not go from it, for to death you shall die.
2KI 1:7 And the king said to them, What was the distinguishing mark of the man ascending to meet you, and speaking to you these words?
2KI 1:8 And they said to him, He was a hairy man, and a belt made of skin was girded upon his loin. And he said, This is Elijah the Tishbite.
2KI 1:9 And he sent to him a commander of fifty, and his fifty. And he ascended to him. And Elijah himself sat upon the top of the mountain. And the commander of fifty spoke to him, O man of God, the king calls you, Come down!
2KI 1:10 And Elijah answered and said to the commander of fifty, And if I am a man of God, fire shall come down from out of the heaven, and shall devour you and your fifty. And there came down fire from out of the heaven, and devoured him and his fifty.
2KI 1:11 And the king proceeded, and he sent to him another commander of fifty, and his fifty. And the commander of fifty ascended and spoke to him, and said, O man of God, thus says the king, Quickly come down!
2KI 1:12 And Elijah answered and said to him, If I am a man of God, fire shall come down from out of the heaven, and shall devour you and your fifty. And there came down fire from out of the heaven and devoured him and his fifty.
2KI 1:13 And the king proceeded again to send a third commander of fifty and his fifty. And the third commander of fifty came, and bent upon his knees in front of Elijah, and beseeched him, and spoke to him, and said, O man of God, value indeed my life, and the lives of your servants - these fifty, in your eyes!
2KI 1:14 Behold, there came down fire from out of the heaven, and devoured the first two commanders of fifties and their fifties. And now value indeed the life of your servants in your eyes!
2KI 1:15 And the angel of the LORD said to Elijah, Go down with him; you should not fear from their presence. And Elijah rose up, and went down with them to the king.
2KI 1:16 And he said to him, Thus says the LORD, Because you sent messengers to ask to Baal the fly god of Ekron, as if there was not a God in Israel to ask the word of him, on account of this the bed upon which you ascended upon it, you shall not go down from it, for in death you shall die.
2KI 1:17 And he died according to the saying of the LORD which Elijah spoke. And Joram the brother of Ahaziah reigned instead of him, (for there was not a son to him,) in the second year of Joram son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah.
2KI 1:18 And the rest of the words of Ahaziah, as many things as he did - behold are not these written in the scroll of the words of the days of the kings of Israel?
2KI 2:1 And it came to pass in the LORD to lead Elijah in a rumbling as into the heaven, that Elijah and Elisha went from out of Gilgal.
2KI 2:2 And Elijah said to Elisha, Sit down indeed here! For the LORD has sent me unto Beth-el. And Elisha said, As the LORD lives, and as your soul lives, shall I abandon you? And they came unto Beth-el.
2KI 2:3 And the sons of the prophets in Beth-el came to Elisha. And they said to him, Do you know that the LORD today takes your master above your head? And he said, Indeed even I knew, keep silent!
2KI 2:4 And Elijah said to Elisha, Sit down indeed here! For the LORD has sent me to Jericho. And Elisha said, As the LORD lives, and as your soul lives, shall I abandon you? And they came unto Jericho.
2KI 2:5 And the sons of the prophets in Jericho approached to Elisha. And they said to him, Do you know that today the LORD takes your master from above your head? And he said, I knew, keep silent!
2KI 2:6 And Elijah said to him, Sit down indeed here! For the LORD has sent me unto the Jordan. And Elisha said, As the LORD lives, and as your soul lives, shall I abandon you? And they both went.
2KI 2:7 And fifty men from the sons of the prophets came, and stood right opposite far off. And both stood at the Jordan.
2KI 2:8 And Elijah took his sheepskin, and wrapped it, and struck the water, and the water was divided here and there, and they both passed over through dry ground.
2KI 2:9 And it came to pass, in their passing over, Elijah said to Elisha, Ask! What I shall do for you before my being taken up from you. And Elisha said, Let there be indeed a double of your spirit upon me!
2KI 2:10 And Elijah said, You hardened to ask. If you should behold me being taken up from you, it will be thus to you; but if not, in no way will it be.
2KI 2:11 And it came to pass, of their going and speaking, that behold - a chariot of fire, and horses of fire, and they drew apart between both; and Elijah was taken up in a rumbling unto into the heaven.
2KI 2:12 And Elisha was beholding, and he yelled, O father, O father, the chariot of Israel, and his horseman. And he did not see him any longer. And he took hold of his garments, and tore them into two.
2KI 2:13 And he raised up high the sheepskin of Elijah which fell on top of him. And Elisha turned, and stood upon the edge of the Jordan;
2KI 2:14 And he took the sheepskin of Elijah which fell on top of him, and struck the waters, and said, Where is the God of Elijah now? And he struck the waters, and they tore apart here and there - and Elisha passed over.
2KI 2:15 And the sons of the prophets beheld him, the ones in Jericho right opposite. And they said, The spirit of Elijah rests upon Elisha. And they came to meet with him, and did obeisance to him upon the ground.
2KI 2:16 And they said to him, Behold indeed, there are with your servants fifty men, sons of power. In going indeed, let them seek your master, lest at some time spirit of the LORD lifted him, and tossed him in the mountains, or upon one of the hills! And Elisha said, You shall not send.
2KI 2:17 And they pressed him until he was shamed. And he said, Send them! And they sent fifty men; and they sought three days, and they did not find him.
2KI 2:18 And they returned to him. And he stayed in Jericho. And he said to them, Said I not to you, Do not go?
2KI 2:19 And the men of the city said to Elisha, Behold now, the site of the city is good, as you, O master, see; but the waters are bad, and the ground being barren.
2KI 2:20 And Elisha said, Bring to me a new water-pot, and cast salt there! And they took it to him.
2KI 2:21 And he went forth unto the outlet of the waters, and he tossed there the salt. And he said, Thus says the LORD, I have healed these waters, there will not be any longer there death and being barren.
2KI 2:22 And the waters were healed until this day, according to the word of Elisha which he spoke.
2KI 2:23 And he ascended from there unto Beth-el. And in his ascending in the way, that small boys came forth from out of the city, and they mocked him, and said to him, Ascend, bald one! Ascend, bald one!
2KI 2:24 And he turned aside behind them, and beheld them. And he cursed them in the name of the LORD. And two bears came forth from out of the forest, and they tore asunder of them forty and two children.
2KI 2:25 And he went from there to mount Carmel, and from there he turned unto Samaria.
2KI 3:1 And Joram son of Ahab reigned in Israel in Samaria in the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned twelve years.
2KI 3:2 And he did the wicked thing in the eyes of the LORD; only not as his father, and his mother. And he removed the monuments of Baal which his father made.
2KI 3:3 Except in the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who led Israel into sin, he cleaved; he did not abstain from it.
2KI 3:4 And Mesha king of Moab was a shepherd, and he restored to the king of Israel a hundred thousand lambs, and a hundred thousand rams with fleece.
2KI 3:5 And it came to pass, after the dying of Ahab, Moab annulled allegiance with the king of Israel.
2KI 3:6 And king Joram went forth in that day from out of Samaria, and he numbered Israel.
2KI 3:7 And he went and sent to Jehoshaphat king of Judah, saying, The king of Moab annulled allegiance with me. Shall you go with me unto Moab for war? And he said, I will go - likened to you, likened to me; as your people, so my people; as your horses, so my horses.
2KI 3:8 And he said, What way shall we ascend? And he said, The way of the wilderness of Edom.
2KI 3:9 And the king of Israel went, and the king of Judah, and the king of Edom. And they encircled a journey of seven days. And there was not water for the camp, and for the cattle at their feet.
2KI 3:10 And the king of Israel said, O that the LORD called these three kings to deliver them up into the hand of Moab.
2KI 3:11 And Jehoshaphat said to him, Is there not here a prophet of the LORD, that we should seek anxiously the LORD by him? And answered one of the servants of the king of Israel and said, Elisha son of Shaphat is here, who poured water upon the hands of Elijah.
2KI 3:12 And Jehoshaphat said, The word of the LORD is with him. And the king of Israel went down to him, and Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and the king of Edom.
2KI 3:13 And Elisha said to the king of Israel, What is there between me and you? Go to the prophets of your father, and to the prophets of your mother. And the king of Israel said to him, Is it that the LORD calls these three kings, to deliver them into the hands of Moab?
2KI 3:14 And Elisha said, As the LORD of the forces lives, in whom I stand before him, that if it were not the face of Jehoshaphat king of Judah which I receive, shall I have looked upon you or beheld you?
2KI 3:15 And now bring to me one for strumming! And it came to pass as the one strumming strummed, that the hand of the LORD came upon him.
2KI 3:16 And he said, Thus says the LORD, Make this dry stream cistern upon cistern.
2KI 3:17 For thus says the LORD, You shall not see wind, and you shall not see rain; but this dry stream shall be filled with water, and you shall drink, you and your possessions, and your cattle.
2KI 3:18 But it is a light thing in the eyes of the LORD. And I will deliver up Moab into your hands.
2KI 3:19 And you shall strike every fortified city, and every choice city; and every good tree you shall throw down; and all springs of water you shall obstruct, and every good portion of land you shall make useless with stones.
2KI 3:20 And it came to pass in the morning of the ascending of the sacrifice, that behold, waters came from out of the way of Edom, and the land was filled of the waters.
2KI 3:21 And all Moab heard that the kings ascended to wage war against them, and they yelled out from all sides girding on a belt, and went forward, and stood at the border.
2KI 3:22 And they rose early in the morning, and the sun rose upon the waters. And Moab beheld the waters right opposite fiery red as blood.
2KI 3:23 And they said, This is blood of a broadsword. The kings did combat, and each man struck his neighbor. And now, the spoils are for Moab.
2KI 3:24 And they entered into the camp of Israel, and Israel rose up and struck Moab, and they fled in front of them; and they entered going and beating Moab.
2KI 3:25 And they demolished the cities, and every good portion of land each man tossed his stone, and filled it. And every spring of water they obstructed, and every good tree they threw down; unto leaving behind the stones of the wall being demolished. And the slingers encircled, and struck it.
2KI 3:26 And the king of Moab beheld that the battle overpowered him, and he took with himself seven hundred men unsheathing the broadsword to cut through to the king of Edom - but they were not able.
2KI 3:27 And he took his first-born son whom he gave reign instead of him, and offered him as a whole burnt offering upon the wall. And came to pass a great repentance in Israel. And they departed from him, and returned to the land.
2KI 4:1 And one wife of the sons of the prophets yelled to Elisha, saying, Your servant, my husband died, and you know that your servant was fearing the LORD. And the money-lender came to take my two sons for servants to himself.
2KI 4:2 And Elisha said to her, What should I do for you, announce it to me? What is there to you in the house? And she said, There is not to your maidservant one thing in the house, only a vessel of olive oil in the house which I anoint with.
2KI 4:3 And he said to her, Go, you ask for yourself vessels from outside, from all your neighbors - empty vessels, not a few!
2KI 4:4 And you shall enter, and lock the door after you and after your sons, and shall pour out into these vessels, and the one being filled you shall take away.
2KI 4:5 And she went forth from him, and did thus. And she locked the door after herself and after her sons. And they drew near to her; and she poured until the vessels were filled.
2KI 4:6 And she said to her sons, Bring near to me a vessel! And they said to her, There is not yet a vessel. And the olive oil stopped.
2KI 4:7 And she came and reported to the man of God. And he said to her, Go, and render the olive oil for sale, and pay your interest, and you and your sons shall live by the rest!
2KI 4:8 And a day came, and Elisha passed over into Shunem. And there was a great woman there; and she took hold of him to eat bread. And it came to pass whenever it was fit for him to enter, that he turned aside there to eat bread.
2KI 4:9 And the woman said to her husband, Behold indeed, I know that this is a holy man of God, who travels unto us continually.
2KI 4:10 We should indeed make for him a small upper room; and we should put for him there a bed, and a table, and a chair, and a lamp-stand. And it will be in his coming to us, that he shall turn aside there.
2KI 4:11 And a day came, and he entered there, and he turned aside into the upper room, and went to bed there.
2KI 4:12 And he said to Gehazi his servant, Call this Shunammite! And he called her, and she stood before him.
2KI 4:13 And he said to him, Say indeed to her, Behold, you startled us all with this change of state, what shall we do for you? Is there to you a word to say to the king, or to the ruler of the force? And she said, I dwell in the midst of my people.
2KI 4:14 And he said to Gehazi, What must be done for her? And Gehazi said, That by all means a son is not to her, and her husband is old.
2KI 4:15 And he said, Call her! And he called her, and she stood by the door.
2KI 4:16 And Elisha said to her, At this time next year, about this hour, and living, you shall be holding a son. But she said, No, O master, O man of God, you should not disappoint your maidservant.
2KI 4:17 And the woman conceived, and bore a son at this same time about the same hour living, as Elisha spoke to her.
2KI 4:18 And the boy matured. And it came to pass the boy went forth to his father, to the ones harvesting.
2KI 4:19 And he said to his father, My head, my head. And he said to the servant, Carry him to his mother.
2KI 4:20 And he lifted him, and he carried him in to his mother, and laid him down to rest upon her knees until midday, and he died.
2KI 4:21 And she bore him, and rested him upon the bed of the man of God, and locked after him, and went forth.
2KI 4:22 And she called her husband, and said, Send indeed for me one of the servants, and one of the donkeys, and I shall run unto the man of God, and I shall return.
2KI 4:23 And he said, Why is it that you should go to him today? It is not a new moon, nor a Sabbath. And she said, Peace.
2KI 4:24 And she saddled the donkey, and said to her servant, You lead, and go! Do not wait for me to mount. For if I said to you, Go, then you shall go, and shall come to the man of God in mount Carmel.
2KI 4:25 And she went, and came unto the man of God in the mountain. And it came to pass as the man of God saw her right opposite, that he said to Gehazi his servant, Behold, that Shunammite.
2KI 4:26 Now run to meet her! And you shall say to her, Is peace to you? Is peace to your husband? Is peace to the boy? And she said, Peace.
2KI 4:27 And she straightened to the man of God in the mountain, and she seized his feet. And Gehazi approached to thrust her away, and the man of God said to him, Allow her! For her soul severely pains her, and the LORD concealed it from me, and announced it not to me.
2KI 4:28 And she said, Did I ask a son from my master? Did I not say, Do not mislead with me?
2KI 4:29 And Elisha said to Gehazi, Tie up your loin, and take my staff in your hand, and go! And if you should find a man in the way, you shall not bless him; and if a man should bless you, you shall not answer him; and you shall place my staff upon the face of the boy.
2KI 4:30 And the mother of the boy said, As the LORD lives, and as your soul lives, shall I leave you behind? And Elisha rose up, and went after her.
2KI 4:31 And Gehazi went in front of them, and placed the staff upon the face of the boy; and there was not a sound, and there was not a hearing anything. And he returned to meet him, and he reported to him, saying, the boy was not arisen.
2KI 4:32 And Elisha entered into the house, and behold, the boy having died was resting upon his bed.
2KI 4:33 And Elisha entered, and locked the door after the two of them. And he prayed to the LORD.
2KI 4:34 And he ascended, and bedded down upon the boy, and put his mouth upon his mouth, and his eyes upon his eyes, and his hands upon his hands. And he bent upon him, and warmed through the flesh of the boy.
2KI 4:35 And he returned, and went about the house this side and that side, and he ascended, and bent downwards upon the boy for seven times. And the boy opened his eyes.
2KI 4:36 And Elisha yelled out loud to Gehazi, and said, Call this Shunammite! And he called her, and she entered to him. And Elisha said, Receive your son!
2KI 4:37 And the woman entered, and fell at his feet, and did obeisance upon the ground, and took her son, and went forth.

2KI 4:39 And he went forth into the field to collect together herbs. And he found a vine in the field, and he collected together from it a wild gourd to fill his cloak, and he entered and put it into the kettle of the stew - but they did not know.
2KI 4:40 And he poured out to the men to eat. And it came to pass in their eating from the stew, that they yelled out, and said, Death is in the kettle, O man of God. And they were not able to eat.
2KI 4:41 And he said, You take flour, and put it in the kettle! And they put. And Elisha said to Gehazi, Pour out to the people, and let them eat! And there was not a bad thing still in the kettle.

2KI 5:1 And Naaman. the ruler of the force of the king of Syria, was a great man before his master, and being an admired person, for through him the LORD gave deliverance to Syria. And the man was mighty in strength, but leprous.
2KI 5:2 And the Syrians went forth in armed bands, and they captured from out of the land of Israel a small young woman; and she was in the presence of the wife of Naaman.
2KI 5:3 And she said to her lady, Ought that my master was in the presence of the prophet in Samaria, then he shall cure him from his leprosy.
2KI 5:4 And she entered and reported it to her master, and said, Thus and thus says the young woman from out of the land of Israel.
2KI 5:5 And the king of Syria said, Come, enter, and I will send out a scroll to the king of Israel! And he went, and took in his hand ten talents of silver, and six thousand pieces of gold, and ten changes of apparels.
2KI 5:6 And he brought the scroll to the king of Israel, saying, And now when ever this scroll should come to you, behold, I sent to you Naaman my servant, and you shall cure him from his leprosy.
2KI 5:7 And it came to pass, as the king of Israel read the scroll, that he tore his garments, and said, Am I God, the one putting to death and restoring to life, that this one sends to me to cure a man from his leprosy? For besides, know and see that this one makes an excuse towards me.
2KI 5:8 And it came to pass as Elisha the man of God heard that the king tore his garments, that he sent to the king of Israel, saying, Why do you tear your garments? Let indeed Naaman come to me, and he shall know that there is a prophet in Israel!
2KI 5:9 And Naaman came by horse and chariot, and stood at the door of the house of Elisha.
2KI 5:10 And Elisha sent to him a messenger, saying, In going, bathe in the Jordan seven times, and your flesh shall return to you, and you shall be cleansed.
2KI 5:11 And Naaman was enraged, and went forth, and said, Behold, I said, he will come forth to me, and shall stand, and call in the name of the LORD his God, and shall place his hand upon the place, and shall cure the leper.
2KI 5:12 Are not the Abana and Phaphar rivers of Damascus good over the Jordan, and all the waters of Israel? Shall I not go bathe in them, and be cleansed? And he turned aside, and went forth in rage.
2KI 5:13 And his servants approached, and said to him, If the prophet spoke a great word to you, would you not have done in so far as he said to you? Bathe and be cleansed!
2KI 5:14 And Naaman went down, and immersed in the Jordan seven times, according to the word of the man of God. And his flesh returned as the flesh of a small boy, and he was cleansed.
2KI 5:15 And he returned to the man of God, he and his camp, and came, and stood before him; and he said, Behold, now I know that there is not a God in all the earth, but only in Israel. And now, receive a blessing from your servant!
2KI 5:16 And Elisha said, As the LORD lives in whom I stand before him, shall I take it? And he pressed him to take, but he resisted persuasion.
2KI 5:17 And Naaman said, And if not, let there be given indeed to your servant a cargo team of mules of earth, for your servant shall not offer any longer a whole burnt offering and sacrifice to other gods; but only to the LORD alone.
2KI 5:18 And concerning this matter, the LORD shall deal kindly with me, to your servant in the entering of my master into the house of Rimmon to do obeisance there, for he shall rest upon my hand. And I shall do obeisance in the house of Rimmon, in his doing obeisance in the house of Rimmon. And the LORD shall deal kindly with me to your servant over this matter.
2KI 5:19 And Elisha said to Naaman, Go in peace! And he went forth from him into the land of Havratha.
2KI 5:20 And said Gehazi, the servant of Elisha the man of God, Behold, my master spared Naaman this Syrian, so as to not take from his hand of what he brought. As lives the LORD, that I shall run after him, and I shall take something from him.
2KI 5:21 And Gehazi pursued after Naaman. And Naaman saw him running after him, and he leaped down from the chariot for meeting him. And he said, Peace.
2KI 5:22 And Gehazi said, Peace. My master has sent me, saying, Behold, now there came to me two young men from out of mount Ephraim, from the sons of the prophets. Give indeed to them a talent of silver and two changes of apparel!
2KI 5:23 And Naaman said, Take two talents of silver! And he forced him, and he took to him two talents of silver in two purses, and two changes of apparel. And he gave unto his two servants, and they carried them in front of him.
2KI 5:24 And he came to a dark place, and took from their hands, and he placed them in the house, and sent out the men, and they left.

2KI 5:26 And Elisha said to him, Did not my heart go with you when the man turned from his chariot for meeting you? And now, you took the silver, and the garments, and shall you take with it gardens, and olive groves, and vineyards, and flocks, and herds, and bondmen and bondwomen?
