1CH 27:24 And Joab the son of Zeruiah began to count among the people, and he did not complete it. And anger against Israel happened because of this. And the number was not set down in writing in a scroll of the matters of the days of king David.
1CH 27:25 And over the storehouses of the king was Azmaveth the son of Adiel. And over the storehouses in the country, and in the cities, and in the towns, and in the estates, and in the towers, was Jehonathan the son of Uzziah.
1CH 27:26 And over the ones cultivating the ground of the ones being worked was Ezri the son of Chelub.
1CH 27:27 And over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite. And over the storehouses in the fields for the wine was Zabdi the one of Shiphmi.
1CH 27:28 And over the olive groves and over the sycamine trees in the plain was Baal-hanan the Gederite. And over the storehouses of the olive oil was Joash.
1CH 27:29 And over the oxen grazing in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite. And over the oxen in the canyons was Shaphat son Adlai.
1CH 27:30 And over the camels was Obil the Ishmaelite. And over the donkeys was Jehdeiah the one of Merathon.
1CH 27:31 And over the sheep was Jaziz the Hagerite. All these were rulers of the possessions of David the king.
1CH 27:32 And Jonathan, the uncle of David, was a counselor, a discerning man, and a scribe himself; and Jehiel the one of the Hachmoni was with the sons of the king.
1CH 27:33 And Ahitophel was counselor of the king, and Hushai was the foremost friend of the king.
1CH 27:34 And after Ahitophel next was Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar. And Joab was commander-in-chief for the king.
1CH 28:1 And David held an assembly of all the rulers of Israel, rulers of the tribes, and the rulers of the divisions of the daily rotations of the ones ministering to the king, and the rulers of the thousands, and of the hundreds, and of the keepers of the treasury, and of the ones over his possessions, and all the property of the king, and of his sons, with the eunuchs, and the mighty ones, and the warriors of the military in Jerusalem.
1CH 28:2 And David the king stood in the midst of the assembly, and said, Hear me my brothers, and my people! It came to me in heart to build a house for a rest for the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and a station to be the footstool of the feet of God. And I prepared the things needful for the construction.
1CH 28:3 And God said, You shall not build to me a house to name my name upon it, for you are a man of war, and you poured out blood.
1CH 28:4 And the LORD God of Israel chose by me from out of all the house of my father to be king over Israel into the eon; even for Judah to take up the crown; even of the house of Judah, the house of my father; even among the sons of my father; in me he wanted me to become king over all Israel.
1CH 28:5 And of all my sons (for the LORD gave to me many sons) he chose Solomon my son to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of the LORD over Israel.
1CH 28:6 And God said to me, Solomon your son shall build my house, and my courtyards; for I chose in him to be to me for a son, and I will be to him for a father.
1CH 28:7 And I will set up his kingdom unto the eon, if he should be strong to do, and to guard my commandments and my judgments, as in this day.
1CH 28:8 And now according to the eyes of all Israel, of every assembly of the LORD, and in the ears of our God, guard and seek all the commandments of the LORD our God! that you should inherit the good land, and should inherit it to your sons after you unto the eon.
1CH 28:9 And now, Solomon, O my son, know the God of your fathers, and serve to him with a perfect heart and a willing soul! for the LORD inquires diligently of all hearts, and every idea of thoughts he knows. If you should seek him, he will be found by you. And if you should leave him, he shall leave you to the end.
1CH 28:10 Behold now! For the LORD has taken you to build for him a house for a sanctuary; be strong, and act!
1CH 28:11 And David gave to Solomon his son the plan of the temple, and its houses, and its treasuries, and the upper rooms, and the inner storerooms, and the house of the atonement-seat,
1CH 28:12 and the plan of all which was in his spirit, and of the courtyards of the house of the LORD, and all of the chambers round about of the places for the storehouses of the house of the LORD, and of the storehouses of the holy things;
1CH 28:13 and for the divisions of daily rotations of the priests and the Levites, and for every work of ministration of the house of the LORD, and of the storehouses of the items of ministrations of the service of the house of the LORD;
1CH 28:14 and for the gold and the weight of its scale-weight, for all the items service by service, and to all the items of silver in weight, to every item service by service;
1CH 28:15 and the weight to the lamp-stands in gold, and to their lamps; gold in weight lamp-stand by lamp-stand, and to its lamps, and to the lamp-stands. But of the gold and silver lamp-stands he gave to him of the scale-weight of money, and the lamp-stands he gave to him the scale-weight.
1CH 28:16 In like manner he gave the weight for the tables of the place setting - each one a table of gold; and likewise the tables made of silver,
1CH 28:17 and the meat hooks, and libation bowls, and bowls of gold, and the basins of gold in weight for basin and basin; and the weight of the things of gold, and of the ones of silver of each weight;
1CH 28:18 and the thing for the altar of the incenses - the weight of the unadulterated gold. And he plainly showed to him the plan of the chariot of the cherubim opening and spreading out the wings, and shadowing over the ark of the covenant of the LORD.
1CH 28:19 All in the writing by the hand of the LORD David gave to Solomon, according to the advantage to him for understanding of the working out of the plan.
1CH 28:20 And David said to Solomon his son, Be strong and manly, and act! Do not fear nor be terrified! for the LORD my God is with you. He will not forsake you, and in no way should he abandon you until you complete every ministration of work of the house of the LORD.
1CH 28:21 And behold, the daily rotations of the priests and the Levites are for all the ministration of the house of God. And with you in every work, all eager in every voluntary thing, in wisdom according to every craft, are even the rulers, and all the people for all your words.
1CH 29:1 And David the king said to all the assembly, Solomon my son, in whom the LORD has taken for himself, is young and tender, and the work is great; for the place of abode is not to man, but only to the LORD God.
1CH 29:2 And I according to all my power have prepared for the house of my God - the gold for a gold thing, and the silver for a silver thing, and the brass for a brass thing, and the iron for an iron thing, and wood for a wood thing, and onyx stones, and fullness of very costly and colored stones, and every valuable stone, and stones of Paros in multitude.
1CH 29:3 And still, because of my favoring for the house of my God, there is to me gold and silver which I procured; and behold, I give it for the house of my God, for above and outside what I prepared for the house of the holy place -
1CH 29:4 three thousand talents of gold from Ophir, and seven thousand talents of unadulterated silver, to overlay by them the walls of the temple;
1CH 29:5 for the gold for the gold thing, and for the silver for the silver thing, and for every work by the hand of craftsmen. And who then is feeling eager to fill his hands today to the LORD?
1CH 29:6 And the rulers of the families were eager, and the rulers of the sons of Israel, and the commanders of thousands, and commanders of hundreds, and the superintendents of the works, and the managers of the king.
1CH 29:7 And they gave for the works of the house of the LORD five thousand talents of gold, and ten thousand dracmas, and ten thousand talents of silver, and ten thousand and eight thousand talents of brass, and of iron a hundred thousand talents.
1CH 29:8 And the ones who were found with themselves having precious stones gave to the storehouses of the house of the LORD, through the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.
1CH 29:9 And the people were glad over the voluntary offering, for from a full heart they were volunteering to the LORD. And David the king was glad with great gladness.
1CH 29:10 And king David blessed the LORD before the assembly, saying, Blessed are you, O LORD God of Israel, our father from the eon and unto the eon.
1CH 29:11 To you, O LORD, is the greatness, and the power, and the majesty, and the victory, and the acknowledgment. For you are master of all the things in heaven and upon the earth. To you, O LORD, is the kingdom, and the raising in all, and in all rule.
1CH 29:12 From you are the riches and the glory. You rule all, O LORD, ruler of all sovereignty. And in your hand is strength and dominion; and in your hand is to magnify, and to strengthen all.
1CH 29:13 And now, O LORD, we make acknowledgment to you, and we praise the name of your glory.
1CH 29:14 And who am I, and what is my people, that we were strong to volunteer to you thus? For all things are yours, and from out of your things we give to you.
1CH 29:15 For we are sojourners before you, and sojourners as all our fathers. And our days are as shadows upon the earth, and there is not a waiting.
1CH 29:16 O LORD our God, to all this abundance which we prepared for you to build a house to your name - to the holy name, for it is from your hand, and all things are yours.
1CH 29:17 And I know, O LORD, that you are the one examining hearts, and loving righteousness. And I in singleness of heart volunteered all these things. And now, your people, being found here, see with gladness, volunteering to you.
1CH 29:18 O LORD, God of Abraham, and Isaac, and Israel, of the ones of our fathers, keep of them the thing shaped of the thoughts of the heart of your people into the eon! And straighten out their hearts to you!
1CH 29:19 And give to my son Solomon a good heart to observe your commandments and your testimonies and your orders, and to lead all unto completion, and to build the furnishing of your house which I prepared!
1CH 29:20 And David said to all the assembly, Bless indeed the LORD our God! And all the assembly blessed the LORD, the God of their fathers, and bent the knees to do obeisance to the LORD, and to the king.
1CH 29:21 And David sacrificed to the LORD a sacrifice, and offered whole burnt offerings to the LORD on the next day of the first day - of a thousand calves, a thousand rams, a thousand lambs, and their libations, and sacrifices in multitude for all Israel.
1CH 29:22 And they ate and drank before the LORD in that day with great joy. And they gave reign for a second time for Solomon son of David. And they anointed him to the LORD as king, and Zadok for priest.
1CH 29:23 And Solomon sat upon the throne of the LORD as king instead of David his father. And he prospered, and all Israel obeyed him.
1CH 29:24 And the rulers, and the mighty ones, and also all the sons of king David submitted to him.
1CH 29:25 And the LORD magnified Solomon before all Israel, and put upon him glory of the kingdom as had not happened unto any king before him over Israel.
1CH 29:26 And David son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.
1CH 29:27 And the days which he reigned over Israel - forty years. In Hebron he reigned seven years, and in Jerusalem thirty-three years.
1CH 29:28 And he died in a good old age, full of days, in wealth and glory. And Solomon his son reigned instead of him.
1CH 29:29 And the rest of the words of David the king, the ones former and the ones latter, behold, they are written in the words of Samuel the seer, and by the words of Nathan the prophet, and by the words of Gad the seer,
1CH 29:30 concerning all his kingship, and all his dominion, and of the events of the times spreading unto him, and unto Israel, and unto all the kingdoms of the lands.
2CH 1:1 And Solomon son of David grew in strength over his kingdom, and the LORD his God was with him, and magnified him in stature.
2CH 1:2 And Solomon spoke to all Israel, to the commanders of thousands, and to the commanders of hundreds, and to the judges, and to all the rulers before all Israel - to the rulers of the families.
2CH 1:3 And Solomon went out, and all the assembly with him, unto the high place in Gibeon; of which the tent of the testimony of God was located, which Moses the servant of the LORD made in the wilderness.
2CH 1:4 But David brought the ark of God from out of the city of Kirjath Jearim, for the place David prepared for it, for he pitched a tent for it in Jerusalem.
2CH 1:5 And the altar of brass which Bezaleel son of Uri son of Hur made was there before the tent of the LORD. And Solomon and the assembly sought by it.
2CH 1:6 And Solomon offered there upon the altar of brass before the LORD in the tent of the testimony. And he offered upon it a thousand whole burnt offerings.
2CH 1:7 In that night God appeared to Solomon, and said to him, Ask! what I shall give to you?
2CH 1:8 And Solomon said to God, You performed with David my father a great act of kindness, and gave me reign instead of him.
2CH 1:9 And now, O LORD God, let your word be trustworthy with David my father! for you gave me reign over a people vast as the dust of the earth.
2CH 1:10 Now give to me wisdom and understanding! and I shall go forth before this people and enter in. For who shall judge this your great people?
2CH 1:11 And God said to Solomon, Because this happened in your heart, and you asked not for wealth of things, nor glory, nor the life of the ones detesting you, and you did not ask for many days - but you asked for yourself wisdom and understanding, so as to judge my people upon whom I gave you to reign over it.
2CH 1:12 The wisdom and the understanding I give to you; and wealth, and possessions, and glory I shall give to you, as did not happen likened unto you among the kings before you, and it will not be thus after you.
2CH 1:13 And Solomon came from Bama in Gibeon unto Jerusalem, from the face of the tent of the testimony, and reigned over Israel.
2CH 1:14 And Solomon brought together chariots and horsemen. And there were to him a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen. And he left them in the cities of the chariots, and with the king in Jerusalem.
2CH 1:15 And the king established silver and gold in Jerusalem as stones, and the cedars in Judea as sycamine trees in the plains in multitude.
2CH 1:16 And there was an exodus of the horses to Solomon from Egypt, and they were bought by the value of the merchants of the king to go forth.
2CH 1:17 And they ascended and brought from out of Egypt one chariot for six hundred pieces of silver, and a horse for fifty and a hundred. And thus to all the kings of the Hittites, and to the kings of Syria, they brought them forth by their hands.
2CH 2:1 And Solomon spoke to build the house to the name of the LORD, and a house for his kingdom.
2CH 2:2 And Solomon brought together seventy thousand men load carriers, and eighty thousand men quarrying in the mountain, and the supervisors over them - three thousand and six hundred.
2CH 2:3 And Solomon sent to Hiram king of Tyre, saying, As you did with David my father, and sent to him cedars to build for himself a house to dwell in it,
2CH 2:4 then behold, I his son am building a house to the name of the LORD my God, to sanctify it to him, to burn before him incense of aromatics, and for a place setting to be continually before him, and to offer whole burnt offerings continually in the morning and the evening, and on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the holidays of the LORD our God - into the eon this is for Israel.
2CH 2:5 And the house which I build is to be great; for great is the LORD our God beyond all the gods.
2CH 2:6 And who is strong to build to him a house? for the heaven and the heaven of the heaven does not bear him. And who am I building to him a house, except to burn incense in front of him?
2CH 2:7 And now, send to me a wise man, and one knowing how to prepare in gold, and in silver, and in brass, and in iron, and in purple, and in scarlet, and in blue, and having knowledge to carve carved works with the wise ones with me in Judah and in Jerusalem, whom David my father prepared!
2CH 2:8 And send to me timbers of cedars, and of junipers, and of pines, from out of Lebanon! for I know that your servants know how to fell timbers from Lebanon. And behold, my servants shall go with your servants,
2CH 2:9 to prepare for me timbers in multitude - for the house which I build is great and glorious.
2CH 2:10 And behold, to the ones working in the felling timbers, I have given grain for foods as gifts to your servants of cors of wheat - twenty thousand, and barley cors - twenty thousand, and wine measures - twenty thousand, and olive oil measures - twenty thousand.
2CH 2:11 And Hiram king of Tyre spoke by writing. And he sent to Solomon, saying, In the LORD loving his people, he put you over them for king.
2CH 2:12 And Hiram said, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, who made the heaven and the earth, who gave to king David a wise son, and knowing understanding and higher knowledge, who shall build a house to the LORD, and a house for his kingdom.
2CH 2:13 And now I have sent to you a man wise and knowing understanding - Hiram my servant,
2CH 2:14 a son of a woman from the daughters of Dan, and his father is a Tyrian man, knowing how to prepare in gold, and in silver, and in brass, and in iron, and in stones, and woods, and to weave in purple, and in blue, and in linen, and in scarlet, and to carve carvings, and to consider every device in which ever you should give to him with your wise ones, and the wise ones of my master David your father.
2CH 2:15 And now the grain, and the barley, and the olive oil, and the wine which my master spoke, let him send it to his servants!
2CH 2:16 And we will fell trees from out of Lebanon, according to all your need. And we will bring them by barge upon the sea to Joppa, and you shall bring them up unto Jerusalem.
2CH 2:17 And Solomon gathered all the men of the foreigners in the land of Israel, after the count which David his father counted them; and were found a hundred fifty thousand and three thousand six hundred.
2CH 2:18 And he made of them seventy thousand load carriers, and eighty thousand quarriers in the mountain, and three thousand six hundred foremen over the people.
2CH 3:1 And Solomon began to build the house of the LORD in Jerusalem on mount Moriah, of which the LORD appeared to David his father, in the place which David prepared on the threshing-floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
2CH 3:2 And he began to build in the second month, in the fourth year of his kingdom.
2CH 3:3 And with these Solomon began to build the house of God - the length of the first measurement was sixty cubits, and the breadth twenty cubits.
2CH 3:4 And the columned porch before the face of the house - its length upon the face of the width of the house was twenty cubits, and the height was a hundred and twenty cubits. And he gilded it inside in pure gold.
2CH 3:5 And the great house he boarded with woods of cedars, and gilded it in pure gold, and carved upon it palms and chainwork.
2CH 3:6 And he adorned the house with valuable stones for glory; and the gold was gold from Parvaim.
2CH 3:7 And he gilded the house, and its walls, and the gatehouses, and the roofing, and the doorways with gold; and he carved cherubim upon the walls.
2CH 3:8 And he made the house of the holy of the holies - its length upon the face of the width of the house was twenty cubits, and the breadth was twenty cubits. And he gilded it in pure gold, amounting to six hundred talents.
2CH 3:9 And the scale-weight of the nails - the scale-weight of the one was fifty shekels of gold. And the upper room he gilded in gold.
2CH 3:10 And he made in the house, in the holy of the holies, two cherubim, a work of incorruptible wood, and gilded them in gold.
2CH 3:11 And the wings of the cherubim - the length was twenty cubits, and to the one wing was five cubits touching the wall of the house.
2CH 3:12 And the other wing was five cubits, touching the wing of the other cherub.
2CH 3:13 And the wings of these cherubim, being open and spread out, was twenty cubits. And these stood upon their feet, and their faces were towards the house.
2CH 3:14 And he made the veil out of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and of linen, and wove cherubim in it.
2CH 3:15 And he made in front of the house two columns - thirty-five cubits in height, and their capitals were five cubits.
2CH 3:16 And he made chain-work in the dabir, and put them upon the tops of the columns. And he made a hundred figures of pomegranates, and put them upon the chainwork.
2CH 3:17 And he set the columns at the front of the temple, one at the right, and one at the left. And he called the name of the one at the right - Success, and the name of the one at the left - Strength.
2CH 4:1 And he made an altar of brass - twenty cubits was the length, and twenty cubits the breadth, and ten cubits the height.
2CH 4:2 And he made the cast sea - ten cubits the diameter, from its lip to its lip, globular round about, and five cubits was the height, and the circumference - thirty cubits encircled it round about.
2CH 4:3 And a representation of calves was underneath it, round about encircling it; ten in a cubit encircling the sea round about; with two rows of cast oxen in their being cast in a furnace,
2CH 4:4 in which they made them. And standing upon twelve calves was the sea. The three were looking north, and the three were looking west, and the three were looking south, and the three were looking towards the east. And the sea was upon them upward. And their posteriors were towards the inside.
2CH 4:5 And its thickness was a palm, and its lip was as a lip of a cup, having been carved of buds of a lily, having a capacity of three thousand measures. And he completed it.
2CH 4:6 And he made ten bathing tubs, and put five on the right, and five on the left, to wash in them the works of the whole burnt offerings, and to rinse off in them. But the sea was for the washing of the priests in it.
2CH 4:7 And he made the lamp-stands of gold - ten, according to their distinguishing manner. And he put them in the temple - five on the right, and five on the left.
2CH 4:8 And he made ten tables, and put them in the temple - five on the right, and five on the left. And he made a hundred bowls of gold.
2CH 4:9 And he made the courtyard of the priests, and the great courtyard, and doors for the courtyard - and their doorways were being brazed in brass.
2CH 4:10 And the sea he put at the corner of the house from out of the right towards the east of the part towards the south.
2CH 4:11 And Hiram made the kettles, and the meat hooks, and the censers. And Hiram completed doing all the work which he did for Solomon the king in the house of God -
2CH 4:12 making two columns, and the pommels, and the capitals upon the tops of the two columns, and two latticed works to cover up the two pommels of the capitals, which are upon the tops of the columns;
2CH 4:13 and pomegranates of gold - four hundred for the two latticed works; two kinds of pomegranates on the one latticed work, to cover the two bases of the capitals which are upon the columns.
2CH 4:14 And he made the bases - ten; and the bathing tubs he made upon the bases,
2CH 4:15 and the one sea, and the twelve calves underneath it,
2CH 4:16 and the kettles, and the meat hooks, and bowls - even all their items which Hiram made. And he brought to king Solomon in the house of the LORD - all of pure brass.
2CH 4:17 In the place round about the Jordan the king cast them in the thick earth, between Succoth and between Zeredathah.
2CH 4:18 And Solomon made all these items in multitude - exceedingly. For the scale-weight of the brass was not wanting.
2CH 4:19 And Solomon made all the items of the house of the LORD; even the altar of gold, and the tables. And upon them were breads of the place setting.
2CH 4:20 And the lamp-stands, and the lamps for the light according to the distinguishing manner in front of the dabir were of pure gold.
2CH 4:21 And their lamps, and their tongs, and the bowls, and the incense pans, and the censers were of pure gold.
2CH 4:22 And the inner door of the house, which is in the holies of the holies, and the doors of the house of the temple, were in gold.
2CH 5:1 And all the work was completed which Solomon did in the house of the LORD. And Solomon carried in the holy things of David his father, and the silver, and the gold, and all the items, and put them in a treasury house of the LORD.
2CH 5:2 Then Solomon held an assembly of all the elders of Israel, and all the rulers of the tribes, rulers of the families of the sons of Israel in Jerusalem, to bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD from out of the city of David - this is Zion.
2CH 5:3 And every man of Israel was assembled unto the king in the holiday - this the seventh month.
2CH 5:4 And all the elders of Israel came; and all the Levites took the ark.
2CH 5:5 And they brought the ark, and the tent of the testimony, and all the holy items in the tent - even the priests and the Levites brought it.
2CH 5:6 And king Solomon, and all the gathering of Israel, and the ones being assembled unto him before the ark, were sacrificing calves and sheep which shall not be counted nor considered because of the multitude.
2CH 5:7 And the priests carried in the ark of the covenant of the LORD into its place, into the dabir of the house, into the holies of the holies, underneath the wings of the cherubim.
2CH 5:8 And the cherubim were being opened and spread out of their wings over the place of the ark. And the cherubim covered the ark, and over its bearing poles on top.
2CH 5:9 And the bearing poles projected, and the tips of the bearing poles were seen from the ark of the holies in front of the dabir; and they were not seen outside. And they were there until this day.
2CH 5:10 Not a thing was in the ark except the two tablets which Moses stationed at Horeb, which the LORD ordained with the sons of Israel, in their coming forth from out of the land of Egypt.
2CH 5:11 And it came to pass in the coming forth of the priests from out of the holy places (for all the priests being found were sanctified, for they were not then set in order according to daily rotation),
2CH 5:12 and the Levites, the psalm singers, all with the sons of Asaph, with Heman, with Jeduthun, and to their sons, and to their brothers putting on apparels of fine linen, were with cymbals, and with stringed instruments, and with lutes, standing over against the altar, and with them a hundred and twenty priests trumpeting with the trumpets.
2CH 5:13 And there was one sound in the trumpeting, and in the singing along with stringed instruments, and in the sounding out loud with one voice to praise and to make acknowledgement to the LORD. And as they raised up high the voice with the trumpets, and with cymbals, and with instruments of the odes, that they said, Make acknowledgment to the LORD for he is good, for into the eon is his mercy! And the house was filled up of the cloud and of the glory of the LORD.
2CH 5:14 And the priests were not able to stand to officiate before the face of the cloud; for the glory of the LORD filled up the house of God.
2CH 6:1 Then Solomon said, The LORD spoke to encamp in dimness.
2CH 6:2 And I have built a house to your name, holy to you, and prepared to encamp into the eons.
2CH 6:3 And the king turned his face, and blessed all the assembly of Israel. And all the assembly of Israel stood by.
2CH 6:4 And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, who spoke by his mouth to David my father, and by his hands he fulfilled, saying,
2CH 6:5 From the day which I led my people from out of the land of Egypt, I did not choose a city from all the tribes of Israel to build a house for my name to be there, and I did not choose a man to be for leader over my people Israel.
2CH 6:6 But I chose Jerusalem for my name to be there; and I chose David to be above my people Israel.
2CH 6:7 And it came upon the heart of David my father to build a house to the name of the LORD God of Israel.
2CH 6:8 And the LORD said to David my father, Since it was upon your heart to build a house to my name, you do well, for it was upon your heart.
2CH 6:9 Except you shall not build to me a house; for your son who comes forth from out of your loin, he shall build the house to my name.
2CH 6:10 And the LORD established the word which he spoke, and I became instead of David my father, and I sit upon the throne of Israel, as the LORD said; and I built the house to the name of the LORD God of Israel.
2CH 6:11 And I put there the ark, in which the covenant of the LORD is located which he ordained with Israel.
2CH 6:12 And he stood before the altar of the LORD, before all the assembly of Israel; and opened and spread out his hands.
2CH 6:13 For Solomon made a brass platform, and put it in the midst of the courtyard of the temple - five cubits was its length, and five cubits was its breadth, and three cubits was its height. And he stood upon it, and bent upon his knees before all the assembly of Israel, and opened and spread out his hands into the heaven.
2CH 6:14 And he said, O LORD God of Israel, there is not a God likened to you in heaven, nor upon the earth, keeping the covenant, (and showing mercy to your children going before you with all their heart);
2CH 6:15 which you kept with your servant David my father, which you spoke to him; and you spoke by your mouth, and by your hands you fulfilled it, as this day.
2CH 6:16 And now, O LORD the God of Israel, keep with your servant David, my father, what you spoke to him, saying, There shall not fail to you a man from before my face sitting upon the throne of Israel; if only your sons should guard their way to go by my law, as you went before me.
2CH 6:17 And now, O LORD God of Israel, let your saying indeed be trustworthy, which you spoke to your manservant David.
2CH 6:18 For shall God truly dwell with men upon the earth? If the heaven and the heaven of the heaven is not sufficient to you; then what is this house which I built?
2CH 6:19 And should you look upon the prayer of your manservant, and upon his supplication, O LORD my God, to heed the supplication and the prayer which your manservant prayed before you today;
2CH 6:20 for your eyes to be open unto this house day and night, in this place which you said to call upon your name there; to hear the prayer which your manservant prayed in this place;
2CH 6:21 then shall you hear the supplication of your manservant, and of your people Israel, in what ever they should pray to this place; and you shall hear from the place of your dwelling - from the heaven; and you shall hear and shall be propitious.
2CH 6:22 If a man should sin against his neighbor, and he takes upon him an oath to cause him to make an oath, and he should come and make an oath against the altar in this house;
2CH 6:23 then you shall listen from out of the heaven, and shall act, and shall judge your servants, to recompense to the lawless one, and to recompense his ways upon his head; and to do justice to the just one, to recompense to him according to his righteousness.
2CH 6:24 And if your people Israel should be devastated before an enemy, if they should sin against you, and should turn, and should acknowledge your name, and should pray, and should beseech before you in this house;
2CH 6:25 then you shall listen from out of the heaven, and you shall be propitious to the sins of your people Israel, and shall return them into the land which you gave to them and to their fathers.
2CH 6:26 And in the holding together the heaven, and there is no rain, because they sinned against you; and they pray to this place, and confess to your name, and from their sins they shall turn, because you shall humble them;
2CH 6:27 then you shall listen from out of the heaven, and shall be propitious to the sins of your servants, and your people Israel, that you shall make manifest to them the good way in which they shall go by it; and you shall put rain upon your land, which you gave to your people for an inheritance.
2CH 6:28 If famine happens upon the land, if plague happens, wind-blown blight, jaundice; if there should be locust and grasshopper, and if its enemies should afflict it in the land against its cities; according to every calamity and every misery;
2CH 6:29 then every prayer, and all supplication, whichever should be by any man, and all your people Israel, if a man should know his infection and his infirmity, and should open and spread out his hands to this house;
2CH 6:30 then you shall listen from out of the heaven, from out of your prepared home, and you shall atone, and shall give to a man according to his ways (as you should know his heart, for you most only know the heart of the sons of men),
2CH 6:31 so that they should fear you, to go in all your ways, all the days which they should live upon the face of the land which you gave to our fathers.
2CH 6:32 And also every alien who is not of your people Israel, and should come from out of a land far off because of your great name, and your fortified hand, and your high arm; and should come and should pray in this place;
2CH 6:33 then you shall listen from out of the heaven, from out of your prepared home, and you shall do according to all as much as the alien should have called upon you; so that all the peoples of the earth should know your name, and to fear you, as your people Israel, and to know that your name is called upon in this house which I built.
2CH 6:34 And if your people should go forth for war against its enemies, in the way which you shall send them, and they should pray to you towards the way of this city which you chose, towards it and the house which I built to your name;
2CH 6:35 then you shall hear their prayer and their supplication from out of the heaven, and you shall do them justice.
2CH 6:36 For they shall sin against you - for there is not a man who shall not sin. And if you should be enraged over them, and should deliver them before the face of the enemies, and the ones capturing shall take them captive into a land far or near;
2CH 6:37 and they should turn their heart in the land of which they were taken captive there, and shall turn, and shall beseech you in the land of their captivity, saying, We sinned, we acted lawlessly, and we acted impiously;
2CH 6:38 and they should turn towards you with all their heart, and with all their soul, in the land of their being taken captive, of which they took them captive there, and they should pray in the way of their land, which you gave to their fathers, and of the city of which you chose, and of the house of which I built to your name;
2CH 6:39 then you shall hear from the heaven, from your prepared home, of their prayer and their supplication, and shall make their case, and shall be propitious to the people sinning against you.
2CH 6:40 And now, O LORD God, let indeed your eyes be open, and your ears attentive to the supplication of this place!
2CH 6:41 And now, rise up O LORD God, in your rest, you and the ark of your strength! Your priests, O LORD God, shall clothe themselves in deliverance, and your sacred ones shall be glad in good things.
2CH 6:42 O LORD God, you should not turn the face of your anointed one. Remember the mercies of David your servant!
2CH 7:1 And as Solomon completed praying, that fire came down from out of the heaven and devoured the whole burnt offerings and the sacrifices; and the glory of the LORD filled the house.
2CH 7:2 And the priests were not able to enter into the house of the LORD at that time, for the glory of the LORD filled the house of the LORD.
2CH 7:3 And all the sons of Israel seeing the fire come down, and the glory of the LORD upon the house, that they fell upon their face upon the ground, upon the stone pavement, and did obeisance and gave praise to the LORD, saying, For he is good, for his mercy is into the eon.
2CH 7:4 And the king and all the people were sacrificing sacrifices before the LORD.
2CH 7:5 And king Solomon sacrificed the sacrifice of calves - twenty and two thousand, and pastured sheep - a hundred and twenty thousand. And the king and all the people dedicated the house of God.
2CH 7:6 And the priests were standing at their watches, and the Levites with instruments of odes of the LORD, which David the king made to acknowledge before the LORD, that his mercy is into the eon, along with the hymns of David by their hand; and the priests were trumpeting trumpets opposite them, and all Israel was standing.
2CH 7:7 And Solomon sanctified the middle of the courtyard in the house of the LORD; for he offered there the whole burnt offerings, and the fat of the deliverance offerings; for the altar of brass which Solomon made did not suffice to take the whole burnt offerings, and the gift offerings, and the fat.
2CH 7:8 And Solomon observed the holiday at that time seven days, and all Israel with him, an exceedingly great assembly, from the entrance of Hamath, and unto the rushing stream of Egypt.
2CH 7:9 And he made a holiday recess on the eighth day; he observed seven days for the dedication of the altar, and the holiday seven days.
2CH 7:10 And on the third and twentieth day of the seventh month he sent the people to their tents being glad and with a good heart over the good things which the LORD did to David, and to Solomon, and to Israel his people.
2CH 7:11 And Solomon completed the house of the LORD, and the house of the king. And all as much as Solomon wanted in his soul to do with the house of the LORD, and in his house, he was prospered.
2CH 7:12 And the LORD appeared to Solomon in the night, and said to him, I heard your prayer, and I chose in this place to myself for a house of sacrifice.
2CH 7:13 If I should hold up the heaven, and rain does not happen, and if the locust should be given charge to eat up the land, and if I send a plague among my people,
2CH 7:14 and they should have shame, (my people upon whom call upon my name by them), and should pray, and should seek my face, and should turn from their wicked ways; then I shall listen from out of the heaven, and will be propitious to their sins, and will heal their land.
2CH 7:15 And now, my eyes will be open, and my ears attentive to the prayer of this place.
2CH 7:16 And now, I chose and have sanctified this house, for my name to be there unto the eon. And my eyes and my heart will be there all the days.
2CH 7:17 And if you should go before me as David your father went, and should do according to all what I gave charge to you, and keep my orders and my judgments;
2CH 7:18 then I will raise up the throne of your kingdom as I ordained to David your father, saying, There shall not be removed to you a man ruling in Israel.
2CH 7:19 But if you should turn, and should abandon my orders, and my commandments, which I put before you, and you should go and should serve to other gods, and should do obeisance to them;
2CH 7:20 then I will remove you from the land of which I gave to you; and this house which I sanctified to my name I will disown it from my face, and will appoint it for a parable, and for a tale among all the nations.
2CH 7:21 And this house, which was exalted - everyone traveling by it shall be amazed, and shall say, For why did the LORD do thus to this land, and to this house?
2CH 7:22 And they shall say, For they abandoned the LORD God of their fathers, the one leading them from out of the land of Egypt; and they took hold of other gods, and did obeisance to them, and served to them. On account of this he brought upon them all this evil.

2CH 8:7 All the people left behind from the Hittite, and the Amorite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite, who are not of Israel
2CH 8:8 (but were of their sons being left behind after them in the land of which the sons of Israel did not utterly destroy), even them Solomon led into tribute until this day.

2CH 9:2 And Solomon announced to her all her words; and not a word went by from Solomon which he did not report to her.
2CH 9:3 And the queen of Sheba beheld the wisdom of Solomon, and the house which he built,
2CH 9:4 and the foods of his tables, and the form of his servants, and the station of his ministers, and their garments, and his wine servers, and their uniform, and the whole burnt offerings which he offered in the house of the LORD; and there was not a breath in her any longer.
2CH 9:5 And she said to the king, The word is true which I heard in my land concerning your words, and concerning your wisdom.
2CH 9:6 And I did not trust in the words until of which I came and beheld with my eyes. And behold, the half was not reported to me of the magnitude of your wisdom, being added over the hearing which I heard.
2CH 9:7 Blessed are your men, blessed are these your servants standing beside you always and hearing your wisdom.

2CH 9:9 And she gave to the king a hundred twenty talents of gold, and aromatics in very great multitude, and valuable stone. And there was not any according to those aromatics which the queen of Sheba gave to king Solomon.
2CH 9:10 And the servants of Hiram, and the servants of Solomon, brought gold to Solomon from out of Ophir, and wood of pines, and valuable stone.
2CH 9:11 And the king made ascents from the wood of pines for the house of the LORD, and for the house of the king, and harps and stringed instruments for the singers; and there was not seen such as these before in the land of Judah.
2CH 9:12 And king Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her wants, which she asked for, outside of all what she brought to king Solomon. And she returned unto her land.

2CH 9:14 besides what the men arranging and trading brought. And all the kings of Arabia and satraps of the land brought gold and silver to king Solomon.
2CH 9:15 And king Solomon made two hundred shields of hammered out gold - six hundred weights of pure gold being used upon the one shield.
2CH 9:16 And three hundred shields of hammered out gold of three hundred weights of gold bore upon each shield. And the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.
2CH 9:17 And the king made a great ivory throne of tusks, and gilded it in unadulterated gold.
2CH 9:18 And there were six stairs to the throne being bonded with gold; and he placed a footstool in gold under the throne; and armrest angles on this side and on that side were upon the chair of the throne, and two lions were standing by the armrest angles.
2CH 9:19 And twelve lions were standing there upon the six stairs on this side and on that side - there was not such in any kingdom.
2CH 9:20 And all the items of king Solomon were of gold, and all the items of the house of the forest of Lebanon were overtaken covered with gold. - silver was not considered as anything in the days of Solomon.
2CH 9:21 For ships belonging to the king went to Tarshish with the servants of Hiram. Once in three years boats came from Tarshish to the king being full of gold, and silver, and tusks of ivory, and apes.
2CH 9:22 And Solomon was magnified above all the kings of the earth, even in riches and wisdom.

2CH 9:25 And there were to Solomon four thousand female horses for chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen. And he stationed them in the cities of the chariots, and with the king in Jerusalem.
2CH 9:26 And he was leader of all the kings from the river and unto the land of the Philistines, and unto the border of Egypt.

2CH 10:3 And they sent and called him. And Jeroboam came, and all the assembly of Israel and spoke to Rehoboam, saying,
2CH 10:4 Your father hardened our yoke; and now, you lighten from the hard servitude of your father, and from his heavy yoke which he put upon us, and we will serve to you!
2CH 10:5 And he said to them, Go until three days, and then come to me! And the people went forth.
2CH 10:6 And king Rehoboam brought together the elders standing before Solomon his father during his life, saying, How do you counsel to answer a word to this people?
2CH 10:7 And they spoke to him, saying, If today you should be for good to this people, and you should please them, and should speak to them good words, then they will be to you for servants all the days.
2CH 10:8 And he forsook the counsel of the elders advising to him, and was advised by the young men being brought up with him standing before him.
2CH 10:9 And he said to them, What word do you counsel that I shall answer to this people who spoke to me, saying, Spare us from the yoke of which your father put upon us?
2CH 10:10 And the young men having been brought up with him said to him, saying, Thus shall you speak to the people speaking to you, saying, Your father oppressed our yoke, and you now lighten from our yoke! Thus you shall say to them, My small finger is thicker than the loin of my father.
2CH 10:11 And now my father inserted to you a heavy yoke, but I will add upon your yoke. My father corrected you with whips, but I will correct you with scorpions.
2CH 10:12 And Jeroboam came and all the people to Rehoboam on the third day, as the king said, saying, Return to me on the third day!
2CH 10:13 And the king answered them hard; and king abandoned Rehoboam the counsel of the elders.
2CH 10:14 And he spoke to them according to the counsel of the younger men, saying, My father oppressed your yoke, and I will add upon it. My father corrected you with whips, and I will correct you with scorpions.
2CH 10:15 And the king hearkened not to the people. For it was a conversion from God, that the LORD should establish his word, which he spoke by the hand of Ahijah the Shilonite concerning Jeroboam son of Nebat.
2CH 10:16 And all Israel saw that the king hearkened not to them. And the people answered to the king, saying, What is our portion with David, and the inheritance with the son of Jesse? Run to your tents, O Israel! Now look to your own house, David! And all Israel went to its tents.

2CH 14:1 And Abijah slept with his fathers, and they entombed him in the city of David. And Asa his son took reign instead of him. In the days of Asa the land of Judah was quiet ten years.
2CH 14:2 And he did the good and the upright thing before the LORD his God.
2CH 14:3 And he removed the altars of the aliens, and the high places, and broke the monuments, and cut down the sacred groves.
2CH 14:4 And he spoke to Judah to seek after the LORD God of their fathers, and to observe the law and the commandments.
2CH 14:5 And he removed from all of the cities of Judah the altars and the idols. And the kingdom was at peace before him.
2CH 14:6 And he built walled cities in the land of Judah, for there was peace in the land; and there was not war to him in these years, for the LORD gave rest to him.
2CH 14:7 And he said to Judah, We should build these cities, and we should make walls, and towers, and gates, and bars, in which land we dominate, for as we sought the LORD our God, he sought us, and rested us round about. And they built and prospered.
2CH 14:8 And there was to Asa a force of armor-bearers lifting shields and spears in Judah - three hundred thousand. And in Benjamin men armed with small shields, and bowmen - two hundred and eighty thousand - all these were warriors of power.
2CH 14:9 And Zerah the Ethiopian came forth against them in a force with a thousand thousand, and with three hundred chariots, and came unto Mareshah.
2CH 14:10 And Asa came forth to meet against him, and deployed for war in the ravine to the north of Mareshah.
2CH 14:11 And Asa yelled to the LORD his God, and said, O LORD, it is not impossible for you to deliver by many or by few. Help us, O LORD our God, for upon you we yield, and in your name we came against this vast multitude. O LORD our God, you are God. Let not man prevail against you!
2CH 14:12 And the LORD struck the Ethiopians before Asa, and before Judah; and the Ethiopians fled.
2CH 14:13 And Asa pursued them and his people unto Gerar. And the Ethiopians fell so as to not be in procurement of safety for themselves, for they were defeated before the LORD, and before his force. And they despoiled many spoils.
2CH 14:14 And they knocked down their towns round about Gerar, for there became a change of state of the LORD upon them. And they plundered all their cities, for many spoils came to them.
2CH 14:15 And indeed the tents of the cattle they cut down, and took many sheep and camels, and returned to Jerusalem.
2CH 15:1 And Azariah son of Oded - spirit of God came upon him.
2CH 15:2 And he went forth for meeting with Asa, and said to him, Hear me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin! The LORD is with you in your being with him. And if you seek after him, he shall be found by you; and if you should abandon him, he will abandon you.
2CH 15:3 For many days passed to Israel without the true God, and not a priest to plainly show things, and with not a law.
2CH 15:4 And he shall turn them in affliction unto the LORD God of Israel, and they shall seek him, and he shall be found by them.
2CH 15:5 And in those times there is not peace to the one going forth, and to the one entering, for much astonishment was upon all the dwelling places.
2CH 15:6 And nation shall wage war against nation, and city against city, for God startled them in every affliction.
2CH 15:7 And you be strong, and do not loosen your hands! for there is a wage for your work.
2CH 15:8 And in Asa hearing of these words, and the prophecy of Oded the prophet, that he prevailed, and cast out the loathsome things of all the land of Judah and Benjamin, and from the cities which he took control of from Jeroboam, from the mountains of Ephraim, and he dedicated the altar of the LORD which was in front of the temple of the LORD.
2CH 15:9 And he assembled Judah and Benjamin, and the foreigners sojourning with him from Ephraim, and from Manasseh, and from Simeon; for many from out of Israel were added to him in their seeing that the LORD God himself was with him.
2CH 15:10 And they gathered in Jerusalem in the third month, in the fifteenth year of the kingdom of Asa.
2CH 15:11 And they sacrificed to the LORD in that day from the spoils which they brought - seven hundred calves and seven thousand sheep.
2CH 15:12 And they went into a covenant to seek the LORD God of their fathers with their entire heart and with their entire soul.
2CH 15:13 And all who ever did not seek after the LORD God of Israel shall die, from younger unto older, from man unto woman.
2CH 15:14 And they swore by an oath to the LORD with a great voice, and with shouting, and with trumpets, and with horns.
2CH 15:15 And all Judah was glad on account of the oath, for from their entire soul they swore by an oath, and with all their volition they sought him; and he was found by them. And the LORD gave rest to them round about.
2CH 15:16 And Asa removed Maachah the mother of the king to not be officiating to Ashtoreth. And he cut in pieces the idol, and incinerated it at the rushing stream Kidron.
2CH 15:17 Except the high places were not removed, for they existed in Israel. Only the heart of Asa was perfect all his days.
2CH 15:18 And he carried in the holy things of his father, and his own holy things into the house of God - silver, and gold, and vessels.
2CH 15:19 And war was not with him until the thirtieth and fifth year of the kingdom of Asa.
2CH 16:1 And in the thirtieth and eighth year of the kingdom of Asa, Baasha king of Israel ascended against Judah and built Ramah, to not give an exit nor entrance to Asa king of Judah.
2CH 16:2 And Asa took silver and gold from out of the treasuries of the house of the LORD, and from the house of the king, and sent to the son of Hadad king of Syria, the one dwelling in Damascus, saying,
2CH 16:3 Ordain a covenant between me and between you, and between my father and between your father! Behold, I have sent to you gold and silver. Come, and efface your covenant with Baasha king of Israel, and he shall go forth from me!
2CH 16:4 And the son of Hadad hearkened to king Asa, and sent the rulers of his force against the cities of Israel. And he struck Ijon, and Dan, and Abel-maim, and all the places round about Naphtali.
2CH 16:5 And it happened when Baasha heard, that he left off to no longer build Ramah, and rested his work.
2CH 16:6 And king Asa took all Judah to lift away all the stones of Ramah, and its timbers, which Baasha built with; and he built with them Geba and Mizpah.
2CH 16:7 And in that time Hanani the prophet came to Asa king of Judah, and said to him, Because you relied upon the king of Syria, and you did not rely upon the LORD your God, on account of this the force of the king of Syria came through safe from your hand.
2CH 16:8 Were not the Ethiopians and Lubim a vast force, and of courage for chariots and horsemen in multitude, exceedingly? And in your relying upon the LORD, he delivered them into your hands.
2CH 16:9 For the eyes of the LORD look in all the earth to strengthen with every heart perfect towards him. You have known about this; from now on war will be with you.
2CH 16:10 And Asa was enraged with the prophet, and placed him in the house of the prison, for he was angry over this. And Asa laid waste among the people at that time.
2CH 16:11 And behold, the words of Asa, the first and the last, are written upon the scroll of the kings of Judah and Israel.
2CH 16:12 And Asa was infirm in the thirtieth and ninth year of his kingdom in his feet, until his infirmity was higher severe.. And in his infirmity he did not seek the LORD, but the physicians.
2CH 16:13 And Asa slept with his fathers, and came to an end in the fortieth and first year of his kingdom.
2CH 16:14 And they entombed him in the tomb in which he dug for himself in the city of David. And they rested him upon the bed, and filled it of aromatics, and types of scented perfumes. And they made for him a great funeral, and kindled him a great burning - unto exceedingly.
2CH 17:1 And Jehoshaphat his son reigned instead of him. And Jehoshaphat strengthened against Israel.
2CH 17:2 And he put a force in all the fortified cities of Judah, and put leaders in the land of Judah, and in the cities of Ephraim which Asa his father first took.
2CH 17:3 And the LORD was with Jehoshaphat, for he went in the first ways of David his father; and did not seek after the idols.
2CH 17:4 But he sought after the LORD God of his father, and by his commandments he went, and not according to the works of Israel.
2CH 17:5 And the LORD straightened the kingdom in his hand; and all Judah gave gifts to Jehoshaphat; and there became to him much riches and glory.
2CH 17:6 And his heart was raised up high in the ways of the LORD. And again he removed the high places and the sacred groves from the land of Judah.
2CH 17:7 And in the third year of his kingship he sent his leaders, and the sons of the mighty ones - Obadiah, and Zechariah, and Nethaneel, and Michaiah, to teach in the cities of Judah.
2CH 17:8 And with them the Levites - Shemaiah, and Nethaniah, and Zebadiah, and Asahel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehonathan, and Adonijah, and Tobijah, and Tob-adonijah, the Levites; and with them Elishama and Jehoram, the priests.
2CH 17:9 And they taught in Judah, and with them was the book of the law of the LORD. And they went through in the cities of Judah, and taught the people.
2CH 17:10 And there came to pass a change of state of the LORD upon all the kingdoms of the land round about Judah, and they did not wage war against Jehoshaphat.
2CH 17:11 And from the Philistines they brought to Jehoshaphat gifts and silver; and also the Arabians brought to him rams of the flocks - seven thousand seven hundred; he-goats - seven thousand seven hundred.
2CH 17:12 And Jehoshaphat was going greater unto height; and he built places of abode in Judah, and fortified cities.
2CH 17:13 And many works were taking place by him in Judah. And mighty men warriors being strong were in Jerusalem.
2CH 17:14 And this is the number of them according to the houses of their families. And to Judah the commanders of thousands - Adnah the ruler, and with him mighty sons of power - three hundred thousand.
2CH 17:15 And after him Johahnan the ruler, and with him two hundred eighty thousand.
2CH 17:16 And after him was Amasiah the son of Zichri, the one feeling eager to the LORD; and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of power.
2CH 17:17 And from Benjamin the mighty man of power Eliada, and with him bowmen and men armed with small shields - two hundred thousand.
2CH 17:18 And with him was Jehozabad, and with him a hundred eighty thousand mighty men of war.
2CH 17:19 These were the ones officiating to the king, outside of the ones whom the king put in the fortified cities in all Judea.
2CH 18:1 And there came to Jehoshaphat still much riches and glory. And he was allied by marriage with the house of Ahab.
2CH 18:2 And he went down at the end of years to Ahab in Samaria. And Ahab sacrificed to him sheep and calves in abundance, and to the people with him, and persuaded him to go up with him unto Ramoth Gilead.
2CH 18:3 And Ahab king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat king of Judah, Will you go with me to Ramoth of Gilead? And he said to him, As you, so also I, and as your people, also my people; even with you for war.
2CH 18:4 And Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, Let us seek indeed today the word of the LORD!
2CH 18:5 And the king of Israel gathered the prophets - four hundred men. And he said to them, Shall I go to Ramoth Gilead for war, or should I wait? And they said, Ascend, and God shall give them into the hands of the king!
2CH 18:6 And Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of the LORD yet, that we shall seek anxiously by him?
2CH 18:7 And the the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, There is one man to seek the LORD through him - and I detest him; for he is not prophesying for good things concerning me, for all his days are for bad things. He is Michaiah son of Imla. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king speak thus!
2CH 18:8 And the king of Israel called one eunuch, and said, Quickly call Michaiah son of Imla!
2CH 18:9 And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah were sitting each upon his throne, being clothed with robes, and they sat down in the broad space at the door of Samaria; and all the prophets were prophesying before them.
2CH 18:10 And Zedekiah son of Chenaanah made for himself horns of iron, and he said, Thus says the LORD, With these you shall gore the Syrian until whenever he should be finished off entirely.
2CH 18:11 And all the prophets prophesied thus, saying, Ascend unto Ramoth Gilead! and you shall prosper in the way, and the LORD will give it into the hands of the king.
2CH 18:12 And the messenger going to call Michaiah spoke to him, saying, Behold, the prophets spoke good things with one mouth concerning the king; and let your words indeed be as one of them, and you shall speak good things!
2CH 18:13 And Michaiah said, As the LORD lives, that what ever God should say to me, it I shall speak.
2CH 18:14 And he came to the king. And the king said to him, Michaiah, Shall I go to Ramoth Gilead for war, or should I wait? And he said, Ascend! And your way shall prosper, and they shall be given into your hands.
2CH 18:15 And the king said to him, How often shall I bind you by an oath that you should not speak to me except the truth in the name of the LORD?
2CH 18:16 And Michaiah said, I see Israel all being scattered in the mountains as sheep in which there is not a shepherd. And the LORD said, These have not a leader; let them each return to his house in peace.
2CH 18:17 And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, Said I not to you that he would not prophesy for my good, but only bad?
2CH 18:18 And Michaiah said, It is not so. Hear the word of the LORD! I beheld the LORD sitting upon his throne, and all the force of the heaven stood beside at his right and at his left.
2CH 18:19 And the LORD said, Who shall deceive Ahab king of Israel, that he shall ascend and shall fall in Ramoth Gilead? And this one spoke thus, and this other one spoke thus.
2CH 18:20 And came forth the spirit, and stood in the presence of the LORD, and said, I shall deceive him. And the LORD said, By what means?
2CH 18:21 And he said, I shall go forth, and I will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And he said, You shall deceive, and shall prevail. Go forth, and do so!
2CH 18:22 And now, behold, the LORD put a lying spirit in the mouths of all these your prophets, and the LORD spoke against you for bad things.
2CH 18:23 And Zedekiah son of Chenaanah approached and struck Michaiah upon the jaw, and said to him, By what way passed the spirit of the LORD from me to speak to you?
2CH 18:24 And Michaiah said, Behold, you shall see in that day in which you shall enter closet by closet to hide.
2CH 18:25 And the king of Israel said, Take Michaiah and return him to Amon the ruler of the city, and to Joash the son of the king.
2CH 18:26 And you shall say, Thus said the king, Put this one into a prison house, and let him eat bread of affliction and water of affliction until my returning in peace!
2CH 18:27 And Michaiah said, If by returning you should return in peace, the LORD spoke not by me. And he said, Hearken all peoples!
2CH 18:28 And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah ascended to Ramoth Gilead.
2CH 18:29 And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, I shall cover up and enter into the battle; but you put on my clothes! And the king of Israel covered up, and entered into the battle.
2CH 18:30 And the king of Syria gave charge to the heads of the chariots with him, saying, Do not wage war with the small and the great, but the king of Israel only.
2CH 18:31 And it came to pass, as the ones in charge of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, that they said, It is the king of Israel. And they encircled him to do battle. And Jehoshaphat yelled, and the LORD delivered him; and God turned them from him.
2CH 18:32 And it came to pass, as the ones in charge of the chariots saw that it was not the king of Israel, that they turned from him.
2CH 18:33 And a man stretched tight a bow skillfully, and he struck the king of Israel between the lungs and between the chest plate. And he said to the charioteer, Turn your hand, and lead me from the battle! for I am wounded.
2CH 18:34 And the battle turned in that day. And the king of Israel was set upon the chariot right opposite Syria until evening; and he died in the going down of the sun.
2CH 19:1 And Jehoshaphat king of Judah returned to his house in peace into Jerusalem.
2CH 19:2 And came forth to meet him Jehu the son of Hanani the prophet. And he said to king Jehoshaphat, Shall you help a sinner, or do you befriend one being detested by the LORD? Because of this the anger of the LORD took place against you.
2CH 19:3 But good words were found in you, for you removed the sacred groves from the land of Judah, and straightened out your heart to seek after the LORD.
2CH 19:4 And Jehoshaphat dwelt in Jerusalem. And again he went forth to the people from Beer-sheba unto mount Ephraim, and turned them unto the LORD the God of their fathers.
2CH 19:5 And he placed judges in all the cities of Judah, the fortified ones, in city by city.
2CH 19:6 And he said to the judges, Know what you do! for not unto man do you judge, but to the LORD, and with you are the words of judgment.
2CH 19:7 And now, let the fear of the LORD be upon you, and guard and act! For injustice is not with the LORD our God, nor admiring a face, nor taking bribes.
2CH 19:8 And indeed in Jerusalem Jehoshaphat placed from out of the Levites, and of the priests, and of the patriarchs of Israel, for the judgment of the LORD, and to judge the ones dwelling in Jerusalem.
2CH 19:9 And he gave charge to them, saying, Thus you shall do in the fear of the LORD, in truth and with a full heart.
2CH 19:10 Every man with a judgment coming unto you of your brothers dwelling in their cities, whether between blood for blood, and between the order and commandment, and for ordinances and judgments, that you shall warn them, that they shall not sin against the LORD, that there will not be anger against you, and against your brothers - thus you shall do, and you shall not sin.
2CH 19:11 And behold, Amariah the leading priest over you is for every matter of the LORD; and Zebadiah son of Ishmael is the leader in the house of Judah for every word of the king. And the scribes, the Levites, are before you. Be strong and act, and the LORD will be with the good!
2CH 20:1 And after these things came the sons of Moab, and the sons of Ammon, and with them ones from out of the Ammonites, against Jehoshaphat for war.
2CH 20:2 And they came and reported to Jehoshaphat, saying, A vast multitude comes against you from the other side of the sea, from Syria; and behold, they are in Hazazon-tamar - this is En-gedi.
2CH 20:3 And Jehoshaphat feared, and put his face to seek after the LORD, and proclaimed a fast in all Judah.
2CH 20:4 And Judah gathered to seek after the LORD; and they came from out of all the cities of Judah to seek the LORD.
2CH 20:5 And Jehoshaphat rose up in the assembly of Judah in Jerusalem, in the house of the LORD, in front of the new courtyard.
2CH 20:6 And he said, O LORD God of our fathers, are you not God in heaven? And do you not dominate all the kingdoms of the nations? And is not in your hand strength and dominion, and there is not one to oppose against you?
2CH 20:7 Are you not our God, the one utterly destroying the ones dwelling this land from in front of your people Israel, and gave it to the seed of Abraham, to your friend into the eon?
2CH 20:8 And they dwell in it, and built to you in it a sanctuary to your name, saying,
2CH 20:9 If evils should come against us - the broadsword, judgment, plague, famine, we will stand before this house, and before you, (for your name is called upon in this house,) and we will yell to you from our affliction, and you shall hear and shall deliver.
2CH 20:10 And now, behold, the sons of Ammon, and Moab, and mount Seir, in which you did not grant to Israel to go through them, in their coming forth from out of the land of Egypt, for they turned aside from them and did not utterly destroy them -
2CH 20:11 and behold, they make an attempt against us, to come and to cast us from our inheritance, of which you have given to us.
2CH 20:12 O LORD our God, will you not judge by them? For there is not to us strength to oppose against this vast multitude coming against us. And we do not know what we should do, but our eyes are unto you.

2CH 20:14 And Jahaziel the son of Zechariah, son of Benaiah, son of Jeiel, son of Mattaniah the Levite of the sons of Asaph - came upon him spirit of the LORD in the assembly.
2CH 20:15 And he said, Hearken all Judah, and the ones dwelling in Jerusalem, and king Jehoshaphat! Thus says the LORD to you, Do not fear nor be terrified from the face of this vast multitude! For the battle array is not to you, but to God.
2CH 20:16 Tomorrow go down against them! Behold, they ascend according to the ascent of Ziz; and you shall find them at the tip of the river of the wilderness of Jeruel.
2CH 20:17 It is not for you to wage war in this. Stand, and perceive, and see the deliverance of the LORD with you, O Judah and Jerusalem! Do not fear, nor be terrified tomorrow to go forth for meeting them! even the LORD is with you.

2CH 20:19 And the Levites rose up from the sons of Kohath, and from the sons of the Korhites, to give praise to the LORD God of Israel with a great voice unto the height.
2CH 20:20 And they rose early in the morning, and went forth into the wilderness of Tekoa. But in their going forth, Jehoshaphat stood and yelled, and said, Hear me, O Judah, and O ones dwelling in Jerusalem! Entrust in the LORD your God, and you will be entrusted! Entrust in his prophet, and your way will be prosperous!

2CH 20:30 And the kingdom of Jehoshaphat had peace, and his God rested him round about.

2CH 20:32 And he went in the ways of Asa his father. And he did not turn aside from them to do the upright before the LORD.
2CH 20:33 Only the high places he did not remove; and still the people did not straighten out their heart to the LORD God of their fathers.
2CH 20:34 And the rest of the words of Jehoshaphat, the first and the last, behold, they are written in the words of Jehu the son of Hanani, which he wrote down upon a scroll of the kings of Israel.

2CH 21:1 And Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was entombed with his fathers in the city of David. And Jehoram his son reigned instead of him.
2CH 21:2 And to him were brothers, sons of Jehoshaphat - Azariah, and Jehiel, and Zechariah, and Michael, and Shephatiah; all these were sons of Jehoshaphat king of Judah.
2CH 21:3 And their father gave to them many gifts - silver, and gold, and shields, with cities being walled in Judah. But the kingdom he gave to Jehoram, for he was the first-born.
2CH 21:4 And Jehoram rose over the kingdom of his father, and was strengthened, and killed all his brothers by the broadsword, and indeed some of the rulers of Israel.
2CH 21:5 His being thirty and two years old was Jehoram in his reigning, and eight years he reigned in Jerusalem.
2CH 21:6 And he went in the way of the kings of Israel, as did the house of Ahab, for a daughter of Ahab was to him for a wife. And he did the wicked thing before the LORD.
2CH 21:7 And the LORD wanted not to utterly destroy the house of David on account of the covenant which he ordained with David, and as he said to him, to give him a lamp and to his sons all the days.
2CH 21:8 In those days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah, and they gave a king reign over themselves.
2CH 21:9 And Jehoram set out with his rulers, and all his chariots, and all the cavalry with him. And it came to pass that he arose by night and struck Edom, the one encircling him, and the rulers of the chariots.
2CH 21:10 And Edom revolted from the hand of Judah until this day. Then Libnah revolted in that time from under his hand, for he abandoned the LORD God of his fathers.
2CH 21:11 Moreover he made the high places in the cities of Judah, and fornicated the ones dwelling in Jerusalem, and led Judah astray.
2CH 21:12 And there came to him in writing words by Elijah the prophet, saying, Thus says the LORD, the God of David your father, Because you went not in the way of Jehoshaphat your father, and in the ways of Asa king of Judah,
2CH 21:13 and went in the ways of the king of Israel, and fornicated Judah, and the ones dwelling in Jerusalem, as the house of Ahab fornicated, and also you killed your brothers sons of your father being good ones over you;
2CH 21:14 behold, the LORD shall strike you with a great calamity among your people, and among your sons, and among your wives, and among all your belongings;
2CH 21:15 and you shall be in severe sicknesses in disease of your belly, until of which your innards should come forth from the sickness from days unto days.
2CH 21:16 And the LORD roused the Philistines against Jehoram, and the Arabians, and the ones adjoining the Ethiopians.
2CH 21:17 And they ascended against Judah, and overpowered it, and captured all the possessions which they found in the house of the king, and the houses of his sons, and his daughters; and there was not left to him a son, except Jehoahaz, the youngest of his sons.
2CH 21:18 And after all these things the LORD struck him in his belly with a sickness in which there is not a healing.
2CH 21:19 And it happened from days unto days, and as his time came in two days, there came forth his innards with his belly in his sickness. And he died in severe sicknesses, and his people did not make a funeral to him, nor a burning according to the burning of his fathers.
2CH 21:20 He was thirty and two years old in his reigning, and eight years he reigned in Jerusalem. And he went in not high praise. And they entombed him in the city of David, and not in the tombs of the kings.
2CH 22:1 And the ones dwelling in Jerusalem gave reign to Ahaziah his son, the youngest, instead of him, for all the elder sons were killed by the ones coming upon them - the band of robbers, the Arabians. And Ahaziah son of Jehoram king of Judah reigned.
2CH 22:2 Ahaziah was a son being forty and two years old in his reigning, and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. And the name of his mother was Athaliah daughter of Omri.
2CH 22:3 And also he went in the ways of the house of Ahab, for his mother was his counselor to sin.
2CH 22:4 And he did the wicked thing in the eyes of the LORD, as the house of Ahab; for they were to him counselors after the dying of his father, to utterly destroy him.

2CH 29:17 And they began on day one of the first month to sanctify, and on the eighth day of the month they entered into the temple of the LORD. And they sanctified the house of the LORD in eight days; and on the sixteenth day of the first month they completed.

2CH 32:4 And he brought together many people, and they obstructed the waters of the springs, and the rushing stream separating through the city, saying, Should the king of the Assyrians come and find much water, and grow strong?

2CH 32:6 And he put rulers of war over the people. And they were brought together to him upon the square of the gate of the city. And he spoke unto their heart, saying,

2CH 32:9 And after these things Sennacherib king of the Assyrians sent his servants unto Jerusalem. And he was by Lachish, and all his military with him. And he sent to Hezekiah king of Judah, and to all Judah in Jerusalem, saying,
