JOB 36:5 But know that the LORD in no way shall undo the guileless man - God the mighty in strength of heart!
JOB 36:6 Impious ones in no way should he restore to life, and he shall impute equity of the poor.
JOB 36:7 He will not remove his eyes from a just one; and with kings on a throne he shall seat them into victory, and they shall be exalted.
JOB 36:8 And the ones being shackled in manacles shall be held together by rough cords of poverty,
JOB 36:9 and he shall announce to them their works, and their transgressions, for they are prevalent.
JOB 36:10 But he will listen to the just one; and he spoke that they shall turn from unrighteousness.
JOB 36:11 If they shall hear and serve, they shall complete their days among good things, and their years among beautiful things.
JOB 36:12 But impious ones are not preserved by their not willing to behold the LORD, and that even being admonished they were unhearing.
JOB 36:13 And hypocrites in heart shall order rage; they shall not yell for help, for he bound them.
JOB 36:14 Therefore may their soul die in youth, and their life being pierced by messengers of evils,
JOB 36:15 because they afflicted the weak and disabled. And he will expound judgment for the gentle.
JOB 36:16 And from when he beguiled from out of the mouth of the enemy, an abyss for throwing down underneath it, that your table went down full of fatness.
JOB 36:17 But judgment shall not fail from a just one;
JOB 36:18 and rage will be upon impious ones, because of the impiety of bribes which they received for iniquities.
JOB 36:19 Let not the mind willingly turn you aside of the supplication of the ones being disabled in necessity, not even all the ones fortifying for strength!
JOB 36:20 You shall not drag away the night, so that others should ascend instead of them.
JOB 36:21 But guard lest you act out of place! for of these things you took up because of poorness.
JOB 36:22 Behold, the strong one shall conquer by his strength; for who is as he - the mighty one.
JOB 36:23 And who is the one examining his works? Or who is the one having said, He acted unjustly.
JOB 36:24 Remember that his works are great, which men command!
JOB 36:25 Every man beholds in himself how many mortals are being pierced.
JOB 36:26 Behold, the strong one is great, and we shall not know him; and the number of his years are unlimited.
JOB 36:27 And the drops of rain shall be counted by him, and shall be poured for rain in the cloud.
JOB 36:28 Things grown old shall flow, and clouds shadow over untold mortals.
JOB 36:29 And should one have perceived the spreading out of the clouds as equal of his tent?
JOB 36:30 Behold, he stretches out light upon it, and covers the root of the sea.
JOB 36:31 For in them he shall judge peoples; he shall give nourishment to the one being strong.
JOB 36:32 With the hands he covers light, and gave charge concerning it with the encountering clouds.
JOB 36:33 He will announce his friend concerning him - for possession and for injustice.
JOB 37:1 And from this my heart is disturbed, and was dropped down from out of its place.
JOB 37:2 Hear a report in anger of rage of the LORD! And a meditation from out of his mouth shall come forth.
JOB 37:3 Underneath all the heaven is his sovereignty, and his light is upon the wings of the earth.
JOB 37:4 After him a voice shall yell out; he shall thunder with the sound of his insult, and shall not bargain them, that one shall hear his voice.
JOB 37:5 The strong one will thunder wonders with his voice; he established a season for animals, and they know the order of the fold. Upon all these things your thought is not receded, nor is your heart reconciled from your body. For he did great things which we knew not -
JOB 37:6 ordering the snow, saying, Be upon the earth; and the winter rain of his command.
JOB 37:7 In the hand of every man he seals up, that every man should know his own weakness.
JOB 37:8 And the wild beasts entered under the protection, and are tranquil in their lair.
JOB 37:9 From out of inner chambers come griefs, and from extremities chilliness.
JOB 37:10 And from the breath of the strong one he appoints ice; and he steers the water where ever he wants.
JOB 37:11 And if a chosen cloud plasters over, then his light disperses the cloud,
JOB 37:12 and he shall turn aside the swirls by his rule for performing their works - all as much as he should give charge to them.
JOB 37:13 These things were ordered by him upon the earth. Whether for instruction, whether for his land, whether for an object of his mercy, he shall find it.
JOB 37:14 Give ear to these things, O Job! Stand admonished by the power of the LORD!
JOB 37:15 We know that God established his works, making light out of darkness.
JOB 37:16 And he knows the distinction of clouds, and the extraordinary calamitous downfalls of the wicked.
JOB 37:17 And your apparel is hot, but there is tranquility upon the earth from the south.
JOB 37:18 Will you solidify with him for things grown old; things which are strong as the vision of a vessel?
JOB 37:19 Why teach me? what shall we say to him? Then let us cease from saying much.
JOB 37:20 Is there a book or scribe standing beside me that standing I should quell a man?
JOB 37:21 But the light is not visible to all; it is radiant among the things grown old, as if from him upon the clouds.
JOB 37:22 From the north are clouds shining like gold - in these the glory and honor from the almighty is great.
JOB 37:23 And we do not find another likened to his strength. The one judging the just ones - do you not imagine that he listens?
JOB 37:24 Therefore men shall fear him; and even the wise ones in heart shall fear him.
JOB 38:1 And after the ceasing of the speech of Elihu, the LORD said to Job through a tempest and cloud, saying,
JOB 38:2 Who is this hiding counsel, and constraining matters in heart, and imagines to hide from me?
JOB 38:3 Tie up your loin as a man! And I will ask you, and you answer me!
JOB 38:4 Where were you in my laying the foundation for the earth? and report to me if you should have knowledge of understanding!
JOB 38:5 Who established the measures of it, if you know? or who is the one bringing a measuring cord upon it?
JOB 38:6 Upon what are its hooks pitched on? And who is the one laying an angular foundation stone upon it?
JOB 38:7 When stars became, all my angels praised me with a great voice.
JOB 38:8 And I shut up the sea with gates, when it was led irresistibly going forth from out of its mother's belly.
JOB 38:9 And I established the cloud for its clothing, and fog for its being swaddled.
JOB 38:10 And I established limits for it; I put in place bolts and gates.
JOB 38:11 And I said to it, Unto this far you shall come, and shall not pass over; and within yourself your waves shall break.
JOB 38:12 Or by you have I ordered the early morning brightness? And did Hesperus behold his own order;
JOB 38:13 to take hold of the wings of the earth, to shake off impious ones from it.
JOB 38:14 Or did you, having taken earth's clay, shape a living creature, and establish for it the power of speech upon the earth?
JOB 38:15 And have you removed the light from impious ones, and broke the arm of proud ones?
JOB 38:16 Did you come unto the spring of the sea, and walk in the tracks of the deep?
JOB 38:17 And do the gates of death open to you in fear? and did gatekeepers of Hades, in beholding you, become alarmed?
JOB 38:18 And have you been admonished about the breadth under heaven? Announce indeed to me how great it is!
JOB 38:19 And of what kind of land lodges the light? And darkness, what kind of place -
JOB 38:20 if you could lead me into their limits, and even if you know their paths?
JOB 38:21 Have you known that it is so then because you were born, and the number of your years great?
JOB 38:22 But did you come unto treasuries of snow? and have you seen treasuries of hail?
JOB 38:23 And is it reserved to you for the hour of the enemies, for the day of war and battle?
JOB 38:24 And from what place goes forth the frost? or the south wind is dispersed into the place under heaven?
JOB 38:25 And who prepared the flow of the fierce rain, and a way in uproar;
JOB 38:26 to rain upon the land of which there is not a man - a wilderness of which there is not a man existing in it;
JOB 38:27 so as to fill the untrodden and uninhabited land, and the causing to sprout forth the issue of tender shoots?
JOB 38:28 Who is the rain's father, and who is the one giving birth to droplets of dew?
JOB 38:29 And from out of whose womb comes forth the ice? and who gave birth to the frost in heaven,
JOB 38:30 which comes down as if water flowing? And who alarmed the face of the abyss?
JOB 38:31 And do you perceive the bond of Pleiades? and did you open the barrier of Orion?
JOB 38:32 Or will you open Mazuroth in its time? And Hesperus with its tail - will you lead it?
JOB 38:33 And do you know the circuits of heaven, or the things taking place with one accord under heaven?
JOB 38:34 And will you call a cloud by voice, and in trembling will the fierce water of rain obey you?
JOB 38:35 And will you send thunderbolts, and they shall go forth, and shall say to you, What is it?
JOB 38:36 And who gave women wisdom for a woven work, or higher knowledge for embroidery?
JOB 38:37 And who is the one counting clouds in wisdom, and leaned the heaven unto the earth,
JOB 38:38 and it is poured as earth's powder, and I have cleaved it as a stone cube?
JOB 38:39 And will you hunt prey for lions? and fill up the souls of dragons?
JOB 38:40 For they are in awe in their lairs, and sit in the woods lying in wait.
JOB 38:41 And who prepared carrion for the crow? for its young in wandering cry out to the LORD seeking grain.
JOB 39:1 Do you know the time of the birthing of antelopes of the rock? And did you watch the birth pangs of hinds?
JOB 39:2 And did you count their full months of birthing? And did you untie their birth pangs?
JOB 39:3 And did you nourish their offspring outside of fear? and will you send away their birth pangs?
JOB 39:4 Their young shall rip forth - they shall be multiplied in offspring; their young will go forth and in no way shall return to them.
JOB 39:5 And who is the one letting the wild donkey free? and who untied his bonds?
JOB 39:6 For I established for his habitation a wilderness, and the salt-flats for his tents.
JOB 39:7 He ridicules the great multitude of the city, and hears not the complaint of the tribute-gatherer.
JOB 39:8 He shall survey the mountains as his pasture, and he seeks after every green thing.
JOB 39:9 And shall the unicorn be willing to serve to you, or to sleep at your stable?
JOB 39:10 And will you tie his yoke with straps? or will he draw furrows in the plain?
JOB 39:11 And do you rely upon him, because of his great strength? And will you slacken your works for him?
JOB 39:12 And do you trust that he will give back to you the seed, and carry it into your threshing-floor?
JOB 39:13 The wing delighting ostriches; but should the stork and feathers conceive?
JOB 39:14 For she shall let her eggs go unto the earth, and she shall incubate upon the dust.
JOB 39:15 And she forgot that the foot will disperse them, and the wild beasts of the field will trample them.
JOB 39:16 She hardened against her offspring, so as to not bereave herself; in vain she tired without fear;
JOB 39:17 for God quelled her wisdom, and portioned not to her with understanding;
JOB 39:18 in time she will raise up high in height; she will ridicule the horse and his rider.
JOB 39:19 Or did you invest the horse with power, or clothe his neck in fear?
JOB 39:20 And did you invest in him full armor, and the glory of his breast in daring?
JOB 39:21 He prances rooting up in the plain, and goes forth into the plain in strength.
JOB 39:22 He ridicules meeting up with spears, and in no way turns from an iron weapon.
JOB 39:23 Against him prance the bow and sword;
JOB 39:24 and in anger he shall obliterate the ground. In no way shall he trust until whenever the trumpet signifies;
JOB 39:25 and with the trumpet signifying, he says, Well done! And at a distance he smells war with leaping and crying out.
JOB 39:26 And from your higher knowledge does the hawk station having the look of effrontery with wings fixed looking down towards the south?
JOB 39:27 And at your order does the eagle rise up high, and a vulture sit lodged upon its nest,
JOB 39:28 upon the prominence of a rock and is concealed,
JOB 39:29 being at that place he seeks grain; and his eyes watch at a distance,
JOB 39:30 and his young befoul themselves in blood, and where ever ones dying might be, immediately they are found?
JOB 40:1 And the LORD God responded to Job, and said,
JOB 40:2 Shall you judge a judgment with the fit one? One reproving God - shall he answer to him?
JOB 40:3 And undertaking, Job says to the LORD,
JOB 40:4 Why still do I plead, being admonished and reproved by the LORD? hearing such things, and being nothing. And I, what answer shall I give to these things? I shall put a hand upon my mouth.
JOB 40:5 Once I have spoken; but for a second time, I will not proceed.
JOB 40:6 And again undertaking, the LORD spoke to Job from out of the cloud, saying,
JOB 40:7 But no, tie up your loin as a man, and I will ask you, then you answer me!
JOB 40:8 Or should you undo my judgment? and do you imagine me otherwise executing things with you? or that you should appear just?
JOB 40:9 Or is your arm as the arm of the LORD? or do you thunder with a voice as him?
JOB 40:10 Then lift yourself up in stature and power, and clothe yourself with glory and honor!
JOB 40:11 And send angels in anger, and humble all the arrogant!
JOB 40:12 And extinguish the proud man, and cause impious ones to rot immediately!
JOB 40:13 And hide them in the earth with one accord, and the things of their faces fill with dishonor!
JOB 40:14 Then indeed I shall acknowledge surely that your right hand is able to deliver.
JOB 40:15 But indeed, behold, the wild beast by you; it eats grass equal to oxen.
JOB 40:16 Behold indeed, his strength is in his loin, and his power is in the navel of his belly.
JOB 40:17 He sets his tail as a cypress; and his nerves are closely joined.
JOB 40:18 His sides are sides of brass; and his spine is as cast iron.
JOB 40:19 This is the beginning of the thing shaped by the LORD; being made to be mocked by his angels.
JOB 40:20 And coming upon a chiseled mountain, he produces a cause for joy to the four-footed in the infernal region.
JOB 40:21 Under all kinds of trees he sleeps - by the papyrus, and reed, and flowering rush.
JOB 40:22 And trees shadow in him with scions, and branches of the chaste tree.
JOB 40:23 If there becomes an inundation, in no way shall it be perceived. He relies that the Jordan will rush up into his mouth.
JOB 40:24 In his eye, will one take him? being caught in a snare, will you drill his nose?
JOB 41:1 And will you lead a dragon by a hook? and will you put a halter around his nose?
JOB 41:2 Or will you tie a hook in his nose, and will you make a hole in his lip for a clasp?
JOB 41:3 And will he speak to you earnest supplications softly?
JOB 41:4 And will he establish a covenant with you? and will you take him for an everlasting servant?
JOB 41:5 And will you play with him as a bird? or will you bind him as a sparrow for a child?
JOB 41:6 And do nations feed in him? and do the nations of the Phoenicians partition him?
JOB 41:7 And everything afloat coming together in no way shall bear the hide of his one tail; nor in the boats of fishermen shall they bear his head.
JOB 41:8 But shall you place a hand on him, remembering war taking place in his body, and let it no longer take place?
JOB 41:9 Have you not seen him, nor wondered over the ones speaking?
JOB 41:10 Are you not in awe that it has been prepared by me? for who is the one opposing me?
JOB 41:11 Or who shall oppose me, and remain? since all under heaven is mine.
JOB 41:12 I will not keep silent because of him; and the word of power shall show mercy equal to him.
JOB 41:13 Who will uncover the front of his clothing? and into the fold of his chest plate who can enter?
JOB 41:14 Who will open the gates of his face? Round about his teeth is fear.
JOB 41:15 His insides are as shields of brass, and his sinews are as emery stone;
JOB 41:16 one unto the one cleaves, and wind in no way should go through it;
JOB 41:17 as a man to his brother - they shall be cleaved; they are held together, and in no way should they draw apart.
JOB 41:18 In his sneezing brightness shines forth, and his eyes are as the appearance of Hesperus.
JOB 41:19 From out of his mouth burning lamps shall go forth, and scattered grates of fire.
JOB 41:20 From out of his nostrils comes forth smoke of a furnace, burning with coals of fire.
JOB 41:21 His soul is as live coals, and a flame goes forth from out of his mouth.
JOB 41:22 And in his neck lodges power; destruction runs before him.
JOB 41:23 And the flesh of his body cleaves tightly; if one pours down upon him, he will not be shaken.
JOB 41:24 His heart is fixed as stone, and he stands as an anvil, not malleable.
JOB 41:25 And his turning gives fear to the four-footed wild beasts leaping upon the earth.
JOB 41:26 If lances should meet up with him, nothing in any way shall terrify by spear and chest plate.
JOB 41:27 For he esteems iron as straw, and brass as rotten wood.
JOB 41:28 In no way shall the bow of brass pierce him; he esteems a slinger indeed as grass.
JOB 41:29 Hammers are considered as stubble; and he ridicules the quaking of a fire-bearer.
JOB 41:30 His strewn bed is of sharp points, and all the gold of the sea under him is as untold mud.
JOB 41:31 The abyss breaks out as a brazen cauldron, and he esteems the sea as an ointment jar.
JOB 41:32 And the infernal region of the abyss is as if a captive; he considers the abyss for a promenade.
JOB 41:33 There is not anything upon the earth likened to him, being made, to be mocked at by my angels.
JOB 41:34 Every lofty thing he sees, and he is king of all the things in the waters.
JOB 42:1 And undertaking, Job says to the LORD,
JOB 42:2 I know that in all things you are able, and nothing is powerless to you.
JOB 42:3 For who is the one hiding you counsel, and sparing words, and imagines to hide you? And who announces to me things which I knew not, great and wonderful things which I had not knowledge of?
JOB 42:4 But hear me, O LORD, that I also shall speak! And I will ask you, and you teach me!
JOB 42:5 Hearing indeed in my ear, I heard of you formerly; but now my eye sees you.
JOB 42:6 Therefore I treated myself as worthless, and I was melted away; and I esteem myself earth and ashes.
JOB 42:7 And it came to pass after the LORD speaking all these words to Job, the LORD said to Eliphaz the Temanite, You sinned, and your two friends; for you spoke not anything before me true, as my attendant Job.
JOB 42:8 And now, take seven calves, and seven rams, and go to my attendant Job, and he shall offer a yield offering for you! For shall not I receive of his face. For if not on account of him I would have destroyed you. For you did not speak true concerning my attendant Job.
JOB 42:9 And they went - Eliphaz the Temanite, and Baldad the Shuhite, and Sophar the Minean. And they went as the LORD ordered them. And he dismissed their sin because of Job.
JOB 42:10 And the LORD increased Job. And of his making a vow, and because of being his friends, he forgave to them the sin. And the LORD gave double, as much as was Job's before, by doubling.
JOB 42:11 And all his brothers and his sisters heard all the things coming to pass to him. And they came to him, even all as many as knew him at first. And eating and drinking with him, they comforted him. And they wondered upon all which the LORD brought upon him. And they each gave to him one ewe-lamb, and a four-drachma piece of unmarked gold.
JOB 42:12 And the LORD blessed the latter end of Job than the former. And his cattle was - ten thousand four thousand sheep; six thousand camels; a thousand teams of oxen; a thousand female grazing donkeys.
JOB 42:13 And there were born to him seven sons and three daughters.
JOB 42:14 And he called the first, Day, and the second, Keziah, and the third, Amalthaia's Horn.
JOB 42:15 And were not found, according to the daughters of Job, any better than they among the places under heaven. And their father gave to them an inheritance among the brothers.
JOB 42:16 And Job lived after the calamity a hundred forty years. And Job saw his sons, and the sons of his sons, to the fourth generation.
JOB 42:17 And Job came to an end an old man and full of days.
PSA 1:1 Blessed is a man who went not in the counsel of impious ones, and stood not in the way of sinners, and sat not upon a chair of mischievous ones.
PSA 1:2 But his will is in the law of the LORD; and in his law he shall meditate day and night.
PSA 1:3 And he will be as the tree being planted by the outlets of the waters, which gives his fruit in his season; and his leaf shall not drop down; and all as much as he should do will greatly prosper.
PSA 1:4 Not so the impious ones, not so; but are as dust which the wind casts forth from the face of the earth.
PSA 1:5 On account of this the impious ones shall not rise up in judgment, nor sinners in a counsel of just ones.
PSA 1:6 For the LORD knows the way of just ones; but the way of impious ones shall perish.
PSA 2:1 A psalm to David. Why do nations neigh, and peoples meditate vain things?
PSA 2:2 The kings of the earth stood by, and the rulers gathered together against the LORD, and against his Christ, saying,
PSA 2:3 We should tear up their bonds, and throw away from us their yoke.
PSA 2:4 The one dwelling in heavens laughs out loud at them; and the LORD derides them.
PSA 2:5 Then he shall speak to them in his anger, and in his rage shall disturb them.
PSA 2:6 But I was placed king by him over mount Zion, his holy place,
PSA 2:7 declaring the order of the LORD. The LORD said to me, You are my son, I today engendered you.
PSA 2:8 Ask from me, and I will give to you nations for your inheritance, and for your possession the ends of the earth!
PSA 2:9 You shall tend them with a rod of iron; as vessels of a potter you shall break them.
PSA 2:10 And now, O kings, perceive! Let all the ones judging the earth be instructed!
PSA 2:11 Serve to the LORD in fear, and exult to him with trembling!
PSA 2:12 Grab instruction, lest at any time you should provoke the LORD to anger, and you shall perish from the just way, whenever his rage should be kindled quickly! Blessed are all the ones yielding upon him.

PSA 3:3 But you, O LORD, are my shielder; my glory, and the one raising up my head.
PSA 3:4 I cried out my voice to the LORD, and he heeded me from out of his holy mountain.
PSA 3:5 And I went to bed and slept; I woke up; for the LORD shall assist me.
PSA 3:6 I shall not fear from ten thousands of people round about joining in attacking me.
PSA 3:7 Rise up, O LORD! Deliver me, O my God! For you struck all the ones hating me for no cause; you broke the teeth of sinners.
PSA 3:8 Deliverance is of the LORD; and your blessing is upon your people.

PSA 4:8 In peace I will go to bed upon the same place and sleep. For you, O LORD, alone settled me upon hope.

PSA 5:2 Take heed to the voice of my supplication, my king and my God! For to you I shall pray, O LORD.

PSA 40:3 And he put into my mouth a new song, a hymn to our God. Many shall see, and shall fear, and shall hope upon the LORD.
PSA 40:4 Blessed is the man of which his hope is the name of the LORD, and he did not look to follies and false frenzies.
PSA 40:5 Many things you did yourself, O LORD my God, concerning your wonders, and concerning your devices. There is not any that shall be likened to you. I reported and spoke - they were multiplied above number.
PSA 40:6 A sacrifice and offering you wanted not, but a body you readied to me; whole burnt offerings and a sacrifice for sin you did not seek.
PSA 40:7 Then I said, Behold, I come (in the chapter of the scroll it is written concerning me,)
PSA 40:8 to do your will, O my God I wanted; and your law is in the midst of my belly.
PSA 40:9 I announced good news - righteousness in the great assembly. Behold, in no way should I restrain my lips, O LORD - you know.
PSA 40:10 My righteousness I hid not in my heart; your truth and your deliverance I told; I hid not your mercy and your truth from the gathering of many.
PSA 40:11 But you, O LORD, your compassions should not be far from me. Your mercy and your truth, may they always take hold of me.
PSA 40:12 For bad things compass me which there is not a number. My lawless deeds overtook me, and I was not able to see; they were multiplied over the hairs of my head; and my heart abandoned me.
PSA 40:13 Think well, O LORD, to rescue me! O LORD, take heed to help me!
PSA 40:14 May the ones seeking my life to lift it away be disgraced and feel shame together. May they be turned back to the rear, and may the ones wanting bad things for me feel shame.
PSA 40:15 Let them carry immediately their shame - the ones saying to me, Well done. well done.
PSA 40:16 All the ones seeking you exult and are glad over you, O LORD. And let the ones loving your deliverance always say let the LORD be magnified!
PSA 40:17 But I am poor and needy; but the LORD will be thoughtful of me. You are my helper and my defender, O my God, you should not delay.
PSA 41:1 To the director; a psalm to David. Blessed is the one taking notice upon the poor and needy; the LORD shall rescue him in the evil day.
PSA 41:2 May the LORD guard him, and enliven him, and bless him in the land; and may he not deliver him into the hands of his enemies.
PSA 41:3 Let the LORD give help to him upon the bed of his grief! You turned all of his bed in his illness.
PSA 41:4 I said, O LORD, show mercy on me! Heal my soul! For I sinned against you.
PSA 41:5 My enemies said bad things against me, saying, When shall he die, and his name perish?
PSA 41:6 And if he entered to see me, his heart spoke folly. He gathered lawlessness to himself; he went forth outside, and spoke in the same manner.
PSA 41:7 All my enemies whispered against me; against me they devised bad things for me.
PSA 41:8 They laid down against me an illegal matter, saying, Shall the one going to bed not proceed to rise up?
PSA 41:9 For also the man of my peace, upon whom I hoped, the one eating my bread loaves, magnified against me with trickery.
PSA 41:10 But you, O LORD, show mercy on me, and raise me up, and recompense to them!
PSA 41:11 By this I knew that you wanted me, that in no way should my enemy rejoice over me.
PSA 41:12 But because of my innocence, you assisted and firmed me up before you into the eon.
PSA 41:13 Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, from the eon and into the eon. May it be, May it be.
PSA 42:1 To the director; for contemplation to the sons of Korah. In which manner the stag longs after the springs of the waters, so my soul longs after you, O God.
PSA 42:2 My soul thirsted for the mighty living God. When shall I come and appear in front of God?
PSA 42:3 My tears became bread to me day and night, in the saying to me each day, Where is your God?
PSA 42:4 These things I remembered, and my soul poured out upon me; for I shall go through to the place of the wonderful tent, unto the house of God, with a voice of exultation, and acknowledgment of the sound of the solemnizing a holiday.
PSA 42:5 Why are you dejected, O my soul? and why do you disturb me? Hope upon God! For I shall acknowledge to him the deliverance of my person.
PSA 42:6 O my God, to myself my soul was disturbed. On account of this I will remember you from out of the land of Jordan, and Hermons, from the small mountain.
PSA 42:7 The deep calls the deep at the sound of your torrents; all your crests and your waves went over me.
PSA 42:8 By day the LORD gives charge to his mercy, and at night his ode shall be with me - a prayer to the God of my life.
PSA 42:9 I will say to God, You are my shielder; why did you forget me? Why do I go looking downcast at the squeezing by the enemy?
PSA 42:10 In the breaking in pieces of my bones, the ones afflicting me berated me; while in their saying to me accordingly each day, Where is your God?
PSA 42:11 Why are you dejected, O my soul? and why do you disturb me? Hope upon God! For I shall acknowledge to him deliverance of my person, and my God.
PSA 43:1 A psalm to David. Judge for me, O God, and adjudicate my cause, from a nation which is not sacred! Rescue me from a man unjust and deceitful!
PSA 43:2 For you are the God of my fortification. Why did you thrust me away? And why do I go looking downcast during the squeezing by the enemy?
PSA 43:3 Send out your light and your truth! They guided me, and they led me to your holy mountain, and to your tents.
PSA 43:4 And I shall enter to the altar of God; to the God gladdening my youth. I will acknowledge to you with harp, O God, my God.
PSA 43:5 Why are you dejected, O my soul? and why disturb me? Hope upon God! For I shall make acknowledgment to him - the deliverance of my person, and my God.
PSA 44:1 To the director; to the sons of Korah; for contemplation. O God, we heard with our ears, and our fathers announced to us the work which you worked in their days, in ancient days.
PSA 44:2 How your hand utterly destroyed nations, and planted them. You afflicted peoples and cast them out.
PSA 44:3 For not by their broadsword they inherited the land, and their arm did not deliver them; but it was your right hand, and your arm, and the illumination of your countenance, for you thought well by them.
PSA 44:4 You are he, O my king and my God, the one giving charge to the deliverances of Jacob.
PSA 44:5 In you we will gore our enemies, and in your name we will treat with contempt the ones rising up against us.
PSA 44:6 For not upon my bow will I hope, and my broadsword will not deliver me.
PSA 44:7 For he delivered us from the ones afflicting us, and the ones detesting us he disgraced.
PSA 44:8 In God we will praise the entire day, and in your name we will make acknowledgment into the eon.
PSA 44:9 But now you thrusted away, and put us to shame; and you shall not go forth, O God, with our forces.
PSA 44:10 You turned us to the rear by our enemies; and the ones detesting us plundered for themselves.
PSA 44:11 You gave us as sheep for food; and among the nations you scattered us.
PSA 44:12 You rendered your people without a value, and there was not an abundance by their shout.
PSA 44:13 You put us for scorn to our neighbors, for a sneering and a taunting to the ones round about us.
PSA 44:14 You put us as a parable among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.
PSA 44:15 My being made ashamed is in front of me the entire day, and the shame of my face covered me;
PSA 44:16 even from a voice of one berating and speaking improperly from in front of the enemy and the one banishing.
PSA 44:17 All these things came upon us; but we did not forget you, and we did not do wrong by your covenant.
PSA 44:18 And we did not leave our heart to the rear, nor turned aside our paths from your way.
PSA 44:19 For you humbled us in the place of affliction, and the shadow of death covered over us.
PSA 44:20 If we forgot the name of our God, and if we opened and spread out our hands to an alien god,
PSA 44:21 shall not God require these things? For he knows the secret things of the heart.
PSA 44:22 For because of you we are being put to death the entire day; we are considered as sheep for slaughter.
PSA 44:23 Awaken! Why do you sleep, O Lord? Rise up! and you should not thrust us away unto the end.
PSA 44:24 Why do you turn your face, and forget our poorness, and our affliction?
PSA 44:25 For our soul was humbled into the dust; our belly was cleaved to the earth.
PSA 44:26 Rise up, O LORD, help us and ransom us, because of your name!
PSA 45:1 To the director; for the changings; to the sons of Korah; for contemplation; an ode for the beloved. My heart discharged forth a good word. I speak of my works to the king. My tongue is a reed pen of a scribe writing fast.
PSA 45:2 More beautiful in beauty than the sons of men. Favor was poured out on your lips. On account of this God blessed you into the eon.
PSA 45:3 Gird your broadsword upon your thigh, O mighty one, in your beauty!
PSA 45:4 And in your fineness, even stretch tight your bow, and greatly prosper, and reign! Because of truth, and gentleness, and righteousness even shall your right hand guide you wonderfully.
PSA 45:5 Your arrows are being sharpened, O mighty one. Peoples shall fall underneath you in the heart of the enemies of the king.
PSA 45:6 Your throne, O God, is unto the eon of the eon. A rod of straightness is the rod of your kingdom.
PSA 45:7 You loved righteousness, and detested lawlessness. On account of this God your God anointed you with oil of exultation beyond your fellow partakers.
PSA 45:8 Myrrh, and balsam, and cassia of your garments from palaces of ivory,
PSA 45:9 from of which daughters of kings gladdened you in your honor. The queen stood at your right in having put around clothes interwoven with gold being embroidered.
PSA 45:10 Hear, O daughter, and behold! And lean your ear, and forget your people, and the house of your father!
PSA 45:11 Even the king desired your beauty; for he is your lord; and you shall do obeisance to him.
PSA 45:12 And the daughter of Tyre shall come with gifts. The rich of the people will implore your face.
PSA 45:13 All the glory of the daughter of the king within, with bordered fringes of gold,
PSA 45:14 being put around, being embroidered. The virgins shall be carried to the king after her; the ones near her shall be carried to you.
PSA 45:15 They shall be carried in gladness and exultation; they shall be led into the temple of the king.
PSA 45:16 In place of your fathers, your sons were born. You shall place them as rulers over all the earth.
PSA 45:17 I will make your name remembered in every generation, and generation. On account of this peoples will make acknowledgment to you into the eon, and into the eon of the eon.
PSA 46:1 To the director; for the sons of Korah; a psalm concerning the secrets. Our God is a refuge and power, a helper in afflictions, to the ones exceedingly having found us.
PSA 46:2 On account of this we shall not fear when the earth is disturbed, and mountains are transposed in the hearts of seas.
PSA 46:3 Their waters sounded and were disturbed; the mountains were disturbed by his force.
PSA 46:4 The rapid movements of the river gladdens the city of God. The highest sanctified his tent.
PSA 46:5 God is in the midst of her, and she shall not be shaken. God shall help her towards morning by morning.
PSA 46:6 Nations were disturbed; kingdoms leaned; the highest gave out his voice, the earth shook.
PSA 46:7 The LORD of the forces is with us; the God of Jacob is our shielder.
PSA 46:8 Come, and see the works of God; what miracles he made upon the earth!
PSA 46:9 Taking away wars in return unto the ends of the earth; He shall break the bow, and shall break in pieces the weapon; and the shields he shall incinerate with fire.
PSA 46:10 Relax, and know that I am God! I shall be raised up high in the nations, I shall be raised up high in the earth.
PSA 46:11 The LORD of the forces is with us; the God of Jacob is our shielder.
PSA 47:1 For the director; for the sons of Korah; a psalm. All the nations - clap hands! Shout to God with a voice of exultation!
PSA 47:2 For the LORD the highest is dreadful; a great king over all the earth.
PSA 47:3 He submitted peoples to us, and nations under our feet.
PSA 47:4 He chose to us the inheritance for us, the beauty of Jacob whom he loved.
PSA 47:5 God ascended in a shout, the LORD with the sound of a trumpet.
PSA 47:6 Strum to our God! Strum! Strum to our king! Strum!
PSA 47:7 For the king of all the earth is God. Strum expertly!
PSA 47:8 God reigns over the nations. God sits upon his holy throne.
PSA 47:9 Rulers of peoples are brought together with the God of Abraham. For by God the strong ones of the earth were lifted up exceedingly.
PSA 48:1 A psalm; an ode to the sons of Korah; second of Sabbath. Great is the LORD, and exceedingly praiseworthy in the city of our God, in his holy mountain.
PSA 48:2 With good root, a leap for joy of all the earth, is mount Zion on the sides of the north, the city of the great king.
PSA 48:3 God is known in her palaces, whenever he should assist her.
PSA 48:4 For behold, the kings of the earth are being brought together; they went through together.
PSA 48:5 They in seeing thus wondered; they were disturbed; they were shaken.
PSA 48:6 Trembling took hold of them there - pangs as a woman giving birth.
PSA 48:7 By a violent wind you shall break the boats of Tarshish.
PSA 48:8 Just as we heard, so also we behold in the city of the LORD of the forces, in the city of our God. God founded her into the eon.
PSA 48:9 We undertook, O God, of your mercy in the midst of your people.
PSA 48:10 According to your name, O God, so also is the praise of you unto the ends of the earth. Your right hand is full of righteousness.
PSA 48:11 Be glad, mount Zion, and exult daughters of Judea! because of your judgments, O LORD.
PSA 48:12 Encircle Zion, and take hold of her! Describe concerning her towers!
PSA 48:13 Put your hearts for her force, and divide her palaces, so that you may describe to another generation!
PSA 48:14 For this is our God into the eon, and into the eon of the eon; he shall tend us into the eons.
PSA 49:1 To the director; to the sons of Korah; a psalm. Hear these things, all nations! Give ear, all dwelling in the inhabitable world -
PSA 49:2 both the earth-born, and the sons of men together, rich and needy!
PSA 49:3 My mouth speaks wisdom, and the meditation of my heart understanding.
PSA 49:4 I will lean my ear to a parable; I will open my riddle with a psaltery.
PSA 49:5 Why do I fear in the wicked day when lawlessness at my heel shall encircle me?
PSA 49:6 The ones yielding upon their power, even the ones boasting upon the multitude of their riches,
PSA 49:7 a brother does not ransom. Shall a man ransom? He shall not give to God an appeasement for himself;
PSA 49:8 even the value of the ransoming his soul, even if he labored into the eon;
PSA 49:9 even if he shall live till the end, that he should not see corruption.
PSA 49:10 Whenever he should behold wise ones dying, the foolish one and the mindless one shall perish together; and shall leave behind their riches to strangers.
PSA 49:11 And their tombs are their houses into the eon; their tents unto generation and generation. They call lands after their names.
PSA 49:12 And a man being in honor perceived not. He resembles the unthinking cattle, and is like them.
PSA 49:13 This their way is an obstacle to them; and after these things they take pleasure with their mouths.
PSA 49:14 They placed them as sheep in Hades; death tends them; and the upright shall dominate them in the morning; and their help shall grow old in Hades; they were banished from their glory.
PSA 49:15 Except God shall ransom my soul from out of the hand of Hades, whenever he should take me.
PSA 49:16 Do not fear whenever a man should be enriched, or whenever the glory of his house should be multiplied;
PSA 49:17 for he shall not take anything in his dying, nor will his glory go down with him!
PSA 49:18 For his soul shall be blessed in his life. He shall make acknowledgment to you whenever you should do good to him.
PSA 49:19 He shall enter unto the generation of his fathers; unto the eon he shall not see light.
PSA 49:20 And a man being in honor, and perceived not, resembles the unthinking cattle, and is like them.
PSA 50:1 A psalm to Asaph. The God of gods, the LORD spoke, and called the earth from the east sun unto its descent.
PSA 50:2 From out of Zion is the attractiveness of his beauty.
PSA 50:3 God visibly shall come, our God, and he will not remain silent. A fire before him shall burn; and round about him an exceeding gale.
PSA 50:4 He shall call on the heaven upward, and the earth, to separate his people.
PSA 50:5 Gathered to him are his sacred ones, the ones ordaining his covenant with a sacrifice.
PSA 50:6 And the heavens shall announce his righteousness; for God is judge.
PSA 50:7 Hear, O my people, and I will speak to you; O Israel, and I will testify to you! The God, I am your God.
PSA 50:8 I will not reprove you over your sacrifices; for your whole burnt offerings are always before me.
PSA 50:9 I will not take calves from your house, nor winter yearlings from your flocks.
PSA 50:10 For it is all mine - the wild beasts of the field, the cattle on the mountains, and oxen.
PSA 50:11 I know all the winged creatures of the heaven, and the beauty of the field is with me.
PSA 50:12 If I should hunger, in no way should I tell you, for the inhabitable world is mine, and the fullness of it.
PSA 50:13 Shall I eat meats of bulls or drink blood of he-goats?
PSA 50:14 Sacrifice to God a sacrifice of praise; and render to the highest your vows!
PSA 50:15 And call upon me in a day of affliction, and I shall rescue you, and you shall glorify me!
PSA 50:16 But to the sinner God said, Why do you describe my ordinances, and take up my covenant through your mouth?
PSA 50:17 For you detested instruction, and cast out my words to the rear.
PSA 50:18 Since you viewed a thief, you ran together with him; and you established your portion with the adulterer.
PSA 50:19 Your mouth abounded with evil, and your tongue twisted with deceits.
PSA 50:20 In sitting down, you spoke ill against your brother; even to place an obstacle against the son of your mother.
PSA 50:21 These things you did, and I kept quiet. You undertook lawlessness, for you thought I will be likened to you. I will reprove you, and I will stand your sins in front of your face.
PSA 50:22 Perceive indeed these things, O ones forgetting God!, lest at any time he should snatch you away, and in no way should there be one rescuing!
PSA 50:23 A sacrifice of praise shall glorify me, and there in the way I will show to him my deliverance.

PSA 51:2 Abundantly wash me from my lawlessness, and cleanse me from my sin!
PSA 51:3 For I know my lawlessness, and my sin is always before me.
PSA 51:4 Against you alone I sinned, and did the wicked thing before you; that you should be justified in your words, and should overcome in your judging.
PSA 51:5 For behold in lawless deeds I was conceived, and in sins my mother craved strange food for me.
PSA 51:6 For behold, you loved truth. You manifested to me the concealed things and the private things of your wisdom.
PSA 51:7 You shall sprinkle me with hyssop, and I shall be cleansed; you shall wash me, and I shall be whitened above snow.

PSA 51:11 Reel not your face from me, and do not take away in return the holy spirit from me!
PSA 51:12 Give back to me the exultation of your deliverance, and support me with your governing spirit!
PSA 51:13 I shall teach the lawless ones your ways; and the impious ones shall turn unto you.

PSA 51:15 O Lord, you shall open my lips, and my mouth shall announce your praise.
PSA 51:16 For if you wanted a sacrifice, I would have given; whole burnt offerings you do not think well of.
PSA 51:17 A sacrifice to God is a spirit being broken; God will not treat with contempt a heart being broken and humbled.

PSA 51:19 Then you will think well of a sacrifice of righteousness offering, and whole burnt offerings; then they shall offer calves upon your altar.

PRO 1:25 but you made my counsels void, and your did not give heed to my reproofs;
PRO 1:26 accordingly I also laugh at your destruction; and will rejoice when ever ruin comes to you.
PRO 1:27 And when ever a tumult should arrive unto you suddenly, and the undoing of yourself like a blast is at hand; or whenever affliction and assault should come upon you;
PRO 1:28 that it will be whenever you should call upon me, even I shall not listen to you. Evil men shall seek me, and they will not find me;

PRO 3:10 that your storerooms should be filled with fullness of grain, and wine should gush out of your wine vats.
PRO 3:11 O son, do not have little regard for the instruction of the LORD, nor loosen up under his reproving!
PRO 3:12 For whom the LORD loves he corrects; and he whips every son whom he welcomes.
PRO 3:13 Blessed is the man who found wisdom, and the mortal who beholds intelligence.
PRO 3:14 For it is better to trade for her than for gold and silver treasures.
PRO 3:15 And she is more valuable than very costly stones; and every valuable thing is not equal her worth.
PRO 3:16 For length of existence and years of life are in her right hand; and in her left riches and glory. Out of her mouth goes forth in righteousness; and law and mercy she wears upon her tongue.
PRO 3:17 Her ways are good ways, and all her paths are in peace.
PRO 3:18 She is a tree of life to all the ones holding her; and to the ones leaning upon her are safe as upon the LORD.
PRO 3:19 God in wisdom founded the earth, and prepared the heavens in intelligence.
PRO 3:20 In his perception abysses were torn, and clouds flowed dew.
PRO 3:21 O son, you should not let it flow by; but heed my counsel and insight!
PRO 3:22 that your soul should live, and favor should be around your neck; and it will be healing to your flesh, and care to your bones;
PRO 3:23 that you should go yielded in peace in all your ways, and the foot of yours in no way should stumble.
PRO 3:24 For if you should sit down, you will be without fear; and if you should repose, you shall sleep with pleasure.
PRO 3:25 And you shall not be afraid of terror coming upon, nor the thrusting of the impious ones coming upon.
PRO 3:26 For the LORD will be over all your ways, and he shall establish your foot that you should not be shaken.
PRO 3:27 You should not be at a distance to do good to the one lacking, when you should have your hand to help.
PRO 3:28 You should not say, Returning, come back again, and tomorrow I will give! while being able to do good is with you; for you shall not see what shall give birth against you.
PRO 3:29 You should not contrive bad things against your friend sojourning and relying upon you.
PRO 3:30 You should not be fond of quarreling against a man in vain, so that he should not work evil against you.
PRO 3:31 You should not acquire scorn with evil men, nor should you be jealous of their ways.
PRO 3:32 For every lawbreaker is unclean before the LORD, and they do not sit together with the just ones.
PRO 3:33 The curse of the LORD is in the houses of the impious ones, but the properties of the just ones are blessed.
PRO 3:34 The LORD resists the proud, but gives favor to the humble.
PRO 3:35 The wise shall inherit glory; but the impious ones exalted dishonor.
PRO 4:1 Hear, O children, the instruction of a father, and take heed to know insight!
PRO 4:2 For I present to you a good gift; you should not abandon my word.
PRO 4:3 For I was also a son subject to a father, and being loved in the presence of a mother;
PRO 4:4 the ones who spoke and taught me, saying, Establish our word in your heart! Keep the commandments! Do not forget!
PRO 4:5 Acquire wisdom! Acquire understanding! You should not forget, nor should you ignore the saying of my mouth; nor should you turn aside from the words of my mouth.
PRO 4:6 You should not abandon it, for it shall hold to you. Love it passionately, and it will keep you!
PRO 4:7 Wisdom is the beginning - acquire wisdom! And in all of your possessing acquire understanding!
PRO 4:8 Surround her with a rampart, and she shall exalt you! Esteem her, that she should keep you;
PRO 4:9 that she should give a crown of favors to your head, and should shield you with a crown of luxury!
PRO 4:10 Hear, O son, and receive my words, and years of your life will be multiplied to you, that to you there should be many ways of life!
PRO 4:11 For the ways of wisdom I teach you; and I put you on board straight tracks.
PRO 4:12 For when you should go, your footsteps will not be hemmed in; and when you should run, you shall not tire.
PRO 4:13 Take hold of my instruction! you should not let go; but keep it to yourself, for your life!
PRO 4:14 You should not come by impious ways, nor be jealous of the ways of lawbreakers.
PRO 4:15 In what ever place they should encamp, you should not come there. Turn aside from them, and alter course!
PRO 4:16 For not in any way shall they sleep unless they should have done evil. Sleep is removed from them, and they do not go to bed.
PRO 4:17 For thus they feed well on grain of impiety; and by wine of a lawbreaker they are intoxicated.
PRO 4:18 But the ways of the just ones are likened to light - they radiate. They go before and give light until whenever the day should set up.
PRO 4:19 But the ways of the impious ones are dark - they do not know how they stumble.
PRO 4:20 O son, take heed to my saying; and to my words set aside your ear,
PRO 4:21 so that your springs should not fail you! Keep them in your heart!
PRO 4:22 For they are life to all the ones finding them, and healing to all flesh.
PRO 4:23 With all guard - give heed to your heart! For from out of these things are the issues of life.
PRO 4:24 Remove yourself from a crooked mouth, and thrust away unjust lips far from you!
PRO 4:25 Let your eyes see straight, and let your eyelids nod assent to a just one!
PRO 4:26 Make straight tracks for your feet, and straighten out your ways!
PRO 4:27 You should not turn aside unto the right nor unto the left; but turn your foot from an evil way! For the ways of the right God knows; but the ones perverting are of the left; but he makes your tracks straight, and he shall lead before your goings in peace.
PRO 5:1 O son, take heed to my wisdom, and set aside your ear to my words!
PRO 5:2 that you should guard good insight! And perception of my lips I give charge to you. Give no heed to a vile woman!
PRO 5:3 For honey drops from the lips of a harlot woman, which for a time fattens your throat.
PRO 5:4 Afterwards however you shall find it more bitter than bile, and being more sharpened rather than a double-edged sword.
PRO 5:5 For the feet of folly lead the ones dealing with her down unto Hades with death; and her tracks are not established.
PRO 5:6 For she does not come by the ways of life; but her tracks are slippery, and not well-known.
PRO 5:7 Now then, O son, hear me! and you should not do void works of my words.
PRO 5:8 Make your way far from her! You should not approach to doors of her houses;
PRO 5:9 that you should not let your means of life go to others, and your livelihood to the unmerciful;
PRO 5:10 that strangers should not be filled with your strength, and your toils should enter into houses of strangers;
PRO 5:11 and you shall be repenting at last, when ever the flesh wears away from your body.
PRO 5:12 And you shall say, O how I detested instruction, and my heart turned aside reproofs.
PRO 5:13 I did not hear the voice of one correcting me and teaching me; nor did I set aside my ear.
PRO 5:14 By little I came unto every evil in the midst of the assembly and congregation.
PRO 5:15 O son, drink waters from your own receptacles, and the flow from your own wells!
PRO 5:16 Let the waters overflow to you from out of your own spring; and into your own squares let your waters go along!
PRO 5:17 Let it be existing to you alone, and let not a stranger partake with you!
PRO 5:18 The spring of your water - let it be to you in particular! and be glad with the wife of your youth!
PRO 5:19 Let your hind of friendship, and your filly of favors, consort with you! and in particular let her be esteemed by you, and be with you at all time! For in this friendship you will be accommodated a great deal.
PRO 5:20 Be not much with the strange woman, nor hold the one not your own in embraces!
PRO 5:21 For the ways of a man are before the eyes of God, and he watches unto all his tracks.
PRO 5:22 Unlawful deeds ensnare a man; and each is grasped by chains of ones own sins.
PRO 5:23 This man comes to an end with the uninstructed; and from the abundance of his own sustenance was cast forth, and perished through folly.
PRO 6:1 O son, if you should guarantee a loan for your friend, you shall deliver up your hand to the enemy.
PRO 6:2 For a man's own lips are a strong snare, and he is captured by the words of his own mouth.
PRO 6:3 Do, O son, what I give charge to you, and preserve yourself! For on account of your friend you come into the hands of evils. Be not enfeebled! but you provoke even your friend whom you guaranteed a loan.
PRO 6:4 You should not give sleep to your eyes nor slumber to your eyelids,
PRO 6:5 so that you should escape as a doe from nooses, and as a fowl from out of a snare.
PRO 6:6 Be as the ant, O lazy one, and be jealous beholding his ways; and become as that one - wiser!
PRO 6:7 For to that one there is no farm possession, nor is he having one compelling him, nor is he being under a master.
PRO 6:8 He prepares the nourishment of summer, and also he prepares much in the harvest for the fete.
PRO 6:9 For how long, O lazy one, do you recline? And when will you arise from out of sleep?
PRO 6:10 A little then to sleep, and a little you sit down, and a little you slumber, and a little you fold your arms with hands to the breasts.
PRO 6:11 So then poverty comes upon you as an evil traveler, and lack as a good runner.
PRO 6:12 A foolish man, and a lawbreaker, shall go by ways not good.
PRO 6:13 And the same beckons with the eyes, and makes signs with the foot, and teaches with the beckoning of his fingers.
PRO 6:14 And a heart being perverted contrives evils; at all time such a one concocts disturbances to a city.
PRO 6:15 On account of this his destruction comes suddenly - severance and irretrievable destruction.
PRO 6:16 For he rejoices in all things which the LORD detests, and is destroyed because of uncleanness of soul -
PRO 6:17 an insulting eye, an unjust tongue, hands pouring out just blood,
PRO 6:18 and a heart contriving evil devices, and feet hurrying to do evil.
PRO 6:19 An unjust witness kindles lying, and brings in addition judicial cases between brothers.
PRO 6:20 O son, guard the laws of your father! and you should not thrust away the rules of your mother.
PRO 6:21 But affix them upon your soul always, and bind them with a cord around your neck!
PRO 6:22 When ever you should walk, bring it, and let it be with you! And when ever you should sleep, let it guard you, that in arising it should converse together with you!
PRO 6:23 For the commandment of the law is a lamp, and a light, and a way of life, and reproof, and instruction;
PRO 6:24 to guard you from a married woman, and from the distraction of a strange tongue.
PRO 6:25 O son, the desire of beauty should not overcome you; nor your eyes be caught nor seized by her eyelids.
PRO 6:26 For the value of a harlot is as much as even one bread loaf; and a woman ensnares the precious souls of men.
PRO 6:27 Shall anyone tie up fire in his bosom, and his garments not incinerate?
PRO 6:28 Or shall anyone walk upon coals of fire, and his feet shall not incinerate.
PRO 6:29 So the one entering to a married woman; he shall not be acquitted, nor any one touching her.
PRO 6:30 It is not a wonder if any be captured stealing, for he steals that he should fill up his soul when hungering;
PRO 6:31 but if he should be captured, he shall pay seven-fold; and shall rescue himself by giving all his possessions.
PRO 6:32 But the adulterer, through lack of sense, procures destruction for his soul.
PRO 6:33 Both griefs and dishonor he suffers; and his scorn shall not be wiped away into the eon.
PRO 6:34 For the rage of her husband is full of zeal - he will not spare in the day of judgment.
PRO 6:35 he will not bargain for any ransom of his hatred, nor part by many gifts.
PRO 7:1 O son, keep my words, and my commandments hide for yourself!
PRO 7:2 O son, esteem the LORD, and you shall strengthen; and besides him, do not fear another! Keep my commandments and you shall spend life, and my words keep as if the pupil of your eyes!
PRO 7:3 Put them on your fingers, and inscribe them upon the width of your heart!
PRO 7:4 Speak wisdom to be your sister; and procure to yourself intelligence as an acquaintance!
PRO 7:5 that she should keep you from the strange and wicked wife, if she should put words for you for favor.
PRO 7:6 For from the window of her house she leans into the squares,
PRO 7:7 at whom ever she should behold of the foolish one's offsprings - a young man lacking of sense,
PRO 7:8 passing by the corner in the corridors of her houses, speaking
PRO 7:9 in darkness during the evening, when ever all is at rest nightly, or also at dimness.
PRO 7:10 And the wife meets with him having the appearance of a harlot, which makes the heart of young men to flutter.
PRO 7:11 And she is inciting and carnal, and her feet do not stay still in her house.
PRO 7:12 For at certain time she strays outside, and another time she lies in wait in the squares by every corner.
PRO 7:13 Then, taking hold, she fondles him; and with impudent face she says to him,
PRO 7:14 There is a peace sacrifice with me, today I render my vows.
PRO 7:15 Because of this I come forth for meeting you; feeling the absence of your face, I have found you.
PRO 7:16 In trimming, I have stretched my bed. I spread spreads from Egypt.
PRO 7:17 I have sprinkled my bed with saffron, and my house with cinnamon.
PRO 7:18 Come, for we should enjoy friendship until dawn! Come, and we should wrap up in passion;
PRO 7:19 for my husband is not at hand in the house; he has gone a long way,
PRO 7:20 taking a bundle of silver in his hands; for only after many days will he come back again to his house.
PRO 7:21 And she led him astray with much companionship, and also with nooses. By the things from her lips she led him aground.
PRO 7:22 And he followed after her, being easily led on, and as an ox is led unto slaughter, and as a dog to bonds, and as a stag shot with a bow,
PRO 7:23 striking into the liver - but he hastens as a fowl into a snare, not seeing that he runs for his life.
PRO 7:24 Now then, O son, hear me, and take heed to the sayings of my mouth!
PRO 7:25 Do not turn aside to her ways with your heart, and you should not be misled by her short-cuts!
PRO 7:26 For she has thrown down many in piercing, and innumerable are whom she has murdered.
PRO 7:27 Her house is the ways of Hades - they lead down into the storerooms of death.
PRO 8:1 You shall proclaim wisdom, that intellect should obey you.
PRO 8:2 For she is upon the high extremities, and she stands in the midst of the paths.
PRO 8:3 For by the gates of mighty ones she is occupied; and in the entrances sings, saying,
PRO 8:4 You, O men, I comfort; and I let go with my voice to the sons of men.
PRO 8:5 Comprehend, O guileless ones, astuteness! and O uninstructed, insert it in heart!
PRO 8:6 Listen to me! for I shall speak serious things; and I will offer straight things from my lips!
PRO 8:7 For my throat shall meditate truth; and lying lips are abhorrent before me.
PRO 8:8 All the sayings of my mouth are with righteousness; nothing in them is crooked nor insidious.
PRO 8:9 All is face to face to the ones perceiving, and straight to the ones finding knowledge.
PRO 8:10 Receive instruction, and not silver! and knowledge above tried gold.
PRO 8:11 For wisdom is better than very costly stones; and every esteemed thing is not worth her.
PRO 8:12 I, wisdom, encamped with counsel and knowledge; and I called upon reflection.
PRO 8:13 The fear of the LORD detests injustice; insolence also, and pride, and the ways of evil ones; and I have detested the perverting ways of evil men.
PRO 8:14 Counsel and safety are mine; intelligence is mine; and strength is mine.
PRO 8:15 By me kings reign, and the mighty ones write righteousness.
PRO 8:16 Through me great men become magnified, and sovereigns through me take hold of the earth.
PRO 8:17 I love the ones being fond of me; and the ones seeking me shall find favor.
PRO 8:18 Wealth and glory exist by me, and much property and righteousness.
PRO 8:19 Best to gather my fruit than gold and precious stone; (and my produce is better than choice silver.
PRO 8:20 I walk in the ways of righteousness, and I return in the midst of paths of reason;)
PRO 8:21 that I shall portion substance to the ones loving me, and their treasuries I shall fill up of good things. If I should announce to you the things happening each day, I will remember also to count the things of the eon.
PRO 8:22 The LORD created me the head of his ways for his works.
PRO 8:23 Before the eon he founded me in the beginning, before the making the earth;
PRO 8:24 and before the making the abysses; before the coming forth of the springs of waters;
PRO 8:25 before the seating of the mountains; and before all the hills he engenders me.
PRO 8:26 The LORD made regions, and uninhabited places, and uttermost parts of the inhabitable world under the heavens.
PRO 8:27 When he prepared the heaven, I was present with him; even when he separated his throne upon the winds,
PRO 8:28 when he made the upward clouds strong, and as made the springs under heaven safe,
PRO 8:29 in the putting of his restriction to the sea, and the waters shall not go by his mouth, and as he made the foundations of the earth strong,
PRO 8:30 I was by him. I was being in accord, in which he rejoiced with. And each day I was glad in front of him at all time;
PRO 8:31 even when he was pleased with the completing the inhabitable world, and was pleased in the sons of men.
PRO 8:32 Now then, O son, hear me! and blessed are the ones guarding my ways.
PRO 8:33 Hear wisdom! and you should be wise, and you should not seal it up. Blessed is the man who shall listen to me, and the man who shall guard my ways;
PRO 8:34 being awake at my doors each day, giving heed at the doorposts of my entrances.
PRO 8:35 For my issues are the issues of life, and in them volition is prepared from the LORD.
PRO 8:36 But the ones sinning against me are impious unto their own souls; and the ones detesting me love death.
PRO 9:1 Wisdom built to herself a house, and she propped up seven columns.
PRO 9:2 She slew the things for herself which are offered in sacrifices; she mixed into a basin wine for herself, and she prepared a table for herself.
PRO 9:3 She sent her own servants, calling together with high proclamation, upon a basin, saying,
PRO 9:4 Whosoever is a foolish one, turn aside to me! And to the ones lacking of sense, she said,
PRO 9:5 Come eat of my breads, and drink wine which I mixed for you!
PRO 9:6 Cease folly, and you shall live! And seek intelligence, that you should spend life! And keep straight understanding by knowledge!
PRO 9:7 The one correcting evil men shall take on himself dishonor; and in reproving, the impious one scoffs at himself.
PRO 9:8 Do not reprove evil men, so that they should not detest you! Reprove a wise one, and he shall love you!
PRO 9:9 Give to a wise one opportunity, and he will be wiser! Make things known to a just one, and he shall proceed to receive more!
PRO 9:10 The beginning of wisdom is fear of the LORD; and the counsel of holy ones is understanding. For to know the law is of good consideration.
PRO 9:11 For in this manner you shall live a long time, and years of life shall be added to you.
PRO 9:12 O son, if you be wise, you shall be wise to yourself; and if you should turn out to be evil, then you shall draw evils alone.
PRO 9:13 A foolish and bold woman who does not have knowledge of shame becomes lacking of a morsel.
PRO 9:14 She sits at the doors of her own house upon a chair, visibly in the squares,
PRO 9:15 calling the ones passing by the way, and the ones going straight on their ways, saying,
PRO 9:16 Whoever is most foolish of you, turn aside to me! And to the ones lacking intelligence I rouse, saying,
PRO 9:17 Breads of secrets you touch with pleasure, and water of fraud you drink sweet!
PRO 9:18 But he does not know that earth-born men are destroyed by her, and he meets upon the perch of Hades.
PRO 10:1 A wise son gladdens a father; but a foolish son is distress to a mother.
PRO 10:2 Treasures shall not benefit the lawless; but righteousness shall rescue from out of death.
PRO 10:3 The LORD will not famish a just soul; but the life of the impious ones he will prostrate.
PRO 10:4 Poverty humbles a man; but the hands of the vigorous enrich. A son being corrected will be wise; but to the foolish one he shall be treated as to a servant.
PRO 10:5 An intelligent son is preserved from sweltering heat; but destruction by the wind comes at the harvest to a son who is a lawbreaker.
PRO 10:6 A blessing of the LORD is upon the head of a just one; but the mouth of the impious ones he covers with untimely mourning.
PRO 10:7 Remembrance of a just one is with commendation; but the name of an impious one is extinguished.
PRO 10:8 A wise heart shall receive commandments; but the open-mouthed shall be tripped up by crooked lips.
PRO 10:9 The one who goes simply, goes complying; but the one perverting his ways shall be known.
PRO 10:10 The beckoning eye with treachery gathers distresses for men; but the one reproving with an open manner makes peace.
PRO 10:11 The spring of life is in the hand of a just one; but destruction shall cover the mouth of an impious one.
PRO 10:12 Hatred raises up altercation; but friendship shall cover all the ones not fond of altercations.
PRO 10:13 The one who brings forth wisdom from his lips, beats the heartless man with a rod.
PRO 10:14 The wise shall hide perception; but the mouth of the precipitous approaches destruction.
PRO 10:15 The property of rich men is a fortified city; but destruction of the impious ones is poverty.
PRO 10:16 The works of the just ones produce life; but the fruit of the impious ones produces sins.
PRO 10:17 Instruction keeps the ways of life; but instruction unascertained wanders.
PRO 10:18 Just lips cover hatred; but the ones bringing forth reviling are most foolish.
PRO 10:19 By many words you shall not flee from sin; but sparing of your lips you will be intelligent.
PRO 10:20 The tongue of a just one is silver being purified; but the heart of an impious one shall fail.
PRO 10:21 The lips of the just ones have knowledge of high things; but the foolish ones come to an end with lack.
PRO 10:22 The blessing of the LORD upon the head of a just one - this enriches, and in no way shall distress in heart be added to it.
PRO 10:23 With laughter a foolish one commits evils; but wisdom births intelligence to a man.
PRO 10:24 By destruction an impious one is carried round about; but the desire of a just one is accepted.
PRO 10:25 In the coming of the blast the impious one is obliterated; but a just one, in turning aside, escapes into the eon.
PRO 10:26 As an unripe grape to the teeth is hurtful, and smoke to the eyes; thus unlawfulness to the ones dealing with it.
PRO 10:27 The fear of the LORD adds days; but the years of the impious ones shall be lessened.
PRO 10:28 Gladness lingers with just ones; but the hope of the impious ones shall be destroyed.
PRO 10:29 The fear of the LORD is the fortress of the sacred; but destruction to the ones working evils.
PRO 10:30 A just one shall not give way into the eon; but the impious ones shall not live on the earth.
PRO 10:31 The mouth of a just one drops wisdom; but the tongue of the unjust one shall be totally ruined.
PRO 10:32 The lips of just men drop favors; but the mouth of impious ones is perverted.
PRO 11:1 Deceitful yoke balance scales are an abomination before the LORD; but a just weight is acceptable to him.
PRO 11:2 Where ever insult should enter, dishonor is also there; but the mouth of the humble meditates upon wisdom.
PRO 11:3 A just one forsakes regret in dying; but beforehand the destruction of the impious ones takes place and incurs ridicule.
PRO 11:4 The soundness of upright ones will guide them; and a fall will plunder the ones disregarding them. Possessions will not benefit in the day of rage; and righteousness shall rescue from death.
PRO 11:5 Righteousness unblemished cuts straight ways; but impiety falls among injustice.
PRO 11:6 Righteousness of upright men shall rescue them; but by thoughtlessness lawbreakers are captured.
PRO 11:7 A coming to an end of a just man, hope is not destroyed; but the boasting of the impious ones is destroyed.
PRO 11:8 A just one is taken from out of a trap; and instead of him the impious one is delivered up.
PRO 11:9 In the mouth of the impious ones is a snare to fellow-countrymen; but the perception of the just ones is prosperous.
PRO 11:10 By the good things of the just ones a city is set up; and in the destruction of the impious ones there is a leap for joy.
PRO 11:11 By the blessing of the upright a city shall be exalted; but by the mouths of impious ones it shall be razed.
PRO 11:12 A man lacking of sense sneers at fellow-countrymen; but an intelligent man leads restfully.
PRO 11:13 A man being double-tongued uncovers plans in the sanhedrin; but the trustworthy man in breath keeps matters hidden.
PRO 11:14 The ones who do not exist with guidance, fall as leaves; but deliverance exists in much counsel.
PRO 11:15 The wicked man does evil whenever he mixes with a just one; and he detests the sound of safety.
PRO 11:16 A gracious wife raises glory to her husband; but a throne of dishonor is a wife detesting just things. The lazy become lacking of riches; but the vigorous establish riches.
PRO 11:17 A merciful man does good to his soul; but the unmerciful totally ruins his body.
PRO 11:18 An impious one does unjust works; but the seed of the just ones is a wage of truth.
PRO 11:19 A just son engenders unto life; but the persecution of an impious one is unto death.
PRO 11:20 Perverting ways are an abomination to the LORD; but all unblemished ones in the way are acceptable to him.
PRO 11:21 The one putting hands unjustly against a hand will not be unpunished of evils; but the one sowing righteousness shall receive a trustworthy wage.
PRO 11:22 As a ring of gold in a nose of a pig; so beauty to an evil-minded woman.
PRO 11:23 All the desire of the just ones is good; but the hope of impious ones shall perish.
PRO 11:24 There are the ones sowing their own seed making more; and there are also the ones gathering having less.
PRO 11:25 Every sincere soul is being blessed; but a man inclined to rage is not decent.
PRO 11:26 May the one hoarding grain leave it to the nations; but a blessing be on the head of the one sharing.
PRO 11:27 The one contriving good things seeks good favor; but the one seeking evil things, evil shall overtake him.
PRO 11:28 The one yielding upon his own riches, this one shall fall; but the one assisting the just ones shall rise.
PRO 11:29 The one not being accommodating to his own house shall inherit the wind; and a foolish one will be a slave to the intelligent.
PRO 11:30 From out of the fruit of righteousness germinates a tree of life; but the lives of lawbreakers are removed at unseasonable times.
PRO 11:31 If then a just man hardly is delivered, the impious one and the sinner, where shall he appear?
PRO 12:1 The one loving instruction loves perception; but the one detesting reproofs is a foolish one.
PRO 12:2 Better the one finding favor from the LORD; but a man who is a lawbreaker shall be silenced.
PRO 12:3 A man will not keep straight by a lawless deed; but the roots of the just ones shall not be lifted away.
PRO 12:4 A courageous wife is a crown to her husband; but as the worm in wood, so an evil doing wife destroys her husband.
PRO 12:5 The devices of just ones are true judgments; but impious ones shall devise treachery.
PRO 12:6 The words of impious ones are deceitful for blood; but the mouth of upright ones shall rescue them.
PRO 12:7 Of which ever time the impious one should be overturned he vanishes; but houses of just ones remain.
PRO 12:8 The mouth of the discerning is lauded by a man; but the dull of heart is sneered at.
PRO 12:9 Better a man with dishonor serving himself, than one putting value on himself, and feeling want of bread.
PRO 12:10 A just one pities the lives of his cattle; but the feelings of compassion of the impious ones are unmerciful.
PRO 12:11 The one working his own ground shall be filled up of breads; but the ones pursuing vain things are lacking of sense. The one who is pleasure-bent in wine drinking pastimes, shall leave behind dishonor in his own fortresses.
PRO 12:12 The desires of the impious ones are evil things; but the roots of the pious are in fortresses.
PRO 12:13 Through the sin of the lips a sinner falls into snares; but a just one flees from them.
PRO 12:14 From fruits of the mouth a soul of a man shall be filled of good things; and a recompense of his lips shall be rendered to him.
PRO 12:15 The ways of foolish ones are straight before them; but a wise one listens to advice.
PRO 12:16 A foolish one daily publishes his anger; but an astute one hides his own dishonor.
PRO 12:17 A just one reports by displaying trust; but the witness of the unjust is deceitful.
PRO 12:18 There are the ones speaking - they pierce as a sword; but the tongues of the wise heal.
PRO 12:19 True lips straighten testimony; but a quick witness has an unjust tongue.
PRO 12:20 Treachery is in the heart of the one contriving evils; but the ones wanting peace shall be glad.
PRO 12:21 Anything unjust shall not please the just one; but the impious ones shall be filled with bad things.
PRO 12:22 Lying lips are an abomination to the LORD; but the one dealing in trust is accepted by him.
PRO 12:23 A discerning man is a throne of perception; but the heart of foolish ones shall meet with curses.
PRO 12:24 The hand of chosen men shall prevail easily; but the deceitful will be for plunder.
PRO 12:25 A fearful word disturbs the heart of a man; but a good message gladdens him.
PRO 12:26 A friend will be a just arbitrator of himself; but the ones sinning pursue evil things; and the way of the impious ones misleads them.
