ISA 5:1 I will sing indeed to the one being loved of me a song of my beloved concerning his vineyard. A vineyard became to the one being loved on a horn in a plentiful place.
ISA 5:2 And I put a barrier around it, and built a palisade, and planted a grapevine - a choice vine. And I built a tower in the midst of it, and dug a wine press in it, and waited for it to produce the grape, and it produced thorn-bushes.
ISA 5:3 And now, ones dwelling in Jerusalem, and man of Judah, judge then between me and my vineyard!
ISA 5:4 What shall I do still to my vineyard, that I did not do to it? For I waited for it to produce a grape, but it produced thorn-bushes.
ISA 5:5 Now then, I will announce to you what I will do to my vineyard. I will remove its barrier, and it will be for ravaging; and I will demolish its wall, and it will be for trampling.
ISA 5:6 And I will forsake my vineyard. For in no way should it be pruned, neither shall it be dug. And the thorn-bush shall ascend into it as in an uncultivated land. And I will give charge to the clouds to not rain any rain upon it.
ISA 5:7 For the vineyard of the LORD of hosts is the house of Israel, and the man of Judah is the newly planted one being loved. I waited for it to produce equity, but it produced lawlessness and not righteousness - but a cry.
ISA 5:8 Woe to the ones joining together house to house, and nearing field to field, that they should remove anything of their neighbor - will you not live alone upon the land?
ISA 5:9 For it was heard in the ears of the LORD of hosts about these things. For even if there should become many residences in desolation, they shall be great and good, but there will not be ones dwelling in them.
ISA 5:10 For where ten teams of oxen work the land will produce one full clay vessel; and the one sowing six large measures shall produce three measures.
ISA 5:11 Woe to the ones arising in the morning and pursuing liquor, waiting late for it; for the wine shall burn with them.
ISA 5:12 For with the harp, and psaltery, and tambourines, and pipes, they drink wine; but the works of the LORD they do not look at, and the works of his hands they do not contemplate.
ISA 5:13 Therefore my people became captive because of their not knowing the LORD. And a multitude became dead because of hunger and thirst for water.
ISA 5:14 And Hades widened its breath, and opened wide its mouth to not stop. And the honorable ones shall go down, and the great, and the rich, and the one exalting in her.
ISA 5:15 And a people shall be abased, and a man shall be dishonored, and the elevated eyes shall be abased.
ISA 5:16 And the LORD of hosts shall be raised up high in judgment, and the holy God shall be glorified in righteousness.
ISA 5:17 And the ones tearing in pieces shall be grazed as bulls; and lambs shall eat the things of the barren places being taken away.
ISA 5:18 Woe to the ones drawing sins as with a long rough cord, and lawlessnesses as with a yoke strap of a heifer.
ISA 5:19 The ones saying, Let him quickly approach to do, that we should see it! And let the counsel of the holy one of Israel come, that we should know it!
ISA 5:20 Woe to the ones calling the evil thing good, and the good thing evil; the ones making the darkness light, and the light darkness; the ones making the bitter sweet, and the sweet bitter.
ISA 5:21 Woe to the wise ones in themselves, and having knowledge before themselves.
ISA 5:22 Woe to your strong ones drinking wine, and the mighty ones mixing liquor;
ISA 5:23 the ones justifying the impious one because of bribes, and lifting away the just thing of the just one.
ISA 5:24 On account of this, in which manner stubble shall be burnt by a coal of fire, and shall be burnt up by a flame being sent up, their root will be as dust, and their flower shall ascend as a cloud of dust; for they wanted not the law of the LORD of hosts; but the oracle of the holy one of Israel they provoked.
ISA 5:25 And the LORD of hosts was enraged in anger against his people, and put a hand against them, and struck them. And the mountains were provoked, and their decaying flesh became as dung in the midst of the way. And in all these his rage was not turned, but still his hand is high.
ISA 5:26 Accordingly he shall lift up an agreed upon sign among the nations far off, and shall whistle at them from the uttermost part of the earth. And behold, quickly, nimbly they come.
ISA 5:27 They shall not hunger nor tire, nor shall they slumber, nor shall they go to sleep, nor shall they untie their belts from their loins, nor shall they tear away the straps of their sandals;
ISA 5:28 whose arrows are sharp, and their bows being stretched tight; the feet of their horses are considered as solid rock; the wheels of their chariots as a blast;
ISA 5:29 they advance as lions, and stand beside as lion cubs; and he shall take hold, and shall yell as a wild beast, and shall cast them out, and there will not be one rescuing them.
ISA 5:30 And he shall yell on account of them in that day, as the sound of the sea swelling up. And they shall look into the heaven upward and below; and behold, a hard darkness in their perplexity.

ISA 6:2 And seraphim stood round about him - six wings to the one, and six wings to the other one. And with the first two they covered up the front, and with the second two they covered up the feet, and with the third two they flew.
ISA 6:3 And they cried out another to another, and said, Holy, holy, holy is the LORD of hosts; all the earth is full of his glory.
ISA 6:4 And the lintel lifted up from the sound of which they cried out, and the house was filled up of smoke.
ISA 6:5 And I said, O, I am miserable, for I am vexed; for being a man and having unclean lips in the midst of a people having unclean lips I live in; and the king, the LORD of hosts, I beheld with my eyes.
ISA 6:6 And one of the seraphim was sent to me. And in the hand he had a coal, which he took from the altar with the tong.
ISA 6:7 And he touched my mouth, and said, Behold, this touched your lips; and your lawless deeds it shall remove, and it shall purge your sins.
ISA 6:8 And I heard the voice of the LORD, saying, Whom shall I send, and who shall go to this people? And I said, Behold, I am, send me!
ISA 6:9 And he said, Go, and say to this people! Hearing, you shall hear, but in no way should you perceive; and seeing you shall see, but in no way should you know.
ISA 6:10 For the heart of this people was thickened, and they heard heavily with their ears, and the eyes closed eyelids; lest at any time they should behold with their eyes, and the ears should hear, and the heart should perceive, and they should turn, and I shall heal them.
ISA 6:11 And I said, Until when, O LORD? And he said, Until whenever cities should be made desolate by not being dwelt in, and houses by reason of not being men, and the land shall be left desolate.
ISA 6:12 And after these things God shall distance the men, and the ones being left behind upon the land shall be multiplied.
ISA 6:13 But still upon it is the tenth part, and again it will be for plunder. As a terebinth tree, and as an acorn, whenever it should fall from out of its casing - the holy seed is its pillar trunk..

ISA 7:6 We shall ascend unto Judea, and conversing together with them, we shall turn them to us, and will give to reign over them the son of Tabeal.

ISA 7:12 And Ahaz said, In no way shall I ask, nor shall I test the LORD.
ISA 7:13 And he said, Hear indeed, O house of David! Is it a small thing to you to furnish a struggle to men, then how do you furnish a struggle to the LORD?

ISA 24:20 It leans and the earth shall be shaken as a storehouse of fruits - as the one being intoxicated and dizzy. And it shall fall, and in no way be able to rise up. For lawlessness shall grow strong upon it.

ISA 25:2 For you made cities into a heap of embankments - they were cities fortified to not fall of their foundations. The city of the impious ones in no way should be built into the eon.
ISA 25:3 On account of this, the poor people shall bless you, and cities of men being wronged shall bless you.
ISA 25:4 For you became a helper to every humble city, and a protection to the ones depressed on account of lack; you shall rescue them from wicked men; a protection of ones thirsting, and a fresh wind spirit. for men being wronged;
ISA 25:5 as faint-hearted men thirsting in Zion. For you shall rescue them from impious men, to whom you delivered us.

ISA 26:3 taking hold of truth, and guarding peace!
ISA 26:4 For upon you we hoped, O LORD, unto the eon - the great eternal God;
ISA 26:5 who humbling, led down the ones dwelling in heights. You shall throw down fortified cities, and lead them down unto the ground.
ISA 26:6 And gentle feet will tread them, and of humble rostrums.
ISA 26:7 The way of the pious becomes straight; and the way of the pious is being prepared.
ISA 26:8 For the way of the LORD is equitable; we hoped upon your name, and upon the remembrance of you
ISA 26:9 which our soul desires. From out of the night my spirit rises early to you, O God, for your orders are light upon the earth. Learn righteousness, O ones dwelling upon the earth!
ISA 26:10 For the impious one ceases; in no way should he learn righteousness upon the earth; no way should he execute truth. Lift away the impious one, that he should not behold the glory of the LORD!

ISA 26:16 O LORD, in affliction we remembered you; in small affliction your instruction is with us.
ISA 26:17 And as the travailing approaches to give birth, and over her birth pangs she cries out, so we were to your beloved.
ISA 26:18 Because of the fear of you, O LORD, we conceived in the womb, and travailed, and birthed the breath of your deliverance which you did upon the earth. We shall not fall, but all the ones dwelling upon the earth shall fall.

ISA 27:4 There is not her who did not take hold of her; therefore because of this the LORD did all as much as he ordered - I am incinerated.

ISA 28:3 And by the feet the crown of insolence shall be trampled, the hirelings of Ephraim.
ISA 28:4 And the flower shall be (the one having fallen off of the hope of the glory) upon the tip of the high mountain, as a forerunner of a fig. The one beholding it, before taking it into his hand, will want to swallow it down.

ISA 28:11 because of disparagement of the lips; for they shall speak by another tongue to this people,

ISA 28:15 For you said, We made a covenant with Hades, and treaties with death; if a gale being brought should go by, in no way should it come to us; we made the lie our hope, and by the lie we shall be sheltered.

ISA 28:20 O ones having been restricted, we are not able to do combat; but ourselves - we weakened for you to gather.

ISA 28:22 And you, may you not be glad, nor the bonds strengthen in you; for I heard the things being completed and being rendered concise by the LORD of Host, which he will do upon all the earth.
ISA 28:23 Give ear, and hearken to my voice! Take heed, and hear my words!
ISA 28:24 Shall not the one plowing be about to plow the entire day? or the one sowing, will he not prepare beforehand to work the ground?
ISA 28:25 Is it not whenever he should level the face of it, then sow the small pepperwort or cummin, and again sow wheat, and barley, and spelt, in your boundaries?
ISA 28:26 And you shall be corrected in the equity of your God, and shall be glad.
ISA 28:27 For not with hardness is the pepperwort cleansed, nor shall the wheel of a wagon lead about upon the cummin; but the pepperwort is shaken off by a rod.
ISA 28:28 But the cummin shall be eaten with bread, for I am not provoked to anger against you into the eon, nor shall the voice of my bitterness trample you.

ISA 29:12 And this scroll will be given into the hands of a man not having knowledge of letters. And one shall say to him, Read this! And he shall say, I have not knowledge of letters.
ISA 29:13 And the LORD said, this people approach unto me with their mouth, and by their lips they esteem me, but their heart is far off at a distance from me; and in vain they worship me, teaching the precepts and instructions of men.

ISA 29:15 Woe to the ones deeply making plans, and not according to the LORD - woe to the ones making plans in secret, and their works shall be in darkness, and they shall say, Who has seen us? and who shall know us or what we do?

ISA 29:19 and the poor shall exult because of the LORD with gladness, and the ones despairing of men shall be filled up with gladness.

ISA 29:21 even the ones causing men to sin by a word. And they shall make all the ones reproving at the gates to be considered for stumbling, for they bent away the just one by unjust acts.

In the affliction and in the straits are the lion and lion's cub; from there also asps and the progeny of flying asps; the ones who brought upon donkeys and camels of their riches to a nation who shall not benefit them for help, but for shame and scorn.

ISA 30:13 therefore this will be to you - this sin will be as a wall of a fortified city immediately falling being captured, of which immediately is at hand the calamitous downfall.
ISA 30:14 And the calamitous downfall of it will be as the breaking of a receptacle of earthenware of a thin clay vessel, so that there should not be found among them even a potsherd in which to lift coals of fire, and with which to whistle up a little water.

ISA 30:18 And again God will wait so as to pity you. And on account of this he shall be raised up high to show mercy on you; for the LORD your God is judge. Blessed are all the ones adhering in him.

ISA 30:21 and your ears shall hearken to the words of the ones following after you, misleading you. The ones saying, This is the way, we should go by it, whether right or whether left.
ISA 30:22 And you shall remove the idols being silver plated; and the ones being gilded you shall make into fine dust; and you shall winnow them as the water of a woman sitting apart, and you shall thrust them away as dung.
ISA 30:23 Then there will be rain for the seed of your land; and the bread from the produce of your land will be plenteous and lustrous; and your cattle shall graze in that day in a place fertile and broad-spaced;
ISA 30:24 your bulls and oxen working the ground shall eat straw being prepared from barley being winnowed;
ISA 30:25 and there shall be upon every high mountain, and upon every elevated hill, water traveling over in that day, whenever many should be destroyed, and whenever towers shall fall;
ISA 30:26 and the light of the moon shall be as the light of the sun; and the light of the sun will be seven-fold in the day whenever the LORD should heal the breaking up of his people, and shall heal the grief of your calamity.

ISA 30:28 And his breath, as water being dragged along in a ravine, shall come unto the neck, and be divided. He shall disturb nations for a vain addiction to a delusion, and an addiction to a delusion shall pursue them, and shall take them according to their face.

ISA 33:3 On account of the sound of the fear of you peoples were amazed, and the nations were dispersed because of the fear of you.
ISA 33:4 But now your spoils shall be gathered, small and great; in which manner as if one should gather locusts, so they shall mock you.
ISA 33:5 Holy is the God dwelling in heavens. Zion shall be filled up with equity and righteousness.

ISA 33:7 Behold indeed, in the fear of you these shall be fearful. Whom you feared shall yell out because of you; for messengers shall be sent enjoining for peace, bitterly weeping.
ISA 33:8 For the ways of these shall be made desolate. Your fear of the nations has been made to cease, and the covenant is lifted away, and in no way shall you consider them men.

ISA 33:13 The ones at a distance shall hear what I did; and the ones approaching shall know my strength.
ISA 33:14 The lawless ones in Zion departed. Trembling shall take the impious ones. Who shall announce to you that a fire is being burned? Who shall announce to you the eternal place?
ISA 33:15 The one going in righteousness, speaking the straight way, detesting lawlessness and injustice, and shaking off bribes with the hands, of one weighing down the ears that he should not hear a judgment of blood, and closing the eyelids of the eyes that he should not behold injustice.

ISA 33:17 You shall see a king with glory; and your eyes shall see a land at a distance.
ISA 33:18 Your soul shall meditate upon fear. Where are the academics? Where are the ones advising? Where is the one counting the ones being maintained?
ISA 33:19 A small and great people which did not take advice, nor perceived a deep voice, so that a people being treated as worthless should not hear, and there is not understanding to the one hearing.

ISA 33:21 For the name of the LORD will be great to you; with rivers and spacious and broad aqueducts. You shall not go this way, nor shall a boat being rowed go.
ISA 33:22 For my God is great; the LORD shall not pass me by; the LORD our judge; the LORD our ruler; the LORD our king; the LORD himself shall deliver us.
ISA 33:23 Your rough cords were torn, for your mast does not have strength, it leans, it shall not let down the shrouds, it shall not lift a signal flag until of which time it should be delivered up for plunder; therefore many lame men shall cause plunder.

ISA 34:1 Lead forward, O nations, and hearken, O rulers! Hear, O earth, and the ones living in it; O world, and the people in it!
ISA 34:2 For the rage of the LORD is upon all the nations, and his anger is upon their number, to destroy them and to deliver them up unto slaughter.
ISA 34:3 And the slain ones of theirs shall be tossed forth, and the dead ones. And the scent of them shall ascend, and the mountains shall be rained upon by their blood.
ISA 34:4 And all the powers of the heavens shall melt away. And the heaven shall coil up as a scroll. And all the stars shall fall as leaves fall from a grapevine, and as leaves fall from a fig-tree.
ISA 34:5 For my sword was intoxicated in the heaven. Behold, it shall go down upon Edom, and upon the people of the destruction with judgment.
ISA 34:6 The sword of the LORD was filled of blood thickened from the fat of lambs, and from the fat of he-goats and rams; for a sacrifice to God is in Bosor, and a great slaughter in Edom.
ISA 34:7 And the stout men shall be cast down with them, and the rams and the bulls. And the earth will be intoxicated from the blood, even their embankment; and they shall be filled up of their fat.
ISA 34:8 For it is a day of judgment of the LORD, and a year of recompense of judgment of Zion.
ISA 34:9 And her ravines shall be turned into pitch; and her land into sulphur; and her land will be in burning pitch
ISA 34:10 night and day; and it shall not be extinguished into the eon of time. And her smoke shall ascend upward; unto her generations she shall be made desolate, and for a long time she shall be made desolate.
ISA 34:11 Birds, and hedgehogs, and ibises, and crows shall dwell in her; and a surveying cord of desolation shall be put upon her; and satyrs shall live in her.
ISA 34:12 Her rulers will not be; for her kings and her great men will be for destruction.
ISA 34:13 And thorny woods shall grow up in their cities, and also in her fortresses; and they will be properties of sirens, and a courtyard of ostriches.
ISA 34:14 And demons shall meet with satyrs; and they shall yell another to the other; satyrs shall rest there, for they found for themselves a place of rest.
ISA 34:15 The hedgehog shall nest there, and the earth preserved her children with safety; there stags meet together, and beheld the faces of one another.
ISA 34:16 They go by in number, and not one of them perished; the other did not seek the other; for the LORD gave charge to them, and his spirit gathered them.
ISA 34:17 And he shall cast lots for them, and his hand divided out parts to them to graze. Into the eon of time you shall inherit; for generations of generations shall rest upon it.
ISA 35:1 Be glad, O thirsting wilderness! Exult, O wilderness, and bloom as a lily!
ISA 35:2 And the desolate places of the Jordan shall blossom and exult. The glory of Lebanon was given to it, and the honor of Carmel. And my people shall see the glory of the LORD, and the stature of God.
ISA 35:3 Be strong, O hands being forsaken, and knees being disabled!
ISA 35:4 Take comfort, O faint-hearted in mind! Be strong! Do not fear! Behold, our God recompenses judgment, and he will recompense. He himself shall come, and shall deliver us.
ISA 35:5 Then shall the eyes of the blind be opened, and the ears of the deaf shall hear.
ISA 35:6 Then the lame shall leap as a stag, and the tongue of the stammering will be plain; for water was torn forth in the wilderness, and a ravine in a thirsting land.
ISA 35:7 And the waterless place will be turned into marshes, and the thirsting land into a spring of water. There will be there a gladness of birds, properties of reed and marshes.
ISA 35:8 There will be there a pure way, and it shall be called a holy way; and in no way shall anything unclean pass by there; nor shall there be there an unclean way. But the ones having been scattered shall go upon it, and in no way shall they wander.
ISA 35:9 And there will not be a lion there. Nor the ferocious wild beasts in any way shall ascend unto it, nor even should it be found there. But the ones being ransomed shall go in it,
ISA 35:10 even ones being gathered together by the LORD. And they shall return, and shall come to Zion with gladness; even eternal gladness is upon their head. For upon their head is praise and a leap for joy. And gladness shall overtake them; grief and distress and moaning ran away.
ISA 36:1 And it came to pass the fourteenth year of the reigning of Hezekiah, Sennacherib king of the Assyrians ascended upon the fortified cities of Judea, and took them.
ISA 36:2 And the king of the Assyrians sent Rabshakeh from Lachish unto Jerusalem to king Hezekiah with a great force. And he stood by the aqueduct of the upper pool in the way of the field of the fuller.
ISA 36:3 And there came forth to him, Eliakim, the son of Hilkiah the manager, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph, the recorder.
ISA 36:4 And Rabshakeh said to them, Speak to Hezekiah! Thus says the great king, the king of the Assyrians. What are you relying on?
ISA 36:5 Does the battle take place by a plan with the words of the lips? And now, upon whom are you relying, that you resist my persuasion?
ISA 36:6 Behold, you are relying upon this fractured rod of reed - upon Egypt; which if a man should stay his weight upon it, it shall enter into his hand, and shall puncture it. Thus is Pharaoh king of Egypt, and all the ones relying upon him.
ISA 36:7 And if you should say, Upon the LORD our God we rely on. Is he not whom Hezekiah removed his high places, and his altars; and he spoke to Judah and to Jerusalem, saying, In front of this altar do obesiance now!
ISA 36:8 But mix in with my master the king of the Assyrians, and I will give to you two thousand horses, if you are able to put riders upon them.
ISA 36:9 And how are you all able to turn to the face of the toparchs? The ones relying upon the Egyptians for a horse and rider are our servants.
ISA 36:10 And now, have we ascended without the LORD upon this place to wage war with it? The LORD said to me, Ascend upon this land, and utterly destroy it!
ISA 36:11 And Eliakim and Shebna and Joah said to him, to Rabshakeh, Speak indeed to your servants in Syriac, for we hear ourselves, and speak not to us in Jewish! for why do you speak unto the ears of the men standing upon the wall?
ISA 36:12 And Rabshakeh said to them, Is it to your master, or to you my master sent me to speak these words? Is it not to the men sitting upon the wall, that they should eat their dung, and drink their urine with you together?
ISA 36:13 And Rabshakeh stood, and yelled out with a great voice in Jewish, and said, Hearken to indeed the words of the great king, the king of the Assyrians!
ISA 36:14 Thus says the king, Do not let Hezekiah deceive you with words! in no way shall he be able to rescue you.
ISA 36:15 And do not let Hezekiah say to you that, God shall rescue you, and in no way shall this city be delivered into the hand of the king of the Assyrians!
ISA 36:16 Do not hearken to Hezekiah! Thus says the king of the Assyrians, If you want to be blessed, come forth to me, and you shall each eat of his own grapevine and fig-trees, and drink water from out of his own well,
ISA 36:17 until whenever I should come and should take you into a land as your land - a land of grain, and wine, and breads, and vineyards!
ISA 36:18 Let not Hezekiah deceive you! saying, God shall rescue us. Have the gods of the nations each rescued his own place from out of the hand of the king of the Assyrians?
ISA 36:19 Where is the god of Hamath and Arpad? and where is the god of the city of Sepharvaim? Have they been able to rescue Samaria from out of my hand?
ISA 36:20 Which of the gods of all these nations is the one who was rescued of his land from out of my hand, that the LORD shall rescue Jerusalem from out of my hand?
ISA 36:21 And they kept silent, and no one answered him a word by the assignment of the king, saying, No one is to answer.
ISA 36:22 And Eliakim the son of Helkiah the manager entered, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder, to Hezekiah, having split their inner garments. And they announced to him the words of Rabshakeh.
ISA 37:1 And it came to pass in king Hezekiah hearing, he split his garments, and put on sackcloth, and ascended unto the house of the LORD.
ISA 37:2 And he sent Eliakim the manager, and Shebna the scribe, with the elders of the priests, putting on sackcloths, to Isaiah son of Amoz the prophet.
ISA 37:3 And they said to him, Thus says Hezekiah, A day of affliction, and scorning, and rebuke, and anger is today's day. For the pangs in giving birth come, but she has not strength to give birth.
ISA 37:4 If by any means the LORD your God may listen to the words of Rabshakeh, whom his master the king of the Assyrians sent to berate the living God, and to berate by the words which the LORD your God heard, therefore you shall make beseechment to the LORD your God concerning these surviving.
ISA 37:5 And the servants of king Hezekiah came to Isaiah.
ISA 37:6 And Isaiah said to them, Thus you shall say to your master, Thus says the LORD, You should not be fearful of the words which you heard, which the ambassadors of the king of the Assyrians berated me.
ISA 37:7 Behold, I shall put upon him a spirit, and hearing a message he shall return unto his place, and he shall fall by the sword in his land.
ISA 37:8 And Rabshakeh returned, and overtook the king of the Assyrians while assaulting Libna, for he heard that he departed from Lachish.
ISA 37:9 And there came forth Tirhakah king of the Ethiopians to assault him. And hearing he returned and sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,
ISA 37:10 Thus you shall say to Hezekiah king of Judea, Let not your God deceive you, upon whom you rely upon him! saying, In no way shall Jerusalem be delivered up into the hand of the king of the Assyrians.
ISA 37:11 Behold, have you not heard what the kings of the Assyrians did; how they destroyed the whole earth - and shall you be rescued?
ISA 37:12 Have the gods of the nations rescued them whom my fathers destroyed - both Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, which are in the place of Telassar?
ISA 37:13 Where are the kings of Hamath? and where is Arphad? and where is the city Sepharvaim, Henah and Ivah?
ISA 37:14 And Hezekiah took the scroll from the messengers, and read it. And he ascended into the house of the LORD, and opened it before the LORD.
ISA 37:15 And Hezekiah prayed to the LORD, saying,
ISA 37:16 O LORD of hosts, God of Israel, the one sitting upon the cherubim, you are God alone, of every kingdom of the inhabitable world. You made the heaven and the earth.
ISA 37:17 Lean, O LORD, your ear! Hearken, O LORD! Open, O LORD, your eyes! Look in, O LORD, and know and hear all the words of Sennacherib which he sent to berate the living God!
ISA 37:18 For in truth, O LORD, the kings of the Assyrians made desolate the entire inhabitable world, and their region.
ISA 37:19 And they raised their idols unto the fire, for they were not gods, but works of the hands of men - wood and stones. And they destroyed them.
ISA 37:20 But now, O LORD our God, deliver us from out of his hand, that every kingdom of the earth should know that you are God alone!
ISA 37:21 And Isaiah son of Amoz was sent to Hezekiah. And he said to him, Thus says the LORD God of Israel, I heard what you prayed to me concerning Sennacherib king of the Assyrians.
ISA 37:22 This is the word which God spoke concerning him; The virgin daughter of Zion treated you as worthless and sneered at you; the daughter of Jerusalem shook her head against you.
ISA 37:23 To whom did you berate and provoke? or to whom did you raise up high your voice, and lifted your eyes unto the height - against the holy one of Israel?
ISA 37:24 For through messengers you berated the LORD. For you said, With the multitude of chariots I shall ascend unto the height of mountains, and into the ends of Lebanon; and I felled the height of its cedar, and the beauty of the cypress; and I entered unto the height of the portion of the forest;
ISA 37:25 and I made a dam, and made desolate the waters and every gathering of water.
ISA 37:26 Have you not heard these things which I did earlier? From ancient days I ordered it. But now I displayed to make nations in fortified places desolate, and the ones living in fortified cities.
ISA 37:27 I weakened the hands, and they were dried up; and they became as dry grass upon the roofs, and as wild grass.
ISA 37:28 But now I know your rest and your exit and your entrance,
ISA 37:29 and your rage which you were enraged - even your bitterness ascended to me. And I will put a rein into your nose, and a bit into your lips, and I will return you in the way in which you came by it;
ISA 37:30 and this is the sign to you, Eat this year what you have sown; and the second year the vestige; and the third year, sow, and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat of their fruit!
ISA 37:31 And they shall be the ones being left behind in Judea. They shall germinate a root below, and they shall produce grain upward.
ISA 37:32 For from out of Jerusalem shall come forth the ones surviving, and the ones being preserved from out of mount Zion. The zeal of the LORD of hosts shall do these things.
ISA 37:33 Therefore thus says the LORD concerning the king of the Assyrians, In no way shall he enter into this city, nor throw an arrow against it, nor shall he put a shield against it, nor shall he encircle a siege mound against it.
ISA 37:34 But in the way in which he came by it, he shall return; and in no way shall he enter into this city. Thus says the LORD.
ISA 37:35 I will shield over this city to deliver it, because of myself and because of David my servant.
ISA 37:36 And an angel of the LORD came forth, and did away with the camp of the Assyrians - a hundred eighty-five thousand. And rising up in the morning, he found all the dead bodies.
ISA 37:37 And he went forth returning. And Sennacherib king of the Assyrians returned, and lived in Nineveh.
ISA 37:38 And while he did obeisance in the house of Nisroch his god, Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons struck him with swords; and they came through safe into Armenia. And Esar-haddon his son took reign instead of him.
ISA 38:1 And it came to pass in that time Hezekiah was infirm unto death. And there came to him Isaiah son of Amoz the prophet. And he said to him, Thus says the LORD, Give orders concerning your house, for you die, and shall not live!
ISA 38:2 And Hezekiah turned his face to the wall, and prayed to the LORD,
ISA 38:3 saying, Remember, O LORD, as I was gone before you with truth, in a true heart, and the things pleasing before you I did. And Hezekiah wept a great weeping.
ISA 38:4 And the word of the LORD came to Isaiah, saying,
ISA 38:5 Go, and say to Hezekiah, Thus says the LORD, the God of David your father, I heard your prayer, and beheld your tears. Behold, I add to your time fifteen years.
ISA 38:6 And from out of the hand of the king of the Assyrians I shall rescue you, and this city - and I shall shield over this city.
ISA 38:7 And this is the sign to you from the LORD, that God will do this thing which he said.
ISA 38:8 Behold, I shall turn the shadow of the stairs which the sun went down the ten stairs of the house of your father. I will return the sun the ten stairs which the shadow went down.
ISA 38:9 The prayer of Hezekiah king of Judea when he was infirm, and rose up from his infirmity.
ISA 38:10 I said in the height of my days, I shall go to the gates of Hades. I shall forsake the years remaining.
ISA 38:11 I said, No longer in any way shall I behold the deliverance of God upon the land of the living. No longer in any way shall I behold a man with ones inhabiting.
ISA 38:12 I failed my kin; I forsook the rest of my life; it departed and went forth from me as the one resting up pitching a tent. My spirit in me became as the web of one working in wool approaching to cut it off.
ISA 38:13 In that day I was delivered over until morning. As a lion so he broke all my bones. For from the day until the night I was delivered over.
ISA 38:14 As a swallow, so shall I call out, and as a dove, so shall I meditate. For my eyes failed to see into the height of the heaven, to the LORD who rescued me.
ISA 38:15 And he removed the grief of my soul, and he acted.
ISA 38:16 O LORD, for concerning this it was announced to you, and you awakened my breath, and being comforted, I live.
ISA 38:17 Behold, being in peace was bitter for me. For you took up my soul that it should not perish; and you threw away all my sins behind me.
ISA 38:18 For the ones in Hades shall not praise you; nor the ones dying shall bless you; nor shall the ones in Hades hope on your charity.
ISA 38:19 The living shall bless you in which manner as I. For from today I shall produce children who shall announce your righteousness.
ISA 38:20 O LORD of my deliverance, even I will not cease blessing you with the psaltery all the days of my life before the house of God.
ISA 38:21 And Isaiah said to Hezekiah, Take a dried cluster of figs, and grind them, and plaster over, and you will be in health!
ISA 38:22 And Hezekiah said, What is the sign that I shall ascend into the house of God.
ISA 39:1 In that time Merodach Baladan the son of Baladan the king of Babylonia sent letters, and ambassadors, and gifts to Hezekiah; for he heard that he was infirm unto death, and was raised up.
ISA 39:2 And Hezekiah rejoiced over them with a great joy, and showed to them the house of the spices, and of the silver, and of the gold, and of the balsam, and of the incenses, and of the perfumed liquid, and all the houses of the items of the treasury, and all as much as was in his treasuries. And there was not one thing which Hezekiah did not show to them in his house.
ISA 39:3 And Isaiah the prophet came to king Hezekiah, and said to him, What did these men say? and from what place have they come to you? And Hezekiah said, From a land at a distance - they have come to me from Babylon.
ISA 39:4 And Isaiah said, What did they see in your house? And Hezekiah said, All the things in my house they beheld; and there is not anything in my house which they beheld not - but even the things in my treasuries.
ISA 39:5 And Isaiah said to him, Hear the word of the LORD of hosts!
ISA 39:6 Behold, days come, and they shall take all the things in your house, and as much as your fathers brought together until this day - it shall come unto Babylon, and not one thing in any way should survive. and God said,
ISA 39:7 for even of your children whom you engendered they shall take; and they shall be made castrati in the house of the king of the Babylonians.
ISA 39:8 And Hezekiah said to Isaiah, the word of the LORD is good which you spoke - let there be indeed peace and righteousness in my days!
ISA 40:1 Take comfort, take comfort, my people, says your God!
ISA 40:2 O priests, speak to the heart of Jerusalem! Comfort her! For her humiliation was filled up; her sin is untied; for she received from the hand of the LORD double her sins.
ISA 40:3 A voice yelling in the wilderness, Prepare the way of the LORD! Make straight the roads of our God!
ISA 40:4 Every ravine shall be filled, and every mountain and hill shall be lowered; and all the crooked paths shall be for straight, and the rough into smooth plains.
ISA 40:5 And the glory of the LORD shall be seen, and all flesh shall see the deliverance of God - for the LORD said it.
ISA 40:6 A voice saying, Yell! And I said, What shall I yell? All flesh is as grass, and all glory of man is as the flower of grass;
ISA 40:7 the grass is dried, and the flower fell off, for breath of God breathed on it. Truly the grass is the people.
ISA 40:8 The grass is dried, the flower fell off, but the word of our God abides into the eon.
ISA 40:9 Ascend upon the high mountain, O one announcing good news of Zion! Raise up high in the strength of your voice, O one announcing good news of Jerusalem! Raise it up high! Do not fear! Say to the cities of Judah, Behold your God!
ISA 40:10 Behold, the Lord; the LORD comes with strength, even the arm with dominion. Behold, his wage is with him, and the work before him.
ISA 40:11 As a shepherd he shall tend his flock, and his arm shall gather the lambs, and he shall comfort the one having one in the womb.
ISA 40:12 Who measured the water with the hand, and the heaven with a span, and all the earth in a handful? Who established the mountains weight, and the groves in a yoke balance scale?
ISA 40:13 Who knew the mind of the LORD? and who became his counselor? Who shall instruct him?
ISA 40:14 Or whom did he take up advice with, and instructed him? Or who showed to him equity? Or who showed to him a way of understanding?
ISA 40:15 Since all the nations were considered as a drop from a pail and as the crux of a yoke balance scale; and they are considered as saliva.
ISA 40:16 And Lebanon is not fit for burning, and all the four-footed are not fit for a whole offering;
ISA 40:17 and all the nations are as nothing; and were considered as nothing to him.
ISA 40:18 To whom did you liken the LORD, and to what representation did you liken him?
ISA 40:19 Has not the fabricator made an image? Or the goldsmith having cast gold, gilt it over, and carefully prepared it for a representation?
ISA 40:20 For the fabricator chooses incorruptible wood, and wisely seeks how to station his image, that it should not be shaken.
ISA 40:21 Will you not know? Will you not hear? Was it not announced from the beginning to you? Did you not know the foundations of the earth?
ISA 40:22 He is the one controlling the curve of the earth, and the ones dwelling in it are as locusts; He is the one establishing the heaven as a vault, and extending it out as a tent to dwell in;
ISA 40:23 the one establishing rulers to rule as nothing; and he made the earth as nothing.
ISA 40:24 For not in any way shall they plant, nor shall they sow, nor shall they be rooted in the earth of their root. He breathed upon them, and they were dried up; and a blast shall take them away as sticks.
ISA 40:25 Now then, to whom did you liken me that I shall be exalted, said the holy one?
ISA 40:26 Look up into the height with your eyes, and behold who introduced all these things! The one bringing forth his cosmos by number shall call all things by name by great glory, and by the might of strength. Nothing of which you are unaware.
ISA 40:27 For you should not say, O Jacob, and why did you speak, O Israel, saying, My way was concealed from God, and my God removed judgment, and departed.
ISA 40:28 And now, did you not know unless you heard? the eternal God, the God carefully preparing the tips of the earth, he shall not hunger nor tire, nor is there a finding out of his intelligence;
ISA 40:29 giving strength to the ones hungering, and distress to the ones not grieving.
ISA 40:30 For younger men shall hunger, and the young shall tire, and the chosen men will be without strength.
ISA 40:31 But the ones waiting upon God shall change in strength; they shall grow wings as eagles; they shall run and shall not tire; they shall proceed and shall not hunger.
ISA 41:1 Dedicate a feast to me, O islands! for the rulers shall change strength. Let them approach and speak together; then let them announce judgment!
ISA 41:2 Who awakened righteousness from the east, called it by his feet, and it shall go? He shall appoint against nations, and he shall recede kings, and shall put their swords into the earth, and their bows as sticks being pushed out.
ISA 41:3 And he shall pursue them - the way of his feet shall go through in peace.
ISA 41:4 Who exerted energy and did these things? He called her - the one calling her, from the beginning of generations - I God, the first, and into the coming, I am.
ISA 41:5 Nations beheld and feared; the tips of the earth are startled; they approached, and came together;
ISA 41:6 judging each for the neighbor, and helping for the brother; and shall say,
ISA 41:7 The man was strong - the fabricator, and the brazier beating with a hammer, forging together; how long then shall he say, The coupling is good, they strengthened them with nails; they shall establish them, and it shall not be moved.
ISA 41:8 But you, Israel, my servant, Jacob whom I chose, seed of Abraham whom I loved;
ISA 41:9 whom I took hold of from the uttermost parts of the earth, and from out of its heights called you, and said to you, You are my servant; I chose you, and did not abandon you.
ISA 41:10 Fear not, for I am with you! Wander not, for I am your God, the one strengthening you! And I will give help to you, and safeguard you by my just right hand.
ISA 41:11 Behold, all your adversaries shall be ashamed and shall be respectful, for they will be as not existing; and all your opponents shall perish.
ISA 41:12 You shall seek them, and in no way shall you find the men who shall insult while drunk with wine against you, for they shall be as ones not being; and the ones waging war against you shall not be.
ISA 41:13 For I am your God, the one holding your right hand, the one saying to you,
ISA 41:14 Do not fear, O Jacob, O Israel, very few in number! I gave help to you, says your God, the one ransoming you, O Israel.
ISA 41:15 Behold, I made you as wheels of a wagon threshing - new, toothed. And you shall thresh mountains, and shall thin out hills, and make as dust.
ISA 41:16 And you shall winnow, and a wind shall take them, and a gale shall scatter them. But you shall be glad among the holy ones of Israel.
ISA 41:17 And the poor and the ones lacking will exult, for they shall seek water, and it will not be; their tongue was dried up from the thirst. I the LORD shall heed, the God of Israel, and I will not abandon them.
ISA 41:18 But I will open rivers upon the mountains, and springs in the midst of plains. I will make the wilderness into marshes of waters, and the thirsting ground in aqueducts.
ISA 41:19 I will put into the waterless earth the cedar, and boxwood, and myrtle, and cypress, and white poplar;
ISA 41:20 that they should behold, and should know, and should reflect on, and should have knowledge of together, that the hand of the LORD did these things, and the holy one of Israel introduced them.
ISA 41:21 Your judgment approaches, says the LORD God; your counsels approached, says the king of Jacob.
ISA 41:22 Let them approach and announce to you what shall come to pass, or the things prior to what it was you said! And we will attend our mind, and we shall know what the last things, and the ones coming are.
ISA 41:23 Tell to us! Announce the things coming at the latter end, and we shall know that you are gods! Do good, and do evil, and we shall wonder, and we shall see at the same time,
ISA 41:24 for from what place you are, and from what place your work is from! They chose you an abomination out of the earth.
ISA 41:25 But I raised the one from the north, and the one from the sun eastward - they shall be called by my name. Let the rulers come! And as clay of a potter, and as a potter trampling the clay, so you shall be trampled.
ISA 41:26 For who shall announce the things from the beginning, that we should know? and the things happening before, and we shall say that they are true? There is not the one speaking beforehand, nor one hearing your words.
ISA 41:27 I will give sovereignty to Zion, and I will comfort Jerusalem in the way.
ISA 41:28 For from the nations, behold, there was no one; and from their idols there was not one announcing. And if I should ask them, From what place are you - in no way should they answer to me.
ISA 41:29 For they are the ones making you, so you say, and in folly ones misleading you.
ISA 42:1 Jacob, my child - I shall take hold of him. Israel, my chosen - my soul favorably received him. I have put my spirit upon him; he shall bring forth judgment to the nations.
ISA 42:2 He shall not cry out, nor shall he spring up, nor shall his voice be heard outside.
ISA 42:3 A reed being crushed he will not break, and smoking flax he will not extinguish; but to validity he will bring forth judgment.
ISA 42:4 He shall illuminate, and shall not be devastated until whenever he should set judgment upon the earth. And upon his name nations shall hope.
ISA 42:5 Thus says the LORD God, the one making the heaven, and pitching it; solidifying the earth, and the things in it; and giving breath to the people upon it, and spirit to the ones treading it.
ISA 42:6 I the LORD God called you in righteousness, and I shall hold your hand, and shall strengthen you; and I gave you for a covenant of a race, for a light of nations;
ISA 42:7 to open the eyes of the blind, to lead out of bonds ones being tied from out of the house of prison, and ones sitting in darkness.
ISA 42:8 I am the LORD God. This is my name. I will not give my glory to another, nor my virtues to the carvings.
ISA 42:9 The things from the beginning, behold, they have come, even new things which I shall announce; and before the announcing it was made manifest to you.
ISA 42:10 Sing to the LORD a new hymn! Glorify his name from the uttermost part of the earth, O ones going down into the sea, and sailing it; the islands, and the ones dwelling in them!
ISA 42:11 Be glad, O wilderness, and her towns, properties, and the ones dwelling in Kedar! The ones dwelling in the rock Petra shall be glad.. From the tip of the mountains they shall yell.
ISA 42:12 They shall give to God glory; they shall report his virtues in the islands.
ISA 42:13 The LORD God of the forces shall go forth, and shall break war. He shall rouse zeal, and shall yell against his enemies with strength.
ISA 42:14 I kept silent from the eon; shall I also continually keep silent and endure? As the woman giving birth perseveres, I will now amaze and dry out at the same time.
ISA 42:15 I will make mountains and hills desolate, and will dry out all their grass. And I will make rivers into islands, and marshes to dry land.
ISA 42:16 And I will lead the blind in the way which they knew not; and I will cause them to tread roads which they had not seen. I will make for them darkness into light, and crooked into straight. These are the things I will do to them, and I shall not abandon them.
ISA 42:17 But they were turned into the rear. You should be ashamed with shame, O ones relying upon the carvings, O ones saying to the molten images, You are our gods.
ISA 42:18 O deaf-mutes, hear! And O blind, look up to behold!
ISA 42:19 And who is blind, but my servants? and who are deaf-mutes, but the ones dominating them? Who is blind as the one receiving? Even the servants of God were blinded.
ISA 42:20 You beheld many times, and watched not; opening the ears, and heard not.
ISA 42:21 The LORD God willed that he should be justified, and should magnify praise.
ISA 42:22 And I beheld, and it came to pass the people were being despoiled and plundered; for the snare is in the storerooms everywhere, and in the houses together where they hid them; they became for plunder, and there was not the one rescuing one seized; and there was not the one saying, Give back!
ISA 42:23 Who among you shall give ear to these things which shall be heard for the things coming about?
ISA 42:24 Who gave Jacob for ravaging, and Israel to the ones plundering? Was it not God to whom they sinned? and they wanted not to go in his ways, nor to hear his law.
ISA 42:25 And he brought upon them the anger of his rage; and the war strengthened against them and the ones burning them round about; and each of them did not know, nor put it unto their soul.
ISA 43:1 And now, thus says the LORD God, the one making you, O Jacob, and the one shaping you, O Israel, Do not fear! For I ransomed you, I called you by your name; you are mine.
ISA 43:2 And if you should pass over through water, I am with you; and rivers shall not engulf you. And if you go through fire, in no way should you be incinerated; a flame shall not incinerate you.
ISA 43:3 For I am the LORD your God, the holy one of Israel, the one delivering you. I made a barter for you - Egypt, and Ethiopia, and Seba for you.
ISA 43:4 From of which time you were esteemed valuable before me, you were glorified, and I loved you. And I will give men for you, and rulers for your head.
ISA 43:5 Do not fear, for I am with you! From the east I will lead your seed, and from the west I will bring you together.
ISA 43:6 I will say to the north, Bring! And to the south, Restrain not! Bring my sons from a land at a distance, and my daughters from uttermost parts of the earth,
ISA 43:7 even all, as many as have been called upon to my name. For in my glory I carefully prepared him, and I shaped him, and I made him.
ISA 43:8 And I brought out a blind people, and the eyes are likewise blind; and deaf ones having the ears.
ISA 43:9 All the nations were brought together, and rulers from them shall be brought together. Who will announce these things? Or the things from the beginning, who will announce? Let them bring their witnesses, and let them be justified, and let them hear, and let them speak truth!
ISA 43:10 Be witnesses to me! Even I witness, says the LORD God, and my servant whom I chose. That you should know, and should trust, and should perceive that I am. Before me another God did not exist, and after me it will not be.
ISA 43:11 I am God, and besides me there is not one delivering.
ISA 43:12 I announced it, and I delivered. I berated, and there was not among you an alien god. You are to me witnesses, and I am the LORD God,
ISA 43:13 Even from the beginning; and there is not one taking from my hands. I will do, and who shall turn it?
ISA 43:14 Thus says the LORD God, the one ransoming you, the holy one of Israel. Because of you I will send unto Babylon, and I will rouse all the ones fleeing, and the Chaldeans shall be tied in boats.
ISA 43:15 I am the LORD God, your holy one, the one introducing for Israel your king.
ISA 43:16 For thus says the LORD, the one making a way in the sea, and a path in strong water;
ISA 43:17 the one leading chariots and horse, and a mighty multitude; but they were gone to sleep, and they shall not rise up; they were extinguished as flax being extinguished.
ISA 43:18 Do not remember the first things, and the ancient things do not reckon together!
ISA 43:19 Behold, I do new things which now shall arise, and you shall know them. And I will make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the waterless place.
ISA 43:20 The wild beasts of the field shall bless me, sirens and daughters of ostriches; for I established water in the wilderness, and rivers in the waterless place, to give to drink, my chosen race,
ISA 43:21 my people whom I procured; the ones to describe my virtues.
ISA 43:22 Not now I called you, O Jacob, nor acted to tire you, O Israel.
ISA 43:23 You brought not to me of your sheep of your whole offering; nor in your sacrifices you glorified me. You were not enslaved in sacrifices, nor did you weary with frankincense.
ISA 43:24 Nor have you acquired for me a sacrifice of silver; nor the fat of your sacrifices I desired. But in your sins you stood in front of me, and in your iniquities.
ISA 43:25 I am, I am he, the one wiping away your lawless deeds because of me, and your sins in no way shall I remember.
ISA 43:26 But you, remember! And let us plead together! You tell of your lawless deeds first that you should be justified!
ISA 43:27 Your fathers first sinned, and your rulers acted lawlessly against me.
ISA 43:28 And the rulers defiled my holy things; and I gave Jacob up to be destroyed, and Israel for scorning.
ISA 44:1 But now hear, O Jacob, my child; and O Israel, whom I chose!
ISA 44:2 Thus says the LORD God, the one creating you, and shaping you from the belly. You shall still be helped. Fear not, O Jacob my servant; and the one being loved, Israel, whom I chose!
ISA 44:3 For I will give water for thirst to the ones going in a waterless place. I will place my spirit upon your seed, and my blessings upon your children.
ISA 44:4 And they shall rise up as grass in the midst of water, and as willows upon water flowing by.
ISA 44:5 This one shall say, I am of God, and this one shall call himself by the name Jacob. And another shall inscribe with his hand, I am of God, and shall call himself by the name Israel.
ISA 44:6 Thus says God, the king of Israel, and the one rescuing him - the God of hosts. I am first, and I am after these things; besides me there is not a God.
ISA 44:7 Who is as I? Let him stand, and call, and announce, and prepare for me from which time I made man into the eon! And the things coming before their coming to pass, let them announce to you!
ISA 44:8 Do not cover yourselves up, nor wander! Have you not from the beginning given ear, and I reported it to you? You are witnesses if there is a God besides me.
ISA 44:9 And they were not hearkening then, the ones shaping and carving all the vain idols, doing their wishes which do not benefit them. But they are their own witnesses. They shall not see, and they shall not know, that they should be ashamed - he who shapes mighty, and a carved molten casting for unprofitable things. Behold, all the ones partaking with him shall be ashamed -
ISA 44:10 the ones shaping a god, and all the ones carving unprofitable things.
ISA 44:11 And all from where they came from were dried up. Yes, let all the deaf-mutes of men be brought together, and let them stand together, and let them feel remorse, and let them be ashamed together!
ISA 44:12 For the fabricator sharpens the iron tool, and with a hammer he works it in coals, and with a drill he sets it, and works it with the arm of his strength. And he shall hunger and be weak, and in no way shall he drink water.
ISA 44:13 The fabricator having chosen a piece of wood sets it with a measure, and forms it with a scraper. He made it with a carpenter's square, and with glue he composes it. And he made it as the appearance of a man. And as a thing of beauty of man he sets it in a niche.
ISA 44:14 And in which he fells cedars for himself, then he takes the holm oak and the oak; and he strengthened for himself the tree from the grove which the LORD planted - a pine; and the rain lengthened it,
ISA 44:15 that it might be for men to burn. And taking of it he warms himself, and in burning they bake breads upon it; and with the remaining he works out gods, and does obeisance to them. He made it a carved idol, and he bends to them;
ISA 44:16 of which the half of it he incinerates in fire, and upon the half of it he ate meat - roasting he roasted a roast, and was filled up. And heating himself he said, It is agreeable to me, for I was heated, and I beheld a fire.
ISA 44:17 And the rest he makes into a carved god. He bends to it, and does obeisance, and prays to it, saying, Deliver me, for your are my god!
ISA 44:18 They do not know to think, for they were blurred to see with their eyes, and to comprehend with their heart.
ISA 44:19 And he considered not in his soul, nor knew by the intellect that the half of it he incinerated by fire, and baked breads upon its coals, and ate roasting meat; and that the rest of it he made into an abomination, and they do obeisance to it.
ISA 44:20 Know that their heart is ashes, and they err, and no one is able to rescue his soul! Behold! Shall you not say that, A lie is in my right hand?
ISA 44:21 Remember these things, O Jacob and Israel! For you are my servant; I shaped you to be my servant. And you, O Israel, do not forget me!
ISA 44:22 Behold, I wiped away your lawless deeds as a cloud, and your sin as dimness. Turn to me, and I shall ransom you!
ISA 44:23 Be glad, O heavens! For the God of Israel showed mercy. Trump, O foundations of the earth! Yell out, O mountains in gladness, O hills, and all the trees in them! For the LORD ransomed Jacob, and Israel shall be glorified.
ISA 44:24 Thus says the LORD, the one ransoming you, and the one shaping you from the belly, I am the LORD, the one completing all things. I stretched out the heaven alone, and solidified the earth.
ISA 44:25 Who other shall efface the signs of the ones who deliver oracles, and divinations from the heart; turning the intelligent ones unto the rear, and their counsel as being moronish;
ISA 44:26 and establishing the discourse of his servant, and verifying the counsel of his messengers. The one saying to Jerusalem, You shall be inhabited; and to the cities of Judea, You shall be built, and her desolate places I shall raise up.
ISA 44:27 The one saying to the deep, You shall be made desolate, and I will dry up your rivers.
ISA 44:28 The one telling Cyrus, Think, and all my wants he will do. The one saying to Jerusalem, You shall be built, and I shall lay the foundation of my holy house.
ISA 45:1 Thus says the LORD God to my anointed, Cyrus, whose right hand I held, for nations to heed before him; and the strength of kings I will tear up; I will open doors before him, and gates shall not be closed up.
ISA 45:2 I will go before you, and shall level mountains. I shall break the doors of brass, and shall break in pieces bars of iron.
ISA 45:3 And I shall give to you treasures - obscure, concealed, unseen. I will open to you that you should know that I am the LORD your God, the one calling your name, the God of Israel.
ISA 45:4 Because of my servant Jacob, and Israel my chosen, I shall call you by your name, and favorably receive you - but you did not know me.
ISA 45:5 For I am the LORD God, and there is not yet besides me - there is not a god. I strengthened you, and you knew me not;
ISA 45:6 that the ones from the east sun and the ones from the west should know that there is not one besides me. I am the LORD God, and there is not any more.
ISA 45:7 I am the one carefully preparing light, and I made darkness - the one making peace, and the one creating bad things. I am the LORD God doing all these things.
ISA 45:8 Let the heaven above be glad, and let the clouds sprinkle righteousness! Let the earth arise, and burst forth mercy! And let righteousness burst forth together! I am the LORD, the one creating you.
ISA 45:9 What made better mortar of a potter? Will the one plowing plow the earth the entire day? Will the mortar say to the potter, What do you do that you work not, nor have hands?
ISA 45:10 Woe the one saying to the father, Why shall you engender? and to the mother, Why shall you travail?
ISA 45:11 For thus says the LORD God, the holy one of Israel, the one making the coming things, Ask me concerning my sons, and concerning the works of my hands - shall you give charge to me!
ISA 45:12 I made the earth, and man upon it. I solidified the heaven by my hand. I gave charge to all the stars.
ISA 45:13 I raised him with righteousness as king, and all his ways are straight. This one shall build my city, and the captivity of my people he shall return - not by ransoms, nor by gifts, said the LORD of hosts.
ISA 45:14 Thus says the LORD of hosts, Egypt tired for you, and the trade of the Ethiopians and the Sabeans, haughty men shall pass over you, and will be your servants, and shall follow after you being tied in manacles, and shall pass over to you, and shall do obeisance to you, and shall pray to you, for God is among you, and there is not a God besides you.
ISA 45:15 For you are God, and we knew not - God of Israel, the deliverer.
ISA 45:16 All the ones being an adversary to him shall be ashamed and shall feel remorse; and they shall go in shame. Be dedicated to me, O islands.
ISA 45:17 Israel is delivered by the LORD with an eternal deliverance; they shall not be ashamed, nor should they feel remorse unto the eon still.
ISA 45:18 For thus says the LORD, the one making the heaven, this God, the one introducing the earth and making it; he separated it, he did not make it empty, but he shaped it to dwell in; I am the LORD, and there is not yet.
ISA 45:19 I have not spoken in secret, nor in a place of the earth that is dark. I told not to the seed of Jacob, Seek a vain thing! I am the LORD, the one speaking righteousness, and announcing truth.
ISA 45:20 Gather together and come! Consult together, O ones being delivered from the nations! the ones lifting their wood carving knew not, and the ones praying to a god which does not deliver.
ISA 45:21 The ones they shall announce. Let them approach that they should know together who audibly did these things! From the beginning from then it was announced to you. Am I not the LORD God? There is not another besides me - a just one and a deliverer. There is not one besides me.
ISA 45:22 Turn unto me, and you shall be delivered, O ones from the end of the earth! I am God, and there is not another.
ISA 45:23 According to myself I swear by an oath. Shall not righteousness scome forth from out of my mouth; my words shall not be perverted. For every knee shall bend to me, and every tongue shall swear by an oath by God,
ISA 45:24 saying, Righteousness and glory shall come to him; and all the ones of them being separated from the LORD shall be ashamed.
ISA 45:25 They shall be justified, and in God All the seed of the sons of Israel shall be glorified.

ISA 47:3 Your shame shall be uncovered; your scornings shall be shone forth; I will take the just one from you; no longer shall I deliver up to men.
ISA 47:4 The one rescuing you - the LORD of hosts is his name, the holy one of Israel.
ISA 47:5 Sit being vexed! Enter into the darkness, O daughter of the Chaldeans! No longer should you be called, the strength of a kingdom.
ISA 47:6 I was provoked by my people. You defiled my inheritance. I gave them into your hand, but you did not grant mercy to them. You oppressed the old man by the yoke exceedingly.
ISA 47:7 And you said, I will be ruling into the eon. You comprehended not these things in your heart, nor remembered the latter end.
ISA 47:8 But now, hear these things, O delicate one! the one sitting down, the one yielding, the one saying in her heart, I am, and there is not another; I shall not sit as a widow, nor shall I know bereavement.
ISA 47:9 But now these two things shall come upon you suddenly in one day - childlessness and widowhood. It shall come suddenly upon you in your sorcery, in the strength of your enchantments - exceedingly;
ISA 47:10 in the hope of your wickedness. For you said, I am, and there is not another. Know that the understanding of these things, and your harlotry will be shame to you! And you said in your heart, I am, and there is not another.
ISA 47:11 And destruction shall come upon you. And in no way shall you know a cesspool is there, and you shall fall into it. And misery shall come upon you, and in no way shall you be able to be clean. And destruction shall come upon you suddenly, and in no way shall you know.
ISA 47:12 Stand now with your enchantments, and in the abundance of your sorcery, which you learned from your youth - if you shall be able to derive benefit!
ISA 47:13 You are tired in your counsels. Let the astrologers of the heaven stand indeed and deliver you! Let the ones seeing the stars announce to you what is about to come upon you!
ISA 47:14 Behold, all are as sticks upon a fire, they shall be incinerated; and in no way shall they rescue their soul from out of the flame. For you shall have coals of fire to sit by them;
ISA 47:15 these shall be your help. You tired in the revolt from your youth. A man wanders by himself, but to you there will not be deliverance.

ISA 48:2 and ones holding to the name of the holy city, and taking support upon the God of Israel! The LORD of hosts is his name.
ISA 48:3 The former things again I announced, and from out of my mouth it came forth, and audibly it happened. Suddenly I did, and it came about.
ISA 48:4 I know that you are hardened, and your neck is a nerve of iron, and your forehead is as brass.
ISA 48:5 And I announced to you earlier what whould happen before it came upon you. Audibly to you I did it, lest at some time or other you should say that, My idols did. And you should say that, The carvings and the molten images gave charge to me!
ISA 48:6 You heard all, and you knew not. But even audibly I committed to you the new things from the present, which are about to take place, and you spoke not.
ISA 48:7 Now it takes place, and not earlier; and not in former days, and you heard them not. Lest you should say, Yes, I know them.
ISA 48:8 Neither you knew, nor were knowing of, nor from the beginning when I opened your ears; for I knew that in disregarding you shall disregard, and you would be called lawless even from out of the belly.

ISA 49:1 Hear, O islands! and take heed, O nations! Through a long time it shall be established, says the LORD. From out of the belly of my mother he called my name.
ISA 49:2 And he made my mouth as a sharp sword; and under the protection of his hand he hid me. He made me as a chosen arrow; and in his quiver he hid me.
ISA 49:3 And he said to me, You are my servant, O Israel, and in you I shall be glorified.
ISA 49:4 And I said, Uselessly I tired in vain, and for nothing I gave my strength. On account of this my judgment is from the LORD, and my toil before my God.
ISA 49:5 And now, thus says the LORD, the one shaping me from out of the belly, to be his own servant, to gather Jacob to him, Even Israel I shall have gathered, and I shall be glorified before the LORD, and my God will be my strength.
ISA 49:6 And he said, It is a great thing for you to be called my servant; to establish the tribes of Jacob, and to return the dispersion of Israel. Behold, I have given you for a covenant of a race, for a light of nations, for you to be for deliverance unto the end of the earth.
ISA 49:7 Thus says the LORD, the one rescuing you, the God of Israel, Sanctify the one treating his life as worthless; the one being abhorred by the nations of the servant of the rulers. ISA 49:15 Shall a woman forget her child, or to not show mercy on the progeny of her belly? But even if a woman might forget these things, I will not forget you, says the LORD.
ISA 49:16 Behold, upon my hands I portrayed your walls; and you are always before me.
ISA 49:17 And quickly you shall be built by whom you were demolished; and the ones making you desolate shall go forth from out of you.
ISA 49:18 Lift up round about your eyes, and perceive all! Behold, they were brought together, and they come to you. As I live, says the LORD, that, You shall clothe yourself with them all as an ornament, and you shall put them on as an ornament of a bride.

ISA 49:20 For your sons whom you have lost shall say in your ears, The place is too narrow for me - make for me a place that I shall dwell!
ISA 49:21 And you shall say in your heart, Who engendered to me these? For I am childless and a widow, a sojourner and excluded. But these, who nourished for me? For I was left alone. But these, from where were these to me?
ISA 49:22 Thus says the Lord, the LORD, Behold, I lift my hand unto the nations; and unto the islands I shall lift my agreed upon sign. And they shall lead your sons in the bosom; and they shall lift your daughters upon shoulders.
ISA 49:23 And kings shall be your wet-nurses, and their ruling women your nurses. They shall do obeisance to you upon the face of the earth, and the dust of your feet they shall lick. And you shall know that I am the LORD, and the ones waiting for me shall not be ashamed.
ISA 49:24 Will anyone take spoils from a giant? and if anyone should be captured unjustly, shall he be delivered?
ISA 49:25 For thus says the LORD, If any should capture a giant, he shall take the spoils. And the one taking from the one being strong, shall be delivered. But I will plead your case, and I will rescue your sons.

ISA 50:3 I shall clothe the heaven with darkness, and I shall make its wrap-around garment as sackcloth.
ISA 50:4 The Lord, the LORD gives to me a tongue of instruction, to know when it is necessary to speak a word. He stood me morning by morning. He added an ear for me to hear.
ISA 50:5 And the instruction of the LORD opens my ears, and I do not resist persuasion, nor do I dispute.
ISA 50:6 My back I have given to whips, and my jaws for slaps, and my face I turned not from the shame of ones spitting.
ISA 50:7 And the Lord, the LORD was a helper to me. On account of this I was not ashamed; but I set my face as a solid rock; and I knew that in no way should I be ashamed.

ISA 50:10 Who among you is the one fearing the LORD? Let him obey the voice of his servant! Let the ones going in darkness, and there is not light to them, yield upon the name of the LORD, and support yourselves upon God!
ISA 50:11 Behold, you all kindle a fire, and you strengthen the flame; you go to the light of your fire, and the flame which you kindled. On account of me these things came to pass to you; you shall remain the night in distress.

ISA 51:6 Lift up your eyes unto the heaven, and look unto the earth below! For the heaven is as smoke having been solidified, and the earth as a cloak shall be old.
