ISA 51:7 Hear me, O ones knowing equity - a people of whom my law is in their heart! Do not fear the scorning of men, and let their disparagement not vanquish you!
ISA 51:8 For as a garment that shall be eaten upon time, and as wool shall be eaten by a moth; but the righteousness of mine will be into the eon, and the deliverance of mine for generations of generations.
ISA 51:9 Awaken! Awaken, O Jerusalem, and put on the strength of your arm! Awaken as in the beginning of days, as a generation of an eon! Are not you the one being quarried in width, being torn up by a dragon?
ISA 51:10 Are you not the one making desolate the sea, the abundance of the deep water, the one having put the depths of the sea a way of a ford to the ones being rescued?
ISA 51:11 And the ones being ransomed - for by the LORD they shall be returned, and shall come unto Zion with gladness, and an everlasting leap for joy. For upon their head praise and gladness shall overtake them; grief and distress and moaning ran away.
ISA 51:12 I am, I am he, the one comforting you. Know who is being, that you should be fearful from mortal man, and from a son of man - the ones who as grass were dried up!
ISA 51:13 And you forgot God, the one making you, the one making the heaven, and laying the foundation for the earth. And fear continually all the days in front of the rage of the one afflicting you, in which manner he planned to carry you away! And now where is the rage of the one afflicting you?
ISA 51:14 For in your being delivered - he shall not stop nor pass time, and he shall not kill for hurt, and in no way shall he lack his bread.
ISA 51:15 For I am your God, the one disturbing the sea, and resounding its waves. The LORD of hosts is my name.
ISA 51:16 I will put my words into your mouth, and under the shadow of my hand I will shelter you, in which I established the heaven, and founded the earth. And he shall say to Zion, You are my people.
ISA 51:17 Awaken! Awaken! Rise up, O Jerusalem, the one drinking from the hand of the LORD the cup of his rage! For the cup of the blow, the drinking cup of rage, you drank and emptied out.
ISA 51:18 And there was not the one comforting you from all of your children whom you gave birth. And there was not the one taking hold of your hand, nor from all of your sons whom you raised.
ISA 51:19 Therefore these things are adverse to you. Who will grieve with you? A calamitous downfall, and defeat, hunger, and sword. Who will comfort you?
ISA 51:20 Your sons are the ones being perplexed, sleeping upon the top of all the streets, as a half-boiled beet full of the rage of the LORD, fainting from the LORD God.
ISA 51:21 On account of this, hear, O one being humbled, and O one being intoxicated not from wine!
ISA 51:22 Thus says the LORD God, the one judging his people, Behold, I took from out of your hand the cup of the blow, the drinking cup of my rage; and you shall not proceed to drink it any longer.
ISA 51:23 And I give it into the hand of the ones wronging you, and of the ones humbling you; which said to your soul, Bow, that we should go by! And you put the things in your midst equal to the ground outside to the ones coming near.
ISA 52:1 Awaken! Awaken, O Zion! Put on your strength, O Zion! And you, put on your glory, O Jerusalem, the holy city! No longer shall there proceed to go through you uncircumcised and unclean.
ISA 52:2 Shake off the dust and rise up! Sit, O Jerusalem! Take off the bond from your neck, O captive daughter of Zion!
ISA 52:3 For thus says the LORD, You were sold without charge, and you shall not be ransomed with silver.
ISA 52:4 For thus says the Lord, the LORD. To Egypt My people went down formerly to sojourn there, and were led into Assyria by force.
ISA 52:5 And now, why shall you be here? Thus says the LORD, Because my people were taken without charge - wonder and shriek! Thus says the LORD, On account of you, my name always is being blasphemed among the nations.
ISA 52:6 On account of this, my people shall know my name. On account of this in that day, (for I am he, the one speaking am at hand;
ISA 52:7 as an hour upon the mountains, as feet announcing good news, the hearing of peace; as of announcing good news - good things;) that audibly I will produce your deliverance, saying, Zion, Your God shall reign.
ISA 52:8 The voice of the ones guarding you is exalted, and with the voice together they shall be glad. For eyes to eyes shall see when ever the LORD should show mercy on Zion.
ISA 52:9 Let the desolate places of Jerusalem break asunder with gladness together! for the LORD showed mercy on her, and rescued Jerusalem.
ISA 52:10 And the LORD shall uncover his holy arm in the presence of all the nations. And all the uttermost parts of the earth shall see the deliverance by our God.
ISA 52:11 Leave! Leave! Go forth from there, and the unclean thing do not touch! Go forth from out of the midst of it! Separate yourselves, O ones bearing the vessels of the LORD!
ISA 52:12 For you shall not come forth with disturbance, nor shall you go forth in flight into exile. For the LORD shall go before prior of you; and the one assembling you is the God of Israel.
ISA 52:13 Behold, my servant shall perceive, and shall be exalted, and shall be glorified, and shall be raised up on high exceedingly.
ISA 52:14 In which manner many shall be amazed by you, so the sight of your appearance shall be despised by men, and your glory by the sons of men.
ISA 52:15 Thus many nations shall wonder over him; and kings shall hold their mouth. For ones to whom it was not announced concerning him shall see; and the ones who heard not shall perceive.
ISA 53:1 O LORD, who believed in our report? and the arm of the LORD, to whom was it uncovered?
ISA 53:2 We announced as of a male child before him, as a root in a land thirsting. There is not an appearance to him, nor glory; and we beheld him, and he has not appearance nor beauty.
ISA 53:3 But his appearance was without honor, and wanting by sons of men. A man being for calamity, and knowing how to bear infirmity. For he turned his face; he was dishonored, and not considered.
ISA 53:4 This one bore our sins, and on account of us he was grieved. And we considered him to be for misery, and for calamity by God, and for ill treatment.
ISA 53:5 But he was wounded because of our sins, and was made infirm on account of our lawless deeds. The discipline chastisement. for our peace was upon him; by his stripe we were healed.
ISA 53:6 We were all wandered as sheep. A man in his way was wandered, and the LORD delivered him up for our sins.
ISA 53:7 And he on account of being inflicted by evil, opened not his mouth. He was led as a sheep unto slaughter. And as a lamb before the one shearing is voiceless, so he opened not his mouth.
ISA 53:8 In the humiliation, in his equity, he was lifted away. Who shall describe his generation? for his life was lifted away from the earth. Because of the lawless deeds of my people he was led unto death.
ISA 53:9 And I shall give the wicked for his burial, and the rich for his death. For he did not commit lawlessness, nor was treachery in his mouth.
ISA 53:10 And the LORD willed to cleanse him of the beating. If you should offer for a sin offering the thing for your life, he shall see a long-lived seed.
ISA 53:11 And the LORD willed by his hand to remove misery of his soul, to show to him light, and to shape in the understanding; to justify a just one, a good one serving many - and he shall bear their sins.
ISA 53:12 On account of this he shall inherit many, and of the strong ones he will portion out spoils; because his soul was delivered up unto death; and he was considered among the lawless ones; and he himself bore the sins of many, and because of their lawless deeds he was delivered up.
ISA 54:1 Be glad, O sterile one, the one not giving birth! Break forth and yell, O one not travailing! For many are the children of the barren, rather than the one having the husband. For thus spoke the LORD.
ISA 54:2 Widen the place of your tent, and pitch the hide coverings of your curtains! You should spare not. Distance out your measured lands, and strengthen your tent pegs!
ISA 54:3 Spread forth yet unto the right and the left! for your seed shall inherit nations, and you shall dwell in cities having been made desolate.
ISA 54:4 You should not fear that you were disgraced, nor should you feel ashamed that you were berated. For you shall forget everlasting shame; and the scorn of your widowhood in no way shall you remember any longer.
ISA 54:5 For the LORD, the one making you, the LORD of hosts is his name; and the one rescuing you, he is the God of Israel. He shall be called God of all the earth.
ISA 54:6 Not as a forsaken and faint-hearted woman has the LORD called you; nor as a woman being detested from youth, said your God.
ISA 54:7 A little time I left you behind; and with great mercy I will show mercy on you.
ISA 54:8 In a little rage I turned my face from you; and in eternal mercy I will show mercy on you, said the one rescuing you - the LORD.
ISA 54:9 From the water of the one upon Noah, this is my plan, in so far as I swore by an oath to him in that time to the earth, to not be enraged against you any longer; nor by your intimidation.
ISA 54:10 Shall the mountains change over, and neither your hills shall be moved about; so not even mercy shown by me to you shall fail, and neither the covenant for your peace in any way shall change; for the LORD spoke kindness to you.
ISA 54:11 Humble and confused, you were not comforted. Behold, I prepare for you carbuncle for your stone, and for your foundations sapphire.
ISA 54:12 And I will make the parapets jasper, and your gates stones of crystal, and your enclosure of choice stones;
ISA 54:13 and all your sons instructed of God, and much peace to your children.
ISA 54:14 And you shall be built in righteousness, at a distance from the unjust. And you shall not be fearful, and trembling shall not approach to you.
ISA 54:15 Behold, converts shall come forward to you because of me, and they shall sojourn with you, and unto you they shall take refuge.
ISA 54:16 Behold, I created you, not as a brazier blowing in a fire of coals and bringing forth a utensil for work; but I created you, not for destruction to corrupt.
ISA 54:17 Every weapon concocted against you shall not be prosperous; and every voice that shall rise up against you for judgment - all of them you shall vanquish. And the ones liable of you shall be in her; it is the inheritance to the ones attending the LORD, and you shall be just ones to me, says the LORD.
ISA 55:1 Woe the ones thirsting. Go unto water! And as many as do not have money, proceeding, buy and eat! And go, and buy without money - even valuable wine and fatling!
ISA 55:2 What do you value for money not in breads, and your effort not unto fullness? Hearken to me, and you shall eat good things, and shall revel in good things to your soul!
ISA 55:3 Take heed with your ears, and follow after my ways! Listen to me, and you shall live with good things for your soul! And I shall ordain with you an eternal covenant - the sacred things of David, the trustworthy ones.
ISA 55:4 Behold, I made him a testimony to nations, a ruler and one assigning to nations.
ISA 55:5 Behold, nations which do not know you - they shall call upon you; and peoples which have not a knowledge of you - they shall take refuge upon you, because of the LORD your God, even the holy one of Israel - for he glorified you.
ISA 55:6 Seek the LORD! And in the finding call upon him whenever he should approach to you!
ISA 55:7 Let the impious one leave his ways, and the lawless man his plans! And let him return unto the LORD! And he shall be shown mercy, even from our God, for he will forgive your sins unto much.
ISA 55:8 For my plans are not as your plans; nor as your ways are my ways, says the LORD.
ISA 55:9 But as the distance the heaven is from the earth, so my way is at a distance from your ways, and your considerations from my mind.
ISA 55:10 For as whenever the rain or snow should come down from heaven, and in no way shall it return until whenever it should saturate the earth, and the earth should bring forth, and should sprout forth, and should give seed to the one sowing, and bread for food;
ISA 55:11 so shall it be with my word, which ever shall come forth from out of my mouth - in no way shall it return to me empty, until whenever it should finish as much as I wanted; and I will prosper your ways and my precepts.
ISA 55:12 For with gladness you shall go forth, and in joy you shall be led. For the mountains and the hills shall leap out favorably receiving you in joy, and all the trees of the field shall clap with their tender branches.
ISA 55:13 And instead of a pile, the cypress shall ascend. And instead of the briar the myrtle shall ascend. And the LORD will be for a name, and for an eternal sign, and it shall not cease.
ISA 56:1 Thus says the LORD, Guard equity, and do righteousness, for my deliverance is near to come, and my mercy to be uncovered!
ISA 56:2 Blessed is the man doing these things, and the man holding to them, and guarding the sabbaths, so as to not profane them, and observing his hands, so as to not do unjustly.
ISA 56:3 Let not the foreigner say, the one joining to the LORD! saying, By separation The LORD surely will separate me from his people. And let not the eunuch say that, I am a dry tree!
ISA 56:4 For thus says the LORD to the eunuchs, As many as should keep my sabbaths, and should choose what I want, and should hold to my covenant,
ISA 56:5 I will give to them in my house, and in my wall a famous place, better than sons and daughters. I will give to them an eternal name, and it shall not cease.
ISA 56:6 And to the foreigners joining to the LORD to serve him, and to love the name of the LORD, to be to him for menservants and maidservants, and all the ones keeping my sabbaths, to not profane, and ones holding to my covenant,
ISA 56:7 I will bring them unto my holy mountain, and will gladden them in my house of prayer. Their whole-burnt offerings and their sacrifices will be accepted upon my altar. For my house shall be called a house of prayer for all the nations,
ISA 56:8 said the LORD, the one gathering the ones having been dispersed of Israel. For I will gather unto him a congregation.
ISA 56:9 All wild beasts, come! Let all the wild beasts of the forest eat!
ISA 56:10 See how they all have been blinded - they knew not! All are dumb dogs, they shall not be able to bark; ones dreaming of a bed, being fond of slumber.
ISA 56:11 Yes, the impudent dogs not knowing fullness in the soul; and they are wicked, not knowing understanding; all followed after their own ways; each according to his own advantage from his uttermost, saying,
ISA 56:12 Come we should take wine and be drunk with wine to intoxication, and tomorrow shall be such as this day - great, rather exceedingly.
ISA 57:1 Behold how the just one perishes! and no one looks out for the heart. And just men are lifted away, and no one contemplates. For from the face of injustice the just one has been lifted away.
ISA 57:2 His burial will be in peace; he has been lifted from out of the midst.
ISA 57:3 But you lead forward here, O lawless sons, seed of adulterers, and of a harlot!
ISA 57:4 In what have you reveled in? and against whom have you opened your mouth? and against whom have you slackened your tongue? are you not children of destruction? a seed without honor?
ISA 57:5 the ones calling for aid upon the idols under bushy trees? ones slaying their children in the ravines between the rocks?
ISA 57:6 That is your portion, this is your lot. To those you poured out libations, and to these you offered sacrifices. Over these things then shall I not be provoked to anger?
ISA 57:7 Upon the high and elevated mountain, there is your bed, and there you hauled to sacrifice your sacrifices.
ISA 57:8 And behind the doorposts of your door you placed your memorials. Did you think that if you should separate from me you would have anything more. You loved the ones going to bed with you;
ISA 57:9 and you multiplied your harlotry with them; and you made many of them far from you. And you sent ambassadors over your borders; and you were abased unto Hades.
ISA 57:10 You tired in your many ways, yet you said not, I shall cease growing in strength. For you practiced these things. On account of this you did not earnestly beseech of me.
ISA 57:11 In venerating, whom were you afraid of, that you lied against me, and did not remember me, nor took me into your consideration, nor into your heart? And I beholding you will overlook; yet you did not fear me.
ISA 57:12 And I will report - your righteousness, and your evils shall not benefit you.
ISA 57:13 Whenever you should yell out, then let them rescue you in your affliction! For all these things the wind shall take, and the gale shall carry away. But the ones holding on in me shall acquire the earth, and they shall inherit my holy mountain.
ISA 57:14 And they shall say, Clear the ways from in front of him; and lift the impediments from the way of my people!
ISA 57:15 Thus says the highest, the one in the highest, dwelling the eon; holy in the holies; the name to him - the LORD; the one resting highest in the holies; and to the faint-hearted giving long-suffering, and giving life to the ones being broken in heart.
ISA 57:16 I shall not punish you into the eon, nor shall I be provoked to anger with you always; for a spirit from me shall go forth, and I made all breath.
ISA 57:17 On account of sin a little in anything I grieved him, and I struck him, and I turned my face from him; and I was grieved, and he went gloomy in his ways.
ISA 57:18 I have seen his ways, and I healed him, and comforted him, and gave to him true comfort.
ISA 57:19 Peace upon peace to the ones far off, and to the ones being near. And the LORD said, I will heal them.
ISA 57:20 But the unjust thus shall swell as waves, and I will not be able to rest.
ISA 57:21 There is not a rejoicing to the impious ones, said God.
ISA 58:1 Yell out in strength, and you should not spare! As a trumpet, raise up high your voice, and announce to my people their sins, and to the house of Jacob their lawless deeds!
ISA 58:2 They seek me day by day, and they desire to know my ways, as a people executing righteousness, and not abandoning judgment of their God. They ask me now for a just judgment, and they desire to approach to God,
ISA 58:3 saying, Why is it that we fasted, and you looked not? Why did we humble our souls, and you knew not? For in the days of your fasts you find the things of your wants, and all the ones under your hands you goad.
ISA 58:4 You fast for litigations and fights, and you beat the humble with your fists. Why do you fast to me as you do today? Is it for your voice to be heard in a cry?
ISA 58:5 I did not choose this fast, nor a day for a man to humble his soul; nor even should you bend your neck as a hook, nor should you spread under you sackcloth and ashes, nor thus shall you call an acceptable fast.
ISA 58:6 I choose not such a fast, says the LORD. But untie every bond of injustice! Part violent perverseness of exchanges! Send out by a free release the ones having been devastated, and tear apart every unjust writ!
ISA 58:7 Break your bread with ones hungering, and bring the homeless poor into your house! If you behold one naked, clothe him! And concerning the members of your family of your seed, you shall not disdain them.
ISA 58:8 Then your light shall be torn through the morning, and the things for your cures quickly shall arise; and your righteousness shall go before in front of you, and the glory of God shall screen you.
ISA 58:9 Then you shall yell, and the LORD shall hearken to you. Yet while you are speaking he shall say, Behold, I am at hand. If you remove from yourself conspiracy, and stretching forth of the hands, and grumbling discourse;
ISA 58:10 and should give to ones hungering the bread from your soul, and should fill up the soul being humble, then your light shall rise in the darkness, and your darkness shall be as midday.
ISA 58:11 And your God will be with you always, and you shall be filled up just as your soul desires. And your bones shall be fattened, and will be as a saturated garden, and as a spring which water failed not.
ISA 58:12 And the everlasting desolate places shall be built to you, and your everlasting foundations will be in generations of generations; and you shall be called a builder of barriers. And the stones in the midst of your roads shall cease.
ISA 58:13 If you should turn your foot from the sabbaths, to not do your wants on the holy day, and shall call the sabbaths delightful, holy to your God, then you shall not lift your foot to work, nor shall you speak a word in anger from out of your mouth.
ISA 58:14 Then shall you be relying upon the LORD, and he will bring the good things upon your land, and he will feed you the inheritance of Jacob your father. For the mouth of the LORD spoke these things.
ISA 59:1 Is not the hand of the LORD strong to deliver? or his ear weighed down to not listen?
ISA 59:2 But your sins make a part between you and God; and on account of your sins he turned his face from you, to not show mercy.
ISA 59:3 For your hands are tainted with blood, and your fingers with sins; and your lips spoke lawlessness, and your tongue meditated upon injustice.
ISA 59:4 No one speaks just things, nor is there true equity. They rely upon vanities, and they speak empty things; for they sire misery and give birth to lawlessness.
ISA 59:5 They hatch eggs of asps, and weave of a spider a web. And the one about to eat their eggs, breaking a rotten egg, found also in it a cobra.
ISA 59:6 Their web shall not be made into a garment, nor shall they clothe themselves from their works; for their works are works of lawlessness.
ISA 59:7 And their feet run unto wickedness, quick to pour out blood; and their thoughts are thoughts of murder. Destruction and misery are in their ways.
ISA 59:8 And the way of peace they know not, and there is not equity in their ways. For their roads which they travel through are perverted, and they know not peace.
ISA 59:9 On account of this equity left from them, and in no way shall righteousness overtake them. In their waiting light, darkness came to them; waiting for daylight, they walked in midnight.
ISA 59:10 They shall grope as blind men for a wall, and they shall grope as ones not possessing eyes. They shall fall in midday as at midnight; they shall moan as ones dying.
ISA 59:11 As a bear, and as a dove, together they shall go. We awaited judgment, and there is not a deliverance; it is removed far from us.
ISA 59:12 For our lawlessness is great before you, and our sins withstood us. For our lawless deeds are in us, and our offences we knew.
ISA 59:13 We were impious, and lied, and departed from our God. We spoke unjustly, and we resisted persuasion. We sired, and meditated unjust words from our heart.
ISA 59:14 And we left behind equity, and righteousness removed far off. For the truth was consumed in their ways, and they were not able to go by a straight way.
ISA 59:15 And the truth was lifted away, and they changed their thought of perceiving. And the LORD beheld, and it did not please him, for there was not equity.
ISA 59:16 And he beheld, and there was not a man. And he contemplated, and there was not the one assisting. And he defended them by his arm; and with charity he supported them.
ISA 59:17 And he clothed himself with righteousness as a chest plate, and put a helmet of deliverance upon his head, and put around himself a cloak of vengeance - even a wrap-around garment,
ISA 59:18 as one recompensing a reward of scorn to the adversaries.
ISA 59:19 And the ones from the west shall fear the name of the LORD; and the ones from the east sun shall fear the honorable name. For the anger of the LORD shall come as a violent river; it shall come with rage.
ISA 59:20 And the one rescuing shall come from Zion, and shall turn impiety from Jacob.

ISA 60:20 For the sun shall not go down to you, and the moon shall not subside to you. For the LORD will be to you an eternal light. And the days of your mourning shall be fulfilled.
ISA 60:21 And your people are all just, and they shall inherit the earth through the eon, keeping the thing planted, even the works of their hands for glory.
ISA 60:22 The very few will be for thousands, and the least for a great nation. I the LORD according to time shall gather them.

ISA 62:4 And no longer shall you be called - One Being Forsaken. And your land shall not be called - Desolation. For you shall be called - My will, and your land - Being Lived In. For the LORD took pleasure in you, and your land shall be lived in together.

ISA 62:9 But only ones gathering shall eat them, and shall praise the LORD; and the ones gathering shall drink them in my holy properties.
ISA 62:10 Go through my gates, and open a way for my people! And the stones of the ones from the way scatter away! Lift the agreed upon sign unto the nations!
ISA 62:11 For behold, the LORD made it audible unto the end of the earth. Say to the daughter of Zion, Behold, the deliverer is come to you, having his own wage with him, and his work before his face!
ISA 62:12 And he shall call them, Holy People Being ransomed By The LORD. But you shall be called, A City Being Anxiously Sought After, and not Being Abandoned.
ISA 63:1 Who is this coming from out of Edom, with garments dyed red from out of Bozrah? This one beautiful in his apparel, with a mighty force? I reason righteousness, and the case of deliverance.
ISA 63:2 Why are your clothes red, and your garments as from a trampled wine vat,
ISA 63:3 full of that being trampled? And of the nations there is not a man with me. And I trampled them in my rage, and I broke them in pieces as ground, and led their blood unto the ground, and all my garments I defiled.
ISA 63:4 For a day of recompense came upon them, and a year of ransoming is at hand.
ISA 63:5 And I looked, and there was not a helper. And I paid attention, and no one assisted. And my arm rescued them, and my rage attended to it.
ISA 63:6 And I trampled them in my anger, and I led down their blood unto the ground.
ISA 63:7 I remembered the mercy of the LORD; the virtues of the LORD in all which he recompenses to us. The LORD - a good judge to the house of Israel; he brings upon us according to his mercy, and according to the magnitude of his righteousness.
ISA 63:8 And he said, Children in no way will disrespect my people. And he became to them for deliverance,
ISA 63:9 from out of all their affliction. Not an ambassador, nor an angel, but he, the LORD delivered them, because of loving them. And he spared them - he ransomed them, and he took them, and raised them all the days of the eon.
ISA 63:10 But they resisted persuasion, and provoked his holy spirit. And the LORD turned against them for enmity; he waged war against them.
ISA 63:11 And he remembered everlasting days; the bringing up from the land the shepherd of the sheep. Where is the one having put the holy spirit in them?
ISA 63:12 the one leading Moses by the right hand, the one being the arm of his glory? He prevailed over water in front of him; he made for himself an everlasting name.
ISA 63:13 He led them through the deep, as a horse through a wilderness, and they tired not.
ISA 63:14 And as cattle led through a plain, spirit of the LORD descended, and guided them. Thus you led your people, to make for yourself a glorious name.
ISA 63:15 Turn from the heaven, and look from your holy house and of your glory! Where is your zeal and your strength? Where is the abundance of your mercy and your compassions, that you withheld from us?
ISA 63:16 For you are our father. For Abraham did not know us, and Israel did not recognize us. But you, O LORD our father, rescue us! From the beginning your name is upon us.
ISA 63:17 Why did you wander us, O LORD, from your way? You hardened our hearts to not fear you? Return on account of your servants, on account of the tribes of your inheritance,
ISA 63:18 that we should inherit a little of your holy mountain! Our adversaries trampled your sanctuary.
ISA 63:19 We became as from the beginning when you did not rule us, nor was your name called upon us.
ISA 64:1 If you should open the heaven, mountains shall take trembling from you, and they shall melt away;
ISA 64:2 as beeswax from fire shall melt away. And fire shall incinerate the adversaries, and your name will be for distinction among the adversaries. From in front of you nations shall be disturbed.
ISA 64:3 Whenever you should do the honorable things, trembling shall take hold of mountains.
ISA 64:4 From the eon we heard not, nor our eyes beheld a God besides you, and your works which you shall do to the ones waiting for mercy.
ISA 64:5 For he shall meet with the ones doing the just thing, and your ways shall be remembered. Behold, you have been provoked to anger, and we sinned; on account of this we were wandered.
ISA 64:6 And we all became as unclean. All our righteousness is as a menstrual rag sitting apart; and we flowed away as leaves; on account of our lawless deeds thus the wind shall bear us away.
ISA 64:7 And there is not one calling upon your name, nor one remembering to take hold of you. For you turned your face from us, and you delivered us up because of our sins.
ISA 64:8 And now, O LORD, you are our father, and we are mortar; we are all works of your hands.
ISA 64:9 You should not be provoked to anger with us very much, and our sins should not be remembered for a long time. And now, look upon us, O LORD, for we are all your people!
ISA 64:10 The city of your holiness became desolate. Zion became as desolate. Jerusalem for a curse.
ISA 64:11 The house our holy place, and the glory which our fathers blessed, became scorched; and all our honorable things are cast down.
ISA 64:12 And over all these things you endured, O LORD, and kept silent, and humbled us very much.
ISA 65:1 I became apparent to the ones not seeking for me; I was found by the ones not asking me. I said, Behold, I am - to the nation, the ones who did not call my name.
ISA 65:2 I spread forth my hands the entire day to a people resisting persuasion and disputing; the ones not having gone the good way, but after their sins.
ISA 65:3 This people provoking me is always before me. They sacrifice in the gardens, and they burn incense upon the bricks to the demons which are not.
ISA 65:4 And in the tombs in the caves they sleep for the sake of dreams; the ones eating meat of a pig, and by broth of sacrifices all their vessels are tainted.
ISA 65:5 The ones saying, Be at a distance from me, you should not approach me, for I am clean. This is the smoke of my rage - a fire burns with it all the days.
ISA 65:6 Behold, it is written in my presence; I shall not keep silent, until whenever I recompense. And I will recompense unto their bosom
ISA 65:7 their sins, and the ones of their fathers, says the LORD, the ones that burnt incense upon the mountains, and berated me upon the hills. I will recompense their works into their bosom.
ISA 65:8 Thus says the LORD, In which manner the grape-stone shall be found in the cluster of grapes, and they shall say, You should not lay it waste, for there is a blessing in it; so I will do because of the ones serving me - because of this one in no way shall I destroy all.
ISA 65:9 And I shall lead out the one of the seed of Jacob, and the one of Judah, and he shall inherit my holy mountain. And my chosen and my servants shall inherit it, and they shall dwell there.
ISA 65:10 And there shall be in the grove folds of flocks; and the ravine of Achor for a resting place of herds to my people, who sought me.
ISA 65:11 But you are the ones having abandoned me, and having forgotten my holy mountain, and are preparing a table to the demon, and filling a mixture to good luck Tyche, the goddess of fortune..
ISA 65:12 I will deliver you unto the sword - you shall all fall by slaughter; for I called you, and you hearkened not; I spoke, and you disregarded; and you did the wicked thing before me, and what I did not want you chose.
ISA 65:13 On account of this, Thus says the LORD, Behold, the ones serving to me shall eat, but you shall hunger. Behold, my servants shall drink, but you shall thirst. Behold, the ones serving me shall be glad, but you shall be ashamed.
ISA 65:14 Behold, the ones serving me shall exult in gladness, but you shall cry out because of the misery of your heart; and from the destruction of your spirit you shall shriek.
ISA 65:15 For you shall leave behind your name for a glut to my chosen, and the LORD shall do away with you. But to the ones that serve to me, they shall be called by a new name,
ISA 65:16 which shall be blessed upon the earth. For they shall bless the true God. And the ones swearing by an oath upon the earth, shall swear by an oath on the true God. For they shall forget their first affliction, and it shall not ascend unto their heart.
ISA 65:17 For there will be the new heaven, and the new earth. And in no way shall they remember the former things, nor in any way shall it come upon their heart.
ISA 65:18 But they shall find in her gladness and a leap for joy. For behold, I make Jerusalem a leap for joy, and over my people for gladness.
ISA 65:19 And I shall exult over Jerusalem, and shall be glad over my people. And no longer shall there be heard in her a voice of weeping, nor a voice of crying;
ISA 65:20 nor in any way shall there be yet an untimely miscarriage, nor an old man who shall not fill up his time. For the young man will be a hundred years old, and the sinner will be accursed dying at a hundred years old.
ISA 65:21 And they shall build residences, and they shall dwell in them. And they shall plant vineyards, and they shall eat their produce, and shall drink the wine.
ISA 65:22 In no way shall they build, and another dwell therein; and in no way shall they plant, and another eat of it. For according to the days of the life of a tree will be the days of my people, for the works of their hands shall grow old.
ISA 65:23 And my chosen shall not tire in empty things, nor shall they produce children for a curse; for it is a seed being blessed by God, and their progeny with them.
ISA 65:24 And it will be before their crying out, I will hearken unto them; yet during their speaking I will say, What is it?
ISA 65:25 Then wolves and lambs shall graze together; and the lion shall eat straw as an ox; and the serpent shall eat of the earth as bread; they shall not do wrong nor lay waste upon my holy mountain, says the LORD.
ISA 66:1 Thus says the LORD, The heaven is my throne, and the earth a footstool for my feet. What kind of house shall you build to me? and what kind of place for my rest?
ISA 66:2 For all these things I made by my hand, and all these are mine, says the LORD. And upon whom shall I look upon? but only upon the humble and unassuming, and the one trembling at my words.
ISA 66:3 But the lawless one, the one sacrificing a calf to me is as the one striking a man; and the one sacrificing of the flock is as the one killing a dog; and the one offering fine flour is as the one offering the blood of a pig; the one offering frankincense for a memorial is as blasphemous. And they chose their ways, and their abominations which their soul wanted.
ISA 66:4 And I will choose their mockeries, and I will recompense their sins against them; for I called them, and they hearkened not to me; I spoke and they heard not; and they acted wickedly before me, and chose that which I wanted not.
ISA 66:5 Hear the word of the LORD, O ones trembling at his word! Let your brothers speak to the ones detesting you, and abhorring you, that the name of the LORD should be glorified, and should be seen in their gladness, but those shall be ashamed.
ISA 66:6 A voice of a cry from out of the city; a voice from out of the temple; the voice of the LORD recompensing a recompense to the adversaries.
ISA 66:7 Before her travailing to give birth, before the coming of the misery of the pangs, she fled, and gave birth to a male.
ISA 66:8 Who heard such? and who has seen thus? Has the earth travailed in one day? or even a nation given birth at once, that Zion travailed and gave birth to her children?
ISA 66:9 But I gave this expectation, and you did not remember me, said the LORD. And behold, I made the one bearing and the one sterile, said your God.
ISA 66:10 Be glad, O Jerusalem, and let all the ones loving her assemble for a festival in her! And the ones dwelling her rejoice in joy, all as many as mourn for her!
ISA 66:11 that you should nurse and be filled up from the breast of her comfort; that sucking out, you should indulge at the introduction of her glory.
ISA 66:12 For thus says the LORD, Behold, I turn aside to them as a river of peace, and as a rushing stream inundating the glory of the nations. Their children shall be carried upon shoulders, and shall be comforted upon knees.
ISA 66:13 As if any mother shall comfort, so also I shall comfort you; and in Jerusalem you shall be comforted.
ISA 66:14 And you shall see, and your heart shall rejoice, and your bones shall rise up as pasturage; and the hand of the LORD shall be known to the ones fearing him, and he shall threaten the ones resisting persuasion.
ISA 66:15 For behold the LORD shall come as a fire, even as a blast by his chariots, to recompense punishment in rage, and being contemptuously rejected in a flame of fire.
ISA 66:16 For by the fire of the LORD all the earth shall be judged, and by his broadsword all flesh. Many shall be slain by the LORD.
ISA 66:17 The ones purifying themselves and cleansing themselves in the gardens, and the ones eating the meat of a pig and the abominations and the mouse in the thresholds, together shall be consumed, said the LORD.
ISA 66:18 And I know their works and their device. And I come to bring together all the nations, and the languages. And they shall come, and shall see my glory.
ISA 66:19 And I will leave upon them a sign. And I will send out from them ones having been delivered unto the nations - unto Tarshish, and Pul, and Lud, and Meshach, and Tubal, and unto Greece, and unto the islands - the ones at a distance, the ones who heard not of my name, nor have seen my glory. And they shall announce my glory among the nations.
ISA 66:20 And they shall lead your brothers from out of all the nations, as a gift to the LORD, with horses, and chariots - in royal chariots drawn by mules with awnings, into the holy city Jerusalem. And the LORD said, As the sons of Israel may offer their sacrifices to me with psalms in the house of the LORD,
ISA 66:21 that from them I will take priests and Levites, said the LORD.
ISA 66:22 For in which manner the new heaven and the new earth, which I make wait before me, says the LORD, so I shall establish your seed, and your name.
ISA 66:23 And it will be month by month, and sabbath by sabbath, all flesh shall come to do obeisance before me in Jerusalem, said the LORD.
ISA 66:24 And they shall go forth, and shall see the carcasses of the men violating against me. For their worm shall not come to an end, and their fire shall not be extinguished. And they will be for a sight to all flesh.
JER 1:1 The saying of God which came unto Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, of the priests who dwelt in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin.
JER 1:2 As the word of God came to him in the days of Josiah son of Amon king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his kingship.
JER 1:3 And it took place in the days of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, until the eleventh year of Zedekiah son of Josiah king of Judah, until the captivity of Jerusalem in the fifth month.
JER 1:4 And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
JER 1:5 Before my shaping you in the belly I knew you; and before your coming forth from out of the womb I sanctified you; I appointed you prophet unto nations.
JER 1:6 And I said, O Being One, Master, O LORD, behold, I know not how to speak, for I am younger.
JER 1:7 And the LORD said to me, Do not say that! I am younger. For to all whom ever I should send you, you shall go; and according to all as much as I should give charge to you, you shall speak.
JER 1:8 You should not be fearful from in front of them, for I am with you, to rescue you, says the LORD.
JER 1:9 And the LORD stretched his hand to me, and touched my mouth. And the LORD said to me, Behold, I have placed my words in your mouth.
JER 1:10 Behold, I have ordained you today over nations, and over kingdoms, to root out, and to raze, and to loosen, and to rebuild, and to plant.
JER 1:11 And came to pass the word of the LORD to me, saying, What do you see, Jeremiah? And I said, A walnut staff.
JER 1:12 And the LORD said to me, You have seen well; for I am vigilant over my words to do them.
JER 1:13 And the word of the LORD came to pass of a second time to me, saying, What do you see? And I said, A kettle being fired up, and the face of it towards the face of the north.
JER 1:14 And the LORD said to me, From the face of the north shall burn away the evils upon all the ones dwelling in the land.
JER 1:15 For behold, I call together all the kingdoms from the north, says the LORD; and they shall come, and each shall put his throne upon the thresholds of the gates of Jerusalem, and upon all the walls round about, and upon all the cities of Judah.
JER 1:16 And I shall speak to them with judgment concerning all their evil, as they abandoned me, and they sacrificed to strange gods, and did obeisance to the works of their hands.
JER 1:17 And you, gird your loin and rise up, and speak to them all as much as I should give charge to you! You should not be fearful from in front of them, nor should you be terrified before them, for I am with you to rescue you, says the LORD.
JER 1:18 Behold, I have made you in today's day as a fortified city, and as a fortified wall of brass all together against the kings of Judah, and its rulers, and to the people of the land.
JER 1:19 And they shall wage war against you; but in no way shall they be able to prevail against you, for I am with you to rescue you, said the LORD.
JER 2:1 And came to pass the word of the LORD to me, saying,
JER 2:2 Go, and yell into the ears of Jerusalem! saying, Thus says the LORD, I remembered the mercy of your youth, and the love of your consecration, for you to follow after the holy one of Israel, says the LORD;
JER 2:3 Holy Israel to the LORD, the beginning of his offspring. All the ones devouring him shall offend; evils shall come upon them, says the LORD.
JER 2:4 Hear the word of the LORD, O house of Jacob, and every family of the house of Israel!
JER 2:5 Thus says the LORD, What trespass did your fathers find in me that they left far from me, and went after the vain things, and acted in folly?
JER 2:6 And they said not, Where is the LORD, the one directing us from out of the land of Egypt, the one steering us in the wilderness, in a vast and untrodden land, in a land waterless and unfruitful, in a land in which a man traveled not through in it, and a man dwelt there not?
JER 2:7 And I brought you into Carmel, to eat the fruits of it, and the good things of it. And you entered, and defiled my land; and my inheritance you made into an abomination.
JER 2:8 The priests said not, Where is the LORD? And the ones holding to the law have not made acknowledgment to me; and the shepherds were impious to me; and the prophets prophesied by Baal, and they went after unprofitable things.
JER 2:9 On account of this, still I will arbitrate for you, says the LORD; and for the sons of your sons I will arbitrate.
JER 2:10 For go into the islands of the Chittim, and see! And send unto Kedar, and comprehend exceedingly! And see if such things have taken place,
JER 2:11 if nations changed their gods, and these are not gods! But my people changed their glory by which they do not derive benefit.
JER 2:12 The heaven is amazed by this, and shuddered over it much, exceedingly, says the LORD.
JER 2:13 For two and wicked things my people did to me; they abandoned the spring of water of life, and they dug for themselves cisterns having been broken which are not able to hold water.
JER 2:14 Is Israel a servant or is he native-born? Why did he become for plunder?
JER 2:15 Upon him the lions roar, and the ones who ordered his land for extinction gave out their voice. And his cities they razed so as for no one to dwell.
JER 2:16 And the sons of Memphis and Tahapanhes knew you, and were mocking you.
JER 2:17 Were not these things done to you for your forsaking me, says the LORD your God?
JER 2:18 And now, what is it to you and the way of Egypt, to drink the water of Sihor? And what is it to you in the way of the Assyrians, to drink water of the rivers?
JER 2:19 Your defection shall correct you, and your evil shall reprove you. And know and see that your forsaking me is bitter to you! says the LORD your God. And I thought not well in you, says the LORD your God.
JER 2:20 For from the eon you broke your yoke, and tore up your bonds. And you said, I will not serve, but I will go upon every high hill, and underneath every shady tree; there I will disperse in my harlotry.
JER 2:21 But I planted you a grapevine bearing fruit - all true. How are you turned into bitterness - a strange grapevine?
JER 2:22 If you should wash in bleach, and should multiply soap to yourself, still you are spotted in your iniquities before me, says the LORD.
JER 2:23 How will you say, I was not defiled, and I went not after Baal? Behold your ways in the cemetery, and know what you did! Her voice shrieks in the evening.
JER 2:24 Her ways widen over waters of the wilderness; in the desires of her soul she was being carried by the wind; she was delivered up to them; who will turn her? All the ones seeking her shall not tire; in her humiliation they shall find her.
JER 2:25 Turn your foot from the rough way, and your throat from thirst! But she said, I will be manly. For I loved strangers, and went after them.
JER 2:26 As shame of a thief whenever he should be captured, so shall the sons of Israel be ashamed; they, and their kings, and their rulers, and their priests, and their prophets.
JER 2:27 They said to the tree that, You are my father; and to the stone, You engendered me. And they turned their backs against me, and not their faces. And in the time of their evils they shall say, Rise up and deliver us!
JER 2:28 And where are your gods which you made for yourself? Shall they rise up and deliver you in the time of your ill-treatment? For according to the number of your cities were your gods, O Judah; and according to the number of the corridors of Jerusalem, they sacrificed to Baal.
JER 2:29 Why do you speak to me? You all acted impious, and you all acted lawlessly against me, says the LORD.
JER 2:30 In vain I struck your children. They received not correction. A sword devoured your prophets, as a lion annihilating, and you feared not.
JER 2:31 Hear the word of the LORD! Thus says the LORD, Did I become a wilderness to Israel, or a land being made barren? Why said my people, We will not be lorded over, and We shall not come to you any longer?
JER 2:32 Will the bride forget her bridal ornament, and the virgin her breastband? But my people forgot me for days which there is not a number.
JER 2:33 What good device will you yet apply in your ways to seek affection? It will not be thus. But even you did wicked to defile your ways.
JER 2:34 And in your hands was found blood of innocent souls. I found them not in ditches, but upon every oak.
JER 2:35 And you said, I am innocent, so turn his rage from me! Behold, I judge against you, in your saying, I sinned not.
JER 2:36 For you are disdained very much of the repeating a second time of your ways. And from Egypt you shall be disgraced, as you were disgraced by Assyria.
JER 2:37 For even from here you shall go forth, and your hands will be upon your head. For the LORD thrusted away your hope, and you shall not be prosperous in it.
JER 3:1 If a husband should send away his wife, and she should go forth from him, and becomes to another man, shall by returning she return to him yet again? Shall not by defiling that woman be defiled? But you fornicated with many shepherds, and you have returned to me, says the LORD.
JER 3:2 Lift your eyes unto the upright way, and see where you have not been defiled! You have sat upon the ways for them as a crowbar having been made desolate, and defiled the land in your harlotries, and in your evils.
JER 3:3 And you had many shepherds for your occasion for stumbling; the appearance of a harlot became to you; you cast shame to all.
JER 3:4 Was it not until now you called me even, Father? and, Head of your virginity?
JER 3:5 Shall it abide into the eon, or shall it be guarded for victory? Behold, you spoke and did these evils, and have prevailed.
JER 3:6 And the LORD said to me in the days of Josiah the king, You saw what the house of Israel did to me. She went upon every high mountain, and underneath every tree of the woods, and committed harlotry there.
JER 3:7 And I said after her committing harlotry all these things, Turn to me! And she turned not. And the Judah covenant-breaker saw her breach-of-contract.
JER 3:8 And I beheld, (for on account of all of which she was overtaken by them the house of Israel committed adultery, and I sent her out and gave to her a scroll certificate of divorce into her hands,) that the covenant-breaker Judah feared not, and went and committed harlotry even herself.
JER 3:9 And her harlotry was nothing to her; and she committed adultery with the wood and the stone.
JER 3:10 And in all these things the covenant-breaker Judah turned not to me with her whole heart, but with a lie.
JER 3:11 And the LORD said to me, Israel justified her soul above the covenant-breaker Judah.
JER 3:12 Go and read these words towards the north! And you shall say, Be returned to me, O house of Israel, says the LORD! And in no way shall I firmly fix my face against you. For I am merciful, says the LORD, and I shall not be infuriated with you into the eon.
JER 3:13 Only know your iniquity! For it is against the LORD your God you acted impious, and dispersed your ways unto strangers underneath every tree of the woods; but my voice you obeyed not, says the LORD.
JER 3:14 Return, O revolting sons, says the LORD! For I shall lord over you, and shall take you - one from out of a city, and two from out of a family; and I will bring you into Zion.
JER 3:15 And I will appoint to you shepherds according to my heart, and they shall tend you, tending with higher knowledge.
JER 3:16 And it will be if you should be multiplied, and should grow upon the land, says the LORD, in those days, they shall not say any more, Ark of the covenant of holy Israel. It shall not ascend upon the heart, nor be named, nor shall it be examined, and it shall not be done any more.
JER 3:17 In those days, and in that time they shall call Jerusalem, The throne of the LORD; and shall be brought together unto her all the nations; and they shall not go any more after the wicked thoughts of their heart.
JER 3:18 In those days the house of Judah shall come together with the house of Israel. And they shall come together from the land of the north, and from all the places upon the earth which I caused their fathers to inherit.
JER 3:19 And I said, May it be, O LORD, for you said, I shall arrange you among children, and I shall give to you a choice land ( the inheritance of God almighty) of nations. And I said, you shall call me father; and you shall not be turned from me.
JER 3:20 Only as a wife annuls against the one being with her, so the house of Israel annulled against me, says the LORD.
JER 3:21 A voice from the lips was heard of weeping and supplication of the sons of Israel. For they transgressed in their ways; they forgot God their holy one.
JER 3:22 Turn, O turning sons, and I shall heal your brokenness! Behold, thus we shall be to you, for you are the LORD our God.
JER 3:23 Really the hills and the powers of the mountains were for a lie. Only through the LORD our God is the deliverance of Israel.
JER 3:24 But the shame consumed the efforts of our fathers from our youth; their sheep and their calves, their sons and their daughters.
JER 3:25 We were gone to bed in our shame, and our dishonor covered us. For before our God we and our fathers sinned from our youth until this day, and we hearkened not of the voice of the LORD our God.
JER 4:1 If Israel should return, says the LORD, to me - he shall be returned. And if he should remove his abominations from his mouth, and should show reverence from in front of me,
JER 4:2 and should swear by an oath, The LORD lives, with truth in equity and in righteousness; then they shall bless nations by him, and in him they shall give praise to God in Jerusalem.
JER 4:3 For thus says the LORD to the men of Judah, and to the ones dwelling in Jerusalem, Plow to yourselves fields prepared for plowing! And you should not sow among thorn-bushes.
JER 4:4 Circumcise yourselves to your God, and circumcise the hardness of your heart, O men of Judah, and O ones dwelling in Jerusalem! Lest my rage should go forth as fire, and shall be kindled, and there will not be one extinguishing from in front of the wickednesses of your practices.
JER 4:5 Announce in Judah, and hearken in Jerusalem! Say, Signify with a trumpet unto the land! Cry out great! Say, be gathered together! and, We should enter into the walled cities.
JER 4:6 In taking up your things, flee unto Zion! Hasten, do not stand! For I bring evils from the north, and great destruction.
JER 4:7 The lion ascended from out of his lair, utterly destroying nations; he lifted away and came forth from out of his place to make the earth for desolation; and your cities shall be demolished, so as to not dwell them.
JER 4:8 Concerning these things gird yourselves with sackcloths, and lament, and shout, for the rage of the anger of the LORD shall not be turned from you!
JER 4:9 And it will be in that day, says the LORD, the heart of the king shall perish, and the heart of the rulers; and the priests shall be amazed, and the prophets shall wonder.
JER 4:10 And I said, O master, O LORD, Surely indeed in beguiling you beguiled this people, and Jerusalem, saying, Peace will be to you; whereas the sword shall touch unto their soul.
JER 4:11 In that time they shall say to this people, and to Jerusalem, There is a spirit of addiction to a delusion in the wilderness. The way of the daughter of my people is not to purity, nor to holiness.
JER 4:12 A spirit of fullness shall come to me; but now I shall speak my judgments against them.
JER 4:13 Behold, as a cloud he shall ascend, and his chariots as a blast. Lighter than eagles are his horses. Woe to us, for we are in misery.
JER 4:14 Wash your heart from evils, O Jerusalem, that you should be delivered! For how long shall the devices of your miseries exist in you?
JER 4:15 For a voice of one announcing from out of Dan shall come; and the misery from out of mount Ephraim shall be heard.
JER 4:16 Remind nations! Behold, announce in Jerusalem! Confederacies are come from out of a land far off, and they uttered their voices against the cities of Judah.
JER 4:17 As ones guarding a field they have come upon her round about; for you neglected me, says the LORD.
JER 4:18 Your ways and your practices did these things to you; this is your evil, for it is bitter, for it touched unto your heart.
JER 4:19 My belly, my belly aches, and the senses of my heart. My soul is irresistibly led. My heart is being thrown into a spasm. I shall not keep silent, for my soul heard the sound of a trumpet - a cry of war,
JER 4:20 and of misery. Conflict is being called upon, for all the land is in misery suddenly. The tent languishes; my hide coverings have been pulled apart.
JER 4:21 For how long shall I see ones fleeing, hearing the sound of a trumpet?
JER 4:22 For the ones leading of my people know me not; they are foolish sons, and not discerning; they are wise ones to do evil, but the doing good they have not recognized.
JER 4:23 I looked upon the earth, and behold - nothing; and into the heaven, and its lights were not.
JER 4:24 I beheld the mountains, and there was trembling, and all the hills were being disturbed.
JER 4:25 I looked, and behold, a man existed not, and all the birds of the heaven were terrified.
JER 4:26 I beheld, and behold, Carmel was desolate, and all the cities being set on fire, by fire from the countenance of the LORD; and from the countenance of the anger of his rage they were removed from view.
JER 4:27 Thus says the LORD, All the earth will be desolate; but in no way will I do it unto completion.
JER 4:28 Upon these things let the earth mourn, and let the heaven above be darkened, for I have spoken, and I shall not change my mind! I advanced it, and I will not turn from it.
JER 4:29 From the sound of a horseman, and tightly stretched bow, every place withdrew; they have entered into the caves, and they were hid in the sacred groves; and they ascended upon the rocks. Every city they abandoned; man dwells not in them.
JER 4:30 And you, what shall you do? If you should put on scarlet, and should be adorned with an ornament of gold; and if you should rub antimony on your eyes, your finery is in vain; your lovers thrusted you away - they seek your life.
JER 4:31 For I heard a sound as women travailing; your moaning as one giving birth for the first time. The voice of the daughter of Zion shall faint, and her hands shall weaken, saying, Woe am I, for my soul fails over the ones being done away with.
JER 5:1 Run about in the streets of Jerusalem, and see! And know, and seek in her squares if there should be found a man! If there is one having equity, and seeking trust - then I will be kind to them, says the LORD.
JER 5:2 As the LORD lives, they say, On account of this do they not swear an oath with lies?
JER 5:3 O LORD, your eyes look unto trust. You whipped them, and they were not pained. You finished them off entirely, but they wanted not to take correction. They solidified their faces above a rock, and they wanted not to turn towards you.
JER 5:4 And I said, perhaps they are poor; for they are not able. For they knew not the way of the LORD, and the equity of God.
JER 5:5 I will go to the stout men and speak to them; for they recognized the way of the LORD, and the equity of God. And behold, with one accord they broke the yoke - they tore up the bonds.
JER 5:6 On account of this a lion smote them from out of the forest; and the wolf annihilated them unto their houses; and a leopard acted vigilant over their cities. All the ones going forth from them shall be hunted; for they multiplied their impiety, they strengthened in their rejection.
JER 5:7 What kind of kindness should happen to you for these things? Your sons abandoned me, and they swore by an oath by the ones not being gods. And I have filled them, and they committed adultery, and rested up in the houses of harlots.
JER 5:8 They became sex-crazed horses; each snorting over the wife of his neighbor.
JER 5:9 Shall I not visit over these things, says the LORD? Or to such a nation shall not my soul take vengeance?
JER 5:10 Ascend upon her battlements, and raze! But you should not do it unto completion. Destroy her supports! For they are not of the LORD.
JER 5:11 For by disrespecting they disrespected against me, says the LORD, even the house of Israel, and the house of Judah.
JER 5:12 They have lied to their LORD, and they said, These things are not so; there shall not come upon us bad things, and the sword and hunger we will not see.
JER 5:13 Our prophets were into the wind, and the word of the LORD exists not among them. Thus it shall be to them.
JER 5:14 On account of this, thus says the LORD almighty, Because you spoke this word, behold, I have given my words into your mouth as fire, and this people as wood, and it shall devour them.
JER 5:15 Behold, I bring upon you a nation at a distance, O house of Israel, says the LORD; a strong nation, a nation from the eon, a nation of which you shall not hear the voice of its language;
JER 5:16 all strong men - his quiver is as a tomb being open.
JER 5:17 And they shall devour your harvest, and your breads. And they shall devour your sons, and your daughters. And they shall devour your sheep, and your calves. And they shall devour your vineyards, and your fig groves, and your olive groves. And they shall thresh your fortified cities (upon which you rely upon them) by the broadsword.
JER 5:18 And it will be in those days, says the LORD your God, in no way will I appoint you unto completion.
JER 5:19 And it will be whenever you should say, For what reason did the LORD our God do to us all these things? that you shall say to them, Because you abandoned me, and served strange gods in your land, thus shall you serve strangers in a land not of yours.
JER 5:20 Announce these things unto the house of Jacob, and let it be heard in Judah!
JER 5:21 Hearken indeed to these things, O moronish and heartless people! They have eyes, and they see not; they have ears, and they hear not.
JER 5:22 Will you not fear me, says the LORD? Or before my face will you not show veneration? The one ordering the sand for a limit to the sea as an eternal order, and the sea shall not pass over it; and it shall be disturbed but it shall not prevail; and its waves shall resound, but shall not pass over it.
JER 5:23 But to this people there became an unhearing heart, and a resistance of persuasion - they turned aside and departed.
JER 5:24 And they said not in their heart, We should indeed fear the LORD our God, the one giving to us the early and late rain, (according to its season of the fullness of the order of harvest,) and guarded it for us.
JER 5:25 Your lawless deeds turned aside these things, and your sins removed the good things from you.
JER 5:26 For impious ones were found among my people. And they set a snare to corrupt men; and they conceive their plan.
JER 5:27 As a snare having been set is full of birds, so their houses are full of treachery. On account of this they were magnified, and enriched.
JER 5:28 They became fat and violated equity. They judged not the case of the orphan, and they judged not for the case of the widow.
JER 5:29 Shall I not watch for these, says the LORD? Or to such a nation shall I not avenge my soul?
JER 5:30 A change of state and causes for shuddering was taken place upon the earth.
JER 5:31 The prophets prophesied unjustly, and the priests clapped their hands; and my people have loved it so. And what will you do in the times after these things?
JER 6:1 Grow in strength, O sons of Benjamin, from the midst of Jerusalem! And in Tekoa signify by trumpet! And over Beth-haccerem lift a sign! For bad things look out from the north, and great destruction is happening.
JER 6:2 And your haughtiness shall be removed, O daughter of Zion.
JER 6:3 Shepherds shall come unto her and their flocks; and they shall pitch tents against her round about; and each shall tend by his hand.
JER 6:4 Make preparations against her for war! Rise up, and we should ascend upon her at midday! Woe to us, for the day has declined, for the shadows of the day fail.
JER 6:5 Rise up, and we should ascend at night, and utterly destroy her foundations.
JER 6:6 For thus says the LORD of the forces, Cut down her trees! Discharge a force against Jerusalem, O lying city! Complete tyranny is in her.
JER 6:7 As a well cools its water, so evil cools her. Impiety and misery shall be heard in her before her face always.
JER 6:8 In misery and with a whip you shall be corrected, O Jerusalem, lest my soul should depart from you; lest I should make you an untrodden land which shall not be settled.
JER 6:9 For thus says the LORD of the forces, Glean! Glean the remnants of Israel as a grapevine! Return as one gathering the vintage returns unto his basket!
JER 6:10 To whom should I speak, and testify, and he shall hearken? Behold, their ears are uncircumcised, and they are not able to hear. Behold, the word of the LORD became to them as a scorning; in no way shall they be willing to hear it.
JER 6:11 And I filled my rage, and I waited, but not finished them off entirely. I will pour out upon the simple ones outside, and upon the gathering of young men together; for man and woman shall be seized; the elder with the one full of days.
JER 6:12 And their houses shall be transferred to others, with fields and their wives together. For I will stretch out my hand against the ones dwelling this land, says the LORD.
JER 6:13 For from their small and unto great all have completed lawless deeds; from the priest and unto false prophet, all acted falsely.
JER 6:14 And they repaired the destruction of my people treating it with contempt, and saying, Peace. And where is peace?
JER 6:15 They were shamed for they failed; but neither as ones being disgraced were they disgraced; and their dishonor they knew not. On account of this they shall fall in their downfall; and in the time of their visitation they shall perish, said the LORD.
JER 6:16 Thus says the LORD, Stand upon the ways, and behold, and ask of the eternal roads of the LORD, and see what kind is the good way, and proceed in it, and you will find purification to your souls! And they said, We will not go.
JER 6:17 I have placed over you watchmen - hearken to the sound of the trumpet! But they said, We will not hearken.
JER 6:18 On account of this, the nations heard, and the ones tending their flocks.
JER 6:19 Hearken, O earth! Behold, I will bring upon this people bad things - the fruit of their rejection. For my word they heeded not, and my law they have thrust away.
JER 6:20 Why do you bring frankincense from out of Sheba to me, and cinnamon from out of a land far off? Your whole burnt offerings are not acceptable, and your sacrifices delighted not to me.
JER 6:21 On account of this, thus says the LORD, Behold, I impute upon this people weakness, and fathers and sons shall weaken in it together; neighbor and his near one shall perish.
JER 6:22 Thus says the LORD, Behold, a people comes from the north, and nations shall be awakened from the end of the earth.
JER 6:23 Bow and pike they shall hold. It is audacious, and will not show mercy. Its sound is as the sea swelling up. Upon horses and chariots it shall deploy as fire for war against you, O daughter of Zion.
JER 6:24 We heard the report of them - our hands were disabled. Affliction holds us down - pangs as a woman giving birth.
JER 6:25 Do not go forth into a field, and do not proceed in the ways! For a broadsword of the enemies sojourns round about.
JER 6:26 Daughter of my people, gird on sackcloth! Strew ashes! You shall observe for yourself mourning as of a beloved one by beating the breast pitiably. For suddenly misery shall come upon you.
JER 6:27 I have appointed you as an approver among peoples being tried; and you shall know in my trying their way.
JER 6:28 All are unhearing, going crookedly; as brass and iron they are all being corrupted.
JER 6:29 The bellows failed at the fire; the lead failed; the silversmith works silver in vain; their wickednesses melt not away.
JER 6:30 Call them rejected silver! For the LORD rejected them.
JER 7:1 The word which came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying, Stand upon the gate of the house of the LORD, and read there this word! And say,
JER 7:2 Hear the word of the LORD all Judea!
JER 7:3 Thus says the LORD of the forces, the God of Israel, Set right your ways and your practices, and I will settle you in this place!
JER 7:4 Rely not upon yourselves with lying words, for thoroughly they will not benefit you, saying, The temple of the LORD, it is the temple of the LORD.
JER 7:5 For if in setting right you should set right your ways, and your practices; and in doing you should execute equity between a man and between his neighbor,
JER 7:6 and you should not tyrannize over the foreigner and orphan and widow, and you should not pour out innocent blood in this place, and you should not go after strange gods for your hurt;
JER 7:7 then I will settle you in your place, in the land which I gave to your fathers from the eon, and unto the eon.
JER 7:8 But since you rely upon lying words, from where you will not be benefitted;
JER 7:9 and you murder, and you commit adultery, and steal, and swear upon an oath unjustly, and burn incense to Baal, and go after strange gods whom you know not;
JER 7:10 it is to be wickedness to you. And you came and stood before me in the house which my name is called upon in it. And you said, We have kept a distance to do all these abominations.
JER 7:11 Is My house a cave of robbers, of which my name is called upon in it there before you? And behold, I have seen, says the LORD.
JER 7:12 For go unto my place, in Shiloh, where I encamped my name before it there prior, and see what I did to it because of the countenance of evil of my people Israel!
JER 7:13 And now, because you have done all these works, and I spoke to you, and you heard me not; and I called you, and you responded not;
JER 7:14 I also will do to this house (of which my name is called upon in it, upon which you relied upon it, and the place which I gave to you and to your fathers,) as I did to Shiloh.
JER 7:15 And I will throw you away from my face, as I threw away your brothers, all the seed of Ephraim.
JER 7:16 And you, do not pray for this people, and petition not to show them mercy, and make not a vow, and do not come forward to me concerning them! For I will not listen.
JER 7:17 Or do you not see what they do in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem?
JER 7:18 Their sons collect together wood, and their fathers kindle a fire, and their women knead dough to make cakes to the military of the heaven, and they offered libations to strange gods, that they should provoke me to anger.
JER 7:19 Do they not provoke me to anger, says the LORD? Do they not provoke themselves that their faces should be disgraced?
JER 7:20 On account of this, thus says the LORD, Behold, my anger and rage is poured upon this place, and upon the men, and upon the cattle, and upon every tree of the field, and upon the produce of the land, and it shall be kindled, and not extinguished.
JER 7:21 Thus says the LORD, Gather together your whole burnt offerings with your sacrifices, and eat meats!
JER 7:22 For I spoke not to your fathers, and I did not give charge to them in the day I led them from out of the land of Egypt concerning whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.
JER 7:23 But only this saying gave I charge to them, saying, Hearken to my voice, and I will be to you for God, and you will be to me for a people! And go in all my ways in which ever I should give charge to you, so even it might be good to you!
JER 7:24 And they listened not to me, and heeded not with their ear, but went by the thoughts of their evil heart; and they became for the rear, and not for the front.
JER 7:25 From which day their fathers went forth from out of the land of Egypt, and until this day, even I sent to you all my servants of the prophets by day; and at dawn also I sent.
JER 7:26 And they listened not to me, and their ear took not heed, and they hardened their neck above their fathers.
JER 7:27 And you shall say to them this word, and they will not listen to you. And you shall call them, and they will not respond to you.
JER 7:28 And you shall say to them, This is the nation which hearkened not to the voice of the LORD their God, nor received instruction - trust failed from their mouth.
JER 7:29 Shear your head, and throw away, and take upon your lips wailing! For the LORD rejected and thrust away the generation doing these things.
JER 7:30 For the sons of Judah did wicked before me, says the LORD. They arranged their abominations in the house of which my name is called upon it, to defile it.
JER 7:31 And they built the shrine of Tophet, which is in the ravine of the son of Hinnom, to incinerate their sons and their daughters by fire; which I did not give charge to them, and considered it not in my heart.
JER 7:32 On account of this, Behold, days come, says the LORD, and they shall not say any more, Shrine of Tophet, and Ravine of the Son of Hinnom, but, The Ravine of the ones Being done away with. And they shall entomb in Tophet, on account of a place not existing.
JER 7:33 And the dead of this people will be for food to the birds of the of heaven, and to the wild beasts of the earth; and there will not be one frightening them away.
JER 7:34 And I will depose from out of the cities of Judah, and from out of the corridors of Jerusalem, the voice of ones being glad, and the voice of ones rejoicing, the voice of the groom, and the voice of the bride; for all the land will be for desolation.
JER 8:1 In that time, says the LORD, they shall bring forth the bones of the kings of Judah, and the bones of its rulers, and the bones of the priests, and the bones of their prophets, and the bones of the ones dwelling in Jerusalem, from out of their burying-places.
JER 8:2 And they shall freshen them to the sun, and to the moon, and to all the stars, and to all the military of the heaven, which they loved, and which they served, and of which they went after them, and which they held to, and to which they did obeisance to them. They shall not be lamented, and they shall not be entombed. And they will be for an example upon the face of the earth.
JER 8:3 For they took death rather than life, even to all the ones remaining being left behind from that generation, in every place of which ever I shall push them there.
JER 8:4 For thus says the LORD, Shall the one falling not be raised up, or the one turning, not return?
JER 8:5 Why turned this people in an impudent rejection, and they hold firmly to their resolve, and they wanted not to return?
JER 8:6 Give ear indeed, and hearken! Will they not rightly speak? There is not a man repenting from his evil, saying, What did I do? The one running stopped from his race, as a horse sweating in his snorting.
JER 8:7 Even the stork in the heaven knew her time, and the turtle-dove and the swallow of the field. The sparrows guard the times of their entrances, but my people knew not the judgments of the LORD.
JER 8:8 How shall you say that, We are wise ones, and, The law of the LORD is with us? For the lying rush reed pen became vain to the scribes.
JER 8:9 The wise ones are ashamed, terrified, and convicted; for the word of the LORD they rejected; what wisdom is in them?
JER 8:10 On account of this, I give their wives to others, and their fields to the heirs. For from small unto great all pursue a fondness of money. And from prophet unto priest all commit lies,
JER 8:11 and treating the broken daughter of my people with dishonor, saying, Peace peace; and there was not peace.
JER 8:12 They have been shamed, for they did an abomination. And with shame they were not ashamed; even to be ashamed they knew not. On account of this they shall fall in the midst of ones falling. In the time of his visit they shall fall, says the LORD.
JER 8:13 And they shall gather of their produce, says the LORD - there is not a grape on the grapevines, and there is not figs on the fig-trees, and the leaves have flown down.
JER 8:14 For why do we sit? Come together, and we should enter into the fortified cities, and we should be disowned there; for God disowned us, and gave us to drink water of bile, for we sinned before him.
JER 8:15 We have gathered together for peace, and there was not good things in the time of healing, but behold, anxiety.
JER 8:16 From out of Dan we shall hear a sound of his swift horses. From a sound of snorting of ones riding his horses all the land shall be shaken. And he shall come and devour the land, and the fullness of it - the city, and the ones dwelling in it.
JER 8:17 For behold, I send out against you serpents putting to death, ones which are not charmed, and they shall bite you -
JER 8:18 incurably with the grief of your heart being perplexed.
JER 8:19 Behold, the sound of a cry - the daughter of my people from a land far off, saying, Is the LORD not in Zion? Or is not a king there? For they provoked me to anger by their idolatrous carvings, and by strange vanities.
JER 8:20 Summer went, harvest passed, and we were not delivered.
JER 8:21 Upon destruction of the daughter of my people I have been enveloped in darkness; in perplexity pangs prevailed over me as a woman giving birth.
JER 8:22 And is not balm not in Gilead? and Is not a physician there? Why did a healing not ascend for the daughter of my people?
JER 9:1 Who will give my head water, and my eyes a spring of tears, that I shall weep for this my people day and night - the ones being slain of the daughter of my people?
JER 9:2 Who shall give to me a post house at the end of the wilderness? for I shall leave my people, and shall go forth from them; for all commit adultery - a convocation of ones annulling covenant.
JER 9:3 And they stretched tight their tongue as a bow; a lie and not trust grows in strength upon the earth; for they went from evils unto evils, and they knew me not, says the LORD.
JER 9:4 Let each take guard of his neighbor, and let them not rely upon their brothers! For every brother shall stomp with the heel, and every friend shall go deceitfully.
JER 9:5 Each shall mock against his friend. In no way shall they speak truth. Their tongue has learned to speak falsely. They wronged, and stopped not to turn back.
JER 9:6 Interest upon interest, treachery upon treachery; they did not want to behold me, says the LORD.
JER 9:7 On account of this, Thus says the LORD of the forces, Behold, I shall set them on fire, and try them. What will I act before the face of the wickedness of the daughter of my people?
JER 9:8 Their tongue is a piercing arrow; the words of their mouth deceitful; one speaks peaceably to his neighbor, and in himself he has hatred.
JER 9:9 Shall I not visit upon these, says the LORD? or, shall my soul not take vengeance on such a people?
JER 9:10 Over the mountains, take up a lamenting! And over the roads of the wilderness, a wailing! For they failed by there not being men. They heard not the sound of the existence of winged creatures of the heaven. And the cattle receded - they were set out.
JER 9:11 And I will give Jerusalem for displacement, and for a home of dragons. And the cities of Judah I will appoint for extinction, so as to not be dwelt in.
JER 9:12 Who is the discerning man? Then let him perceive this! And the word of the mouth of the LORD is with him. Let him announce to you on account of why the land was destroyed! It was lit on fire as a wilderness, so as to not travel through it.
JER 9:13 And the LORD said to me, On account of their abandoning my law which I put before their face, and they hearkened not to my voice;
JER 9:14 but they went after the things pleasing their heart - the evil thing; and after the idols which their fathers taught them.
JER 9:15 On account of this, thus says the LORD of the forces, the God of Israel, Behold, I will feed them distresses, and will cause them to drink water of bile.
JER 9:16 And I will disperse them among the nations which they knew not, nor their fathers. And I will send the sword as a successor upon them, until they are completely consumed by it.
JER 9:17 Thus says the LORD, Call the wailing women and let them come! And to the wise woman send, and let them utter their voice!
JER 9:18 And let them take upon you a lamentation! And let your eyes lead down tears! And let your eyelids flow water!
