JER 9:19 For a voice of lament was heard in Zion, saying, O how we became in misery. We were disgraced very much, for we abandoned the land, and threw away our tents.
JER 9:20 Hear indeed, O women, the word of God, and let your ears receive the words of his mouth, and teach your daughters a lamentation, and a woman her neighbor wailing!
JER 9:21 For death ascended through your windows; it entered into your land to obliterate infants outside, and young men from the squares.
JER 9:22 And the dead of men will be for an example upon the face of the plain of your land; and as grass after being mowed, and there will not be one gathering.
JER 9:23 Thus says the LORD, Let not the boast wise one in his wisdom! And let not the strong man boast in his strength! And let not the rich man boast in his riches!
JER 9:24 But in this boasting let him boast! To perceive and to know me, that I am the LORD, the one having mercy, and judgment, and righteousness upon the earth. For my will is in these things, says the LORD.
JER 9:25 Behold, days come, says the LORD, and I will visit upon all having been circumcised of their uncircumcision -
JER 9:26 upon Egypt, and upon Judah, and upon Edom, and upon the sons of Ammon, and upon the sons of Moab, and upon every one shaving round about his face dwelling in the wilderness. For all the nations are uncircumcised in flesh, and all the house of Israel uncircumcised of their heart.
JER 10:1 Hear the word of the LORD which he spoke to you, O house of Israel!
JER 10:2 Thus says the LORD, Do not learn according to the ways of the nations! And from the signs of the heaven do not fear! For nations are fearing them.
JER 10:3 For the laws of the nations are vain. An idol is a tree being cut from out of the forest, the work of a fabricator, even a molten casting.
JER 10:4 It is being bedecked in silver and gold. By a hammer and nail they stiffen them,
JER 10:5 and they move not. It is a silver turned piece - they do not speak. Being lifted they shall be lifted, for they shall not mount themselves. You should not fear them, for in no way should they do evil, and there is not good in them.
JER 10:6 There is not one likened to you, O LORD. Great are you, and great is your name in strength.
JER 10:7 Who shall not fear you, O king of nations? For to you it is becoming. For among all the wise ones of the nations, and among all their kingdoms, there is not one likened to you.
JER 10:8 At the same time they are foolish and unthinking. Their tree is an instruction of vanities.
JER 10:9 Amalgamated silver from Tarshish; gold shall come from Uphaz; and by the hand of goldsmiths they are all works of craftsmen. They shall put on them blue and purple.
JER 10:11 Thus you shall say to them, The gods who did not make the heaven and the earth, let them be destroyed from the earth, and from beneath this heaven!
JER 10:12 The LORD is the one making the earth by his strength, erecting the place being inhabited by his wisdom, and by his intellect he stretched out the heaven,
JER 10:13 and the multitude of water in heaven, and led clouds from the end of the earth, and made lightnings for the rain, and brought out winds from his treasuries.
JER 10:14 Every man was made moronish from knowledge; every goldsmith was disgraced over his carved idols; for they cast false in a furnace - there is not breath in them.
JER 10:15 They are vanities, mocking works. In the time of their visitation they shall be destroyed.
JER 10:16 Such is not the portion to Jacob. For the one shaping all things is he, and Israel is the rod of his inheritance - the LORD of forces is his name.
JER 10:17 He gathered his support from outside dwelling in choice vessels.
JER 10:18 For thus says the LORD, Behold, I trip up the ones dwelling this land, and I will squeeze them out so that it should be found so.
JER 10:19 Woe over your destruction, your wound is painful. And I said, Really this is my wound, and it overtook me.
JER 10:20 My tent is in miserable condition, it was destroyed; and all of my hide coverings were pulled apart. My sons and my sheep are not. There is not more place for my tent, nor a place for my hide coverings.
JER 10:21 For the shepherds were unwise, and sought not the LORD. On account of this all the sheep of the pasture comprehended not, and are dispersed.
JER 10:22 Behold there comes a sound of a report, and a great quake from out of the land of the north, to order the cities of Judah for extinction, and for a bed of ostriches.
JER 10:23 I know, O LORD, that the way of man is not his own; nor shall a man go and keep his goings straight.
JER 10:24 Correct us, O LORD, only with equity, and not in rage, that you should not make us few!
JER 10:25 Pour out your rage upon the nations not knowing you, and upon kingdoms which called not upon your name! For they devoured Jacob, and completely consumed Israel, and made desolate his pasture.
JER 11:1 The word coming from the LORD to Jeremiah, saying,
JER 11:2 Hear the words of this covenant! And you shall speak to the men of Judah, and to the ones dwelling in Jerusalem.
JER 11:3 And you shall say to them, Thus says the LORD God of Israel, Accursed is the man who shall not hearken to the words of this covenant,
JER 11:4 of which I gave charge to your fathers in the day I led them from out of the land of Egypt, from out of the furnace of iron, saying, Hearken to my voice, and do all as much as I give charge to you! And you will be to me for a people, and I will be to you for God;
JER 11:5 so that I should establish my oath which I swore by an oath to your fathers, to give to them a land flowing milk and honey, as this day. And I answered, and said, May it be, O LORD.
JER 11:6 And the LORD said to me, Read all these words in the cities of Judah, and outside of Jerusalem! saying, Hear the words of this covenant, and do them!
JER 11:7 For bearing witness together I bore witness to your fathers in the day in which I led them out of the land of Egypt, until this day. Rising early I bore witness, saying, Hear my voice! And they heard not, and they inclined not their ear; but they went each in the deformity of his evil heart. And all the words of this covenant were brought in unto them, of which I commanded to be done.
JER 11:8 But they did not act.
JER 11:9 And the LORD said to me, A conspiracy is found among the men of Judah, and among the ones dwelling in Jerusalem.
JER 11:10 They returned unto the iniquities of their fathers prior, who wanted not to listen to my words. And behold, they went after strange gods, to serve them. And the house of Israel and the house of Judah effaced my covenant which I ordained with their fathers.
JER 11:11 On account of this, thus says the LORD, Behold, I bring upon them evils, from out of which they shall not be able to come forth from out of them. And they shall cry out to me, and I will not listen to them.
JER 11:12 And the cities of Judah and the ones dwelling Jerusalem shall go, and shall cry out to their gods to whom they burn incense to them; the ones which shall not deliver them in the time of their evils.
JER 11:13 For according to the number of your cities were your gods, O Judah. And according to the number of the streets of Jerusalem you arranged shrines to burn incense to Baal.
JER 11:14 And you, do not pray for this people, and do not petition concerning them with supplication and prayer! For I will not listen in the time in which they call upon me, in the time of their affliction.
JER 11:15 What abomination did the one being loved in my house do? Shall vows and holy meats remove from you your evils, or by these will you evade?
JER 11:16 The LORD called your name a beautiful well-shaded olive tree to the sight. In the sound of its being lopped a fire was lit unto it; her tender branches were made useless.
JER 11:17 And the LORD of the forces, having planted you, spoke evils against you - against the evils of the house of Israel, and the house of Judah; for they did it to themselves, provoking me to anger in their burning incense to Baal.
JER 11:18 O LORD, make it known to me, and I shall know! Then I knew their practices.
JER 11:19 But I am as a little lamb, guileless, being led for the sacrificing, not knowing. Against me they devised a device, saying, Come, and we should put wood for his bread, and we should obliterate him from the land of the living; and his name in no way shall be remembered any longer.
JER 11:20 O LORD of the forces, judging just things, trying the kidneys and the hearts, may I behold the punishment exacted by you on them. For to you I revealed my right action.
JER 11:21 On account of this, Thus says the LORD against the men of Anathoth, seeking my life, saying, In no way should you prophesy in the name of the LORD, and if you do not agree you shall die by our hands.
JER 11:22 On account of this, thus says the LORD of the forces, Behold, I will make a visit unto them. Their young men shall die by the sword; their sons and their daughters shall come to an end in famine,
JER 11:23 and there will not be left any of them. For I will bring evils upon the ones dwelling in Anathoth, in the year of their visitation.
JER 12:1 You are just, O LORD, that I may plead to you. I will speak to you only concerning judgments. Why is it that the way of the impious ones prospers? All the ones disregarding by disregardings prospered.
JER 12:2 You planted them, and they were rooted. They produced children, and they produced fruit. You are near their mouth, and at a distance from their kidneys.
JER 12:3 And you, O LORD, know me. You have tried my heart before you. Gather them as a flock for a sacrifice, and purify them for the day of slaughter!
JER 12:4 For how long will the land mourn, and all the grass of the field be dried, because of the evils of the ones dwelling in it? The cattle and the winged creatures were removed from view, for they said, God shall not see our ways.
JER 12:5 Your feet run, and they cause you to faint; how then will you make preparations to ride upon horses? And you have relied in the land of your peace, how then will you do in the neighing raging. of the Jordan?
JER 12:6 For even your brothers, and the house of your father, even they disregarded you. And they yelled out, they assembled at your rear, you should not trust in them when they speak with you good words.
JER 12:7 I have abandoned my house, I let go of my inheritance, I gave the one being loved of my soul into the hands of her enemies.
JER 12:8 My inheritance became to me as a lion in the forest; she uttered her voice against me - on account of this I detested her.
JER 12:9 Is not the cave of a hyena my inheritance to me, the cave round about her against her? Proceed, bring together all the wild beasts of the field, and let them come to eat her!
JER 12:10 Many shepherds corrupted my vineyard, they tainted my portion, they made my desirable portion for an untrodden wilderness.
JER 12:11 It was appointed for extinction by destruction; on account of me all the land was obliterated in extinction, for there is not a man putting it to heart.
JER 12:12 Upon every mountain pass in the wilderness came the ones causing misery. For the sword of the LORD shall devour from one tip of the land unto the other tip of the land - there is not peace to all flesh.
JER 12:13 You sowed wheat, and harvested thorn-bushes. Their lots shall not benefit them. Be ashamed of your boasting, because of scorn before the LORD!
JER 12:14 For thus says the LORD, Concerning all the wicked neighbors touching my inheritance, which I portioned to my people Israel; behold, I draw them away from their land, and Judah I will cast out from the midst of them.
JER 12:15 And it will be after my casting them out I will return, and will show mercy on them, and will settle them each in his inheritance, and each in his land.
JER 12:16 And it will be if in learning they should learn the way of my people, to swear by an oath to my name, saying, As the LORD lives; as they taught my people to swear by an oath to Baal; then they shall be edified in the midst of my people.
JER 12:17 But if they should not return, then I shall lift away that nation by removal and destruction, says the LORD.
JER 13:1 Thus says the LORD, Proceed and acquire for yourself a flaxen linen loincloth, and put it around your loin, and you shall not go through water!
JER 13:2 And I acquired the loincloth according to the word of the LORD, and put it around my loin.
JER 13:3 And came to pass the word of the LORD to me of a second time, saying,
JER 13:4 Take the loincloth around your loin, and arise, and proceed unto the Euphrates, and hide it there in the hole of the rock!
JER 13:5 And I went, and hid it by the Euphrates, as the LORD gave charge to me.
JER 13:6 And it came to pass after many days, and the LORD said to me, Arise! Proceed unto the Euphrates, and take from there the loincloth which I gave charge to you to hide it there!
JER 13:7 And I went unto the Euphrates, and I dug, and I took the loincloth from out of the place where I hid it there. And behold, it was ruined, which in no way should it be used for anything.
JER 13:8 And came to pass the word of the LORD to me, saying,
JER 13:9 Thus says the LORD, Thus I shall corrupt the insolence of Judah, and the insolence of Jerusalem;
JER 13:10 this great insolence of the ones not wanting to obey my words, and having gone in straightness of their wicked heart, and having gone after strange gods, to serve to them, and to do obeisance to them. And they will be as this loincloth, which shall not be used yet for anything.
JER 13:11 For just as the loincloth cleaves around the loin of a man, so I cleaved to myself the house of Israel, and all the house of Judah, says the LORD; to be to me for a famous people, and for a boasting, and for glory. And they hearkened not to me.
JER 13:12 And you shall say to the people this word, Thus says the LORD, the God of Israel. Every leather bag shall be filled of wine. And it will be if they should say to you, Is it in not knowing, we know not that every leather bag shall be filled of wine?
JER 13:13 That you shall say to them, Thus says the LORD, Behold, I shall fill all the ones dwelling this land, and their kings, the ones sitting down of the sons of David upon their throne, and the priests, and the prophets, and Judah, and all the ones dwelling in Jerusalem, with strong drink.
JER 13:14 And I will disperse them, a man and his brother, and their fathers, and their sons in the same way. I will not long after them, says the LORD, and I will not spare; and I will not pity at their ruin.
JER 13:15 Hear, and give ear, and do not be encouraged! For the LORD spoke.
JER 13:16 Give to the LORD your God glory before the darkening, and before the stumbling of your feet upon dark mountains! And you shall await for light, and there is the shadow of death, and they shall be put into darkness.
JER 13:17 But if you should not hearken, secretly your soul shall weep from in front of insolence; and your eyes shall lead down tears. For the flock of the LORD was broken up.
JER 13:18 Say to the king, and to the ones being in power, Be humbled, and sit down! For your crown of glory was demolished from your head.
JER 13:19 The cities towards the south were closed up, and there was not one opening. Judah was resettled, they completed in it a complete resettlement.
JER 13:20 Lift up your eyes, O Jerusalem, and behold the ones coming from the north! Where is the flock which was given to you, the sheep of your glory?
JER 13:21 What shall you say whenever they should visit you, and you taught them lessons for rule against yourself? Shall not pangs control you as a woman giving birth?
JER 13:22 And if you shall say in your heart, Why have these things met up with me? On account of the magnitude of your iniquity your posteriors were uncovered, to make an example of your heels.
JER 13:23 If the Ethiopian shall change his skin, and the leopard her colors, then you shall be able to do good while learning the bad.
JER 13:24 And I scattered them as sticks being carried by the wind into a wilderness.
JER 13:25 Thus is your lot and portion for your resisting me, says the LORD; as you forgot me, and hoped upon lies,
JER 13:26 even I will uncover your rear unto your face, and your dishonor shall be seen.
JER 13:27 Your adultery, and your snorting, and the alienation of your harlotry upon the hills, and in the fields I have seen - your abominations. Woe to you, O Jerusalem, for you were not cleansed to follow after me - for how long yet?
JER 14:1 And came to pass the word of the LORD to Jeremiah concerning the drought.
JER 14:2 Judea mourned, and her gates are emptied, and are enveloped in darkness upon the earth, and the cry of Jerusalem ascended.
JER 14:3 And her great men sent their younger ones for water. They came upon the wells, and did not find water. They returned their receptacles empty.
JER 14:4 And the works of the land failed, for there was not any rain. The farmers were ashamed, they covered their head.
JER 14:5 And the hinds in the field gave birth, and abandoned it, for there was not a pasturage.
JER 14:6 The wild donkeys stood upon the groves, and drewsniffed. wind as dragons; their eyes failed, for there was not grass.
JER 14:7 Since our sins opposed us, O LORD, do for us because of your name! For our sins are many before you. Against you we sinned.
JER 14:8 You are the endurance of Israel, O LORD, delivering in time of evils. Why did you become as a sojourner upon the earth, and as a native-born turning aside for lodging?
JER 14:9 Will you be as a man sleeping, or as a man not being able to deliver? But you are among us, O LORD, and your name is called upon us; you should not forget us.
JER 14:10 Thus says the LORD to this people, They loved to move their feetwander., and spared not, and God prospered not the way among them. Now the iniquity shall be remembered, and he visited their sins.
JER 14:11 And the LORD said to me, Do not pray for this people for good!
JER 14:12 For if they should fast, I will not listen to their supplication. And if they should bring whole burnt offerings, and sacrifices, I will not think well of them. For by sword, and by famine, I will finish them off entirely unto death.
JER 14:13 And I said, O Being One, O LORD. Behold, the prophets prophesy and say, You shall not see a sword, nor shall hunger be among you; but truth and peace I shall appoint upon the land, and in this place.
JER 14:14 And the LORD said to me, the prophets prophesy lies in my name. I sent them not, and gave charge to them not, and spoke not to them. For lying visions, and divinations, and omens, and the resolves of their own heart they prophesy to you.
JER 14:15 On account of this, thus says the LORD, concerning the prophets prophesying lies in my name, and I sent them not, who say, Sword and famine will not be upon this land - by a diseased death the prophets shall die and by hunger they shall be finished off entirely,
JER 14:16 even the people to whom they prophesy to them. And they will be tossed in the streets of Jerusalem, from in front of the sword, and of the famine. And there will not be one entombing them, even their wives, and their sons, and their daughters. And I shall pour out against them for their evils.
JER 14:17 And you shall say to them this word, Lead down tears into your eyes day and night, and let them not stop! For by a great defeat the daughter of my people was defeated, even by an exceedingly grievous beating.
JER 14:18 If I should go forth into the plain, then behold, ones slain by sword. And if I should enter into the city, then behold, the misery of famine. For priest and prophet were gone into a land which they knew not.
JER 14:19 Did by rejecting you reject Judah? And has your soul removed itself from Zion? Why did you smite us, and there is not a healing for us? We waited for peace, but there was not good; for a time of healing, but behold, only disturbance.
JER 14:20 We knew, O LORD, our sins, the iniquities of our fathers; for we sinned before you.
JER 14:21 Abate, on account of your name! You should not destroy the throne of your glory. Remember, you should not efface your covenant with us!
JER 14:22 Is there one among the idols of the nations causing rain, and shall an idol give the heaven its fullness? Is it not you being he, O LORD our God? And we shall wait on you, for you made all these.
JER 15:1 And the LORD said to me, If Moses and Samuel should stand before my face my soul is not for them. Send out this people from my face, and let them go forth!
JER 15:2 And it will be if they should say to you, Where shall we go forth? That you shall say to them, Thus says the LORD, As many as for death, to death; and as many as for sword, to sword; and as many as for famine, to famine; and as many as for captivity, to captivity.
JER 15:3 And I will avenge against them four forms, says the LORD; the sword unto slaughter, and the dogs for tearing in pieces, and the wild beasts of the earth, and the winged creatures of the heaven for solid food and corruption.
JER 15:4 And I will deliver them up for distresses to all the kingdoms of the earth, because of Manasseh son of Hezekiah king of Judah, for all which he did in Jerusalem.
JER 15:5 Who will spare over you, O Jerusalem? And who will show timidity against you? Or, who shall return to say, Peace to you?
JER 15:6 You turned from me, says the LORD; you shall go back. And I will stretch out my hand, and I shall utterly destroy you; and no longer shall I spare them.
JER 15:7 And I will scatter them in a dispersion in the gates of my people. They were made childless; they destroyed my people because of their evils.
JER 15:8 Their widows were multiplied above the sand of the sea; I brought young men against the mother - misery in midday. I cast upon her sudden trembling and anxiety.
JER 15:9 The one giving birth to seven was emptied - her soul suffered misfortune; her sun set even in the middle of the day; she was disgraced and berated. Of the ones remaining of them I will give to the sword before their enemies, says the LORD.
JER 15:10 Woe, O mother, as how you bore me a man adjudicating and litigating in all the earth. I derived not a benefit, nor did anyone benefit me. My strength failed among the ones cursing me.
JER 15:11 May it be, O LORD master, of their prospering in a time of their affliction for good against the enemy.
JER 15:12 Shall it be known that iron and a wrap-around garment of brass is your strength?
JER 15:13 And of your treasures I will give an equivalent, on account of all your sins, and in all your borders.
JER 15:14 I will reduce you to slavery round about your enemies, in the land which you knew not. For a fire has been kindled because of my rage - it shall be kindled against you.
JER 15:15 O LORD, remember me, and visit me, and acquit me from the ones pursuing me - not for leniency to them! Know how I took scorning on account of you,
JER 15:16 even by the ones disregarding your words! Finish them off entirely, and your word will be to me for gladness and joy of my heart! For your name has been called upon me, O LORD almighty.
JER 15:17 I sat not in their sanhedrin playing about, but I was cautious from in front of your hand. Alone I sat, for I was filled with bitterness.
JER 15:18 Why do the ones grieving me prevail over me? My wound is substantial, from where shall I be healed? In becoming, it became to me as false water, not having trust.
JER 15:19 Because of this, thus says the LORD, If you should return, and I should restore you, you shall stand before my face. And if you should lead out the esteemed from the unworthy, you will be as my mouth. And they shall return to you, and you shall not return to them.
JER 15:20 And I will appoint you to this people as a fortified wall of brass. And they shall wage war against you, but in no way shall they be able to prevail against you. For I am with you to deliver you, and to rescue you, says the LORD.
JER 15:21 And I will deliver you from the hand of wicked ones, and I will ransom you from the hand of pestilent ones.
JER 16:1 And the word of the LORD came to me saying,
JER 16:2 You should not take a wife, and there shall not be engendered to you a son nor daughter in this place.
JER 16:3 For thus says the LORD, Concerning the sons and the daughters of the ones being engendered in this place, and concerning their mothers giving them birth, and concerning their fathers engendering them in this land;
JER 16:4 by a diseased death they shall die; they shall not be lamented, and they shall not be entombed; for they will be an example upon the face of the earth. By the sword they shall fall, and in hunger they shall be finished off entirely. And their corpses shall be for food to the wild beasts of the earth, and to the winged creatures of the heaven.
JER 16:5 Thus says the LORD, You should not enter into their revelry, and you should not go in to lament, and you should not mourn them. For I have removed my peace from this people, says the LORD - mercy and charity.
JER 16:6 And great and small shall die in this land. They shall not be buried, and they shall not be lamented; they shall not beat their chest for them, nor shall they make cuts, and they shall not be shaven;
JER 16:7 and in no way should bread be broken in their mourning for consolation over one having died; they shall not give a drink for them of a cup for consolation over his father or his mother;
JER 16:8 into a residence of a banquet you shall not enter to sit down with them to eat and to drink.
JER 16:9 For thus says the LORD God of Israel, Behold, I depose from out of this place before your eyes, and in your days, a voice of joy, and a voice of gladness, a voice of a groom, and the voice of a bride.
JER 16:10 And it will be whenever you should announce to this people all these matters, then they shall say to you, Why did the LORD speak against us all these evils - what is our injustice, and what is our sin which we sinned before the LORD our God?
JER 16:11 And you shall say to them, Because your fathers abandoned me, says the LORD; and they set out after strange gods, and served to them, and did obeisance to them; and abandoned me, and kept not my law.
JER 16:12 And you were wicked above your fathers. And behold, you each go after the things pleasing your heart - the evils, to not obey me.
JER 16:13 And I will throw you away from this land, into a land which you knew not - you and your fathers. And you shall serve there strange gods day and night - the ones that shall not grant mercy to you.
JER 16:14 On account of this, behold, days come, says the LORD, and they shall not still say, As the LORD lives, the one leading up the sons of Israel from out of the land of Egypt.
JER 16:15 But they shall say, As the LORD lives, who led the house of Israel from the land of the north, and from all the places where they were pushed out there. And I shall restore them unto their land which I gave to their fathers.
JER 16:16 Behold, I send many fishermen, says the LORD, and they shall fish them. And after these I shall send many hunters, and they shall hunt them upon every mountain, and upon every hill, and from out of the holes of the rocks.
JER 16:17 For my eyes are upon all their ways, and their offences were not hid before my eyes.
JER 16:18 And I shall recompense double their iniquities, and their sins upon which they profaned my land by the decaying flesh of their abominations, and by their lawless deeds in which they filled my inheritance.
JER 16:19 O LORD, my strength, and my help, and my refuge in a day of evils. To you nations shall come from the ends of the earth, and shall say, O how false the idols our fathers acquired, and there is not a benefit in them.
JER 16:20 Shall a man make for himself gods, and these are not gods?
JER 16:21 On account of this, behold, I will make manifest to them my hand in this time; and I shall make known to them my power; and they shall know that my name is the LORD.

JER 17:3 O mountain in the plain, of your wealth and all of you treasures I shall give for plunder; your heights for sin in all your boundaries.
JER 17:4 And you shall be forsaken from your inheritance which I gave to you. And I will make you to serve to your enemies in the land which you knew not. For you kindled fire in my wrath - unto the eon it shall blaze.
JER 17:5 Thus says the LORD, Cursed is the man who has hope upon man, and shall fix firmly the flesh of his arm, and should separate his heart from the LORD.
JER 17:6 And he will be as the tamarisk in the wilderness; he shall not see whenever good things come. But he shall encamp in salty lands, and in a wilderness, in a land brackish which is not dwelt.
JER 17:7 And being blessed is the man who relies upon the LORD, and the LORD will be his hope.
JER 17:8 And he shall be as a tree prospering by waters; and upon a moist place he shall shoot his roots; and he will not be fearful whenever sweltering heat comes, and there will be for him tree trunks of the woods. In the year of drought he shall not be fearful, and he shall not stop producing fruit.
JER 17:9 The heart is deep beyond all things, and man is - who shall know him?
JER 17:10 I the LORD am examining hearts, trying kidneys, to give to each according to his ways, and according to the fruits of their practices.
JER 17:11 The partridge speaks out loud, gathering together what she bore not. So the man having his riches not with equity - in the first half of his days his riches will leave him, and at the last half of his days he will be a foolish one.
JER 17:12 Our sanctuary is a throne of glory being raised up high from the beginning.
JER 17:13 The waiting of Israel, O LORD, all the ones forsaking you, let them be disgraced! Ones revolting, let them be written upon the ground! For they abandoned the spring of life - the LORD.
JER 17:14 Heal me, O LORD, and I shall be healed! Deliver me, and I shall be delivered! For you are my boasting.
JER 17:15 Behold, they say to me, Where is the word of the LORD? Let it come!
JER 17:16 But I tired not following closely after you; and the day of man I desired not. You have knowledge of the things having gone forth through my lips; it is before your face.
JER 17:17 You should not be to me for alienation; but one sparing me in the evil day.
JER 17:18 May the ones pursuing me be disgraced, and may I not be disgraced myself. May they be terrified, but may I not be terrified myself. Bring upon them the wicked day! In double destruction destroy them!
JER 17:19 Thus says the LORD to me, Proceed and stand in the gates of the sons of the people, by which kings of Judah enter, and by which they go forth by them, and in all the gates of Jerusalem!
JER 17:20 And you shall say to them, Hear the word of the LORD, O kings of Judah, and all Judea, and all Jerusalem, O ones entering by these gates!
JER 17:21 Thus says the LORD, Guard your souls, and do not lift burdens on the day of the sabbaths! And you should not carry in through the gates of Jerusalem.
JER 17:22 And do not bring forth burdens from out of your residences on the day of the sabbaths! And you shall not do any work - sanctify the day of the sabbaths, as I gave charge to your fathers!
JER 17:23 And they hearkened not, and leaned not their ear, and hardened their neck over their fathers to not hear me, and to not take instruction.
JER 17:24 And it will be, if you should hearken to me, says the LORD, to not carry in burdens through the gates of this city in the day of the sabbaths, and to sanctify the day of the sabbaths, to not do any work in it,
JER 17:25 that there shall enter through the gates of this city kings and rulers sitting upon the throne of David, and mounting upon their chariots and horses, they and their rulers, the men of Judah, and the ones dwelling in Jerusalem. And this city shall be settled into the eon.

JER 17:27 And it will be if you should not hearken to me to sanctify the day of the sabbaths, of the not lifing burdens, and not entering through the gates of Jerusalem in the day of the sabbaths; then I will kindle a fire in her gates, and it shall devour the plazas of Jerusalem, and it shall not be extinguished.

JER 18:2 Rise up and go down unto the house of the potter, and there you shall hear my words!
JER 18:3 And I went down unto the house of the potter. And behold, he was making a work upon the stones.
JER 18:4 And the vessel failed, which he was making with his hands. And again he made it into another vessel as was pleasing before him to make.
JER 18:5 And came to pass the word of the LORD to me, saying,
JER 18:6 Shall as this potter I not be able to make you, O house of Israel, says the LORD? Behold, as the mortar in the hand of the potter, so are you in my hands, O house of Israel.
JER 18:7 At end I shall speak unto a nation or unto a kingdom to lift them away, and to destroy them.
JER 18:8 But should that nation turn from their evils, then I shall change my mind concerning the bad things which I devised to do to them.
JER 18:9 And at end I shall speak unto a nation, and unto a kingdom to rebuild and to plant,
JER 18:10 and they do the wicked things before me, to not hear my voice, then I will change my mind concerning the good things which I spoke to do for them.
JER 18:11 And now say to the men of Judah, and to the ones dwelling in Jerusalem! Thus says the LORD, Behold, I shape against you bad things, and I devise against you a device! Let indeed each turn from his evil way, and make your practices good and your ways!
JER 18:12 And they said, We will be manly, for after our turning, we shall go and each do the things pleasing his evil heart.
JER 18:13 On account of this, Thus says the LORD, Ask indeed among the nations! Who heard such causes for shuddering which virgin Israel did exceedingly?
JER 18:14 Shall nipples fail from the rock, or snow from the Lebanon range? Will water being brought forcibly by a wind turn aside?
JER 18:15 For my people forgot me. They burned incense in vain, and they shall weaken in their ways - eternal roads; to mount roads not having a way for going;
JER 18:16 to order up their land for extinction, and the everlasting hissing. All the ones traveling through it shall be amazed, and shall shake their head.
JER 18:17 As a burning wind I will scatter them in front of their enemies. The back, and not the front, I will show to them in a day of their destruction.
JER 18:18 And they said, Come, we should devise against Jeremiah a device, for the law shall not perish from the priest, nor counsel from the discerning, nor the word from the prophet. Come, for we should strike him in the tongue, and we shall not hear all his words.
JER 18:19 Hear me, O LORD, and hear the voice of my right action!
JER 18:20 Shall evils be recompensed for good things? For they conversed together things against my soul. Remember my standing in front of you, to speak good for them, to turn your rage from them!
JER 18:21 On account of this, give their sons to famine, and gather them into the hands of swords! Let their women become childless and widows, and let their men become men being done away with in death, and their young men falling by sword in war!
JER 18:22 Let there become a cry in their houses! You shall bring upon them robbers suddenly. For they took in hand a word to seize me, and they hid snares against me.
JER 18:23 And you, O LORD, knew all together their plan against me for death. You should not acquit their iniquities, and you should not wipe away their sins from in front of you. Let their weakness come before you! In the time of your rage deal with them!

JER 19:3 And you shall say to them, Hear the word of the LORD, O kings of Judah, and O ones dwelling Jerusalem! Thus says the LORD of the forces, the God of Israel, Behold, I bring upon this place evils, so that all hearing them - his ears shall resound.
JER 19:4 Because they abandoned me, and separated from this place; and they burned incense in it to strange gods, who they knew not and their fathers; and the kings of Judah filled this place of innocent blood.
JER 19:5 And they built high places to Baal, to incinerate their sons in fire, which I did not give charge nor spoke, and did not consider in my heart.
JER 19:6 On account of this, days come, says the LORD, and they shall not call this place still, Downfall, and Cemetery of the son of Hinnom, but Cemetery of the Slaughter.
JER 19:7 And I will slay the counsel of Judah, and the counsel of Jerusalem in this place; and I will throw them down by the sword before their enemies, and by the hands of the ones seeking their lives; and I will give their dead for food to the winged creatures of the heaven, and to the wild beasts of the earth.
JER 19:8 And I will order this city into extinction, and for a hissing. All coming upon it shall look downcast, and shall whistle over all its calamity.
JER 19:9 And they shall eat the flesh of their sons, and the flesh of their daughters; and each shall eat the flesh of his neighbor in the citadel, and in the assault in which their enemies shall assault them, and the ones seeking their life.
JER 19:10 And you shall break the pitcher before the eyes of the men going forth with you.
JER 19:11 And you shall say to them, Thus says the LORD, So I will break this people, and this city, as the earthenware container was broken, which is not able to be repaired again. And in Tophet they shall bury, for there is not a place to bury.
JER 19:12 Thus I will do, says the LORD, to this place, and to the ones dwelling in it, to yield up this city as the one having fallen into ruin.
JER 19:13 And the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses of the kings of Judah, will be as a place having fallen into ruin because of the uncleannesses in all the houses in which they burned incense upon the roofs to all the military of the heaven, and offered libations to strange gods.
JER 19:14 And Jeremiah came from DownfallTophet., where the LORD sent him there to prophesy. And he stood in the courtyard of the house of the LORD, and said to all the people,
JER 19:15 Thus says the LORD of the forces, the God of Israel, Behold, I bring upon this city, and upon all her cities, and upon her towns, all the evils which I spoke against her, for they hardened their neck to not listen to my commandments.
JER 20:1 And Pashur heard, (the son of Immer the priest; and this one was being ordained leader of the house of the LORD,) Jeremiah prophesying these words.
JER 20:2 And he struck him, and put him into the dungeon which was by the gate of the house of Benjamin, the upper, which was in the house of the LORD.
JER 20:3 And it came to pass in the next morning, and Pashur led out Jeremiah from the dungeon. And Jeremiah said to him, the LORD called not your name Pashur, but instead, Refugee.
JER 20:4 For thus says the LORD, Behold, I give you for displacement with all your friends. And they shall fall by the sword of their enemies, and your eyes shall see it. And you and all Judah I will give into the hands of the king of Babylon, and they shall displace them, and shall cut them in pieces with swords.
JER 20:5 And I will put all the strength of this city, and all its toils, and all the treasures of the king of Judah into the hands of his enemies, and they shall lead them into Babylon.
JER 20:6 And you, and all the ones dwelling in your house shall go into captivity; and in Babylon you shall die, and there you shall be entombed, you and all your friends, to whom you prophesied lies to them.
JER 20:7 You deceived me, O LORD, and I was deceived. You held, and prevailed. I became for laughter. Every day I continue being sneered at.
JER 20:8 For I shall laugh with my bitter word, I will call upon rebellion and misery; for the word of the LORD became for scorning to me, and for taunting all day.
JER 20:9 And I said, in no way shall I name the name of the LORD, and in no way shall I speak yet in his name. And it became as a burning fire blazing in my bones; and I am weakened from all sides, and I am not able to bear up.
JER 20:10 For I heard the fault of many gathering together round about, saying, Rise up together against him! And, We should rise up together against him - all his men friends. Give heed to his thought! If he should be deceived, and we shall prevail against him, then we shall take our vengeance on him.
JER 20:11 But the LORD is with me as a strengthening warrior. On account of this they pursued, but were not able to comprehend. They were shamed exceedingly; for they comprehended not their dishonor, ones which through the eon will not be forgotten.
JER 20:12 O LORD, trying just things, perceiving the kidneys and hearts, may I behold the punishment by you on them. For to you I uncovered my pleas in defense.
JER 20:13 Sing to the LORD! Praise him! For he rescued the soul of the needy from out of the hand of the most substantial ones.
JER 20:14 Cursed is the day in which I was birthed in it, the day in which my mother gave birth to me - let it not be longed for!
JER 20:15 Cursed is the man announcing good news to my father, saying, There was birthed to you a male child -- they are making merry.
JER 20:16 Let that man be as the cities which the LORD eradicated in rage, and he repented not! Let him hear the cry in the morning, and the shout at midday!
JER 20:17 For he did not kill me in the womb of my mother, for my mother to be to me my burying-place, and the womb an everlasting conception.
JER 20:18 Why is this that I came forth from out of the womb to see toils and miseries; and my days continue in shame?

JER 21:2 You ask the LORD for us! For the king of Babylon has set by us; shall the LORD do according to all his wonders, and the king shall go forth from us.
JER 21:3 And Jeremiah said to them, Thus you shall say to Zedekiah,
JER 21:4 Thus says the LORD, the God of Israel, Behold, I turn back the weapons of warfare which are in your hands, and by which you wage war with them against the Chaldeans hemming you in who are outside the wall; and I will gather them into the midst of this city.
JER 21:5 And I shall wage war myself against you with a hand being stretched out, and with a fortified arm with rage and great anger.
JER 21:6 And I will strike all the ones dwelling in this city, men and the cattle. By a great death even they shall die.
JER 21:7 And after these things, thus says the LORD, I will deliver up Zedekiah king of Judah, and his servants, and the people surviving in this city from death, and from famine, and from the sword, into the hands of their enemies seeking their lives. And they shall cut them in pieces by the mouth of the sword; I will not spare against them, and in no way shall I pity them.
JER 21:8 And you shall say to this people, Thus says the LORD, Behold, I put before your face the way of life, and the way of death.
JER 21:9 The one being settled in this city shall die by the sword and by famine; and the one going forth to join with the Chaldeans hemming you in, he shall live; and his life will be for spoils - he shall live.
JER 21:10 For I firmly fixed my face against this city for bad, and not for good, says the LORD. Into the hands of the king of Babylon it shall be delivered up, and he shall incinerate it by fire.
JER 21:11 O house of the king of Judah, hear the word of the LORD!
JER 21:12 O house of David, Thus says the LORD, Arbitrate judgment in the morning, and straighten out, and rescue the one being torn in pieces from the hand wronging him, so that my anger should not be lit as a fire, and it should be kindled, and there shall not be one extinguishing it!
JER 21:13 Behold, I am against you, O one dwelling the valley of Sor; the plain country of the ones saying, Who shall terrify us? Or who shall enter to our home?
JER 21:14 And I will look about upon you, and I will kindle a fire in her forest. And it shall devour all the things round about her.
JER 22:1 Thus says the LORD, Go, and go down to the house of the king of Judah! And you shall speak there this word.
JER 22:2 And you shall say, Hear the word of the LORD, O king of Judah, O one sitting down upon the throne of David, you and your servants, and your people, and the ones entering by these gates!
JER 22:3 Thus says the LORD, Execute equity and righteousness, and rescue the one being plundered from out of the hand of the one wronging him! And the foreigner, and orphan, and widow, do not tyrannize! And do not be impious! And you should not pour out innocent blood in this place.
JER 22:4 For if doing you should do this word, then kings shall enter in the gates of this house sitting down upon the throne of David, and mounting upon chariots, and horses, they and their children, and their people.
JER 22:5 But if you should not do these words, according to myself I swear by an oath, says the LORD, that this house will be for desolation.
JER 22:6 For thus says the LORD against the house of the king of Judah, You are Gilead to me, head of Lebanon. Should I not make you desolate cities not being dwelt in?
JER 22:7 And I will bring upon you an annihilating man, and his hewing axe. And they shall cut down your chosen cedars, and shall put them into the fire.
JER 22:8 And many nations shall go through this city. And they shall say each to his neighbor, Why did the LORD do thus to this great city?
JER 22:9 And they shall say, Because they abandoned the covenant of the LORD their God, and did obeisance to strange gods, and served to them.
JER 22:10 Do not weep for the one having died, nor lament him! Weep by weeping for the one going forth! for he shall not return again, nor shall he see the land of his fatherland.
JER 22:11 For thus says the LORD against Shallum, son of Josiah king of Judea, who reigned for Josiah his father, who came forth from out of this place, He shall not return there again.
JER 22:12 But in the place where I displaced him, there he shall die, and this land he shall not see again.
JER 22:13 O the one building his house not with righteousness, and his rooms not in equity; for to him the neighbor works without pay, and his wage in no way shall he give over to him.
JER 22:14 You built to yourself a house well-proportioned, with upper rooms ventilated, separated by windows, and being boarded by cedar, and being coated in vermilion.
JER 22:15 Should you reign because you are provoked with Ahaz your father? Shall they not eat, and shall they not drink? It is best for you to execute equity and fair righteousness.
JER 22:16 They knew not; they judged not with equity to the humble, nor with equity to the needy. Is this not because of your not knowing me, says the LORD?
JER 22:17 Behold, your eyes are not nor is your heart good. But they are for your desire for wealth, and for the pouring out innocent blood, and for offences, and for murder, to do them.
JER 22:18 On account of this, thus says the LORD against Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, Woe against this man. In no way should they lament him, saying, O brother. Nor shall they weep over him, saying, Alas, O lord.
JER 22:19 As the burial of a donkey he shall be buried; being scraped away he shall be tossed beyond the gate of Jerusalem.
JER 22:20 Ascend unto Lebanon, and cry out! And give out your voice unto Bashan, and yell unto the end of the sea! For all your lovers were defeated.
JER 22:21 I spoke to you in your transgression, and you said, I will not hearken. This is your way from your youth - you hearkened not to my voice.
JER 22:22 All your shepherds shall tend the wind, and your lovers shall go forth into captivity; for then you shall be ashamed, and shall be disgraced because of all the ones being fond of you.
JER 22:23 O one dwelling in Lebanon, nesting among the cedars, you shall groan in the griefs coming to you - pangs as one giving birth.
JER 22:24 As I live, says the LORD, Though in coming to pass Coniah son of Jehoiakim king of Judah should become a seal upon my right hand, from there will I pull you out.
JER 22:25 And I will deliver you up into the hands of the ones seeking your life, whom you are cautious from in front of them, even into the hands of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and into the hands of the Chaldeans.
JER 22:26 And I will throw you and your mother, the one giving birth to you, into a land of which you were not birthed there; and there you shall die.
JER 22:27 And unto the land which they made a vow in their souls, there in no way shall they return.

JER 22:29 O land, O land, hear the word of the LORD!
JER 22:30 Thus says the LORD, Write up this man as a man banished by public proclamation! For in no way should there be anything grown from out of his seed - a man sitting down upon the throne of David, ruling again in Judah.
JER 23:1 O the shepherds scattering and destroying the sheep of my pasture.
JER 23:2 On account of this, thus says the LORD, the God of Israel, against the shepherds tending my people; You scattered my sheep, and pushed them out, and did not visit them. Behold, I shall take vengeance upon you, against your wicked practices.
JER 23:3 And I will take in the ones remaining of my people upon all the earth of which place I pushed them there; and I shall place them into their pasture, and they shall grow and be multiplied.
JER 23:4 And I shall raise up to them shepherds tending them, and they shall not be fearful any more, nor shall they be terrified, nor shall they be seeking after, says the LORD.
JER 23:5 Behold, days come, says the LORD, and I will raise up to David a just dawn; and a king shall reign, and shall perceive, and shall execute equity and righteousness upon the earth.
JER 23:6 In his days Judah shall be delivered, and Israel shall encamp complying. And this is his name, which the LORD shall call him - Josedek.
JER 23:7 On account of this, behold, days come, says the LORD, and they will not say any longer, As the LORD lives, who led the house of Israel from out of the land of Egypt.
JER 23:8 But as the LORD lives, who led up and gathered all together the seed of Israel from the land of the north, and from all the places of which they were pushed there, and restored them unto their land.
JER 23:9 In the prophets my heart was broken; in me all my bones were shaken; I became as a man being broken, and as a man constrained by wine, from the countenance of the LORD, and from the countenance of the beauty of his glory.
JER 23:10 For the land is full of adulterers. For from the countenance of these things the land mourned; the pastures of the wilderness were dried up; and their race became wicked, and their strength not thus.
JER 23:11 For priest and prophet were tainted; and in my house I saw their wickedness, says the LORD.
JER 23:12 On account of this, let their way become to them for a slip in dimness! And they shall be tripped up, and shall fall in it. For I shall bring upon them bad things in the year of their visitation, says the LORD.
JER 23:13 And among the prophets of Samaria, I beheld violations of laws - they prophesied by Baal, and they misled my people Israel.
JER 23:14 And among the prophets of Jerusalem I have seen causes for shuddering - committing adultery, and going by lies, and taking hold of hands of wicked ones, for each to not be turned from his wicked way. They all became to me as Sodom, and the ones dwelling in it as Gomorrah.
JER 23:15 On account of this, thus says the LORD of the forces to the prophets; Behold, I will feed them grief, and I shall give them to drink bitter water; for from the prophets of Jerusalem contamination came forth to all the land.
JER 23:16 Thus says the LORD the almighty, Do not hearken to the words of the prophets prophesying to you! For they frame in folly a vision for themselves. From their heart they speak, and not from the mouth of the LORD.
JER 23:17 They say to the ones thrusting away the word of the LORD, Peace will be to you; and to all the ones going by their wants, and to all going in a delusion of his heart, Evils shall not come upon you.
JER 23:18 For who stood in the garrison of the LORD, and beheld and heard his word? Who gave ear and heard?
JER 23:19 Behold, a quaking by the LORD, and anger shall go forth in a rumbling. It shall come contracting upon the impious ones.
JER 23:20 And the rage of the LORD shall not turn away until whenever he should execute it, and until whenever he should establish it according to the enterprise of his heart. At the last of the days they shall comprehend them.
JER 23:21 I sent not the false prophets, yet they ran. I spoke not to them, and they prophesied.
JER 23:22 And if they stood with my support, and they hearkened to my words, then my people would have turned from their wicked practices.
JER 23:23 I am a God being near, says the LORD, and not a God at a distance.
JER 23:24 Shall any be hid in secret, and I not see him, says the LORD. Is it not that I shall fill the heaven and the earth, says the LORD?
JER 23:25 I heard what the prophets speak who prophesy lies by my name, saying, I dreamed a dream.
JER 23:26 For how long shall it be in the heart of the prophets prophesying lies, and in their prophesying the wants of their heart?
JER 23:27 The ones devising ways to forget my name by their dreams, which each was described to his neighbor; as their fathers forgot my name in service to Baal.
JER 23:28 The prophet by which the dream is, let him describe his dream! And the one by which my word is truly with him, let him describe my word in truth! What is the straw to the grain? Thus are my words, says the LORD.
JER 23:29 Are not my words as fire blazing, says the LORD? And as a hewing axe beating the rock?
JER 23:30 Behold, I am against the prophets, says the LORD God, the ones stealing my words each from his neighbor.
JER 23:31 Behold, I am against the prophets, says the LORD, the ones casting out prophecies of the tongue, and slumbering of their own slumber.
JER 23:32 Behold, I am against the prophets prophesying false dreams, and of whom described them, and misled my people by their lies, and in their delusions; and I sent them not, and I gave charge not to them, and they derived not a benefit for this people, says the LORD.

JER 23:34 and the prophet, and the priest, and the people, who should say, The concern of the LORD. And I will punish that man, and his house.
JER 23:35 Thus you shall say each to his neighbor, and each to his brother, What did the LORD answer? And what did the LORD speak?
JER 23:36 And the concern of the LORD name not again! For the concern to the man will be his word. And you distorted the words of the living God.
JER 23:37 Thus you shall say to the prophet, What spoke the LORD our God?
JER 23:38 On account of this, thus says the LORD, Because you said this word, The concern of the LORD, that I sent to you, saying, You shall not say, The concern of the LORD.
JER 23:39 On account of this, behold, I will take and dash you down, and the city which I have given to you and to your fathers.
JER 23:40 And I shall put upon you eternal scorn and eternal dishonor, which shall not be forgotten.

JER 24:2 The one reed basket was of exceedingly better figs as the early figs; and the other reed basket was of exceedingly bad figs which shall not be eaten, because of their badness.
JER 24:3 And the LORD said to me, What do you see, Jeremiah? And I said, Figs; the better figs are exceedingly better; and the bad ones, exceedingly bad, which shall not be eaten because of their badness.
JER 24:4 And came to pass the word of the LORD to me, saying,
JER 24:5 Thus says the LORD God of Israel, As these better figs, so shall I recognize the Jews being resettled whom I have sent out of this place into the land of the Chaldeans for good.
JER 24:6 And I shall firmly fix my eyes upon them for good, and I shall restore them into this land. And I will rebuild them, and in no way demolish; and I will plant them, and in no way will I pluck them up.
JER 24:7 And I will give them a heart for them to know me, that I am the LORD. And they will be to me for a people, and I will be to them for God. For they shall turn towards me with their entire heart.
JER 24:8 And as the bad figs which shall not be eaten because of their badness, thus says the LORD, So will I deliver up Zedekiah king of Judah, and his great men, and the rest of Jerusalem being left behind in this land, and the ones dwelling in Egypt.

JER 24:10 And I will send against them the famine, and the plague, and the sword, until whenever they should fail from the land which I gave to them, and to their fathers.

JER 26:1 In the beginning of the reign of king Jehoiakim son of Josiah came this word from the LORD.
JER 26:2 Thus said the LORD; Stand in the courtyard of the house of the LORD! And you shall execute an order to all Judah coming to do obeisance in the house of the LORD, all the words which I ordered to you to execute to them - you should not remove a thing.
JER 26:3 Perhaps they shall hear, and shall be turned each from his evil way, and I will cease from the bad things which I devise to do to them because of their evil practices.
JER 26:4 And you shall say, Thus said the LORD, If you should not hearken to me to go by my laws which I put before your face,
JER 26:5 to listen to the words of my servants the prophets, whom I sent to you at dawn, (for I sent, and you hearkened not to me;)
JER 26:6 then I will appoint this house as Shiloh; and this city I will appoint for a curse to all the nations of the earth.
JER 26:7 And they heard, (the priests, and the false prophets, and all the people,) Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of the LORD.
JER 26:8 And it came to pass of Jeremiah ceasing speaking all which the LORD ordered to him to say to all the people, that they seized him - the priests, and the false prophets, and all the people, saying, To death he shall die;
JER 26:9 for you prophesied in the name of the LORD, saying, This house will be as Shiloh, and this city shall be made desolate of ones dwelling it. And all the people held an assembly against Jeremiah in the house of the LORD.
JER 26:10 And the rulers of Judah heard these words, and ascended from out of the house of the king unto the house of the LORD, and sat in the thresholds of the new gate of the LORD.
JER 26:11 And the priests and the false prophets said to the rulers, and to all the people, A judgment of death belongs to this man, for he prophesied against this city, as you heard with your ears.
JER 26:12 And Jeremiah said to all the rulers, and to all the people, saying, The LORD sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words which you heard.
JER 26:13 And now, you make your ways better, and your works; and hearken to the voice of the LORD your God, and the LORD will cease from the evils which he spoke against you!
JER 26:14 And behold, I am in your hands. Do to me as is advantageous to you, and as best for you!
JER 26:15 But only in knowing know! that if you do away with me, you have imputed innocent blood against you, and against this city, and against the ones dwelling in it. For in truth the LORD has sent me to you to speak into your ears all these words.

JER 32:18 the one having mercy unto thousands, and recompensing sins of fathers into the bosom of their children after them; the great and strong God; the LORD of the forces, is his name;
JER 32:19 of great counsel, and mighty in works, (your eyes are opened upon all the ways of the sons of men, to give each according to his way, and according to the fruit of his practices;)

JER 32:22 And you gave to them this land which you swore by an oath to their fathers - a land flowing milk and honey.
JER 32:23 And they entered, and took it. And they hearkened not to your voice, and they did not go by your orders. All which you charged to them they did not do. And they caused all these bad things to come to pass to them.
