JER 32:26 And came to pass the word of the LORD to me, saying,
JER 32:27 I am the LORD God of all flesh. Shall anything be hidden from me?
JER 32:28 On account of this, thus said the LORD; In granting, this city shall be delivered up into the hands of Chaldeans, and into the hands of the king of Babylon, and he shall take it.
JER 32:29 And the Chaldeans shall come waging war against this city; and they shall burn this city by fire, and shall incinerate the houses in which they burned incense upon their roofs to Baal, and offered libations to other gods, to greatly embitter me.
JER 32:30 For the sons of Israel and the sons of Judah were alone doing the wicked thing in front of my eyes from their youth. The sons of Israel were the ones greatly embittering me in the works of their hands, says the LORD.
JER 32:31 For this city was for my anger and for my rage from which day they built it, and unto this day; to rid it from my face;
JER 32:32 because of all the wickedness of the sons of Israel and Judah, which they did to embitter me, they, and their kings, and their rulers, and their priests, and their prophets, the men of Judah, and the ones dwelling in Jerusalem.
JER 32:33 And they turned their back to me, and not their face. And I taught them at dawn, and they hearkened not to take instruction.
JER 32:34 And they put their defilements in the house which my name was called upon by them in their uncleannesses.
JER 32:35 And they built the shrines to Baal in the ravine of the son of Hinnom, to offer their sons and their daughters to Molech; which I ordered not to them, and it ascended not unto my heart to do this abomination, to seduce Judah to sin.
JER 32:36 And now, thus said the LORD God of Israel against this city, which you say, It shall be delivered up into the hands of the king of Babylon by the sword, and by famine, and by pestilence.
JER 32:37 Behold, I will gather them from out of all the land of which I scattered them there in my anger, and in my rage, and a great fit of temper. And I will return them unto this place, and will settle them having secured them.
JER 32:38 And they will be to me for a people, and I will be to them for God.
JER 32:39 And I will give to them another way and another heart, to fear me all the days, and for good to them, and to their children after them.
JER 32:40 And I will ordain with them an everlasting covenant which in no way shall I turn behind them. And I will put my fear in their heart, to not separate them from me.
JER 32:41 And I will visit them to do good to them. And I will plant them in this land in trust, even with all my heart, and with all my soul.
JER 32:42 For thus said the LORD, As I brought upon this people all these great bad things, so I will bring upon them all the good things which I spoke unto them.
JER 32:43 And there shall be acquired still fields in the land, in which you say, It is untrodden of men and beast; and they were delivered up into the hands of Chaldeans.
JER 32:44 And they shall acquire fields with silver. And you shall write in a scroll, and shall set a seal upon it, and shall take testimony of witnesses in the land of Benjamin, and round about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, and in the cities of the mountain, and in the cities of the Sephela, and in the cities of the Negev. For I shall return their resettlement, says the LORD.
JER 33:1 And came to pass the word of the LORD to Jeremiah a second time, (and he was still bound in the courtyard of the guard,) saying,
JER 33:2 Thus said the LORD, the one making the earth and shaping it, to re-erect it; the LORD is his name.
JER 33:3 Cry out to me, and I will answer you, and I will report to you great and mighty things which you knew them not!
JER 33:4 For thus said the LORD God of Israel, concerning the houses of this city, and concerning the houses of the king of Judah being demolished for a siege mound and battlements,
JER 33:5 to do combat against the Chaldeans, and to fill it of ones dead, of the men whom I struck in my anger, and in my rage, and turned my face from this city on account of all their wickednesses.
JER 33:6 Behold, I lead to her a closing of her wound and a cure, and I will treat them, and I will make manifest to them to hear, and I will make to them peace and trust.
JER 33:7 And I will return the resettlement of Judah and the resettlement of Israel, and will build them as prior.
JER 33:8 And I will cleanse them from all their iniquities which they sinned against me; and in no way shall I remember their sins which they sinned against me, and separated from me.
JER 33:9 And it will be to me for a name for gladness, and for praise, and for magnificence to all the people of the earth, who shall hear all the good things which I do for them. And they shall fear and shall be pricked on account of all the good things, and on account of all the peace which I make for them.
JER 33:10 Thus said the LORD, There shall still be heard in this place, (in which you say, It is desolate of men and animals, in the cities of Judah, and outside Jerusalem in the places having been made desolate by the not being a man and beast,)
JER 33:11 a voice of gladness, and a voice of joyfulness, a voice of a groom, and a voice of a bride, a voice of men saying, Make acknowledgment to the LORD almighty! For the LORD is gracious, for into the eon is his mercy. And they shall carry in gifts to the house of the LORD. For I shall return all the resettlement of that land as prior, said the LORD.
JER 33:12 Thus said the LORD of the forces, There shall yet be in this desolate place, (by reason of not being a man and cattle in all of its cities,) a lodging for shepherds bedding flocks.
JER 33:13 In the cities of the mountainous area, and in the cities of the Sephela, and in the cities of the Negev, and in the land of Benjamin, and in the places round about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, yet shall go sheep by the hand of one counting, said the LORD.
JER 33:14 Behold days come, says the LORD, and I will raise up the good word which I spoke over the house of Israel and over the house of Judah.
JER 33:15 In those days, and in that time, I will cause to sprout to David a bud of righteousness. And a king shall reign, and shall be perceiving, and shall cause equity and righteousness in the land.
JER 33:16 In those days Judah shall be delivered, and Jerusalem shall dwell securely. And this is the name they shall call him, The LORD our just one.
JER 33:17 For thus says the LORD, It shall not be deficient to David for a man sitting upon the throne of Israel.
JER 33:18 And from the priests and Levites it shall not be deficient for a man to be before me offering whole burnt offerings, and an incense gift, and doing a sacrifice all the days.
JER 33:19 And came to pass the word of the LORD to Jeremiah, saying,
JER 33:20 Thus says the LORD, If you should make my covenant as being annulled, the covenant with the day and my covenant with the night, so as for there to not be a day and a night in their time,
JER 33:21 then my covenant in being annulled will be with David my servant, so as to not be of him a son reigning upon his throne, nor with the Levites and priests of my ministration.
JER 33:22 As if the military of heaven shall not be counted, and the sand of the sea shall not be measured, thus I shall multiply the seed of David my firebrand, and of the Levites of my ministration.
JER 33:23 And came to pass the word of the LORD to Jeremiah, saying,
JER 33:24 Do you not know what this people spoke, saying, Two kin which the LORD chose, he pushed them out? And they provoked my people that you should not be a nation before them.
JER 33:25 Thus says the LORD, If my covenant may not be to the day and to the night, and laws of the heaven and of the earth, then I ordained not.
JER 33:26 Thus the seed of Jacob, and David my servant I would have banished, so as for me to not receive of his seed rulers among the seed of Abraham, and of Isaac, and of Jacob. For I shall return their captivity, and I shall show mercy on them.
JER 34:1 The word coming to Jeremiah from the LORD, and for Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and all his encamped army, and to all the kingdoms of the earth under the dominion of his hand, all the peoples waging war against Jerusalem, and against all the cities of Judah, saying,
JER 34:2 Thus said the LORD, the God of Israel; Proceed to Zedekiah king of Judah! And you shall say to him, Thus said the LORD, In delivering up, I shall deliver up this city into the hands of the king of Babylon, and he shall seize it, and shall burn it with fire.
JER 34:3 And you in no way shall be delivered from out of his hand, and by seizure you shall be seized, and into his hands you shall be given; and your eyes shall see his eyes and his mouth shall speak with your mouth, and into Babylon you shall enter.
JER 34:4 But hear the word of the LORD, Zedekiah, O king of Judah! Thus says the LORD to you, You shall not die by the broadsword.
JER 34:5 In peace you shall die, and as they burned your fathers reigning prior of you, so they shall burn also you, saying, O Lord. And they shall lament you, for I spoke the word, said the LORD.
JER 34:6 And Jeremiah spoke to king Zedekiah all these words in Jerusalem.
JER 34:7 And the force of the king of Babylon waged war against Jerusalem, and against the cities of Judah remaining, and against Lachish, and against Azekah, for these were left among the cities of Judah - fortified cities.
JER 34:8 The word coming to Jeremiah by the LORD, after the completing by king Zedekiah the covenant with the people in Jerusalem, to call indeed for a release;
JER 34:9 for each to send out his manservant, and each his maidservant - the Hebrew man and the Hebrew woman free, so that no man from Judah should slave.
JER 34:10 And all the great men heeded, and all the people entering into the covenant to send each his manservant, and each his maidservant free, to not serve any more to them. And they heeded, and let them go.
JER 34:11 And they were turned after these happenings. And they led the bondmen and the maidservants whom they sent free, and subjected them again as menservants and maidservants.
JER 34:12 And came to pass the word of the LORD to Jeremiah, saying,
JER 34:13 Thus said the LORD God of Israel, I ordained a covenant with your fathers in the day in which I rescued them from out of the land of Egypt, from out of the house of slavery, saying,
JER 34:14 Whenever six years should be fulfilled, you shall send free your Hebrew brother, who shall be sold to you; and he shall work for you six years, and then you shall send him out free. And they heard me not, and leaned not their ear.
JER 34:15 And they turned today to do the right thing before my eyes, for each to call for a release for his neighbor; and they completed a covenant in front of me, in the house of which my name is called upon in it.
JER 34:16 And you turned and profaned my covenant, to return each his manservant, and each his maidservant, whom you sent out as ones free in their soul, and subjected them again to be to you for menservants and maidservants.
JER 34:17 On account of this, thus said the LORD, You hearkened not to me to call a release - each for his brother, and each for his neighbor; behold, I call a release to you - to the sword, and to the plague, and to the famine; and I will give you for dispersion unto all the kingdoms of the earth.
JER 34:18 And I will give the men passing my covenant, the ones not establishing my covenant, which they made in front of me, the calf which they cut in two parts, and I went through in the midst of its parts,
JER 34:19 of the rulers of Judah, and rulers of Jerusalem, and mighty ones, and priests, and all the people of the land;
JER 34:20 and I will give them to their enemies, and into the hand of ones seeking their life. And their decaying flesh will be food to the winged creatures of the heaven, and to the wild beasts of the earth.
JER 34:21 And Zedekiah king of Judea, and his rulers I will give into the hands of their enemies, and into the hands of ones seeking their life, and into the hands of the force of the king of Babylon - to the ones running from them.
JER 34:22 Behold, I order it, says the LORD, and I will return them into this city. And they shall wage war against her, and shall take her, and shall incinerate her in fire; and the cities of Judah - I will make them for untrodden of ones dwelling.
JER 35:1 The word coming to Jeremiah by the LORD in the days of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, saying,
JER 35:2 Proceed unto the family of the Rechabites, and call them, and you shall bring them into the house of the LORD, into one of the courtyards, and give them wine to drink.
JER 35:3 And he led Jaazaniah son of Jeremiah, son of Habaziniah, and his brothers, and his sons, and all the family of the Rechabites.
JER 35:4 And I brought them into the house of the LORD, into the chamber of the sons of Hanan son of Igdaliah, a man of God, which is near the house of the rulers, above the house of Maaseiah the son of Shallum, the one guarding the way.
JER 35:5 And I set in front of them a clay vessel of wine, and cups, and I said, Drink wine!
JER 35:6 And they said, In no way should we drink wine, for Jonadab son of Rechab our father gave charge to us, saying, In no way shall you drink wine, you and your sons unto the eon.
JER 35:7 And in no way shall you build houses, and in now way shall you sow seed, and a vineyard shall not be to you; for in tents you shall dwell all your days, so that you should live many days upon the land, upon which you spend your time upon it.
JER 35:8 And we hearkened to the voice of Jonadab son of Rechab our father in all things which he gave charge to us, to not drink wine all the days of our life, we, and our wives, and our sons, and our daughters;
JER 35:9 for the not building houses to dwell in there, and a vineyard and a field, and seed - it happened not to us.
JER 35:10 And we lived in tents, and we hearkened, and did according to all as much as Jonadab our father gave charge to us.
JER 35:11 And it came to pass when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon ascended upon the land, that we said, In ascending, we shall enter into Jerusalem from in front of the Chaldeans, and from in front of the force of the Assyrians. And we lived there.
JER 35:12 And came to pass the word of the LORD to me, saying,
JER 35:13 Thus says the LORD of the forces, the God of Israel; Go and say to the man of Judah, and to the ones dwelling Jerusalem! In no way will you take instruction to hear my word, says the LORD.
JER 35:14 The sons of Jonadab son of Rechab established the word given charge to his children to not drink wine; and they drank not unto this day, for they hearkened to the command of their father. And I spoke to you early, and I spoke and you hearkened not.
JER 35:15 And I sent to you my servants the prophets, rising early in the morning and sending, saying, Let each turn from his evil way, and do better in your practices! And you shall not go after other gods to serve them. And you shall live upon the land which I gave to you, and to your fathers. And you leaned not your ears, and you hearkened not.
JER 35:16 But the sons of Jonadab son of Rechab established the commandment of their father, which he gave charge to them; but this people heard me not.
JER 35:17 On account of this, Thus said the LORD of the forces, the God of Israel; Behold, I bring upon Judah, and upon the ones dwelling Jerusalem all the bad things which I spoke against them. For I spoke to them, and they hearkened not. And I called them, and they answered not.
JER 35:18 And to the house of the Rechabites, Jeremiah said, Thus said the LORD, Since the sons of Jonadab son of Rechab hearkened to the commandment of their father, to do in so far as their father gave charge to them; on account of this, thus says the LORD of the forces, the God of Israel,
JER 35:19 No way shall there fail a man of the sons of Jonadab son of Rechab standing in front of me all the days.
JER 36:1 And in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah came to pass the word of the LORD to me, saying,
JER 36:2 Take to yourself a papyrus leaf scroll, and write upon it all the words which I spoke to you against Israel, and against Judah, and against all the nations from which day I spoke to you, from the days of Josiah king of Judah, and unto this day!
JER 36:3 Perhaps the house of Judah will hear all the bad things which I devise to do to them; that they should turn from their wicked way; and I will be propitious to their iniquities, and to their sins.
JER 36:4 And Jeremiah called Baruch son of Neriah. And Baruch wrote from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the LORD of which he gave a divine message to him on a papyrus paper scroll.
JER 36:5 And Jeremiah gave charge to Baruch, saying, I am guarded, and I am not able to enter into the house of the LORD.
JER 36:6 And you shall enter, and shall read with this papyrus paper scroll into the ears of the people in the house of the LORD in the day of the fast. And in the ears of all Judah coming from out of their cities, you shall read to them.
JER 36:7 Perhaps their need for mercy will fall in front of the LORD, and they will turn from their evil way. For great is the rage and the anger of the LORD which he spoke against this people.
JER 36:8 And Baruch son of Neriah did according to all which Jeremiah gave charge to him, to read in the scroll the words of the LORD in the house of the LORD.
JER 36:9 And it came to pass in the fifth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, in the ninth month, they held an assembly fast in front of the LORD, all the people of Jerusalem, and the house of Judah.
JER 36:10 And Baruch read in the scroll the words of Jeremiah in the house of the LORD, in the house of Gemariah son of Shaphan the scribe, in the upper courtyard, in the thresholds of the new gate of the house of the LORD, in the ears of all the people.
JER 36:11 And Micaiah son of Gemariah son of Shaphan heard all the words of the LORD from out of the scroll.
JER 36:12 And he went down unto the house of the king, unto the house of the scribe. And behold, there all the rulers sat - Elishama the scribe, and Delaiah son of Shemaiah, and Elnathan son of Achbor, and Gemariah son of Shaphan, and Zedekiah son of Hananiah, and all the rulers.
JER 36:13 And Michaiah announced to them all the words which he heard Baruch reading in the scroll, in the ears of the people.
JER 36:14 And all the rulers sent to Baruch, son of Neriah, the son of Jehudi, son of Nethaniah, son of Shelemiah, son of Cushi, saying, The scroll in which you read by it into the ears of the people, take it into your hand and come! And Baruch son of Neriah took the scroll in his hand, and went down to them.
JER 36:15 And they said to him, Again read for our ears! And Baruch read in their ears.
JER 36:16 And it happened as they heard all the words, each gave advice to his neighbor, and said to Baruch, By announcing, we should announce to the king all these words.
JER 36:17 And they asked Baruch, saying, From what place did you write all these words?
JER 36:18 And Baruch said, From the mouth of Jeremiah. He announced to me all these words, and I wrote upon a scroll.
JER 36:19 And the rulers said to Baruch, Proceed and be hid, you and Jeremiah! Let not a man know where you are!
JER 36:20 And they entered to the king, into the courtyard, and put the scroll to guard in the house of Elishama the scribe. And they announced to the king all these words.
JER 36:21 And the king sent Jehudi to take the scroll. And he took it from out of the house of Elishama the scribe. And Jehudi read in the ears of the king, and in the ears of all the rulers sitting around the king.
JER 36:22 And the king was sitting in the winter house in the ninth month, with a grate of fire in front of him.
JER 36:23 And it came to pass Jehudi having read three columns or four, he shred them with the razor of the scribe, and tossed into the fire upon the grate, until all the papyrus leaf vanished in the fire upon the grate.
JER 36:24 And they were not amazed, and they tore not their garments - the king and all his servants, hearing all these words.
JER 36:25 And Elnathan and Delaiah and Gemariah suggested to the king to not incinerate the papyrus paper.
JER 36:26 And he hearkened not to them. And the king gave charge to Jerahmeel son of the king, and to Seraiah son of Azriel, and Shelemiah son of Abdeel, to seize Baruch the scribe, and Jeremiah the prophet - and they were hidden.
JER 36:27 And came to pass the word of the LORD to Jeremiah, after the king incinerating the papyrus paper with all the words which Baruch wrote from the mouth of Jeremiah, saying,
JER 36:28 Again take to yourself another papyrus paper scroll, and write all the words being on the papyrus paper scroll which king Jehoaikim incinerated!
JER 36:29 And to Jehoiakim, the king of Judah, you shall say, Thus said the LORD, You incinerated this scroll, saying, Why did you write upon it, saying, In entering the king of Babylon shall enter, and shall utterly destroy this land, and shall obliterate from it man and beast.
JER 36:30 On account of this thus said the LORD against Jehoiakim king of Judah; There will not be to him one sitting down upon the throne of David; and his decaying flesh will be for tossing in the sweltering heat of the day, and in the icy coldness of the night.
JER 36:31 And I will visit against him, and against his family, and against his children their lawlessnesses. And I will bring upon them, and upon the ones dwelling in Jerusalem, and upon the land of Judah, all the evils which I spoke to them; and they heard not.
JER 36:32 And Jeremiah took another papyrus paper scroll, and he gave it to Baruch son of Neriah the scribe. And he wrote upon it from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the scroll which Jehoiakim king of Judah incinerated in fire, and still were added to it many words as these.
JER 37:1 And Zedekiah son of Josiah reigned instead of Coniah the son of Jehoiakim, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon gave reign to reign in the land of Judah.
JER 37:2 And he hearkened not, and his servants, and the people of the land, of the words of the LORD which he spoke by the hand of Jeremiah.
JER 37:3 And king Zedekiah sent Jehucal son of Shelemiah and Zephaniah son of Maaseiah the priest to Jeremiah, saying, Pray concerning us to the LORD our God!
JER 37:4 And Jeremiah came and went through the middle of the city, and they did not put him into prison.
JER 37:5 And the force of Pharaoh came forth from out of Egypt. And the Chaldeans heard the report of them, and they ascended unto Jerusalem.
JER 37:6 And came to pass the word of the LORD to Jeremiah, saying,
JER 37:7 Thus said the LORD, the God of Israel; Thus shall you say to the king of Judah, the one sending to you to inquire of me; Behold, the force of Pharaoh coming forth to you for help shall return into the land of Egypt.
JER 37:8 And the Chaldeans themselves shall return, and shall wage war against this city, and shall seize it, and shall burn it with fire.
JER 37:9 For thus said the LORD, You should not undertake the thought in your souls, saying, The Chaldeans shall depart from us running. For in no way shall they depart.
JER 37:10 And if you should strike all the force of the Chaldeans waging war against you, and there should be left behind a certain amount having been stabbed each in his place, these shall rise up, and shall burn this city by fire.
JER 37:11 And it came to pass when the force of the Chaldeans ascended from Jerusalem from in front of the force of Pharaoh,
JER 37:12 that Jeremiah came forth from Jerusalem to go into the land of Benjamin to buy from there land in the midst of the people.
JER 37:13 And he was himself in the gate of Benjamin. And there was there a man by whom he rested up, Irijah, son of Shelemiah, son of Hananiah. And he seized Jeremiah, saying, You are fleeing to the Chaldeans.
JER 37:14 And he said, It is a lie, I am not fleeing unto the Chaldeans. But he did not listen to him. And Irijah seized Jeremiah, and brought him to the rulers.
JER 37:15 And the rulers were embittered over Jeremiah, and they struck him, and sent him into the house of the prison of Jonathan the scribe - for this they made into a house of a prison.
JER 37:16 And Jeremiah came into the house of the pit, and into the confinement, and stayed there many days.
JER 37:17 And Zedekiah sent and called him. And the king asked him secretly, and said to him, Is there a word from the LORD? And he said, It is into the hands of the king of Babylon you shall be delivered up.
JER 37:18 And Jeremiah said to the king, How did I wrong you, and your servants, and this people, that you put me into a prison house?
JER 37:19 And where are your prophets, the ones prophesying to you, saying that, In no way shall the king of Babylon come unto this land?
JER 37:20 And now hear indeed, O lord, O king! Let mercy fall for me in front of you! And in no way should you return me unto the house of Jonathan the scribe, and in no way should I die there.
JER 37:21 And the king ordered, and they put him in the house of the guard, and gave to him one bread a day from outside of which they baked, until the breads failed from the city. And Jeremiah stayed in the courtyard of the guard.
JER 38:1 And Shephatiah son of Mattan heard, and Gedaliah son of Pashur, and Jucal son of Shelemiah, and Pashur son of Malchiah, the words which Jeremiah spoke unto the people, saying,
JER 38:2 Thus said the LORD, The one dwelling in this city shall die by the broadsword, and by famine, and by pestilence; and the one going forth to the Chaldeans shall live; and his life shall be for gain, and he shall live.
JER 38:3 For thus said the LORD, In being delivered up, this city shall be delivered up into the hands of the force of the king of Babylon, and he shall seize it.
JER 38:4 And the rulers said to the king, Do away with that man indeed, for he enfeebles the hands of the men waging war being left in this city, and the hands of all the people, by speaking to them according to these words. For this man does not speak oracles for peace to this people, but only evils.
JER 38:5 And king Zedekiah said, Behold, he is in your hands; for the king was not able to resist them.
JER 38:6 And they took Jeremiah, and tossed him into the pit of Malchiah, son of the king, which was in the courtyard of the guard. And they let him down with rough cords into the pit. And in the pit there was not water, but only mire, and he was in the mire.
JER 38:7 And Ebed-melech the Ethiopian eunuch man heard, (and he was in the courtyard of the king,) that they cast Jeremiah into the pit; and the king was sitting down at the gate of Benjamin.
JER 38:8 And Ebed-melech went forth from the house of the king, and spoke to the king, and said,
JER 38:9 My master, O King, all these men did wickedly in which they did against Jeremiah the prophet, dropping him into the pit, that he should die in it from the face of hunger, for there are not yet breads in the city.
JER 38:10 And the king gave charge to Ebed-melech, saying, Take with yourself from here thirty men, and lead him from out of the pit, that he should not die.
JER 38:11 And Ebed-melech took the men, and he entered into the house of the king, the subterranean part. And he took from there old rags and old rough cords, and he tossed them to Jeremiah in the pit.
JER 38:12 And he said to him, Put these underneath the rough cords! And Jeremiah did so.
JER 38:13 And they drew him with the rough cords, and led him up from out of the pit. And Jeremiah stayed in the courtyard of the guard.
JER 38:14 And the king sent, and called him to himself into the house Asaliseel, in the house of the LORD. And the king said to him, I shall ask you a word, and you shall not hide from me the saying.
JER 38:15 And Jeremiah said to the king, If I should announce to you, will you not to death put me to death? And if I shall advise you, in no way shall you hear me.
JER 38:16 And the king swore by an oath to him secretly, saying, As the LORD lives, who appointed us this life, Shall I kill you, and shall I put you into the hands of these men seeking your life? No!
JER 38:17 And Jeremiah said to him, Thus said the LORD of the forces, the God of Israel, If by going forth you should go forth to the governors of the king of Babylon, your soul shall live, and this city in no way shall be incinerated by fire; and you shall live, and your family.
JER 38:18 But if you do not go forth, this city shall be given into the hands of the Chaldeans, and they shall burn it with fire, and you in no way shall be delivered from their hands.
JER 38:19 And the king said to Jeremiah, I have a matter with the Jews having fled to the Chaldeans, lest they give me into their hands, and they shall deride me.
JER 38:20 And Jeremiah said, In no way shall they deliver you up. Hearken to the word of the LORD which I speak to you! And it will be better for you, and your soul shall live!
JER 38:21 And if you do not want to come forth, this is the word which the LORD showed to me.
JER 38:22 Behold, all the women being left behind in the house of the king of Judah having been led out to the rulers of the king of Babylon, and these women shall say, the men at peace with you deceived you and prevailed over you, and they will depose you in slips of your feet - they turned from you.
JER 38:23 And your wives, and your children they shall lead out to the Chaldeans; and you, in no way shall you be delivered, for by the hand of the king of Babylon you shall be seized, and this city shall be incinerated.
JER 38:24 And Zedekiah said to him, to Jeremiah, Let no man know of these words, and you shall in no way die!
JER 38:25 And if the rulers should hear that I spoke to you, and they should come to you, and should say to you; Announce to us what you spoke to the king, you should not hide it from us, then in no way will we do away with you; and what did the king say to you?
JER 38:26 And you shall say to them, I tossed my plead for mercy before the eyes of the king, to not return me to the house of Jonathan for me to die there.
JER 38:27 And came all the rulers to Jeremiah, and they asked him. And he announced to them according to all these words which the king gave charge to him. And they kept silent, for the true matter was not heard.
JER 38:28 And Jeremiah stayed in the courtyard of the guard until a time of which Jerusalem was seized.
JER 39:1 And it came to pass in the ninth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the tenth month, came Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and all his force against Jerusalem, and they assaulted it.
JER 39:2 And in the eleventh year of Zedekiah, in the fourth month, ninth of the month, the city was broken asunder.
JER 39:3 And all the governors of the king of Babylon entered, and sat at the gate, the one in the middle - Nergal-sharezer, Samgar, and Nebo-sarsechim, and Nebu-sarkes and Nergal, Sharezer, Rab-mag, and the rest of the governors of the king of Babylon.
JER 39:4 And it came to pass as Zedekiah king of Judah saw them, and all the men warriors, that they fled and went forth at night from the city, according to the way of the garden of the king, through the gate between the wall and the fortification around the wall. And they went forth by the way of Araba.
JER 39:5 And the force of the Chaldeans pursued after them, and seized Zedekiah on the other side of Jericho. And they led him to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon to Riblah the city in the land of Hamath. And he spoke against him with judgment.
JER 39:6 And the king of Babylon slew the sons of Zedekiah in Riblah before his eyes; and all the rulers of Judah he slew.
JER 39:7 And the eyes of Zedekiah he blinded. And he bound him with shackles, and led him unto Babylon.
JER 39:8 And the house of the king, and the houses of the people the Chaldeans set on fire with fire, and the wall of Jerusalem they demolished.
JER 39:9 And the extra of the people, and the ones being left behind in the city, and the ones falling in - they fell to the king of Babylon.
JER 39:10 And the rest of the people, and the ones being left behind, Nabuzar-adan the chief guard removed unto Babylon. And of the poor of the people who were not anything, Nabuzar-adan the chief guard left behind in the land of Judah. And he gave to them vineyards and fields in that day.
JER 39:11 And Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon gave charge concerning Jeremiah in the hand of Nebuzar-adan the chief guard, saying,
JER 39:12 Take him and put your eyes upon him! And you should not do to him anything bad; but as he should say to you, thus you shall do for him!
JER 39:13 And Nabuzar-adan the chief guard sent, and Nabushasban and Rab-sares and Nergel and Sharezer and Rab-mag and all the governers of the king of Babylon.
JER 39:14 And they sent and took Jeremiah from out of the courtyard of the guard, and gave him to Gedaliah son of Ahikam son of Shaphan, and led him out. And he sat in the midst of the people.
JER 39:15 And to Jeremiah came the word of the LORD in the courtyard of the guard, saying,
JER 39:16 Go and speak to Ebed-melech the Ethiopian! saying, Thus said the LORD God of Israel, Behold, I bring my words upon this city for bad things, and not for good things. And they shall be before you in that day.
JER 39:17 And I shall deliver you in that day, says the LORD, and I will not give you into the hands of the men whom you fear from their face.
JER 39:18 For by delivering, I shall deliver you, and by the broadsword in no way shall you fall. And your life will be for gain, for you relied upon me, says the LORD.
JER 40:1 The word coming to Jeremiah from the LORD afterwards with his being sent by Nabuzar-adan the chief guard from out of Ramah in the taking him in manacles in the midst of the resettlement of Judah, of the ones being led into Babylon.
JER 40:2 And the chief guard took him, and said to him, The LORD your God spoke these evils against this place.
JER 40:3 And the LORD did as he said, for you all sinned against him, and hearkened not to his voice, and this word happened to you,
JER 40:4 And now behold, I untied you from the manacles upon your hands. If it is good before you to come with me into Babylon - come, and I will put my eyes upon you! But if not, run from here! Behold, all the land before you is for good; and for where it is pleasing in your eyes to go there - go!
JER 40:5 And return to Gedaliah son of Ahikam son of Shaphan whom the king of Babylon established in the land of Judah, and live with him in the midst of the people! For all the places good in your eyes to go - go! And the chief guard gave to him a feast and gifts, and sent him.
JER 40:6 And he came to Gedaliah in Mizpah, and stayed in the midst of the people being left behind in the land.
JER 40:7 And all the leaders of the force in the field heard, they and their force, that the king of Babylon established Gedaliah in the land, and that they deposited to his care men, and their wives, and the simple people, and for the needy of the land, of which he resettled not in Babylon.
JER 40:8 And came to Gedaliah in Mizpah, even Ishmael son of Nethaniah, and Johanan son of Kareah, and Seraiah son of Tanhumeth, and the sons of Ephai the Netophathite, and Jezaniah son of the Maachathite - they and their men.
JER 40:9 And Gedaliah swore by an oath to them and to their men, saying, Lest you should fear from the face of the servants of the Chaldeans, dwell in the land, and work for the king of Babylon, and it will be better to you!
JER 40:10 And behold, I sit in Mizpah to stand against the face of the Chaldeans, to whom ever should come against us. And you bring together wine, and autumn fruits, and olive oil, and lay them in your receptacles, and dwell in the cities in which you held firmly!
JER 40:11 And all the Jews in Moab, and among the sons of Ammon, and the ones in Edom, and the ones in all the land, heard that the king of Babylon granted a vestige to Judah, and that he placed over them Gedaliah son of Ahikam.
JER 40:12 And all the Jews were returned from every place into which they were dispersed. And they came to Gedaliah in the land of Judah in Mizpah. And they gathered wine and autumn fruits - much, exceedingly, and olive oil.
JER 40:13 And Johanan son of Kareah, and all the governors of the force in the fields, came to Gedaliah in Mizpah.
JER 40:14 And they said to him, Do you with knowledge know that Baalis king of the sons of Ammon sent against you Ishmael son of Nethaniah to strike your life? And Gedaliah son of Ahikam trusted them not.
JER 40:15 And Johanan son of Kareah said to Gedaliah secretly in Mizpah, I will go indeed, and I shall strike Ishmael son of Nethaniah, and let no one know lest he should strike your soul, and should scatter all Judah being brought together to you, and they shall destroy the rest of Judah!
JER 40:16 And Gedaliah said to Johanan son of Kareah, You should not do this thing, for you speak lies concerning Ishmael.
JER 41:1 And it came to pass in the seventh month, came Ishmael son of Nethaniah son of Elishama, from the family of the king, and leaders of the king, and ten men with him to Gedaliah in Mizpah; and they ate bread together there.
JER 41:2 And Ishmael rose up, and the ten men who were with him, and they struck Gedaliah by sword, and killed him, whom the king of Babylon established over the land,
JER 41:3 and all the Jews being with him in Mizpah, and all the Chaldeans being found there. And Ishmael stuck the men warriors.
JER 41:4 And it came to pass in the second day of his striking Gedaliah, that not a man knew of it;
JER 41:5 And there came men of Shechem from Shiloh, and from Samaria - eighty men, being shaven of beards, and having the garments being torn, and beating their chests, and gifts and frankincense was in their hands to carry into the house of the LORD.
JER 41:6 And Ishmael son of Nethaniah came forth to meet them from Mizpah, and they went and wept. And he said to them, Enter to Gedaliah!
JER 41:7 And it happened in their entering in the midst of the city, that he slew them at the well - he and the men with him.
JER 41:8 And ten men were found there. And they said to Ishmael, You should not do away with us, for there are with us treasures in the field, wheat and barley, and honey, and olive oil. And he passed by, and did not do away with them in the midst of their brothers.
JER 41:9 And the well into which Ishmael tossed all whom he struck was a great well. This is the one which king Asa made from fear in front of Baasha king of Israel. This well Ishmael son of Nethaniah filled of slain ones.
JER 41:10 And Ishmael returned all the people being left behind in Mizpah, and the daughters of the king who the chief guard deposited in the care to Gedaliah son of Ahikam. And he set out unto the other side of the sons of Ammon.
JER 41:11 And Johanan son of Kareah heard, and all the leaders of the force with him, all the evil things which Ishmael son of Nethaniah did.
JER 41:12 And he led all their encamped army, and set out to wage war against him, and found him at the water of the great pool in Gibeon.
JER 41:13 And it came to pass when all the people with Ishmael saw Johanan son of Kareah, and all the leaders of the force with him, they were glad,
JER 41:14 and they returned to Johanan.
JER 41:15 But Ishmael escaped with eight men, and set out towards the sons of Ammon.
JER 41:16 And Johanan took, and all the leaders of the force with him, all the remnant of the people whom he returned from Ishmael son of Nethaniah from Mizpah - after his striking Gedaliah son of Ahikam - mighty men in war; and the women, and the rest of the things, and the eunuchs, whom he returned from Gibeon,
JER 41:17 and set out and stayed in Chimham by Beth-lehem, to go into Egypt,
JER 41:18 from the face of the Chaldeans. For they feared from their face; for Ishmael struck Gedaliah whom the king of Babylon established in the land.
JER 42:1 And all the leaders of the force went forward, and Johanan son of Kareah, and Jezaniah son of Hoshaiah, and all the people from small and unto great.
JER 42:2 And they said to Jeremiah the prophet, Let there fall now our need for mercy in front of you! And pray to the LORD your God concerning the rest of these! For we are left few from many, as your eyes see.
JER 42:3 And let the LORD your God announce to us, the way in which we shall go by it, and the word which we shall do!
JER 42:4 And Jeremiah the prophet said to them, I heard, behold, I will pray to the LORD our God according to your words. And it will be the word which the LORD shall answer, I will announce to you; in no way shall I hide from you a word.
JER 42:5 And they said to Jeremiah, Let the LORD be to us for a just and trustworthy witness! For according to every word which ever the LORD your God should send you to us - thus we will do.
JER 42:6 And whether if good or if bad be the voice of the LORD our God, of whom we send you to him, then we shall hearken, that it should be better to us - for we shall hearken to the voice of the LORD our God.
JER 42:7 And it came to pass after ten days, the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah.
JER 42:8 And he called Johanan son of Kareah, and the leaders of the force, and all the people, from small and unto great.
JER 42:9 And he said to them, Thus said the LORD, the God of Israel, of whom you sent me to him, that your supplication should fall before him.
JER 42:10 If staying, you should stay in this land, then I will build you, and in no way shall I demolish; and I will plant you, and in no way pluck. For I have caused rest over the hurts which I did to you.
JER 42:11 You should not be fearful from the face of the king of Babylon, of whom you fear from his face. You should not be fearful, says the LORD, for I am with you, to rescue you, and to deliver you from out of his hand.
JER 42:12 And I will grant to you an act of kindness, and will show mercy on you, and will return you unto your land.
JER 42:13 And if you say to yourselves, In no way should we stay in this land, so as to not hearken to the voice of the LORD your God,
JER 42:14 saying, Far be it, for we shall enter into the land of Egypt, and in no way should we know war, and in no way should we hear the sound of a trumpet, and in no way should we hunger in breads, and we shall live there.
JER 42:15 On account of this, hear the word of the LORD, O remnant of Judah, thus said the LORD of the forces, the God of Israel! If you should put your face unto Egypt, and should enter in there to dwell;
JER 42:16 then it shall be the broadsword which you shall fear from its face - it shall find you in Egypt; and the famine of which you have a reckoning from in front of it - it shall overtake you in Egypt, and there you shall die.
JER 42:17 And shall be all the men putting their face to enter into the land of Egypt to dwell there - they shall fail by the broadsword, and by the famine, and pestilence. And there will not be for them any one delivering from the evils which I bring upon them.
JER 42:18 For thus said the LORD of the forces, the God of Israel, As my rage dripped upon the ones inhabiting Jerusalem, so shall my rage drip upon you, on your entering into Egypt. And you shall be for an untrodden land, and under one's hands, and for a curse, and for scorning; and in no way shall you behold any longer this place,
JER 42:19 which the LORD spoke against you, the ones remaining of Judah - you should not enter into Egypt. And now, in knowing, you shall know that I witnessed to you today,
JER 42:20 that you did wickedly in your souls, sending me to the LORD your God, saying, Pray concerning us to the LORD! And according to all what ever the LORD our God should say to you, thus you tell us and we will act.
JER 42:21 And I announced to you, and you hearkened not to the voice of the LORD your God, according to all which he sent to you.
JER 42:22 And now by the broadsword, and by famine, and by pestilence, you shall end in the place in which you wanted to enter to dwell there.
JER 43:1 And it came to pass as Jeremiah ceased speaking to the people all the words of the LORD their God, which the LORD their God sent to them, even all these words.
JER 43:2 And Azariah son of Hoshaiah said, and Johanan son of Kareah, and all the proud men speaking to Jeremiah, You speak lies, The LORD our God sent you not to us, to say, You should not enter into Egypt to live in there.
JER 43:3 But Baruch son of Neriah unites with you against us, that you should give us into the hands of the Chaldeans, to put us to death, and to resettle us in Babylon.
JER 43:4 And Johanan son of Kareah, and all the leaders of the force, and all the people hearkened not to the voice of the LORD to dwell in the land of Judah.
JER 43:5 And Johanan took, and all the leaders of the force, the whole of the rest of Judah, of the ones returning from all of the nations which they were scattered there, to dwell in the land of Judah,
JER 43:6 the mighty men, and the women, and the infants remaining, and the daughters of the king, and the souls which Nabuzar-adan the chief guard left behind with Gedaliah son of Ahikam, and Jeremiah the prophet, and Baruch son of Neriah,
JER 43:7 and entered into Egypt, for they hearkened not to the voice of the LORD; and they entered into Tahpanhes.
JER 43:8 And came to pass the word of the LORD to Jeremiah in Tahpanhes, saying,
JER 43:9 Take to yourself great stones, and hide them in the thresholds in the gate of the residence of Pharaoh in Tahpanhes, in front of the eyes of the men of Judah.
JER 43:10 And you shall say, Thus said the LORD of the forces, the God of Israel, Behold, I send for, and I will bring Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon my servant, and he shall put his throne upon these stones which you hid; and he shall lift the shields upon them.
JER 43:11 And he shall enter, and shall strike the land of Egypt - whom for death unto death, and whom for resettlement unto resettlement, and whom for broadsword unto broadsword.
JER 43:12 And he shall kindle a fire in the houses of their gods, and shall set them on fire, and shall resettle them, and shall fumigate the land of Egypt as the shepherd fumigates his garment; and he shall go forth in peace.
JER 43:13 And he shall break the columns of Heliopolis, in Egypt. And the houses of the gods of Egypt he shall incinerate with fire.
JER 44:1 The word coming to Jeremiah to all the Jews dwelling in the land of Egypt, and to the ones settling in Migdol, and in Tahpanhes, and in Memphis, and in the land of Pathros, saying,
JER 44:2 Thus said the LORD of the forces, the God of Israel, You have seen all the evils which I brought upon Jerusalem, and upon the cities of Judah; And behold, they are desolate today of ones dwelling,
JER 44:3 because of the face of their wickedness of which they did to greatly embitter me; going to burn incense to other gods, which they knew not - even you, and your fathers.
JER 44:4 And I sent to you my servants the prophets early. And I sent saying, You shall not do this thing - this contamination of which I detested.
JER 44:5 And they hearkened not to me, and leaned not their ear to turn from their evils to not burn incense to other gods.
JER 44:6 And my anger dripped upon them, and my rage, and it was kindled in the cities of Judah, and outside Jerusalem. And they became for desolation and for an untrodden place, as this day.
JER 44:7 And now thus said the LORD almighty, the God of Israel; Why do you do great evils against your souls - to cut off from you man and woman, infant and one nursing, from the midst of Judah, to not leave behind for yourselves not one person;
JER 44:8 to embitter me greatly in the works of your hands, to burn incense to other gods in the land of Egypt, into which you entered to dwell there, that you should be cut off, and that you should become as a curse, and for scorning among all the nations of the earth?
JER 44:9 Have you yourselves forgotten the evils of your fathers, and the evils of the kings of Judah, and the evils of your rulers, and the evils of your wives, which they did in the land of Judah, and outside of Jerusalem?
JER 44:10 And they did not cease unto this day. And they feared not, and held not to my orders which I put in front of them, and in front of their fathers.
JER 44:11 On account of this, thus said the LORD of the forces, the God of Israel; Behold, I set my face against you for evil, to destroy all Judah.
JER 44:12 And I shall take the remnant of Judah, that established their face to enter into the land of Egypt to dwell there, and they shall all fail in the land of Egypt; and they shall fall by broadsword, and they shall fail by famine, from small unto great. And they will be for scorning, and for destruction, and for a curse.
JER 44:13 And I will visit against the ones settling in the land of Egypt, as I visited against Jerusalem by broadsword, and by famine, and by plague.
JER 44:14 And there shall not be one escaping - not one of the ones remaining of Judah sojourning in the land of Egypt, to return into the land of Judah upon which they hope in their souls to return there. In no way shall they return, except the ones escaping.
JER 44:15 And all the men answered to Jeremiah, the ones knowing that their wives burned incense to other gods, and all the women, a great gathering, and all the people settling down in the land of Egypt, in the land of Pathros, saying,
JER 44:16 The word which you spoke to us in the name of the LORD - we will not hearken to you.
JER 44:17 For in doing we will do all the matter which shall come forth out of our mouth, to burn incense to the queen of heaven, and to offer to her libations, as we did ourselves, and our fathers, and our kings, and our rulers, in the cities of Judah, and outside of Jerusalem. And we were filled of breads, and we were better off, and we did not see bad things.
JER 44:18 And as we stopped burning incense to the queen of the heaven, and offering a libation to her of a libation, we were all made less, and by broadsword and by famine we failed.
JER 44:19 And seeing that we burned incense to the queen of heaven, and offered to her libations, did we without our husbands knowledge make to her cakes, and offer libations to her?
JER 44:20 And Jeremiah said to all the people, to the mighty men, and to the women, and to all the people responding to him with words, saying,
JER 44:21 Did not, ( concerning the incense of which you burned in the cities of Judah, and outside Jerusalem, you and your fathers, and your kings, and your rulers, and the people of the land) the LORD remember and it ascended unto his heart?
JER 44:22 And the LORD was not able still to bear up from in front of the wickedness of your deeds, and from your abominations which you did; and your land became for desolation, and for an untrodden place, and for a curse, as this day,
JER 44:23 from in front of which you burned incense, and which you sinned against the LORD, and hearkened not to the voice of the LORD, and to his orders, and to his law, and did not go by his testimonies, and these evils took hold of you as this day.
JER 44:24 And Jeremiah said to the people, and to the women, Hear the the word of the LORD all Judah, the ones in the land of Egypt!
JER 44:25 Thus said the LORD God of Israel, You and your women spoke with your mouth, and fulfilled by your hands, saying, In offering, we shall offer our acknowledgment offerings which we acknowledged, to burn incense to the queen of heaven, and to offer to her libations. In adhering you adhered to your acknowledgment offerings, and the offerings which you offered.
JER 44:26 On account of this, hear the word of the LORD all Judah, the ones settling down in the land of Egypt! Behold, I swore by an oath to my great name, said the LORD. My name shall no longer be in the mouth of all Judah, to say, Live, O Lord the LORD, in all the land of Egypt.
JER 44:27 For behold, I have been vigilant against them, to inflict hurt on them, and not to do good. And all Judah dwelling in the land of Egypt shall fail by broadsword, and by famine, until whenever they should cease.
JER 44:28 And the ones escaping from the broadsword shall return into the land of Judah being few in number. And all the remnant of Judah shall know, the ones sojourning in the land of Egypt to sojourn there, whose word will adhere, mine, or theirs.
JER 44:29 And this is the sign, says the LORD, to you, that I myself will visit upon you in this place, that you should know that my words shall adhere unto you for evils.
JER 44:30 Thus said the LORD, Behold, I give Pharaoh Hophra king of Egypt into the hands of his enemy, and into the hands of ones seeking his life; as I have given Zedekiah king of Judah into the hands of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, his enemy, and the one seeking his life.
JER 45:1 The word which Jeremiah the prophet spoke to Baruch son of Neriah, when he wrote these words in the scroll from the mouth of Jeremiah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, saying,
JER 45:2 Thus said the LORD God of Israel, concerning you, O Baruch.
JER 45:3 For you said, Alas, for the LORD added toil upon my misery; I went to bed in my moanings, I did not find rest.
JER 45:4 You said to him! Thus said the LORD; Behold, What I built up I demolish, and what I planted I pluck - even all the land of mine.
JER 45:5 And you seek to yourself great things. You should not seek. For behold, I bring bad things upon all flesh, says the LORD. But I will give to you your life for gain in every place wherever you should proceed there.
JER 46:1 And came to pass the word of the LORD to Jeremiah the prophet against all nations;
JER 46:2 against Egypt, against the force of Pharoah Necho king of Egypt, who was at the river Euphrates in Carchemish, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon struck, which was in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah.
JER 46:3 Take up weapons and shields, and lead forward to battle!
JER 46:4 Saddle the horses, mount up the horsemen, and put on your helmets! Furbish the spears, and put on your chest plates!
JER 46:5 Why is it that they are terrified and retreat to the rear - for their strong ones shall be beaten; they fled a flight into exile, and they shall not return compassing round about, says the LORD.
JER 46:6 Let not the nimble flee, and let not the strong be rescued by the north! The ones by the river Euphrates are weakened, and have fallen.
JER 46:7 What is this that shall ascend as a river, even as rivers swell up by water?
JER 46:8 The waters of Egypt shall ascend as a river. And he said, I will ascend, and cover up the earth; and I will destroy the city and the ones dwelling in it.
JER 46:9 Mount upon the horses, and prepare the chariots! Let come forth the warriors of Ethiopia, and Libyans armed with shields! And ascend, O Lydians - stretch tight the bow!
JER 46:10 And that day will be to the LORD God of the forces, a day of vengeance, to take vengeance on his enemies. And the sword shall devour, and be filled, and be intoxicated from their blood. For there is a sacrifice to the LORD of Hosts upon a land of the north at the river Euphrates.
JER 46:11 Ascend to Gilead, and take balm to the virgin daughter of Egypt! In vain you multiplied your cures - there is not a benefit to you.
JER 46:12 The nations heard your voice, and the earth was filled with your cry. For warrior against warrior is weakened together - both fell.
JER 46:13 What the LORD spoke by the hand of Jeremiah the prophet concerning the coming of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon to smite the land of Egypt.
JER 46:14 Announce in Egypt, and make audible in Migdol, and exhort in Memphis! And in Tahpanhes say, Attend to, and prepare; for the sword devoured your yew tree!
JER 46:15 Why did he flee after your chosen calf? He remained not, for the LORD disabled him.
JER 46:16 And your multitude weakened and fell. And each said to his neighbor, We should rise up, and return to our people, and unto our fatherland, from the face of the Grecian sword.
JER 46:17 Call the name Pharaoh Necho king of Egypt, Saon Esbeie Moed.
JER 46:18 As I live, says the king, the LORD of the forces, for as Tabor is in the mountains, and as Carmel is by the sea, he shall come.
JER 46:19 Make for yourself items for settlement, O one dwelling, O daughter of Egypt! For Memphis will be for extinction, and shall be called, Woe, by there not existing ones dwelling in her.
JER 46:20 Egypt is a heifer being bedecked, a broken branch from the north came upon her.
JER 46:21 And her hirelings in her are as calves well fed, being maintained in her; for also they turned and fled with one accord. They did not stand, for the day of destruction came upon them, and the time of their punishment.
JER 46:22 Her voice is as a serpent hissing; for they shall go in sand. With axes they shall come upon her, as ones felling wood.
JER 46:23 You cut down her forest! says the LORD. For in no way should their number be imagined; for it is multiplied above the locust, and there is not a number to them.
JER 46:24 The daughter of Egypt shall be disgraced. She is delivered into the hands of the people from the north.
JER 46:25 Says the LORD of the forces, the God of Israel; Behold, I punish Amon her son upon Egypt, and upon her gods, and upon her kings; even upon Pharaoh, and upon the ones relying upon him.
JER 46:26 And I will give them into the hand of the ones seeking their life, and into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of his servants. And after these things it shall be as in the old days, says the LORD.
JER 46:27 But you should not be fearful, my servant Jacob, nor should you be terrified, O Israel. For behold, I deliver you from far off, and your seed from their captivity. And Jacob shall return, and shall be tranquil, and shall sleep, and there will not be one troubling him.
JER 46:28 You should not fear, my child, Jacob, says the LORD, For I am with you. For I will appoint consummation among every nation in which I led you out of there. But you in no way will I appoint to cease, and I will correct you in judgment; but I will not acquit you as innocent.

JER 47:3 from the sound of his thrust, from the hoofs of his feet, and from the quake of his chariots, the sound of his wheels. Fathers turned not unto their sons because of the feebleness of their hands,
JER 47:4 in the day, in the coming one, to destroy all the Philistines, and to obliterate Tyre and Sidon and all the rest of their helpers; for the LORD will utterly destroy the Philistines of the remnants of the islands of Cappadocia.
JER 47:5 Baldness is come upon Gaza; Ashkelon was thrown away, and the remnant of the Anakim.
JER 47:6 How long will you smite, sword of the the LORD? Until when will you not be still? Restore it unto your sheath! Cause it to rest, and be lifted away!
JER 47:7 How shall it be quiet, and the LORD gave charge to it against Ashkelon, and against the places by the sea, for the remnant to be roused.
JER 48:1 To Moab, thus said the LORD of the forces, the God of Israel; Woe unto Nebo, for it was destroyed. Kiriathaim was taken. The fortification was shamed - it was vanquished.
JER 48:2 Moab is not still prancing. In Heshbon he devised for her bad things; come, and we should cut her from being a nation, and by cessation she shall cease; a sword shall proceed behind you.
JER 48:3 For there is a voice of men crying out of Horonaim - ruin and great destruction.
JER 48:4 Moab is destroyed. Announce in Zogora!
JER 48:5 tnat Luhith is filled with weeping. It shall ascend weeping in the way of Horonaim. You heard a cry of destruction.
JER 48:6 Flee, and escape with your lives, and you shall be as a wild donkey in the wilderness!

JER 51:62 then you shall say, O LORD, you spoke against this place, to utterly destroy it, and to not be in it any dwelling from man unto beast, for it will be an extinction into the eon.
JER 51:63 And it will be whenever you shall cease to read this scroll, that you shall fasten upon it a stone, and shall toss it into the midst of the Euphrates.
JER 51:64 And shall say, So shall Babylon descend, and in no way shall she rise up from in front of the evils which I bring upon her, and it shall vanish. Until this are the words of Jeremiah.
JER 52:1 Being the twentieth and one year of Zedekiah in his taking reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And the name of his mother was Hamutal daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
JER 52:2 And he did the wicked thing before the LORD, according to all as much as Jehoiakim did.
JER 52:3 For the wrath of the LORD was in Jerusalem and in Judah, until of which the throwing them off from his face, and Zedekiah separated against the king of Babylon.
JER 52:4 And it came to pass in the ninth year of his kingdom, in the tenth month, on the tenth of the month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, and all his force against Jerusalem. And they encamped by it, and they built against it a rampart round about.
JER 52:5 And the city came into conflict until the eleventh year to king Zedekiah.
JER 52:6 In the fourth month, the ninth of the month, even the famine was solidified in the city, and there were not breads to the people of the land.
JER 52:7 And the city was cut through, and all the men warriors fled, and went forth by night according to the way of the gate in the middle of the wall, and the area around the wall, which was next to the garden of the king, (and the Chaldeans were upon the city round about,) and went by the way into the wilderness.
JER 52:8 And the force of the Chaldeans pursued after the king, and overtook him on the other side of Jericho; and all his servants were dispersed away from him.
JER 52:9 And they seized the king, and led him to the king of Babylon in Riblah in the land of Hamath; and he spoke to him with judgment.
JER 52:10 And the king of Babylon slew the sons of Zedekiah in front of his eyes. And all the rulers of Judah he slew in Riblah.
JER 52:11 And the eyes of Zedekiah were blinded; and he bound him in shackles, and the king of Babylon led him into Babylon, and put him into the mill house until the day of which he died.
JER 52:12 And in the fifth month, the tenth of the month, came Nabuzar-ardan the chief guard, (the one standing in front of the king of Babylon,) unto Jerusalem.
JER 52:13 And he burnt the house of the LORD, and the house of the king, and all the houses of the city; even all the great houses he burnt with fire.
JER 52:14 And every wall of Jerusalem round about was demolished by the force of the Chaldeans with the chief guard.
JER 52:15 And from the needy of the people, and the rest of the people, and the ones being left behind in the city, and the ones falling in who fell to the king of Babylon, and the extra of the multitude, the chief guard moved.
JER 52:16 And the chief guard left behind some from the poor of the land for vine dressers and for farmers.
JER 52:17 And the columns of brass in the house of the LORD, and the bases, and the brass sea in the house of the LORD, the Chaldeans broke. And they took of their brass unto Babylon.
JER 52:18 And the rim, and the bowls, and the meat hooks, and all the items of brass in which they officiated by them;
JER 52:19 even the silver things, and the snuffers, and the oil flasks, and the lamp-stands, and the incense pans, and the cups, (which was gold by gold, and which was silver by silver,) the chief guard took;
JER 52:20 even the two columns, and the one sea, and the twelve calves of brass underneath the sea, which king Solomon made for the house of the LORD. The weight of their brass was not known.
JER 52:21 And the columns - eighteen cubits was the height of the one column, and a string measure of twelve cubits surrounded it, and its thickness was of four fingers round about.
JER 52:22 And the molding upon them was of brass, and the length was five cubits, superior of the molding of the one. And a latticed work and pomegranates were upon the molding round about, all of brass. According to these things was the second column and pomegranates.
JER 52:23 And there were the pomegranates - ninety-six to the one part; and there were in all the pomegranates upon the lattice work round about a hundred.
JER 52:24 And the chief guard took Seraiah the foremost priest, and Zephaniah the priest being second, and the three of the ones guarding the way.
JER 52:25 And from the city he took one eunuch who was supervisor of the men of the warriors, and seven famous men of the ones in front of the king, being found in the city, and the scribe of the forces, acting as scribe to the people of the land, and sixty men from out of the people of the land being found in the midst of the city.
JER 52:26 And Nabuzar-ardan the chief guard took them, and led them to the king of Babylon in Riblah.
JER 52:27 And the king of Babylon struck them in Riblah in the land of Hamath. And Judah was transfered from its land.
JER 52:28 This is the people whom Nebuchadnezzar transferred in the seventh year - of Jews, three thousand and twenty-three.
JER 52:29 In the eighth and tenth year of Nebuchadnezzar he transferred from Jerusalem eight hundred thirty two souls.
JER 52:30 In the third and twentieth year of Nebuchadnezzar, the chief guard transferred of Jews seven hundred forty-five souls. All the souls four thousand and six hundred.
JER 52:31 And it came to pass in the thirtieth and seventh year of the resettling of Jehoiakim king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the fifth and twentieth day of the month, Evil-merodach king of Babylon took, in the year in which he took reign, the head of Jehoiakim king Judah, and led him from out of the house of which he was guarded.
JER 52:32 And he spoke to him graciously. And he put his throne above the thrones of the kings with him in Babylon.
JER 52:33 And he changed his prison apparel. And he ate bread always in front of him all the days which he lived.
JER 52:34 And the rate always given to him by the king of Babylon continued from day to day until the day of which he died.
LAM 1:1 And it came to pass after Israel was taken captive, and Jerusalem was made desolate, Jeremiah sat down weeping, and wailed this lamentation over Jerusalem, and said, O how the city being filled with peoples sits alone; she became as a widow. Becoming filled in the nations ruling in the regions, she became for tribute.
LAM 1:2 In weeping, she wept in the night, and her tears are upon her cheeks; and their existed not the one comforting her from all of the ones loving her. All the ones being fond of her discarded her; they became to her for enemies.
LAM 1:3 Judea was displaced because of her humiliation, and because of the multitude of her servitude. She stays among the nations, she did not find rest. All the ones pursuing her overtook her in the midst of the ones afflicting.
LAM 1:4 The ways of Zion mourn, by reason of there not being ones coming to the holiday feast. All her gates have been obliterated. Her priests are groaning, her virgins are being led captive, and she is being embittered in herself.

LAM 1:6 And went forth from out of the daughter of Zion all her beauty. Her rulers became as rams not finding pasture, and not going in strength in front of the one pursuing.
LAM 1:7 Jerusalem remembered the days of her humiliation, and her repulsions - all her desirable things, as many as were from ancient days during the falling of her people into the hands of the one afflicting, and not was one helping her. In seeing her, her enemies laughed upon her displacement.

LAM 1:9 Her uncleanness is before her feet; she remembered not her end, and she was brought down enormously. There is not the one comforting her. Behold, O LORD, my humiliation, for the enemy was magnified!
LAM 1:10 The one afflicting his hand spread forth upon all the desirable things of hers. For she saw nations entering into her sanctuary - the ones which I charged them not to enter into your assembly.
LAM 1:11 All her people are groaning, seeking bread; they gave the desirable things of hers for food to restore their soul. Behold, O LORD, and look upon! For she became as one being disgraced.
LAM 1:12 All the ones coming near to you in the way turn and see if there is a pain as my pain which happened. The one uttering a sound to me humbled me - the LORD in a day of anger of his rage.
LAM 1:13 From out of his height he sent fire in my bones, and led it down. He opened and spread out a net for my feet; he turned me to the rear; he appointed me for being removed from view; an entire day for grieving.
LAM 1:14 He was vigilant concerning my acts of impiety; they are closely joined in my hands; they ascended unto my neck. My strength is weakened, for the Lord put griefs in my hands; I shall not be able to stand.
LAM 1:15 The Lord lifted away all my strong men from the midst of me. He called upon me a time to break my choice men. The LORD trod the wine vat for the virgin daughter of Judah.
LAM 1:16 Over these things I weep; my eye led down water. For far from me is the one comforting me, the one restoring my soul. My sons were obliterated, for the enemy conquered.
LAM 1:17 Zion opened and spread out her hands; there is not the one comforting her. The LORD gave charge to Jacob; round about him are the ones afflicting him. Jerusalem was as a woman sitting apart unclean in the midst of them.
LAM 1:18 The LORD is just; for I greatly embittered his mouth. Hear indeed all peoples, and behold my pain! My virgins and my young men were gone into captivity.
LAM 1:19 I called my lovers, but they misled me. My priests and my elders failed in the city, for they sought food for themselves, that they should restore their lives.
LAM 1:20 Behold, O LORD, for I am afflicted! My belly was disturbed, and my heart was turned within me; greatly embittering I was embittered. Outside the sword made me childless, as if a death in the house.
LAM 1:21 Hear indeed that I moan! There is not the one comforting me. All my enemies heard the bad things concerning me, and they rejoice that you did it. You brought on the day; you called the time; they became alike to me.
LAM 1:22 May all their evils enter before your face; and glean them in which manner they made a gleaning for all of my sins! For my moanings are many, and my heart frets.

EZE 1:1 And it came to pass in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, the fifth of the month, and I was in the midst of the captivity by the river Chebar, and the heavens were opened, and I beheld visions of God.
EZE 1:2 On the fifth of the month, this is the fifth year of the captivity of king Jehoiachin,
EZE 1:3 that the word of the LORD came to Ezekiel, the son of Buzi the priest, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the hand of the LORD came upon me.
EZE 1:4 And I beheld, and behold, a wind lifting up came from the north, and a great cloud with it, and brightness round about it, and fire flashing. And in the midst of it was as a vision of molten bronze in the midst of the fire, and brightness in it.
EZE 1:5 And in the midst was as a likeness of four living creatures. And this is their vision - a likeness of a man was unto them.
EZE 1:6 And there were four faces to the one, and four wings to the one.
EZE 1:7 And their legs were straight; and their feet feathered; and there were sparks as flashing brass; and their wings were light.
EZE 1:8 And the hand of a man was beneath their wings upon their four parts; and their faces and their wings of the four were being next to the other of the other.
EZE 1:9 And their wings turned not in their proceeding; each went opposite their face.
EZE 1:10 And the likeness of their faces was as the face of a man, and a face of a lion from out of the right to the four; and the face of a calf from out of the left to the four; and the face of an eagle to the four.
EZE 1:11 And their wings were stretching out above; to the four each, two being yoked together to one another, and two covered up upon their body.
EZE 1:12 And each to the other went in front of him. Where ever the spirit was going, they went; and they turned not.
EZE 1:13 And in the midst of the living creatures was a vision as of coals of fire burning, as the appearance of lamps twisting in the midst of the living creatures; and brightness was of the fire, and from out of the fire went forth as lightning.
EZE 1:14 And the living creatures were running and returning as the appearance of the lightning.
EZE 1:15 And I beheld, and behold, one wheel was upon the earth being next to the living creatures, to the four.
EZE 1:16 And the sight of the wheels and their action was as the sight of Tharsis stone. And there was one likeness to the four; and their work was as if it may be a wheel in a wheel.
EZE 1:17 Upon their four parts they went; they turned not in their going,
EZE 1:18 and yet their backs and height was to them. And I beheld them, and their backs were full of eyes, round about to the four.
EZE 1:19 And in the going, the living creatures went - the wheels being next to them. And in the lifting away the living creatures from the earth, the wheels lifted away.
EZE 1:20 Where ever the cloud was, there the spirit was to go. And as the living creatures went, the wheels also lifted away with them; for spirit of life was in the wheels.
EZE 1:21 In their going, the wheels went; and in their standing, the wheels stood; and in their lifting away from the earth, the wheels lifted away with them; for spirit of life was in the wheels.
EZE 1:22 And the likeness above the head of the living creatures was as a firmament as the vision of ice, being stretched out over their wings on top.
EZE 1:23 And under the firmament their wings were stretching out flapping, the other to the other - to each two covering their bodies.
EZE 1:24 And I heard the sound of their wings in their going, as the sound of much water, as the sound of a worthy one in their going, a sound of the word, as a sound of a camp; and in their standing their wings rested.
EZE 1:25 And behold, a sound far above the firmament,

EZE 29:10 On account of this, behold, I am against you, and against all your rivers, and I will give the land of Egypt unto desolation, broadsword, and destruction, from Migdol and Syene even unto the borders of the Ethiopians.
EZE 29:11 In no way shall there go through by it the foot of a man; and the foot of a beast in no way shall go through it, and it shall not be inhabited forty years.
EZE 29:12 And I will appoint her land for destruction in the midst of a land being made desolated, and her cities shall be in the midst of cities being made desolated for extinction forty years. And I will scatter Egypt among the nations, and I will winnow them among the places.
EZE 29:13 Thus says Adonai the LORD, After forty years I will gather the Egyptians from the nations of which they were dispersed there.
EZE 29:14 And I will return the captivity of the Egyptians, and I will settle them in the land of Phathros, in the land from where they were taken; and it will be a humble rule there,
EZE 29:15 more than all the rules, it shall be least to not be raised up high any more over the nations. And I will make them very few, so as for them to not be many among the nations.
EZE 29:16 And no longer will they be any more for a hope to the house of Israel, calling to mind lawlessness in their following after them. And they shall know that I am Adonai the LORD.
EZE 29:17 And it came to pass in the seventh and twentieth year, day one of the first month, came the word of the LORD to me, saying,
EZE 29:18 O son of man, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon reduced to slavery his force for a great service against Tyre. Every head was bald and every shoulder loose of hair. And a wage existed not to him, and his force was against Tyre, for the service of which they served against it.
EZE 29:19 On account of this, thus says Adonai the LORD; Behold, I give to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon the land of Egypt; and he shall despoil her spoils, and he shall plunder her plunder; and it will be the wage for his force.
EZE 29:20 In return for his ministration of which he served against Tyre, I have given to him the land of Egypt, because of as much as he worked to me, says Adonai the LORD.
EZE 29:21 In that day there shall rise up a horn to all the house of Israel, and I will give to you a mouth being opened in the midst of them; and they shall know that I am the LORD.
EZE 30:1 And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
EZE 30:2 O son of man, Prophesy and say! Thus says Adonai the LORD; O, O the day;
EZE 30:3 for the day of the LORD is near, even the day of the LORD approaches. It will be a day of cloud and a time of nations.
EZE 30:4 And a sword shall come against the Egyptians, and there will be a disturbance in the land of Ethiopia, and they shall fall being slain in Egypt, and they shall take of her abundance, and her foundations shall be cast down.
EZE 30:5 Persians, and Cretans and Lydians, and Libyans, and Ethiopians, and all the intermixed peoples, and of the sons of my covenant shall fall by the sword with them.
