EZE 30:7 And it shall be made desolate in the midst of places being obliterated, and her cities will be in the midst of cities being made desolate.
EZE 30:8 And they shall know that I am the LORD, whenever I shall appoint fire against Egypt, and all the ones helping her shall be broken.
EZE 30:9 In that day shall come forth messengers hastening to obliterate the hope of Ethiopia, and there will be a disturbance among them in the day of Egypt; for behold, it is come.
EZE 30:10 Thus says Adonai the LORD; And I will destroy the multitude of the Egyptians by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon;
EZE 30:11 he and his people with him, the pestilent ones from nations being sent to destroy the land. And they shall all empty out their swords against Egypt, and shall fill the land with slain.
EZE 30:12 And I will make their rivers desolate, and I will render the land by the hand of evil ones; and I will obliterate the land, and its fullness, by the hands of strangers. I the LORD have spoken.
EZE 30:13 For thus says the LORD God; And I will destroy the abominations, and I will rest the great ones from Memphis, and the rulers from the land of Egypt; and they will not be any longer. And I will put fear in the land of Egypt.
EZE 30:14 And I will destroy the land of Pathros, and I will put fire upon Tanis, and I will execute punishment in Diospolis.
EZE 30:15 And I will pour out my rage upon Sin, the strength of Egypt. And I will destroy the multitude of Memphis.
EZE 30:16 And I will appoint fire unto Egypt. And Sin shall be disturbed with a disturbance, and in Diospolis there will be inundation, and waters shall be dispersed.
EZE 30:17 Young men of Heliopolis and Bubastum shall fall by the sword, and the women shall go into captivity.
EZE 30:18 And in Tehaphnehes the day shall darken in my breaking there the chiefdoms of Egypt. And the insolence of her strength shall perish there. And a cloud shall cover her, and her daughters shall be led captives.
EZE 30:19 And I will execute judgment on Egypt. And they shall know that I am the LORD.
EZE 30:20 And it took place in the eleventh year, in the first month, the seventh of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
EZE 30:21 O son of man, I broke the arms of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and behold, it was not earnestly beseeched to give to him healing, to put upon him a dressing, to be given strength to take hold of the sword.
EZE 30:22 On account of this, thus says Adonai the LORD; Behold, I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and I will break his arms, the strong ones, and the ones being broken; and I will throw down his sword from out of his hand.
EZE 30:23 And I will scatter Egypt into the nations, and will winnow them into the places.
EZE 30:24 And I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and will put my broadsword into his hand. And he shall bring it upon Egypt, and shall plunder her plunder, and shall despoil her spoils.
EZE 30:25 And I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and the arms of Pharaoh shall fall; and they shall know that I am the LORD in my putting the broadsword into the hands of the king of Babylon, and he shall stretch it against the land of Egypt.
EZE 30:26 And I will scatter Egypt into the nations, and shall winnow them into the places; and they shall know that I am the LORD.
EZE 31:1 And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the third month, day one of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
EZE 31:2 O son of man, say to Pharaoh king of Egypt, and to his multitude! To whom did you liken yourself in your haughtiness?
EZE 31:3 Behold, Assyria was a cypress in Lebanon, and goodly in shoots, and dense in the protection, and high in size, and his top came into the midst of the clouds.
EZE 31:4 Water nourished him, the deep made him rise up high, she led the rivers round about his plants, and sent forth her collections of water unto all the trees of the field.
EZE 31:5 Because of this, his greatness was raised up high over all the trees of the field, and his tender branches were multiplied, and his shoots were raised up high over much water, in his stretching out.
EZE 31:6 In his shoots nested all the birds of the heaven, and underneath his tender branches all the wild beasts of the plain procreated; in his shadow dwelt all the multitude of nations.
EZE 31:7 And he became good in his height, because of the multitude of his tender branches; for his roots existed among much water.
EZE 31:8 And such cypresses in the paradise of God, and the pines were not likened to his shoots; and fir trees became not likened to his branches; every tree in the paradise of God was not likened to him in his beauty.
EZE 31:9 Because of the multitude of his tender branches I made him good in the multitude of his tender branches. And the trees of the paradise of the delicacy of God were jealous of him.
EZE 31:10 On account of this, thus says Adonai the LORD; Because you became great to greatness, and you put your top into the midst of clouds; and his heart was lifted up unto his height;
EZE 31:11 even I delivered him up into the hands of the ruler of the nations; and he caused his destruction.
EZE 31:12 And strangers utterly destroyed him, pestilent ones from the nations. And they threw him down upon the mountains. In all the ravines his tender branches fell; and his trunks were broken in every plain of the land; and all the peoples of the nations went down from his protection, and they dashed him.
EZE 31:13 All the birds of the heaven rested upon his downfall; and upon his trunks existed all the wild beasts of the field,
EZE 31:14 so that all the trees by the water should not be exalted in their greatness, and put not their top into the midst of clouds, and all the ones drinking water stand not in their height against him. All were given unto death in the depth of the earth, in the midst of the sons of men going down into the pit.
EZE 31:15 Thus says Adonai the LORD; In which day he went down into Hades, the abyss mourned him. And I attended to her rivers, and restrained the abundance of water. And Lebanon was darkened over him; all the trees of the plains were enfeebled by him.
EZE 31:16 From the sound of his downfall the nations shook, when I brought him down unto Hades with the ones going down into the pit. And all the trees of the delicacy comforted him in lowermost earth, and the chosen ones and the best ones of Lebanon, all the ones drinking water.
EZE 31:17 For also even they went down with him into Hades with the ones slain by the sword; and his seed dwelling under his protection were destroyed in the middle of their life.
EZE 31:18 To whom are you likened in power, and in glory, and in greatness among the trees of the delicacy? Go down with the trees of the delicacy into the depth of the earth! You shall sleep in the midst of uncircumcised with ones slain by sword. Thus Pharaoh and all the multitude of his strength, says Adonai the LORD.
EZE 32:1 And it took place in the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, day one of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
EZE 32:2 O son of man, take up a lamentation for Pharaoh king of Egypt! And you shall say to him, You were likened to a lion of nations, and as a dragon in the sea. And you gored in your rivers, and disturbed water with your feet, and trampled your rivers.
EZE 32:3 Thus says Adonai the LORD; And I will put my net upon you by an assembly of many peoples; and I will lead you by my hook.
EZE 32:4 And I will stretch you upon the earth; the plains shall be filled. And I shall set upon you all the birds of the heaven, and I will fill up by you all the wild beasts of all the earth.
EZE 32:5 And I will put your flesh upon the mountains, and will fill up ravines of your blood.
EZE 32:6 And I will water the earth from your excrement; from your multitude upon the mountains I will fill up the ravines from you.
EZE 32:7 And I will cover up the heaven in your being extinguished, and I will darken his stars; I will cover the sun by a cloud, and the moon - in no way shall her light appear.
EZE 32:8 All the things shining light in the heaven shall darken over you, and I will appoint darkness over your land, says the Lord the LORD.
EZE 32:9 And I will provoke to anger the heart of many peoples, whenever I lead you as a captivity into the nations, into a land which you knew not.
EZE 32:10 And many nations shall be gloomy over you; and their kings shall be amazed by a change of state in the flying of my broadsword unto their faces, the ones waiting for their downfall, from the day of your downfall.
EZE 32:11 For thus says the Lord the LORD; The broadsword of the king of Babylon shall come upon you.
EZE 32:12 With swords of giants even I shall throw down your strength, pestilent ones from all nations. And they shall destroy the insolence of Egypt, and all her strength shall be broken.
EZE 32:13 And I will destroy all her cattle from great water; and in no way shall a foot of man disturb it any more; and the track of cattle in no way shall trample it.
EZE 32:14 Then shall their waters be still, and their rivers shall go forth as oil, says Adonai the LORD.
EZE 32:15 Whenever I shall give Egypt unto destruction, and the land shall be made desolate with the fullness of her; whenever I shall scatter all the ones dwelling in her, even they shall know that I am the LORD.
EZE 32:16 There is a lamentation and they shall lament him; and the daughters of the nations shall lament him over Egypt; and over all her strength they shall lament her, says the Lord the LORD.
EZE 32:17 And it happened in the twelfth year, in the fifteenth of the month, the word of the LORD came to me saying,
EZE 32:18 O son of man, lament over the multitude of Egypt! For the daughters shall bring her down; even the nations dead into the depths of the earth, to the ones going down into the pit.
EZE 32:19 From good-looking waters descend and sleep with the uncircumcised!
EZE 32:20 Among the midst of ones slain by sword they shall fall with him, and all of his strength shall sleep.
EZE 32:21 And the giants shall say to you in the depth of the pit, You are not best. Go down and sleep with the ones uncircumcised in the midst of the ones slain by sword!
EZE 32:22 There is Assyria and all his gathering round about his grave; all slain having fallen by the sword.

EZE 32:24 There is Elam and all his force surrounding his tomb; all the slain having fallen by the sword, and the ones going down uncircumcised into the depth of the earth, putting the fear of them upon the land of life; and they took their torment with the ones going down into the pit.
EZE 32:25 In the midst of the slain.
EZE 32:26 There they put Meshech and Tubal, and all his strength surrounding his tomb; all his slain ones, all the uncircumcised ones, slain ones by the sword, the ones putting their fear upon the land of life.
EZE 32:27 And they sleep with the giants having fallen from the eon, who went down into Hades with weapons of warfare; and they put their swords under their heads, and their lawless deeds came upon their bones, for they were frightening giants during their life.
EZE 32:28 And you shall be destroyed in the midst of the uncircumcised, and shall sleep with the ones being slain by sword.
EZE 32:29 There is Edom, and her kings, and all the rulers. Assyria, the ones giving their strength to the wound of the sword; these sleep with the slain, with the ones going down into the pit.
EZE 32:30 There are the rulers of the north, all these, all the commandants of Assyria, going down with the slain; with the fear of them, and in their strength being ashamed, they sleep uncircumcised with ones slain of the sword; and they carry away their torment with the ones going down into the pit.
EZE 32:31 Those king Pharaoh shall see, and he shall be comforted over all their strength. Slain by the sword, Pharaoh and all his force, says the Lord the LORD.
EZE 32:32 For I have put the fear of him upon the land of life; yet he shall sleep in the midst of the uncircumcised with ones slain by the sword, even Pharaoh and all his multitude, says the Lord the LORD.
EZE 33:1 And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
EZE 33:2 O son of man, speak to the sons of your people! And you shall say to them, A land upon which ever I bring a broadsword - even the people of the land should take one man from out of them, and shall put him for themselves as a watchman.
EZE 33:3 And if one should behold the broadsword coming upon the land, and he should trump the trumpet, and should signify to the people,
EZE 33:4 and the one hearing shall hear the sound of the trumpet, and should not take guard, and the broadsword comes and overtakes him, his blood shall be upon his own head.
EZE 33:5 For hearing the sound of the trumpet, he did not take guard; his blood shall be upon him. But this one that guarded rescued his life.
EZE 33:6 And the watchman, if he should behold the broadsword coming, and should not signify by the trumpet, and the people should not take guard; and coming, the broadsword should take from out of them a soul, this soul is taken on account of its lawlessness; but the blood of the hand of the watchman I will require.
EZE 33:7 And you, O son of man, I have appointed you as watchman to the house of Israel; and you shall hear a word from out of my mouth, and you shall announce to them from me.
EZE 33:8 And in my saying to the sinner, To death you shall die; and you should not speak to guard the impious one from his way, he, the lawless one, shall die of his lawlessness; but his blood I will require of your hand.
EZE 33:9 But you, if you should forewarn the impious one of his way to turn from it; and he should not turn from his way, this one shall die in his impiety; but you rescued your own soul.
EZE 33:10 And you, O son of man, say to the house of Israel! Thus you spoke, saying, Our delusions and our lawless deeds are upon us, and in them we melt away - and how then shall we live?
EZE 33:11 Say to them! As I live, says Adonai the LORD, I want not the death of the impious one; but as for the impious one to turn from his way, and for him to live. By turning you turn from your evil way! For why do you die, O house of Israel?
EZE 33:12 And you, O son of man, say to the sons of your people! The righteousness of a just one in no way should rescue him, in which ever day he should wander. And the lawlessness of an impious one - in no way should he inflict evil on him in which ever day he should turn from his lawlessness. But a just one in no way shall be able to be delivered in the day of his sin.
EZE 33:13 In my saying to the just one he shall live to life; and this one has relied upon his righteousness, and should commit lawlessness, all his righteousness in no way shall be called to mind; in his iniquity in which he committed, in it he shall die.
EZE 33:14 And in my saying to the impious one, To death you shall be put to death; and he shall turn from his sin, and shall execute equity and righteousness,
EZE 33:15 and should give back collateral, and should pay back for any seizures, and should travel in the orders of life, to not do unjustly - to life he shall live, and in no way shall he die.
EZE 33:16 All his sins which he sinned in no way shall be called to mind, for he observed equity and righteousness - by them he shall live.
EZE 33:17 And the sons of your people shall say, the way of the LORD is not right. But this their way is not right.
EZE 33:18 In the turning of a just one from his righteousness, and he should commit lawless deeds - he shall die in them.
EZE 33:19 And in the sinner turning from his lawlessness, and should observe equity and righteousness - by them he shall live.
EZE 33:20 And you said, The way of the LORD is not straight. I will judge you each by his ways, O house of Israel.
EZE 33:21 And it came to pass in the twelfth year, in the tenth month, the fifth of the month of our captivity, there came to me one having escaped from Jerusalem, saying, the city is captured.
EZE 33:22 And the hand of the LORD came upon me at evening before he came. And he opened my mouth as he came to me in the morning; and in opening, my mouth was not held together any longer.
EZE 33:23 And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
EZE 33:24 O son of man, the ones inhabiting the places being made desolate upon the land of Israel, speaking, they say, Abraham was one, and he held down the land; and we, we are many; the land was given to us for a possession.
EZE 33:25 On account of this say to them! Thus says the Lord the LORD; Since you chew upon food with blood, and lift your eyes unto your abominations, and pour out blood - then shall you inherit the land?
EZE 33:26 And you stood with your broadswords, you did loathsome things, and each tainted the wife of his neighbor - then shall you inherit the land?
EZE 33:27 Thus say to them! Thus says the Lord the LORD; As I live, assuredly the ones in the places being made desolate shall fall by swords, and the ones upon the face of the plain shall be given to the wild beasts of the field for a thing to be devoured, and the ones behind the places being walled, and the ones in the caves I will kill by plague.
EZE 33:28 And I will make the land a wilderness; and the insolence of her strength shall perish; and the mountains of Israel shall be made desolate, on account of the not being anyone traveling through.
EZE 33:29 And they shall know that I am the LORD. And I will make their land wilderness; and it shall be made desolate on account of all their abominations which they did.
EZE 33:30 And you, O son of man, the sons of your people speaking concerning you by the walls and in the gatehouses of the houses, and each speaks to his brother, saying, We should come together and should hear the goings forth from the LORD.
EZE 33:31 And they come to you as a people going with one another, and sit down before you, and hear your sayings, but in no way will they do them, for the lie is in their mouth, and their heart goes after their defilements.
EZE 33:32 And should you become to them as the sound of a sweet sounding well-tuned psaltery, and they shall hear your words, but no way shall they do them,
EZE 33:33 that when ever it should come to pass, they shall say, Behold, it is come; and they shall know that a prophet was in their midst.
EZE 34:1 And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
EZE 34:2 O son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel! Prophesy, and say to the shepherds! Thus says the Lord the LORD; O shepherds of Israel, shall the shepherds graze themselves? Do not the shepherds graze the sheep?
EZE 34:3 Behold, you devour the milk, and the wool you put around yourselves, and the robust you slay, and my sheep you graze not.
EZE 34:4 The ones being weak you strengthen not, and the ill having a sickness you rejuvenated not, and the broken you did not bind up, and the one wandering you did not turn back, and the lost you did not seek after, and the strong you worked in trouble.
EZE 34:5 And my sheep were scattered on account of the not being shepherds; and my sheep became for a thing devoured by all the wild beasts of the field.
EZE 34:6 And my sheep were scattered in every mountain, and upon every high hill; and they were scattered upon the face of all the earth, and there was not one seeking after them, nor turning them back.
EZE 34:7 On account of this, O shepherds, hear the word of the LORD!
EZE 34:8 As I live, says the Lord the LORD, assuredly instead my sheep became for plunder, and my sheep became for a thing to be devoured by all the wild beasts of the plain, because of the not being shepherds; and the shepherds sought not after my sheep; and the shepherds grazed themselves, but my sheep they grazed not.
EZE 34:9 On account of this, O shepherds, hear the word of the LORD!
EZE 34:10 Thus says the Lord the LORD; Behold, I am against the shepherds; and I will require my sheep from out of their hands. And I will turn them away to not tend my sheep; and the shepherds shall not graze any longer them. And I shall rescue my sheep from out of their mouth, and they will not be themselves any longer for a thing devoured.
EZE 34:11 For thus says the Lord the LORD; Behold, I shall seek after my sheep, and I shall visit them.
EZE 34:12 As if the shepherd seeks his flock in the day whenever there might be dimness and cloud in the midst of his sheep having been parted, so shall I seek after my sheep. And I will drive them away from every place of which they were scattered there, in the day of cloud and dimness.
EZE 34:13 And I will lead them from out of the nations, and will gather them from the regions, and will bring them into their land, and will graze them upon the mountains of Israel, and in the ravines, and in every dwelling of the land.
EZE 34:14 I will graze them in good pasture on the high mountain of Israel, and their havens will be there. And they shall sleep there, and they shall rest in good luxury, and they shall graze in a plentiful pasture upon the mountains of Israel.
EZE 34:15 I will graze my sheep, and I will rest them; thus says the Lord the LORD,
EZE 34:16 The lost I will seek, and the one wandering I will return, and the one being broken I will bind, and the one faltering I will strengthen, and the strong I will guard, and I will graze them with equity.
EZE 34:17 And you, my sheep, thus says the Lord the LORD; Behold, I separate between sheep and sheep, rams and he-goats.
EZE 34:18 And is it not enough to you that you fed on the good pasture, and the rest of your pasture you trampled by your feet? And the place of water you drank, and the rest you disturbed by your feet?
EZE 34:19 And my sheep fed on the things trampled upon by your feet; and they drank the disturbed water under your feet.
EZE 34:20 On account of this, thus says the Lord the LORD; Behold, I separate between the strong sheep and weak.
EZE 34:21 With the sides and your shoulders you pushed away, and with your horns you gored, and all the faltering you squeezed out, until of which time you thrust them outside.
EZE 34:22 And I will deliver my sheep, and no way should they be yet for plunder; and I will judge between ram to ram.
EZE 34:23 And I shall raise up for them one shepherd, and he will tend them as my servant David. He will tend them, and he will be their shepherd.
EZE 34:24 And I the LORD will be to them for God, and my servant David in the midst of them a ruler; I the LORD have spoken.
EZE 34:25 And I will ordain with them a covenant of peace, and will obliterate the ferocious wild beasts from the land. And they shall dwell in the wilderness, and shall sleep in the forests.
EZE 34:26 And I will put them surrounding my mountain; and I will give rain according to its time - a rain of blessing.
EZE 34:27 And the trees in the plain will yield their fruit, and the earth shall yield her strength, and they shall dwell upon their land in a hope of peace, And they shall know that I am the LORD in my breaking the chain of their yoke; and I will rescue them from out of the hand of the ones reducing them to slavery.
EZE 34:28 And they shall not be any longer for plunder by the nations. And the wild beasts of the land no longer in any way shall eat them. And they shall dwell in hope, and there shall not be the one frightening them.
EZE 34:29 And I will raise up to them a plant of peace, and no longer shall they be ones being destroyed by hunger upon the land; and in no way they shall bear any longer the scorning of nations.
EZE 34:30 And they shall know that I am the LORD their God with them, and they are my people, O house of Israel, says the Lord the LORD.
EZE 34:31 And you are my sheep, even sheep of my pasture - you are a man, and I am the LORD your God, says the Lord the LORD.

EZE 35:6 On account of this, as I live, says the Lord the LORD; Since you sinned unto blood, even blood shall pursue you. And blood you detested, even blood shall pursue you.
EZE 35:7 And I will appoint mount Seir for a wilderness, and for being made desolate, and will destroy from it men and beasts.

EZE 35:9 I will establish you an eternal desolation, and your cities no way shall be inhabited any longer; and you shall know that I am the LORD.

EZE 35:13 And you spoke great words against me with your mouth, and you called out loud against me. Your words I heard.
EZE 35:14 Thus says the LORD, In the gladness of all the earth, I will make you a wilderness.

EZE 36:2 Thus says the Lord the LORD; Because the enemy said against you, Well done, for now the eternal desolate places became our possession.
EZE 36:3 On account of this, prophesy and say! Thus says the Lord the LORD; Because of you being dishonored, and being detested by the ones round about you, for you to be for a possession to the rest of the nations, then you ascended as a tongue of discussion, and a scorn to nations.
EZE 36:4 On account of this, O mountains of Israel, hear the word of the LORD. Thus says the LORD to the mountains, and to the hills, and to the rushing streams, and to the ravines, and to the places being made quite desolate and being obliterated, and to the cities being abandoned and became for plunder and for trampling to the surrounding nations being left behind.
EZE 36:5 On account of this, thus says the Lord the LORD; Assuredly by fire of my rage I spoke against the remaining nations, and against all Edom; for they gave my land to themselves for a possession with gladness, dishonoring lives, to obliterate in plunder.
EZE 36:6 On account of this, prophesy over the land of Israel, and say to the mountains, and to the hills, and to the ravines, and to the groves! Thus says the LORD; Behold, I in my zeal and in my rage spoke against your scorning, which nations bore to you.
EZE 36:7 On account of this, thus says the Lord the LORD; I shall lift my hand against the nations surrounding you; these shall bear their dishonor.
EZE 36:8 But you, O mountains of Israel, my people shall eat the grape and your fruit; for they are hoping to come.
EZE 36:9 For behold, I am for you, and I will look upon you, and you shall be worked and sown.

EZE 36:15 And dishonor of nations shall not be heard any longer against you, and the scorning of peoples no way shall you bear any more, and your nation shall not be childless still, says the Lord the LORD.
EZE 36:16 And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
EZE 36:17 O son of man, the house of Israel dwelt upon their land, and defiled it by their way, and by their uncleannesses. And according to the uncleanness of a woman sitting apart was their way before my face.
EZE 36:18 And I poured out my rage upon them for the blood of which they poured out upon the land; and in their abominations they tainted it.
EZE 36:19 And I scattered them into the nations, and winnowed them into the places. According to their way, and according to their sin, I judged them.
EZE 36:20 And they entered unto the nations of which they entered there. And they profaned my holy name in the their saying, These are the people of the LORD, and they went forth from out of his land.
EZE 36:21 And I spared them on account of my holy name, which the house of Israel profaned among the nations of which they entered there.
EZE 36:22 On account of this, say to the house of Israel! Thus says the Lord the LORD; Not to you do I act, O house of Israel, but because of my holy name, which you profaned among the nations of which you entered there.
EZE 36:23 And I will sanctify my great name, the one being profaned among the nations, which you profaned in the midst of them. And the nations shall know that I am the LORD, says the Lord the LORD, in my being sanctified among you before their eyes.
EZE 36:24 And I will take you from out of the nations, and I will gather you from out of all the lands, and I will bring you into your land.
EZE 36:25 And I will sprinkle upon you clean water, and you shall be cleansed from all your uncleannesses; and I will cleanse you from all your idols.
EZE 36:26 And I will put in you a new heart, and I will put a new spirit in you. And I will remove the stone heart from your flesh, and I will give to you a heart of flesh.
EZE 36:27 And I will put my spirit in you, and shall make it that you shall go by my ordinances, and you shall keep my judgments, and shall observe them.
EZE 36:28 And you shall dwell upon the land which I gave to your fathers; and you will be to me for a people, and I will be to you for God.
EZE 36:29 And I will deliver you from out of all your uncleannesses. And I will call for the grain, and will multiply it, and I will not appoint you unto famine.
EZE 36:30 And I will multiply the fruit of the tree, and the produce of the field, so that you should not take still the scorn of famine among the nations.
EZE 36:31 And you shall remember your evil ways, and your practices, the ones not good. And you shall loathe yourselves in front of them in your lawless deeds, and for your abominations.
EZE 36:32 Not for your sakes do I do this, says the Lord the LORD, it is made known to you. Be ashamed and feel remorse for your ways, O house of Israel!
EZE 36:33 Thus says the Lord the LORD, In the day in which I shall cleanse you from out of all your lawless deeds; and I will settle the cities, and desolate places shall be built up.
EZE 36:34 And the land having been obliterated shall be worked; for reason that it being obliterated according to the eyes of all traveling by.
EZE 36:35 And they shall say, That land being obliterated, has become as a garden of luxury; and the cities, the ones desolate and having been obliterated and having been razed, they sat fortified.
EZE 36:36 And the nations shall know, as many as might be left behind round about you, that I the LORD built up the places having been demolished, and planted the places having been obliterated. For I the LORD spoke, and I will act.

EZE 36:38 As holy sheep, as sheep of Jerusalem in her holiday feasts; thus the desolate cities will be full of sheep of men. And they shall know that I am the LORD.

EZE 37:3 And he said to me, O son of man, shall these bones live? And I said, O Lord, O LORD, you know these things.
EZE 37:4 And he said to me, Prophesy over these bones! And you shall say to them, O dry bones, hear the word of the LORD.
EZE 37:5 Thus says the Lord the LORD to these bones, Behold, I shall bring into you a spirit of life.

EZE 37:8 And I beheld, and behold, upon them nerves and flesh germinated, and skin ascended upon them above; but there was not a breath in them.
EZE 37:9 And he said to me, Prophesy over the wind! Prophesy, O son of man, and say to the wind! Thus says the Lord the LORD, From out of the four winds, come wind and breathe onto these dead, and let them live!

EZE 47:23 And they will be in the tribe of converts in the converts with them. There you shall give an inheritance to them, says the LORD God.

DAN 1:1 In the third year of the kingdom of Jehoiakim king of Judah came Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon unto Jerusalem, and assaulted it.
DAN 1:2 And the LORD gave into his hand Jehoiakim king of Judah, and from part of the items of the house of the LORD. And he brought them into the land of Shinar for the house of his god. And the items he carried into the house of the treasury of his god.
DAN 1:3 And the king told Ashpenaz his chief eunuch to bring in some from the sons of the captivity of Israel, and from the seed of the royalty, and from the nobles;
DAN 1:4 young men to whom there is not a blemish upon them, and good to the appearance, and perceiving in all wisdom, and knowing knowledge, and considering in intelligence, and in whom there is strength in them to stand in the house before the king, to teach them letters and the language tongue. of Chaldeans.
DAN 1:5 And the king set in order to them the thing of the day, each day from the table of the king, and from the wine of his banquet; and to maintain them for three years, and after these things to stand them before the king.
DAN 1:6 And there existed among them from out of the sons of Judah, Daniel, and Hananiah, and Mishael, and Azariah.
DAN 1:7 And the chief eunuch added names to them; to Daniel - Belteshazzar, and to Hananiah - Shadrach, and to Mishael - Meshach, and to Azariah - Abed-nego.
DAN 1:8 And Daniel put unto his heart so as in no way he should be polluted in the table of the king, and in the wine of his banquet. And he petitioned the chief eunuch so that in no way he should be polluted.
DAN 1:9 And God granted Daniel for mercy and compassion before the chief eunuch.
DAN 1:10 And the chief eunuch said to Daniel, I fear my lord the king, the one arraying your food and your drink, lest at any time he should behold your faces looking downcast more than the boys of your contemporaries; and you should condemn my head to the king.
DAN 1:11 And Daniel said to Melzar, whom the chief eunuch placed over Daniel, and Hananiah, and Mishael, and Azariah.
DAN 1:12 Test now indeed your servants ten days; and let there be given to us from seeds of the earth! And we shall eat of it, and water we shall drink.
DAN 1:13 And let our shape be seen before you, and the shapes of the boys eating at the table of the king! And as how ever you should behold, do accordingly with your servants!
DAN 1:14 And he hearkened to them, and he tested them ten days.
DAN 1:15 And after the end of the ten days their shape looked good and strong in the flesh above all the boys eating at the table of the king.
DAN 1:16 And it came to pass Melzar did away with their supper and the wine for their drink, and gave to them food of the seeds.
DAN 1:17 And God gave to them understanding and intelligence in all academics, and wisdom. And Daniel perceived in every vision and in dreams.
DAN 1:18 And after the end of the days which the king told to bring them in, that the chief eunuch brought them in before Nebuchadnezzar.
DAN 1:19 And the king spoke with them; and there was not found from out of all of them one likened to Daniel, and Hananiah, and Mishael, and Azariah; and they stood before the king.
DAN 1:20 And in every discourse of wisdom and higher knowledge, as much as the king sought from them, he found them ten-times more than all of the enchanters, and the magi being in all of his kingdom.
DAN 1:21 And Daniel existed until year one of Cyrus the king.
DAN 2:1 In the second year of the kingdom of Nebuchadnezzar, Nebuchadnezzar dreamed a dream, and his spirit was startled, and his sleep went from him.
DAN 2:2 And the king said to call the enchanters, and the magi, and the administers of potions, and the Chaldeans, to announce to the king the things of his dreams. And they came and stood before the king.
DAN 2:3 And the king said to them, I dreamed, and it startled my spirit so as to know the dream.
DAN 2:4 And the Chaldeans spoke to the king in Syriac, O king, live into the eons! You tell the dream to your servants, and the interpretation of it we shall announce!
DAN 2:5 The king answered and said to the Chaldeans, The matter departed from me. If then you should not make known to me the dream, and the interpretation of it, you will be for destruction, and your houses shall be torn in pieces.
DAN 2:6 But if the dream, and the interpretation of it, you should make known to me, gifts and favors without charge, and much honor you shall receive from me - except the dream and the interpretation of it report to me!
DAN 2:7 They answered a second time and said, Let the king tell the dream to his servants, and the interpretation of it we shall announce!
DAN 2:8 And the king answered and said, In truth I know that you buy back time, even in so far as you knew that the word departed from me.
DAN 2:9 If then the dream you should not announce to me, I know that a lying and corrupt word you agreed to speak before me until the time should go by - tell to me my dream, and I shall know that also its interpretation you shall announce to me!
DAN 2:10 Answered again the Chaldeans before the king, and they say, There is not a man upon the dry land who is able to make known the discourse of the king, in so far as every great king and ruler according to such matter asked not an enchanter, magus or Chaldean.
DAN 2:11 For the word which the king asks is heavy, and there is not another who shall announce it before the king, except the gods, which are not dwelling with any flesh.
DAN 2:12 Then the king in rage and much anger said to destroy all the wise ones of Babylon.
DAN 2:13 And the decree went forth that the wise ones be killed; and they sought Daniel and his friends to do away with.
DAN 2:14 Then Daniel answered counsel and opinion to Arioch the chief guard of the king, who came forth to do away with the wise ones of Babylon.
DAN 2:15 And he inquired of him, saying, O Ruler of the king, for what reason came forth the decree which is impudent from in front of the king? And Arioch made known the saying to Daniel.
DAN 2:16 And Daniel entered, and petitioned the king so as to give time to him, and the interpretation of it he should announce to the king.
DAN 2:17 And Daniel went into his house, and to Hananiah, and to Mishael, and to Azariah his friends, to make known the saying.
DAN 2:18 And they sought compassions from the God of heaven concerning this mystery, so that therefore Daniel and his friends should not be destroyed with the rest of the wise ones of Babylon.
DAN 2:19 Then the mystery was uncovered to Daniel in a night vision, and Daniel blessed the God of heaven.
DAN 2:20 And he said, May it be - the name of God being blessed from the eon and unto the eon; for the wisdom and the might are his.
DAN 2:21 And he changes seasons and times; he ordains kings, and changes; giving wisdom to the wise ones, and intelligence to the ones knowing understanding;
DAN 2:22 he uncovers deep and concealed things, knowing the things in the darkness, and the light is with him.
DAN 2:23 To you, O God of my fathers, I acknowledge, and praise, for wisdom and power you gave to me, and made known to me what we petitioned from you; and the matter of the king you made known to me.
DAN 2:24 And Daniel came to Arioch, whom the king appointed to destroy the wise ones of Babylon, and said to him, The wise ones of Babylon you should not destroy, but bring me before the king, and the interpretation I will announce to the king.
DAN 2:25 Then Arioch in haste brought Daniel before the king, and said to him, I found a man from out of the sons of the captivity of Judea, who will announce the interpretation to the king.
DAN 2:26 And the king answered and said to Daniel, of which the name was Belteshazzar, Are you able to announce to me the dream which I beheld, and the interpretation of it?
DAN 2:27 And Daniel answered before the king, and he said, The mystery which the king asks is not of wise ones, magi, enchanters, astrologers, to announce to the king.
DAN 2:28 But there is a God in heaven uncovering mysteries, and he made known to king Nebuchadnezzar what must take place at the last of the days. The dream of yours, and the visions of your head upon your bed, is this,
DAN 2:29 You, O king, your thoughts upon your bed ascended to what must take place after these things. And the one uncovering mysteries made known to you what must take place.
DAN 2:30 And to me there is not a wisdom being in me more than all the living, but this mystery was uncovered because of the interpretation to be made known to the king, that you should know the thoughts of your heart.
DAN 2:31 You, O king, viewed, and behold, one great image. That great image, and the aspect of it was overwhelming, standing before your face; and the vision of it was fearful.
DAN 2:32 An image of which the head was of pure gold, the hands and the breast and the arms of it silver, the belly and the thighs brass,
DAN 2:33 the shanks iron, the feet part somewhat of iron and part somewhat earthenware.
DAN 2:34 You viewed until a stone was shredded from out of the mountain without hands, and it struck the image upon the feet of iron and earthenware, and it thinned them out unto completion.
DAN 2:35 Then they were thinned out at once - the potsherd, the iron, the brass, the silver, the gold, and became as a cloud of dust from the threshing-floor at harvest; And the abundance of the wind lifted them away, and not a place was found for them. And the stone which struck the image became a great mountain, and it filled all the earth.
DAN 2:36 This is the dream; and the interpretation of it we will tell before the king.
DAN 2:37 You, O king, are king of kings; to whom the God of heaven gave a strong and fortified and honorable kingdom.
DAN 2:38 In every place where the sons of men dwell, both wild beasts of the field and birds of heaven he gave into your hand, and he placed you lord of all. You are the head of gold.
DAN 2:39 And after you shall arise another kingdom inferior of you, and a third kingdom which is the brass, which shall dominate over all the earth.
DAN 2:40 And a fourth kingdom which shall be strong as iron, in which manner iron makes fine and tames all things - so it shall be made fine and be tamed.
DAN 2:41 And that which you beheld of the feet and of the toes, part somewhat earthenware, and part somewhat of iron, will be a kingdom divided; and some from the root of iron will be in it, in which manner you beheld the iron being intermingled with the potsherd.
DAN 2:42 And the toes of the feet, part somewhat of iron and part somewhat earthenware, part of the kingdom will be somewhat strong, and some from it will be broken.
DAN 2:43 For you beheld the iron being intermingled with the potsherd; so they will be mixed together with the seed of men. But they will not be cleaving this one with this other one, as the iron intermingles not with the potsherd.
DAN 2:44 And in the days of those kings the God of heaven shall raise up a kingdom, which shall not be corrupted into the eons. And his kingdom shall not be left to another people, but it shall thin and winnow all the kingdoms, and this one shall rise up into the eons.
DAN 2:45 In which manner you beheld that from a mountain a stone was trimmed without hands, and it thinned the potsherd, the iron, the brass, the silver, the gold; the great God has made known to the king what must take place after these things. And the dream is true, and the interpretation of it trustworthy.
DAN 2:46 Then king Nebuchadnezzar fell upon his face, and did obeisance to Daniel, and said to offer a libation to him of a gift offering and of a pleasant aroma offering.
DAN 2:47 And responding, the king said to Daniel, In truth, your God, he is God of gods, and lord of the kings, and uncovering mysteries, for you were able to uncover this mystery.
DAN 2:48 And the king magnified Daniel, and gave to him great and many gifts, and established him over all the places of Babylon, and ruler of satraps over all the wise ones of Babylon.
DAN 2:49 And Daniel asked of the king, and he placed over the works of the region of Babylon, Shadrach, Meshach and Abed-nego. And Daniel was in the courtyard of the king.
DAN 3:1 Nebuchadnezzar the king made a gold image. Its height was sixty cubits, its breadth was six cubits, and he stationed it in the plain of Dura, in the region of Babylon.
DAN 3:2 And he sent to gather together the supreme leaders, and the commandants, and the toparchs, leaders, and sovereigns, and the ones in authorities, and all the rulers of the regions, to come unto the holidays of dedication of the image which Nebuchadnezzar the king stationed.
DAN 3:3 And gathered together the toparchs, supreme leaders, commandants, leaders, sovereigns, great ones, the ones in authorities, and all the rulers of the regions, to the dedication of the image which Nebuchadnezzar the king stationed. And they stood before the image which Nebuchadnezzar stationed.
DAN 3:4 And the herald yelled in strength, To you it is spoken, O nations, peoples, tribes, languages,
DAN 3:5 in which ever hour you should hear a sound of a trumpet, also flute and harp, also sambuke and psaltery, and every harmony of sound of kinds of music, in falling, you shall do obeisance to the image of gold which Nebuchadnezzar the king stationed.
DAN 3:6 And who ever should not fall to do obeisance, in that same hour shall be put into the burning furnace of fire.
DAN 3:7 And it came to pass when the peoples heard the sound of the trumpet, even flute and harp, even sambuke and psaltery, and every kind of music, in falling, the peoples, tribes, languages, did obeisance to the image of gold which Nebuchadnezzar the king stationed.
DAN 3:8 Then Chaldean men came forward, and accused the Jews. And undertaking, they said to king Nebuchadnezzar,
DAN 3:9 O king, live into the eons!
DAN 3:10 You, O king, established a decree, that every man who ever should hear the sound of the trumpet, even flute and harp, even sambuke and psaltery, and harmony of sound, and every kind of music,
DAN 3:11 and should not fall to do obeisance to the image in gold, shall be put into the burning furnace of fire.
DAN 3:12 There are men Jews whom you placed over the works of the region of Babylon - Shadrach, Meshach, Abed-nego. These men obeyed not, O king, your decree, and your gods they serve not, and to the image of gold, which you stationed, they do not do obeisance.
DAN 3:13 Then Nebuchadnezzar in rage and anger said to lead in Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego. And they led them before the king.
DAN 3:14 And Nebuchadnezzar responded and said to them, Is it truly, Shadrach, Meshach, Abed-nego, to my gods you serve not, and to the image in gold which I stationed you do not do obeisance?
DAN 3:15 Now then if it suffices readily that as whenever you should hear the sound of the trumpet, also flute and harp, also sambuke and psaltery, and harmony of sound, and every kind of music, in falling you should do obeisance to the image which I made - good. And if you should not do obeisance this hour, you shall be put into the burning furnace of fire; and who is God who shall rescue you from out of my hands?
DAN 3:16 And answered, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, saying to king Nebuchadnezzar, We have not a need concerning this matter to answer to you.
DAN 3:17 For our God in the heavens in whom we serve is able to rescue us from out of the burning furnace of fire; and from out of your hands, O king, he shall rescue us.
DAN 3:18 But if not, let it be made known to you, O king! that your gods we will not serve, and to the golden image which you stationed, we will not do obeisance.
DAN 3:19 Then Nebuchadnezzar was filled of rage, and the appearance of his face changed against Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego. And he said to burn the furnace seven-fold until which it should burn to the end.
DAN 3:20 And he told strong men of strength, shackling Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, to cast them into the burning furnace fire.
DAN 3:21 Then those men were shackled with their pantaloons, and tiaras, and leggings, and their garments. And they were thrown into the midst of the burning furnace of fire,
DAN 3:22 since the saying of the king excelled, and the furnace burned away over even extra seven-fold.
DAN 3:23 And these three - Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, fell into the midst of the burning furnace of fire, being shackled.
DAN 3:24 And Nebuchadnezzar heard their praising. And he wondered, and rose up in haste, and said to his great men, Was it not three men we threw into the midst of the fire being shackled? And they said to the king, Truly, O king.
DAN 3:25 And the king said, Here, I see four men being loose, and walking in the midst of the fire, and there is not corruption to them; and the vision of the fourth is likened to son of God.
DAN 3:26 Then Nebuchadnezzar came forward to the door of the burning furnace of fire, and said, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, O servants of God the highest, go forth and come! And went forth Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, from out of the midst of the fire.
DAN 3:27 And the satraps were brought together, and the commandants, and the toparchs, and the mighty ones of the king. And they viewed the men, for the fire dominated not their body, and the hair of their head was not ablaze, and their pantaloons did not change, and the scent of fire was not on them.
DAN 3:28 And the king did obeisance before them to the LORD. And Nebuchadnezzar the king responded, and said, Blessed be the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, who sent his angel, and rescued his servants that relied upon him, and the word of the king they changed, and they delivered up their bodies unto fire, so that they should not serve nor do obeisance to any god, except their God.
DAN 3:29 And I display a decree, Every people, tribe, language, which ever should speak blasphemy against the God of Shadrach, Meshach, Abed-nego, shall be for destruction, and their houses for ravaging, in so far as there is not another God who shall be able to rescue thus.
DAN 3:30 Then the king prospered Shadrach, Meshach, Abed-nego, in the region of Babylon.
DAN 4:1 Nebuchadnezzar the king, to all the peoples, tribes, languages, dwelling in all the land; may peace be multiplied to you.
DAN 4:2 The signs and the miracles which God the highest did with me is pleasing before me to announce to you.
DAN 4:3 As of how great his signs, and as of how mighty his wonders. His kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and his authority unto generation and generation.
DAN 4:4 I Nebuchadnezzar was prospering in my house, and thriving upon my throne.
DAN 4:5 I beheld a dream, and it threw me into fear, and I was disturbed upon my bed, and the visions of my head disturbed me.
DAN 4:6 And by me was made a decree to bring in before me all the wise ones of Babylon, so that the interpretation of the dream they should make known to me.
DAN 4:7 And the enchanters magi astrologers Chaldeans entered. And the dream I told before them; and the interpretation of it they did not make known to me,
DAN 4:8 until Daniel came, whose name was Belteshazzar, (according to the name of my God,) who has holy spirit of God within himself. And the dream I told before him, saying,
DAN 4:9 O Belteshazzar, ruler of the enchanters, whom knowing that holy spirit is in you, and concerning every mystery you are not powerless, hear the vision of my dream which I beheld, and the interpretation of it tell to me!
DAN 4:10 And the visions of my head I viewed upon my bed. And behold, a tree was in the midst of the earth, and the height of it was great.
DAN 4:11 The tree was magnified, and became strong, and its height came unto the heaven, and the extent of it into the ends of all the earth.
DAN 4:12 Its leaves were beautiful, and its fruit abundant, and a nourishment for all was in it. And underneath it encamped the wild beasts, and in its branches dwelt the birds of the heaven - from out of it all flesh was nourished.
DAN 4:13 I viewed in a vision of the night upon my bed, and behold, a sentinel, even a holy one from heaven came down.
DAN 4:14 And he spoke out loud in strength, and thus he said, Cut down the tree, and pluck off his branches, and shake off his leaves, and scatter his fruit! Let the wild beasts be shaken from beneath him, and the birds from his branches!
DAN 4:15 Only the development of his roots in the earth allow, and with a bond of iron and brass, and in the tender shoots of grass in the outside! And in the dew of the heaven he shall lay down, and his portion will be with the wild beasts in the grass of the ground.
DAN 4:16 His heart shall be changed from the ones of men, and the heart of a wild beast shall be given to him. And seven times shall change over him.
DAN 4:17 The word is through the interpretation of a sentinel, and the saying of holy ones the response; that the ones living should know that the LORD is the highest of the kingdom of men, and to whom ever it should seem good he shall give it, and he will raise up over it that which is in contempt of men.
DAN 4:18 This dream I beheld, I the king, Nebuchadnezzar. And you, O Belteshazzar, tell the interpretation! For all the wise ones of my kingdom are not able to manifest the interpretation of it to me. But you Daniel are able; for holy spirit of God is in you.
DAN 4:19 Then Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, was rendered speechless for one hour, and his thoughts disturbed him. And the king answered, and said, Belteshazzar, the dream and interpretation you hasten not! Belteshazzar answered, and said, O lord, let be the dream to the ones detesting you, and the interpretation of it for your enemies!
DAN 4:20 The tree which you beheld being magnified and strengthened, of which the height came unto the heaven, and the extent of it into all the earth,
DAN 4:21 and its leaves flourishing, and its fruit abundant, and a nourishment to all by it, and underneath it dwelt the wild beasts, and in its branches encamped the birds of the heaven -
DAN 4:22 you are, O king. For you were magnified and strengthened; and your greatness was magnified, and came unto the heaven, and your dominion unto the ends of the earth.
DAN 4:23 And that the king beheld a sentinel, and a holy one coming down from the heaven, and he said, Pluck the tree, and destroy it; only the development of his roots in the earth allow! And with a bond of iron and brass, and in the tender shoots of grass in the outside, and in the dew of the heaven he shall lodge. And his portion will be with wild beasts until of which time seven seasons should be changed over him.
DAN 4:24 This is the interpretation of it, O king, and it is an interpretation of the highest which came upon my lord the king.
DAN 4:25 And you shall be banished from men, and your dwelling will be with wild beasts. And grass as an ox they shall feed you, and from the dew of the heaven you shall lodge, and seven seasons shall change over you, until of which you should know that the highest dominates the kingdom of men, and to whomever it seems good he will give it.
DAN 4:26 And whereas they said, Allow the development of the roots of the tree in the ground - your kingdom abides to you from of which ever time you should know the heavenly authority.
DAN 4:27 On account of this, O king, let my counsel please you, and ransom your sins by charities, and your iniquities by compassions on the needy! Perhaps it will be lenient to your transgressions.
DAN 4:28 All these things came upon Nebuchadnezzar the king.
DAN 4:29 After twelve months, upon the temple of his kingdom in Babylon while walking,
DAN 4:30 the king responded, and said, Is not this Babylon the great, which I built for a house of royalty by the might of my strength, for the honor of my glory?
DAN 4:31 With the word being in the mouth of the king, a voice from heaven came, To you it is spoken, O king Nebuchadnezzar; Your kingdom went from you.
DAN 4:32 And from men they shall banish you, and your dwelling shall be with wild beasts; and grass as an ox they shall feed you, and seven seasons shall change over you, until of which you shall know that the highest dominates the kingdom of men, and to whom ever it seems good to give it.
DAN 4:33 In this hour the word was completed upon Nebuchadnezzar. And he was banished from men, and ate grass as an ox, and from the dew of the heaven his body was dipped, until his hairs were enlarged as lions' hairs, and his fingernails as birds' claws.
DAN 4:34 And after the end of the days, I Nebuchadnezzar, lifted up my eyes unto heaven, and my senses returned unto me, and to the highest I blessed, and to the one living into the eons I praised and glorified; for his authority is an eternal authority, and his kingdom is unto generation and generation.
DAN 4:35 And all the ones inhabiting the earth are considered as nothing; and according to his will he does among the force of the of heaven, and among the one dwelling the earth. And there is not one who shall act against his hand, and says to him, What did you do?
DAN 4:36 At the same time my senses returned unto me; and I came into the honor of my kingdom; and my appearance returned to me, and my sovereigns and my great men sought me; and over my kingdom I was strengthened, and more extra greatness was added to me.
DAN 4:37 Now then I Nebuchadnezzar praise and greatly exalt and glorify the king of heaven, for all his works are true, and his paths equitable; and all the ones going in pride he is able to humble.

DAN 5:2 And of drinking, Belshazzar spoke in the tasting of the wine, to bring the items of gold and of silver, which Nebuchadnezzar his father brought forth from out of the temple in Jerusalem. And they drank with them - the king, and his great men, and his concubines, and his mistresses.
DAN 5:3 And they brought the items of gold and of silver, which were brought forth from out of the temple of God in Jerusalem. And they drank with them - the king, and his great men, and his concubines, and his mistresses.
DAN 5:4 They drank wine, and they praised the gods of gold, and of silver, and of brass, and of iron, and of wood, and of stones.
DAN 5:5 In the same hour came forth fingers of the hand of a man, and wrote over against the lamp upon the whitewashed portion of the wall of the house of the king. And the king viewed the knuckles of the hand writing.
DAN 5:6 Then the appearance of the king changed, and his thoughts disturbed him, and the bonding together of his loin parted, and his knees struck together.
DAN 5:7 And the king yelled in strength to bring the magi, and the Chaldeans, and the astrologers. And he said to the wise ones of Babylon, Who ever should read this writing, and should make known its interpretation to me, purple garments shall be put on him, and the necklace of gold upon his neck, and as third in my kingdom he shall rule.
DAN 5:8 And entering were all the wise ones of the king. And they were not able to read the writing, nor to make known the interpretation to the king.
DAN 5:9 And king Belshazzar was disturbed, and his appearance changed in him, and his great men were disturbed.
DAN 5:10 And the queen entered into the house of the banquet. And the queen responded and said, O king, live into the eon! Let your thoughts not disturb you, and let not your appearance be changed!

DAN 5:12 For extra spirit is in him, and intelligence, and understanding of interpreting dreams, and reporting things held, and untying things bonded together - it is Daniel, and the king put to him the name - Belteshazzar. Now then let him be called, and its interpretation he will announce to you!

DAN 5:14 I heard concerning you, that spirit of God is in you, and vigilance and understanding and extra wisdom is found in you.
DAN 5:15 And now there entered before me the wise ones, magi, and astrologers, that they should read this writing, and the interpretation they should make known to me; but they were not able to announce to me.
DAN 5:16 And I heard concerning you, that you are able to interpret judgments. Now then, if you should be able to read this writing, and its interpretation to make known to me, purple garments shall be put on you, and the necklace of gold will be upon your neck, and as third in my kingdom you shall rule.
DAN 5:17 Then answered Daniel, and said before the king, Let your gifts be yours, and the present of your house give to another! But I shall read the writing to the king, and the interpretation of it I shall make known to you.
DAN 5:18 O king, God the highest gave the kingdom and the greatness and the honor and the glory, to Nebuchadnezzar your father.
DAN 5:19 And because of the greatness of which he gave to him, all the peoples, tribes, languages were trembling and fearing from before him. Whom he willed he did away with; and whom he willed he beat; and whom he willed he raised up high; and whom he willed he humbled.
DAN 5:20 And when his heart was raised up high, and his spirit was fortified to be prideful, he was brought down from the throne of the kingdom, and the honor was removed from him.

And grass was fed him as an ox, and his body was dipped of the dew of the heaven; until of which he knew that God the highest dominated the kingdom of men, and to whom ever it seems good he gives it.

And the God of whom your breath is in his hand, and all your ways - him you glorified not.

DAN 5:25 And this is the writing being arranged - Mene, Tekel, Peres.
DAN 5:26 This is the interpretation of the saying, Mene - God measured your kingdom, and finished it.
DAN 5:27 Tekel - it was set in the yoke balance scale, and found lacking.
DAN 5:28 Peres - your kingdom was divided, and was given to the Medes and Persians.

DAN 6:1 And it was pleasing before Darius, and he placed over the kingdom a hundred twenty satraps, for them to be in his entire kingdom.
DAN 6:2 And above them three tacticians, whom Daniel was one of them, for the satraps to render a reckoning to them, so that the king should not be troubled.
DAN 6:3 And Daniel was over them, for extra spirit was in him; and the king placed him over his entire kingdom.
DAN 6:4 And the tacticians and the satraps sought an excuse to find something against Daniel; and any excuse, and transgression, and error they did not find against him, for he was trustworthy.
DAN 6:5 And the tacticians said, We did not find against Daniel an excuse, unless it be in the laws of his God.
DAN 6:6 Then the tacticians, and the satraps stood beside the king, and said to him, O king Darius, live into the eons!
DAN 6:7 All the ones over your kingdom took counsel (commandants, and satraps, the supreme leaders, and toparchs) to establish a royal position, and to strengthen an enactment, so that whoever should ask a request from any god or man, for thirty days, except from you, O king, shall be put into the pit of the lions.
DAN 6:8 Now then, O king, establish the enactment, and display in writing how the decree of the Persians and Medes should not be changed!
DAN 6:9 Then king Darius gave orders to write the decree.
DAN 6:10 And when Daniel knew that the decree was arranged, he went into his house; and the windows were open to him in his upper rooms before Jerusalem. And three times of the day he was bending upon his knees, and praying, and making acknowledgment before his God, as he was doing before.
DAN 6:11 Then those men closely watched, and found Daniel petitioning and beseeching his God.
DAN 6:12 And coming forward, they say to the king, O king, did you not order an enactment, so that every man who ever should ask from any God or man a request unto thirty days, except from you, O king, shall be put into the pit of lions? And the king said, The word is true, and the decree of the Medes and Persians shall not pass away.
DAN 6:13 Then they responded and spoke before the king, saying, Daniel, the one from the sons of the captivity of Judea, was not submitted to your decree; and three times of the day he asks of his God the requests of his.
DAN 6:14 Then the king, as he heard the saying, fretted much over him. And concerning Daniel he struggled to rescue him; and until evening he was struggling to rescue him.
DAN 6:15 Then those men say to the king, Know, O king, that the decree of the Medes and Persians, every enactment and position which the king shall establish, must not be altered!
DAN 6:16 Then the king spoke, and they led Daniel, and they put him into the pit of the lions. But the king said to Daniel, Your God in whom you serve continually, he will rescue you.
DAN 6:17 And they brought one stone, and placed it upon the mouth of the pit, and the king set seal with his ring, and with the ring of his great men, so that the thing should not be changed with regard to Daniel.
DAN 6:18 And the king went forth unto his house, and went to bed supperless; and food was not carried in to him, and sleep left from him.
DAN 6:19 Then the king rose up in the morning at the light, and in haste came unto the pit of the lions.
DAN 6:20 And at his approaching to the pit he yelled to Daniel a strong voice, Daniel, O servant of the living God, your God in whom you serve continually, was he able to rescue you from out of the mouth of the lions?
DAN 6:21 And Daniel said to the king, O king, live into the eons!
DAN 6:22 My God sent his angel, and obstructed the mouths of the lions, and they did not lay me waste; for before him uprightness was found in me; and even before you, O king, I did not commit a transgression.
DAN 6:23 Then the king felt much good over him, and spoke for Daniel to be brought from out of the pit. And they bore Daniel from out of the pit, and all hurt was not found on him, for he trusted in his God.
DAN 6:24 And the king spoke, and they led the men accusing Daniel, and put them into the pit of the lions, and their sons, and their wives. And they came not unto the floor of the pit before the lions dominated them, and made fine all of their bones.
DAN 6:25 Then Darius the king wrote to all the peoples, tribes, and languages, living in all the earth; Peace be multiplied unto you.
DAN 6:26 From my presence I made a decree for the one in every rule of my kingdom to be trembling and fearing from the face of the God of Daniel. For he is the living God, and abiding into the eons, and his kingdom shall not be destroyed, and his dominion is unto the end.
DAN 6:27 He takes hold of and rescues, and produces signs and miracles in the heaven and upon the earth, who rescued Daniel from out of the mouth of the lions.
DAN 6:28 And Daniel prospered during the kingdom of Darius, and during the kingdom of Cyrus the Persian.
DAN 7:1 In the first year of Belshazzar king of the Chaldeans, Daniel beheld a dream, and visions of his head upon his bed. And he wrote his dream, and the total sum of the words he said,
DAN 7:2 I Daniel viewed in my vision of the night, and behold, the four winds of the heaven struck up in the great sea.
DAN 7:3 And four great wild beasts ascended from out of the sea, differing from one another.
DAN 7:4 The first was as a lioness, and her wings were of an eagle. I viewed until of which her wings were plucked, and she was lifted away from the earth, and upon the feet of a man she stood, and the heart of a man was given to her.
DAN 7:5 And behold, a second wild beast likened to a bear, and on one part she stood, and three ribs were in her mouth in between her teeth. And so they said to her, Rise up, eat much flesh!
DAN 7:6 After it I viewed, and behold, another wild beast as a leopard; and to her were four wings of a bird above her; and four heads were to the wild beast; and authority was given to her.
DAN 7:7 After this I viewed, and behold a fourth wild beast, fearful and utterly astonishing, and extremely great; and its teeth iron, strong, eating, and making fine, and the rest with its feet it trampled. And it was extremely diverse from all the wild beasts before it; and ten horns were to it.
DAN 7:8 I paid attention to its horns, and behold, another small horn ascended in the midst of them, and three horns prior to it were rooted out from in front of it. And behold, eyes as eyes of a man were in this horn, and a mouth speaking great things.
DAN 7:9 I viewed until when thrones were set, and the old one of days sat down. And his garment was as snow - white, and the hair of his head was as pure wool. His throne a flame of fire, his wheels as fire blazing.
DAN 7:10 A river of fire drew exiting before him. A thousand thousands ministering to him, and ten thousand ten thousands were present before him. A judgment seat was set, and books were opened.
DAN 7:11 I viewed then because of a voice of the great words which that horn spoke, until the wild beast was done away with, and destroyed, and its body was given unto burning fire.
DAN 7:12 And the rule of the rest of the wild beasts was changed over, and a duration of life was given to them until a time and a season.
DAN 7:13 I viewed in a vision of the night, and behold, with the clouds of the heaven, and one as son of man was coming. And he came unto the old one of days, and was brought before him.
DAN 7:14 And to him was given the rule, and the honor, and the kingdom; and all the peoples, tribes, and languages shall serve to him. His authority is an eternal authority, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom shall not be destroyed.
DAN 7:15 My spirit shuddered, I Daniel, in my manner, and the visions of my head disturbed me.
DAN 7:16 And I came forward to one of the ones standing, and the exactness I sought of him to learn concerning all these things. And he spoke to me the exactness, and the interpretation of the words he made known to me.
DAN 7:17 These four great wild beasts - four kingdoms shall rise up upon the earth,
DAN 7:18 The ones shall be lifted away, and holy ones of the highest shall take to themselves the kingdom; and they shall hold it unto the eon, and unto the eon of the eons.
DAN 7:19 And I sought exactly concerning the fourth wild beast, that was diverse from every wild beast, extremely fearsome, its teeth of iron, and its fingernails of brass; devouring, and making fine, and it trampled upon the rest with its feet.
DAN 7:20 And concerning the horns of it, of the ten in his head, and of the other ascending and shaking off the former three - that horn in which the eyes and mouth spoke great things, and the sight of it was greater than the rest,
DAN 7:21 I viewed, and that horn made war with the holy ones, and prevailed against them,
DAN 7:22 until of which the old one of days came, and gave judgment to holy ones of the highest; and the time came, and the holy ones took control of the kingdom.
DAN 7:23 And he said, The fourth wild beast will be a fourth kingdom on the earth, which shall excel all the kingdoms, and shall devour all the earth, and shall trample upon it and cut it in pieces.
DAN 7:24 And the ten horns of it are ten kings, and they shall rise up. And after them shall rise up another who shall overwhelm all the ones prior, and three kings he shall humble.
DAN 7:25 And words against the highest he shall speak, and the holy ones of the highest he shall mislead, and shall be of the opinion to change times and law. And it shall be granted in his hand until a time and times and half a time.
DAN 7:26 And the judgment seat he shall set, and the rule shall change over to remove it from view, and to destroy it until the end.
DAN 7:27 And the kingdom, and the authority, and the greatness of the kings underneath all the heaven, was given to holy ones of the highest. And his kingdom is an eternal kingdom, and all the sovereignties shall serve and obey him.
DAN 7:28 Unto here is the end of the matter. I Daniel, very much the thoughts of mine disturbed me, and my appearance changed upon me; and the matter I preserved in my heart.

DAN 8:3 And I lifted my eyes, and looked. And behold, one ram standing before the Ubal; and there was to him horns, and the horns were high; and the one was higher than the other, and the high one ascended up last.
DAN 8:4 And I beheld the ram butting towards the west, and the north, and the south; and all the wild beasts shall not stand before him, and there was not one rescuing from out of his hand; and he did according to his will, and was magnified.
DAN 8:5 And I was perceiving, and behold, a he-goat of the goats came from the southwest upon the face of all the earth, and was not touching the earth. And to the he-goat was a horn which may be viewed between his eyes.
DAN 8:6 And he came unto the ram having the horns, which I beheld standing before the Ubal, and ran against him with the thrust of his strength.
DAN 8:7 And I beheld him anticipating unto the ram, and he was furiously enraged against him. And he hit the ram, and broke both of his horns. And there was not strength to the ram to stand before him. And he tossed him upon the ground, and trampled upon him. And there was not one rescuing the ram from out of his hand.

DAN 8:9 And from out of the one of them came forth one strong horn, and was magnified extremely towards the south, and towards the east, and towards the setting of the sun.
DAN 8:10 And it was magnified unto the force of the heaven; and it fell upon the earth from the force of the of heaven, and from the stars, and trampled upon them.

DAN 8:16 And I heard the voice of a man in the midst of the Ulai. And he called, and said, Gabriel, bring understanding the vision for that one!
DAN 8:17 And he came and stood next to my position. And in his coming I was distraught, and I fell upon my face. And he said to me, Take notice, O son of man! For the vision is still for end time.
DAN 8:18 And in his speaking with me, I fell upon my face unto the earth. And he touched me, and stood me upon my feet.
DAN 8:19 And he said, Behold, I make known to you the things being at the last of the wrath; for it is yet for end of time.

DAN 8:22 And of the one being broken, of which four horns stood underneath - four kings from out of his nation shall rise up, but not in his strength.

DAN 8:24 And his strength is fortified, and not by his strength. And wonderfully he shall corrupt, and shall prosper, and shall perform, and shall corrupt strong ones, and a holy people.
DAN 8:25 And the yoke of the collar shall prosper. Treachery is in his hand, and in his heart he shall magnify himself. And by treachery he shall corrupt many; and for a destruction of many he shall establish himself; and as eggs in a hand he shall break.

DAN 9:3 And I put my face towards the LORD God, to inquire by prayer and supplication, in fasting, and sackcloth, and ashes.
DAN 9:4 And I prayed to the LORD my God, and made acknowledgment, and said, O LORD, the great and wonderful God, the one keeping your covenant and mercy to the ones loving you, and to the ones keeping your commandments -
DAN 9:5 we sinned, we did wrong, we were impious, and we left, and turned aside from your commandments and from your judgments.
DAN 9:6 And we listened not to your servants the prophets, the ones speaking in your name to our kings, and our rulers, and our fathers, and to all the people of the land.
DAN 9:7 To you, O LORD, is righteousness, and to us the shame of face, as this day - to the man of Judah, and to the ones dwelling Jerusalem, and to all Israel, to the ones near, and to the ones far off in all the earth, of which you dispersed them there, for their rebellion in which they annulled covenant with you, O LORD.

DAN 9:9 To the LORD our God are the compassions and the atonements, for we separated from the LORD.

DAN 9:11 And all Israel violated your law, and turned aside to not hearken to your voice; and there came upon us the curse, and the oath having been written in the law of Moses the servant of God, for we sinned against him.
DAN 9:12 And he established his words, which he spoke against us, and against our judges judging us, for him to bring upon us great evils, such as have not taken place underneath all of the heaven, according to the things taking place in Jerusalem.

DAN 9:14 And the LORD our God was vigilant against the evil, and brought them upon us. For the LORD our God is just in all his doing which he did. And we hearkened not to his voice.

DAN 9:16 O LORD, in all your charity, turn indeed your rage and your anger from your city Jerusalem, your holy mountain! For we sinned in our iniquities, and of the ones of our fathers. Jerusalem and your people became for scorn among all the ones surrounding us.
DAN 9:17 And now, hearken O LORD our God, of the prayer of your servant and his supplications! And let your face appear upon your sanctified place, the deserted one, because of you, O LORD!
DAN 9:18 Lean, O my God, your ear, and hearken! Open your eyes, and behold our extinction, and the one of your city upon which your name is called upon it! For not upon our righteousness we toss our compassion before you, but upon your great compassions, O LORD.
DAN 9:19 Hearken, O LORD! Atone, O LORD! Take heed, O LORD! Act, and do not delay for your sake, O LORD my God! For your name is called upon your city, and upon your people.
DAN 9:20 And yet during my speaking, and praying, and declaring openly my sins, and the sins of my people Israel, and tossing my desire for mercy before the LORD my God concerning the holy mountain of my God,
DAN 9:21 that yet during my speaking in the prayer, that behold, the man Gabriel appeared, whom I beheld in the vision at the beginning flying. And he touched me about the hour of the evening sacrifice.
DAN 9:22 And he brought understanding to me, and spoke with me, and said, O Daniel, now I came forth to instruct you for understanding.
DAN 9:23 In the beginning of your supplication the word went forth, and I came to announce to you; for you are a man desired. And now reflect in the matter, and perceive in the apparition!

DAN 9:25 And you shall know and perceive, from the delivery of the word to respond and to build Jerusalem until the anointed one Christ. leading - seven periods of seven, and sixty-two periods of seven. Again the square and wall shall be built in straits of the times.
DAN 9:26 And after the sixty-two periods of seven, the anointing shall be utterly destroyed, and judgment is not in him. DAN 10:1 In the third year of Cyrus, king of the Persians, the word was uncovered to Daniel, (of whom the name was called Belteshazzar;) and the word is true, and great ability and understanding was given to him in the apparition.
DAN 10:2 In those days, I Daniel was mourning three periods of seven of days.
DAN 10:3 Of desirable bread I ate not, and meat and wine did not go into my mouth, and with an anointing I annointed not, until the fullness of the three period of sevens of days.
DAN 10:4 On the twentieth and fourth day of the first month, even I was next to the great river - it is the Tigris.
DAN 10:5 And I lifted my eyes and looked, and behold, a man, one being clothed with linen clothes, and his loin being girded in gold of Uphaz.
DAN 10:6 And his body was as Tharsis stone, and his face as a sight of lightning, and his eyes as lamps of fire, and his arms and his legs were as the sight of brass shining, and the sound of his words as a sound of a multitude.
DAN 10:7 And I Daniel alone beheld the apparition. And the men with me, beheld not the apparition; but a great change of state fell upon them, and they fled in fear.
DAN 10:8 And I was left behind alone, and beheld this great apparition, and there was not left in me strength; and my glory converted into corruption, and I held not strength.
DAN 10:9 And I heard the voice of his words. And in my hearing the sound of his discourses, I was being vexed, and my face was upon the ground.
DAN 10:10 And behold, a hand was touching me, and raised me upon my knees and palms of my hands.
DAN 10:11 And he said to me, Daniel, man desired, perceive by the words which I speak to you, and stand at your position! For now I am sent to you. And in his speaking to me this word, I rose up trembling.
DAN 10:12 And he said to me, Fear not Daniel! For from the first day of which you gave your heart to perceive, and to afflict yourself before the LORD your God, your words were heard, and I came because of your words.
DAN 10:13 And the ruler of the kingdom of the Persians stood right opposite me twenty days and one day. And behold, Michael, one of the rulers of the ones foremost, came to help me; and I left him there with the ruler of the kingdom of the Persians.
DAN 10:14 And I came to bring understanding to you as much as shall meet your people in last of the days. For the vision is still for days.
DAN 10:15 And in his speaking with me according to these words, I put my face unto the ground, and was vexed.
DAN 10:16 And behold, as a likeness of a son of man touched my lips. And I opened my mouth, and I spoke, and said to the one standing before me, O lord, at the apparition of you my within turned in me, and I had not strength.
