MAL 3:10 The year is completed, and you carried in all the resources into the storehouses, and there will be the ravaging in your houses. Restore indeed in this, says the LORD almighty, if I should not open to you the torrents of the heaven, and pour out to you my blessing until it is enough!
MAL 3:11 And I will draw apart to you for food, and in no way will I utterly destroy the fruit of the land; and in no way should it be weakened upon your grapevine in the field, says the LORD almighty.
MAL 3:12 And all the nations shall declare you happy. For you will be a wanted land, says the LORD almighty.
MAL 3:13 You weighed down against me by your words, says the LORD. And you said, We spoke ill against you in what?
MAL 3:14 You said, The one serving God is vain. and, What more is it, that we kept his injunctions, and that we go as supplicants before the face of the LORD almighty?
MAL 3:15 And now we declare aliens blessed; and all the ones doing lawless deeds are built up; and they opposed God, and were preserved.
MAL 3:16 The ones fearing the LORD spoke these things each to his neighbor. And the LORD heeded, and hearkened, and wrote a scroll of memorial before him to the ones fearing the LORD, and venerating his name.
MAL 3:17 And they will be to me, says the LORD almighty, in the day which I prepare for a procurement. And I will select them in which manner a man selects his son serving to him.
MAL 3:18 Then shall you be turned, and you shall see between the just one and the wrongdoer; and between the one serving God and the one not serving to him.
MAL 4:1 For behold, a day comes, burning as an oven; and it shall blaze against them. And all the foreigners will be, and all the ones doing lawless deeds, as stubble. And the day coming shall light them, says the LORD of the forces. And in no way shall there be left of them root nor vine branch.
MAL 4:2 And to you, O ones fearing my name, shall arise sun of righteousness, and healing is in his wings; and you shall come forth, and shall leap as young calves being spared from out of bonds.
MAL 4:3 And you shall trample the lawless ones. And they will be ashes underneath your feet in the day which I prepare, says the LORD almighty.
MAL 4:4 Remember the law of Moses my manservant, in so far as I gave charge to him in Horeb for all Israel - orders and judgments!
MAL 4:5 And behold, I will send to you Elijah the prophet before the coming day of the LORD - the great and apparent;
MAL 4:6 the one who shall restore the heart of the father to the son, and the heart of a man to his neighbor, lest coming I strike the earth entirely.
MAT 1:1 The book of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, son of David, son of Abraham.
MAT 1:2 Abraham engendered Isaac; and Isaac engendered Jacob; and Jacob engendered Judah and his brothers;
MAT 1:3 and Judah engendered Perez and Zara from Thamar; and Perez engendered Esrom; and Esrom engendered Aram;
MAT 1:4 and Aram engendered Aminadab; and Aminadab engendered Naasson; and Naasson engendered Salmon;
MAT 1:5 and Salmon engendered Boaz from Rachab; and Boaz engendered Obed from Ruth; and Obed engendered Jesse;
MAT 1:6 and Jesse engendered David the king; and David the king engendered Solomon from the wife of Urias;
MAT 1:7 and Solomon engendered Rehoboam; and Rehoboam engendered Abia; and Abia engendered Asa;
MAT 1:8 and Asa engendered Jehoshaphat; and Jehoshaphat engendered Joram; and Joram engendered Uzziah;
MAT 1:9 and Uzziah engendered Jotham; and Jotham engendered Ahaz; and Ahaz engendered Hezekiah;
MAT 1:10 and Hezekiah engendered Manasseh; and Manasseh engendered Amon; and Amon engendered Josiah;
MAT 1:11 and Josiah engendered Jechoniah and his brothers, unto the displacement in Babylon.
MAT 1:12 And after the displacement of Babylon, Jechoniah engendered Salathiel; and Salathiel engendered Zorobabel;
MAT 1:13 and Zorobbabel engendered Abiud; and Abiud engendered Eliakim; and Eliakim engendered Azor;
MAT 1:14 and Azor engendered Zadok; and Zadok engendered Achim; and Achim engendered Eliud;
MAT 1:15 and Eliud engendered Eleazar; and Eleazar engendered Matthan; and Matthan engendered Jacob;
MAT 1:16 and Jacob engendered Joseph the husband of Mary, from out of whom was born Jesus, being called Christ.
MAT 1:17 All then the generations from Abraham unto David - fourteen generations; and from David unto the displacement of Babylon - fourteen generations; and from the displacement of Babylon unto the Christ - fourteen generations.
MAT 1:18 And the nativity of Jesus Christ was thus. For his mother Mary being espoused to Joseph, (before their coming together) was found having one in the womb from holy spirit.
MAT 1:19 And Joseph her husband, being just, and not wanting to make her an example, willed in private to dismiss her.
MAT 1:20 And of his pondering these things, behold, an angel of the Lord by dream appeared to him, saying, Joseph son of David, fear not to take to yourself Mary your wife, for the one in her is engendered from holy spirit.
MAT 1:21 And she shall bear a son, and you shall call his name Jesus; for he shall deliver his people from their sins.
MAT 1:22 And this completely happened, that should be fulfilled the thing having been spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying,
MAT 1:23 Behold, the virgin has one in the womb, and she shall birth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which is being translated, God with us.
MAT 1:24 And Joseph having been awakened from the sleep did as the angel of the Lord assigned to him, and took to himself his wife.
MAT 1:25 And he knew her not until of which she bore her first-born son. And he called his name Jesus.
MAT 2:1 And of Jesus having been born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of Herod the king, behold, magi from the east came unto Jerusalem,
MAT 2:2 saying, Where is the one having been born king of the Jews? for we beheld his star in the east, and we came to do obeisance to him.
MAT 2:3 And hearing, Herod the king was disturbed, and all Jerusalem with him.
MAT 2:4 And gathering together all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he inquired of them where the Christ is born.
MAT 2:5 And they said to him, In Bethlehem of Judea. For thus it has been written by the prophet,
MAT 2:6 And you Bethlehem, land of Judea, are not at all least in the governs of Judea. For from out of you shall come forth one leading, who shall tend my people Israel.
MAT 2:7 Then Herod, in private having called the magi, exacted from them the time of the star appearing.
MAT 2:8 And having sent them unto Bethlehem, he said, Having gone, exactly inquire concerning the child! And when you should have found, report to me, so that I also having come should do obeisance to him.
MAT 2:9 And they, having heard the king, went. And behold, the star which they beheld in the east, led before them, until having come it stood above of which place the child was.
MAT 2:10 And beholding the star, they rejoiced a great joy, exceedingly.
MAT 2:11 And having come unto the residence, they saw the child with Mary his mother; and having fallen, they did obeisance to him. And having opened their treasuries, they offered to him gifts - gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.
MAT 2:12 And having received a divine message by dream to not return to Herod, they withdrew by another way unto their place.
MAT 2:13 And of their withdrawing, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared by dream to Joseph, saying, Having arisen, take to yourself the child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and be there until whenever I should speak to you! for Herod is about to seek the child to destroy it.
MAT 2:14 And having arisen, he took to himself the child and his mother by night, and withdrew into Egypt.
MAT 2:15 And he was there until the decease of Herod; that should be fulfilled the thing having been spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying, From out of Egypt I called my son.
MAT 2:16 Then Herod, knowing that he was mocked by the magi, was enraged exceedingly. And having sent, he did away with all the boys in Bethlehem, and in all the borders of it, from two years old and lower, according to the time which was exacted from the magi.
MAT 2:17 Then was fulfilled the thing having been spoken by Jeremiah the prophet, saying,
MAT 2:18 A voice in Rama was heard, wailing and weeping, and much grieving, Rachel weeping over her children, and she wanted not to be comforted, for they are not.
MAT 2:19 And Herod having come to an end, behold, an angel of the Lord by dream appears to Joseph in Egypt,
MAT 2:20 saying, Having arisen, take to yourself the child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel! for the ones seeking the life of the child have died.
MAT 2:21 And having arisen, he took to himself the child and his mother, and he came into the land of Israel.
MAT 2:22 And having heard that Archelaus reigned over Judea instead of Herod his father, he feared to go forth there. And having received a divine message by dream, he withdrew into the parts of Galilee.
MAT 2:23 And having come, he dwelt in a city being called Nazareth, so that should be fulfilled the thing having been spoken through the prophets that he shall be called a Nazarene.
MAT 3:1 And in those days came John the Baptist proclaiming in the wilderness of Judea,
MAT 3:2 and saying, Repent, for the kingdom of the heavens approaches!
MAT 3:3 For this is the thing having been spoken by Isaiah the prophet, saying, A voice yelling in the wilderness, Prepare the way of the Lord! Make straight his roads!
MAT 3:4 And he, John, had his garment from camel's hair, and a belt made of skin around his loin; and his nourishment was locusts and wild honey.
MAT 3:5 Then came forth to him Jerusalem, and all Judea, and all the place round about the Jordan.
MAT 3:6 And they were immersed in the Jordan by him, acknowledging their sins.
MAT 3:7 And beholding many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming upon his immersion, he said to them, Offspring of vipers, who showed plainly to you to flee from the about to come anger?
MAT 3:8 Do then fruits worthy of repentance!
MAT 3:9 And you should not seem to say in yourselves, We have father Abraham. For I say to you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from out of these stones.
MAT 3:10 But already even the axe to the root of the trees is situated. For every tree not producing good fruit is cut down, and thrown into fire.
MAT 3:11 I indeed immerse you in water for repentance. But the one coming after me is stronger than me, of whom I am not fit to bear the sandals. He shall immerse you in holy spirit, and fire;
MAT 3:12 of which the winnowing fan is in his hand, and he shall thoroughly cleanse his threshing-floor, and shall gather together his grain into the storehouse; but the straw he shall incinerate by inextinguishable fire.
MAT 3:13 Then comes Jesus from Galilee unto the Jordan to John, to be immersed by him.
MAT 3:14 And John restrains him, saying, I have need to be immersed by you, and you come to me?
MAT 3:15 And answering Jesus said to him, Allow it just now! For to this it is becoming to us to fulfill all righteousness. Then he allows him.
MAT 3:16 And Jesus having been immersed, ascended straightway from the water; and behold, the heavens were opened to him, and he beheld the spirit of God coming down as a dove, and coming upon him.
MAT 3:17 And behold, a voice from out of the heavens, saying, This is my son, the beloved, in whom I take pleasure.
MAT 4:1 Then Jesus was led into the wilderness by the spirit to be tested by the devil.
MAT 4:2 And he fasted forty days and forty nights, afterwards he hungered.
MAT 4:3 And having come forward to him, the one testing said, If you are son of God, speak, that these stones should become breads!
MAT 4:4 And responding he said, It has been written, Not by bread alone shall a man live, but by every word coming forth by the mouth of God.
MAT 4:5 Then the devil takes him unto the holy city, and stands him upon the border of the temple.
MAT 4:6 And he says to him, If you are son of God, throw yourself below! For it has been written that, To his angels he shall give charge concerning you, And By hands they shall lift you, lest at any time you should stumble your foot against a stone.
MAT 4:7 Jesus said to him, Again it has been written, You shall not put to test the Lord your God.
MAT 4:8 Again, the devil takes him unto an exceedingly high mountain, and shows to him all the kingdoms of the world, and their glory.
MAT 4:9 And he says to him, All these I will give to you, if falling down you should do obeisance to me.
MAT 4:10 Then Jesus says to him, Go behind me Satan! For it is written, You shall do obeisance to the Lord your God, and to him alone you shall serve.
MAT 4:11 Then the devil left him, and behold, angels came forward and served to him.
MAT 4:12 And Jesus having heard that John was delivered up, he withdrew into Galilee.
MAT 4:13 And leaving Nazareth, coming, he dwelt in Capernaum by the sea, in the borders of Zebulun and Naphtali,
MAT 4:14 that the word through Isaiah the prophet should be fulfilled, saying,
MAT 4:15 Land of Zebulun, and land of Naphtali, way of the sea, on the other side of the Jordan, Galilee of the nations.
MAT 4:16 The people sitting in darkness beheld a great light, and to the ones sitting in a place and shadow of death light arose to them.
MAT 4:17 From then Jesus began to proclaim and to say, Repent! For the kingdom of the heavens approaches.
MAT 4:18 And Jesus walking by the sea of Galilee beheld two brothers - Simon the one being called Peter, and Andrew his brother, throwing a casting-net into the sea; for they were fishermen.
MAT 4:19 And he says to them, Come after me, and I will make you fishers of men!
MAT 4:20 And the one, immediately having left the nets, followed him.
MAT 4:21 And advancing from there, he beheld another two brothers, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in the boat with Zebedee their father, readying their nets; and he called them.
MAT 4:22 And, immediately having left the boat and their father, they followed him.
MAT 4:23 And Jesus led about all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, and proclaiming the good news of the kingdom, and curing every disease and every infirmity among the people.
MAT 4:24 And went forth the report of him into all Syria. And they brought to him all the ones having an illness with various diseases, and being held by torments, and ones being demon-possessed, and ones acting as lunatic, and paralytics; and he cured them.
MAT 4:25 And great multitudes followed him from Galilee, and Decapolis, and Jerusalem, and Judea, and on the other side of the Jordan.
MAT 5:1 And beholding the multitudes, he ascended into the mountain. And of his having sat, there came forward to him his disciples.
MAT 5:2 And having opened his mouth, he taught them, saying,
MAT 5:3 Blessed are the poor in the spirit; for of them is the kingdom of the heavens.
MAT 5:4 Blessed are the ones mourning; for they shall be comforted.
MAT 5:5 Blessed are the gentle; for they shall inherit the earth.
MAT 5:6 Blessed are the ones hungering and thirsting for righteousness; for they shall be filled.
MAT 5:7 Blessed are the merciful; for they shall be shown mercy.
MAT 5:8 Blessed are the clean ones in the heart; for they shall see God.
MAT 5:9 Blessed are the peacemakers; for they shall be called sons of God.
MAT 5:10 Blessed are the ones having been persecuted because of righteousness; for of them is the kingdom of the heavens.
MAT 5:11 Blessed are you, whenever they should berate you, and persecute, and shall say every wicked saying against you in lying, because of me.
MAT 5:12 Rejoice, and exult! for your wage is great in the heavens. For so they persecuted the prophets before you.
MAT 5:13 You are the salt of the earth. But if the salt becomes insipid, by what means shall it be salted? For it is strong for nothing any longer, unless to be thrown outside, and to be trampled by the men.
MAT 5:14 You are the light of the world. A city is not able to hide being situated upon a mountain.
MAT 5:15 Nor do they burn a lamp, and put it under the bushel, but upon the lamp-stand, and it radiates to all the ones in the house.
MAT 5:16 So let your light radiate before the men, so that they should behold your good works, and should glorify your father, the one in the heavens.
MAT 5:17 You should not think that I came to depose the law, or the prophets. I came not to depose, but to fulfill.
MAT 5:18 For amen I say to you, Until whenever the heaven and the earth shall pass away, in no way should pass from the law one iota or one dot, until whenever all comes to pass.
MAT 5:19 Who ever then should untie one of the least of these commandments, and shall teach men so, he shall be called least in the kingdom of the heavens. And who ever should do and should teach, this one shall be called great in the kingdom of the heavens.
MAT 5:20 For I say to you, That if your righteousness should not abound greater than of the scribes and Pharisees, in no way should you enter into the kingdom of the heavens.
MAT 5:21 You heard that it was said to the ancients, You shall not murder; and who ever should murder shall be liable to the judgment.
MAT 5:22 But I say to you, That all provoking to anger his brother in vain shall be liable to the judgment. And who ever should say to his brother, Worthless! shall be liable to the sanhedrin. And who ever should say, O moron! shall be liable for the Gehenna of fire.
MAT 5:23 If then you should offer your gift offering upon the altar, and there should remember that your brother has something against you;
MAT 5:24 leave there your gift offering before the altar, and go away! First to reconcile to your brother, and then having come offer your gift offering!
MAT 5:25 Be well-disposed towards your opponent quickly, at wherever you are in the way with him, lest at any time the opponent should deliver you up to the judge, and the judge should deliver you up to the officer, and he should throw you into prison!
MAT 5:26 Amen, I say to you, In no way should you come forth from there, until whenever you should deliver over the last quadrans.
MAT 5:27 You heard that it was said to the ancients, You shall not commit adultery.
MAT 5:28 But I say to you, That all looking at a wife for lusting her, already committed adultery with her in his heart.
MAT 5:29 And if your right eye causes you to stumble, take it out, and throw it from you! For it is advantageous to you that one of your members should be destroyed, and your entire body should not be thrown into Gehenna.
MAT 5:30 And if your right hand causes you to stumble, cut it off, and throw it from you! For it is advantageous to you that one of your members should be destroyed, and your entire body should not be thrown into Gehenna.
MAT 5:31 Also it was said, That who ever should dismiss his wife, let him give to her a certificate of divorce.
MAT 5:32 But I say to you, That who ever should dismiss his wife, except for the matter of harlotry, makes her to commit adultery; and who ever should marry a woman being divorced commits adultery.
MAT 5:33 Again, you heard that it was said to the ancients, You shall not swear upon, but shall render to the Lord your oaths.
MAT 5:34 But I say to you, Do not swear by an oath wholly; nor on the heaven; for it is the throne of God.
MAT 5:35 Nor on the earth; for it is the footstool of his feet. Nor on Jerusalem; for it is the city of the great king.
MAT 5:36 Nor on your head should you swear by an oath, for you are not able to make one hair white or black.
MAT 5:37 But let be your word - a yes, Yes! a no, No! but anything extra than these is of the wicked one.
MAT 5:38 You heard that it was said, An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth.
MAT 5:39 But I say to you, to not oppose the wicked one. But whoever slaps you upon your right jaw, turn to him also the other!
MAT 5:40 And to the one wanting to arbitrate against you, and to take your garment, leave to him also your cloak!
MAT 5:41 And whoever conscripts you to go one mile, go with him two!
MAT 5:42 To the one asking you, give! And the one wanting from you to borrow, you should not turn away.
MAT 5:43 You heard that it was said, You shall love your neighbor, and you shall detest your enemy.
MAT 5:44 But I say to you, Love your enemies! Bless the ones cursing you! Do well to the ones detesting you! And pray for the ones threatening you, and persecuting you!
MAT 5:45 So that you should become sons of your father in the heavens. For his sun rises upon wicked ones and good ones, and it rains upon just ones and unjust ones.
MAT 5:46 For if you should love the ones loving you, what wage have you? Do not also the tax collectors do the same?
MAT 5:47 And if you should greet your brothers only, what extra do you do? Do not also the tax collectors do the same?
MAT 5:48 You shall be then yourselves perfect, as your father in the heavens is perfect.
MAT 6:1 Take heed of your charity! To not act in front of the men so as to be a spectacle to them; otherwise you have not a wage from your father in the heavens.
MAT 6:2 Whenever then you should do charity, you should not trump before you as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, so that they should be glorified by the men. Amen, I say to you, They receive their wage.
MAT 6:3 But you doing charity, let not your left hand know what your right does,
MAT 6:4 so that your charity might be in secret, and your father seeing in secret, he will recompense to you in the open!
MAT 6:5 And whenever you pray, you should not be as the hypocrites, for they are fond of being in the synagogues, and in the corners of the squares standing to pray, so that they should appear to the men. Amen, I say to you, That they receive their wage.
MAT 6:6 But you, whenever you should pray, enter into your inner chamber! And having locked your door, pray to your father in secret! And your father seeing in secret shall recompense to you in the open!
MAT 6:7 And praying, do not repeat over and over as the ethnics; for they think that by the many words of theirs they shall be listened to.
MAT 6:8 You should not then be like them. For your father knows of what need you have before you ask him.
MAT 6:9 So then you pray! Our father, the one in the heavens, sanctify your name!
MAT 6:10 Let your kingdom come! Let your will come to pass! as in heaven, also upon the earth.
MAT 6:11 Our bread, the sufficient, give to us today!
MAT 6:12 And forgive us our debts, as also we forgive our debtors!
MAT 6:13 And you should not insert us for a test, but rescue us from the wicked one! For of you is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, into the eons, amen.
MAT 6:14 For if you should forgive men their transgressions, your heavenly father shall also forgive you.
MAT 6:15 But if you should not forgive the men their transgressions, not even your heavenly father shall forgive your transgressions.
MAT 6:16 And whenever you should fast, be not as the hypocrites, looking downcast! For they obliterate their faces, so as to appear to men as fasting. Amen, I say to you, That they receive their wage.
MAT 6:17 But you, fasting, anoint your head, and wash your face!
MAT 6:18 So that you should not appear to men as fasting, but to your father in secret. And your father seeing in secret shall recompense to you in the open.
MAT 6:19 Treasure not to yourself treasures upon the earth, where moth and rust obliterate, and where thieves dig through and steal!
MAT 6:20 But treasure up to yourself treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust obliterate, and where thieves do not dig through nor steal!
MAT 6:21 For where your treasure is, there will be also your heart.
MAT 6:22 The lamp of the body is the eye. If then your eye should be sincere, your entire body will be giving light.
MAT 6:23 But if your eye should be evil, your entire body will be dark. If then the light in you is darkness, how great the darkness.
MAT 6:24 No one is able to serve two masters; for the one he will detest, and the other love; or the one he will hold to, and the other he will disdain. You are not able to serve God and mammon.
MAT 6:25 On account of this I say to you, Be not anxious to your life, what you should eat, and what you should drink; nor to your body, what you should put on! Is not life more than nourishment, and the body more than a garment?
MAT 6:26 Look at the birds of the heaven! For they sow not, nor do they harvest, nor do they gather together into storehouses - and your heavenly father maintains them. Are you not rather different than them?
MAT 6:27 And who of you being anxious is able to add unto his stature one cubit?
MAT 6:28 And concerning a garment - why are you anxious? Study the lilies of the field, how they grow - they tire not, nor spin!
MAT 6:29 And I say to you, That not even Solomon in all his glory was clothed as one of these.
MAT 6:30 But if the grass of the field today is being, and tomorrow is being thrown into an oven, and God so clothes them - not much rather you, O ones of little belief?
MAT 6:31 You should not then be anxious, saying, What shall we eat? or What shall we drink? or What should be worn?
MAT 6:32 (For all these the nations seek anxiously.) For your heavenly father knows that you need these all together.
MAT 6:33 But seek first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness! and all these will be added to you.
MAT 6:34 You should not then be anxious for tomorrow; for tomorrow shall be anxious for the things of itself. Sufficient to the day is the evil of it.
MAT 7:1 Judge not, that you should not be judged!
MAT 7:2 For by what judgment you judge, you shall be judged. And by what measure you measure, it shall be measured back to you.
MAT 7:3 But why do you see the speck in the eye of your brother, but the beam in your eye you contemplate not?
MAT 7:4 Or how shall you say to your brother, Allow me to cast out the speck from your eye; and behold, the beam is in your eye?
MAT 7:5 Hypocrite, cast out first the beam from your eye! and then you shall see clearly to cast out the speck from the eye of your brother.
MAT 7:6 You should not give the holy to the dogs, nor should you throw your pearls before the swine, lest at any time they shall trample them with their feet, and having turned should tear you.
MAT 7:7 Ask, and it shall be given to you! Seek, and you shall find! Knock, and it shall be opened to you!
MAT 7:8 For every one asking receives; and the one seeking finds; and to the one knocking it shall be opened.
MAT 7:9 Or who is it of you, being a man, whom ever his son should ask for bread, will give to him a stone?
MAT 7:10 And if he shall ask for a fish, will give to him a serpent?
MAT 7:11 If then you, being wicked, know to give good gifts to your children, how much rather your father in the heavens shall give good things to the ones asking him?
MAT 7:12 All things then, as much as you should want that men should do to you, so also you do to them! For this is the law and the prophets!
MAT 7:13 Enter through the narrow gate! For spacious is the gate, and broad is the way leading unto destruction, and many are the ones entering through it.
MAT 7:14 For narrow is the gate, and being afflicted is the way leading unto life, and few are the ones finding it.
MAT 7:15 And take heed of the false prophets who come to you in garments of sheep, but inside are predacious wolves!
MAT 7:16 From their fruits you shall recognize them. Do they collect together the grape from thorn-bushes, or figs from thistles?
MAT 7:17 Thus every good tree produces good fruits; but the rotten tree produces bad fruits.
MAT 7:18 A good tree is not able to produce bad fruits, nor a rotten tree to produce good fruits.
MAT 7:19 All trees not producing good fruit are cut down, and thrown into a fire.
MAT 7:20 Yes, it is so - from their fruits you shall recognize them.
MAT 7:21 Not all saying to me, O Lord, O Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of the heavens; but the one doing the will of my father in heavens.
MAT 7:22 Many shall say to me in that day, O Lord, O Lord, did we not prophesy in your name, and in your name cast out demons, and in your name do many powerful works?
MAT 7:23 And then I will acknowledge to them that, At no time I knew you. Retreat from me, O ones working lawlessness!
MAT 7:24 Every one then whoever hears these my words, and does them, I will liken him to a practical man, who built his house upon the rock.
MAT 7:25 And the rain came down, and the rivers came, and the winds blew, and they fell on that house; and it fell not. For the foundation was laid upon the rock.
MAT 7:26 And all hearing these my words, and not doing them, shall be likened to a moronish man who built his house upon the sand.
MAT 7:27 And the rain came down, and the rivers came, and the winds blew, and struck against that house; and it fell. And its downfall was great.
MAT 7:28 And it came to pass, when Jesus completed these words, the multitudes were overwhelmed by his teaching.
MAT 7:29 For he was teaching them as one having authority, and not as the scribes.
MAT 8:1 And in his coming down from the mountain, a great multitude followed him.
MAT 8:2 And behold, a leper having come did obeisance to him, saying, O Lord, if you should want, you are able to cleanse me.
MAT 8:3 And stretching out the hand, Jesus touched him, saying, I want, be cleansed! And immediately he was cleansed of his leprosy.
MAT 8:4 And Jesus says to him, See that you tell no one! But go, show yourself to the priest, and offer the gift offering Moses assigned for a testimony to them!
MAT 8:5 And Jesus having entered into Capernaum, there came forward to him a centurion, enjoining him,
MAT 8:6 and saying, O Lord, my servant is lying in the house paralytic, being tormented awfully.
MAT 8:7 And Jesus says to him, I coming shall cure him.
MAT 8:8 And responding the centurion said, O Lord, I am not fit that you should enter under my roof; but only speak the word, and my servant shall be healed!
MAT 8:9 For I also am a man under authority, having under myself soldiers. And I say to this one, Go! and he goes. And to another, Come! and he comes. And to my manservant, Do this! and he does it.
MAT 8:10 And hearing, Jesus marveled, and said to the ones following, Amen I say to you, Not even in Israel found I such great belief.
MAT 8:11 And I say to you, That many from east and west shall come, and shall be lain down with Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, in the kingdom of the heavens.

MAT 10:1 And having called on his twelve disciples, he gave to them authority of unclean spirits, so as to cast them out, and to cure every disease and every infirmity.
MAT 10:2 And of the twelve apostles, the names are these - first, Simon, the one being called Peter, and Andrew his brother; James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother;
MAT 10:3 Philip and Bartholomew; Thomas, and Matthew the tax collector; James the son of Alphaeus, and Lebbaeus called Thaddaeus;
MAT 10:4 Simon the Canaanite, and Judas Iscariot, the one also having delivered him up.
MAT 10:5 These, the twelve, Jesus sent, exhorting them, saying, Unto the way of the nations you should not go forth, and unto a city of Samaritans you should not enter.
MAT 10:6 But you go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel!
MAT 10:7 And going, proclaim! saying that, The kingdom of the heavens approaches.
MAT 10:8 Ones being weak - cure! Dead - raise up! Leprous - cleanse! Demons - cast out! Freely you received, freely you give!
MAT 10:9 You should not acquire gold, nor silver, nor brass coin in your belts,
MAT 10:10 nor a provision bag for the way, nor two inner garments, nor sandals, nor rods; for the worker is worth his provision.
MAT 10:11 And into whatever city or town you should enter, inquire diligently who in it is worthy; and there remain until whenever you should go forth!
MAT 10:12 And entering into the house, greet it!
MAT 10:13 And if indeed the house might be worthy, let your peace come upon it! But if it might not be worthy, let your peace return to you!
MAT 10:14 And who ever should not receive you, nor should hear your words, in going forth from the residence or that city, shake off the dust of your feet!
MAT 10:15 Amen I say to you, More endurable will it be to the land of Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment, than to that city.
MAT 10:16 Behold, I send you as sheep in the midst of wolves. Be then skilled as the serpents, and unmixed as the doves!
MAT 10:17 And take heed of the men! For they shall deliver you unto sanhedrins, and in their synagogues they shall whip you.
MAT 10:18 And before governors also and kings you shall be led because of me, for a testimony to them and to the nations.
MAT 10:19 And whenever they deliver you, be not anxious how or what you should speak. For it shall be given to you in that hour what you should speak.
MAT 10:20 For you are not the ones speaking, but the spirit of your father speaking in you.
MAT 10:21 But brother shall deliver up brother unto death, and a father a child. And children shall rise up against parents, and they shall put them to death.
MAT 10:22 And you will be detested by all on account of my name. But the one remaining unto completion, this one shall be delivered.
MAT 10:23 But whenever they should persecute you in this city, flee unto the other! For amen I say to you, In no way should you finish the cities of Israel, until whenever the son of man should come.
MAT 10:24 A disciple is not above the teacher, nor a manservant above his master.
MAT 10:25 Sufficient to the disciple that he should become as his teacher, and the manservant as his master. If they invoked Beelzebub the master of the house, how much more the ones of his same house?
MAT 10:26 You should not then fear them. For nothing is being covered, which shall not be uncovered; and hidden, which shall not be known.
MAT 10:27 What I say to you in the darkness, you speak in the light! And what in the ear you hear, proclaim upon the roofs!
MAT 10:28 And fear not from the ones killing the body, but not being able to kill the soul! But you fear rather the one being able both soul and body to destroy in Gehenna!
MAT 10:29 Are not two sparrows sold for an assarion? And one of them shall not fall upon the earth without your father.
MAT 10:30 But you, even the hairs of the head are all counted.
MAT 10:31 Do not then fear - you differ than many sparrows!
MAT 10:32 Every one then whoever shall make acknowledgement in me before men, I shall make acknowledgement, even myself, in him before my father in heavens.
MAT 10:33 And whoever should deny me before men, I shall deny him, even myself, before my father in heavens.
MAT 10:34 You should not think that I came to cast peace upon the earth. I came not to cast peace, but a sword.
MAT 10:35 For I came to cleave a man against his father, and a daughter against her mother, and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.
MAT 10:36 And the enemies of the man are the ones of his own house.
MAT 10:37 The one being fond of a father or mother above me is not worthy of me. And the one being fond of a son or daughter above me is not worthy of me.
MAT 10:38 And the one who does not take his cross, and follow after me, is not worthy of me.
MAT 10:39 The one finding his life shall lose it. And the one losing his life because of me shall find it.
MAT 10:40 The one receiving you receives me, and the one receiving me receives the one sending me.
MAT 10:41 The one receiving a prophet in the name of a prophet shall receive a wage of a prophet; and the one receiving a just one in the name of a just one shall receive a wage of a just one.
MAT 10:42 And who ever shall give a drink to one of these small ones a cup of cold water only in the name of a disciple, amen I say to you, In no way shall he lose his wage.

MAT 12:1 In that time Jesus went on the sabbaths through the wheat fields; and his disciples hungered, and began to pluck ears of wheat. and to eat.
MAT 12:2 And the Pharisees seeing, said to him, Behold, your disciples do what is not allowed to do in a sabbath.
MAT 12:3 And he said to them, Did you not read what David did when he hungered, and the ones with him?

MAT 12:5 Or did you not read in the law, that in the sabbaths the priests in the temple profane the sabbath, and they are innocent?
MAT 12:6 But I say to you that a greater than the temple is here.
MAT 12:7 And if you had known what it is, Mercy I want, and not sacrifice, you would not have condemned the innocent ones.
MAT 12:8 For the son of man is master of the sabbath.

MAT 12:10 And behold, there was a man having a hand withered. And they asked him, saying, Is it allowed on the sabbaths to cure? that they should charge him.
MAT 12:11 And he said to them, What man will be of you who shall have one sheep, and if this one should fall in the sabbaths into a cistern, shall not grab hold of it and raise it?
MAT 12:12 How much then differs a man than a sheep? So that it is allowed to do well on the sabbaths.
MAT 12:13 Then he says to the man, Stretch out your hand! And he stretched it out; and it was restored in health as the other.

MAT 12:16 And he gave reproach to them that they should not make him known openly,
MAT 12:17 so that should be fulfilled the thing having been spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,

MAT 12:19 He shall not contend, nor cry out, nor shall anyone hear his voice in the squares.
MAT 12:20 A reed being broken he shall not break away, and smoldering flax he shall not extinguish, until whenever he should cast forth equity into victory.
MAT 12:21 And in his name nations shall hope.

MAT 12:23 And all the multitudes were amazed, and said, Is not this. the son of David?
MAT 12:24 But the Pharisees having heard, said, This one does not cast out the demons, except by Beelzebul the ruler of the demons.

MAT 12:26 And if Satan casts out Satan, he portions against himself; how then shall his kingdom be left standing?
MAT 12:27 And if I by Beelzebul cast out the demons, by what means do your sons cast out? On account of this they will be your judges.
MAT 12:28 But if I by spirit of God cast out the demons, surely then came upon you the kingdom of God.
MAT 12:29 Or how is anyone able to enter into the house of the strong man, and plunder his equipment, if not first he ties up the strong man? and then he shall plunder his house.
MAT 12:30 The one not being with me is against me; and the one not gathering together with me disperses.
MAT 12:31 On account of this I say to you, Every sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven to the men. But the blasphemy of the spirit shall not be forgiven to the men.
MAT 12:32 And whoever should say a word against the son of man, it shall be forgiven him. But the one who should speak against the holy spirit, it shall not be forgiven him, neither in the present eon, nor in the one about to be.
MAT 12:33 Then make the tree good, and its fruit good; or make the tree rotten, and its fruit rotten! For of the fruit the tree is known.
MAT 12:34 Offspring of vipers, how are you able to speak good things, being wicked? for from out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaks.
MAT 12:35 The good man from out of the good treasury of the heart casts forth the good things. And the wicked man from out of the wicked treasury casts forth the wicked things.
MAT 12:36 But I say to you, That every idle saying which ever men shall speak, they shall render for it a reckoning in the day of judgment.
MAT 12:37 For by your words you shall be justified, and by your words you shall be condemned.

MAT 12:40 For as Jonah was in the belly of the sea monster three days and three nights; so will the son of man be in the heart of the earth three days and three nights.

MAT 13:1 And in that day, Jesus having gone forth from the house, sat down by the sea.
MAT 13:2 And were gathered together with him great multitudes, so that he having stepped into the boat sat down; and all the multitude upon the shore stood.
MAT 13:3 And he spoke to them many things in parables, saying, Behold, came forth the one sowing to sow.
MAT 13:4 And in his sowing, some seeds indeed fell by the way, and the birds came and ate them.
MAT 13:5 And others fell upon the rocky places, where it did not have much earth. And immediately it rose up, on account of the not having a depth of earth.
MAT 13:6 But the sun having risen scorched it; and on account of the not having root it was dried up.
MAT 13:7 And others fell by the thorn-bushes; and the thorn-bushes ascended, and choked them.
MAT 13:8 And others fell upon the good earth, and yielded fruit - some indeed a hundred, and some sixty, and some thirty.
MAT 13:9 The one having ears to hear, let him hear!
MAT 13:10 And having come, the disciples said to him, Why in parables do you speak to them?
MAT 13:11 And he answering said to them, That to you has been given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of the heavens, but to those it has not been given.
MAT 13:12 For whosoever has, it shall be given to him, and he shall abound. But whosoever does not have, even what he has shall be lifted from him.
MAT 13:13 On account of this I speak to them in parables. For seeing they see not; and hearing they hear not, nor perceive.
MAT 13:14 And is fulfilled by them the prophecy of Isaiah, saying, Hearing you shall hear, and in no way should you perceive; and seeing you shall see, and in no way should you know.
MAT 13:15 For the heart of this people was thickened, and with the ears they heard heavily, and they closed the eyelids of their eyes; lest at any time they should see with the eyes, and with the ears should hear, and the heart should perceive, and they should turn, and I shall heal them.
MAT 13:16 But blessed are your eyes, for they see; and your ears, for they hear.
MAT 13:17 For amen I say to you, That many prophets and just ones desired to behold what you see, and beheld not; and to hear what you hear, and heard not.
MAT 13:18 You then hear the parable of the one sowing!
MAT 13:19 Every one hearing the word of the kingdom, and not perceiving, there comes the evil one, and he seizes by force the thing being sown in his heart - this is the one being sown by the way.
MAT 13:20 And the one by the rocky places being sown - this is the one hearing the word, and straightway with joy receives it;
MAT 13:21 but he has not a root in himself, but is temporary. And affliction taking place or persecution on account of the word, straightway he is caused to stumble.
MAT 13:22 And the one being sown in the thorn-bushes - this is the one hearing the word; and the anxiety of this eon, and the deception of riches, chokes out the word, and he becomes unfruitful.
MAT 13:23 But the one being sown upon the good earth - this is the one hearing the word, and perceiving; who indeed bears fruit, and produces some indeed a hundred, and some sixty, and some thirty.
MAT 13:24 Another parable he pointed out to them, saying, The kingdom of the heavens is like a man sowing good seed in his field.
MAT 13:25 And during the sleeping of the men, his enemy came and sowed tares in the midst of the grain, and went forth.
MAT 13:26 And when the blade burst forth, and produced fruit, then appeared also the tares.
MAT 13:27 And coming forward, the menservants of the master of the house said to him, O Master, was it not good seed you sowed in your field? From where then have the tares?
MAT 13:28 And he said to them, an enemy, a man did this. And the menservants said to him, Do you want then having gone forth we gather them?
MAT 13:29 And he said, No, lest gathering the tares you should root out together with them the grain.
MAT 13:30 Allow both to grow together until the harvest! And at the time of the harvest I will say to the harvesters, Gather together first the tares, and tie them into a bundle so as to incinerate them! But the grain you gather together unto my storehouse!
MAT 13:31 Another parable he pointed out to them, saying, The kingdom of the heavens is likened to a kernel of mustard, (which a man having taken sowed in his field,)
MAT 13:32 which indeed is lesser of all the seeds. But whenever it should grow, the vegetation is greater, and it becomes a tree, so as for the birds of the heaven to come and encamp in its branches.
MAT 13:33 Another parable he spoke to them. The kingdom of the heavens is likened to yeast, which having taken, a woman hides in three seahs of flour, until of which all is leavened.
MAT 13:34 All these things Jesus spoke in parables to the multitudes, and without parables he spoke not to them;
MAT 13:35 so that should be fulfilled the thing having been spoken through the prophet, saying, I shall open my mouth in parables; I will bellow things being hidden from the founding of the world.
MAT 13:36 Then dismissing the multitudes, Jesus went into the house. And his disciples came forward to him, saying, Expound to us the parable of the tares of the field.
MAT 13:37 And answering he said to them, The one sowing the good seed is the son of man;
MAT 13:38 and the field is the world; and the good seed, these are the sons of the kingdom; and the tares are the sons of the wicked one;
MAT 13:39 and the enemy sowing them is the devil; and the harvest is the completion of the age; and the harvesters are angels.
MAT 13:40 As then the tares are collected together and incinerated in fire, so it will be in the completion of this eon.
MAT 13:41 The son of man shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather together from his kingdom all the ones causing offence, and the ones committing lawlessness;
MAT 13:42 and they shall throw them into the furnace of the fire. There, there shall be the weeping and the gnashing of the teeth.
MAT 13:43 Then the just ones shall shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their father. The one having ears to hear, let him hear!
MAT 13:44 Again the kingdom of the heavens is likened to a treasure being hidden in the field; which having found, a man hid. And from the joy of it he goes, and all as much as he has he sells, and he buys that field.
MAT 13:45 Again the kingdom of the heavens is likened to a man, a merchant seeking good pearls;
MAT 13:46 who having found one valuable pearl, having gone forth sells all as much as he has, and buys it.
MAT 13:47 Again the kingdom of the heavens is likened to a dragnet being thrown into the sea, and gathering together of every kind.
MAT 13:48 Which when it was filled, having been hauled upon the shore, and having sat down, they gather together the good things into receptacles, and the rotten they throw out.
MAT 13:49 Thus it shall be in the completion of the age. The angels shall go forth, and shall separate the evil ones from the midst of the just ones.
MAT 13:50 And they shall throw them into the furnace of fire. There, there shall be the weeping and the gnashing of the teeth.

MAT 13:52 And he said to them, On account of this every scribe discipled into the kingdom of the heavens is likened to a man, a master of a house, who casts out from his treasury new and old.

MAT 14:4 For John said to him, It is not allowed to you to have her.

MAT 15:2 Why do your disciples violate the tradition of the elders? they wash not for their hands whenever they eat bread.
MAT 15:3 And answering he said to them, Why also do you violate the commandment of God through your tradition?
MAT 15:4 For God gave charge, saying, Esteem the father and the mother! and, The one speaking evil of father or mother, by death shall come to an end.
MAT 15:5 But you say, Who ever should say to the father or to the mother, whatever from me you should derive benefit is a gift offering;
MAT 15:6 and in no way should he esteem his father or his mother - then you voided the commandment of God through your tradition.

MAT 15:8 This people approach me with their mouth, and with the lips esteem me; but their heart is far off at a distance from me.

MAT 15:17 Not yet do you comprehend, that all entering into the mouth has a space in the belly, and into the bowel is cast out?
MAT 15:18 But the things going forth out of the mouth come forth from the heart; and those defile the man.
MAT 15:19 For from out of the heart comes forth evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, harlotries, frauds, false witnesses, blasphemies.
MAT 15:20 These are the things defiling the man. But to eat with unwashed hands defiles not the man.

MAT 15:26 And answering he said, It is not good to take the bread of the children, and to throw it to the little dogs.

MAT 15:28 Then responding Jesus said to her, O woman, great is the belief of your's. Let it be to you as you want! And her daughter was healed from that hour.

MAT 16:1 And having come forward, the Pharisees and Sadducees testing, asked him to display a sign from out of the heaven to them.

MAT 18:1 In that hour the disciples came forward to Jesus, saying, Who then is greater in the kingdom of the heavens?
MAT 18:2 And Jesus having called a child, stood it in the midst of them,
MAT 18:3 and said, Amen I say to you, If you should not turn, and become as the children, in no way should you enter into the kingdom of the heavens.
MAT 18:4 Whoever then humbles himself as this child, this one is the greater in the kingdom of the heavens.
MAT 18:5 And who ever receives one such child in my name, receives me.
MAT 18:6 And who ever should cause to stumble one of these small ones trusting in me, it would be advantageous to him that a millstone of a donkey should be hung upon his neck, and he should be sunk in the open sea.
MAT 18:7 Woe to the world because of the obstacles; for it is a necessity for the obstacles to come; except woe to that man through whom the obstacle comes.
MAT 18:8 And if your hand or your foot causes you to stumble, cut them off, and throw them from you! It is good for you to enter into life lame or crippled, than having two hands or two feet to be thrown into the eternal fire.
MAT 18:9 And if your eye stumbles you, take it out and cast it from you! It is good for you to enter one-eyed in life, than having two eyes to be thrown into the Gehenna of fire.
MAT 18:10 See that you should not disdain one of these small ones! For I say to you, That their angels in heavens continually see the face of my father in the heavens.
MAT 18:11 For the son of man is come to save the lost.
MAT 18:12 What do you think? if there should be to any man a hundred sheep, and one should wander from them, shall he not leave the ninety nine upon the mountains, and having gone seek the one wandering?
MAT 18:13 And if it happens he finds it, amen I say to you, That he rejoices over it, rather than over the ninety nine not wandering.
MAT 18:14 Thus it is not the will before your father in heavens, that one of these small ones should be lost.
MAT 18:15 But if your brother should sin against you, go and reprove him between you and him alone! If he should hear you, you gain your brother.
MAT 18:16 And if he should not hear, take with you still one or two! that by the mouth of two witnesses or three every matter shall be established.
MAT 18:17 But if he should disregard them, speak to the assembly! And if also the assembly he should disregard, let him be to you as if the ethnics and the tax collector!
MAT 18:18 Amen I say to you, As much as you should tie upon the earth, it will be tied in the heaven; and as much as you should untie upon the earth, it will be untied in the heaven.
MAT 18:19 Again amen I say to you, That if two of you should join in harmony upon the earth concerning every matter of which ever they should ask, it shall happen to them by my father in the heavens.
MAT 18:20 For where there are two or three being gathered together in my name, there I am in the midst of them.
MAT 18:21 Then having come forward to him, Peter said, O Lord, how often shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him - until seven times?
MAT 18:22 Jesus says to him, Not I say to you unto seven times; but, Unto seventy times seven.
MAT 18:23 On account of this likened is the kingdom of the heavens to a man, a king, who wants to take up a reckoning with his menservants.
MAT 18:24 And he having begun to take up the matter, brings near to him one debtor of ten thousand talents.
MAT 18:25 But he not having means to give back, his master bids him to be sold, and his wife, and the children, and all as much as he had, and to render back.
MAT 18:26 Then the manservant falling, did obeisance to him, saying, O Lord, be lenient upon me, and I will give back all to you!
MAT 18:27 And the master being moved with compassion on that manservant, released him, and forgave to him the debt.
MAT 18:28 And going forth, that manservant found one of his fellow-servants who owed to him a hundred denarii. And having held him, he choked him saying, Give back to me if anything you owe!
MAT 18:29 Then his fellow-servant falling at his feet enjoined him, saying, Be lenient upon me, and I will give back to you!
MAT 18:30 But he wanted not. But going forth he cast him into prison, until he should give back the thing being owed.

MAT 20:34 And moved with compassion, Jesus touched their eyes. And immediately their eyes gained sight, and they followed him.
MAT 21:1 And when they approached unto Jerusalem, and came into Bethphage, to the mount of olives, then Jesus sent two disciples,
MAT 21:2 saying to them, Go into the town before you! And immediately you shall find a donkey being tied, and a foal with her; having untied lead them to me!
MAT 21:3 And if anyone should say to you anything, you say that, Their master has need; and immediately he sends them.
MAT 21:4 And this entirely came to pass, that should be fulfilled the thing having been spoken through the prophet, saying,
MAT 21:5 Say to the daughter of Zion! Behold, your king comes to you, gentle, and being mounted upon a donkey, and a foal, an offspring of a beast of burden.
MAT 21:6 And the disciples having gone, and having done as Jesus assigned to them,
MAT 21:7 they led the donkey, and the foal, and placed upon them their cloaks. And he sat upon them.
MAT 21:8 And the greatest part of the multitude spread out their own cloaks in the way; and others beat branches from the trees, and spread them out in the way.
MAT 21:9 And the multitudes leading before, and the ones following, cried out, saying, Hosanna to the son of David; being blessed is the one coming in the name of the Lord; hosanna in the highest.
MAT 21:10 And of his entering into Jerusalem, all the city was shaken, saying, Who is this?
MAT 21:11 And the multitudes said, This is Jesus the prophet from Nazareth of Galilee.
MAT 21:12 And Jesus entered into the temple of God, and cast out all the ones selling and buying in the temple, and the tables of the money-changers he overturned, and the chairs of the ones selling the doves.
MAT 21:13 And he says to them, It is written, My house shall be called a house of prayer; but you made it a cave of robbers.
MAT 21:14 And came forward to him the lame and blind in the temple; and he cured them.
MAT 21:15 And the chief priests and the scribes beholding the wonders which he did, and the children crying out in the temple, and saying, Hosanna to the son of David; they were indignant.
MAT 21:16 And they said to him, Do you hear what these say? And Jesus says to them, Yes, at no time did you read that, From out of the mouth of infants and nursing ones I readied praise?
MAT 21:17 And leaving them, he came forth outside the city into Bethany; and he lodged there.
MAT 21:18 And in the morning turning back into the city, he hungered.
MAT 21:19 And beholding one fig-tree upon the way, he came unto it, and found nothing on it, except leaves only. And he says to it, No longer from you should fruit be produced into the eon. And immediately the fig-tree dried up.
MAT 21:20 And beholding, the disciples marveled, saying, How did the fig-tree immediately dry up?
MAT 21:21 And answering Jesus said to them, Amen I say to you, If you should have belief, and should not examine, not only the thing of the fig-tree shall you do, but even if to this mountain you should say, Be lifted and be thrown into the sea! it shall come to pass.
MAT 21:22 And all as much as you should have asked in the prayer, believing, you shall receive.
MAT 21:23 And in his coming into the temple, the chief priests came forward to him in his teaching, and the elders of the people, saying, By what authority do you do these things? and who gave to you this authority?
MAT 21:24 And answering Jesus said to them, I will ask you also one word, which if you should tell to me, I also will tell to you by what authority I do these things.
MAT 21:25 The immersion of John, from what place was it? from heaven, or from men? And they argued by themselves, saying, If we should say, From heaven; he will say to us, Why then did you not believe in him?
MAT 21:26 And if we should say, From men; we fear the multitude; for all hold John as a prophet.
MAT 21:27 And answering to Jesus they said, We do not know. He said to them also himself, Nor I tell to you by what authority I do these things.
MAT 21:28 But what do you think? A certain man had two children; and having come forward to the first, he said, Child, go, today work in my vineyard!
MAT 21:29 And responding he said, I do not want to. But afterwards, having changed his mind, he went forth.
MAT 21:30 And having come forward to the second, he said likewise. And he answering said, I will, O master. And he did not go forth.
MAT 21:31 Which of the two did the will of the father? They say to him, The first. Jesus says to them, Amen I say to you, That the tax collectors and the harlots go before you into the kingdom of God.
MAT 21:32 For John came to you in the way of righteousness, and you did not believe him, but the tax collectors and the harlots believed him; But you having seen, repented not afterwards, to believe him.
MAT 21:33 Another parable hear! A certain man was master of a house, who planted a vineyard, and put around a barrier to it, and dug in it a wine vat, and built a tower, and handed it over to growers, and traveled abroad.
MAT 21:34 And when the season of the fruits approached, he sent his menservants to the growers to receive of his fruits.
MAT 21:35 And the growers having taken his menservants - one then they flayed, and one they killed, and one they stoned.
MAT 21:36 Again, he sent other menservants more than the first; and they did to them likewise.
MAT 21:37 And afterwards he sent to them his son, saying, They will respect my son.
MAT 21:38 And the growers seeing the son, said among themselves, This is the heir; come, we should kill him, and take control of his inheritance.
MAT 21:39 And having taken, they cast him outside the vineyard, and killed him.
MAT 21:40 Whenever then the master of the vineyard shall come, what will he do to those growers?
MAT 21:41 They say to him, The evil men, harshly he will destroy them, and the vineyard he will hand over to other growers, who will render to him the fruits in their seasons.
MAT 21:42 Jesus says to them, At no time did you read in the scriptures? The stone which the ones building rejected, this one became as head corner stone; by the Lord this happened, and it is wonderful in our eyes?
MAT 21:43 On account of this I say to you, that, The kingdom of God shall be lifted away from you, and shall be given to a nation producing the fruits of it.
MAT 21:44 And the one falling upon this stone shall be fractured in pieces; but upon whom ever it should fall, it shall winnow him.
MAT 21:45 And the chief priests and the Pharisees hearing his parables, knew that about them he speaks.
MAT 21:46 And seeking to hold him, they feared the multitudes, since they held him as a prophet.
MAT 22:1 And responding Jesus again spoke to them in parables, saying,
MAT 22:2 The kingdom of the heavens was likened to a man, a king, who prepared wedding feasts for his son.
MAT 22:3 And he sent his menservants to call the ones being invited unto the wedding feasts; and they did not want to come.
MAT 22:4 Again, he sent other menservants, saying, Say to the ones being invited! Behold, my dinner is prepared; my bullocks and the fattened calves are being sacrificed, and all things are prepared; come to the wedding feasts.
MAT 22:5 But neglecting, they went forth, the one unto his own field, and one unto his trade;
MAT 22:6 and the remaining having taken hold of his menservants, insulted, and killed them.
MAT 22:7 And having heard, that king was provoked to anger. And having sent forth his military, he destroyed those murderers, and their city he burned.
MAT 22:8 Then he says to his menservants, Indeed the wedding feast is prepared, but the ones being invited were not worthy.
MAT 22:9 You go then unto the outer reaches of the ways, and as many as you should find, invite to the wedding feasts!
MAT 22:10 And those menservants having gone forth into the ways, gathered together all as many as they found, both wicked and good; and the wedding feast was filled with ones reclining.
MAT 22:11 And the king entering to see the ones reclining, he beheld there a man not having put on the wedding garment.
MAT 22:12 And he says to him, Friend, how did you enter here not having a wedding garment? And he was halted.
MAT 22:13 Then the king said to the servants, Having bound his feet and hands, lift him, and cast him into the outer darkness! There, there will be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth.
MAT 22:14 For many are called, but few are chosen.
MAT 22:15 Then having gone, the Pharisees took council how they should ensnare him in a matter.
MAT 22:16 And they sent to him their disciples with the Herodians, saying, Teacher, we know that you are true, and the way of God in truth you teach, and there is not a care to you concerning any one; for you see not to the person of men.
MAT 22:17 Now then tell to us! What do you think? Is it allowed to give tribute to Caesar or not?
MAT 22:18 And Jesus knowing their wickedness, said, Why do you test me, hypocrites?
MAT 22:19 Display to me the money for the tribute! And they brought to him a denarius.
MAT 22:20 And he says to them, What is the image to this and the inscription?
MAT 22:21 They say to him, Caesar's. Then he says to them, Render then the things of Caesar, to Caesar; and the things of God, to God!
MAT 22:22 And having heard they marveled; and leaving him, they went forth.
MAT 22:23 On that day, Sadducees came forward to him, the ones saying there is no resurrection. And they asked him,
MAT 22:24 saying, Teacher, Moses said, If any should die not having children, his brother shall ally by marriage to his wife, and shall raise up seed to his brother.
MAT 22:25 Now there were with us seven brothers; and the first having married came to an end, and not having seed he left his wife to his brother.
MAT 22:26 In like manner also the second, and the third, unto the seven.
MAT 22:27 And afterwards all died and the wife.
MAT 22:28 In the then resurrection which of the seven will she be wife? for all had her.
MAT 22:29 And answering Jesus said to them, You err, not knowing the scriptures, nor the power of God.
MAT 22:30 For in the resurrection neither they marry, nor give in marriage, but they are as angels of God in heaven.
MAT 22:31 But concerning the resurrection of the dead, have you not read the thing having been spoken to you by God, saying,
MAT 22:32 I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob? He is not the God of the dead, but of living.
MAT 22:33 And having heard, the multitudes were overwhelmed at his teaching.
MAT 22:34 And the Pharisees, having heard that he halted the Sadducees, gathered together at the same place.
MAT 22:35 And one of them a legal expert asked, testing him, and saying,
MAT 22:36 Teacher, which commandment is great in the law?
MAT 22:37 And Jesus said to him, You shall love the Lord your God with your entire heart, and with your entire soul, and with your entire thought.
MAT 22:38 This is the first and great commandment.
MAT 22:39 And second likened to it, You shall love your neighbor as yourself.
MAT 22:40 In these two commandments all the law and the prophets hang upon.
MAT 22:41 And the Pharisees being gathered together, Jesus asked them,
MAT 22:42 saying, What do you think concerning the Christ? Whose son is he? They say to him, David's.
MAT 22:43 He says to them, How then does David in spirit call him Lord? saying,
MAT 22:44 The Lord - the Greek proper name of Diety said. to my Lord, Sit down at my right until whenever I should establish your enemies for a footstool for your feet!
MAT 22:45 If then David calls him, Lord, how is he his son?
MAT 22:46 And no one was able to answer him a word, nor dared to ask him anything from that day any more.
MAT 23:1 Then Jesus spoke to the multitudes, and to his disciples,
MAT 23:2 saying, Upon the chair of Moses sat the scribes and the Pharisees.
MAT 23:3 All then, as much as they should say to you to give heed, you give heed and do! But according to their works do not do! For they speak, and do not do.
MAT 23:4 For they bind a heavy load and ones hard to bear, and place them upon the shoulders of men; but with their finger they do not want to move them.
MAT 23:5 And all their works they do to be a spectacle to the men. And they widen their phylacteries, and magnify the decorative hems of their cloaks,
MAT 23:6 and are fond of first place in the suppers, and the first seats in the synagogues,
MAT 23:7 and the greetings in the markets, and to be called by the men, Rabbi, Rabbi.
MAT 23:8 But you should not be called Rabbi; for one is your mentor, the Christ; and all you are brothers.
MAT 23:9 And call not any of yours upon the earth father; for there is one - your father in the heavens.
MAT 23:10 Nor be called mentors; for one is your mentor - the Christ.
MAT 23:11 And the greater of you will be your servant.
MAT 23:12 And whoever shall exalt himself, shall be humbled; and whoever shall humble himself, shall be exalted.
MAT 23:13 Woe to you scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites; for you devour the houses of the widows, and as an excuse praying long; on account of this you shall receive more extra judgment.
MAT 23:14 Woe to you scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites; for you lock the kingdom of the heavens before men; for you do not enter in, nor the ones entering do you allow to enter.
MAT 23:15 Woe to you scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites; for you lead about the sea and the dry land to make one convert, and whenever he becomes so, you make him a son of Gehenna - more double than yourselves.
MAT 23:16 Woe to you blind guides, the ones saying, Who ever should swear by an oath on the temple, it is nothing; but who ever should swear by an oath on the gold of the temple, he owes.
MAT 23:17 Morons and blind; for what is greater, the gold, or the temple sanctifying the gold?
MAT 23:18 And saying, Who ever should swear by an oath on the altar, it is nothing; but who ever should swear by an oath by the gift offering upon it, he owes.
MAT 23:19 Morons and blind; for which is greater, the gift offering, or the altar sanctifying the gift offering?
MAT 23:20 The one then swearing an oath by the altar, swears an oath by it, and by all the things upon it.
MAT 23:21 And the one swearing an oath by the temple, swears an oath by it, and by the one having dwelt it.
MAT 23:22 And the one swearing an oath by the heaven, swears an oath by the throne of God, and by the one sitting down upon it.
MAT 23:23 Woe to you scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites; for you tithe the mint, and the dill, and the cummin, and leave the heavier matters of the law - the judgment, and the mercy, and the belief - these necessary to do, and these are not allowed.
MAT 23:24 Blind guides, the ones straining the gnat, but swallowing down a camel.
MAT 23:25 Woe to you scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites; for you cleanse the outside of the cup and the dish, but inside is full of seizure and intemperance.
MAT 23:26 Blind Pharisee, cleanse first the thing within the cup and the dish, that their outside should also become clean.
MAT 23:27 Woe to you scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites; for you are like tombs being whitewashed, which outside indeed appear beautiful, but inside are full of bones of dead ones, and of all uncleanness.
MAT 23:28 So also you from outside indeed appear to men as just, but inside you are full of hypocrisy and of lawlessness.
MAT 23:29 Woe to you scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites; for you build the tombs of the prophets, and adorn the memorials of the just ones,
MAT 23:30 and say, If we were in the days of our fathers, we would not be their partners in the blood of the prophets.
MAT 23:31 So that you witness against yourselves, that you are sons of the ones murdering the prophets.
MAT 23:32 And you fill up the measure of your fathers.
MAT 23:33 Serpents, offspring of vipers, how should you flee from the judgment of Gehenna?
MAT 23:34 On account of this, behold, I send to you prophets, and wise ones, and scribes; and of them you shall kill and crucify; and of them you will whip in your synagogues, and persecute them from city to city;
MAT 23:35 so that should come upon you all just blood having been poured out upon the earth, from the blood of Abel the just one unto the blood of Zachariah son of Barachiah, whom you murdered between the temple and the altar.
MAT 23:36 Amen I say to you, That all these things shall come upon this generation.
MAT 23:37 Jerusalem, Jerusalem, the one killing the prophets, and stoning the ones sent to her, how often I wanted to assemble your children in which manner a hen assembles her nestlings under the wings, and you wanted not.
MAT 23:38 Behold, your house is left to you desolate.
MAT 23:39 For I say to you, In no way should you behold me from now, until whenever you should say, Being blessed is the one coming in the name of the Lord.
MAT 24:1 And coming forth, Jesus went from the temple. And his disciples came forward to display to him the constructions of the temple.
MAT 24:2 And Jesus - answering. said to them, Do you not see all these? Amen I say to you, In no way shall there be left here stone upon stone which in any way shall be resting.
MAT 24:3 And of his sitting down upon the mount of olives, there came forward to him the disciples in private, saying, Tell us when these things will be, and what is the sign of your arrival, and the completion of the eon?
MAT 24:4 And answering Jesus said to them, Take heed lest any should mislead you!
MAT 24:5 For many shall come in my name, saying, I am the Christ. And they shall mislead many.
MAT 24:6 But you shall be about to hear of wars and reports of wars. Look to it, lest you be alarmed! For all these things must take place, but not yet is the end.
MAT 24:7 For nation shall rise up against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. And there will be famines, and pestilent things, and earthquakes, in places.
MAT 24:8 And all these things are the beginning of birth-pangs.
MAT 24:9 Then they shall deliver you unto affliction, and shall kill you. And you shall be ones being detested by all the nations on account of my name.
MAT 24:10 And then many shall be stumbled, and they shall deliver up one another, and they shall detest one another.
MAT 24:11 And many false prophets shall arise, and they shall mislead many.
MAT 24:12 And on account of the multiplying the lawlessness, the love of many shall be made cold.
MAT 24:13 But the one remaining unto the end, this one shall be delivered.
MAT 24:14 And this good news of the kingdom shall be proclaimed in the entire inhabitable world for a testimony to all the ones among the nations; and then shall come the end.
MAT 24:15 Whenever then you should behold the abomination of the desolation, the thing having been spoken through Daniel the prophet, standing in a holy place; (the one reading let him comprehend!)
MAT 24:16 Then the ones in Judea, let them flee unto the mountains!
MAT 24:17 The one upon the roof, let him not go down to lift anything from out of his house!
MAT 24:18 And the one in the field, let him not turn back to carry his garments!
MAT 24:19 But woe to the ones having one in the womb, and the ones nursing in those days.
MAT 24:20 And pray that your flight into exile should not take place in winter, nor on a sabbath.
MAT 24:21 For there will be then great affliction, such as has not taken place from the beginning of the world until the present, nor in any way to be.
MAT 24:22 And unless those days were cut short, not even was any flesh delivered. But on account of the chosen ones those days shall be cut short.
MAT 24:23 Then if any should say to you, Behold, here is the Christ, or here; you should not believe.
MAT 24:24 For false christs and false prophets shall arise, and shall give great signs and miracles; so as to mislead, if possible, even the chosen ones.
MAT 24:25 Behold, I described to you beforehand.
MAT 24:26 If then they should say to you, Behold, he is in the wilderness; you should not go forth. Or, Behold, he is in the inner chambers; you should not believe it.
MAT 24:27 For as the lightning comes forth from the east, and shines forth unto the west; so will be also the arrival of the son of man.
MAT 24:28 For where ever might be the corpse, there the eagles will be gathered together.
MAT 24:29 And immediately after the affliction of those days the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall not give her brightness, and the stars shall fall from the heaven, and the forces of the heavens shall be shaken.
MAT 24:30 And then shall appear the sign of the son of man in the heaven. And then all the tribes of the earth shall beat their chest. And they shall see the son of man coming upon the clouds of the heaven with power and great glory.
MAT 24:31 And he shall send his angels with a trumpet of great sound, and they shall assemble his chosen from out of the four winds, from the tips of the heavens unto their tips.
MAT 24:32 But from the fig-tree learn the parable! Whenever already its branches become tender, and the leaves spring forth, know that summer is near.
MAT 24:33 So also you, whenever you behold all these things, know that it is near, at the doors.
MAT 24:34 Amen I say to you, In no way should this generation pass away, until whenever all these things should come to pass.
MAT 24:35 The heaven and the earth shall pass away, but my words in no way shall pass away.
MAT 24:36 But concerning that day and hour no one knows, not even the angels of the heavens, only my father alone.
MAT 24:37 And as the days of Noah, so will be also the arrival of the son of man.
MAT 24:38 For as were in the days before the flood chewing and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, as far as of which day Noah entered into the ark,
MAT 24:39 and knew not until the flood came, and lifted all; so it will be also in the arrival of the son of man.
MAT 24:40 Then two will be in the field; the one shall be taken by himself, and the one left.
MAT 24:41 Two women grinding at the mill; one shall be taken by herself, and one left.
MAT 24:42 Be vigilant then; for you know not what hour your Lord comes!
MAT 24:43 But this know! That if the master of the house knew what watch the thief comes, he would have been vigilant, and would not have allowed his house to be dug through.
MAT 24:44 On account of this you also be prepared! For in which hour you think not the son of man comes.
MAT 24:45 Who then is the trustworthy and practical manservant, whom his master placed over his service, to give to them provision in season?
MAT 24:46 Blessed is that manservant, whom his master having come shall find doing thus.
MAT 24:47 Amen I say to you, That over all his possessions he shall place him.
MAT 24:48 But if that evil manservant should say in his heart, My master passes time to come;
MAT 24:49 and he should begin to beat the fellow-servants, and to eat and drink with the ones being intoxicated;
MAT 24:50 the master of that manservant shall come in a day in which he does not expect, and in an hour in which he knows not,
MAT 24:51 and shall cut him in pieces, and his portion will be established with the hypocrites. There, there shall be the weeping and the gnashing of the teeth.

MAT 25:4 But the practical took oil in their receptacles with their lamps.

MAT 25:6 And in the middle of the night a cry came, Behold, the groom comes; go forth to meet him!
MAT 25:7 Then arose all those virgins, and trimmed their lamps.
MAT 25:8 And the moronish said to the practical, Give to us from your oil! for our lamps are extinguishing.
MAT 25:9 And the practical answered, saying, No, lest at any time it should not be sufficient to us and to you; but you go rather to the ones selling, and buy for yourselves!

MAT 25:16 And having gone, the one receiving the five talents worked with them, and made another five talents.
MAT 25:17 Likewise also the one receiving the two, he gained himself also another two.
MAT 25:18 And the one receiving the one, having gone forth dug in the ground, and concealed the money of his master.
MAT 25:19 And after a long time came the master of those menservants, and he takes up a reckoning with them.
MAT 25:20 And the one receiving the five talents having come forward, brought another five talents, saying, O Master, five talents to me you delivered; see, another five talents I gained besides them!
MAT 25:21 And his master said to him, Well done, O good and trustworthy manservant; over a few things you were trustworthy, over many I will place you - enter into the joy of your master!
MAT 25:22 And coming forward also the one receiving the two talents, said, O Master, two talents you delivered up to me; see, another two talents I gained besides them!
MAT 25:23 And his master said to him, Well done, O good and trustworthy manservant, over a few things you were trustworthy, over many I will place you - enter into the joy of your master!
MAT 25:24 And having come forward also the one having taken the one talent, said, O Master, I knew that you are a hard man, harvesting where you sowed not, and gathering from where you dispersed not.
MAT 25:25 And fearing, having gone forth, I hid your talent in the ground - see, you have yours!
MAT 25:26 And responding his master said to him, O Wicked and lazy manservant, you knew that I harvest where I sowed not, and gather from where I dispersed not.
MAT 25:27 It was necessary then for you to put my money with the bankers, and coming I would be delivered whatever was mine with interest.
MAT 25:28 Take then from him the talent, and give it to the one having the ten talents!
MAT 25:29 For to every one having shall be given, and shall abound; but from the one not having, even what - he thinks to have. he has shall be taken from him.
MAT 25:30 And cast out the useless manservant into outer darkness! There, there will be the weeping and gnashing of the teeth.

MAT 25:32 And he shall gather together before him all the nations; and he will separate them from one another, as the shepherd separates the sheep from the kids of the goats.
MAT 25:33 And he will set the sheep indeed on his right, and the little kids on his left.
MAT 25:34 Then the king shall say to the ones on his right, Come, O ones being blessed of my father, inherit the kingdom being prepared for you from the founding of the world!

MAT 25:36 naked, and you clothed me; I was sick, and you visited me; I was in prison, and you came to me.
