LUK 24:24 And some of the ones with us went forth unto the sepulchre, and found it so as also the women said. But him we saw not.
LUK 24:25 And he said to them, O unthinking ones, and slow in the heart to trust upon all which the prophets spoke.
LUK 24:26 Is it not necessary the Christ to suffer these things, and to enter into his glory?
LUK 24:27 And beginning from Moses, and from all of the prophets, he interpreted to them in all the scriptures the things concerning himself.
LUK 24:28 And they approached unto the town where they were going. And he pretended to be going further.
LUK 24:29 And they pressured him, saying, Stay with us; for it is towards evening, and the day has declined. And he entered to stay with them.
LUK 24:30 And it came to pass, in his lying down to eat with them, having taken the bread, he blessed, and having broken gave it over to them.
LUK 24:31 And their eyes were opened wide, and they recognized him; and he became invisible to them.
LUK 24:32 And they said to one another, Was not our heart burning in us as he was speaking to us in the way, and as he opened wide to us the scriptures?
LUK 24:33 And rising up the same hour, they returned into Jerusalem, and they found the eleven being gathered together, and the ones with them,
LUK 24:34 saying that, The Lord is risen really, and he appeared to Simon.
LUK 24:35 And they described the things in the way, and how he was made known to them in the breaking of the bread.
LUK 24:36 And of their speaking these things, Jesus himself stood in the midst of them, and says to them, Peace to you.
LUK 24:37 And being terrified, and becoming thrown into fear, they thought they viewed a spirit.
LUK 24:38 And he said to them, Why are you disturbed? and why do thoughts ascend into your hearts?
LUK 24:39 Behold my hands and my feet, that I am he! Handle me and see! For a spirit has not flesh and bones, as you view me having.
LUK 24:40 And this having said, he displayed to them his hands and his feet.
LUK 24:41 And yet of their disbelieving from the joy, and marveling, he said to them, Have you anything eatable here?
LUK 24:42 And they gave over to him part of a roasted fish, and some from a bee's honeycomb.
LUK 24:43 And having taken before them, he ate.
LUK 24:44 And he said to them, These are the words which I spoke to you while still being with you, that it is necessary to fulfill all the things being written in the law of Moses, and the prophets, and the Psalms, concerning me.
LUK 24:45 Then he opened wide their mind to perceive the scriptures.
LUK 24:46 And he said to them that, Thus it has been written, and thus it is necessary for the Christ to suffer, and to be raised up from the dead in the third day;
LUK 24:47 and repentance and release of sins to be proclaimed in his name unto all the nations, beginning from Jerusalem.
LUK 24:48 And you are witnesses of these things.
LUK 24:49 And behold, I send the promise of my father unto you. But you stay in the city of Jerusalem, until of which time you shall be clothed with power from out of the height!
LUK 24:50 And he led them outside as far as unto Bethany. And having lifted up his hands, he blessed them.
LUK 24:51 And it came to pass, in his blessing them, he was parted from them, and was borne into the heaven.
LUK 24:52 And they having done obeisance to him, returned unto Jerusalem with great joy.
LUK 24:53 And they were always in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.
JOH 1:1 In the beginning was the word, and the word was with God, and the word was God.
JOH 1:2 This one was in the beginning with God.
JOH 1:3 All through him existed; and apart from him not even one thing existed which exists.
JOH 1:4 In him was life; and the life was the light of men.
JOH 1:5 And the light appears in the darkness; and the darkness overtook it not.
JOH 1:6 There existed a man being sent by God - the name to him was John.
JOH 1:7 This one came for a witness, that he should witness concerning the light, that all should believe through him.
JOH 1:8 That one was not the light, but that he should witness concerning the light.
JOH 1:9 The true light was which enlightens every man coming into the world.
JOH 1:10 He was in the world, and the world by him existed, and the world knew him not.
JOH 1:11 Unto his own he came, and his own received him not.
JOH 1:12 But as many as received him, he gave to them authority to become children of God, to the ones believing in his name;
JOH 1:13 the ones who not from blood, nor from will of flesh, nor from will of man, but from God were born.
JOH 1:14 And the word became flesh, and tented among us. And we saw his glory - glory as an only child of the father, full of favor and truth.
JOH 1:15 John witnessed concerning him, and cried out, saying, This was whom I said, The one coming after me was before me; for he was foremost over me.
JOH 1:16 And from out of his fullness we all received, even favor upon favor.
JOH 1:17 For the law was given through Moses - the favor and the truth came through Jesus Christ.
JOH 1:18 No one has seen God at any time; the only born son, the one being in the bosom of the father, that one described him.
JOH 1:19 And this is the witness of John, when the Jews sent from Jerusalem priests and Levites, that they should ask him, Who are you?
JOH 1:20 And he acknowledged, and denied not; and acknowledged that, I am not the Christ.
JOH 1:21 And they asked him, What then? Are you Elijah? And he says, I am not. Are you the prophet? And he answered, No.
JOH 1:22 They said then to him, Who are you? that an answer we should give to the ones having sent us. What say you concerning yourself?
JOH 1:23 He said, I am a voice yelling in the wilderness, Straighten the way of the LORD! as said Isaiah the prophet.
JOH 1:24 And the ones being sent were of the Pharisees.
JOH 1:25 And they asked him, and said to him, Why then do you immerse, if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the prophet?
JOH 1:26 John answered to them, saying, I immerse in water. But in the midst of you stands, whom you know not.
JOH 1:27 He is the one coming after me, who exists before me, of whom I am not worthy that I should untie his strap of the sandal.
JOH 1:28 These things took place in Bethania on the other side of the Jordan, where John was immersing.
JOH 1:29 The next day John sees Jesus coming to him, and says, See the lamb of God, the one carrying the sin of the world!
JOH 1:30 This is concerning of whom I said, After me comes a man who was before me; for he was foremost over me.
JOH 1:31 And I did not know him. But that he should be made manifest to Israel - on account of this I came in the water immersing.
JOH 1:32 And John witnessed, saying that, I viewed the spirit descending as a dove from out of heaven, and it remained upon him.
JOH 1:33 And I did not know him. But the one having sent me forth to immerse in water, that one said to me, Upon whom ever you should behold the spirit descending, and remaining upon him, he is the one immersing by holy spirit.
JOH 1:34 And I have seen, and I have witnessed that this is the son of God.
JOH 1:35 The next day again John stood, and two of his disciples.
JOH 1:36 And looking at Jesus walking, he says, Behold the lamb of God!
JOH 1:37 And the two disciples heard him speaking, and they followed Jesus.
JOH 1:38 And Jesus having turned, and viewing them following, says to them, What do you seek? And they said to him, (Rabbi, which is to say, being translated, Teacher,) where do you stay?
JOH 1:39 He says to them, Come and see! They came and saw where he stayed, and stayed with him that day. And the hour was about the tenth.
JOH 1:40 Andrew the brother of Simon Peter was one of the two of the ones having heard from John, and having followed him.
JOH 1:41 He first finds his own brother Simon, and says to him, We have found the Messiah, which is being translated, Christ.
JOH 1:42 And he led him to Jesus. And looking at him, Jesus said, You are Simon the son of Jonah, you shall be called Cephas, which is translated, A piece of rock. Peter.
JOH 1:43 The next day he wanted to go forth into Galilee, and he finds Philip, and Jesus says to him, Follow me!
JOH 1:44 And Philip was from Bethsaida, from out of the city of Andrew and Peter.
JOH 1:45 Philip finds Nathanael, and says to him, The one whom Moses wrote in the law, and the prophets, we have found - Jesus the son of Joseph from Nazareth.
JOH 1:46 And Nathanael said to him, Is anything good able to be from out of Nazareth? Philip says to him, Come and see!
JOH 1:47 Jesus beheld Nathanael coming to him, and says concerning him, See! Truly an Israelite, in whom there is not deceit.
JOH 1:48 Nathanael says to him, From what place do you know me? Jesus answered and said to him, Before Philip calling you, being under the fig-tree, I beheld you.
JOH 1:49 Nathanael responded and says to him, Rabbi, you are the son of God; you are the king of Israel.
JOH 1:50 Jesus responded and said to him, Because I said to you, I beheld you underneath the fig-tree, you believe? greater of these you shall see.
JOH 1:51 And he says to him, Amen, amen, I say to you, From now on you shall see the heaven opening, and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the son of man.
JOH 2:1 And in the third day a wedding took place in Cana of Galilee; and the mother of Jesus was there.
JOH 2:2 And were invited also Jesus and his disciples, unto the wedding.
JOH 2:3 And lacking wine, the mother of Jesus says to him, They do not have wine.
JOH 2:4 Jesus says to her, What is it to me and to you, O woman? my hour is not yet come.
JOH 2:5 Says his mother to the servants, What ever he should say to you, you do it!
JOH 2:6 And there were there six stone water-pitchers, being situated for the cleansing of the Jews, having capacity of up to two or three measures.
JOH 2:7 Jesus says to them, Fill the water-pitchers with water! And they filled them unto upward.
JOH 2:8 And he says to them, Draw out now, and bring it to the chief attendant! And they brought.
JOH 2:9 And as the chief attendant tasted the water becoming wine, and knew not from where it is; (but the servants knew, the ones drawing the water;) the chief attendant calls the groom,
JOH 2:10 and says to him, Every man places the good wine first, and whenever they should be intoxicated, then the lesser; you have kept the good wine until just now.
JOH 2:11 This the beginning of the signs Jesus did in Cana of Galilee, and manifested his glory; and his disciples believed in him.
JOH 2:12 After this he went down into Capernaum, he, and his mother, and his brothers, and his disciples. And there they stayed not many days.
JOH 2:13 And the passover of the was Jews near, and Jesus ascended unto Jerusalem.
JOH 2:14 And he found in the temple the ones selling oxen and sheep and doves, and the money-changers sitting down.
JOH 2:15 And having made a scourge out of rough cords, he cast out all from the temple - both the sheep, and the oxen. And of the money-changers, he poured out the brass coins, and the tables he overturned.
JOH 2:16 And to the ones selling the doves he said, Take these from here! Do not make the house of my father a house of a market-place!
JOH 2:17 And his disciples remembered that it is being written, The zeal of your house devoured me.
JOH 2:18 The Jews responded then, and said to him, What sign do you show to us that these things you do?
JOH 2:19 Jesus answered and said to them, Loosen this temple, and in three days I will raise it!
JOH 2:20 The Jews then said, Forty and six years it took to build this temple, and you in three days will raise it?
JOH 2:21 But that one spoke concerning the temple of his body.
JOH 2:22 When then he was raised from the dead, his disciples remembered that this he said to them; and they believed in the scripture, and in the word which Jesus spoke.
JOH 2:23 And as he was in Jerusalem at the passover, in the holiday feast, many believed in his name, viewing his signs which he did.
JOH 2:24 But Jesus himself did not entrust himself to them, on account of his knowing all,
JOH 2:25 and that he had not a need that any should witness concerning man; for he knew what was in man.
JOH 3:1 And there was a man of the Pharisees, Nicodemus was the name to him, a ruler of the Jews.
JOH 3:2 This one came to Jesus by night, and said to him, Rabbi, we know that from God you have come as a teacher; for no one is able to do these signs which you do, unless God should be with him.
JOH 3:3 Jesus responded and said to him, Amen, amen, I say to you, Unless one should be born from above, he is not able to behold the kingdom of God.
JOH 3:4 Nicodemus says to him, How is a man able to be born being aged? Is he able to enter into the belly of his mother a second time, and be born?
JOH 3:5 Jesus answered, Amen, amen, I say to you, Unless one should be born of water and spirit, he is not able to enter into the kingdom of God.
JOH 3:6 The one being born of the flesh is flesh; and the one being born of the spirit is spirit.
JOH 3:7 You should not wonder that I said to you, It is necessary for you to be born from above.
JOH 3:8 The wind blows where it wants, and its sound you hear, but you know not from what place it comes, and where it goes. So is every one being born of the spirit.
JOH 3:9 Nicodemus answered and said to him, How is it possible for these things to be?
JOH 3:10 Jesus answered and said to him, You are the teacher of Israel, and these things you know not?
JOH 3:11 Amen, amen, I say to you that, What we know we speak, and what we have seen we witness; and our witness you do not receive.
JOH 3:12 If the earthly things I told to you, and you believe not, how then will you believe if I should speak to you the heavenly things?
JOH 3:13 And no one has ascended into the heaven, except the one descending from out of the heaven - the son of man being in the heaven.
JOH 3:14 And as Moses raised up high the serpent in the wilderness, so is it necessary the son of man be raised up high.
JOH 3:15 That every one believing in him should not perish, but have eternal life..
JOH 3:16 For thus God loved the world, so that he gave his only born son, that every one believing in him should not perish, but should have eternal life.
JOH 3:17 For God did not send his son into the world that he should judge the world; but that the world should be delivered by him.
JOH 3:18 The one believing in him is not judged; but the one not believing already has been judged, for he believes not in the name of the only born son of God.
JOH 3:19 And this is the judgment - that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness more than the light, for their works were evil.
JOH 3:20 For every one acting heedlessly detests the light, and does not come to the light, that his works should not be reproved.
JOH 3:21 But the one observing the truth comes to the light, that his works should be made manifest, that in God they are working.
JOH 3:22 After these things Jesus came and his disciples into the Judean land; and there he spent time with them, and was immersing.
JOH 3:23 And also John was immersing in Aenon near Salim, for there was much water there. And they were arriving and being immersed.
JOH 3:24 For not yet was John thrown into the prison.
JOH 3:25 Became then an inquiry from the disciples of John with the Jews concerning cleansing.
JOH 3:26 And they came to John, and said to him, Rabbi, the one who was with you on the other side of the Jordan, in whom you witnessed - see, this one immerses, and all come to him!
JOH 3:27 John answered and said, Man is not able to receive anything, unless it should be given to him from the heaven.
JOH 3:28 You yourselves witness to me, that I said, I am not the Christ, but that I am one being sent before that one.
JOH 3:29 The one having the bride is the groom. And the friend of the groom, standing and hearing him, with joy rejoices because of the voice of the groom. This then my joy is fulfilled.
JOH 3:30 That one must grow, but me to lessen.
JOH 3:31 The one coming from above is above all. The one being from the earth, is from out of the earth, and from out of the earth he speaks. The one coming from out of the heaven is above all.
JOH 3:32 And what he has seen and heard, this one witnesses; and his witness no one receives.
JOH 3:33 The one receiving of his witness set a seal that God is true.
JOH 3:34 For the one whom God sent speaks the sayings of God. For not by measure does God give the spirit.
JOH 3:35 The father loves the son, and all things he has put in his hand.
JOH 3:36 The one believing in the son has eternal life. But the one resisting the son shall not see life; but the anger of God remains upon him.
JOH 4:1 When therefore the Lord - Jesus knew. that the Pharisees heard that Jesus made and immersed more disciples than John,
JOH 4:2 (though indeed Jesus himself did not immerse, but his disciples,)
JOH 4:3 he left Judea, and went forth into Galilee.
JOH 4:4 But it was necessary for him to go through Samaria.
JOH 4:5 He comes then into a city of Samaria, being called Sychar, neighboring the place which Jacob gave to Joseph his son.
JOH 4:6 And the spring of Jacob was there. Then Jesus, being tired from the journey, sat thus at the spring - it was about the sixth hour.
JOH 4:7 There comes a woman from out of Samaria to draw water. Jesus says to her, Give to me to drink!
JOH 4:8 (For his disciples went forth into the city that they should buy provisions.)
JOH 4:9 Then the Samaritan woman says to him, How do you, being a Jew, ask from me to drink, being a Samaritan woman? For Jews do not have dealings with Samaritans.
JOH 4:10 Jesus answered and said to her, If you knew the gift of God, and who is the one saying to you, Give to me to drink! you would have asked him, and he would have given to you living water.
JOH 4:11 The woman says to him, O master, neither a bucket do you have, and the well is deep; from what place then have you the living water?
JOH 4:12 Are you greater than our father Jacob, who gave to us the well, and himself drank from it, and his sons, and his livestock?
JOH 4:13 Jesus answered and said to her, Every one drinking of this water thirsts again.
JOH 4:14 But whoever should drink of the water which I give to him, in no way should he thirst into the eon; but the water which I shall give to him shall become in him a spring of water leaping up into eternal life.
JOH 4:15 Says to him the woman, O master, give to me this water, that I should not thirst, nor should come here to draw!
JOH 4:16 Jesus says to her, Go, call your husband, and come here!
JOH 4:17 The woman answered and said, I do not have a husband. Jesus says to her, Well you said that, I do not have a husband.
JOH 4:18 For you had five husbands; and now the one whom you have is not your husband; this truly you have said.
JOH 4:19 The woman says to him, O master, I view that you are a prophet.
JOH 4:20 Our fathers did obeisance in this mountain; and you say that in Jerusalem is the place where it is necessary to do obeisance.
JOH 4:21 Jesus says to her, O woman, trust me, that there comes an hour, when neither in this mountain, nor in Jerusalem, shall you do obeisance to the father.
JOH 4:22 You do obeisance to whom you know not. We do obeisance to whom we know; for deliverance is from out of the Jews.
JOH 4:23 But comes the hour, and now is, when the true ones doing obeisance shall do obeisance to the father in spirit and truth. For also the father seeks such to do obeisance to him.
JOH 4:24 God is spirit. And the ones doing obeisance to him must do obeisance in spirit and truth.
JOH 4:25 The woman says to him, I know that Messiah comes, the one being called Christ. Whenever he should come, that one will announce to us all things.
JOH 4:26 Jesus says to her, I am he, the one speaking to you.
JOH 4:27 And upon this came his disciples, and they marvelled that he spoke with a woman. No one however said, What do you seek? or, Why do you speak with her?
JOH 4:28 The woman then left her water-pitcher, and went forth into the city, and says to the men,
JOH 4:29 Come, see a man who told to me all things as much as I did! Maybe this is the Christ?
JOH 4:30 They came forth then from out of the city, and came to him.
JOH 4:31 But in between the disciples asked him, saying, Rabbi, eat!
JOH 4:32 And he said to them, I have food to eat which you know not.
JOH 4:33 Then the disciples said to one another, Did anyone bring anything to him to eat?
JOH 4:34 Jesus says to them, My food is that I do the will of the one having sent me, and I should perfect his work.
JOH 4:35 Do you not say that, It is still four months, and the harvest comes? Behold, I say to you, Lift up your eyes, and see the places! For they are white for harvest already.
JOH 4:36 And the one harvesting receives a wage, and gathers fruit unto life eternal; that also the one sowing should rejoice together also with the one harvesting.
JOH 4:37 For in this the word is True that, Another is the one sowing, and another is the one harvesting.
JOH 4:38 I sent you to harvest what you have not tired in; others have tired, and you have entered into their toil.
JOH 4:39 And from that city many believed in him of the Samaritans, because of the word of the woman witnessing that, He told to me all things as much as I did.
JOH 4:40 Then as they came to him, the Samaritans asked him to stay with them; and he stayed there two days.
JOH 4:41 And many more believed because of his word;
JOH 4:42 also to the woman they said that, No longer because of your speech do we believe; for ourselves we have heard, and we know that this is truly the deliverer of the world, the Christ.
JOH 4:43 And after the two days he came forth from there, and went forth into Galilee.
JOH 4:44 For Jesus himself testified that, A prophet has not a value in his own fatherland.
JOH 4:45 When then he came into Galilee, the Galileans received him, having seen all the things which he did in Jerusalem during the holiday feast; for they also went to the holiday feast.
JOH 4:46 Then came Jesus again into Cana of Galilee, where he made the water wine. And there was a certain royal official in Capernaum whose son was weak.
JOH 4:47 He having heard that Jesus is come from out of Judea into Galilee, went forth to him, and asked him that he should come down and heal his son; for he was about to die.
JOH 4:48 Then Jesus said to him, If you should not behold signs and miracles, in no way should you believe.
JOH 4:49 The royal official says to him, O Lord, come down before my child dies!
JOH 4:50 Jesus says to him, Go, your son lives! And the man believed in the word which Jesus said to him, and he went.
JOH 4:51 And already as he was going down, his servants met him, and reported, saying that, Your child lives.
JOH 4:52 He inquired then of them the hour in which he sufficed much better. And they said to him that, Yesterday the seventh hour the fever left him.
JOH 4:53 Then the father knew that it was in that hour in which Jesus said to him that, Your son lives. And he believed him, and his entire family.
JOH 4:54 This again was a second sign Jesus did, coming from out of Judea into Galilee.
JOH 5:1 After these was a holiday of the Jews; and Jesus ascended unto Jerusalem.
JOH 5:2 And there is in Jerusalem at the sheep gate a pool, the one being called in Hebrew Bethesda, having five stoas.
JOH 5:3 In these reclined a great multitude being weak, blind, lame, withered, looking out for the movement of the water.
JOH 5:4 For an angel at times came down in the pool, and disturbed the water. The one then first stepping in after the disturbance of the water became sound in whatsoever disease he was held.
JOH 5:5 And there was a certain man there thirty and eight years being held in his feebleness.
JOH 5:6 Jesus seeing this one reclining, and knowing that already a long time he was held, says to him, Do you want to be sound?
JOH 5:7 The one being invalid Answered to him, O lord, I have not a man, that whenever the water should be disturbed, should lay me in the pool; but in which time I come, another before me descends.
JOH 5:8 Jesus says to him, Arise, lift your litter, and walk!
JOH 5:9 And immediately the man became in health, and lifted his litter, and walked. And it was the sabbath on that day.
JOH 5:10 Then said the Jews to the one being cured, It is a sabbath. It is not allowed for you to carry the litter.
JOH 5:11 He responded to them, saying, The one making me in health, that one told me, Carry your litter, and walk!
JOH 5:12 Then they asked him, Who is the man having said to you, Carry your litter and walk?
JOH 5:13 But the one having been healed knew not who it is; for Jesus turned aside, of a multitude being in the place.
JOH 5:14 After these things Jesus finds him in the temple, and he said to him, See, you are in health; no longer sin, that nothing worse should happen to you!
JOH 5:15 The man went forth, and announced to the Jews that Jesus is the one making him in health.
JOH 5:16 And on account of this the Jews persecuted Jesus, and sought to kill him, for these things he did on a sabbath.
JOH 5:17 But Jesus answered to them, My father works until now, and I work.
JOH 5:18 On account of this then more the Jews sought to kill him, for not only he untied the sabbath, but also called God his own father, making himself equal to God.
JOH 5:19 Then answered Jesus and said to them, Amen, amen, I say to you, The son is not able to do of himself anything, unless what he should see the father doing. For what ever things that one should do, these also the son in like manner does.
JOH 5:20 For the father is fond of the son, and shows to him all things which he does. And greater works than these he will show to him, that you should marvel.
JOH 5:21 For as the father raises the dead, and restores to life; so also the son whom he wants restores to life.
JOH 5:22 For neither the father judges any one, but all judgment he has given to the son;
JOH 5:23 that all should esteem the son, as they esteem the father. The one not esteeming the son esteems not the father sending him.
JOH 5:24 Amen, amen, I say to you that, The one hearing my word, and trusting in the one sending me, has eternal life, and comes not into judgment; but has crossed over from death unto life.
JOH 5:25 Amen, amen, I say to you that, There comes an hour, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the son of God; and the ones hearing shall live.
JOH 5:26 For as the father has life in himself; so he gave also to the son to have life in himself;
JOH 5:27 and gave authority to him even to execute judgment, for he is son of man.
JOH 5:28 Do not wonder at this! for comes an hour, in which all the ones in the tombs shall hear his voice,
JOH 5:29 and shall exit; the ones doing good things unto a resurrection of life; but the ones acting heedlessly, unto a resurrection of judgment.
JOH 5:30 Not am I able to do of myself anything. As I hear, I judge. And my judgment is just; for I seek not my will, but the will of the father sending me forth.
JOH 5:31 If I testify concerning myself, my testimony is not true.
JOH 5:32 There is another testifying concerning me; and I know that the testimony is true which he testifies concerning me.
JOH 5:33 You have sent to John, and he testifies the truth.
JOH 5:34 But I do not receive the testimony from man. And these things I say, that you should be delivered.
JOH 5:35 That one was the lamp burning and shining. And you wanted to exult for an hour in his light.
JOH 5:36 But I have the testimony greater than John. For the works which the father gave me that I should perfect them, the works themselves which I do, testify concerning me, that the father has sent me.
JOH 5:37 And the father sending me forth, he has testified concerning me. Neither his voice have you heard at any time, nor his appearance have you seen.
JOH 5:38 And his word you have not abiding in you. For whom that one sent, this one you do not believe.
JOH 5:39 You search the scriptures; for you think in them to have eternal life. And these are the ones testifying concerning me.
JOH 5:40 And you do not want to come to me, that you should have life.
JOH 5:41 Glory from men I receive not.
JOH 5:42 But I have known you, that the love of God you have not in yourselves.
JOH 5:43 I have come in the name of my father, and you did not receive me. If another should come in his own name, that one you will receive.
JOH 5:44 How are you able to believe, receiving glory from one another, and the glory from the only God you do not seek?
JOH 5:45 Do not think that I accuse you to the father! There is the one accusing you - Moses, in whom you hope.
JOH 5:46 For if you believed Moses, you would have believed in me; for concerning me that one wrote.
JOH 5:47 But if in that one's letters you believe not, how shall you believe in my sayings?
JOH 6:1 After these things Jesus went forth on the other side of the sea of Galilee - the one of Tiberias.
JOH 6:2 And there followed him a great multitude, for they saw his signs which he did for the invalids.
JOH 6:3 And Jesus went up into the mountain, and there sat down with his disciples.
JOH 6:4 And it was near the passover, the holiday of the Jews.
JOH 6:5 Then Jesus having lifted up the eyes, and seeing that a great multitude comes to him, says to Philip, From what place should we buy breads, that these should eat?
JOH 6:6 But this he said testing him, for he knew what he was about to do.
JOH 6:7 Philip answered to him, Of two hundred denarii worth of breads are not sufficient for them, that each of them should receive a little.
JOH 6:8 Says to him one from his disciples, Andrew the brother of Simon Peter,
JOH 6:9 There is one boy here who has five breads of barley, and two little fishes - but these, what are they for so many?
JOH 6:10 And Jesus said, Make the men recline! And there was much grass in the place. Then the men reclined - the number was about five thousand.
JOH 6:11 And Jesus took the breads; and having given thanks he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to the ones reclining; in like manner also of the little fishes as much as they wanted.
JOH 6:12 And as they were filled up, he says to his disciples, Gather together the abounding pieces, that nothing should perish!
JOH 6:13 They gathered together then, and filled twelve hampers of pieces of the five breads of barley, which abounded to the ones having eaten.
JOH 6:14 The men then, having seen what sign Jesus did, said that, This is truly the prophet coming into the world.
JOH 6:15 Jesus then knowing that they were about to come and seize him by force, that they should make him king, again withdrew unto the mountain himself alone.
JOH 6:16 And as it became late, his disciples went down unto the sea.
JOH 6:17 And having stepped into the boat, they went to the other side of the sea unto Capernaum. And darkness already was, and Jesus had not come with them,
JOH 6:18 in which also the sea was awakened by a great wind blowing.
JOH 6:19 Having rowed then about twenty-five stadiums or thirty, they viewed Jesus walking upon the sea, and coming near the boat; and they feared.
JOH 6:20 And he says to them, I am he; fear not!
JOH 6:21 They wanted then to receive him into the boat; and immediately the boat became upon the land into which they were going.
JOH 6:22 The next day, the multitude standing on the other side of the sea, seeing that there was not another boat except one, that one into which his disciples stepped into, and that Jesus entered not together with his disciples into the boat, but that his disciples went forth alone,
JOH 6:23 (but other small boats came from Tiberias near the place where they ate the bread, having given thanks to the Lord).
JOH 6:24 when then the multitude saw that Jesus is not there, nor his disciples, they stepped also themselves into the boats, and came unto Capernaum seeking Jesus.
JOH 6:25 And having found him on the other side of the sea, they said to him, Rabbi, How have you become here?
JOH 6:26 Jesus answered to them and said, Amen, amen, I say to you, You seek me, not that you saw signs, but that you ate from the breads, and were filled.
JOH 6:27 Work not for the food perishing! but the food abiding unto life eternal, which the son of man will give to you; for this one God the father set seal upon.
JOH 6:28 They said then to him, What should we do that we work the works of God?
JOH 6:29 Jesus answered and said to them, This is the work of God, that you should have believed in whom that one sent.
JOH 6:30 They said then to him, What sign then do you do, that we should know, and should believe in you? What work do you do?
JOH 6:31 Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness; as it is written, Bread from out of the heaven he gave to them to eat.
JOH 6:32 Jesus then said to them, Amen, amen, I say to you, Moses has not given to you the bread from out of the heaven; but my father gives to you the bread from the heaven - the true.
JOH 6:33 For the bread of God is the one descending from out of the heaven, and giving life to the world.
JOH 6:34 They said then to him, O Master, at all times give to us this bread!
JOH 6:35 And Jesus said to them, I am the bread of life. The one coming to me in no way should hunger; and the one believing in me in no way should thirst at any time.
JOH 6:36 But I said to you, that even you have seen me, and do not believe.
JOH 6:37 All which the father gives to me shall come to me; and the one coming to me in no way shall I cast outside.
JOH 6:38 For I have descended from the heaven, not that I should do my will, but the will of the one having sent me.
JOH 6:39 And this is the will of the father having sent me, that all which he has given to me I should not lose of it, but should raise it in the last day.
JOH 6:40 And this is the will of the one having sent me, that every one viewing the son, and trusting in him, should have life eternal; and I will raise him up - I in the last day.
JOH 6:41 The Jews were grumbling then concerning him, because he said, I am the bread descending from out of the heaven.
JOH 6:42 And they said, Is this not Jesus the son of Joseph, of whom we know the father and the mother? How then says this one that, From out of the heaven I have descended?
JOH 6:43 Jesus answered then and said to them, Do not grumble with one another!
JOH 6:44 No one is able to come to me, unless the father having sent me should draw him; and I will raise him up in the last day.
JOH 6:45 It is written in the prophets, And they will be all instructed of God. Every one then hearing from the father, and having learned, comes to me.
JOH 6:46 Not that anyone has seen the father, except the one being from God, this one has seen the father.
JOH 6:47 Amen, amen, I say to you, The one believing in me has life eternal.
JOH 6:48 I am the bread of life.
JOH 6:49 Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, and died.
JOH 6:50 This is the bread descending from the heaven, that whoever should eat of it even should not die.
JOH 6:51 I am the living bread having descended from the heaven. If anyone shall eat from this bread, he shall live into the eon. But also the bread which I shall give is my flesh, which I shall give for the life of the world.
JOH 6:52 Then the Jews were quarreling with one another, saying, How will this one be able to give us the flesh to eat?
JOH 6:53 Then Jesus said to them, Amen, amen, I say to you, Unless you should have eaten the flesh of the son of man, and should have drunk of his blood, you shall not have life in yourselves.
JOH 6:54 The one chewing of my flesh, and drinking of my blood, has life eternal; and I will raise him up in the last day.
JOH 6:55 For my flesh truly is solid food, and my blood truly is drink.
JOH 6:56 The one chewing of my flesh, and drinking of my blood, abides in me, and I in him.
JOH 6:57 As the living father sent me, I also live on account of the father; and the one chewing me, that one shall live through me.
JOH 6:58 This is the bread having descended from out of the heaven. Not as your fathers ate the manna, and died. The one chewing this bread shall live into the eon.
JOH 6:59 These things he said in the synagogue teaching in Capernaum.
JOH 6:60 Many then having heard from out of his disciples, said, this word is hard; who is able to hear it?
JOH 6:61 And Jesus knowing in himself that his disciples grumbled concerning this, he said to them, This causes you to stumble?
JOH 6:62 What then if you should view the son of man ascending where he was formerly?
JOH 6:63 The spirit is the one restoring to life, the flesh does not benefit anyone. The sayings which I speak to you is spirit, and is life.
JOH 6:64 But there are of you ones who do not believe. For Jesus knew from the beginning who are the ones not believing, and who it is that shall be delivering him up.
JOH 6:65 And he said, On account of this I have said to you, that no one is able to come to me, unless it should be given to him from my father.
JOH 6:66 Because of this, many of his disciples departed to the rear, and no longer walked with him.
JOH 6:67 Then Jesus said to the twelve, Do you also want to go away?
JOH 6:68 Then Simon Peter answered to him, O Lord, to whom shall we go forth? You have the words of eternal life.
JOH 6:69 And we have believed and have known that you are the Christ, the son of the living God.
JOH 6:70 Jesus responded to them, Did I not choose you the twelve, and one of you is a devil?
JOH 6:71 But he spoke of Judas son of Simon Iscariot; for this one was about to deliver him up, being one of the twelve.
JOH 7:1 And Jesus was walking with these in Galilee; for he wanted not to walk in Judea, for the Jews sought to kill him.
JOH 7:2 And it was near the holiday of the Jews - the one of pitching tents.
JOH 7:3 Then his brothers said to him, Cross over from here, and go into Judea, that also your disciples should view your works which you do!
JOH 7:4 For no one does anything in secret, and he himself seeks to be in an open manner. If these things you do, manifest yourself to the world!
JOH 7:5 For neither his brothers believed in him.
JOH 7:6 Then says Jesus to them, My time is not yet at hand; but your time at all times is ready.
JOH 7:7 The world is not able to detest you; but me it detests, for I testify concerning it, that its works are evil.
JOH 7:8 You ascend unto this holiday feast! I not yet ascend unto this holiday feast; for my time has not yet been fulfilled.
JOH 7:9 And these things having said to them, he stayed in Galilee.
JOH 7:10 But as his brothers ascended, then also he ascended unto the holiday feast, not openly, but as in secret.
JOH 7:11 Then the Jews sought him during the holiday feast, and said, Where is that one?
JOH 7:12 And there was much grumbling concerning him among the multitudes. Some said that, He is good. Others said, No; but he misleads the multitude!
JOH 7:13 No one however in an open manner spoke concerning him for fear of the Jews.
JOH 7:14 But already being in the middle of the holiday, Jesus ascended into the temple, and was teaching.
JOH 7:15 And the Jews marvelled, saying, How did this one know letters, not having learned?
JOH 7:16 Jesus answered them, and said, My teaching is not mine, but the one having sent me.
JOH 7:17 If anyone should want to do his will, he shall know concerning the teaching, whether it is of God, or I speak from myself.
JOH 7:18 The one speaking from himself seeks his own glory; but the one seeking the glory of the one having sent him, this one is true, and unrighteousness is not in him.
JOH 7:19 Has not Moses given you the law, and not one of you practices the law? Why do you seek to kill me?
JOH 7:20 The multitude answered and said, You have a demon; who seeks to kill you?
JOH 7:21 Jesus answered and said to them, One work I did, and you all marvel.
JOH 7:22 On account of this Moses has given to you circumcision; (not that it is from Moses, but from the fathers;) and on the sabbath you circumcise a man.
JOH 7:23 If a man receives circumcision on the sabbath, that the law of Moses should not be untied, why are you incensed with me that entirely I made a man in health on the sabbath?
JOH 7:24 Judge not according to appearance, but judge the just judgment!
JOH 7:25 Said then some of the ones of Jerusalem, Is this not whom they seek to kill?
JOH 7:26 And see! he speaks in an open manner, and they say nothing to him. Perhaps truly the rulers know that this is truly the Christ.
JOH 7:27 But this we know from what place he is - but the Christ, whenever he should come, no one knows from what place he is.
JOH 7:28 Jesus then cried out in the temple teaching, and saying, And me you have known, and you have known from what place I am. And of myself I have not come, but the one sending me is true, whom you know not.
JOH 7:29 I have known him; for from him I am, and that one sent me.
JOH 7:30 They were seeking then to lay hold of him. And no one put the hand upon him, for his hour had not yet come.
JOH 7:31 But many from out of the multitude believed in him, and said that, The Christ, whenever he should come, will he do more signs than these which this one did?
JOH 7:32 The Pharisees heard of the multitude murmuring these things concerning him; and the Pharisees and the chief priests sent officers that they should lay hold of him.
JOH 7:33 Jesus said then to them, Still a little time I am with you, and I go away to the one having sent me.
JOH 7:34 You shall seek me, and shall not find. And where I am, you are not able to come.
JOH 7:35 The Jews said then to themselves, Where is this one about to go, that we shall not find him? Is he about to go unto the dispersion of the Greeks, and to teach the Greeks?
JOH 7:36 What is this word which he said, You shall seek me, and shall not find; and, Where I am, you are not able to come?
JOH 7:37 And during the last day, the great one of the holiday, Jesus stood and cried out, saying, If anyone should thirst, come to me and drink!
JOH 7:38 The one believing in me, as the scripture said, From out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.
JOH 7:39 (But this he said concerning the spirit, of which the ones believing in him were about to receive; for there was not yet holy spirit; for Jesus was not yet glorified.)
JOH 7:40 Many then from out of the multitude, hearing the word, said, This is truly the prophet.
JOH 7:41 Others said, This is the Christ. And others said, Does the Christ come from out of Galilee?
JOH 7:42 Said not the scripture that from out of the seed of David, and from Bethlehem, of the town where David was from, the Christ comes?
JOH 7:43 A split then among the multitude took place because of him.
JOH 7:44 But some of them wanted to lay hold of him; but no one put hands upon him.
JOH 7:45 Came then the officers to the chief priests and Pharisees; and those said to them, For why did you not bring him?
JOH 7:46 The officers answered, At no time thus spoke a man as this man.
JOH 7:47 The Pharisees responded then to them, Have you also been misled?
JOH 7:48 Did any of the rulers believe in him, or of the Pharisees?
JOH 7:49 But this multitude not knowing the law are accursed.
JOH 7:50 Nicodemus says to them, (the one coming by night to him, being one of them,)
JOH 7:51 Does our law judge the man, if it not be heard from him prior, and made known what he does?
JOH 7:52 They answered and said to him, Are you also from out of Galilee? Search, and see, that a prophet arises not from out of Galilee!
JOH 7:53 And each went unto his house.
JOH 8:1 And Jesus went to the mount of olives.
JOH 8:2 And at dawn again he came into the temple, and all the people came to him; and having sat he taught them.
JOH 8:3 And the scribes and the Pharisees led to him a woman having been overtaken in adultery. And having stood her in the midst,
JOH 8:4 they say to him, Teacher, this woman we found in the very act committing adultery.
JOH 8:5 And in our law, Moses gave charge for such to be stoned. You then, what do you say?
JOH 8:6 But this they said testing him, that they should have a charge against him. But Jesus bowing low, with the finger he wrote on the ground.
JOH 8:7 And as they continued asking him, having raised the head he said to them, The one sinless of you let him cast the first stone at her!
JOH 8:8 And again bowing low he wrote on the ground.
JOH 8:9 And they having heard, and by their consciences being reproved, went forth one by one, beginning from the older. And Jesus was left behind alone, and the woman being in the middle.
JOH 8:10 And Jesus having raised the head, and seeing no one except the woman, said to her, Woman, where are they, those your accusers? did no one condemn you?
JOH 8:11 And she said, No one, O Lord. And Jesus said to her, Nor I condemn you. Go, and from the present no longer sin!
JOH 8:12 Again then to them Jesus spoke, saying, I am the light of the world. The one following me in no way should walk in the darkness, but shall have the light of life.
JOH 8:13 The Pharisees said then to him, You testify concerning yourself; your testimony is not valid.
JOH 8:14 Jesus answered and said to them, Even if I testify concerning myself, my testimony is valid. For I know from what place I came, and where I go; but you do not know from what place I come, and where I go.
JOH 8:15 You judge according to the flesh; I do not judge anyone.
JOH 8:16 And if I also judge, my judgment is valid; because I am not alone, but I and the father having sent me.
JOH 8:17 And in your law also it has been written that, Of two men the testimony is valid.
JOH 8:18 I am the one testifying concerning myself, and the father having sent me testifies concerning me.
JOH 8:19 They said then to him, Where is your father? Jesus answered, Neither me you know, nor my father. If you would have known me, also you would have known my father.
JOH 8:20 These words Jesus spoke in the treasury, teaching in the temple. And no one laid hold of him, for his hour had not yet come.
JOH 8:21 Then again Jesus said to them, I go away, and you shall seek me, and in your sin you shall die. Where I go, you are not able to come.
JOH 8:22 Then the Jews said, Maybe he will kill himself, that he says, Where I go, you are not able to come.
JOH 8:23 And he said to them, You are of the lowers; I am of the uppers. You are of this world, I am not of this world.
JOH 8:24 I said then to you that, You shall die in your sins. For if you should not believe that I am, you shall die in your sins.
JOH 8:25 They said then to him, You, who are you? And Jesus said to them, The source of whatever also I speak to you.
JOH 8:26 Many things I have to say concerning you, and to judge. But the one having sent me is true, and I, what I heard from him, these things I say unto the world.
JOH 8:27 They knew not that he spoke to them of the father.
JOH 8:28 Jesus said then to them, Whenever you should raise up high the son of man, then you shall know that I am, and from myself I do nothing; but as my father taught me, these things I speak.
JOH 8:29 And the one having sent me is with me. The father left me not alone; for I do the things pleasing to him at all times.
JOH 8:30 These things of his having spoken, many believed in him.
JOH 8:31 then Jesus said to the Jews believing in him, If you should stay in my word, truly you are my disciples;
JOH 8:32 and you shall know the truth, and the truth shall free you.
JOH 8:33 They answered to him, We are seed of Abraham, and to no one have we been a slave to at any time. How do you say that, You shall become free?
JOH 8:34 Jesus answered to them, Amen, amen, I say to you that, Every one committing the sin is a slave of the sin.
JOH 8:35 And the manservant abides not in the house into the eon. The son abides into the eon.
JOH 8:36 If then the son should free you, really you will be free.
JOH 8:37 I know that you are seed of Abraham; but you seek to kill me, for my word does not have space in you.
JOH 8:38 I speak what I have seen by my father. And you then what you have seen by your father you do.
JOH 8:39 They answered and said to him, Our father is Abraham. Jesus says to them, If you were children of Abraham, you would have done the works of Abraham.
JOH 8:40 But now you seek to kill me, a man who has spoken the truth to you, which I heard from God - this Abraham did not do.
JOH 8:41 You do the works of your father. They said then to him, We have not been born of harlotry; we have one father - God.
JOH 8:42 Jesus said to them, If God was your father, you would have loved me; for I came forth from God, and I come; for neither from myself have I come, but that one sent me.
JOH 8:43 Why do you not know my speech? For you are not able to hear my word.
JOH 8:44 You are of the father of the devil, and the desires of your father you want to do. That one was a man-killer from the beginning, and stood not in the truth, for truth is not in him. Whenever he should speak the lie, from out of his own he speaks; for he is a liar, and the father of it.
JOH 8:45 But I, for I speak the truth, but you do not believe me.
JOH 8:46 Who of you reproves me concerning sin? But if I speak truth, why do you not believe in me?
JOH 8:47 The one being of God hears the sayings of God. On account of this, you do not hear, for you are not of God.
JOH 8:48 Then the Jews answered, and said to him, Do we not speak well that you are a Samaritan, and have a demon?
JOH 8:49 Jesus answered, I do not have a demon, but I esteem my father; and you dishonor me.
JOH 8:50 But I seek not my glory. There is the one seeking and judging.
JOH 8:51 Amen, amen, I say to you, If anyone should give heed to my word in no way shall he view death into the eon.
JOH 8:52 The Jews said then to him, Now we know that you have a demon. Abraham died, and the prophets; and you say, If anyone should give heed to my word in no way shall he taste death into the eon.
JOH 8:53 Are you greater than our father Abraham who died, and the prophets that died? Whom do you make yourself?
JOH 8:54 Jesus answered, If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing. It is my father glorifying me; whom you say, that he is your God.
JOH 8:55 And you have not known him; but I know him. And if I should say that, I do not know him, I will be like you, a liar. But I know him, and his word I give heed to.
JOH 8:56 Abraham, your father exulted that he should behold my day, and he saw and rejoiced.
JOH 8:57 Then said the Jews to him, You have not yet fifty years, and you have seen Abraham?
JOH 8:58 Jesus said to them, Amen, amen, I say to you, Before Abraham existed, I am.
JOH 8:59 Then they lifted stones that they should throw at him. But Jesus was hidden, and went forth from out of the temple, going through the midst of them, and passed by thus.
JOH 9:1 And passing on, he beheld a man blind from birth.
JOH 9:2 And his disciples asked him, saying, Rabbi, Who sinned, this one or his parents, that he was born blind?
JOH 9:3 Jesus answered, Neither this one sinned, nor his parents. But that should be made manifest the works of God in him.
JOH 9:4 It is necessary to work the works of the one sending me forth, while it is day. There comes the night when no one is able to work.
JOH 9:5 Whenever I should be in the world, I am the light of the world.
JOH 9:6 These things having said, he spat on the ground, and made mud from out of the spittle, and smeared the mud upon the eyes of the blind man.
JOH 9:7 And he said to him, Go wash in the pool of Siloam! (which is translated, Being sent.) He went forth then and washed, and came seeing.
JOH 9:8 Then the neighbors, and the ones viewing him prior, knowing that he was blind, said, Is not this the one sitting down and begging?
JOH 9:9 Others said that, This one is he. And others that, He is likened to him. That one said that, I am he.
JOH 9:10 They said then to him, How were your eyes opened?
JOH 9:11 That one answered and said, A man being called Jesus made mud, and smeared it upon my eyes, and said to me, Go unto the pool of Siloam, and wash! And going forth and washing, I gained sight.
JOH 9:12 They said then to him, Where is that one? He says, I know not.
JOH 9:13 They led him to the Pharisees - the one at one time blind.
JOH 9:14 And it was a sabbath when Jesus made the mud, and opened his eyes.
JOH 9:15 Then again the Pharisees asked him also how he gained sight. And he said to them, He placed mud to me upon the eyes, and I washed, and I see.
JOH 9:16 Then one from the Pharisees said, This man is not from God, for he did not heed the sabbath. Others said, How is a man a sinner able to do such signs? And a split was among them.
JOH 9:17 They say then to the blind man again, You, what say you concerning him, for he opened your eyes? And he said that, He is a prophet.
JOH 9:18 The Jews did not believe then concerning him, that he was blind, and gained sight, until whenever his parents spoke up - of the one gaining sight.
JOH 9:19 And they asked them saying, Is this your son, whom you say that he was born blind? How then just now does he see?
JOH 9:20 His parents answered to them and said, We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind.
JOH 9:21 But how now he sees, we know not; or who opened his eyes, we know not. He has age; ask him - he shall speak for himself!
JOH 9:22 These things his parents said, for they feared the Jews. For already the Jews agreed, that if anyone should acknowledge him the Christ, he should be removed from the synagogue.
JOH 9:23 On account of this his parents said that, He has age; ask him!
JOH 9:24 They called then for a second time the man who was blind, and said to him, Give glory to God! We know that this man is a sinner.
JOH 9:25 Then that one answered and said, If he is a sinner, I know not. One thing I know, that being blind, now I see.
JOH 9:26 And they said to him again, What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?
JOH 9:27 He answered to them, I told you already, and you heard not. Why again do you want to hear? Do also you want to become his disciples?
JOH 9:28 Then they reviled him, and said, You are that one's disciple; but we are disciples of Moses.
JOH 9:29 We know that to Moses God has spoken; but this one, we know not from what place he is.
JOH 9:30 The man answered and said to them, For this is wonderful, that you know not from where he is, and he opened my eyes.
JOH 9:31 And we know that God does not hear sinners. But if anyone might be godly, and should do his will, this one he hears.
JOH 9:32 From out of the eon it was not heard that anyone opened the eyes of one being born blind.
JOH 9:33 Unless this one was from God, he would not be able to do anything.
JOH 9:34 They answered and said to him, In sin you were entirely born, and you teach us? And they cast him outside.
JOH 9:35 Jesus heard that they cast him outside; and having found him, said to him, Do you believe in the son of God?
JOH 9:36 That one answered and said, And who is he, O Lord, that I should believe in him?
JOH 9:37 And Jesus said to him, Both you see him, and the one speaking with you is that one.
JOH 9:38 And he said, I believe, O Lord. And he did obeisance to him.
JOH 9:39 And Jesus said, For judgment I came into this world, that the ones not seeing shall see; and the ones seeing should become blind.
JOH 9:40 And some of these Pharisees heard, the ones being with him, and said to him, And not we; are we blind?
JOH 9:41 Jesus said to them, If you were blind, you would not have sin. But now you say that, We see; therefore your sin remains.
JOH 10:1 Amen, amen, I say to you, The one not entering through the door into the courtyard of the sheep, but ascending from elsewhere, that one is a thief and robber.
JOH 10:2 But the one entering through the door is the shepherd of the sheep.
JOH 10:3 To this one the doorkeeper opens. And the sheep hear his voice. And his own sheep he calls by name, and leads them out.
JOH 10:4 And whenever his own sheep should come forth, he goes in front of them, and the sheep follow him; for they know his voice.
JOH 10:5 But a stranger in no way shall they follow, but they shall flee from him; for they know not the stranger's voice.
JOH 10:6 This proverb Jesus spoke to them. But those knew not what it was which he spoke to them.
JOH 10:7 Jesus said then again to them, Amen, amen, I say to you that, I am the door of the sheep.
JOH 10:8 All as many as came are thieves and robbers; but the sheep did not hear them.
JOH 10:9 I am the door. Through me if anyone should enter, he shall be delivered, and shall enter and shall go forth, and shall find pasture.
JOH 10:10 The thief comes not, except that he should steal, and should sacrifice, and should destroy. I came that they should have life, and they should have extra.
JOH 10:11 I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd renders his life for the sheep.
JOH 10:12 But the hireling, and not being the shepherd, whose sheep are not his own, views the wolf coming, and leaves the sheep, and flees. And the wolf seizes them by force, and disperses the sheep.
JOH 10:13 And the hireling flees, for he is a hireling, and there is not a care to him concerning the sheep.
JOH 10:14 I am the good shepherd, and I know the ones mine, and I am known by the ones of mine.
JOH 10:15 As the father knows me, I also know the father. And my life I place for the sheep.
JOH 10:16 And other sheep I have, which are not of this yard. And those it is necessary for me to lead, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be one flock, one shepherd.
JOH 10:17 On account of this the father loves me, for I place my life, that again I should take it.
JOH 10:18 No one takes it from me, but I place it of myself. I have authority to place it, and I have authority again to take it. This commandment I received from my father.
JOH 10:19 Then a split again took place among the Jews on account of these words.
JOH 10:20 And many of them said, He has a demon, and is maniacal; why listen to him?
JOH 10:21 Others said, These sayings are not of one being demon-possessed. Is a demon able to open eyes of blind ones?
JOH 10:22 And took place the holiday of rededication in Jerusalem, and it was winter.
JOH 10:23 And Jesus was walking in the temple, in the stoa of Solomon.
JOH 10:24 Then the Jews encircled him, and said to him, For how long do you carry our soul? If you are the Christ, tell us in an open manner!
JOH 10:25 Jesus answered to them, I told to you, and you believe not. The works which I do in the name of my father, these testify concerning me.
JOH 10:26 But you believe not, for you are not of my sheep, as I said to you.
JOH 10:27 My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me.
JOH 10:28 And I give to them eternal life, and in no way shall they perish into the eon; and not shall any seize them by force from out of my hand.
JOH 10:29 My father, who has given to me, is greater than of all. And no one is able to seize them by force from out of the hand of my father.
JOH 10:30 I and the father - we are one.
JOH 10:31 Then again the Jews bore stones that they should stone him.
JOH 10:32 Jesus responded to them, Many good works I showed to you from my father; for what work of them do you stone me?
JOH 10:33 The Jews answered to him, saying, Concerning a good work we do not stone you; but concerning blasphemy; and that you, being a man, make yourself God.
JOH 10:34 Jesus responded to them, Is it not written in your law, I said, You are gods?
JOH 10:35 If those he said of gods, to whom the word of God came, and the scripture is not able to be untied,
JOH 10:36 the one whom the father sanctified, and sent into the world, you say that, You blaspheme; for I said, I am the son of God?
JOH 10:37 If I do not the works of my father, do not believe me!
JOH 10:38 But if I do, and if you should not believe me, believe the works! that you should know, and should believe, that the father is in me, and I in him.
JOH 10:39 They sought then again to lay hold of him. And he went forth from out of their hand.
JOH 10:40 And he went forth again on the other side of the Jordan unto the place where John was first immersing; and he stayed there.
JOH 10:41 And many came to him, and said that, John indeed did no sign; but all as much as John said concerning this one was true.
JOH 10:42 And many believed there in him.
JOH 11:1 And there was a certain sick man, Lazarus, from Bethany, from out of the town of Mary and Martha her sister.
JOH 11:2 And Mary was the one anointing the Lord with perfumed liquid, and wiped clean his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.
JOH 11:3 The sisters sent then to him, saying, O Lord, behold, whom you are fond of is sick.
JOH 11:4 And hearing, Jesus said, This sickness is not to death, but for the glory of God, that the son of God should be glorified through it.
JOH 11:5 And Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.
JOH 11:6 Then as he heard that he is sick, then indeed he stayed in the place where he was two days.
JOH 11:7 Thereupon after this he says to the disciples, We should lead unto Judea again.
JOH 11:8 The disciples say to him, Rabbi, now the Jews seek to stone you, and again you go there?
JOH 11:9 Jesus answered, Are there not twelve hours in the day? If anyone should walk in the day, he shall not stumble, for the light of this world he sees.
JOH 11:10 But if anyone should walk in the night, he stumbles, for the light is not in him.
JOH 11:11 These things he said. And after this he says to them, Lazarus our friend has went to sleep; but I shall go that that I should wake him up.
JOH 11:12 His disciples said then, O Lord, if he has went to sleep, he will be preserved.
JOH 11:13 But Jesus had spoken concerning his death. But they thought that concerning the resting of sleep he spoke of.
JOH 11:14 Then therefore Jesus said to them in an open manner, Lazarus died.
JOH 11:15 And I rejoice because of you that you should believe, for I was not there; but we should lead on to him.
JOH 11:16 Then said Thomas, the one being called Didymus, to the fellow-disciples, We should lead on also ourselves that we should die with him.
JOH 11:17 Having come then, Jesus found him four days already having been in the sepulchre.
JOH 11:18 And Bethany was near Jerusalem, about fifteen stadiums.
JOH 11:19 And many from the Jews had come to the ones around Martha and Mary, so as to console them concerning their brother.
JOH 11:20 Then Martha, as she heard that Jesus comes, met him. But Mary was seated in the house.
JOH 11:21 Then said Martha to Jesus, O Lord, if you were here, my brother would not have died.
JOH 11:22 But even now I know that as much as you should ask God, God will give to you.
JOH 11:23 Jesus says to her, Your brother shall arise.
JOH 11:24 Martha says to him, I know that he will rise up in the resurrection in the last day.
JOH 11:25 Jesus said to her, I am the resurrection, and the life. The one believing in me, even if he should die, he shall live.
JOH 11:26 And every one living and believing in me in no way should die into the eon. Do you believe this?
JOH 11:27 She says to him, Yes, O Lord; I believe that you are the Christ, the son of God, the one coming into the world.
JOH 11:28 And these things having said, she went forth, and called Mary her sister in private, having said, The teacher is at hand, and calls you.
JOH 11:29 That one as she heard, rises quickly, and comes to him.
JOH 11:30 But not yet was Jesus come into the town, but was in the place where Martha met him.
JOH 11:31 Then the Jews being with her in the house, and consoling her, seeing Mary, that quickly she rose up and went forth, followed her, saying that, She goes unto the sepulchre that she should weep there.
JOH 11:32 Then Mary as she came where Jesus was, seeing him, fell unto his feet, saying to him, O Lord, if you might have been here, my brother would not have died.
JOH 11:33 Jesus then as he beheld her weeping, and the Jews coming with her weeping, was deeply moved in the spirit, and troubled himself.
JOH 11:34 And he said, Where have you placed him? They say to him, O Lord, come and see!
JOH 11:35 Jesus burst into tears.
JOH 11:36 Then said the Jews, See how he was fond of him!
JOH 11:37 But some of them said, Was this one not able, opening the eyes of the blind, to execute that also this one should not have died?
JOH 11:38 Jesus then again deeply moved in himself comes unto the sepulchre. And it was a cave, and a stone was pressed against it.
JOH 11:39 Jesus says, Lift the stone! Martha the sister of the one having died says to him, O Lord, already he reeks; for it is the fourth day.
JOH 11:40 Jesus says to her, Said I not to you that, If you should believe, you shall see the glory of God?
JOH 11:41 Then they lifted away the stone where the one having died was situated. And Jesus lifted his eyes upward, and said, O father, I give thanks to you that you heard me.
JOH 11:42 And I know that at all times you hear me. But on account of the multitude standing around I spoke, that they should believe that you sent me.
JOH 11:43 And these things having said, with a great voice he cried out, Lazarus, come outside.
JOH 11:44 And came forth the one having died, being tied of the feet, and the hands swathed, and his face with a scarf tied about. Jesus says to them, Untie him, and let him go!
JOH 11:45 Then many of the Jews having come with Mary, and seeing what Jesus did, believed in him.
JOH 11:46 But some of them went forth to the Pharisees, and told to them what Jesus did.
JOH 11:47 Then the chief priests and the Pharisees gathered together the sanhedrin, and said, What do we do? for this man does many signs.
JOH 11:48 If we let him do thus, all shall believe in him. And the Romans shall come and take us and the place and the nation.
JOH 11:49 And a certain one of them, Caiaphas, being chief priest that year, said to them, You do not know anything,
JOH 11:50 nor reason that it be advantageous to us that one man should die for the people, and the entire nation should not perish.
JOH 11:51 But this he said not of himself. But being chief priest that year he prophesied that Jesus was about to die for the nation;
JOH 11:52 and not for the nation only, but that also the children of God being dispersed should be brought together into one.
JOH 11:53 From that day then they advised that they should kill him.
JOH 11:54 Jesus then no longer in an open manner walked among the Jews; but went forth from there into the place near the wilderness, into a city being called Ephraim, and there spent time with his disciples.
JOH 11:55 And it was near the passover of the Jews. And many ascended unto Jerusalem from out of the region before the passover, that they should purify themselves.
JOH 11:56 Then they were seeking Jesus, and spoke with one another while standing in the temple, What do you think, that in no way should he come unto the holiday feast?
JOH 11:57 And even the chief priests and the Pharisees gave a command, that if any should know where he is, he should indicate it, so that they should lay hold of him.
JOH 12:1 Then Jesus, six days before the passover, came into Bethany, where Lazarus was, the one having died, whom he raised from the dead.
JOH 12:2 They made then for him a supper there, and Martha served; and Lazarus was one of the ones reclining with him.
JOH 12:3 Then Mary, having taken a liter of valuable perfumed spikenard liquid, anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped clean his feet with her hair. And the house was filled of the scent of the perfumed liquid.
JOH 12:4 Says then one of his disciples, Judas son of Simon Iscariot, the one being about to deliver him up,
JOH 12:5 Why was this perfumed liquid not sold for three hundred denarii, and given to the poor?
JOH 12:6 But he said this, not that it was a care to him concerning the poor, but that he was a thief, and had the money container; and the things being thrown in it he bore.
JOH 12:7 Jesus then said, Leave her alone! she has kept it for the day of my entombing.
JOH 12:8 For at all times you have the poor with you, but me you have not at all times.
JOH 12:9 Then a great multitude of the Jews knew that he is there. And they came not on account of Jesus only, but that also they should see Lazarus, whom he raised from the dead.
JOH 12:10 And the chief priests consulted that also they should kill Lazarus;
JOH 12:11 for many of the Jews drew away because of him, and believed on Jesus.
JOH 12:12 The next day a great multitude having come unto the holiday feast, having heard that Jesus comes unto Jerusalem,
JOH 12:13 took palm fronds of the palm trees, and came forth to meet him, and were crying out, Hosanna; being blessed is the one coming in the name of the LORD, the king of Israel.
JOH 12:14 And Jesus having found a young donkey, sat upon it, as it is written,
JOH 12:15 Fear not, daughter of Zion; behold, your king comes, sitting upon the foal of a donkey.
JOH 12:16 But these things his disciples did not know at first; but when Jesus was glorified then they remembered that these things were written about him, and these things they did to him.
JOH 12:17 Then the multitude being with him testified, about when he called Lazarus from out of the sepulchre, and raised him from the dead.
JOH 12:18 On account of this also the multitude met him, for it heard this sign for him to have done.
JOH 12:19 Then the Pharisees said to themselves, Do you contemplate that you benefit not one thing? See! the world went forth after him.
JOH 12:20 And there were certain Greeks from the ones ascending, that they should do obeisance during the holiday feast.
JOH 12:21 These then came forward to Philip, to the one from Bethsaida of Galilee, and asked him, saying, O master, we want to see Jesus.
JOH 12:22 Philip comes and speaks to Andrew; and again Andrew and Philip speak to Jesus.
JOH 12:23 But Jesus answered to them saying, The hour has come, that the son of man should be glorified.
JOH 12:24 Amen, amen, I say to you, Unless the kernel of grain falling into the earth should die, it alone remains; and if it should die, it bears much fruit.
JOH 12:25 The one being fond of his life, shall lose it; and the one detesting his life in this world shall keep it unto eternal life.
JOH 12:26 If anyone should serve to me - follow me! And where I am, there also my servant will be. And if anyone should serve to me, the father shall esteem him.
JOH 12:27 Now my soul has been disturbed; and what should I say? O father, deliver me from this hour! But on account of this I came unto this hour.
JOH 12:28 O father, glorify your name! Then came a voice from out of the heaven, Even I glorified, and again I will glorify.
JOH 12:29 Then the multitude standing and hearing, said, Thunder has taken place. Others said, An angel has spoken to him.
JOH 12:30 Jesus answered and said, Not on account of me has this voice taken place, but on account of you.
JOH 12:31 Now is judgment of this world. Now the ruler of this world shall be cast outside.
JOH 12:32 And I, if I be raised up high from the earth, I will draw all to myself.
JOH 12:33 And this he said, signifying what death he was about to die.
JOH 12:34 The multitude answered him, We hear from the law that the Christ abides into the eon; and how say you that, It is necessary for the son of man to be raised up high? Who is this Son of man?
JOH 12:35 Then said Jesus to them, Still a little time the light is with you. Walk while you have the light, that darkness should not overtake you. And the one walking in the darkness knows not where he goes.
JOH 12:36 While you have the light, trust in the light, that you should become sons of light! These things Jesus spoke, and going forth, was hid from them.
JOH 12:37 But his doing such great signs in front of them, they believed not in him.
JOH 12:38 That the word of Isaiah the prophet should be fulfilled, which he said, O Lord, who believed our report? and the arm of the Lord, to whom was it uncovered?
JOH 12:39 On account of this they were not able to believe, for again Isaiah said,
JOH 12:40 He has blinded their eyes, and calloused their heart; that they should not see with the eyes, and comprehend with the heart, and be turned, and I should heal them.
JOH 12:41 These things Isaiah said, when he beheld his glory, and spoke concerning him.
JOH 12:42 Even however also many from the rulers believed in him; but because of the Pharisees they acknowledged it not, that they should not be removed from the synagogue.
JOH 12:43 For they loved the glory of men rather than the glory of God.
JOH 12:44 And Jesus cried out and said, The one believing in me, believes not in me, but in the one having sent me.
JOH 12:45 And the one contemplating me, contemplates the one having sent me.
JOH 12:46 I have come a light unto the world, that every one believing in me should not abide in the darkness.
JOH 12:47 And if anyone should hear of my sayings, and should not believe, I do not judge him. For I came not that I judge the world, but that I should deliver the world.
JOH 12:48 The one disregarding me, and receives not my words, has the thing judging him - the word which I have spoken, that one shall judge him in the last day.
JOH 12:49 For I spoke not of myself; but the father having sent me, he gave a commandment to me, what I should say, and what I should speak.
JOH 12:50 And I know that his commandment is life eternal. What then I speak, as the father has said to me, so I speak.
JOH 13:1 But before the holiday feast of the passover, Jesus knew that his hour has come, that he should cross over from out of this world to the father, having loved his own in the world - unto the end he loved them.
JOH 13:2 And supper taking place, the devil already casting into the heart of Judas son of Simon Iscariot, that he should deliver him up;
JOH 13:3 Jesus knowing that the father had given to him all into his hands, and that from God he came forth, and to God he goes;
JOH 13:4 he rises from the supper, and puts aside his garments; and having taken a linen towel he girded up himself.
JOH 13:5 Then he throws water into the washpot, and began to wash the feet of the disciples, and to wipe them clean with the linen towel in which he was girding himself up.
JOH 13:6 He comes then to Simon Peter; and that one says to him, O Lord, do you wash my feet?
JOH 13:7 Jesus answered and said to him, What I do you know not just now; but you shall know after these things.
JOH 13:8 Peter says to him, In no way should you wash my feet into the eon. Jesus responded to him, Unless I should wash you, you have not a part with me.
JOH 13:9 Simon Peter says to him, O Lord, not my feet only, but also the hands and the head.
JOH 13:10 Jesus says to him, The one being bathed has not a need than to wash the feet, but is clean entirely; and you are clean, but not all.
JOH 13:11 For he knew the one delivering him up; on account of this he said, Not all are clean.
JOH 13:12 When therefore he washed their feet, and took his garments, having reclined again, he said to them, Do you know what I have done to you?
JOH 13:13 You call me, The teacher, and, The Lord. And well you speak; for I am.
JOH 13:14 If then I washed your feet, being the Lord and the teacher, even you ought to wash one another's feet.
JOH 13:15 For I gave to you an example, that as I did to you also you should do.
JOH 13:16 Amen, amen, I say to you, A servant is not greater than his master; nor an apostle greater than the one having sent him.
JOH 13:17 If these things you know, blessed are you if you should do them.
JOH 13:18 Not concerning all of you I speak. I know whom I chose, but that the scripture should be fulfilled, The one chewing bread with me lifts his heel against me.
JOH 13:19 From just now I tell it to you before it takes place, that whenever it takes place, you should believe that I am he.
JOH 13:20 Amen, amen, I say to you, The one receiving whomsoever I shall send, receives me; and the one receiving me, receives the one having sent me.

JOH 13:22 Then the disciples looked at one another, being perplexed concerning what he says.
JOH 13:23 And one of his disciples was reclining at the bosom of Jesus, whom Jesus loved.
JOH 13:24 Then Simon Peter nodded to this one, to inquire about who it may be concerning of whom he speaks.
JOH 13:25 And that one having fallen upon the breast of Jesus says to him, O Lord, who is it?
JOH 13:26 Jesus answers, That one is to whom I having dipped the morsel shall give it. And having dipped the morsel, he gives it to Judas son of Simon Iscariot.
JOH 13:27 And after the morsel, then Satan entered into that one. Jesus says then to him, What you do, do more quickly!
JOH 13:28 But no one knew this of the ones reclining about what he said to him.
JOH 13:29 For some thought, since Judas had the money container, that Jesus says to him, Buy what we have need for the holiday feast; or, that he should give something to the poor.
JOH 13:30 Having taken then the morsel, that one immediately went forth - and it was night.

JOH 13:32 If God was glorified in him, also God shall glorify him in himself, and straightway shall glorify him.

JOH 13:35 In this all shall know that you are my disciples, if you should have love among one another.

JOH 13:37 Peter says to him, O Lord, why am I not able to follow you just now? I will put my life for you.
JOH 13:38 Jesus answered to him, Shall you place your life for me? Amen, amen, I say to you, In no way the rooster shall call out, until of which you shall totally reject me three times.

JOH 14:2 In the residence of my father there are many abodes. But if not, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.
JOH 14:3 And whenever I should go and should prepare for you a place, again I will come and take you to myself; that where I am, you should be also.
JOH 14:4 And where I go you know, and the way you know.
JOH 14:5 Thomas says to him, O Lord, we know not where you go; and how are we able to know the way?
JOH 14:6 Jesus says to him, I am the way, and the truth, and the life. No one comes to the father unless through me.
JOH 14:7 If you had known me, you would have known my father also. And from now on you know him, and you have seen him.
JOH 14:8 Philip says to him, O Lord, show to us the father, and it suffices to us!
JOH 14:9 Jesus says to him, So great a time I am with you, and you know me not, Philip? The one seeing me has seen the father; and how do you say, Show us the father?
JOH 14:10 Do you not believe that I am in the father, and the father is in me? The words which I speak to you I speak not from myself. But the father abiding in me, he does the works.
JOH 14:11 Believe me that I am in the father, and the father is in me! But if not, because of the works themselves believe me!
JOH 14:12 Amen, amen, I say to you, The one believing in me, the works which I do even that one will do; and greater than these he shall do; for I go to my father.
JOH 14:13 And whatever you should ask in my name, this I shall do, that the father should be glorified in the son.
JOH 14:14 If you should ask anything in my name, I shall act.
JOH 14:15 If you should love me, give heed to my commandments!
JOH 14:16 And I will ask the father, and he shall give to you another comforter, that he should abide with you into the eon.
JOH 14:17 The spirit of truth; whom the world is not able to receive, for it does not contemplate it, nor knows it. But you know it, for it abides with you, and it will be in you.
JOH 14:18 I will not leave you orphans; I am coming to you.
JOH 14:19 Yet a little while and the world no longer views me; but you view me - for I live, and you shall live.
JOH 14:20 In that day you shall know that I am in my father, and you in me, and I in you.
JOH 14:21 The one having my commandments, and giving heed to them, that one is the one loving me. And the one loving me shall be loved by my father, and I will love him, and will reveal myself to him.
