2PE 1:2 Favor to you, and may peace be multiplied in full knowledge of God, and of Jesus our Lord,
2PE 1:3 as all things to us of his divine power, the things for life and piety, being presented through the full knowledge of the one having called us by glory and virtue;
2PE 1:4 by which he has presented the things esteemed for us and greatest declarations; that through these you should become partners of divine nature, having escaped the corruption in the world by lust.
2PE 1:5 And for this same reason also, adding all diligence, supply virtue in your belief, and in virtue knowledge,
2PE 1:6 and in knowledge self-control, and in self-control endurance, and in endurance piety,
2PE 1:7 and in piety brotherly affection, and in brotherly affection love!
2PE 1:8 For these things being in you, and being superabundant, they stand not idle nor unfruitful in the full knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
2PE 1:9 But in whom these things are not at hand is blind, losing sight, having taken forgetfulness of the cleansing of his earlier sins.
2PE 1:10 Therefore rather, brethren, hurry to make your calling and selection firm! For these things doing, in no way should you fail at some time or other.
2PE 1:11 For thus richly shall be supplied to you the entrance into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and deliverer Jesus Christ.
2PE 1:12 Therefore I shall not neglect to remind you continually concerning these things, though knowing them, and being fixed firmly in the truth at hand.
2PE 1:13 But I esteem it just, for as long as I am in this tent, to awaken you by recollection;
2PE 1:14 knowing that the getting rid of my tent is quick, as also our Lord Jesus Christ manifested to me.
2PE 1:15 But I will hurry also always for you to have after my exodus the making remembrance of these things.
2PE 1:16 For not following after discerning fables did we make known to you the thing of the power and arrival of our Lord Jesus Christ - but having been spectators of that ones' magnificence.
2PE 1:17 For having received from God the father honor and glory, such a voice having been brought to him by the majestic glory, said, This is my son the beloved, in whom I take pleasure.
2PE 1:18 And this voice we heard brought from heaven, being with him on the holy mountain.
2PE 1:19 And we have more firm the prophetic word; which well you do heeding, as a lamp shining forth in a dismal place, until which day should shine through, and the morning star should arise in your hearts.
2PE 1:20 This first knowing, that every prophecy of scripture does not take place by private explanation.
2PE 1:21 For not by will of man was prophecy borne at some time or other; but by holy spirit being borne the holy men of God spoke.
2PE 2:1 But there existed also false prophets among the people, as also among you there will be false teachers who shall introduce privately destructive sects, and denying the master buying them, bringing unto themselves quick destruction.
2PE 2:2 And many shall follow after them in the destructions; through whom the way of the truth shall be blasphemed.
2PE 2:3 And by a desire for wealth, with shaped words, they shall make trade of you; for whom the judgment of old is not idle, and their destruction shall not slumber.
2PE 2:4 For since God spared not of angels sinning, but in chains of the infernal region delivered them up for being kept for judgment;
2PE 2:5 and the ancient world he spared not, but kept Noah the eighth proclaimer of righteousness, having brought a flood in the world for impious ones;
2PE 2:6 and the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah having reduced to ashes he condemned by a final event; having set an example for the ones being about to be impious;
2PE 2:7 and rescued the just Lot being harassed by the unlawful ones in lewdness of behavior,
2PE 2:8 (for by sight and hearing, the just one dwelling among them, day by day tormented his just soul by their lawless works;)
2PE 2:9 then know the Lord knows to rescue the pious from tests, and the unrighteous to keep for a day of judgment being punished;
2PE 2:10 and especially the ones going after the flesh in a desire for defilement, and disdaining lordship; daring, self-willed, they tremble not in blaspheming glories.
2PE 2:11 Where angels being in strength and greater power, do not bring against them before the Lord a blasphemous case.
2PE 2:12 But these, (as physical illogical living creatures, engendered for conquest and corruption in blaspheming what they know not,) in their corruption shall be laid waste;
2PE 2:13 carrying a wage of unrighteousness; esteeming the daily delicacy satisfaction - stains and blemishes, reveling in their deceptions, feasting together with you;
2PE 2:14 having eyes full of an adulterous one, and ceaseless of sin; entrapping unstable souls; having a heart being exercised for a desire for wealth; children of curse.
2PE 2:15 Leaving behind the straight way, they wandered, following after the way of Balaam the son of Bosor, who loved the wage of unrighteousness;
2PE 2:16 but had rebuke of his own unlawfulness - a voiceless beast of burden, in a man's voice uttering a sound restrained the ranting of the prophet.
2PE 2:17 These are waterless springs, clouds being driven by a tempest, ones to whom the infernal region of darkness is kept into the eon.
2PE 2:18 For uttering pompous sounds of folly, they entrap by the desires of the flesh, in lewdnesses, the ones who really escaped from the ones behaving in delusion,
2PE 2:19 promising freedom to them, they being bondmen of corruption; for by whom anyone has been vanquished, by this one even he is enslaved.
2PE 2:20 For if they having escaped the defilements of the world, in the full knowledge of the Lord and deliverer Jesus Christ, and in these things again being entangled they are vanquished, the last has become to them worse than the first.
2PE 2:21 For it was better for them to have not known the way of righteousness, than having known, to have turned from the holy commandment delivered to them.
2PE 2:22 But has come to pass to them the word of the True proverb, A dog having returned unto its own excrement, and a bathed pig unto wallowing in mire.
2PE 3:1 This already, beloved, a second letter I write to you; in which I awaken your honest consideration in recollection,
2PE 3:2 to remember the before described sayings by the holy prophets, and of the commandment of the Lord and deliverer of us the apostles.
2PE 3:3 This first knowing, that mockers will come at the last of the days, going according to their own lusts,
2PE 3:4 and saying, Where is the promise of his arrival? For from of which time the fathers went to sleep, all things thus continue from the beginning of creation.
2PE 3:5 For this escaped their notice willingly, that heavens were of old, and earth from out of water and through water stood together by the word of God.
2PE 3:6 On account of which things the world then perished having been flooded by water.
2PE 3:7 But the present heavens and the earth, in the same word are treasured up for fire, being kept for a day of judgment and destruction of the impious men.
2PE 3:8 But in this, let it not be unaware to you, beloved, that one day with the Lord is as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.
2PE 3:9 The Lord is not slow of promise, as some esteem slowness; but is long-suffering towards us, not willing for anyone to perish, but for all to have space for repentance.
2PE 3:10 But shall come the day of the Lord as a thief in the night; in which the heavens by a loud noise shall pass away, and the elements being destroyed by fire shall be loosed, and the earth and the works in it shall be incinerated.
2PE 3:11 These things then all being loosed, what kind of persons must you be in holy behavior and piety,
2PE 3:12 expecting and hastening the arrival of the day of God, by which the heavens being set on fire shall be loosed, and the elements being destroyed by fire shall melt away?
2PE 3:13 But new heavens and a new earth, according to his declaration, we expect, in which righteousness dwells.
2PE 3:14 Therefore, beloved, these things expecting, endeavor to be found by him spotless and without blemish in peace!
2PE 3:15 And esteem the long-suffering deliverance of our Lord; as also our beloved brother Paul, according to the wisdom given to him wrote to you;
2PE 3:16 as also in all the letters, speaking in them concerning these things; in which some things are hard to comprehend, which the illiterate and unstable make crooked, as also the rest of scriptures, to their own destruction.
2PE 3:17 You then, beloved, foreknowing, guard that not by the delusion of the unlawful ones having been led away, you should fall from your own steadfastness!
2PE 3:18 But grow in the favor and knowledge of our Lord and deliverer Jesus Christ! To him be the glory both now and into day of eon. Amen.
1JO 1:1 Which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we were spectators of, and our hands handled, concerning the word of the life;
1JO 1:2 (and the life was made manifest, and we have seen, and bear witness, and announce - we report. to you the eternal life, which was with the father, and was made manifest to us;)
1JO 1:3 which we have seen and have heard we report to you, that also you should have fellowship with us; and indeed the fellowship, the one ours, is with the father, and with his son Jesus Christ.
1JO 1:4 And these things we write to you, that our joy is being full.
1JO 1:5 And this is the promise which we have heard from him, and we announce to you, that God is light, and darkness is not in any way in him.
1JO 1:6 If we should say that we have fellowship with him, and in the darkness should walk, we lie, and we do not observe the truth.
1JO 1:7 But if we should walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his son cleanses us from all sin.
1JO 1:8 If we should say that we do not have sin, we mislead ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
1JO 1:9 If we should acknowledge our sins, he is trustworthy and just that he should have forgiven to us the sins, and should have cleansed us from all iniquity.
1JO 1:10 If we should say that we sinned not, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
1JO 2:1 My sons, these things I write to you, that you should not sin. And if any should sin, we have a comforter with the father - Jesus Christ the just one.
1JO 2:2 And he is atonement for our sins; but not only for ours, but also for the whole world.
1JO 2:3 And by this we know that we have known him‚ if the commandments of his we keep.
1JO 2:4 The one saying, I know him, and his commandments is not keeping, is a liar, and the truth is not in this one.
1JO 2:5 But who ever should give heed of his word, truly in this one the love of God has been perfected. By this we know that we are in him.
1JO 2:6 The one saying to be abiding in him, ought as that one walked, also himself so to walk.
1JO 2:7 Brothers, I do not write to you a new commandment, but an old commandment which you had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which you heard from the beginning.
1JO 2:8 Again, a new commandment I write to you, which is True in him, and in you; because the darkness passes away, and the true light already shines forth.
1JO 2:9 The one saying to be in the light, and detests his brother, is in the darkness until now.
1JO 2:10 The one loving his brother abides in the light, and there is not a cause of offence in him.
1JO 2:11 But the one detesting his brother is in the darkness, and in the darkness walks, and does not know where he goes, because the darkness blinded his eyes.
1JO 2:12 I write to you, sons, for the sins have been forgiven to you through his name.
1JO 2:13 I write to you, fathers, because you have known the one from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you have overcome the wicked one. I write to you, children, because you have known the father.
1JO 2:14 I wrote to you, fathers, because you have known the one from the beginning. I wrote to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God abides in you, and you have overcome the wicked one.
1JO 2:15 Do not love the world, nor the things in the world! If anyone should love the world, the love of the father is not in him.
1JO 2:16 For every thing in the world, the desire of the flesh, and the desire of the eyes, and the ostentatiousness of existence, is not of the father, but is of the world.
1JO 2:17 And the world passes away, and the desire of it; but the one doing the will of God abides into the eon.
1JO 2:18 Children, it is the last hour; and as you heard that the antichrist comes, and now many antichrists exist; whereupon we know that it is the last hour.
1JO 2:19 From us they went forth, but they were not of us. For if they were of us, they would have remained with us. But it was that they should be made manifest that all are not of us.
1JO 2:20 And you have an anointing from the holy one, and you know all things.
1JO 2:21 I wrote not to you because you know not the truth, but because you do know it, and that every lie is not of the truth.
1JO 2:22 Who is the liar, if not the one denying, saying that, Jesus is not the Christ? This is the antichrist, the one denying the father and the son.
1JO 2:23 Every one denying the son, neither has the father.
1JO 2:24 You then, what you heard from the beginning, let it abide in you! If what you heard from the beginning should abide in you, then you shall abide in the son and in the father.
1JO 2:25 And this is the promise which he promised to us - the life eternal.
1JO 2:26 These things I wrote to you concerning the ones misleading you.
1JO 2:27 And you - the anointing which you received from him abides in you, and you have not a need that any should teach you. But as the same anointing teaches you concerning all things, and is true, and is not a lie, and as it taught you, you shall abide in him.
1JO 2:28 And now, sons, abide in him; that whenever he should be made manifest, we should have an open manner, and we should not be ashamed before him at his arrival!
1JO 2:29 If you know that he is just, you know that every one doing righteousness is engendered of him.
1JO 3:1 Behold, what kind of love the father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! On account of this the world does not know us, because it did not know him.
1JO 3:2 Beloved, now we are children of God, and not yet was it manifested what we will be. But we know that if he should be manifested, we will be likened to him; for we shall see him as he is.
1JO 3:3 And every one having this hope upon him, purifies himself, as that one is pure.
1JO 3:4 Every one committing sin, also commits lawlessness; and sin is lawlessness.
1JO 3:5 And you know that that one was made manifest that he should lift away our sins; and sin is not in him.
1JO 3:6 Anyone abiding in him sins not; anyone sinning has not seen him, nor has known him.
1JO 3:7 Sons, let no one mislead you! The one executing righteousness is just, as that one is just.
1JO 3:8 The one committing sin is of the devil; for from the beginning the devil sins. For this the son of God was made manifest, that he should loosen the works of the devil.
1JO 3:9 Anyone engendered of God does not commit sin; for his seed abides in him; and he is not able to sin, because he has been engendered by God.
1JO 3:10 In this the children of God are apparent, and the children of the devil. Every one not executing righteousness is not of God, even the one not loving his brother.
1JO 3:11 For this is the message which you heard from the beginning, that we should love one another.
1JO 3:12 Not as Cain, who was of the wicked one, and slew his brother. And for what favor did he slay him? For his works were wicked, but the ones of his brother just.
1JO 3:13 Marvel not, my brothers, if the world detests you!
1JO 3:14 We know that we have crossed over from death into life, for we love the brothers. The one not loving the brothers abides in death.
1JO 3:15 Everyone detesting his brother is a man-killer. And you know that every man-killer does not have life eternal abiding in him.
1JO 3:16 By this we have known the love of God, because that one placed his life for us; and we ought to place our lives for the brothers.
1JO 3:17 But who ever should have the livelihood of the world, and should view his brother having need, and should lock up his feelings of compassion from him, how does the love of God abide in him?
1JO 3:18 My sons, we should not love in word nor tongue, but in work and truth.
1JO 3:19 And in this we know that we are of the truth, and before him we shall yield our hearts.
1JO 3:20 For if our heart should condemn, know that God is greater than our heart, and knows all things.
1JO 3:21 Beloved, if our heart should not condemn us, we have confidence before God.
1JO 3:22 And what ever we should ask, we receive from him, for his commandments we keep, and the things pleasing before him we do.
1JO 3:23 And this is his commandment - that we should believe in the name of his son Jesus Christ, and should love one another, as he gave commandment.
1JO 3:24 And the one keeping his commandments abides in him, and he in him. And by this we know that he abides in us, by the spirit which he gave to us.
1JO 4:1 Beloved, believe not every spirit, but distinguish the spirits if they are of God! For many false prophets have gone forth into the world.
1JO 4:2 By this you know the spirit of God - every spirit which acknowledges Jesus Christ having come in flesh is of God.
1JO 4:3 And every spirit which does not acknowledge Jesus Christ having come in flesh is not of God. And this is the thing of the antichrist, which you heard that it comes; and is now in the world already.
1JO 4:4 You are sons of God, and have overcome them. For greater is the one in you, than the one in the world.
1JO 4:5 They are of the world. Because of this they speak of the world, and the world hears them.
1JO 4:6 We are of God. The one knowing God hears us; the one who is not of God, does not hear us. By this we know the spirit of the truth and the spirit of the delusion.
1JO 4:7 Beloved, we should love one another. For love is of God; and every one loving is engendered of God, and knows God.
1JO 4:8 The one not loving does not know God; for God is love.
1JO 4:9 In this was made manifest the love of God in us, that his son, the only born, God sent into the world, that we should live through him.
1JO 4:10 In this is the love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his son as an atonement for our sins.
1JO 4:11 Beloved, if thus God loved us, also we ought to love one another.
1JO 4:12 No one has seen God at any time. If we should love one another, God abides in us, and his love has been perfected in us.
1JO 4:13 By this we know that in him we abide, and he in us - that of his spirit he has given to us.
1JO 4:14 And we have seen and bear witness that the father has sent the son as deliverer of the world.
1JO 4:15 Who ever should acknowledge that Jesus is the son of God, God abides in him, and he in God.
1JO 4:16 And we have known and have believed the love which God has for us. God is love; and the one abiding in the love, abides in God, and God in him.
1JO 4:17 In this the love has been perfected with us, that we should have confidence in the day of the judgment. For as that one is, also we are in this world.
1JO 4:18 Fear is not in love, but perfect love casts fear outside; for fear holds punishment, and the one fearing has not been made perfect in love.
1JO 4:19 We love him, for he first loved us.
1JO 4:20 If anyone should say that, I love God, and should detest his brother, he is a liar. For the one not loving his brother, whom he has seen, how is he able to love God whom he has not seen?
1JO 4:21 And this commandment we have from him, That the one loving God should love also his brother.
1JO 5:1 Every one believing that Jesus is the Christ is engendered by God. And every one loving the one engendering, loves also the one being engendered by him.
1JO 5:2 By this we know that we love the children of God, whenever we love God, and should keep his commandments.
1JO 5:3 For this is the love of God, that his commandments we should keep; and his commandments are not heavy.
1JO 5:4 For every one being engendered by God overcomes the world. And this is the victory in the overcoming the world - the belief of ours.
1JO 5:5 Who is the one overcoming the world, unless it be the one believing that Jesus is the son of God?
1JO 5:6 This is the one coming by water and blood - Jesus the Christ; not by the water only, but by the water and the blood. And the spirit is the one witnessing, that the spirit is the truth.
1JO 5:7 For three are the ones bearing witness in the heaven - the father, and the word and the holy spirit; and the three in one are. And three are the ones witnessing upon the earth -
1JO 5:8 the spirit, and the water, and the blood; and the three are in the one.
1JO 5:9 If the witness of the men we receive, the witness of God is greater. For this is the witness of God which he has witnessed concerning his son.
1JO 5:10 The one believing in the son of God has the witness in himself. The one not believing in God, has made him a liar; for he has not believed in the witness which God has witnessed concerning his son.
1JO 5:11 And this is the witness - that God gave to us eternal life, and this life is in his son.
1JO 5:12 The one having the son, has life. The one not having the son of God does not have life.
1JO 5:13 These things I wrote to you, to the ones believing in the name of the son of God; that you should know that you have eternal life, and that you should believe in the name of the son of God.
1JO 5:14 And this is the confidence which we have with him, that, if anything we should ask according to his will, he hears us.
1JO 5:15 And if we know that he hears us, what ever we should ask, we know that we have the requests which we ask from him.
1JO 5:16 If anyone should see his brother sinning a sin not to death, he shall ask, and he shall give to him life - to the ones not sinning to death. There is sin to death; not concerning that do I say that he should ask.
1JO 5:17 Every unrighteousness is sin; and there is sin not to death.
1JO 5:18 We know that every one being engendered of God does not sin; but the one engendered of God keeps himself, and the wicked one does not touch him.
1JO 5:19 We know that we are of God, and the whole world is situated to the evil one.
1JO 5:20 And we know that the son of God has come, and has given to us thought, that we should know the one true, and we are in the one true, in his son Jesus Christ - this one is the True God, and the life eternal.
1JO 5:21 Sons, guard yourselves from the idols! Amen.
2JO 1:1 The elder, to the chosen lady, and to her children, whom I love in truth; and not I alone, but also all the ones knowing the truth;
2JO 1:2 on acccount of the truth abiding in us, and shall be with us into the eon.
2JO 1:3 There shall be with us favor, mercy, peace from God the father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the son of the father, in truth and love.
2JO 1:4 I rejoiced exceedingly that I have found of your children walking in truth, as we received commandment from the father.
2JO 1:5 And now I ask you, lady, not as writing to you a new commandment, but which we had from the beginning, that we should love one another.
2JO 1:6 And this is love - that we should walk according to his commandments. This is the commandment as you heard from the beginning, that in it you should walk.
2JO 1:7 For many deluded ones entered into the world not acknowledging Jesus Christ coming in flesh. This is the deluded one, and the antichrist.
2JO 1:8 Take heed of yourselves, that we should not lose what things we worked, but should accept a full wage!
2JO 1:9 Anyone violating, and not abiding in the teaching of the Christ, does not have God. The one abiding in the teaching of the Christ, this one has even the father and the son.
2JO 1:10 If anyone comes to you, and this teaching does not bring, do not receive him in the house, and do not say hail to him!
2JO 1:11 For the one saying to him, Hail, participates with his evil works.
2JO 1:12 Many things having to write to you, I do not want to with papyrus and ink. But I hope to come to you, and mouth to mouth to speak, that our joy might be filling.
2JO 1:13 The children of your chosen sister greet you. Amen.
3JO 1:1 The elder, to Gaius the beloved, whom I love in truth.
3JO 1:2 Beloved, concerning all things I make a vow for you to prosper and to be in health, as your soul prospers.
3JO 1:3 For I rejoiced exceedingly of the brothers coming and bearing witness of you in the truth, as you walk in truth.
3JO 1:4 I have not a greater joy than this, that I should hear of my children walking in truth.
3JO 1:5 Beloved, do trusting what ever you should work among the brothers, and among the strangers,
3JO 1:6 witnessing to the love of yours before the assembly; whom you shall do well having sent forward worthily of God.
3JO 1:7 For on account of his name they went forth, taking nothing from the nations.
3JO 1:8 We then ought to accept such, that we should become fellow-workers in the truth.
3JO 1:9 I wrote to the assembly; but the one enjoying being first of them - Diotrephes, does not welcome us.
3JO 1:10 On account of this, if I come, I will remind him the works which he does - evil words prating against us. And not being sufficient with these, neither he himself welcomes the brothers, and the ones wanting to he restrains, and casts them out of the assembly.
3JO 1:11 Beloved, do not imitate evil, but the good! The one doing good is of God. But the one doing evil has not seen God.
3JO 1:12 To Demetrius witness is borne by all, and by the truth itself. And we also bear witness; and you know that our witness is true.
3JO 1:13 Many things I have to write, but I do not want by ink and reed to write to you.
3JO 1:14 But I hope immediately to see you, and mouth to mouth we shall speak. Peace to you. The friends greet you. Greet the friends by name!
JUD 1:1 Jude, bondman of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to the ones having been sanctified in God the father, and of Jesus Christ being kept - called ones.
JUD 1:2 Mercy to you, and may peace and love be multiplied.
JUD 1:3 Beloved, having all diligence to write to you concerning the common deliverance, I had necessity to write to you, exhorting you to contend earnestly in the belief once delivered up to the holy ones.
JUD 1:4 For certain men crept in, the ones earlier being written about beforehand in this judgment - impious ones, transposing the favor of our God into lewdness, and God the only master, and our Lord Jesus Christ denying.
JUD 1:5 And I want to remind you, you once knowing this, that the Lord having delivered people from out of the land of Egypt, the second of the ones not believing he destroyed.
JUD 1:6 Also angels not keeping their own sovereignty, but leaving their own dwelling-place, he keeps in everlasting bonds under the infernal region for a day of great judgment.
JUD 1:7 As Sodom and Gomorrah, and the cities around them likened to these in manner, given themselves to fornication, and having gone after other flesh, are situated as an example, undergoing punishment of eternal fire.
JUD 1:8 In like manner however also these dreaming ones, indeed defile the flesh, and annul lordships, and blaspheme glorious things.
JUD 1:9 And Michael the archangel, when litigating against the devil, reasoned concerning Moses's body, did not dare to bear a blasphemous case, but said, May the Lord reproach you.
JUD 1:10 But these. indeed as many things as they know not of, they blaspheme. And as many things as they physically have knowledge of as illogical living creatures, in these things they corrupt themselves.
JUD 1:11 Woe to them, for in the way of Cain they went, and in the delusion of Balaam for a wage they shed, and in the dispute of Core perished.
JUD 1:12 These are in your love feasts as hidden reefs, feasting together among you, fearlessly tending themselves; waterless clouds being carried about by winds; unfruitful autumnal trees, twice having died, being rooted out;
JUD 1:13 wild waves of the sea foaming up their own shame; wandering stars, to whom the infernal region of darkness is being kept into the eon.
JUD 1:14 And also Enoch the seventh from Adam prophesied to these, saying, Behold, the Lord came with his holy myriads,
JUD 1:15 executing judgment against all, and to reprove all the impious ones of them concerning all the works of their impiety which they were impious, and concerning all of the hard things which impious sinners spoke against him.
JUD 1:16 These are grumblers, being discontented, going according to their desires; and their mouth speaks pompous things, admiring a person for the benefit of favor.
JUD 1:17 But you, beloved, remember the sayings being described beforehand by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ!
JUD 1:18 For they said to you, that in the end of time, there will be mockers, going according to their own desires of the impious deeds.
JUD 1:19 These are the ones separating bounds, physical, not having spirit.
JUD 1:20 But you, beloved, building up yourselves in your most holy belief, praying in holy spirit.
JUD 1:21 keep yourselves in love of God! waiting for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ, unto life eternal.
JUD 1:22 And indeed on some show mercy, scrutinizing!
JUD 1:23 And some with fear, deliver from the fire by seizing! Detesting even the inner garment being stained by the flesh.
JUD 1:24 But to him being able to keep them steady, and to stand them in front of his glory unblemished in exultation,
JUD 1:25 to the only wise God, our deliverer, be glory and greatness, might and authority, even now and into all the eons. Amen.
REV 1:1 The revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave to him, to show to his bondmen what must take place quickly. And he signified having sent by his angel to his bondman John,
REV 1:2 who testified the word of God, and the testimony of Jesus Christ, as much as indeed he saw.
REV 1:3 Blessed is the one reading, and the ones hearing the words of the prophecy, and heeding the things being written in it; for the time is near.
REV 1:4 John, to the seven assemblies in Asia. Favor to you, and peace, from the one being, and who was, and the one coming; and from the seven spirits which are before his throne;
REV 1:5 and from Jesus Christ, the trustworthy witness, the first-born of the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To the one loving us, and bathing us from our sins in his blood,
REV 1:6 and made us a kingdom - priests to God, and to his father; to him be the glory and the might into the eons of the eons. Amen.
REV 1:7 Behold, he comes with the clouds; and every eye shall see him, even the ones which stabbed him. And all the tribes of the earth shall lament over him. Yes, amen.
REV 1:8 I am even the Alpha and the Omega, beginning and end., says the Lord God, the being one, and the one who was, and the one coming - the almighty.
REV 1:9 I John, your brother, and partner in the affliction and kingdom and endurance of Christ Jesus, came to be on the island being called Patmos, on account of the word of God, and on account of the testimony of Jesus Christ.
REV 1:10 I became in spirit on the Lord's day, and heard a great sound behind me, as a trumpet,
REV 1:11 saying -, What you see, write in a scroll, and send forth to the seven assemblies - in Ephesus, and in Smyrna, and in Pergamos, and in Thyatira, and in Sardis, and in Philadelphia, and in Laodicea!
REV 1:12 And there I turned to see the voice which spoke with me. And having turned, I beheld seven golden lamp-stands;
REV 1:13 and in the midst of the seven lamp-stands one likened to son of man, being clothed with a foot length robe, and being girded to the breasts with a golden belt.
REV 1:14 And of his head - even the hairs were white as wool, white as snow; and his eyes as a flame of fire;
REV 1:15 and his feet were likened to fine brass, as in a furnace being with fire; and his voice was as a sound of many waters;
REV 1:16 and having seven stars in his right hand; and from out of his mouth a sharp double-edged broadsword going forth; and his appearance was as the sun shines in its power.
REV 1:17 And when I beheld him, I fell to his feet as dead. And he placed his right hand upon me, saying, Do not fear! I am the first and the last,
REV 1:18 and the living one, and I became dead; and behold, I am living into the eons of the eons, amen. And I have the keys of death and of Hades.
REV 1:19 Write then the things which you saw, and the things which are, and the things which are about to take place after these things!
REV 1:20 The mystery of the seven stars which you saw upon my right, and the seven golden lamp-stands - the seven stars are angels of the seven assemblies. And the seven lamp-stands which you saw are seven assemblies.
REV 2:1 To the angel of the assembly in Ephesus write! Thus says the one holding the seven stars in his right hand, walking in the midst of the seven golden lamp stands;
REV 2:2 I know your works, and your toil, and your endurance, and that you are not able to bear evil ones. And you tested the ones calling themselves apostles, and are not, and found them liars.
REV 2:3 And you bore, and have endurance, because of my name, and you tired not.
REV 2:4 But I have against you, that the first love of yours, you have left.
REV 2:5 Remember then from where you have fallen, and repent, and do the first works! But if not, I come to you quickly, and I will move your lamp stand from out of its place, unless you should repent.
REV 2:6 But this you have, that you detest the works of the Nicolaitans, which I also detest.
REV 2:7 The one having an ear, hear what the spirit says to the assemblies! To the one overcoming, I will give to him to eat from the tree of life, which is in the midst of the paradise of my God.
REV 2:8 And to the angel of the assembly in Smyrna write! Thus says the first and the last, who became dead, and lived;
REV 2:9 I know your works, and affliction, and poorness, (but you are rich ) and the blasphemy of the ones calling themselves to be Jews, and are not, but a synagogue of Satan.
REV 2:10 By no means fear what things you are about to suffer! Behold indeed, the devil is about to throw some of you in prison, that you should be tested; and you shall have affliction ten days. Be trustworthy unto death, and I will give to you the crown of life!
REV 2:11 The one having an ear, hear what the spirit says to the assemblies! The one overcoming in no way should be injured by the second death.
REV 2:12 And to the angel of the assembly in Pergamos write! Thus says the one having the sharp double-edged broadsword.
REV 2:13 I know your works, and where you dwell, where the throne of Satan is; and you hold my name, and denied not the belief of me in the days in which Antipas my trustworthy witness was, who was killed among you, where Satan dwells.
REV 2:14 But I have against you a little. That you have there ones holding the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to throw an obstacle before the sons of Israel, to eat things sacrificed to idols, and to commit harlotry.
REV 2:15 Thus also you have ones holding the teaching of the Nicolaitans in like manner.
REV 2:16 Repent! But if not, I come to you quickly, and I shall wage war with them by the broadsword of my mouth.
REV 2:17 The one having an ear, hear what the spirit says to the assemblies! To the one overcoming I will give to him to eat from the manna being hid, and will give to him a white small stone, and upon the small stone a new name being written, which no one knew except the one receiving.
REV 2:18 And to the angel of the assembly in Thyatira write! Thus says the son of God, the one having his eyes as a flame of fire, and his feet likened to fine brass.
REV 2:19 I know your works, and love, and belief, and service, and your endurance, and your works - the last more than the first.
REV 2:20 But I have against you, - a little. that you allow your woman Jezebel, which calls herself a prophetess, and teaches and misleads my bondmen to commit harlotry, and to eat things sacrificed to an idol.
REV 2:21 And I gave to her time that she should repent; and she wanted not to repent from her harlotry.
REV 2:22 Behold, I throw her into a bed, and the ones committing adultery with her into great affliction, unless they should repent from her works.
REV 2:23 And I will kill her children by plague; and they shall know in all the assemblies that I am the one searching the kidneys and hearts. And I will give to you each according to your works.
REV 2:24 And to you I say, to the rest in Thyatira, as many as have not this teaching, and who knew not the deeps of Satan, as they speak; I will not throw upon you another load.
REV 2:25 Only what you have hold until of when ever I shall come!
REV 2:26 And the one overcoming, and the one giving heed until the end of my works, I will give to him authority over the nations.
REV 2:27 And he shall tend them with a rod of iron; as the vessels made of clay shall be broken; as I also have received from my father.
REV 2:28 And I will give to him the early morning star.
REV 2:29 The one having an ear, hear what the spirit says to the assemblies!
REV 3:1 And to the angel of the assembly in Sardis write! Thus says the one having the seven spirits of God, and the seven stars; I know your works, that you have a name, that you live - but you are dead.
REV 3:2 Become being vigilant, and support the rest which you are about to throw off! For I have not found your works being fulfilled before my God.
REV 3:3 Remember then how you received and heard, and give heed, and repent! If then you should not be vigilant, I will come upon you as a thief, and in no way should you know what hour I will come upon you.
REV 3:4 But You have a few names in Sardis which tainted not their garments; and they shall walk with me in white; for they are worthy.
REV 3:5 The one overcoming, this one shall be covered with white garments; and in no way shall I wipe away his name from out of the book of life; and I will acknowledge his name before my father, even in the presence of his angels.
REV 3:6 The one having an ear, let him hear what the spirit says to the assemblies!
REV 3:7 And to the angel of the assembly in Philadelphia write! Thus says the holy one, the true, the one having the key of David; the one opening, and no one locks, and locks, and no one opens.
REV 3:8 I know your works. Behold, I have put before you a door being opened, which no one is able to lock it. For you have a little power, and gave heed to my word, and denied not my name.
REV 3:9 Behold, I give from out of the synagogue of Satan of the ones saying themselves to be Jews, and are not, but lie. Behold, I will make them that they shall come and do obeisance before the feet of you, and they should know that I love you;
REV 3:10 in that you kept the word of my endurance, and I will keep you from the hour of the test about to come upon the entire world, to test the ones dwelling upon the earth.
REV 3:11 I come quickly. Hold what you have, that no one should take your crown!
REV 3:12 The one overcoming, I will make him a column in the temple of my God, and outside in no way should he go forth any longer. And I will write upon him the name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, (of the new Jerusalem, which comes down from out of the heaven from my God,) and my new name.
REV 3:13 The one having an ear, hear what the spirit says to the assemblies!
REV 3:14 And to the angel of the assembly in Laodicea write! Thus says the Amen, the trustworthy and true witness, the source of the creation of God.
REV 3:15 I know your works, that you are neither cold nor boiling hot; ought you should be cold or boiling hot.
REV 3:16 Thus, because you are lukewarm, and not boiling hot nor cold, I am about to vomit you from out of my mouth.
REV 3:17 For you say that, I am rich, and am enriched, and have no need; and you know not that you are the miserable, and the pitiable, and poor, and blind, and naked.
REV 3:18 I advise you to buy gold from me purified by fire, that you should be rich; and that you should be covered with white garments, and the shame of your nakedness should not be made manifest; and rub collyrium upon your eyes, that you should see!
REV 3:19 I, as many as I should be fond of, I reprove and correct. Be zealous then, and repent!
REV 3:20 Behold, I stand at the door, and I knock. If any should hear my voice, and should open the door, even I will enter to him, and have supper with him, and he with me.
REV 3:21 The one overcoming I will give to him to sit with me on my throne, as even I overcame and sat with my father on his throne.
REV 3:22 The one having an ear, hear what the spirit says to the assemblies!
REV 4:1 After these things I saw, and behold, a door being opened in the heaven. And the first voice which I heard was as a trumpet speaking with me, saying, Ascend here, and I will show to you what must take place after these!
REV 4:2 And immediately I existed in spirit. And behold, a throne was situated in the heaven, and upon the throne one sitting,
REV 4:3 likened in sight to a jasper stone, and sardius. And a rainbow was round about the throne, likened to the sight of emerald.
REV 4:4 And round about the throne were twenty-four thrones. And upon the thrones I saw the twenty-four elders sitting down, being covered in white garments; and upon their heads golden crowns.
REV 4:5 And from out of the throne went forth lightnings, and voices, and thunders. And seven lamps of fire were burning before his throne, which are seven spirits of God.
REV 4:6 And before the throne was as a sea of glass, likened to ice. And in the midst of the throne, and round about the throne, were four living creatures full of eyes in front and behind.
REV 4:7 And the first living creature was likened to a lion, and the second living creature was likened to a calf, and the third living creature having the face as a man, and the fourth living creature was likened to a flying eagle,
REV 4:8 and the four living creatures one by one of them having each six wings round about; and from inside being full of eyes. And they have not rest day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, holy, holy, holy, holy, holy, holy, Lord God almighty, the one who was, and the one being, and the one coming.
REV 4:9 And whenever the living creatures shall give glory, and honor, and thankfulness to the one sitting upon the throne living into the eons of the eons,
REV 4:10 the twenty four elders shall fall before the one sitting upon the throne, and shall do obeisance to the one living into the eons of the eons, and shall cast their crowns before the throne, saying,
REV 4:11 Worthy are you - the Lord and our God, the holy one, to receive the glory, and the honor, and the power; for you created all things, and by your will they are and were created.
REV 5:1 And I saw upon the right of the one sitting upon the throne a scroll being written on inside and outside, being sealed up with seven seals.
REV 5:2 And I saw a strong angel proclaiming with a great voice, Who is worthy to open the scroll, and to loose its seals?
REV 5:3 And no one was able in the heaven, nor upon the earth, nor underneath the earth, to open the scroll, nor to look at it.
REV 5:4 And I wept much, for no one worthy was found to open and to read the scroll, nor to look at it.
REV 5:5 And one from the elders says to me, Weep not! Behold, the lion overcame, the one being from the tribe of Judah, the root of David, to open the scroll and to loose the seven seals of it.
REV 5:6 And I saw, and behold, in the midst of the throne and of the four living creatures, and in the midst of the elders, a lamb standing as being slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven spirits of God being sent into all the earth.
REV 5:7 And he came and took a scroll from out of the right hand of the one sitting upon the throne.
REV 5:8 And when he took the scroll, the four living creatures and twenty-four elders fell before the lamb, each having harps, and bowls made of gold being full of incenses, which are the prayers of the holy ones.
REV 5:9 And they sang a new ode, saying, Worthy are you to take the scroll, and to open its seals; for you were slain, and you bought us to God by your blood, from out of every tribe, and tongue, and people, and nation.
REV 5:10 And you made them kings and priests to our God; and they reign upon the earth.
REV 5:11 And I saw, and I heard as a sound of many angels round about the throne, and of the living creatures, and of the elders - and was the number of them myriads of myriads, and thousands of thousands;
REV 5:12 saying with a great voice, Worthy is the lamb having been slain, to receive power, and riches, and wisdom, and strength, and honor, and glory, and blessing.
REV 5:13 And every creature which is in the heaven, and upon the earth, and underneath the earth, and which are upon the sea, and all the ones in them, I heard, saying, to the one sitting upon the throne, and to the lamb, Blessing, and honor, and glory, and might, to the eons of the eons.
REV 5:14 And the four living creatures saying the Amen. And the twenty four elders fell and did obeisance.
REV 6:1 And I saw that the lamb opened one of the seven seals. And I heard one of the four living creatures saying, as a sound of thunder, Come and see!
REV 6:2 And I saw, and behold, a white horse; and the one sitting upon it having a bow. And was given to him a crown. And he went forth overcoming, and that he should overcome.
REV 6:3 And when he opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature saying, Come and see!
REV 6:4 And went forth another horse, fiery. And to the one sitting upon it was given to him to take peace from the earth, that they shall slay one another; and a great sword was given to him.
REV 6:5 And when he opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature saying, Come and see! And I saw, and behold, a black horse; and the one sitting upon it having a yoke balance scale in his hand.
REV 6:6 And I heard a voice in the midst of the four living creatures saying, A choenix of grain for a denarius, and three choenices of barley for a denarius; and the olive oil and the wine do not wrong.
REV 6:7 And when he opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature saying, Come and see!
REV 6:8 And I saw, and behold, a pale horse; and the one sitting upon it, his name was Death, and Hades followed after him. And was given to him authority upon the fourth of the earth, to kill by broadsword, and by hunger, and by plague, and by the wild beasts of the earth.
REV 6:9 And when he opened the fifth seal, I saw underneath the altar the souls of men having been slain because of the word of God, and because of the testimony of the lamb which they had.
REV 6:10 And they cried out with a great voice, saying, How long, O master, the holy and the true, do you not judge and avenge our blood of the ones dwelling upon the earth?
REV 6:11 And white robes were given to each; and it was said to them, that they should rest yet a time, until of which they should be fulfilled - both their fellow-servants and their brothers about to be killed, as also they.
REV 6:12 And I saw. And when he opened the sixth seal, even a great earthquake took place; and the sun became black as a sackcloth made of hair, and the moon became as blood;
REV 6:13 and the stars of the heaven fell unto the earth, as a fig-tree casts its immature figs being shaken by a great wind.
REV 6:14 And the heaven had been separated as a scroll being rolled; and every mountain and island from out of their places were shaken.
REV 6:15 And the kings of the earth, and the great men, and the commanders of thousands, and the rich, and the mighty ones, and every bondman, and every free man, hid themselves in the caves and in the rocks of the mountains.
REV 6:16 And they say to the mountains and to the rocks, Fall upon us, and hide us from the face of the one sitting upon the throne, and from the anger of the lamb!
REV 6:17 For is come the great day of his anger - and who is able to stand?
REV 7:1 And after this I saw four angels standing upon the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, that they should not blow wind upon the earth, nor upon the sea, nor upon any tree.
REV 7:2 And I saw another angel having ascended from the rising of the sun, having the seal of the living God. And he cried out with a great voice to the four angels, to whom it was given to them to injure the earth and the sea,
REV 7:3 saying, Injure not the earth, nor the sea, nor the trees, until we seal the bondmen of our God upon their foreheads.
REV 7:4 And I heard the numbers of the ones having been sealed - a hundred and forty four thousand having been sealed, from out of every tribe of the sons of Israel.
REV 7:5 From out of the tribe of Judah - twelve thousand having been set seal upon; from out of the tribe of Reuben - twelve thousand having been set seal upon; from out of the tribe of Gad - twelve thousand having been set seal upon;
REV 7:6 from out of the tribe of Asher - twelve thousand having been set seal upon; from out of the tribe of Naphtali - twelve thousand having been set seal upon; from out of the tribe of Manasseh - twelve thousand having been set seal upon;
REV 7:7 from out of the tribe of Simeon - twelve thousand having been set seal upon; from out of the tribe of Levi - twelve thousand having been set seal upon; from out of the tribe of Issachar - twelve thousand having been set seal upon;
REV 7:8 from out of the tribe Zebulun - twelve thousand having been set seal upon; from out of the tribe of Joseph - twelve thousand having been set seal upon; from out of the tribe of Benjamin - twelve thousand having been set seal upon.
REV 7:9 After these things I saw, and behold, a great multitude, which no one was able to count from out of every nation, and tribes, and peoples, and languages, standing before the throne, and before the lamb, wearing white robes, and palms in their hands.
REV 7:10 And they cry out a great voice, saying, Deliverance to our God sitting upon the throne, and to the lamb.
REV 7:11 And all the angels stood round about the throne, and the elders, and the four living creatures, and fell before the throne upon their faces, and did obeisance to God,
REV 7:12 saying, Amen, blessing, and glory, and wisdom, and thankfulness, and honor, and power, and strength to our God into the eons of the eons, amen.
REV 7:13 And answered one of the elders, saying to me, These wearing the white robes, who are they, and from where came they?
REV 7:14 And I said to him, O my Lord, you know. And he said to me, These are the ones coming from out of the great affliction, and they washed their robes, and whitened them in the blood of the lamb.
REV 7:15 Because of this they are before the throne of God, and they serve to him day and night in his temple. And the one sitting upon the throne shall encamp over them.
REV 7:16 They shall not hunger any more, nor thirst any more, nor in any way shall the sun fall upon them, nor any sweltering heat.
REV 7:17 For the lamb in the midst of the throne shall tend them. And he shall guide them unto springs of waters of life. And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.
REV 8:1 And when he opened the seventh seal, there became quietness in the heaven about a half-hour.
REV 8:2 And I saw the seven angels which stand before God; and were given to them seven trumpets.
REV 8:3 And another angel came and stood at the altar, having a golden censer; and many incenses were given to him, that he should offer it with the prayers of all the holy ones upon the golden altar before the throne.
REV 8:4 And the smoke of the incenses ascended, with the prayers of the holy ones, from out of the hand of the angel, before God.
REV 8:5 And the angel took the censer, and filled it from out of the fire of the altar, and cast unto the earth. And there became sounds, and thunders, and lightnings, and an earthquake.
REV 8:6 And the seven angels having the seven trumpets prepared themselves that they should trump.
REV 8:7 And the first trumped; and came to pass hail and fire being mixed in blood, and was cast unto the earth; and the third of the earth was incinerated, and all green grass was incinerated.
REV 8:8 And the second angel trumped; and it was as a great burning mountain cast into the sea; and the third of the sea became blood.
REV 8:9 And the third of the creatures in the sea died, the ones having lives; and the third of the ships were utterly destroyed.
REV 8:10 And the third angel trumped; and a great star fell from out of the heaven, burning as a lamp, and it fell upon the third of the rivers, and upon the springs of the waters.
REV 8:11 And the name of the star is called Absinthium; and the third of the waters became into absinthium; and many of the men died because of the waters, for they were made bitter.
REV 8:12 And the fourth angel trumped; and the third of the sun was struck, and the third of the moon, and the third of the stars; that a third of them should be darkened, and the day should not appear for a third of it, and the night in like manner.
REV 8:13 And I saw and heard one eagle flying in mid-heaven, saying with a great voice, Woe, woe woe, to the ones dwelling upon the earth because of the remaining sounds of the trumpet of the three angels being about to trump.
REV 9:1 And the fifth angel trumped; and I saw a star falling from out of the heaven unto the earth; and was given to him the key of the well of the abyss.
REV 9:2 And he opened the well of the abyss; and ascended smoke from out of the well, as smoke of a furnace burning; and the sun and the air were darkened by the smoke of the well.
REV 9:3 And from out of the smoke came forth locusts unto the earth. And authority was given to them, as the scorpions of the earth have authority.
REV 9:4 And it was said to them that they should not injure the grass of the earth, nor any green thing, nor any tree; except the men only who have not the seal of God upon their foreheads.
REV 9:5 And was given to them that they should not kill them, but that they should be tormented five months. And their torment was as the torment of a scorpion, whenever it should smite a man.
REV 9:6 And in those days men shall seek death, and in no way shall they find it; and shall desire to die, and death shall flee from them.
REV 9:7 And the representations of the locusts were likened to horses being prepared for war; and upon their heads as golden crowns, and their faces as faces of men.

REV 19:9 And he says to me, Write! Blessed are the ones being called to the supper of the wedding of the lamb. And he says to me, These words of God are true.
REV 19:10 And I fell before his feet to do obeisance to him. And he says to me, See that you do not! I am your fellow-servant, and of your brothers having the testimony of Jesus; to God do obeisance! For the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of the prophecy.
REV 19:11 And I saw the heaven being opened, and behold a white horse; and the one sitting upon him being called Trustworthy and True, and with righteousness he judges and wages war.
REV 19:12 And his eyes a flame of fire, and upon his head many diadems; having names being written, and a name being written which no one knows except himself;
REV 19:13 and wearing a cloak being dipped in blood, and his name is called, The Word of God.
REV 19:14 And the militaries in the heaven followed him upon white horses, being clothed in clean white fine linen.
REV 19:15 And from out of his mouth goes forth a sharp double-edged broadsword, that with it he should strike the nations. And he shall tend them with a rod of iron. And he treads the wine vat of the wine of the rage of the wrath of God almighty.
REV 19:16 And he has upon the cloak and upon his thigh a name being written, King of kings, and Lord of lords.
REV 19:17 And I saw one angel standing in the sun; and he cried out with a great voice, saying to all the birds flying in mid-heaven, Come, and be gathered together for the great supper of God;
REV 19:18 that you should eat flesh of kings, and flesh of commanders of thousands, and flesh of strong men, and flesh of horses, and of the ones sitting upon them, and flesh of all, both free and bondmen, both small and great.
REV 19:19 And I saw the wild beast, and the kings of the earth, and their militaries being gathered together to make war with the one sitting upon the horse, and with his military.
REV 19:20 And the wild beast was laid hold of, and with this one the false prophet performing the signs before him, in which he misled the ones receiving the imprint of the wild beast, and the ones doing obeisance to his image. The two were thrown living into the lake of fire burning with sulphur.
REV 19:21 And the rest were killed by the broadsword of the one sitting upon the horse, by the one going forth from out of his mouth. And all the birds were filled of their flesh.
REV 20:1 And I saw an angel coming down from out of the heaven, having the key of the abyss and a great chain in his hand.
REV 20:2 And he seized the dragon, the ancient serpent, who is the devil, and Satan, the one misleading the entire inhabitable world, and bound him a thousand years,
REV 20:3 and cast him into the abyss, and locked, and set a seal upon him, that he should not mislead the nations any more, until the thousand years be fulfilled. And after these things it is necessary to loose him a little time.
REV 20:4 And I saw thrones, and they sat upon them, and judgment was given to them - even the souls of the ones hewn with an axe on account of the testimony of Jesus, and on account of the word of God, and whoever did not do obeisance to the wild beast, nor to his image, and did not take the imprint upon their forehead, and upon their hand; and they lived and reigned with the Christ a thousand years.
REV 20:5 And the rest of the dead did not live until the thousand years should be fulfilled. This is the first resurrection.
REV 20:6 Blessed and holy is the one having part in the first resurrection; over these the second death has not authority, but they will be priests of God and of the Christ, and shall reign with him a thousand years.
REV 20:7 And whenever the thousand years should be fulfilled, Satan shall be loosed from out of his prison,
REV 20:8 and shall come forth to mislead the nations, in the four corners of the earth - Gog and Magog, to gather them together for the war - which the number is as the sand of the sea.
REV 20:9 And they ascended upon the width of the earth, and encircled the camp of the holy ones, and the city being loved. And fire came down from the heaven from God, and it devoured them.
REV 20:10 And the devil misleading them was cast into the lake of fire and sulphur, where the wild beast and the false prophet are, and shall be tormented day and night into the eons of the eons.
REV 20:11 And I saw a great white throne, and the one sitting upon it, from whose face the heaven and the earth fled; and a place was not found for them.
REV 20:12 And I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne; and scrolls were opened. And another scroll was opened, which is the one of life. And the dead were judged from out of the things being written in the scrolls, according to their works.
REV 20:13 And the sea gave up the ones dead in her; and death and Hades gave up the ones of their dead. And they were judged each according to their works.
REV 20:14 And death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death - the lake of fire.
REV 20:15 And if any should not be found written in the book of life he was cast into the lake of fire.
REV 21:1 And I saw a new heaven and a new earth. For the first heaven and the first earth passed away; and the sea is not any longer.
REV 21:2 And the holy city, new Jerusalem, I saw coming down from God out of the heaven, being prepared as a bride being adorned to her husband.
REV 21:3 And I heard a great voice from out of the heaven saying, Behold, the tent of God is with men, and he shall pitch a tent with them, and they will be his people, and God himself will be with them.
REV 21:4 And he shall wipe away every tear from their eyes; and death will not be any more, nor mourning, nor crying, nor misery - it shall not be any more; for the first things departed.
REV 21:5 And said the one sitting upon the throne, Behold, I make all things new. And he says to me, Write! for these words are true and trustworthy.
REV 21:6 And he said to me, It has taken place - the alpha and the omega, the beginning and end. I will give to the one thirsting from out of the spring of the water of life without charge.
REV 21:7 The one overcoming shall inherit all; and I will be to him God, and he will be to me a son.
REV 21:8 But to the timid ones, and unbelieving ones, and sinful ones, and ones being abhorrent, and murderers, and fornicators, and dealers in potions, and idolaters, and to all the liars, their part is in the lake burning with fire and sulphur, which is the second death.
REV 21:9 And one came from the seven angels, having the seven bowls being full of the seven last calamities, and spoke with me, saying, Come, I will show to you the wife, the bride of the lamb.
REV 21:10 And he carried me away in spirit upon a great and high mountain, and showed to me the great city, holy Jerusalem, coming down from out of the heaven from God,
REV 21:11 having the glory of God. Her luminescence was likened to precious stone, as to jasper stone, sparkling;
REV 21:12 having a wall great and high, and having twelve gatehouses. And upon the gatehouses were twelve angels, and names being inscribed, which is of the twelve tribes of the sons of Israel.
REV 21:13 From the east three gatehouses; and from the north three gatehouses; and from the south three gatehouses; and from the west three gatehouses.
REV 21:14 And the wall of the city had twelve foundations, and upon them twelve names of the twelve apostles of the lamb.
REV 21:15 And the one speaking with me had a golden reed measure, that he should measure the city, and her gatehouses, and her wall.
REV 21:16 And the city lies four-cornered, and her length is as much as the width. And he measured the city by the reed unto twelve thousand stadiums. The length, and the width, and the height of her were equal.
REV 21:17 And he measured her wall a hundred forty four cubits, the measure of a man, which is, of an angel.
REV 21:18 And the edifice of her wall was jasper, And the city was pure gold, likened to pure glass.
REV 21:19 And the foundations of the wall of the city were adorned with every precious stone. The first foundation was jasper, the second sapphire, the third chalcedony, the fourth emerald,
REV 21:20 the fifth sardonyx, the sixth carnelian, the seventh chrysolite, the eighth beryl, the ninth topaz, the tenth chrysoprase, the eleventh hyacinth, the twelfth amethyst.
REV 21:21 And the twelve gatehouses were twelve pearls, while each one of the gatehouses was of one pearl. And the square of the city was pure gold, as transparent glass.
REV 21:22 And I saw not a temple in her; for the Lord God almighty is her temple, and the lamb.
REV 21:23 And the city has not a need of the sun, nor of the moon, that they should shine forth in her; for the glory of God gives her light, and her lamp is the lamb.
REV 21:24 And the nations shall walk by her light. And the kings of the earth shall bring the glory and their honor unto her.
REV 21:25 And her gatehouses in no way should be locked by day; for night shall not be there.
REV 21:26 And they shall bring the glory and the honor of the nations unto her.
REV 21:27 And in no way should enter into her anything common, and committing an abomination, and a lie; only the ones being written in the scroll of the life of the lamb.
REV 22:1 And he showed to me a pure river of water of life, bright as crystal, going forth from out of the throne of God and of the lamb.
REV 22:2 In the midst of her square, and of the river, from this side here and from that side there, was a tree of life producing twelve fruits, each by month rendering its fruit; and the leaves of the tree were for treatment of the nations.
REV 22:3 And every great curse shall not be any longer. And the throne of God and of the lamb will be in her; and his bondmen shall serve to him.
REV 22:4 And they shall see his face; and his name is upon their foreheads.
REV 22:5 And night shall not be there; and they have not a need of a lamp, and the light of the sun; for the Lord God enlightens them. And they shall reign into the eons of the eons.
REV 22:6 And he said to me, These words are trustworthy and true. And the Lord God of the spirits of the prophets sent his angel to show to his bondmen what must take place quickly.
REV 22:7 Behold, I come quickly. Blessed is the one giving heed to the words of the prophecy of this scroll.
REV 22:8 And I John am the one hearing and seeing these things. And when I heard and saw, I fell to do obeisance before the feet of the angel showing to me these things.
REV 22:9 And he says to me, See that you do not! For I am your fellow-servant, and of your brothers the prophets, and of the ones giving heed to the words of this scroll - to God do obeisance!
REV 22:10 And he says to me, You should not set a seal upon the words of the prophecy of this scroll; for the time is near.
REV 22:11 The one wronging, let him wrong still! And the filthy one, let him be filthy still! And the just one, let him do righteousness still! And the holy one, let him be sanctified still!
REV 22:12 Behold, I come quickly, and my wage is with me, to render to each as his work will be.
REV 22:13 I am the alpha and the omega, the beginning and end, the first and the last.
REV 22:14 Blessed are the ones observing his commandments, that their authority will be unto the tree of life, and by the gatehouses they should enter into the city.
REV 22:15 Outside are the dogs, and the administers of potions, and the fornicators, and the murderers, and the idolaters, and every one being fond of and committing a lie.
REV 22:16 I Jesus sent forth my angel to testify to you these things unto the assemblies. I am the root and the race of David, the bright early morning star.
REV 22:17 And the spirit and the bride say, Come! And the one hearing let say, Come! And the one thirsting, let come! The one wanting, let take water of life without charge!
REV 22:18 I bear witness to every one hearing the words of the prophecy of this scroll. If anyone should add upon these, God will place upon him the calamities being written in this scroll.
REV 22:19 And if anyone should remove from the words of the scroll of this prophecy, may God remove his part from the tree of life, and from the holy city, of the things having been written in this scroll.
REV 22:20 The one testifying these things says, Yes, I come quickly. Amen. Yes, come O Lord Jesus!
REV 22:21 The favor of our Lord Jesus Christ be with all the holy ones. Amen.
